en.description: Activations cluster around practice (medical professional practice), pleading (a legal statement or complaint), and massagers in one patent text. The first two are constrained by domain and collocational context; the three lack a clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: practice

patterns.name: pleading

patterns.domain: Legal decisions, legal discussions, and related web text

patterns.name: massagers in patent specifications

en.description: Activation is concentrated on practice (practice or professional activity in medicine) and pleading (a plea, legal argument, or pleading in law); there is also a singleton response to the patent-domain word massagers.

patterns.name: Legal meaning of pleading

patterns.name: massagers as a field-of-invention term

3_149.description: 激活集中在 practice（医学领域的实践或从业）和 pleading（法律中的恳求、诉辩或诉状）；另对专利领域词 massagers 有单例反应。

patterns.name: practice 及其领域修饰语

patterns.name: pleading 的法律含义

patterns.name: massagers 的发明领域术语
patterns.context: 专利文本的发明领域部分，描述按摩器及其具体类型。

en.description: Activations cluster around two types of words: practice and its collocations in medical titles or abstracts, and pleading in legal and historical narratives. The two contexts and word senses differ.

patterns.name: practice-related phrases
patterns.context: Appears in titles or abstracts to refer to clinical practice, professional practice, or practice patterns in medicine/healthcare; includes «practice patterns», «university-based practice», «clinical practice», «nursing practice» and «General practice».

patterns.name: pleading and its inflections
patterns.context: Appears in legal case narratives or legal standards, including litigation before a guilty plea, petitioning on someone’s behalf, parties’ pleas, and «pleading standard».
patterns.domain: Court decisions, legal discussions; also historical narratives

3_149.description: 激活集中在两类词语：医学标题或摘要中的 practice 及其搭配，以及法律和历史叙述中的 pleading。两类语境和词义不同。

patterns.name: practice 相关词组
patterns.context: 出现在标题或摘要中，指医学/医疗服务中的临床实践、执业或实践模式；包括 «practice patterns»、«university-based practice»、«clinical practice»、«nursing practice» 和 «General practice»。

patterns.name: pleading 及其词形
patterns.trigger: «pleading»；[2] 中为 «pleading»，另有 «pleading» 的相关诉讼语境
patterns.context: 出现在法律案件叙述或法律标准中，包括认罪前的诉讼程序、代人申诉、当事人恳求，以及 «pleading standard»。
patterns.domain: 判决书、法律论述；另有历史叙述

en.description: The main pattern is a strong response to the word practice in medical titles or body text, covering various medical specialties and practice-related expressions. There is also localized activation on pleading in legal contexts and on the word Teenagers, with no clear connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: practice as a word or part of a phrase
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the word practice, regardless of preceding modifiers or following nouns: examples include regional practice patterns, general practice, clinical practice, practice doctorate, and Family Practice Residency. Capitalization and sentence position vary.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts; titles and body text

patterns.name: pleading in a judicial context
patterns.context: Appears in a criminal case narrative describing a defendant pleading before filing a motion to suppress; unlike the other medical contexts.

patterns.name: Teenagers
patterns.context: Activation falls on the latter part of the tokenized word Teenagers, in a title about teenagers’ choices regarding whether family members are present; no clear practice trigger is evident.

3_149.description: 主要模式是医学标题或正文中对 practice 一词的强响应，涵盖多种医学专科与实践相关表达。另有法律语境的 pleading 和青少年一词的局部激活，未显示与主模式明确相关。

patterns.name: practice 作为词或短语的一部分
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在 practice 一词上，不论其前置修饰语或后续名词：如 regional practice patterns、general practice、clinical practice、practice doctorate、Family Practice Residency。大小写和句中位置不固定。

patterns.name: 司法语境中的 pleading
patterns.context: 出现在刑事案件叙述中，描述被告在提出 suppress 动议之前认罪；与其余医学语境不同。

patterns.name: Teenagers
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的单词 Teenagers 后半部分，所在标题谈青少年对家人是否在场的选择；未见明确的 practice 触发。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the medical professional-practice term “practice” and the legal term “pleading”; there are also responses to Azure technical strings, clinical imaging descriptions, and NIH funding identifier RO1. Each trigger is quite specific in its source text, with limited cross-domain commonality.

patterns.name: practice and professional practice
patterns.context: Refers to practice, professional practice, or practice patterns in a professional or institutional context; sometimes forms a phrase with a preceding domain term.

patterns.name: legal pleading
patterns.context: Appears in legal contexts concerning guilty pleas, complaints, or legal charges; activation is concentrated on the word.

patterns.name: Azure technical strings
patterns.context: Appears as part of a cloud-service domain name, SSH key parameter, or API documentation path.

patterns.name: Medical clinical and imaging terminology
patterns.context: Describes clinical outcomes after carbon monoxide poisoning and clinical imaging methods such as CT; no clear practice or pleading trigger is present.

patterns.name: RO1 funding identifier
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of ongoing laboratory research and funding sources.

3_149.description: 激活主要落在“practice”这一医学专业实践词及法律词“pleading”上；另对 Azure 技术字符串、临床成像表述和 NIH 资助编号 RO1 有反应。各触发在原文中较具体，跨领域共性有限。

patterns.name: practice 及专业实践

patterns.name: 法律 pleading

patterns.name: Rapamycin and stress-memory consolidation

patterns.name: RO1 funding identifier
patterns.context: Appears in an NIH project description, referring to a previously funded RO1.

patterns.name: Image file path/marker

patterns.name: Geriatric clinical problem-solving

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the Hungarian negation nem, and also on specific subword fragments in English words such as nematic, analog, and autoregulatory; fine is also activated in two contexts, legal fines and kinematic detail.

patterns.name: Hungarian “nem”
patterns.context: In Hungarian text, appears at the negation word “nem”; the following content is not fixed.

patterns.name: nem in nematic
patterns.context: In English technical text, the trigger is the initial subword nem in nematic, not the independent Hungarian negation.

patterns.name: analog
patterns.context: Collocations such as analog received signal and analog front-end appear in descriptions of received signals and front ends.

patterns.name: autoregulatory
patterns.context: Triggered when the medical term autoregulatory, referring to the regulatory capacity of renal afferent arterioles, is split.

patterns.name: legal fine
patterns.context: Repeated occurrences of restitution fine and the fine in legal texts, in contexts involving enforcement of fines and ability to pay.

patterns.name: kinematic fine
patterns.context: fine modifies kinematic details, referring to subtle details of a motion trajectory.

3_149.concept: nem 子词及 fine/术语片段

patterns.name: better in outcome evaluations

patterns.name: Sentence-initial example introduction

patterns.name: Imperative operation prompt

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to over in comparisons and dominance relations, especially superiority, dominant, predominates, and priority over; also occurs in effect comparisons such as better/than and in contexts of degree emphasis.

patterns.name: over in comparative or superiority relations
patterns.context: Describes an entity as superior, prioritized, dominant, or advantageous relative to another; often adjacent to a comparative predicate.
patterns.domain: Expository texts in law, philosophy, military affairs, medicine, physics, and other fields

patterns.name: Comparative effects and better outcomes
patterns.context: Compares the effects of two methods, arguments, or treatments, indicating which is better or lower in degree.
patterns.domain: Psychology, medicine, research abstracts, and academic discussion

patterns.name: Expressions emphasizing degree or quantity
patterns.context: Emphasizes degree, scale, or impact in a statement; not all instances constitute a direct comparison.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical, physical-science, and academic exposition

patterns.name: Relative predominance of neural processes
patterns.context: Uses over to compare the relative predominance of two opposing processes.

patterns.name: Legal statements of priority
patterns.context: Legal provisions stipulate that one procedure or right takes precedence over another.

patterns.name: Unexplained trigger
patterns.context: Activation occurs in a project progress narrative about “made substantial progress… developing better methods,” with no clear over comparative structure.

3_149.description: 主要对比较与支配关系中的 over 强烈响应，尤其是 superiority、dominant、predominates、priority over；也出现在 better/than 等效果比较及程度强调语境。

patterns.name: 比较或优势关系中的 over
patterns.context: 描述某对象相对于另一对象占优、优先、支配或具有优势；常与比较性谓语相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律、哲学、军事、医学、物理等说明性文本

patterns.name: 比较效果与更好结果
patterns.context: 比较两种方法、论证或治疗的效果，指出哪一种更好或程度更低。
patterns.domain: 心理学、医学、研究摘要与学术论述

patterns.name: 程度或数量的加强表达
patterns.context: 在陈述中强调程度、规模或影响；并非都构成直接比较。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学、物理及学术说明

patterns.name: 神经过程的相对 predominance
patterns.context: 以 over 比较两类相反过程的相对占优。

patterns.name: 法律优先权表述
patterns.trigger: “«priority» «over» any prior or pending annexation ordinance”
patterns.context: 法律条文中规定某种程序或权利优先于另一项程序。

patterns.name: 未充分解释的触发
patterns.trigger: 具体激活成分不清；可能涉及比较句式或局部词汇搭配
patterns.context: 激活出现在以“made substantial progress… developing better methods”为内容的项目进展叙述中，未见清楚的 over 比较结构。

en.description: Strongly activates mainly when then introduces a subsequent step, result, or narrative across legal, patent, medical, and programming text; there are also legal remedies, SQL filtering, and isolated over and so substring activations.

patterns.name: then marking a subsequent step or result
patterns.context: Appears between preceding and following steps in an action, process, operation, or narrative, introducing a subsequent action, result, or stage.
patterns.domain: Legal text, patent descriptions, medical abstracts, programming Q&A, and general technical explanations

patterns.name: Judgment outcomes and remedy instructions
patterns.context: In legal decision narratives, a court reverses or remands a case and orders an amount to be determined or adjusted, or another subsequent measure to be taken.

patterns.name: Explanation of filtering results in SQL queries
patterns.context: Explains the difference between two query forms, describing how row combinations are generated first and then filtered.

patterns.name: Stepwise assembly or manufacturing process
patterns.context: Assembly, stacking, or similar steps are completed first, followed by further assembly or electrical connection.

patterns.name: Action transitions in procedural steps
patterns.context: First perform the preceding operation, then carry out the next step, such as lifting or observing.

patterns.name: Transition from code to narrative
patterns.context: After code or markup snippets, first-person narrative continues with a description of subsequent findings.

patterns.name: Local high activation in other legal clauses
patterns.context: A statute describes one type of claim as predominating over others; high activation falls on the repeated preposition over, not then.

patterns.name: Local high activation in other medical error descriptions
patterns.context: Describes increased error when a fetal head shape is more elliptical; high activation falls on a substring within a word.

3_149.description: 主要在 then 引出后续步骤、结果或叙述时强激活，跨法律、专利、医学与编程文本；另有判决补救、SQL 筛选及孤立的 over、so 子串激活。

patterns.name: then 标记后续步骤或结果
patterns.context: 出现在动作、流程、运算或叙述的前后步骤之间，引出后续动作、结果或阶段。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、专利说明、医学摘要、编程问答及一般技术说明

patterns.name: 判决结果及补救指令
patterns.context: 法律判决叙述中，法院撤销或发回案件，并要求确定、调整金额或采取后续措施。

patterns.name: SQL 查询中的筛选结果说明
patterns.context: 解释两种查询写法的差异，描述先生成行组合再筛选。

patterns.name: 分步装配或制造流程
patterns.trigger: « then»9 the« sub»1assembly；« then»9« electrically»1 connecting
patterns.context: 先完成组装、堆叠等步骤，再进行后续装配或电气连接。

patterns.name: 操作步骤中的动作衔接
patterns.context: 先执行前述操作，再进行提起、观察等下一步动作。
patterns.domain: 专利说明、StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 连接代码与叙述的转折推进
patterns.context: 代码或标记语言片段之后，以第一人称叙述继续说明后续发现。

patterns.name: 其他法律从句中的局部高激活
patterns.trigger: « over»10 the claim or claims« over»9 which
patterns.context: 法律条文描述某类请求相对于其他请求占主导；高激活落在重复介词 over，而非 then。

patterns.name: 其他医学误差描述中的局部高激活
patterns.context: 描述胎儿头部形状更椭圆时误差增加；高激活落在单词内部的子串。

en.concept: Relations of superiority against a comparative baseline
en.description: Primarily sensitive to comparative relations introduced by over, especially structures expressing dominance, increase, improvement, or preference; also shows strong activation in a forum passage around JSON/newline boundaries and remnants of a Q&A format.

patterns.name: Superiority/comparative structures after over
patterns.context: over introduces the compared entity or baseline; commonly describes a claim, process, result, or choice as superior to, increased over, or improved relative to another. The specific activation falls on over, and strength may vary with collocation and context.
patterns.domain: Expository texts in law, neurophysiology, clinical/biomedical research, market reports, and other fields

patterns.name: JSON/code-block boundaries and formatting remnants
patterns.context: Forum Q&A content follows the end of JSON or similar structured text; activation occurs on brackets, newlines, Q&A labels, and tokenized word fragments, without the same over-comparison structure as the main pattern.
patterns.domain: StackExchange forum text, JSON/code formatting remnants

3_149.concept: 比较基准中的优势关系
3_149.description: 主要对 over 引出的比较关系敏感，尤其是表示占优、增加、改善或偏好的结构；另在一段论坛语料中，对 JSON/换行边界及问答格式残片有强激活。

patterns.trigger: “predominates« over»10 the claim”，“predominance« over»10 inhibiting”，“«increase»3« over»9”，“«improvement»5« over»8”，“«preferred»1« over»8”

en.description: Mainly responds to over expressing comparison against a baseline, often co-occurring with increase, growth, or changes in degree; also covers decreases and legal dominance. One narrative use of rolling is difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: “over” comparison structures
patterns.context: Indicates increase, advantage, or excess relative to a baseline, prior count/period, or another object; also appears in the legal dominance structure “predominates over the claim(s)”.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, legal text, encyclopedias, and general explanations

patterns.name: Increase in quantity or degree
patterns.context: Nearby text discusses increases or changes in numbers, expression, popularity, cell growth, or degree; some examples also involve “over” comparison structures.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, institutional reports, general explanations

patterns.name: Decrease in quantity or opposite trend
patterns.context: A decrease or directional contrast relative to another process appears; there are only a few examples, which do not necessarily express numerical growth.

patterns.name: Rolling action in a non-trend narrative
patterns.context: A person rolls or tumbles in a narrative; there is no clear semantic connection to quantity-change or comparison vocabulary.

3_149.description: 主要响应表示相对基准比较的 over，常与增加、增长或程度变化共现；也涵盖下降及法律支配关系，另有一例叙事性 rolling，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: “over”比较结构
patterns.context: 表示相对于基准、先前计数/时期或另一对象的增加、优势或超出；也出现在法律文本中“predominates over the claim(s)”这一支配关系结构。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、法律文本、百科及一般说明

patterns.name: 数量或程度增加
patterns.context: 附近讨论数值、表达、流行度、细胞生长或程度的上升/变化；部分例子与“over”比较结构同时出现。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、机构报告、一般说明

patterns.name: 数量下降或相反趋势
patterns.context: 出现下降或相对于另一过程的方向性对比；仅有少数例子，未必表达数值增长。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、神经生理学摘要

patterns.name: 非趋势性叙事中的滚动动作
patterns.context: 人物在叙事中滚动或翻滚；与数量变化/比较词汇缺乏明显语义联系。

en.concept: Multiple word forms and phrase fragments
en.description: Activation is sporadic: punched in legal accounts of conflict, increase over in comparisons of increases, the legal-purpose phrase so as to, and several intra-word so substrings (ellipsoid, subsoil, psoas, Ipso facto).

patterns.name: Punching action
patterns.context: In descriptions of conflicts or testimony, punched is followed by the person struck; in 1, activation is strongest on punched and the following object; in 6, punched and twice activate.

patterns.name: over before increase
patterns.context: When comparing prices, recent values, or experimental yields, over occurs after increase and introduces the comparative baseline.

patterns.name: as to phrase
patterns.context: Expresses the purpose of modifying a consent decree in legal documents; activation is concentrated on as and to, especially as.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in ellipsoid
patterns.context: The word ellipsoid is split into tokens, with so as the activated intra-word fragment; examples occur in contexts of fetal head measurement error and geometric symmetry.

patterns.name: Spelling fragment so
patterns.context: Activation falls on the so substring in different words—subsoil, psoas, and Ipso facto—with no clear shared semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Patent background, muscle research abstracts, music encyclopedia

3_149.description: 激活模式分散：法律冲突叙述中的 punched，比较增幅时 increase over，法律目的短语 so as to，以及若干词内 so 子串（ellipsoid、subsoil、psoas、Ipso facto）。

patterns.name: 拳击动作
patterns.context: 描述人物冲突或证词时，动词 punched 后接受击者；1 中 punched 及后续宾语周边激活最强，6 中 punched 与 twice 激活。

patterns.name: increase 前的 over
patterns.context: 比较价格、近期数值或实验产量时，over 出现在 increase 后，引出比较基准。

patterns.name: as to 短语
patterns.context: 法律文书中表达同意令修改的目的；激活集中在 as、to，尤其 as。

patterns.name: 椭球词内部片段
patterns.context: 单词 ellipsoid 被分词切分，so 是词内激活片段；分别出现在胎儿头部测量误差和几何对称性语境。

patterns.name: 拼写片段 so
patterns.context: 激活落在不同词中的 so 子串，分别属于 subsoil、psoas、Ipso facto；没有明显共同语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、肌肉研究摘要、音乐百科

en.concept: Action verbs and local subword fragments
en.description: The clearest activations are on punch/punched: these refer both to hitting a person and to making holes. It also responds to bump(ed) into meaning an accidental encounter, and to bump meaning an upward numerical adjustment. Other highlights include local fragments of over, subsoil, and ellipsoid, with unclear semantic connections.

patterns.name: Boxing or hitting
patterns.context: Refers to punching or repeatedly hitting a person; often appears in sentences narrating conflicts, testimony, or physical attacks.

patterns.name: Punching holes
patterns.context: punch/punched refers to using a tool to punch holes in cards or materials, with the holes corresponding to months.

patterns.name: Phrasal verb meaning an accidental encounter
patterns.context: bumped into is followed by a person or thing and expresses an accidental encounter; the affix and preposition may be marked separately.

patterns.name: Numerical increase
patterns.context: bump combines with up and takes a percentage value as its object, indicating an increase in a metric.

patterns.name: Price increase
patterns.context: The activation falls on the word over; the sentence compares prices in recent years and says they are significantly higher than in previous years.

patterns.name: Subsoil word fragment
patterns.context: The activation falls within the segmented word subsoil (seabed soil); there is no clear meaning related to hitting or accidental encounters.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text on marine seismic data acquisition

patterns.name: Ellipsoid term fragment
patterns.context: The activation falls within the word ellipsoid, in a discussion of fetal head shape and measurement error.

3_149.description: 激活最明显的是 punch/punched：既指击打人，也指打孔；另对 bump(ed) into 偶遇及 bump 数值上调有反应。其余高亮包含 over、subsoil 与 ellipsoid 的局部词片，语义联系不明。

patterns.name: 拳击或击打
patterns.context: 表示对人实施拳击或连续击打；常出现在叙述冲突、证词或身体受攻击的句子中。

patterns.name: 穿孔、打孔
patterns.context: punch/punched 指用工具在卡片或材料上打孔，孔与月份对应。

patterns.name: 偶遇的短语动词
patterns.context: bumped into 后接人或事物，表达偶然遇到；词缀与介词可能分开标记。

patterns.name: 数值上调
patterns.context: bump 与 up 连用，宾语是百分比数值，表示提高指标。

patterns.name: 价格上涨
patterns.context: 激活落在 over 一词上；句子比较近年价格，表达价格显著高于往年。

patterns.name: 海底构词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的 subsoil（海底土层）词内；没有明显的击打或偶遇含义。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本，海洋地震数据采集

patterns.name: 椭圆形术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 ellipsoid（椭球形）词内，讨论胎儿头部形状与测量误差。

en.description: Activation is scattered across rape-accusation reporting, legal phrasing, Bulgarian aid and support, document separators, Java annotations, biomedical growth descriptions, and political quotations, with no unified, stable semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Terms related to rape allegations

patterns.name: Legal orders and procedural phrasing

patterns.name: Bulgarian political/aid vocabulary
patterns.context: Bulgarian sentences discuss opportunities for aid or support for something

patterns.name: Document layout and separators

patterns.name: Inflate in a Java annotation

patterns.name: Cell-culture growth expressions

patterns.name: Speech and opposition in a political quotation

en.description: Activations are scattered across substrings within English words, Bulgarian Cyrillic fragments, and code markers. English examples repeatedly include bumped/stoops, but show no unified semantics or stable context; the feature may primarily respond to local word fragments or tokenization forms.

patterns.name: Fragments within Cyrillic words
patterns.context: Markers fall within Bulgarian words, including legal and EU policy contexts

patterns.name: Miscellaneous fragments within English words

en.concept: Multilingual detection of local word fragments
en.description: Activation occurs on local word fragments in multilingual text: method names and calls in code, intra-word fragments in Russian, colloquial phrases in English emails, and sporadic English and German expressions; topics and styles are not uniform.

patterns.name: Identifiers and method calls in program code
patterns.context: Local fragments near method names, component names, or calls in code snippets activate; no specific programming language or fixed API is required.
patterns.domain: StackExchange/GitHub technical Q&A and Java/Android code

patterns.name: Russian intra-word and inter-word fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Russian text, activation falls on subword fragments within or across adjacent words; content concerns legal discussion or Android Q&A, with no unified semantic word class evident.
patterns.domain: Russian text from EuroParl and StackExchange

patterns.name: Colloquial expressions in email phrases
patterns.context: Idiomatic colloquial phrases or personal expressions in English emails; activation is concentrated on words and fragments within the phrases.

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments in English sentences
patterns.context: Word fragments activate in ordinary English prose or titles, but the examples have no clear shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Opening of a German formal address
patterns.context: Greetings and speech phrasing at the start of a formal German address; in this example, activation is distributed across intra-word fragments.

3_149.description: 激活分布于多语种文本的局部词片：代码中的方法名与调用、俄语词内片段、英文邮件口语短语，以及零散英语和德语表达；主题与文体并不统一。

patterns.name: 程序代码中的标识符与方法调用
patterns.context: 代码片段中，方法名、组件名或调用附近的局部词片被激活；不要求特定语言或固定 API。

patterns.name: 俄语词内及词间片段

patterns.domain: EuroParl 与 StackExchange 的俄语文本

patterns.name: 邮件短语中的口语表达
patterns.context: 英文邮件中的惯用口语短语或个人交流表达；激活集中在短语中的词及词片。

patterns.name: 英语句子中的零散词片
patterns.context: 普通英文叙述或标题中出现词片激活，但这些例子之间没有明确共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻标题/声明及法律判决文本

patterns.name: 德语礼仪性讲话开头
patterns.context: 德语正式讲话开头的问候与发言措辞；本例激活分布于词内片段。

en.concept: Multiple syntactic uses of so, alongside word-fragment triggers
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on so and its syntactic combinations, covering commands, degree, purpose, result, and manner. There are also triggers on SQL UPDATE/SET code and a within-word fragment of Apostolic.

patterns.name: Syntactic connective uses of so / so far / so that
patterns.context: Connects or introduces subsequent constituents in different syntactic environments, expressing a command, degree, purpose, result, or manner; the meanings are not entirely the same across examples.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including legal texts, fiction, patents, argumentative prose, and religious commentary

patterns.name: UPDATE in an SQL update statement
patterns.context: In database code, UPDATE is followed by a table name and SET specifies field assignments.

patterns.name: Affix fragment within a religious term
patterns.context: The triggering fragment occurs at the beginning of the segmented word Apostolic; the context discusses church offices and institutions.

3_149.concept: so 的多种句法用法，兼有词片段触发
3_149.description: 主要激活集中在 so 及其句法搭配，涵盖命令、程度、目的、结果、方式等不同用法；另有 SQL 的 UPDATE/SET 代码触发，以及 Apostolic 的词内片段激活。

patterns.name: so / so far / so that 的句法连接用法
patterns.trigger: «so»10 order；«so»10 many；«so»10 as to；«so»9 far；«so»9 that；«so»9 abiding；«so»9 under its breath
patterns.context: 在不同句法环境中连接或引出后续成分：表示命令、程度、目的、结果或方式；各段的意义并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 法律、小说叙述、专利、议论及宗教评论等多种文体

patterns.name: SQL 更新语句中的 UPDATE
patterns.context: 数据库代码中，UPDATE 后接表名并以 SET 指定字段赋值。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答／SQL 代码

patterns.name: 宗教词语内部的词缀片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在拆分后的 Apostolic 一词开头；上下文讨论教会官职与制度。

en.description: Activation is scattered across common English function words, fragments such as over/to, legal narrative words, proper nouns, and cross-token word forms; sporadic fragments also occur in Bulgarian, Portuguese, and code/operational text. The examples lack consistent semantic or grammatical trigger conditions.

patterns.name: English over/to at token boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on common English words or fragments such as over, to, and coming, in sentences containing prepositions, infinitives, or compound words; there is no consistent syntactic function
patterns.domain: English texts including legal prose, fiction, and business emails

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in terms or word forms
patterns.context: Markers fall within words split across tokens, or near technical terms, proper nouns, loanwords, and affixes; they do not form a stable semantic category
patterns.domain: Code, lists of language names, Bulgarian text

patterns.name: English function words and phrase continuations
patterns.context: In ordinary English sentences, activation is scattered across conjunctions, pronouns, prepositions, articles, or common phrase components, with no fixed collocation
patterns.domain: Code comments, business emails, StackExchange, fiction

patterns.name: Highly distinctive words in legal texts
patterns.context: In legal narratives or litigation documents, activation falls on ordinary narrative words, word-form fragments, or interrogative words that differ in semantics and syntax

patterns.name: Portuguese procedural fragments
patterns.context: In European Parliament speeches, Portuguese words are split into several tokens; some markers happen to fall within words, others on common words

patterns.name: English technical instructions and markup
patterns.context: In technical descriptions or operating steps, programming-related words, formatting markers, and command words all activate, with no single common trigger

patterns.name: Proper nouns and company information in business emails
patterns.context: When emails mention companies, people, or places, activation occurs on fragments of proper nouns and surrounding common words

patterns.name: Fragments in English quoted Q&A
patterns.context: In dialogue quoted in legal records, activation occurs on questions, quotation punctuation, and ordinary words, with no specific pragmatic pattern evident

3_149.concept: 零散的詞片段與常見詞
3_149.description: 激活散見於英語常見功能詞、over/to 等片段、法律敘述詞、專名和跨 token 詞形；另見保加利亞語、葡萄牙語及程式／操作文本中的零散片段。各段缺乏一致語義或語法觸發條件。

patterns.name: 英語 over/to 的 token 邊界
patterns.trigger: «over»3«coming»9；«Gl»2«ancing»1« over»5« to»9；«going»1« over»3« to»9；«to»2« vacate»5；«within»1 three« months»3
patterns.context: 激活落在 over、to、coming 等常見英語詞或詞片段上，所在句子包含介詞、動詞不定式或複合詞；沒有一致的句法功能
patterns.domain: 法律散文、小說、商務郵件等英語文本

patterns.name: 術語或詞形中的切分片段
patterns.context: 標記落在跨 token 切分的詞內部，或技術詞、專名、外來語及詞綴附近；並未形成穩定的詞義類別
patterns.domain: 程式碼、語言名稱清單、保加利亞語文本

patterns.name: 英語功能詞與片語續接
patterns.trigger: « and»5« then»2；« you»2« and»1；«'d»1« like»3« to»4；«a»2 follow«up»1«:»1
patterns.context: 普通英語句子中，激活分散於連接詞、代詞、介詞、冠詞或常見片語成分，未見固定搭配
patterns.domain: 程式碼註解、商務郵件、StackExchange、小說

patterns.name: 法律文本中的高辨識詞
patterns.context: 法律敘述或訴訟文件中，激活落在普通敘述詞、詞形片段或問句詞上，彼此語義與句法不同

patterns.name: 葡萄牙語議事程序詞片段
patterns.context: 歐洲議會發言中，葡萄牙語詞語被切成若干 token；部分標記恰好落在詞內，部分落於常見詞

patterns.name: 英語技術指令與標記
patterns.context: 技術說明或操作步驟中，程式相關詞、格式標記與命令詞均有激活，缺少單一共同觸發點
patterns.domain: GitHub 內容、軟體操作問答

patterns.name: 商務郵件中的專名與公司資訊
patterns.context: 郵件談及公司、人物或地點時，激活出現在專名的片段及其周邊常見詞

patterns.name: 英語引文問答中的詞片段
patterns.context: 法律紀錄所引述的對話中，激活出現在問句、引述標點及普通詞語，未顯示特定語用模式
patterns.domain: 法律文件中的對話引文

en.description: Responds mainly to the ending fragment of Bulgarian “относно”; it also activates on English “over to”, a subword fragment of the author name Fanutti, and a subword of Russian “вызовом”. These span languages and genres, with no unified semantics evident.

patterns.name: The word “относно” and the following word
patterns.context: Bulgarian parliamentary sentences contain “относно” (regarding); activation is concentrated in the latter part of the word, followed by the topic under discussion.

patterns.name: English phrase “over to”
patterns.context: “over to” means going somewhere or sending something/someone somewhere; examples include going to pick someone up, going to someone’s home, and going to India.

patterns.name: “Fanutti” fragment in a reference
patterns.context: Appears in an author name in a microbiology paper citation; activation falls on a subword fragment of the name.
patterns.domain: Academic references in USPTO background materials

patterns.name: Subword in Russian “вызовом”
patterns.context: An Android programming explanation describes returning an address using setResult(); the Russian word “вызовом” (call/by calling) appears.

3_149.description: 主要响应保加利亚语“относно”的词尾片段；另在英语“over to”、作者名 Fanutti 的子词片段及俄语“вызовом”的子词处激活，跨语言与文体，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: “относно”一词及其后续词
patterns.context: 保加利亚语议会句子中出现“относно”（关于），激活集中在该词后半部，后接议题内容。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，保加利亚语政治/政策文本

patterns.name: 英语短语“over to”
patterns.context: “over to”表示前往某处或把某物/某人送往某处；包括去接人、去某人家、去印度等具体移动语境。
patterns.domain: 英语邮件与叙述性文字

patterns.name: 参考文献中的“Fanutti”片段
patterns.context: 出现在微生物学论文引文中的作者姓名，激活落在姓名的子词片段上。
patterns.domain: USPTO 背景材料中的学术参考文献

patterns.name: 俄语“вызовом”中的子词
patterns.context: Android 编程说明中描述通过 setResult() 返回地址，出现俄语“вызовом”（调用/通过调用）一词。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答，俄语文本

en.description: The strongest shared pattern is the tokenized form относно (“regarding”) in Bulgarian parliamentary text; other activations fall separately on English over to, anything, and the club name PAOK, spanning languages and contexts and not reducible to a single trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Bulgarian относно construction
patterns.context: In Bulgarian parliamentary text, относно means “regarding/about” and often introduces a topic or report subject; the three strongest examples all continue with a topic after this word

patterns.name: English over to
patterns.context: to immediately follows over, forming an expression of movement, transfer, or going somewhere; activation falls on to

patterns.name: English do anything
patterns.context: anything follows do in a sentence about an action or choice

patterns.name: Repeated English anything in questions
patterns.context: In courtroom testimony dialogue, anything follows did in a rhetorical quotation

patterns.name: Football club abbreviation PAOK
patterns.context: In a Greek footballer's career narrative, PAOK is the name of the club he transferred to

3_149.description: 最强的共同模式是保加利亚语议会文本中被切分标注的 относно（“关于”）；其余激活分别落在英语 over to、anything 及俱乐部名 PAOK，跨语言和语境，无法归为同一触发模式。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语“относно”结构
patterns.context: 保加利亚语议会文本中，表示“关于/就……而言”的 относно，常接议题或报告主题；最强的三个实例都在该词后继续展开主题
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语议会发言

patterns.name: 英语 over to
patterns.context: over 后紧接 to，构成移动、迁移或前往某处的表达；激活落在 to 上

patterns.name: 英语 do anything
patterns.context: anything 出现在 do 之后，处于关于行为或选择的句子中

patterns.name: 英语 anything 的问句复现
patterns.context: 法庭证词对话中，anything 位于 did 后，出现在反问式引语里
patterns.domain: 法律判决文本中的对话

patterns.name: 足球俱乐部缩写 PAOK
patterns.context: 希腊足球运动员生涯叙述中，PAOK 是其转会目的地俱乐部名称
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科体育传记

en.description: The most prominent activations are on to in various syntactic environments (including introducing destinations), and on structures related to said/anything in legal Q&A. There are also expressions of degree and quantity, Bulgarian within-word fragments, and sporadic lexical activations; overall, there is no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Strong activation on to
patterns.context: Activation falls on infinitival to or prepositional to indicating movement/transfer; neighboring words vary with tokenization.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including emails, technical articles, historical accounts, and literary texts

patterns.name: Q&A structure with said anything
patterns.context: Occurs in questions within direct quotations, or in a narrator’s report of a question about whether anything was said; often adjacent to words such as said and did.

patterns.name: Expressions related to scale or quantity
patterns.context: Describes quantity, degree, or magnitude of growth; the specific meanings and syntactic environments are not all the same.

patterns.name: Fragments within Bulgarian words
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on character fragments within Bulgarian word forms, especially words containing the sequence “вз”; more specific lexical or semantic regularities are uncertain.

patterns.name: to before a date
patterns.context: In an itinerary or timeline, to introduces a destination, but activation there is weak.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations in ordinary vocabulary
patterns.context: These words are marked in their respective contexts, but no stable shared syntactic or semantic condition is evident; «things» recurs in the fragments.

3_149.description: 最突出的是多种句法环境中的 to（含目的地引介），以及法律问答里 said/anything 相关结构；另有程度、数量表达，保加利亚语词内片段和零散词汇激活，整体并无统一语义。

patterns.name: to 的强调激活
patterns.context: 激活落在不定式 to 或表示移动/转移的介词 to；紧邻词因分词方式不同而有所差异。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括邮件、技术文章、历史记述与文学文本

patterns.name: said anything 的问答结构
patterns.context: 出现在直接引语中的疑问句，或叙述者转述对“是否说了什么”的询问；常与 said、did 等词相邻。

patterns.name: 规模或数量相关表达
patterns.context: 描述数量、程度或增长规模；具体词义与句法环境不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 历史/医学散文、技术文章

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在保加利亚语词形内部的字符片段，尤其是含“вз”序列的词；更具体的词汇或语义规律不确定。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会保加利亚语文本

patterns.name: 日期前的 to
patterns.context: 行程或时间线中，to 引出目的地；但该处激活较弱。

patterns.name: 普通词汇中的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些词在各自语境中被标记，但未见稳定的共同句法或语义条件；«things»在片段中重复出现。

en.concept: Common function words and phrase structures
en.description: Activations are distributed across anything interrogative structures, several adverbial or derivational uses of so, the phrasal verb down, and few indicating a small quantity; they span legal, conversational, narrative, and web texts, without a unified, stable syntax.

patterns.name: anything interrogative structures
patterns.context: anything occurs in questions or indirect-question/conditional contexts, often with do/did/need to or said; especially common in quoted testimony and everyday conversation.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony, email conversations, and forum Q&A

patterns.name: Emphatic or resultative use of so
patterns.context: so occurs before a verb as an emphatic/resultative adverb, forms so-called, or means “even so”; these are not a single fixed syntax.
patterns.domain: Legal provisions, patent texts, historical narratives, legal opinions

patterns.name: Directional/resultative use of down
patterns.context: down follows a verb phrase, meaning to pursue someone all the way or chase downward.

patterns.name: Few as a quantity/degree word
patterns.context: few indicates a small quantity and modifies a plural noun.

3_149.concept: 常见功能词与短语结构
3_149.description: 激活分散于 anything 疑问结构、so 的数种副词或构词用法、短语动词 down，以及表示少量的 few；跨法律、对话、叙事和网络文本，缺乏统一稳定句法。

patterns.name: anything 疑问结构
patterns.context: anything 出现在疑问句或间接疑问/条件语境中，常与 do/did/need to 或 said 连用；引号内证词和日常对话尤多。
patterns.domain: 法律证词、邮件对话及论坛问答

patterns.name: so 的强调或结果用法
patterns.context: so 位于动词前作强调/结果副词，构成 so-called，或表示“即便如此”；并非同一固定句法。
patterns.domain: 法律条文、专利文本、历史叙述、法律意见

patterns.name: down 的方向/结果用法
patterns.context: down 紧随动词短语，表示追赶到底或向下追逐。
patterns.domain: 第一人称叙事、网络文章

patterns.name: 少量/程度词 few
patterns.context: few 表示数量少，修饰复数名词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across various structures: function words such as so, to, and that and their syntactic environments; the forms thing(s); category labels and email header fields; and line-break formatting. There are also biochemical terms and within-word segmentation fragments. The samples show no single stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: “so that” result/purpose relation
patterns.context: “so” occurs in expressions of manner/requirement in legal provisions, expressions of causal result, or the “so that” construction; the word senses and syntax are not entirely the same.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, history books, patent texts

patterns.name: to expressing movement and direction
patterns.context: Occurs in directional, transfer, or purpose constructions; segment [1] also contains “as to which”, but with a different use.
patterns.domain: Forums, emails, Wikipedia, legal and narrative texts

patterns.name: that and relative-clause/clause linking
patterns.context: Introduces a clause or connects a proposition; segment [1] marks “that”, and segment [8] also marks “that”.

patterns.name: Forms of Things / thing
patterns.context: In narrative dialogue, characters complain about or describe “things” that happen; segment [4] contains capitalized “Things” in a quotation.
patterns.domain: Fictional dialogue, quoted testimony in legal records

patterns.name: Category labels in category headings
patterns.context: Wikipedia entries list category headings consecutively at the end; highlights also cover fragments within category names.

patterns.name: Column names and email header fields
patterns.context: A forwarded email chain or email header contains a subject field, surrounded by recipient lists and multiple forwarding markers.

patterns.name: Fragment within a protein term
patterns.context: Highlights fall within segmented biochemical terms and methodological descriptions rather than at clear whole-word boundaries.

patterns.name: Text formatting or line-break markers
patterns.context: Fragments include line breaks, blank lines, or formatting such as Markdown code fences; the samples alone do not establish whether the markers themselves or nearby text trigger activation.

patterns.name: Subword fragments and unclassifiable fragments
patterns.context: Highlights fall on subwords, proper names, or abbreviations, without consistent, verifiable semantic conditions across segments.

3_149.description: 激活分散于多种结构：so、to、that 等功能词及其句法环境，thing(s) 词形、分类与邮件头标签、换行格式；另有生化术语和词内切分片段。样本未显示单一稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: “so that”条件关系
patterns.trigger: «so»（段[1]的“he shall so state”、段[2]的“will so blunt”、段[8]的“so that”）
patterns.context: “so”处于法律规定中的方式/要求表达、因果结果表达，或“so that”结构中；触发词义和句法并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、历史书籍、专利文本

patterns.name: to 的跨越与方向表达
patterns.trigger: «to»（“to … AWS”“flow over to mops”“over to the Parliament”“to try it again”）
patterns.context: 出现在趋向、转移或目的结构中；段[1]也有“as to which”，但用途不同。
patterns.domain: 论坛、邮件、维基百科、法律及叙事文本

patterns.name: that 及关系/从句连接
patterns.context: 用于引出从句或承接命题；段[1]标记的是“that”，段[8]也标记了“that”。

patterns.name: Things / thing 词形
patterns.context: 叙事对话中围绕“things”抱怨或描述发生之事；段[4]是引述中大写的“Things”。
patterns.domain: 小说对话、法律记录中的证词引述

patterns.name: 类别标题中的分类标签
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾连续列出分类标题；高亮同时涉及分类名中的片段。

patterns.name: 列名与邮件头字段
patterns.context: 邮件转发链或邮件头中出现主题字段，周围有收件人列表及多重转发标记。

patterns.name: 蛋白质术语内部片段
patterns.context: 高亮落在被拆分的生化术语及方法描述内部，而非清晰的完整词边界。

patterns.name: 文本格式或换行标记
patterns.context: 片段含有换行、空行或 Markdown 代码围栏等格式化内容；仅凭样本难以确定是标记本身还是邻近文本触发。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、论坛帖子、邮件

patterns.name: 切分词片与无法归类片段
patterns.context: 高亮落在词内子词、专名或缩写周围，缺少跨段一致且可确认的语义条件。

en.concept: Local formatting and phrase features in heterogeneous texts
en.description: Activation patterns vary: commonly found in HTML button and label structures containing btn-style classes, and also in paper figure markers, legal quoted Q&A, dosage narratives, and survey articles; some frontend passages discuss clicking to toggle states. No single semantic explanation accounts for the pattern.

patterns.name: HTML buttons and btn classes
patterns.context: In HTML/Vue and similar code, button tags or class attributes contain btn-style classes; often adjacent to attributes, closing tags, or Bootstrap-style variants.

patterns.name: HTML tag and attribute structures
patterns.context: Tags, attributes, and nesting in markup or template code; a button class need not be present.

patterns.name: Figure markers and caption metadata
patterns.context: Figure image Markdown/LaTeX markers in paper text, followed by captions, labels, or dimensions; captions may also contain specific topic words.

patterns.name: Q&A or dialogue in quotations
patterns.context: Direct quotations or Q&A in narrative text, especially questions containing anything; speaker actions may occur around the quotation.

patterns.name: Clicking to toggle UI state
patterns.context: Discussion of clicks, asynchronous requests, or binding changes to toggle the visibility of page elements; some passages also provide button code.

patterns.name: Dosage and drug effects
patterns.context: Narratives about taking a substance at a given dose and its effects on the body or appetite.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg historical exposition or health-related prose

patterns.name: Survey respondents and household appliances
patterns.context: An article recounts a team surveying respondents about ideal household appliances.

3_149.concept: 异质文本中的局部格式与词组特征
3_149.description: 激活模式多样：常见于含 btn 类的 HTML 按钮及标签结构，也见论文图像标记、法律引语问答、剂量叙述和调查文章；部分前端段落谈点击切换状态。无法由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: HTML 按钮及 btn 类
patterns.context: HTML/Vue 等代码中，按钮标签或 class 属性包含 btn 样式类；常邻接属性、闭合标签或 Bootstrap 风格变体。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 前端问答、GitHub 代码

patterns.name: HTML 标签与属性结构
patterns.context: 标记语言或模板代码中的标签、属性及嵌套结构；不要求出现按钮类。

patterns.name: 图表标记及图注元数据
patterns.context: 论文文本中的图像 Markdown/LaTeX 标记，后接图注、标签或尺寸；其中图注还可能含具体主题词。

patterns.name: 引述中的问答或话语
patterns.context: 叙述文本中的直接引语或问答，尤其问句中出现 anything；引语周围可有说话人动作。

patterns.name: 点击切换界面状态
patterns.context: 讨论点击、异步请求或绑定变化，以切换页面元素的显示状态；部分段落同时给出按钮代码。

patterns.name: 剂量与药物影响
patterns.context: 叙述按剂量服用某物及其对身体或食欲的影响。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 历史性说明或健康相关散文

patterns.name: 调查受访者与家用电器
patterns.context: 文章转述团队对受访者进行调查，讨论理想家用电器。
patterns.domain: 社会调查或大众文化文章

en.concept: Structural markers and specialized symbols in technical texts
en.description: Activations occur around figure and caption markers, SQL keywords and concatenated statements, formal legal phrasing, and several unrelated paper-specific names and mathematical notation; these lack a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Figure and caption markers
patterns.context: Activations often occur near figures, captions, labels, or dimension attributes; figure topics differ across texts
patterns.domain: ArXiv scientific papers and their marked-up figure content

patterns.name: SQL statements and keywords
patterns.context: Occurs in SQL queries, stored procedures, or update statements, often alongside column names, table names, and string concatenation

patterns.name: Legal appellate-condition phrasing
patterns.context: Formal legal sentences state orders, conditions, and standards of appeal; triggers are sporadic, involving both common function words and legal terms

patterns.name: Mathematical or proper-name markers in technical texts
patterns.context: Occurs across different paper topics: hyperbolic-space figures, antinuclei, LOCC terminology, and mathematical lattice notation; there is no consistent topic or local syntactic condition
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and quantum information papers

3_149.concept: 技术文本中的结构标记与专用符号
3_149.description: 激活分布在图表及图注标记、SQL 关键字与拼接语句、法律正式措辞，以及若干彼此不同的论文专名和数学记号附近；这些内容缺少统一的语义主题。

patterns.name: 图表与图注的标记
patterns.trigger: «data-label», «fig», «width», «Figure», «shows»，以及图像文件名或图注结构
patterns.context: 激活常出现在图、图注、标签或尺寸属性附近；不同文本中的图表主题并不相同
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文及其标记化图表内容

patterns.name: SQL 语句及关键字
patterns.context: 处于 SQL 查询、存储过程或更新语句中，常伴随列名、表名和字符串拼接

patterns.name: 法律上诉条件措辞
patterns.trigger: «that», «such», «shall», «so»，以及 “controlling question of law”“immediate appeal”等短语
patterns.context: 正式法律句式中陈述命令、条件及上诉标准；触发较分散，既有常见功能词也有法律术语

patterns.name: 技术文本中的数学或专名标记
patterns.context: 出现在不同论文主题中：双曲空间图示、反氦粒子、LOCC 术语及数学格记号；没有一致的主题或局部句法条件
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及量子信息论文

en.description: Activation segments show varied local patterns: figure/image markers in academic texts, and figure descriptions in mathematics, physics, and astronomy. There are also specific strings in legal texts, patents, code, and Wikipedia categories. No unified semantics links the different contexts.

patterns.name: Figure markers and image-embedding syntax
patterns.context: Near figure references, captions, or image-embedding code, often in ArXiv text; also appears in structured markers in other documents.

patterns.name: Strong activation on the specific English word so
patterns.context: In [4], it occurs in “to soothe damaged skin”; in [8], in “so-called”; in [9], in “shall so order”. The meanings and syntactic functions differ, so these cannot be assigned to the same semantics.

patterns.name: Banks category terms and lists of places/institutions
patterns.context: Banks is connected to names of multiple countries or regions in consecutive Wikipedia category headings.

patterns.name: Path wildcard in ASP.NET route templates
patterns.context: A URL template in C# route-registration code, containing a resource placeholder, an extension, and a wildcard that captures the remaining path.

patterns.name: Graph theory and algebraic structure terms
patterns.context: Describes a partially ordered set and its lattice structure, accompanied by mathematical formulas and figure references.

patterns.name: Cross-examination and motive in legal testimony
patterns.context: A case text discusses cross-examining an adverse witness and the witness’s motive for testifying.

patterns.name: Semiconductor light-emitting structure
patterns.context: Patent background describes a semiconductor device and a window layer used to enhance light emission in a specific direction.

patterns.name: Astronomical image caption in a paper
patterns.context: An astronomy paper mentions an observing collaboration, cites an adapted figure, and embeds an image.

patterns.name: Particle-physics figure caption
patterns.context: Discusses particle-physics processes and Feynman diagrams, with accompanying image metadata.

patterns.name: Diagram caption for hyperbolic space
patterns.context: An illustration explaining properties of hyperbolic space, involving equal-area tilings and parallel lines.

3_149.description: 激活片段呈现多种局部模式：学术文本中的图表/图片标记，以及数学、物理、天文领域的图示说明；另有法律、专利、代码和维基分类中的特定词串。不同上下文之间缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: 图表标记与图像嵌入语法
patterns.context: 图表引用、图注或图片嵌入代码附近，常见于 ArXiv 文本；也出现在其他文档中的结构化标记。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及结构化文档

patterns.name: 特定英文单词 so 的强激活
patterns.context: 在 [4] 中出现在“to soothe damaged skin”；在 [8] 中出现在“so-called”；在 [9] 中出现在“shall so order”。词义和句法功能不同，均不能据此归为同一种语义。

patterns.name: Banks 类别词及地名/机构列表
patterns.context: 连续的维基百科分类标题中，Banks 与多个国家或地区名称相连。

patterns.name: ASP.NET 路由模板中的路径通配符
patterns.context: C# 路由注册代码中的 URL 模板，包含资源占位符、扩展名及捕获剩余路径的通配符。

patterns.name: 图论与代数结构术语
patterns.context: 描述偏序集及其格结构，并伴随数学公式和图引用。

patterns.name: 法律证言盘问与动机
patterns.context: 判例文本讨论对不利证人的交叉询问及其作证动机。

patterns.name: 半导体发光结构
patterns.context: 专利背景描述半导体器件及用于提升特定方向出光的窗口层。

patterns.name: 论文中的天文图像说明
patterns.context: 天文论文提及观测合作组、改编图示来源，并嵌入图像。

patterns.name: 粒子物理图示说明
patterns.context: 讨论粒子物理过程及费曼图，并附带图像元数据。

patterns.name: 双曲空间示意图说明
patterns.trigger: “Illustrations of properties of hyperbolic space”“Tiles of constant area”
patterns.context: 说明双曲空间性质的插图，涉及等面积铺砌和平行线。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in paper captions, image embeddings, and label markers; there are also resultative/purpose uses of “so” in patent, legal, and historical texts, as well as activations on several seemingly unrelated terms, word fragments, and common words.

patterns.name: Syntactic triggers for so
patterns.context: “so” occurs in resultative or purposive structures, followed by a result clause or infinitive; in [5], “shall so order” in a legal sentence means to issue an order in the manner stated above.
patterns.domain: Patent background, legal texts, historical narratives

patterns.name: LaTeX captions and image markers
patterns.context: Markdown/LaTeX conversion markers for image embeddings, figure labels, and dimension attributes occur around paper text or captions.

patterns.name: Specific terms or word-form fragments
patterns.context: Specialized terms, split word forms, or ordinary words in the main text are marked; these examples show no shared local semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, historical narratives, web discussions

patterns.name: Sporadic words without an obvious shared trigger
patterns.context: A few common words or local word fragments are marked in their respective contexts; these snippets do not establish a consistent trigger condition.

3_149.description: 激活主要集中在论文图注、图像嵌入及标签标记；另有专利、法律和历史文本中结果/目的用法的“so”，以及若干互不明显相关的术语、词片和通用词激活。

patterns.name: so 的句法触发
patterns.context: “so”出现在表示结果或目的的结构中，后接结果从句或不定式；在 [5] 中为法律语句里的“shall so order”，指按前文所述方式作出命令。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、法律文本、历史叙述

patterns.name: LaTeX 图注与图像标记
patterns.context: 论文正文或图注周围出现图像嵌入、图标签、尺寸属性等 Markdown/LaTeX 转换标记。

patterns.name: 特定术语或词形碎片
patterns.context: 专业词、被拆分的词形或正文中的普通词被标记；这些例子未显示共同的局部语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、历史叙述、网页讨论

patterns.name: 无明显共享触发的零散词语
patterns.context: 少数通用词或局部词片在各自语境中被标记，无法从这些片段确认一致的触发条件。

en.concept: Figure markers and local patterns in heterogeneous texts
en.description: The clearest shared pattern is figure embedding markers and their filenames and labels in academic texts; other activations are distributed across financial emails, historical dosage recommendations, patent skincare descriptions, and group theory questions, with distinct local triggers.

patterns.name: Figures and image markers
patterns.context: Figures, captions, or embedded-image markers occur in academic texts; activations often fall on image markers or caption-related tokens.

patterns.name: Image filenames and caption metadata
patterns.context: Filenames, labels, or split metadata strings in image-embedding syntax; weakly associated with ordinary prose semantics.
patterns.domain: ArXiv image markers and figure metadata

patterns.name: LOCC reactivity statements
patterns.context: Discusses whether reactivity may or may not increase under LOCC, alongside literature citations and figure markers.
patterns.domain: Academic paper text, possibly in chemistry or a related field

patterns.name: Manual adjustments for complex trades
patterns.context: An email discusses distinguishing vanilla from other trades, trade approximations, and manual trade-by-trade adjustments.
patterns.domain: Enron business emails, trading and finance

patterns.name: Monitoring contract information
patterns.context: An email proposes monitoring contract information releases by several companies and says that understanding is currently preliminary.
patterns.domain: Enron business emails, energy contracts and business communications

patterns.name: Dosage causing nausea or appetite suppression
patterns.context: Advice to use a dose that causes nausea and weakness, thereby delaying the next dose and suppressing appetite.

patterns.name: Skincare compositions and skin damage
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph describes collecting data to evaluate the soothing ability of a personal-care composition on skin damage.

patterns.name: Group theory questions and explicit constructions
patterns.context: A mathematics paper poses a question about explicit constructions of interleaving operators for groups and their subgroups.

3_149.concept: 图表标记及异质文本局部模式
3_149.description: 最明显的共同模式是学术文本中的图表嵌入标记及其文件名、标签；其余激活分散在金融邮件、历史剂量建议、专利皮肤护理和群论问题中，局部触发各不相同。

patterns.name: 图表与图像标记
patterns.context: 学术文本中出现图、图注或嵌入图像的标记；激活常落在图像标记或图注相关 token 上。

patterns.name: 图像文件名与图注元数据
patterns.context: 图像嵌入语法中的文件名、标签或被拆分的元数据字符串；与普通正文语义关联较弱。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 图像标记与图表元数据

patterns.name: LOCC 反应性表述
patterns.context: 讨论 LOCC 条件下反应性可能增加或不增加，并伴有文献引用和图表标记。
patterns.domain: 学术论文正文，可能涉及化学或相关领域

patterns.name: 复杂交易的手动调整
patterns.context: 邮件中谈论将 vanilla 与其他交易区分、交易近似以及逐笔手动调整。
patterns.domain: Enron 商务邮件，交易与金融

patterns.name: 合同信息监控
patterns.context: 邮件提出监控若干公司的合同信息发布，并表示目前只初步了解情况。
patterns.domain: Enron 商务邮件，能源合同与业务沟通

patterns.name: 剂量导致恶心或抑制食欲
patterns.context: 劝告使用某种剂量使人恶心、虚弱，进而推迟下一剂并削弱食欲。
patterns.domain: 历史书籍或医疗建议类叙述

patterns.name: 护肤组合物与皮肤损伤
patterns.context: 专利背景段落描述收集数据以评估个人护理组合物对皮肤损伤的舒缓能力。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利文本，个人护理

patterns.name: 群论问题与显式构造
patterns.context: 数学论文提出关于群及其子群的交织算子的显式构造问题。

en.concept: Paper figure markers and miscellaneous formatting
en.description: Most passages contain paper figures, captions, or image markers; others contain legal ruling language, C# routing code, piecewise mathematical formulas, and cross-domain term activations, with no unified local semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Figure/image markers
patterns.context: Figure references, captions, or image embedding markers occur near paper text or equations; activations often fall on the markers and surrounding tokens.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers and their converted Markdown/LaTeX

patterns.name: Legal orders and ruling language
patterns.context: Legal text describes whether an appeal application stays proceedings and uses formal phrasing for orders issued by a judge or court.

patterns.name: C# route configuration code
patterns.context: Code in an ASP.NET route registration method, including a resource-path wildcard.

patterns.name: Piecewise mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A condition expression in a piecewise definition or aligned formula is followed by an alignment marker and an “elsewhere” branch.

patterns.name: Particle physics proper names and symbols
patterns.context: Figure terminology or particle-state names in high-energy physics contexts; visible image markers are not necessarily present.

patterns.name: Term and caption word fragments
patterns.context: Occur respectively in captions or descriptions before and after figures, text near tables, and descriptions of physical results; the words themselves show no shared, stable trigger condition.
patterns.domain: ArXiv geometry, astrophysics, web research, and condensed matter physics

3_149.concept: 论文图表标记及杂项格式
3_149.description: 多数段落含论文图表、图注或图片标记；另有法律裁定措辞、C#路由代码、分段数学公式，以及若干跨领域术语激活，未见统一的局部语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 图示/图片标记
patterns.context: 论文正文或公式附近出现图表引用、图注或图片嵌入标记；激活常落在标记及其周边 token 上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文及其转换后的 Markdown/LaTeX

patterns.name: 法律命令与裁定措辞
patterns.context: 法律条文中描述上诉申请是否中止程序，以及法官或法院作出命令的正式句式。

patterns.name: C# 路由配置代码
patterns.context: ASP.NET 路由注册方法中的代码，包含资源路径通配符。

patterns.name: 分段数学表达式
patterns.context: 分段定义或对齐公式中，条件表达式后接对齐符及“elsewhere”分支。

patterns.name: 粒子物理专名与符号
patterns.context: 高能物理语境中的图示术语或粒子态名称；不一定伴随可见图像标记。

patterns.name: 术语及图注中的词语片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在图注或图前后说明、表格附近文字及物理结果描述中；这些词语本身未显示出共同的稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 几何、天体物理、网络研究与凝聚态物理

en.description: Activations span formulas, markup, code, and academic text: they often fall on parentheses, backslashes, LaTeX commands, and citation/label boundaries. There are also sporadic patterns involving English function words, patent boilerplate, and segmented proper names.

patterns.name: Special symbols adjacent to parentheses and punctuation
patterns.context: Activations are scattered around parentheses, square brackets, braces, and backslashes in formulas, markup, code, and prose; they usually reflect the symbols themselves or their boundary tokens, rather than any unified mathematical content.

patterns.name: LaTeX math commands and formula structures
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical formulas, especially near command boundaries, text labels in formulas, and structural symbols.

patterns.name: HTML/template markers
patterns.context: Near HTML/template attributes and tags for figures or images; activation covers attribute names, quotation marks, and marker boundaries.

patterns.name: Cross-reference and bibliography citation markers
patterns.context: At citations, table, lemma, or proposition labels and adjacent punctuation; some activations fall within label text or citation markers.

patterns.name: English function words and connectives
patterns.context: Near prepositions or connective phrases in ordinary English prose; activation shows no specific topic condition.

patterns.name: Method/object wording in patents
patterns.context: Occurs when patent text introduces the invention’s object or method with “The present invention relates to …”.

patterns.name: Code declarations and routing syntax
patterns.context: Near class declarations, method-name fragments, and resource-path strings in C# routing configuration code; parenthesis-like symbols also activate.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in physics/mathematics
patterns.context: Proper names or terms are segmented into subword tokens; activations fall on fragments of particle-diagram categories and geometry/quantum-state names.

patterns.name: Serialized academic citation keys
patterns.context: Near fragments of author names or keys segmented within BibTeX-style citation keys.

patterns.name: Table-border syntax
patterns.context: Near vertical bars and column-type characters in column formatting or border definitions in table environments.

3_149.description: 激活横跨公式、标记语言、代码和学术文本：常落在括号、反斜杠、LaTeX 命令及引用/标签边界；另有英文功能词、专利套语和被切分的专名等零散模式。

patterns.name: 括号与标点邻接的特殊符号
patterns.context: 激活分散在公式、标记语言、代码和正文中的括号、方括号、花括号及反斜杠附近；通常是符号本身或其边界 token，而非某个统一数学内容。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学命令与公式结构
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式中，尤其是命令边界、公式中的文字标签和结构性符号附近。

patterns.name: HTML/模板标记
patterns.context: 图表或图片的 HTML/模板属性及标签附近；激活覆盖属性名称、引号和标记边界。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文档中的图表标记

patterns.name: 交叉引用与文献引用标记
patterns.context: 引用、表格、引理或命题标签及其相邻标点处；有些激活落在标签文本或引用标记内部。

patterns.name: 英文短功能词和衔接词
patterns.context: 普通英文叙述中介词或连接性短语附近；激活未显示出特定主题条件。

patterns.name: 专利中的方法/对象措辞
patterns.context: 专利文本以“The present invention relates to …”引入发明对象或方法时出现。

patterns.name: 代码声明与路由语法
patterns.context: C# 路由配置代码中，类声明、方法名片段和资源路径字符串附近；括号类符号也有激活。

patterns.name: 物理/数学专名片段
patterns.context: 专名或术语被切分成子词 token；激活落在粒子图类别及几何/量子态名称片段上。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理、几何与量子信息

patterns.name: 序列化学术引用键
patterns.context: BibTeX 式引用键中，作者名或键名被分割的片段附近。

patterns.name: 表格边框语法
patterns.context: 表格环境的列格式或边框定义中，竖线与列类型字符附近。

en.description: High responses are concentrated around structured markers in academic papers: environment labels such as propositions and lemmas, as well as figure labels; there are also formula boundaries, theorem statements, and proof transitions. Across mathematics and physics texts, no single semantic theme explains all the terms.

patterns.name: Lemma, proposition, or corollary labels
patterns.context: Theorem-environment headings marked with square brackets and backslashes in papers; activations often fall at the end of the heading or the beginning of the following statement
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, theorem statements, and proofs

patterns.name: Figure or image markers
patterns.context: Near figure/table references or labels and titles of figure and table environments, typically with numbering and cross-references
patterns.domain: Academic paper typesetting and figure descriptions

patterns.name: Formal mathematical objects and condition boundaries
patterns.context: Inside formulas for piecewise definitions, integrals/inequalities, or geometric conditions; this pattern does not always co-occur with theorem labels

patterns.name: Common words in theorem statements
patterns.context: At the beginning of formal statements of mathematical results or definitions, usually after a lemma/proposition label

patterns.name: Proof transition phrases
patterns.context: Proof text explaining the source of a corollary or announcing that a proof will be given; occurs in only a few passages in this set

patterns.name: Ordinary English words and local structural words
patterns.context: Narration in mathematics papers about assumptions, conclusions, or conditions; some words occur in only one passage and show no stable shared condition

patterns.name: Figure captions and structural descriptions in non-mathematical fields
patterns.context: Figure labels occur alongside caption text in descriptions of crystal structures or device schematics

3_149.description: 高响应主要集中在学术论文的结构化标记附近：命题、引理等环境标签，以及图表标签；另有公式边界、定理陈述和证明衔接词。跨数学与物理文本，未见单一语义主题能解释全部词项。

patterns.name: 引理、命题或推论的标签
patterns.context: 论文中以方括号、反斜线标出的定理环境标题；激活常落在标题末尾或紧随其后的陈述起始处
patterns.domain: 数学论文、定理陈述与证明

patterns.name: 图表或图片标记
patterns.context: 图表引用或图、表环境的标签/标题附近，通常伴随编号和交叉引用
patterns.domain: 学术论文排版与图表说明

patterns.name: 形式化数学对象与条件边界
patterns.context: 分段定义、积分/不等式或几何条件的公式内部；此模式与定理标签并非总同时出现

patterns.name: 定理陈述中的常用词
patterns.context: 数学结果或定义的正式陈述开头，通常在引理/命题标签之后

patterns.name: 证明衔接语
patterns.context: 证明文字中说明推论来源或声明将给出证明；本组只在个别段落出现

patterns.name: 普通英文词与局部结构词
patterns.context: 数学论文正文中关于假设、结论或条件的叙述；部分词只在单段出现，未显示稳定共同条件

patterns.name: 非数学学科图注与结构描述
patterns.context: 晶体结构图注或器件示意图说明中，图标签和图注文本相邻

en.description: Mainly responds to figure numbers, captions, paragraph, and proposition-formatting markers in ArXiv papers; also responds to Enron email header fields and forwarded-message separators. One instance also activates at the end of the conversational question “You okay?”, possibly reflecting a question mark or short-sentence boundary as a separate pattern.

patterns.name: Figure and caption markers
patterns.context: Activations concentrate where paper text references figures, continues into captions, or describes symbols and lines in a figure; especially near figure numbers and caption markers.

patterns.name: Paper paragraph or proposition structural markers
patterns.context: Located at paragraph boundaries, proposition labels, or the start of formal definitions/explanations; related to figure patterns as a paper-formatting cue, though not every instance directly includes a figure reference.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper text and structured markers

patterns.name: Email headers and forwarded-message format
patterns.context: Near email header fields such as To, Cc, and Subject, and email separators; often accompanied by recipient lists and tabs.

patterns.name: Conversational response at the end of a question
patterns.context: A brief, conversational direct question; this example occurs near an isolated utterance in a HackerNews post.

3_149.description: 主要响应 ArXiv 论文中的图号、图注、段落与命题排版标记；也响应 Enron 邮件头字段和转发分隔符。另有一次口语问句“You okay?”末尾激活，可能是问号或短句边界的独立模式。

patterns.name: 图表与图注标记
patterns.context: 激活集中在论文正文中引用图表、接续图注或描述图中符号和线条时；尤其是图号、图注标记附近。

patterns.name: 论文段落或命题结构标记
patterns.context: 位于论文段落边界、命题标签或正式定义/说明的开头；与图表模式同属论文排版线索，但并非每处都直接出现图引用。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文正文与结构化标记

patterns.name: 邮件头与转发邮件格式
patterns.context: 邮件收件人、抄送、主题等头部字段及邮件分隔符附近，常伴随名单和制表符。

patterns.name: 问句结尾的口语回应
patterns.context: 短小、口语化的直接提问；本例出现在 HackerNews 帖子中的独立发言附近。

en.description: The most stable response is to formatting boundaries, especially consecutive line breaks; it also responds to colons in email headers, LaTeX proposition headings, and formula-structure symbols. A few activations fall on proof phrasing, English colons, and Q&A punctuation; no clear corresponding salient pattern is apparent in passage 8.

patterns.name: Consecutive blank lines and paragraph separators
patterns.context: Activations concentrate at multiple consecutive line breaks, especially after email subjects/forwarding headers or between paper text and standalone headings or equations.
patterns.domain: Email formatting, LaTeX academic paper typesetting

patterns.name: Colons in email subjects
patterns.context: Occurs in email header Subject fields and repeated forwarded subjects; adjacent to forwarding markers, subject text, and subsequent blank lines.

patterns.name: Standalone LaTeX proposition headings
patterns.context: A standalone bracketed label marks a proposition, theorem, or lemma after the main text, often immediately followed by the heading text; activations are especially common at the closing label or end of the heading.

patterns.name: Structural symbols and line endings in formulas
patterns.context: Symbols occur at the ends of formula lines, between columns, or at piecewise conditions in multiline mathematical formulas, piecewise definitions, or alignment environments.

patterns.name: Proofs and proposition statements in the main text
patterns.context: Occurs in the body of mathematics papers when introducing a proof, theorem conclusion, or conditional sentence; co-occurs with standalone proposition headings and paragraph boundaries.

patterns.name: Ordinary English colon
patterns.context: A colon introduces following text or a theorem label, rather than appearing in an email subject field.

patterns.name: English quotation marks and mathematical environment closure
patterns.context: Closes an expression at the end of a mathematical formula or typesetting environment, followed nearby by a line break and new paragraph.

patterns.name: Q&A titles and question punctuation
patterns.context: In a StackExchange post's Q&A format, a Q marker and question-marked title form the opening; consecutive blank lines also occur afterward.

3_149.description: 最稳定的反应是排版边界，尤其连续换行；另对邮件头冒号、LaTeX 命题标题与公式结构符号有反应。少数激活落在证明措辞、英文冒号及问答标点；第8段未见清楚对应的显著模式。

patterns.name: 连续空行及段落分隔
patterns.context: 激活集中在多次连续换行处，尤其是邮件主题/转发头之后，或论文正文与独立标题、公式之间。
patterns.domain: 邮件格式、学术论文的 LaTeX 排版

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的冒号
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头的 Subject 字段及重复转发主题中；与转发标记、主题文字和后续空行相邻。

patterns.name: LaTeX 独立命题标题
patterns.context: 正文后用独立的方括号式标签标出 proposition、theorem 或 lemma，常紧接标题正文；激活尤见标签闭合或标题结尾。

patterns.name: 公式中的结构符号与行尾
patterns.context: 在多行数学公式、分段定义或对齐环境中，符号位于公式行末、列间或分段条件处。

patterns.name: 正文中的证明与命题陈述
patterns.context: 出现在数学论文中引出证明、定理结论或条件句的正文位置；与独立命题标题和段落边界并存。

patterns.name: 普通英文冒号
patterns.context: 冒号用于引出后文或定理标签，不在邮件主题字段中。

patterns.name: 英文引号及数学环境闭合
patterns.context: 在数学公式或排版环境末尾关闭表达式，附近接换行及新段落。

patterns.name: 问答标题及问句标点
patterns.context: StackExchange 帖子的问答格式中，Q 标记和标题问句构成开头；之后也出现连续空行。

en.description: Activations are scattered across email headers, line breaks and forwarding separators, LaTeX proposition/caption markers, and code commands, legal wording, and narrative prepositions. Some segments share formatting boundaries, but there is no unified word meaning or single trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Structured content following formatting separators
patterns.context: Activations often fall after formatting markers, immediately before propositions, lemmas, captions, or forwarded email bodies; they can also fall on code commands or lexical verbs, so these different positions should not all be attributed to the same triggering string
patterns.domain: Mixed: paper typesetting, email, code, legal text

patterns.name: Email header fields and message boundaries
patterns.context: Email header fields, forwarding markers, or separators often occur alongside line breaks and fields such as recipient and subject; activation points include field values, line breaks, and forwarding separators

patterns.name: Proposition or lemma heading markers
patterns.context: In mathematics papers, the headings of formal statements are introduced by LaTeX square brackets and abbreviated labels; activation emphasizes the heading’s closing marker rather than being limited to mathematical formulas

patterns.name: Forwarded/subject chains in email subjects
patterns.context: The subject field in email headers contains repeated forwarding prefixes or forwarding markers; activation is distributed across Subject, the colon, prefixes, and the following separator region

patterns.name: Preposition into in narrative
patterns.context: In a narrative about a character flying a plane into a German warship, activation falls on the preposition indicating direction of movement; there are no clear typesetting or email-format cues here

patterns.name: Command insertion in code
patterns.context: JavaScript keyboard-event handling code calls execCommand to insert HTML; activation falls on the command name Insert

patterns.name: Dismissal phrase in legal text
patterns.context: In a legal account of a court case and a defendant, the text says the defendant moved to dismiss the complaint; activation is concentrated around to and dismiss

patterns.name: Figure-caption markers
patterns.context: LaTeX figure references and captions in a paper, where a figure number or subfigure is followed by a description of a crystal structure

3_149.concept: 结构边界与格式标记（宽泛）
3_149.description: 激活散布于邮件头、换行与转发分隔符，LaTeX命题/图注标记，以及代码命令、法律措辞和叙事介词；部分段落共享格式边界，但无统一词义或单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 格式分隔符后接结构化内容
patterns.trigger: 「\[」「Prop:」「Lem:」「!」「(a)」及其前后的换行、反斜线或长横线；尤其标记 token「\]」「(a)」「-----」
patterns.context: 激活常落在成段格式标记之后，紧接命题、引理、图注或转发邮件正文；也可落在代码命令或文字动词上，不能把这些不同位置都归为同一触发串
patterns.domain: 混合：论文排版、邮件、代码、法律文本

patterns.name: 邮件头字段与邮件边界
patterns.context: 邮件头字段、转发标记或分隔符出现时，常伴随换行及收件人、主题等字段；激活点包括字段值、换行和转发分隔符

patterns.name: 命题或引理标题标记
patterns.context: 数学论文中，形式化陈述的标题以 LaTeX 方括号及缩写标签引出；激活突出标题结束标记，而非仅限于数学公式

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的转发/主题链
patterns.trigger: 「Subject: FW: FW: FW: Yes Ossifer?」及「Subject: Fwd:」
patterns.context: 邮件头的主题字段含重复转发前缀或转发标记，激活分布在 Subject、冒号、前缀及其后的分隔区域

patterns.name: 叙述中的介词 into
patterns.context: 人物驾驶飞机撞向德国军舰的叙述中，激活落在表示运动方向的介词上；此处没有明显的排版或邮件格式线索

patterns.name: 代码中的命令插入
patterns.context: JavaScript 键盘事件处理代码中，调用 execCommand 插入 HTML；激活落在命令名 Insert 上

patterns.name: 法律文本中的驳回短语
patterns.context: 法院案件与被告的法律叙述中，说明被告请求驳回诉状；激活集中在 to 及 dismiss 附近

patterns.name: 图注标记
patterns.context: 论文中的 LaTeX 图引用和图注，标记图号或子图后接晶体结构说明

en.concept: Multiple types of structural markers and formatting words
en.description: Activations span LaTeX formula structures, paper text and citations, historical and commentary narratives, email header fields, and code markers; email formatting is the clearest recurring structure, while other triggers are scattered and show no unified lexical pattern.

patterns.name: LaTeX math delimiters and formula structure
patterns.context: In mathematical expressions or piecewise formulas, activations fall on backslash commands, formula-structure symbols, and nearby text; passages 1 and 9 both use mathematical typesetting.

patterns.name: Academic phrasing in general technical papers
patterns.context: Activations fall on common academic words in paper text describing research results, methods, or related work; they do not obviously depend on specific mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Physics proper names and citations
patterns.context: When introducing physics topics such as the Lorentz force and quantum Hall effect and their references, activations fall on name fragments such as author surnames.

patterns.name: Action words in a war narrative
patterns.context: A historical event is narrated in which an aircraft is attacked, damaged, and crashes into a warship; activations include action words, pronouns, and articles, with no clear specialized trigger word.

patterns.name: Strong wording in colloquial commentary
patterns.context: Criticism of the Apple ecosystem and its impact on developers, with activations on common function words and words emphasizing the object of criticism.

patterns.name: Email header fields and formatting
patterns.context: In email headers or forwarded-message formats, activations concentrate on subject fields, company-name fragments, and structural markers such as line breaks.

patterns.name: Email subjects and forwarding markers
patterns.context: When a forwarding marker and brief subject appear in an email subject line, activations occur near related words and punctuation.

patterns.name: Date/time and recipient fields
patterns.context: When an email header lists the date, time, recipients, and subject, activations fall on field names and date/time fragments.

patterns.name: Conditional logic and key handling in code
patterns.context: A JavaScript event handler checks a key code and prevents default behavior; activations involve control flow, property names, and strings that insert HTML.

3_149.concept: 多类结构标记与格式词
3_149.description: 激活覆盖 LaTeX 公式结构、论文正文与引文、历史和评论叙述、邮件头字段及代码标记；邮件格式是最明显的重复结构，其余触发分散，未见统一词义模式。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学分隔符与公式结构
patterns.context: 数学表达式或分段公式中，激活落在反斜杠命令、公式结构符号及其附近；第 1、9 段均为数学排版。

patterns.name: 一般技术论文中的学术措辞
patterns.context: 论文正文叙述研究结果、方法或相关工作时，激活分布在常见学术词语上；不明显依赖特定数学符号。

patterns.name: 物理领域专名与引文
patterns.context: 介绍洛伦兹力、量子霍尔效应等物理内容及其参考文献时，激活落在作者姓氏等专名片段。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文及文献引用

patterns.name: 战争叙事中的动作词
patterns.context: 叙述飞机遭攻击、受损并撞向军舰的历史事件；激活包括动作词、代词和冠词，未显出明确的专门触发词。

patterns.name: 口语评论中的强烈措辞
patterns.context: 批评苹果生态系统及其对开发者的影响，激活落在常见虚词和强调对象的词上。

patterns.name: 邮件头字段与格式
patterns.context: 邮件头或邮件转发格式中，激活集中于主题字段、公司名片段和换行等结构标记。

patterns.name: 邮件主题与转发标记
patterns.context: 邮件主题行出现转发标记和简短主题内容时，相关词语及标点附近有激活。

patterns.name: 日期时间与收件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件头列出日期、时间、收件人和主题时，激活落在字段名及日期时间片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的条件判断与按键处理
patterns.context: JavaScript 事件处理函数检查按键码并阻止默认行为，激活涉及控制流、属性名及插入 HTML 的字符串。

en.description: Activations are scattered across domains, tending toward structural boundaries, common function words, punctuation, and typesetting symbols. There are also several content-word peaks: legal “to dismiss”, code InsertHTML, historical into, and educational closer.

patterns.name: Small words in negative/conditional sentences
patterns.context: Serve as conditionals, prepositions, or pronouns in grammatical structures; occur across code, legal texts, and academic discussion

patterns.name: Colon and punctuation-delimited structures
patterns.context: Punctuation links email subjects, reference numbers, mathematical expressions, or formulas

patterns.name: Line breaks and separators
patterns.context: Occur near separators in quoted emails, paper formulas/reference material, or structured-text boundaries

patterns.name: Legal collocation “to dismiss”
patterns.context: In legal litigation narratives, describes a defendant’s motion to dismiss a case or complaint

patterns.name: Keyboard-event code
patterns.context: JavaScript checks keyCode, prevents the default behavior, and inserts HTML

patterns.name: Plane collides with warship
patterns.context: Historical narrative describes a wounded pilot flying a plane into a German warship

patterns.name: Position adjustment to improve vision
patterns.context: In an educational narrative, a student who struggles to see the blackboard is moved to the front of the classroom

patterns.name: Special symbols/typesetting in mathematical text
patterns.context: LaTeX typesetting in formulas, piecewise definitions, or tensor notation

patterns.name: Email recipients and forwarded subject
patterns.context: An email header lists recipients and a repeatedly forwarded subject, followed by the original email separator

patterns.name: Academic authors and proposition markers
patterns.context: Paper headers/author information or proposition labels in the main text

3_149.description: 激活分散在多领域，偏向结构边界与常见功能词、标点及排版符号；另有若干内容性高峰：法律“to dismiss”、代码 InsertHTML、历史 into、教育 closer。

patterns.name: 否定/条件句中的小词
patterns.context: 在语法结构中充当条件、介词或代词；分散出现在代码、法律文本和学术论述中

patterns.name: 冒号与标点分隔结构
patterns.context: 标点连接邮件主题、文献编号、数学表达式或公式
patterns.domain: 邮件、学术文本、法律文本

patterns.name: 换行及分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在邮件引用分隔、论文公式/参考材料或结构化文本边界附近

patterns.name: “to dismiss”法律搭配
patterns.context: 法律诉讼叙述中，描述被告提出驳回案件或诉状的动议

patterns.name: 键盘事件代码
patterns.context: JavaScript 条件检查 keyCode 后阻止默认行为并插入 HTML

patterns.name: 飞机撞击军舰
patterns.context: 历史叙述中描述受伤飞行员将飞机撞向德国军舰

patterns.name: 位置调整以改善视力
patterns.context: 教育叙述中因学生看黑板吃力而将其移到教室前方

patterns.name: 数学文本中的特殊符号/排版
patterns.context: 公式、分段定义或张量记号中的 LaTeX 排版

patterns.name: 邮件收件人与主题转发
patterns.context: 邮件头部列出收件人并连续转发主题，随后进入原始邮件分隔

patterns.name: 学术作者与论文命题标记
patterns.context: 论文页眉/作者信息或正文中的命题标签

en.description: The dominant pattern is strong activation on surname fragments beginning with McN in personal names across multiple domains; subsequent tokens vary by spelling. The remaining sporadic highlights occur across different words and styles, with no stable shared trigger; segment 10 also shows no clear McN pattern.

patterns.name: McN surname fragments
patterns.context: Surname-initial fragments in proper names, followed by varying spellings; often at the end of a name or in a cited author name.
patterns.domain: News, legal, academic, encyclopedic, and web texts

patterns.name: Specific spelling continuation fragments
patterns.context: Subsequent tokens in surnames beginning with McN; activation is strongly concentrated on McN, while continuation fragments are weaker and not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Personal-name citations, bylines, or narrative text

patterns.name: Other sporadic activations
patterns.context: Each occurs in a local word or phrase, with no stable shared context; beyond co-occurrence in fragments containing McN, no confirmed relationship is apparent.
patterns.domain: Album descriptions, energy news, military writing, papers, encyclopedias, etc.

patterns.name: Person name in an FCC news quote
patterns.context: The name of U.S. politician Jerry McNerney, in a news quote about FCC transparency.

3_158.description: 主导模式是在多领域文本中对 McN 开头的人名姓氏片段强烈激活，后续 token 因拼写而异。其余零散高亮分布于不同词语和文体，未显示稳定共同触发条件；第10段也无明显 McN 模式。

patterns.name: McN 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 在专名中出现的姓氏开头片段，后续拼写各异；多为姓名末尾或引文作者名。
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律、学术、百科及网页文本

patterns.name: 特定拼写续接片段
patterns.context: 出现在 McN 开头姓氏的后续 token 中；激活显著集中于 McN，续接片段强度较弱且不完全一致。

patterns.name: 其他零散激活
patterns.context: 各自处于局部词汇或短语中，没有稳定共同上下文；除共同出现在含 McN 的片段外，缺少可确认的关联。
patterns.domain: 专辑介绍、能源新闻、军事写作、论文、百科等

patterns.name: FCC 新闻引语中的人物名
patterns.context: 美国政界人物 Jerry McNerney 的姓名，处于有关 FCC 透明度的新闻引语中。

en.description: Primarily responds to the McN fragment in surnames, especially McNamara, and also McNerney, McNulty, and McNab; spans multiple genres. Also has an isolated activation on abolished.

patterns.name: Middle fragment of the surname McNamara
patterns.context: Activation falls inside surnames beginning with McN; subsequent letters are unmarked. The specific names vary, and there is no consistent semantic condition in the surrounding text.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: music, business email, military writing, academic papers, law, news

patterns.name: abolished
patterns.context: At the end of a paragraph describing a university qualification that was abolished after 2009; has no apparent connection to the McN surname pattern.

3_158.description: 主要响应姓氏中的 McN 片段，集中于 McNamara，也见 McNerney、McNulty、McNab；跨多种文体。另有孤立激活 abolished。

patterns.name: McNamara 姓氏中间片段
patterns.context: 激活落在以 McN 开头的姓氏内部，后续字母未标记；具体人名不同，前后文并无统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：音乐、商业邮件、军事写作、学术论文、法律、新闻

patterns.name: abolished
patterns.context: 段落末尾讲述某项大学资质在 2009 年后被废除；和 McN 姓氏模式无明显关系。
