en.description: Primarily responds to the surname prefix “McN” in proper nouns, which may be followed by various surnames; there is also one response to the “ox” and “ha” subword fragments in split “oxyhaemoglobin,” though whether they share a mechanism is uncertain.

patterns.name: McN surname fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of surnames in proper nouns, followed by different completions such as McNichols, McNamara, McNulty, McNab, and McNerney; activation is concentrated on the fragment itself.
patterns.domain: People’s names in encyclopedias, email, papers, legal texts, and news

patterns.name: Subword fragments in a tokenized proper noun
patterns.context: A scientific term is split into multiple subword fragments; activation falls on ox and ha, rather than the complete word or other words in its context.

3_158.description: 主要响应专名中姓氏前缀“McN”，其后可接多种姓氏；另有一次响应被拆分的“oxyhaemoglobin”中的“ox”“ha”片段，二者是否同一机制不确定。

patterns.name: McN 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名中的姓氏开头，后接不同补全，如 McNichols、McNamara、McNulty、McNab、McNerney；激活集中于片段本身。
patterns.domain: 人物姓名，见于百科、邮件、论文、法律文本和新闻

patterns.name: 被分词切开的专名片段
patterns.context: 科学术语被切成多个子词片段；激活落在 ox 和 ha，而非完整词或其上下文中的其他词。

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to surname prefixes beginning with McN- in personal names, across a range of domains and styles. The remainder of the surname varies, and activation strength differs.

patterns.name: McNamara surname fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in personal names, especially surnames beginning with McN; activation centers on the surname prefix rather than nearby punctuation or syntax.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, email, scientific papers, promotional text

patterns.name: Other McN surname fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in personal names or surnames beginning with McN; activation is slightly weaker than in the preceding group.

3_158.description: 神经元主要响应人名中 McN- 开头的姓氏前缀；覆盖多种领域与文体，后续姓氏余部不同，激活强度有差异。

patterns.name: McNamara姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名中，尤其是 McN 开头的姓氏；激活集中于姓氏前缀，而非附近标点或句法
patterns.domain: 百科、邮件、科学论文、宣传文本

patterns.name: 其他 McN 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在 McN 开头的人名或姓氏中；强度略低于前一组
patterns.domain: 法律、医学论文、新闻文本

en.description: All segments activate on continuations of surnames beginning with McN, including the spellings Nichols, amara, erney, ulty, ab, and ally; sources and genres vary, with no consistent additional semantic condition.

patterns.name: McN surname fragment
patterns.context: When a person’s name or surname beginning with McN appears, activation is concentrated on the continuation after McN. Continuation length varies, as does capitalization in the source text.
patterns.domain: Proper nouns; found across genres including encyclopedias, email, academic papers, legal documents, and news

3_158.description: 所有段均在 McN 开头的人名姓氏续段上激活，涵盖 Nichols、amara、erney、ulty、ab、ally 等拼写；来源和文体多样，未见稳定的额外语义条件。

patterns.name: McN 姓氏片段
patterns.trigger: « McN»，后接被标记为激活的姓氏续段，如「ichols」「amara」「erney」「amara」「ulty」「ab」「ally」
patterns.context: 文本出现以 McN 开头的人名或姓氏时，激活集中在 McN 之后的续写片段；续段长度不一，大小写也随原文而异。
patterns.domain: 专名；见于百科、邮件、学术论文、法律文书及新闻等多种文体

en.description: All segments activate at the string “McN”, across various surnames, author names, statistical test names, and legal party references. Subsequent spellings and styles vary, with no other shared trigger evident.

patterns.name: McN string onset
patterns.context: Strings beginning with McN in proper names or surnames; the fragment activates whether followed by 9 or 10.
patterns.domain: Personal names, literature citations, and proper names

patterns.name: McNichols surname continuation
patterns.context: Activation is followed by “ichols”, referring to a surname in a sports venue name.

patterns.name: McNamara surname continuation
patterns.context: Activation is followed by “amara”, occurring in author bylines or news bylines.

patterns.name: McNerney surname continuation
patterns.context: Activation is followed by “erney”, occurring in research-paper author names or the name of a political figure.

patterns.name: McNab citation surname continuation
patterns.context: Activation is followed by “ab”, in a parenthetical literature citation.

patterns.name: McNamar(a) cited-author continuation
patterns.context: Occurs in a citation to prior work in an astrophysics paper, followed by a coauthor and year.

patterns.name: McNemar test name
patterns.context: Occurs in a list of statistical tests, followed by a possessive and coordinated with other test names.

patterns.name: McNally surname continuation
patterns.context: Refers to a party in a legal case; the name is repeated in the sentence.

3_158.description: 所有片段都在字符串“McN”处激活，覆盖多种姓氏、作者名、统计检验名及法律当事人称谓；后续拼写和文体各异，未见其他共同触发条件。

patterns.name: McN 字符串开头
patterns.context: 专名或姓氏中以 McN 开头的字符串；该片段无论后续是 9 还是 10 都有激活。

patterns.name: McNichols 姓氏续写
patterns.context: 激活后接“ichols”，指体育场名称中的姓氏。
patterns.domain: 音乐发行介绍、场馆名称

patterns.name: McNamara 姓氏续写
patterns.context: 激活后接“amara”，出现在作者署名或新闻报道署名中。

patterns.name: McNerney 姓氏续写
patterns.context: 激活后接“erney”，出现在研究文献作者名或政治人物姓名中。

patterns.name: McNab 文献姓氏续写
patterns.context: 激活后接“ab”，位于括号内的文献引用。

patterns.name: McNamar(a) 文献作者续写
patterns.context: 出现在天体物理论文对既有研究的引用中，后接合著者与年份。

patterns.name: McNemar 检验名称
patterns.context: 出现在统计检验方法列表中，后接所有格并与其他检验名称并列。

patterns.name: McNally 姓氏续写
patterns.context: 指法律案件中的当事人，姓名在句中重复出现。

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the letter fragment “McN” in proper names, including various personal and company names beginning with McN. It also activates on the “Hor…izon” spelling fragment in one record-catalog entry, possibly an isolated pattern.

patterns.name: McN surname fragments
patterns.context: Activation centers on the spelling fragment McN in proper names; subsequent letters and contexts vary, and the fragment may occur in citations, mid-sentence, or at the start of a proper name.
patterns.domain: Personal or company names in papers, legal texts, news, encyclopedias, and promotional writing

patterns.name: Musician surname spelling fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a record-catalog entry, as part of an album title or parenthetical label content; this is a single instance, and its relation to the main pattern is uncertain.

3_158.description: 主要对专名中的字母片段“McN”强烈响应，涵盖多种以 McN 开头的人名、公司名；另在一处唱片目录的“Hor…izon”拼写片段中激活，可能是孤立模式。

patterns.name: McN 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名中 McN 这一拼写片段；后续字母和语境各异，片段也可能位于引用、句中或专名开头。
patterns.domain: 论文、法律文本、新闻、百科及宣传文字中的人名或公司名

patterns.name: 音乐家姓氏拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在唱片目录条目中，属于专辑名或厂牌/标签括号内容；仅此一例，是否与主模式相关不确定。

en.concept: Size and identifier fragments in code
en.description: Activation is concentrated on C/C++ size calculations, memory allocation/copying, and underscore-separated identifiers. Other sporadic activations occur on Horizon/Verizon string fragments, an R table, ACL code, and a motor-memory paper.

patterns.name: sizeof and size calculations
patterns.context: Calculating allocation sizes or array or struct-member lengths in C/C++ code; usually near malloc, memcpy, or pointer expressions.

patterns.name: Memory allocation and copy code
patterns.context: C code manipulating buffers or struct data; activation occurs across allocation, assignment, copying, and related expressions, not only sizeof.

patterns.name: Underscore-separated identifiers and struct fields
patterns.context: Code identifiers containing underscores, field access, or type names; often accompanied by structs, pointers, and member-size expressions.

patterns.name: Hor«izon»
patterns.context: The final portion of the word Horizon is highlighted in a common word or proper name; the contexts are financial legal text and a musician discography, respectively.

patterns.name: Verizon name
patterns.context: Employer name Verizon in a factual account of an unemployment-benefits lawsuit.

patterns.name: Table variables and sample data
patterns.context: A StackExchange example uses an R data.frame to illustrate data structure, with date, ID, indicator, and other column names and sample values.

patterns.name: ACL constants and CPU conversion identifiers
patterns.context: Linux-style code handling ACL groups and entry ID conversions and struct sizes.

patterns.name: Motor and memory research findings
patterns.context: Paper abstract comparing the effects of motor activity and rest before learning on memory performance.

3_158.concept: 代码中的尺寸与标识符片段
3_158.description: 激活最集中于 C/C++ 尺寸计算、内存分配/复制及下划线标识符；另有 Horizon/Verizon 字符串片段，以及 R 表格、ACL 代码和运动记忆论文中的零散激活。

patterns.name: sizeof 及尺寸计算
patterns.context: C/C++ 代码中计算分配大小、数组或结构体成员长度；通常出现在 malloc、memcpy 或指针表达式附近。

patterns.name: 内存分配与拷贝代码
patterns.context: C 代码操作缓冲区或结构体数据，激活分布于分配、赋值、复制及相关表达式，而不只限于 sizeof。

patterns.name: 下划线分隔的标识符及结构体字段
patterns.context: 代码标识符含下划线、字段访问或类型名；常伴随结构体、指针和成员尺寸表达式。

patterns.name: Hor«izon»
patterns.context: 单词 Horizon 的词尾部分在普通词语或专名中被标记；所在上下文分别是财务法律文本和音乐家唱片目录。

patterns.name: Verizon 名称
patterns.context: 雇主名称 Verizon 出现在失业福利诉讼事实叙述中。

patterns.name: 表格变量及示例数据
patterns.context: StackExchange 中用 R data.frame 说明数据结构，含日期、ID、indicator 等列名及示例数值。

patterns.name: ACL 常量及 CPU 转换标识符
patterns.context: Linux 风格代码中处理 ACL 分组及条目 ID 的转换和结构大小。

patterns.name: 运动与记忆研究结果
patterns.context: 论文摘要比较学习前后运动与休息对记忆表现的影响。

en.concept: Multiple word strings and formatting features
en.description: Activation covers organizational advocacy and association, immunological MHC terminology, code-comment identifiers, and two medical/biological contexts. Some patterns are triggered by specific word strings, with clear differences across domains.

patterns.name: Organizations, association, or public advocacy
patterns.context: Describes advocacy activities, speaking for a group, or the association and actions of organization members; advocacy appears in [3], [6], [9], and [10].
patterns.domain: Institutional descriptions, legal texts, energy policy, biographies

patterns.name: Major histocompatibility complex terminology
patterns.context: In immunological contexts, mentions major histocompatibility complex (MHC) and its classes, expression, or related research.

patterns.name: Punctuation and type identifiers in code comments
patterns.context: C# source-code comment lines and namespace/class path-style identifiers.

patterns.name: Toxic ingestion and treatment phrase
patterns.context: The abstract opens by focusing on current treatment of a type of ingestion poisoning.

patterns.name: Semio chemicals and animal chemical communication
patterns.context: Discusses chemicals used in animal communication and mentions MHC peptides and urine.

3_158.description: 激活涵盖组织倡议与结社、免疫学 MHC 术语、代码注释标识符，以及两类医学/生物学语境；部分模式由特定词串触发，彼此领域差异明显。

patterns.name: 组织、结社或公共倡议
patterns.context: 描述倡议活动、代表群体发声，或组织成员的结社与行动；[3]、[6]、[9]、[10]中均出现 advocacy
patterns.domain: 机构介绍、法律、能源政策、人物传记

patterns.name: 主要组织相容性复合体术语
patterns.trigger: «hist«ocompat»»（如“histocompatibility”）；常邻近 « complex»、« II» 或 « class»
patterns.context: 免疫学语境中出现 major histocompatibility complex（MHC）及其类别、表达或相关研究
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研项目说明

patterns.name: 代码注释中的标点与类型标识符
patterns.context: C# 源码注释行和命名空间/类路径式标识符

patterns.name: 毒物摄入与治疗短语
patterns.trigger: «Current»；紧接“treatment of poisoning by ingestion of caust…”
patterns.context: 摘要开头以当前治疗某种摄入中毒为主题

patterns.name: 半化学物质及动物化学通信
patterns.context: 讨论动物通信所用化学物质，并提及 MHC 肽段和尿液
patterns.domain: 生物医学/动物行为研究

en.description: The most stable trigger is parametric, including forms such as non-parametric. Other activations include participle/past-tense endings across multiple domains, a few internal fragments in biomedical compounds, and words in recruitment descriptions.

patterns.name: parametric term
patterns.context: The word and its compound forms occur in contexts involving statistical analysis, estimation methods, or model uncertainty.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, statistics, research abstracts, or papers

patterns.name: Verb past-tense ending -ed
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of English past-tense or past-participle verbs, with the word split across multiple tokens; context and domain vary.
patterns.domain: Legal, research, web, and general English

patterns.name: -ic morphological fragment
patterns.context: Activation occurs within multi-token words, involving adjectives or compound adjectives; this pattern appears in only a few segments.

patterns.name: -ed in words describing quality or ability
patterns.context: Describes candidates’ service orientation or skills in job advertisements.

patterns.name: Unexplained: isolated strong verb activation
patterns.context: Occurs in an account of police asking someone to remain at the scene; apart from the shared verb-ending phenomenon seen in other segments, no connection to the main pattern is apparent.

3_158.concept: 英语词形片段，尤以 parametric 为主
3_158.description: 最稳定的触发是 parametric（含 non-parametric 等形式）；另有多个领域中分词/过去式词尾激活，以及少数生物医学复合词内部片段和招聘描述词激活。

patterns.name: parametric 词项
patterns.context: 该词及其复合形式出现在统计分析、估计方法或模型不确定性语境中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、统计学、科研摘要或论文

patterns.name: 动词过去式词尾 -ed
patterns.context: 激活落在英语过去式或过去分词动词的词尾部分，词形被分成多个 token；上下文和领域不固定。
patterns.domain: 法律、科研、网页及一般英语

patterns.name: -ic 形态片段
patterns.context: 激活位于多 token 词的内部片段，涉及形容词或复合形容词；此模式仅见于少数段。

patterns.name: 质量或能力描述词中的 -ed
patterns.context: 在招聘广告中描述候选人的服务态度或技能。

patterns.name: Unexplained：孤立的强动词激活
patterns.context: 出现在警方要求当事人留在现场的叙述中；除与其他段共有的动词词尾现象外，看不出与主要模式的联系。

en.description: Activations are distributed across multiple text types and subword fragments: quotations, detention, and charge wording in legal rulings; names, music, and charts in encyclopedias; lists of medical personnel; prison statistics; plot expressions; and isotope chemical formulas. There is no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: Hyphens and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs around court ruling citations, case names, statutes, or page numbers, often with line breaks and citation formatting.

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in proper names and personal names
patterns.context: A word's interior or beginning is split into subwords; occurs in proper names such as film crew members, actors, or historical figures.

patterns.name: Degree and contrast expressions in narratives
patterns.context: In a film plot description, after a character appears and reveals an affair, the narrative foreshadows a worsening situation.

patterns.name: Multidisciplinary medical personnel titles
patterns.context: Lists different specialists on a cardiovascular imaging team, with titles split into subwords.

patterns.name: Institutions, groups, and prison-related terms
patterns.context: Discusses statistical changes in attacks on staff and inmates in U.S. state and federal prisons.

patterns.name: Music and instrument categories
patterns.context: Describes a luthier making instruments for orchestral and jazz musicians and their endorsers.

patterns.name: Detention language in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Describes the conditions of a traffic case involving a stop, a vehicle being pulled over, and the defendant being detained by an officer.

patterns.name: Chemical-formula fragments for radioactive compounds
patterns.context: Experimental methods list isotope-labeled glucose and methyl glucoside compounds.

patterns.name: Popular song charts and rankings
patterns.context: Describes album tracks and songwriters, along with weeks on and rankings in the Billboard Hot 100.

patterns.name: Charges and ruling language in legal judgments
patterns.context: Discusses whether evidence supports a jury's finding on a lesser charge and affirms the judgment at the end.

3_158.description: 激活分布在多类文本与词片段上：法律判决的引文、拘留和罪名措辞；百科中的人名、音乐与榜单；医学人员列举；监狱统计；剧情表达及同位素化学式。没有单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的连字符与标点
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决引文、案名、法条或页码周围，常伴随换行与引文格式

patterns.name: 专名及姓名的词内片段
patterns.context: 词的内部或开头被切分为子词；位于电影制作人员、演员或历史人物姓名等专名中

patterns.name: 叙事中的程度与转折表达
patterns.context: 电影剧情介绍中，人物出现并揭示婚外情后，叙述预示情势恶化

patterns.name: 多学科医疗人员称谓
patterns.context: 列举心血管影像团队中的不同专业人员，称谓以子词形式拆分

patterns.name: 机构、群体及监狱相关词
patterns.context: 讨论美国州和联邦监狱中工作人员与囚犯遭袭的统计变化

patterns.name: 音乐与乐器类别
patterns.context: 介绍制琴师为管弦乐和爵士乐演奏者制作乐器及其代言人

patterns.name: 法律程序中的拘留措辞
patterns.context: 道路交通案件中描述停车、拦截以及被告受警员拘留的条件

patterns.name: 放射性化合物的化学式片段
patterns.context: 实验方法中列出带同位素标记的葡萄糖及甲基葡萄糖苷化合物

patterns.name: 流行歌曲榜单与排名
patterns.context: 介绍专辑歌曲、创作者及其在 Billboard Hot 100 的上榜周数和名次

patterns.name: 法律判决中的罪名与裁决用语
patterns.context: 讨论证据是否支持陪审团认定较轻罪名，并在结尾维持原判

en.description: Activation is distributed across unrelated domains: floating controls and HTML navigation in code, phrasing about rounding to the nearest value in math problems, academic formulas and institution names, philosophical terminology, and sporadic words in encyclopedia and plot narratives.

patterns.name: Floating component identifiers
patterns.context: Activation falls on floating/Floating identifier fragments split across tokens, especially UI control class names or resource IDs.

patterns.name: Questions about rounding to a specified precision
patterns.context: A math problem asks how a value rounds to a specified place; activation is concentrated around rounded, to, the, nearest.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula fragments in academic text
patterns.context: A formula or LaTeX mathematical expression is truncated, split across lines, or interleaved with text; trigger locations do not form an obvious lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and place names in academic institution names
patterns.context: Split proper nouns, place names, and academic or medical institution names appear in affiliations or institutional addresses.

patterns.name: Moral luck terminology
patterns.context: Philosophical discussion of the Moral Luck View, types of moral luck, and their relationship to compatibilism and incompatibilism.

patterns.name: Peak-related word in song chart narratives
patterns.context: Describes changes in a song’s position on the Billboard chart; activation mainly falls on the ending of peaking.

patterns.name: Film production and distribution company names
patterns.context: Describes a production team planning to make a film and release it through a distributor; salient activations are scattered across pronouns, modal verbs, and company names.

patterns.name: HTML document navigation list
patterns.context: An HTML document lists API page sections such as Field, Constructor, and Method using lists and anchor links.

patterns.name: Plot twists and negative expectations
patterns.context: A plot summary mentions a constrained situation, an unknown relationship, and the expectation that things will only get worse; salient words are scattered.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC film and TV plot text

3_158.description: 激活分布跨领域且不统一：包括代码中的 floating 控件与 HTML 导航、数学题的 nearest 舍入措辞、学术公式和机构名、哲学术语，以及百科和剧情叙述中的零散词。

patterns.name: 浮动组件标识符
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 拆分的 floating/Floating 标识符片段，尤其是 UI 控件类名或资源 ID。

patterns.name: 圆整到指定精度的提问
patterns.context: 数学题问某个数值四舍五入到某一位数；激活集中在 rounded、to、the、nearest 一带。

patterns.name: 学术语料中的数学符号与公式碎片
patterns.context: 公式或 LaTeX 数学表达式被截断、跨行或与文本混排；具体触发位置不构成明显词汇模式。

patterns.name: 学术机构名称中的专名与地名
patterns.context: 机构署名或单位地址中出现被拆分的专名、地名及学科/医学机构名称。

patterns.name: 道德运气术语
patterns.trigger: « circumstantial»、« and»、« constitutive»、« moral»、« luck»、« compat»ibil»ism、« incomp»at»ibil»ism
patterns.context: 讨论 Moral Luck View、道德运气类型及其与相容论/不相容论关系的哲学论述。

patterns.name: 歌曲榜单叙述中的高峰词
patterns.trigger: «aking»10（与前面的 pe 组成 peaking）
patterns.context: 叙述歌曲在 Billboard 榜单上的排名变化；主要激活落在 peaking 的词尾。

patterns.name: 电影制作与发行公司名称
patterns.context: 叙述制作团队计划拍摄电影并经发行公司发行；显著激活分散在代词、情态动词和公司名上。

patterns.name: HTML 文档导航列表
patterns.context: HTML 文档中以列表和锚链接列出 Field、Constructor、Method 等 API 页面栏目。

patterns.name: 剧情转折与负面预期
patterns.context: 剧情梗概提及受限处境、未知关系及后续只会变糟的预期；显著词彼此分散。

en.description: Activations cover U.S. population racial-composition statistics, the word peaking, and sporadic text in Java test code, HTML/XHTML markup, and legal bylines. No single stable semantic pattern explains all segments.

patterns.name: Racial-composition statistics
patterns.context: Population-statistics passages about U.S. counties, villages, or cities; activation is distributed across racial-composition phrases and nearby percentages, group names, and punctuation.

patterns.name: peaking participle
patterns.context: Progressive contexts describing an astronomical or musical event reaching a peak; activation occurs within peaking and does not require the same domain.

patterns.name: Java test code and line breaks
patterns.context: Consecutive line breaks and code formatting around Java/JUnit import statements, class names, and package paths.

patterns.name: HTML document markup
patterns.context: HTML/XML fragments in web documents, including API-page navigation and XHTML document type declarations; activation covers several substrings in markup, entities, and declarations.
patterns.domain: GitHub HTML documents and source code

patterns.name: Personal names and titles in legal bylines
patterns.context: Bylines, attorney titles, and institutional addresses in legal documents or Department of Justice letters.

3_158.description: 激活覆盖美国人口种族构成统计、peaking 一词，以及 Java 测试代码、HTML/XHTML 标记和法律署名等零散文本；不存在能解释全部片段的单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 种族构成统计
patterns.trigger: “racial makeup”以及“% White”, “% Black or African American”, “% Native American”, “% Asian”
patterns.context: 美国县、村或城市的人口统计段落；激活分布在种族构成短语及其后的百分比、族群名称和标点附近。

patterns.name: peaking 分词
patterns.context: 描述天文或音乐事件达到峰值的进行式语境；激活落在 peaking 的词内，不要求相同领域。

patterns.name: Java 测试代码与换行
patterns.context: Java/JUnit 导入语句附近，连续换行和类名、包路径的代码格式共同出现。

patterns.name: HTML 文档标记
patterns.context: 网页文档的 HTML/XML 片段，包括 API 页面导航以及 XHTML 文档类型声明；激活覆盖标记、实体和声明中的若干子串。

patterns.name: 法律署名中的人名与职衔
patterns.context: 法律文件或司法部函件的署名、律师职衔及机构地址部分。

en.concept: Structured terminology and symbols in specialized academic text
en.description: Activation mainly falls on fragmentary terminology and typographic units in specialized academic text: LaTeX mathematical symbols/formulas and math paper metadata, quantum-state expressions, as well as PI3K biomedical terminology, experimental staining procedures, and software license clauses. These patterns span a broad range.

patterns.name: Mathematical formula symbols and operators
patterns.context: LaTeX control sequences, brackets, variables, and operators in formulas or derivations; mostly formula fragments rather than complete sentences.

patterns.name: PI3K signaling and phospholipid terminology
patterns.context: PI3K signaling pathways, phosphorylation, and related molecular names; also includes the same terminology in antibody/reagent lists.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical typesetting and formula markers
patterns.context: Typesetting context for mathematical expressions or equation arrays, with activation distributed across symbols, commands, and local parts of formulas.

patterns.name: Mathematical citations and bibliography
patterns.context: Authors, reference metadata, and paper titles; triggers also include mathematical terminology in titles.

patterns.name: Quantum states and tensor product symbols
patterns.context: States quantum information or mathematical examples using state vectors, tensor products, and mapping symbols.

patterns.name: Software license grant clauses
patterns.context: License text lists rights to use, copy, modify, publish, and sell software.

patterns.name: Experimental procedures and dye names
patterns.context: Experimental steps involving cell suspensions, slide preparation, and fluorescent dyes.

3_158.concept: 学术专门文本中的结构化术语与符号
3_158.description: 激活主要落在学术专门文本的片段式术语与排版单元：LaTeX 数学符号/公式及数学论文元数据、量子态表达，另见 PI3K 生物医学术语、实验染色流程和软件许可条款；这些模式跨度较大。

patterns.name: 数学公式符号与算子
patterns.context: 公式或推导中的 LaTeX 控制序列、括号、变量及算子；多为公式片段而非完整句子。

patterns.name: PI3K 信号及磷脂术语
patterns.context: PI3K 信号通路、磷酸化及相关分子名称；也包括抗体/试剂列表中的同一术语。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版与公式标记
patterns.context: 数学表达式或公式数组的排版语境，激活分布在符号、命令和公式局部。

patterns.name: 数学文献引用与参考书目
patterns.context: 作者、参考文献元数据及论文标题；触发点也包括标题中的数学术语。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据/参考书目

patterns.name: 量子态与张量积符号
patterns.context: 以态矢量、张量积和映射符号陈述量子信息或数学例子。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 量子信息/数学论文

patterns.name: 软件许可授予条款
patterns.context: 许可文本列举对软件进行使用、复制、修改、发布和销售的权利。

patterns.name: 实验流程与染色剂名称
patterns.context: 细胞悬液、玻片处理及荧光染色剂的实验步骤。

en.description: Most segments activate on call constructions used to name concepts or objects, across historical narratives, astronomy, mathematics, biology, music, and technical discussions. Other activations occur in Go path comments, mathematical formula symbols, and the name of a biomedical dye.

patterns.name: ‘call’ and its object
patterns.context: In academic or explanatory text, an author names a concept, structure, method, or thing; also includes a narrator reporting someone else's naming. The object may follow immediately or appear after an intervening phrase.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, reviews, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Path handling in Go code
patterns.context: A comment explains how to handle requested paths and nonexistent subpaths when recursively creating directories.

patterns.name: Plus/minus signs and differential terms in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: A formula fragment containing an expression made up of differential terms, plus/minus signs, and superscripts; context is incomplete, making the specific mathematical meaning difficult to determine.

patterns.name: Dye reagent name in experimental methods
patterns.context: After cell suspension is dropped onto a slide and air-dried, a reagent is described as being added; activation is concentrated on multiple subword fragments within the chemical name.

3_158.description: 多数段落激活于为概念或对象命名的 call 结构，涵盖历史叙述、天文、数学、生物学、音乐与技术讨论；另有 Go 路径注释、数学公式符号及生物医学染料名称中的激活。

patterns.name: ‘call’及其宾语
patterns.trigger: “we call”, “they call”, “which they call”, “which I call”，尤其是分隔标记 token «call»9/10
patterns.context: 在学术或说明性文字中，作者为某概念、结构、方法或事物命名；也包括叙述者转述他人的命名。宾语可紧随其后，也可跨短语出现。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、评论与技术讨论

patterns.name: Go 代码中的路径操作
patterns.trigger: «ch»1«own»2 the «requested»2 path + any «sub»3paths that «didn't exist»1；后文有 «MkdirAll»
patterns.context: 注释解释递归创建目录时如何处理请求路径及不存在的子路径。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的正负号与微分项
patterns.trigger: «1»1« +»1 d«^»1«2»3 - d«^»2r)；以及后续分式、期望符号和 LaTeX 标记
patterns.context: 公式片段中出现由微分项、正负号和上标构成的表达式；上下文残缺，难以确定具体数学含义。

patterns.name: 实验方法中的染色试剂名
patterns.context: 细胞悬液滴在玻片上并风干后，描述加入试剂；激活集中于化学名称内部多个子词片段。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on English function words and phrases: call when naming a concept, and/or in lists or license clauses, up in technical contexts, and to introducing purpose or permitted actions; multiple contexts coexist.

patterns.name: Call in naming or defining
patterns.context: When naming, defining, or introducing an object/concept, call is followed by a name or noun phrase; occasionally the subject is omitted.

patterns.name: And/or in software license clauses
patterns.context: Appears in bulleted license clauses, connecting licensed rights or actions, especially “and/or sell copies”.

patterns.name: And in a numerical list
patterns.context: In a consecutive list of chemical bond lengths, and introduces the final item.

patterns.name: Up in technical comments
patterns.context: In a discussion of NoSQL and ACID, it occurs in give up and had me up; the two instances differ in meaning and syntactic function.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: In code comments, appears before a verb to express purpose or an operation to be performed.

patterns.name: Infinitive to in licenses
patterns.context: In license clauses, to introduces actions within the scope of the license, such as “to deal”, “to use”, and “to alter”.

3_158.description: 激活集中在英语功能词及短语：命名概念时的 call、列举或许可条款中的 and/or、技术语境中的 up，以及引出目的或许可行为的 to；多个语境并存。

patterns.name: 称谓或命名中的 call
patterns.context: 在命名、定义或介绍某个对象/概念时，call 后接名称或名词短语；偶有被省略的主语。

patterns.name: 软件许可条款中的 and/or
patterns.context: 出现在许可证的项目符号条款中，连接许可权利或行为，尤其是“and/or sell copies”。

patterns.name: 数值列表中的 and
patterns.context: 化学键长的连续数值列表中，and 引出最后一项。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 化学/结构研究

patterns.name: 技术评论中的 up
patterns.context: NoSQL 与 ACID 的讨论中，分别构成短语 give up 和 had me up；两处语义和句法作用不同。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 代码注释中位于动词前，表达目的或将执行的操作。

patterns.name: 许可证中的 to 不定式
patterns.context: 许可证条款中，to 引出许可范围内的行为，如“to deal”“to use”“to alter”。

en.description: Activations cover formula commands, Greek subword fragments, named expressions, and several words in legal, licensing, scientific, and web texts; beyond local word forms and formatting, no stable cross-domain semantic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical formula symbols
patterns.context: Backslash commands, mathematical variables, and brackets in formulas; activations are scattered across commands and formula fragments

patterns.name: Substrings within Greek words
patterns.context: Fragments within words in continuous Greek text, with no clearly specific semantic condition

patterns.name: Forms of address and naming phrases
patterns.context: Expressions that name, introduce, or refer to objects, such as “call the southern loop” and “calling the circle’s radius”

patterns.name: Topic recommendations and traffic phrasing
patterns.context: Discussion of controversial-topic recommendations, autoplay, and organic traffic; it is difficult to determine whether these words form a stable phrase pattern

patterns.name: Names and court titles in legal documents
patterns.context: Proper names and formal titles, such as those of judges, parties, and courts, on the first page of court rulings

patterns.name: Culture-medium ingredients and experimental procedure connectives
patterns.context: Lists of antibiotics and culture-medium ingredients, and descriptions of transfers or culture conditions in cell-culture methods; most trigger words are common and semantically nonspecific

patterns.name: Quoted sources and paraphrasing language
patterns.context: References to quotation, whether something is mentioned, and repetition of original words in discussions of transmission chains and a prophet’s original words

patterns.name: Software license rights list
patterns.context: Terms granting rights to use, modify, distribute, and sell software in license agreements

3_158.description: 激活涵盖公式命令、希腊语词片段、命名表达，以及法律、许可、科研和网络文本中的若干词语；除局部词形与格式外，未见跨领域稳定的共同语义模式。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学公式符号
patterns.context: 公式中的反斜线命令、数学变量和括号；激活分散在命令与公式片段中

patterns.name: 希腊语词内子串
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文本中的词内部片段，没有明显特定语义条件

patterns.name: 称谓与命名短语
patterns.context: “call the southern loop”及“calling the circle’s radius”等命名、引入称呼或对象的表达

patterns.name: 话题推荐与流量措辞
patterns.context: 争议话题推荐、自动播放及有机流量的讨论；难以确定这些词是否构成稳定短语模式

patterns.name: 法律文书人名及法院头衔
patterns.context: 法院判决首页的法官、当事人和法院名称等专名及正式头衔
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 培养基成分与实验操作连接词
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法段落中列举抗生素、培养基成分并描述转移或培养条件；多数触发词常见且语义不特异

patterns.name: 引述来源与转述措辞
patterns.context: 关于传述链及先知原话的讨论中，涉及引用、是否提及和重复原话

patterns.name: 软件许可权利清单
patterns.context: 许可协议中授予软件使用、修改、分发和销售等权利的条款

en.description: Activation appears in lists of components or categories and their conjunctions across multiple types of technical text, especially cell culture formulations, statistical enumerations, probability problems, and rights granted by software licenses. The common feature may be structured enumeration rather than terminology from a single field.

patterns.name: Culture medium and antibiotic names
patterns.context: Methods for cell culture list medium supplements, antibiotics, or culture conditions; activation also falls on nearby conjunctions and numbers.

patterns.name: Coordination of statistical items
patterns.context: Appears when listing multiple categories, counts, or proportions, especially when connecting items in the final position.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper results and statistical descriptions

patterns.name: Coordinated items in letter-drawing problems
patterns.context: Describes drawing letters without replacement, then asks for the probability of drawing multiple specified letters; letter items co-occur with coordinated structures.

patterns.name: Rights granted by software licenses
patterns.context: License text lists rights to use, modify, distribute, sell, and otherwise freely use software; activation is concentrated on license clauses and their coordinated lists.

patterns.name: Copyright and distribution clauses
patterns.context: Copyright notices or the opening of open-source licenses in code repositories, concerning redistribution in source and binary forms.

3_158.concept: 技术文本中的并列清单
3_158.description: 激活见于多种技术文本中的成分或类别清单及其并列连接，尤其是细胞培养配方、统计列举、概率题和软件许可授予的权利；共同特征可能是结构化枚举，而非单一领域术语。

patterns.name: 培养基与抗生素名称
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法中，列举培养基补充成分、抗生素或培养条件；激活也落在相邻连接词和数字上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 统计项目的并列连接
patterns.trigger: «and»，以及相邻的数量、比例或分类名称
patterns.context: 列举多个类别、计数或比例时出现，尤其在最后一项前连接并列成分。
patterns.domain: 科学论文结果与统计表述

patterns.name: 抽取字母题中的并列项
patterns.trigger: «and»，以及字母项和概率问题中的数量
patterns.context: 描述不放回抽取后，询问同时抽到多个指定字母的概率；字母项与并列结构共同出现。

patterns.name: 软件许可授予权利
patterns.context: 许可文本列出对软件不受限制地使用、修改、分发、销售等权利；激活集中于许可条款及其并列清单。

patterns.name: 版权与分发条款
patterns.context: 代码仓库中的版权声明或开源许可证开头，涉及源代码和二进制形式的再分发。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、软件许可文本

en.concept: Cell culture methods vocabulary, with sporadic word-form triggers
en.description: Primarily responds to media, culture, and serum/antibiotic formulations in cell-culture methods; sporadic triggers also include Bulgarian “national responsibility,” the medical statistics term operating, and xerographic word forms.

patterns.name: Cell culture medium
patterns.context: Culture-medium names and formulation contexts appear when describing cell culture, culture conditions, or experimental treatment.

patterns.name: Culture-medium supplements and antibiotics
patterns.context: Serum and antibiotic supplements are listed in cell-culture medium formulations, typically with values and units.
patterns.domain: Cell culture methods in biomedical papers

patterns.name: Bulgarian expression of national responsibility
patterns.context: Discusses consular assistance and protection as a national responsibility; unrelated to laboratory culture contexts.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, Bulgarian political or institutional phrasing

patterns.name: ROC term fragment
patterns.context: Patient outcomes and peak VO2 statistical analysis, with references to ROC curves or AUC.

patterns.name: Xerographic-distribution-related word forms
patterns.context: Discusses the combination of theory and xerographic distribution and its framework; not a cell-culture context.
patterns.domain: ArXiv theoretical physics or related academic text

3_158.concept: 细胞培养方法词汇，兼有零散词形触发
3_158.description: 主要响应细胞培养方法中的培养基、培养及血清/抗生素配方；另有零散触发：保加利亚语“国家责任”、医学统计术语 operating 和 xerographic 词形。

patterns.name: 细胞培养基质
patterns.trigger: "cultured"、"grown" 与 "in"、"with" 或 "medium" 相邻，及培养基名称如 "Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium"、"DMEM"、"RPMI-1640"、"α-MEM"、"Leibovitz's L-15 medium"
patterns.context: 描述细胞培养、培养条件或实验处理时，出现培养基名称及其配制语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的方法部分

patterns.name: 培养基补充物与抗生素
patterns.trigger: "fetal bovine serum"、"FBS"、"FCS"、"penicillin"、"streptomycin"，常与百分比、浓度或 "supplemented with" 同现
patterns.context: 细胞培养基配方中列出血清及抗生素等补充成分，通常带数值和单位。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的细胞培养方法

patterns.name: 保加利亚语民族责任表述
patterns.context: 论述领事协助与保护是国家责任；与实验室培养语境无关。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，保加利亚语政治或制度表述

patterns.name: ROC 术语片段
patterns.context: 患者结局与峰值 VO2 的统计分析语境，出现 ROC 曲线或 AUC。

patterns.name: xerographic 分布相关词形
patterns.context: 讨论理论与 xerographic distribution 的结合及其框架；不是细胞培养语境。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论物理或相关学术文本

en.description: Primarily responds to prompts, specified-draw questions, and combination lists in probability problems about drawing letters without replacement; also activates on several words in cell culture formulations, forum comments, and disaster narratives, showing multiple related but not fully unified patterns.

patterns.name: Wording in without-replacement sampling prompts
patterns.context: Draws several letters from a set composed of letters and counts in braces, then asks for the probability of a specified combination; wording may vary slightly or be truncated mid-prompt.

patterns.name: Probability questions about specified letter combinations
patterns.context: Immediately follows a prompt about drawing without replacement, asking for specified quantities of each letter; often includes commas and combinations of numbers and letters.

patterns.name: Culture medium components and experimental procedure terminology
patterns.context: Describes cell culture, temperature, and medium/reagent components; activation is distributed around technical names and formulation terms.

patterns.name: Locally emphasized English words
patterns.context: Forum posts discuss running software locally, payment, and paying generously; activation falls on several content words or word fragments, with no obvious lexical pattern matching the math problems.

patterns.name: Degree and outcome words in disaster reporting
patterns.context: Narratives describe a hurricane causing deaths, property damage, flooding, and crop damage; activation falls on adverbs of degree and words describing the disaster’s impact.

3_158.concept: 混合的词语与题型特征
3_158.description: 主要响应无放回字母抽样概率题中的题干、指定抽取问法及组合列表；另在细胞培养配方、论坛评论和灾害叙述中的若干词上激活，呈现多个语境相关但不完全统一的模式。

patterns.name: 无放回抽样题干措辞
patterns.trigger: « without»…« replacement»；«Four letters picked» / «Three letters picked»
patterns.context: 从花括号中的字母及数量构成的集合里抽取若干字母，求指定组合的概率；措辞可略有变化，也可能截在题干中段。

patterns.name: 指定字母组合的概率问法
patterns.trigger: «Give prob of» / «What is prob of»；«picking» 后列出字母数量，并以 «and» 连接
patterns.context: 紧接无放回抽样题干，询问抽到指定数量的各字母；常出现逗号及数字与字母的组合。

patterns.name: 培养基成分及实验流程术语
patterns.context: 描述细胞培养、温度和培养基/试剂成分，激活分布于专业名称和配方词汇附近。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学方法部分

patterns.name: 局部强调的英文词语
patterns.context: 论坛发言中讨论本地运行软件、付费及慷慨支付；激活落在若干内容词或词内片段，缺少与数学题相同的明显词法模式。

patterns.name: 灾害报道中的程度与结果词
patterns.context: 飓风造成死亡、财产损失、洪水及农作物损害的叙述；激活落在程度副词和描述灾害影响的词上。

en.concept: Specific word strings in probability problems and disclaimer clauses
en.description: Primarily responds to “without replacement” and lists of draw events in probability problems; another clear pattern is categories of loss and bases of liability in uppercase disclaimer clauses. Mathematical answers and fragments also occur.

patterns.name: Without-replacement sampling phrasing
patterns.context: Probability problems describe drawing several letters from a set of letters and their counts, typically followed by the set and the requested probability; activations cluster on “without replacement” and nearby words.

patterns.name: Listing draw events
patterns.context: The problem lists the letters and quantities to be drawn, often joined by commas and and; letters and quantities vary randomly by problem.

patterns.name: Legal liability and loss disclaimer clause
patterns.context: Disclaimer clauses list damages involving goods or services, loss of use, data, profits, and business interruption; text is presented in uppercase legal-document format.

patterns.name: Basis of liability and scope of negligence
patterns.context: Disclaimer clauses state that damages are covered regardless of how they are caused or the theory of liability, including contract, strict liability, tort, and negligence; uppercase legal text may contain line breaks or annotations.

patterns.name: Fragments and answer formatting
patterns.context: Isolated problem fragments or answer fractions appear in mathematical passages; these tokens do not form a trigger pattern as clear as that of the main problem and may be residual adjacent text or formatting.

3_158.concept: 概率题与免责条款中的特定词串
3_158.description: 主要响应不放回抽样概率题中的“without replacement”及抽取事件列举；另一明确模式是大写免责条款中的损失类别与责任依据。数学答案、残片亦伴随出现。

patterns.name: 不放回抽样表述
patterns.context: 概率题描述从字母及其数量组成的集合中抽取若干字母，通常后接集合和所求概率；激活集中落在“without replacement”及附近词语。

patterns.name: 抽取事件的列举
patterns.trigger: «picking»、各字母名及其前面的数量，如 «i»、«n»、«v»
patterns.context: 问题列出要抽到的字母及数量，常以逗号和 and 连接；字母与数量是题目随机变化的变量。

patterns.name: 法律责任与损失免责条款
patterns.context: 免责条款列举商品或服务、使用损失、数据、利润及业务中断等损害；文本以大写法律文书格式呈现。
patterns.domain: Github 法律条款／软件免责声明

patterns.name: 责任依据及过失范围
patterns.trigger: «HOWEVER» «CAUSED» AND ON ANY THEORY OF «LIABILITY», WHETHER IN «CONTRACT», «STRICT» «LIABILITY», OR «TORT» (INCLUDING «NEGLIGENCE» OR «OTHERWISE»)
patterns.context: 免责条款说明损害无论如何造成、基于何种责任理论，均包括合同、严格责任、侵权及过失；大写法律文本，局部可能有换行或注释。
patterns.domain: Github 法律条款／软件免责声明

patterns.name: 残片与答案格式
patterns.context: 数学段落中出现孤立题目残片或答案分数；这些 token 不构成与主问题同样清楚的触发规律，可能是相邻文本或格式残留。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 文本残片／答案

en.description: Activation is distributed across substrings within words in multiple languages, morphological fragments, and English function words; it also appears on Go import path fragments and single-letter mathematical variables. The segments have little in common and show no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: English inflectional affixes/word-boundary continuations
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter substrings within words or on word-final/stem portions across tokens, often associated with morphological changes, tokenization, or affix boundaries; the specific locations are not fixed.
patterns.domain: English and multilingual text, prose, email, encyclopedias, math problems, etc.

patterns.name: Path and identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: Appears in import paths in Go code, with activation concentrated on token fragments in domain names, directories, or package names.

patterns.name: Function words and phrase fragments in sentences
patterns.context: Scattered activation on frequent function words or conjunctions in ordinary English sentences, with no stable local syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: English text such as comments, email, and math problems

patterns.name: Hungarian morphological fragments
patterns.context: Appears in continuous Hungarian parliamentary speech, with multiple substrings activating after word forms are split.

patterns.name: Greek morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of Greek words, which are split across multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Bulgarian morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on stem or suffix fragments within Bulgarian words.

patterns.name: Single-letter variables or set elements
patterns.context: Variable letters appear in sets, counts, or probability statements in math problems; usually single-letter tokens.

3_158.description: 激活分布在多语种单词内部的子串、词形片段及英语功能词，也出现在 Go import 路径片段和数学单字母变量上。各段共同点较弱，未显示稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语词内的曲折词缀/词界续接
patterns.trigger: 词内被拆开的字母片段，如«called»、«v»oting、«best»ow« upon»、«Mediterr»an«ée»、«nom»（见希腊语）
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的字母子串或跨 token 的词尾/词干部分，常与形态变化、分词或词缀边界有关；具体落点并不固定。
patterns.domain: 英语及多语种文本、散文、邮件、百科、数学题等

patterns.name: 代码中的路径和标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Go 代码的 import 路径中，激活集中于域名、目录名或包名的 token 片段。

patterns.name: 句中功能词及搭配片段
patterns.context: 普通英语句子中零散落在高频功能词或连接词上，未见稳定的局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: 评论、邮件、数学题等英语文本

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词形片段
patterns.context: 位于连续的匈牙利语议会发言文本中，词形拆分后多个子串均有激活。

patterns.name: 希腊语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在希腊语单词的内部片段，词语跨多个 token 分段。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在保加利亚语单词内部的词干或词尾片段。

patterns.name: 单字母变量或集合元素
patterns.context: 数学题中变量字母出现在集合、计数或概率表述里；多为单字母 token。

en.description: Activations are distributed across Greek characters, mathematical symbols and variables, introduction of academic terms, Go import paths, liability and damage terms in license disclaimers, and statistical phrasing in screening studies; apart from repeated disclaimer text, the instances have no evident common local trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Greek text with a sigma token
patterns.context: Activations fall on Greek letters and fragments of Greek words; contexts include Greek parliamentary speech and mixed Latin- and Greek-letter text at the beginning
patterns.domain: EuroParl; the first passage is ArXiv mixed-symbol text

patterns.name: Numbers, variables, and probability-problem fragments
patterns.context: Draws letters from a set, gives counts, and asks for a probability; activations are scattered across variables, punctuation, and conjunctions

patterns.name: Large-parameter range phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses the two asymptotic ranges large-$n$ and large-$n,N$, and introduces a term

patterns.name: Go package paths and imports
patterns.context: Go source package/import declarations and GitHub path strings

patterns.name: Limitation of liability in software disclaimers
patterns.context: Uppercase license or software disclaimer text listing warranty disclaimers, liability exclusions, and types of damages

patterns.name: Screening studies and statistical analysis terminology
patterns.context: Describes invited populations for breast and bowel cancer screening and reports logistic regression, odds ratios, and relative risks

3_158.description: 激活分布在希腊语字符、数学符号与变量、学术术语引入、Go 导入路径、许可证免责声明的免责与损害词，以及筛查研究统计表述中；除免责文本重复外，各处没有显然共同的局部触发模式。

patterns.name: Greek text with a sigma token
patterns.trigger: «σ»、«ε»、«ό»、«ς»、«Π» 等希腊字母或其词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在希腊字母及希腊语词的片段上；有希腊语议会发言上下文，也有开头的混合拉丁字母、希腊字母文本
patterns.domain: EuroParl；第1段为 ArXiv 混合符号文本

patterns.name: 数字、变量与概率题片段
patterns.context: 在集合中抽取字母、给出计数并询问概率；激活分散在变量、标点和连接词上

patterns.name: 大型参数区间表述
patterns.context: 讨论 large-$n$ 与 large-$n,N$ 两种渐近区间，并引入术语

patterns.name: Go 包路径与导入
patterns.context: Go 源码的 package/import 声明及 GitHub 路径字符串

patterns.name: 软件免责声明中的责任限制
patterns.context: 许可证或软件免责声明中，以大写格式列举保证免责、责任排除及损害类型

patterns.name: 筛查研究与统计分析用语
patterns.context: 描述乳腺癌和肠道筛查的受邀人群，并报告逻辑回归、优势比及相对风险
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

en.description: Primarily activates on probability problems involving drawing letters without replacement and Go source import blocks; also appears in political system commentary and cell culture methods. The shared trigger across domains is unclear.

patterns.name: Letter-sampling probability problems without replacement
patterns.context: Draws letters without replacement from a given multiset and asks for the probability of drawing exactly certain letters; another similar problem often follows the answer.

patterns.name: Go code import paths
patterns.context: Package declarations or import blocks in Go source snippets; activation falls on import parentheses, indentation, and tokens associated with repository paths.

patterns.name: Narratives about political systems and ancestors
patterns.context: English sentences discuss how people vote and where political systems came from; the context includes contrast and historical evaluation.

patterns.name: Cell culture conditions and reagents
patterns.context: Lists cell culture media, supplements, and concentrations in experimental methods descriptions.

3_158.description: 主要激活于不放回抽取字母的概率题、Go 源码导入块；另见政治制度评论和细胞培养方法。跨领域共同触发因素不明确。

patterns.name: 字母不放回抽样概率题
patterns.trigger: “letters picked without replacement”“Give prob of picking”“What is prob of picking”，以及字母计数、指定抽取组合和分数答案
patterns.context: 从给定字母多重集里不放回抽取，询问恰好抽到某些字母的概率；答案后常紧接另一道类似题。

patterns.name: Go 代码导入路径
patterns.context: Go 源码片段的包声明或导入块，激活落在导入括号、缩进和仓库路径相关 token 上。

patterns.name: 政治制度与祖先的叙述
patterns.context: 讨论人们如何投票、政治制度从何而来的英文句子；上下文中出现转折和历史性评价。

patterns.name: 细胞培养条件与试剂
patterns.context: 列出细胞培养基、补充剂及浓度的实验方法描述。

en.description: Primarily responds to cell-culture methods, medium supplements, and cell-line conditions in biomedical papers; other independent patterns include reproductive research institutions, website disclaimers, mathematical formulas and expansion terminology, miRNA expression descriptions, and Portuguese text on clusters of cancer patients.

patterns.name: Medium and supplement formulations
patterns.context: Cell-culture methods list media, serum, and antibiotics; triggers are distributed across these formulation terms and nearby numbers and units.

patterns.name: Cell-line and culture-condition subsection
patterns.context: Introduces cell lines, cell sources, or culture conditions, often adjacent to descriptions of culture methods; a complete medium formulation need not appear.

patterns.name: Reproductive health, obstetrics, and institutional names
patterns.context: Studies the reproductive effects of pollutants and mentions academic institutions in pediatrics, obstetrics, and gynecology.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts or research plans

patterns.name: Trademark and website disclaimer phrasing
patterns.context: Disclaimer-like language concerning trademarks or other materials appears near a website comment form.

patterns.name: Mathematical expansion and terminology
patterns.context: A formula defines a vector indexed by a set and calls it an expansion of an object.

patterns.name: miRNA expression and normalization
patterns.context: Reports miRNA expression measurements and normalization using an internal reference.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper results or methods sections

patterns.name: Portuguese phrasing about cancer-patient clusters
patterns.context: Discusses clusters of cancer patients and their geographic distribution on both sides of the Gibraltar border.

3_158.concept: 生物医学方法文本及术语
3_158.description: 主要响应生物医学论文中细胞培养方法、培养基补充剂与细胞系条件；另有生殖研究机构、网站免责声明、数学公式与展开术语、miRNA表达描述及葡萄牙语癌症患者聚集区文本等独立模式。

patterns.name: 培养基及补充剂配方
patterns.trigger: “cultured in complete DMEM medium”, “supplemented with”, “fetal calf serum”, “penicillin”, “streptomycin”
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法中列出培养基、血清及抗生素等成分；触发分布在这些配方词语及其附近的数字、单位上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 细胞系与培养条件小节
patterns.trigger: “Cell lines and culture conditions”, “cell lines”, “HEK 293 cells”, “CRC cell lines”
patterns.context: 介绍细胞系、细胞来源或培养条件，常紧邻培养方法描述；不一定出现完整培养基配方。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 生殖、妇产及机构名称
patterns.context: 研究污染物对生殖的影响，并提及儿科、产科与妇科学术机构。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要或研究计划

patterns.name: 商标及网站免责声明措辞
patterns.trigger: “trademark’s, or other material that might be found on the”
patterns.context: 网站评论表单附近出现对商标或其他材料的免责声明式表述。

patterns.name: 数学展开式与术语
patterns.context: 公式定义集合索引的向量，并将其称为某对象的展开。

patterns.name: miRNA表达与归一化
patterns.context: 报告miRNA表达测量及以内参进行归一化。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文结果或方法部分

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语肿瘤患者聚集区表述
patterns.context: 讨论癌症患者群体聚集区及直布罗陀边境两侧的地理分布。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

en.description: Responds to several fixed stylistic cues: cell culture recipes, the legal-text designation hereinafter/referred to as, and in paper author lists, and Go import paths; also activates on construction-material wording.

patterns.name: Culture medium and antibiotic recipes
patterns.context: In cell culture methods, the neuron activates on culture descriptions and on conjunctions, ingredients, and units in recipes; includes different cell lines and media.

patterns.name: Legal document references and designations
patterns.context: Defines parties, organizations, or materials for later reference in legal texts; also activates on related formal institution names.

patterns.name: and in author name lists
patterns.context: In ArXiv paper author lines, and connects the final two authors; both spans are author metadata.

patterns.name: Go import paths
patterns.context: GitHub module paths in Go source import blocks, especially domain names and slash-separated path tokens.

patterns.name: Construction-material contract wording
patterns.context: Construction contract narratives describing work and ordered materials; this passage lacks the hereinafter reference wording found in other legal passages.

3_158.description: 响应多种固定文体线索：细胞培养配方，法律文本的 hereinafter/referred to as 称谓，论文作者列表的 and，以及 Go 导入路径；另对建筑施工材料措辞有激活。

patterns.name: 培养基及抗生素配方
patterns.trigger: «cultured» / «grown» in … medium，随后出现 supplemented with、血清、penicillin 和 strept«omycin»
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法中，神经元对培养描述及配方中的连接词、成分和单位均有激活；包括不同细胞系和培养基。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 法律文书的指代与称谓
patterns.context: 法律文本中定义当事人、组织或材料的后续简称；也对相关正式机构名称有激活。

patterns.name: 作者姓名列表中的 and
patterns.trigger: 作者姓名并列列表末尾的 «and»
patterns.context: ArXiv论文作者署名行中，and连接最后两位作者；两段均为作者元数据。

patterns.name: Go 导入路径
patterns.context: Go 源代码 import 块中的 GitHub 模块路径，尤其是域名与斜杠分隔的路径 token。

patterns.name: 建筑材料合同措辞
patterns.context: 施工合同叙述工程工作及订购材料；本段未出现其他法律段落中的 hereinafter 指代措辞。

en.description: The strongest repeated clue is 100 µg/mL streptomycin in medium formulations; and at the end of author lists in multiple papers also strongly activates. Other activations occur sporadically in affiliation numbers, paper section headings, public-health table titles, legal contracts, and scientific text, without a unified condition.

patterns.name: Antibiotic dosage in cell-culture medium
patterns.context: Streptomycin concentration is written as 100 µg/mL in a list of medium ingredients; penicillin and other culture-medium ingredients are also listed

patterns.name: and after author names
patterns.context: and at the end of an author list is followed by the final author’s name; the preceding text contains multiple authors or an author-list format

patterns.name: Digit 1 in scientific notation or citation markers
patterns.context: The digit 1 appears as a marker in metadata such as superscript affiliation numbers and co-author markers; activation may be strongly affected by tokenization boundaries

patterns.name: References section heading
patterns.context: A bibliography label appears after the main text or citations

patterns.name: Acknowledgments section heading
patterns.context: An acknowledgments heading appears at the end of a paper, followed by thanks and the names of those acknowledged

patterns.name: Policy topic in table titles
patterns.context: A table title mentions public health practitioners and policy makers together, near a table reference marker
patterns.domain: Public health papers and table titles

patterns.name: Material terms in construction contracts
patterns.context: A legal contract describes ordering construction materials and uses hereinafter called to introduce a term for a contracting party

patterns.name: Prepositional phrases and specialized terms in scientific text
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across scientific prose on optical cloaking, gene-expression comparisons, and quantum hashing, with no stable common trigger condition
patterns.domain: Scientific paper body text across disciplines

3_158.concept: 链霉素剂量与论文格式片段
3_158.description: 最强而重复的线索是培养基配方中100 µg/mL链霉素；多篇论文作者名单末尾的and也强激活。其余激活零散见于署名编号、论文栏目标题、公共卫生表题、法律合同及科学正文，缺乏统一条件。

patterns.name: 细胞培养液中的抗生素剂量
patterns.context: 培养基成分列表中，链霉素浓度写作100 µg/mL；同时列出青霉素及其他培养液成分

patterns.name: 作者姓名后的 and
patterns.trigger: « and»10 Axel Brandenburg；« and»10 Hagai Net；« and»9 Hongru Ma；« and»9 Marco Carmosino；« and»9 Joanna Garbulińska
patterns.context: 作者名单末尾的 and 后接最后一位作者姓名；前文有多位作者或作者署名格式
patterns.domain: 论文作者署名与元数据

patterns.name: 科学记数或引用标记中的数字1
patterns.context: 姓名后的上标机构编号、共同作者标记等元数据中，数字1以标记形式出现；激活受分词边界影响的可能性较大
patterns.domain: 论文作者署名与脚注格式

patterns.name: 参考文献栏标题
patterns.context: 正文或引文后出现 bibliography 标签

patterns.name: 致谢栏标题
patterns.context: 论文末尾的致谢标题，随后是感谢语和被感谢者姓名

patterns.name: 表格标题中的政策主题
patterns.context: 表格标题并列提及 public health practitioners 与 policy makers，附近含表格引用标记
patterns.domain: 公共卫生论文与表格标题

patterns.name: 建筑合同中的材料称呼
patterns.context: 法律合同描述施工材料订购，并以 hereinafter called 引入合同当事方称谓

patterns.name: 科学文本中的介词短语和特殊术语
patterns.context: 激活分散在光学隐身、基因表达比较及量子哈希等科学正文中，未见稳定共同触发条件

en.description: Mainly activates on medium, serum, and antibiotic terms in cell culture recipes; also occurs on and in name/material lists, the distancing or qualifying so-called, and scanners in lithography patents.

patterns.name: Cell culture medium recipes
patterns.context: Describes culture conditions for cells or cell lines, often listing medium, serum, and antibiotic concentrations; activation is scattered across recipe words and units

patterns.name: and in proper-name lists
patterns.context: Connects listed authors, collaborators, or materials, usually before the final item in a proper-name list; [5] is in a construction-material context

patterns.name: Ironic/quotation-mark cue
patterns.context: Signals distancing, qualification, or commentary about a designation or category; used once for jazz and once for a generation of learners

patterns.name: Scanner terminology in patents
patterns.context: Introduces equipment categories and how they work using a contrastive structure in descriptions of lithography equipment

3_158.description: 主要激活于细胞培养配方中的培养基、血清和抗生素词；另见姓名/材料列举中的 and、带引号或限定意味的 so-called，以及光刻专利中的 scanners。

patterns.name: 细胞培养基配方
patterns.trigger: “DMEM”“MEM”“L-15 medium”等培养基名称，以及 “supplemented with”“fetal bovine/calf serum”“penicillin”“streptomycin”
patterns.context: 描述细胞或细胞系的培养条件，常列出培养基、血清及抗生素浓度；激活散布在配方词语和单位上
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法、细胞培养

patterns.name: 专名中的 and
patterns.trigger: 姓名或组织名称列表中的 “and”，如 “and Axel Brandenburg”“and Joanna Garbulińska”；另见一般并列处 “and anchor bolts”
patterns.context: 连接列举的作者、合作者或材料，通常位于专名列表末尾；[5]为建筑材料语境
patterns.domain: 学术作者列表、法律叙述

patterns.name: 反讽/引号标记词
patterns.context: 对称谓或类别作疏离、限定或评论；一次用于爵士乐，一次用于学习者世代

patterns.name: 专利中的扫描设备术语
patterns.context: 在说明光刻设备时，用对照结构介绍设备类别及其工作方式

en.description: The most stable signal is the in-sentence conjunction and, across papers and legal texts; the biomedical passages also emphasize serum, penicillin, and streptomycin in culture medium recipes. End-of-paper lists, line breaks, legal wording, and a few term fragments show sporadic activation; passage 10 is unexplained.

patterns.name: High activation on in-sentence and
patterns.context: Activation often falls on the conjunction and, which connects coordinate elements, names in acknowledgments, or methods and subjects; in some passages it is adjacent to a line break or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, legal documents, academic papers

patterns.name: Antibiotic culture medium recipes
patterns.context: Describes culture medium supplements in cell culture methods, commonly 10% fetal bovine or bovine serum, with penicillin and streptomycin and their concentrations.

patterns.name: Names in references or acknowledgments
patterns.context: Acknowledgments or author lines at the end of academic papers connect multiple names, or thank people for discussion, suggestions, or comments.

patterns.name: and in legal documents
patterns.context: Ordinary coordination in legal arguments or factual narratives in contracts; the provided context is insufficient to confirm a more specific link to other patterns.

patterns.name: Author labels and line breaks
patterns.context: End-of-paper structures such as acknowledgments, author information, and references follow the abstract or main text; activation sometimes falls near line breaks or labels.

patterns.name: Legal case citations and procedural wording
patterns.context: Hyphenated case names in judgment citations, as well as procedural legal language such as motions and summary affirmance.

patterns.name: Construction contract materials and coordinated lists
patterns.context: Construction facts in contracts list materials such as rebar, metal mesh, and anchor bolts, and describe contractor procurement.

patterns.name: Fragments of numbers and technical terms
patterns.context: Numbers, proper names, or technical word fragments in scientific texts; beyond the scientific register, no consistent trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Proper names and term fragments in body text
patterns.context: Proper names, compounds, or term fragments in astrophysics or invisibility-cloak-related body text; local activation cannot be assigned to one specific semantic feature.

patterns.name: Cross-domain local preference for and
patterns.context: Appears in different styles; may be a salient trigger, but not all instances of and activate equally, and the marker is absent in passage 10.

3_158.concept: 并列连接与学术文本结构
3_158.description: 最稳定的信号是句中并列连接词 and，遍及论文与法律文本；生物医学段还突出培养基配方中的血清、青霉素和链霉素。学术文末名单、换行、法律措辞及少数术语碎片呈现零散激活，段10无法解释。

patterns.name: 句中 and 的高激活
patterns.context: 激活常落在连接词 and 上，连接并列成分、致谢名单中的姓名，或说明方法与对象；在某些段落里紧邻换行或标点。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、法律文书、学术论文

patterns.name: 抗生素培养基配方
patterns.trigger: « penicillin»、«strept»omycin 及其剂量单位 «U»/«mL»、«μg»/«mL»；另有 « fetal»、« serum»、« medium»
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法中描述培养基补充物，常见 10% 胎牛或牛血清，并列青霉素和链霉素及浓度。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学实验方法

patterns.name: 参考文献或致谢名单中的人名
patterns.trigger: «Marco» Carm«os»ino、«Scott Wilson»、«Hagai» Net«zer»、«Hong»ru Ma 等人名附近的 «and»；致谢段另有 « helpful»、«illuminating»、«useful»
patterns.context: 学术论文末尾的致谢或作者署名，连接多人姓名，或感谢讨论、建议、评论。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 and
patterns.context: 法律论证或合同事实叙述中的普通并列连接；所给上下文不足以确认与其他模式有更具体关联。

patterns.name: 作者标签及换行符
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文结束后进入致谢、作者信息、参考文献等文末结构；激活有时落在换行或标签附近。

patterns.name: 法律判决引用与程序用语
patterns.context: 判决引用中带连字符的案件名，以及动议、简易确认等程序性法律措辞。

patterns.name: 建筑合同材料及并列清单
patterns.context: 合同施工事实中列举钢筋、金属网、锚栓等材料，并叙述承包商采购。

patterns.name: 数字及技术术语碎片
patterns.context: 科学文本中出现的数字、专名或技术词片段；除科学语域外，未见一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、量子密码学、统计方法

patterns.name: 正文中的专名及术语碎片
patterns.context: 天体物理或隐形斗篷相关正文中的专名、复合词或术语片段；局部激活无法归为同一具体语义特征。

patterns.name: 跨领域的局部 and 偏好
patterns.trigger: « and» 在段 1–9 多次出现，尤其段 1、7、9 标记强
patterns.context: 不同文体中均出现；可能是显著触发特征，但并非所有 and 都同等激活，且段 10 未见该标记。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to table cross-references and their structured markers in scientific papers; it also occurs in table cells, footnotes, and author-list content. Nearby body-text topics vary.

patterns.name: Table cross-reference markers
patterns.context: The body text refers to a table, especially when the reference is adjacent to a link marker containing ref, type, and table; activations often fall on table numbers, marker fields, and nearby connectives.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central scientific paper body text

patterns.name: Table content and footnote structure
patterns.context: Near table rows, cell data, or footnote markers; a table cross-reference in the body text is not required.

patterns.name: Paper author-list formatting
patterns.context: The text transitions from the end of the body to the author-list section, presenting a formatted author list.

3_158.description: 主要对科学论文中表格交叉引用及其结构化标记敏感，也出现在表格单元格、脚注和作者署名等论文结构内容中；附近正文主题多样。

patterns.name: 表格交叉引用标记
patterns.trigger: 原文中的“[Table 2](#…{…ref…type…="table"})”、“[Tables 3](#…) and [4](#…)”及“Supplementary Table S1”等
patterns.context: 正文引用表格时，尤其是引用文本与包含 ref、type、table 的链接标记相邻；激活常落在表格编号、标记字段及附近连接词上。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 科学论文正文

patterns.name: 表格内容与脚注结构
patterns.context: 表格行、单元格数据或脚注标记附近；不要求出现正文中的表格交叉引用。

patterns.name: 论文作者署名格式
patterns.trigger: “author:”“Huanyang Chen”“and Hongru Ma”及其间的引号、连字符和换行
patterns.context: 正文结束后转入作者署名区，呈现带格式符号的作者列表。

en.description: Mainly responds to structured paper markers, table content, and table references; content is often medical clinical data, patient characteristics, and statistical results, and also covers section navigation, public health policy, genetic risk, and network classification methods.

patterns.name: Table structure and cell content
patterns.context: Appears near tables, table rows, or table captions in medical papers, often alongside values, category labels, and table citation markers.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, especially tables of clinical characteristics, outcomes, or statistical results

patterns.name: Table references and cross-references
patterns.context: Appears in body text pointing to tables, supplementary materials, or other paper sections; often includes parsed links or structured citation markers.
patterns.domain: Paper body text and structured publication markup

patterns.name: Paper subsection navigation and section structure
patterns.context: Centers on section headings, section numbers, or descriptions of the paper's organization, possibly with section cross-references.
patterns.domain: Academic paper body text, including computer science and engineering papers

patterns.name: Medical clinical variables and patient characteristics
patterns.context: Clinical data, diagnoses, or treatment characteristics of patient populations, often adjacent to counts, proportions, measurements, or tables.

patterns.name: Statistical results and comparative data
patterns.context: Reports metrics, distributions, proportions, and between-group comparisons in statistical tables or results sections; formatted numbers may be adjacent to table markers.
patterns.domain: Quantitative results in medical and public health research

patterns.name: Public health decisions and policy topics
patterns.context: Concerns differences in decisions between public health practitioners and policymakers, appearing in a table title or research topic heading.

patterns.name: Cancer risk and gene expression
patterns.context: Describes analysis of the association between gene expression and overall breast cancer risk, near a results heading or table description.

patterns.name: Radiotherapy techniques and patient grouping
patterns.context: Introduces whether patients received a particular radiotherapy field and transitions to a description of patient characteristics.

patterns.name: Network methods and classification evaluation
patterns.context: Discusses network performance, classification methods, evaluation criteria, or future work in a paper, near section-navigation sentences.
patterns.domain: Computer science, sensor, or engineering papers

3_158.description: 主要响应论文结构化标记、表格内容及其引用；内容多为医学临床数据、患者特征和统计结果，也覆盖章节导航、公共卫生政策、基因风险及网络分类方法等学术文本。

patterns.name: 表格结构与单元格内容
patterns.trigger: 表格标记及表格中的字段或数据，如 «type» «table» «fn» «Clinical» stage «PSA» «Bacterial infection» «Male»
patterns.context: 出现在医学论文的表格、表格行或表格标题附近，常伴随数值、分类标签及表格引用标记。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文，尤其是临床特征、结局或统计结果表格

patterns.name: 表格引用与交叉引用
patterns.context: 出现在正文中指向表格、补充材料或其他论文部分的位置；常含解析后的链接或结构化引用标记。
patterns.domain: 论文正文与出版物结构化标记

patterns.name: 论文小节导航与章节结构
patterns.context: 围绕章节标题、章节编号或对论文内容安排的说明，可能带有章节交叉引用。
patterns.domain: 学术论文正文，含计算机与工程论文

patterns.name: 医学临床变量与患者特征
patterns.context: 患者群体的临床资料、诊断或治疗特征，常与人数、比例、测量值或表格相邻。

patterns.name: 统计结果与比较数据
patterns.context: 统计表格或结果段落中报告指标、分布、比例及组间比较；格式化数字可能紧邻表格标记。
patterns.domain: 医学与公共卫生研究的定量结果

patterns.name: 公共卫生决策与政策主题
patterns.context: 涉及公共卫生从业者与政策制定者的决策差异，出现在表题或研究主题标题中。

patterns.name: 癌症风险与基因表达
patterns.context: 描述基因表达与总体乳腺癌风险关联的分析，位于结果标题或表格说明附近。
patterns.domain: 遗传流行病学与肿瘤研究

patterns.name: 放疗治疗技术与患者分组
patterns.context: 介绍患者是否接受特定放射治疗照射野，并转入患者特征描述。

patterns.name: 网络方法与分类评估
patterns.context: 论文中讨论网络性能、分类方法、评估标准或后续工作，邻近章节导航语句。
patterns.domain: 计算机、传感器或工程类论文

en.concept: Proper names and structural markers in scientific text
en.description: Activation is scattered across table, figure, and supplementary-material anchors, biomedical methods and terminology in scientific papers; it also appears on uppercase institution names in legal headings and on physics terms. Several instances involve split proper names or technical terms, but there is no clear semantic or syntactic trigger shared across all passages.

patterns.name: Markdown table/figure/supplementary-material reference markers
patterns.context: Internal anchors in scientific paper body text refer to tables, figures, or supplementary files, often alongside HTML attributes such as ref/type and numbering

patterns.name: Uppercase letter fragments in institution names or proper names
patterns.context: Institution names in legal case headings appear in all caps, with activation on split uppercase word fragments

patterns.name: Reagents and units in biomedical methods
patterns.context: Reagents, media, and dosage units appear in sequence when describing cell culture procedures

patterns.name: Technical terms and internal word fragments
patterns.context: A physics sentence discusses invisibility cloaks and wave propagation; activation is distributed across internal fragments of terms

patterns.name: Terms, conjunctions, and ordinary word fragments in mixed scientific text
patterns.context: Occurs in scientific narratives, scale names, or method descriptions; some trigger words have no apparent shared semantics or fixed syntactic conditions

3_158.concept: 科学文本中的专名与结构标记
3_158.description: 激活分散在科学论文中的表图与补充材料锚点、生物医学方法和术语，也见法律标题的大写机构名及物理术语；多处涉及被切分的专名或技术词，但没有贯穿所有段落的明确语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: Markdown 表格/图/补充材料引用标记
patterns.context: 科学论文正文中以内部锚点引用表格、图或补充文件，常伴随 ref/type 等 HTML 属性及编号
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文的 Markdown/HTML 转换文本

patterns.name: 机构或专名中的大写字母片段
patterns.context: 法律案件标题中的机构名称以全大写形式出现，激活落在被切分的大写词片段上

patterns.name: 生物医学方法中的试剂与单位
patterns.context: 描述细胞培养流程时，试剂、培养基和剂量单位连续出现

patterns.name: 技术术语及其内部词段
patterns.context: 物理学句子中讨论隐形斗篷及波的传播；激活分布于术语的内部片段

patterns.name: 混合科学文本中的术语、连接词与普通词片段
patterns.context: 科学叙述、量表名称或方法描述中出现；部分触发词并无明显共同语义或固定句法条件
patterns.domain: 生物医学及相关科学论文

en.concept: Academic paper formatting and term fragments
en.description: Activation is scattered across links and citation markers, table/reference formatting, technical terms, and method descriptions in papers; the two cell culture recipe passages are particularly similar, but the remaining triggers are not consistent and span biomedicine, astronomy, materials, and table text.

patterns.name: Conjunctions and units in bacterial culture medium recipes
patterns.context: Near antibiotic concentrations, units, or drug names when culturing cells or describing culture conditions; co-occurs with common medium and serum recipes

patterns.name: Citation markers in research materials and methods
patterns.context: Cross-references to supplementary materials, figures, tables, or references following body text, especially structured markup for citation markers

patterns.name: Figure and supplementary-material reference markers
patterns.context: References to figures, tables, or supplementary materials in paper body text or tables, with formatted link markers nearby

patterns.name: Database resource lists
patterns.context: Lists literature databases, search sources, or registries, with database names connected by and

patterns.name: Disease names in tables
patterns.context: Table rows present case data such as sex and counts, with split markers in disease names

patterns.name: Astronomy author lists and references
patterns.context: Author lists or reference sections in astronomy papers, including Galactic research and author-list formatting

patterns.name: Molecular biology terminology and statistical methods
patterns.context: Theoretical basis for expression analysis methods and hybridization processes, with terminology and descriptions of statistical distributions

patterns.name: Electrical material properties and scattering mechanisms
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between platinum film resistivity and thickness, surface, and grain-boundary scattering

patterns.name: High/low metabolite level labels
patterns.context: Explains abbreviated labels for high and low metabolite levels in a table

patterns.name: Cell culture method descriptions
patterns.context: Describes experimental steps for thawing cryopreserved cells and growing them in culture medium

patterns.name: Sex and numeric columns in tables
patterns.context: Table rows contain sex and adjacent numeric fields, without a coherent narrative context

patterns.name: Ordinary words in classification or version comparisons
patterns.context: Discusses the original version, confirmation of no confounding, and the fact that correlation does not imply duplicated samples

patterns.name: Media markers after numbered citations
patterns.context: Media-type markers appear in link metadata for supplementary files, figures, or other materials

3_158.concept: 学术论文格式与术语片段
3_158.description: 激活分散于论文中的链接与引用标记、表格/参考文献格式、专业术语及方法描述；两段细胞培养配方尤为相似，但其余段落触发点并不统一，既有生物医学，也有天文、材料和表格文本。

patterns.name: 细菌培养基配方中的单位连接词
patterns.context: 培养细胞或描述培养条件时，在抗生素浓度、单位或药品名称附近；与常见培养基和血清配方同现

patterns.name: 研究材料与方法中的引用标记
patterns.context: 正文后接补充材料、图表或参考资料的交叉引用，尤其是引用标记的结构化标记文本

patterns.name: 图表与补充材料引用标记
patterns.context: 论文正文或表格中指向图、表、补充材料的引用，附近出现格式化链接标记

patterns.name: 数据库检索资源并列
patterns.context: 列举文献数据库、检索来源或注册库，数据库名称之间以 and 连接
patterns.domain: 系统综述/文献检索方法

patterns.name: 表格中的疾病名称
patterns.context: 表格行中呈现性别、数量等病例资料，疾病名称被拆分标记

patterns.name: 天文学作者署名与参考文献
patterns.context: 天文学论文的作者列表或参考文献区，包含银河系研究及署名格式

patterns.name: 分子生物学术语与统计方法
patterns.context: 表达分析方法与杂交过程的理论依据，出现术语和统计分布描述

patterns.name: 电学材料性质及散射机制
patterns.context: 讨论铂薄膜电阻率与厚度、表面及晶界散射的关系

patterns.name: 代谢物高低水平标注
patterns.context: 解释表格中代谢物高、低水平的缩写标签

patterns.name: 细胞培养方法描述
patterns.trigger: « directly»4 ... liquid nitrogen ... Cells« were« grown» ...« Medium»
patterns.context: 描述细胞冻存后复苏并在培养基中生长的实验步骤

patterns.name: 表格中的性别与数值列
patterns.context: 表格行包含性别及相邻数值字段，缺少连贯叙述语境

patterns.name: 分类或版本比较的普通词汇
patterns.context: 讨论原始版本、确认无混淆以及相关性不等于重复样本

patterns.name: 编号引用后的媒体标记
patterns.context: 补充文件、图表或其他材料的链接元数据中出现媒体类型标记

en.concept: Local language forms and function words
en.description: Activations are distributed across several corpora: common function words, numbers, and units in English academic text; formal forms of address stand out in Polish parliamentary text. Sporadic within-word subword and hyphenated fragments also occur, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: English function words and adjacent structures
patterns.context: In continuous English text, especially lists of parallel items, prepositional phrases, and explanatory sentences; triggers are not limited to a fixed topic.
patterns.domain: English academic papers, abstracts, and mathematical text

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and percentages
patterns.context: Numbers occur in funding identifiers, experimental conditions, statistical results, or mathematical expressions; some numbers stand out alongside nearby English function words.

patterns.name: Polish formal forms of address and inflected word forms
patterns.context: Forms of address to an audience recur in Polish parliamentary speech; prominent activations fall on subword fragments of the address terms.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual local subword fragments
patterns.context: Occur in English, Polish, and text mixing symbols or identifiers; the fragments alone do not constitute a stable semantic pattern.

3_158.concept: 语言局部形式与功能词
3_158.description: 激活分散于多种语料：英语学术文本中常见功能词、数字和单位；波兰语议会语料中突出正式称呼。另有零散词内子词及连字符片段，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及其邻接结构
patterns.context: 在英语连续文本中，尤其是并列项目、介词短语和说明性句子；触发并不局限于某个固定主题。
patterns.domain: 英语学术论文、摘要及数学文本

patterns.name: 数字及单位、百分数
patterns.context: 数字嵌于经费编号、实验条件、统计结果或数学表达式时；部分数字与附近英语功能词同时突出。

patterns.name: 波兰语正式称呼与屈折词形
patterns.context: 波兰语议会发言或正式称呼中，反复出现对听众的称呼；突出部分落在称呼词的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 跨语种局部子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在英语、波兰语及符号或编号混合文本中，片段自身不足以构成稳定语义模式。
patterns.domain: 多语种及混合符号文本

en.description: Mainly responds to and before the final author name in paper text, often accompanied by author fields and name-list formatting; also responds to local patterns involving biomedical reagents/units, company-name endings, acknowledgments, reference markers, mathematical wording, and institutional postal codes.

patterns.name: Final and in author lists
patterns.context: Immediately adjacent to multiple author names in comma-separated lists; usually followed by the final author's name, then a citation end marker or author metadata.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper acknowledgments, author information, and references; also reagent-vendor lists in PMC paper body text

patterns.name: Biomedical reagent names and concentration units
patterns.context: Chemicals, media, serum, antibiotics, and concentration units are adjacent in cell culture methods or reagent lists.

patterns.name: End of reagent vendor name
patterns.context: The end of a reagent or oligonucleotide vendor's full company name, followed by a period and a location in parentheses.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central biomedical materials and methods

patterns.name: Literature author-field marker
patterns.context: Author names are listed in a fixed metadata format after paper acknowledgments or body text; often co-occurs with and before the final name in the list.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper extraction text and author metadata

patterns.name: Expressions of help in acknowledgments
patterns.context: Acknowledgment sentences express thanks for others' help with discussions, followed by an acknowledgments heading or author metadata.

patterns.name: Citation-style reference introduction
patterns.context: An introductory marker for a bibliography or reference list in a mathematics paper, preceded by formulas and citations.

patterns.name: Expression-value comparison and hybridization process
patterns.context: Describes an expression-value comparison strategy and relates it to hybridization and the binomial distribution; the sentence introduces a figure.

patterns.name: Alternative notation for formula symbols
patterns.context: In mathematical contexts, explains shorthand notation for a special case, then gives the general case again.

patterns.name: Place and postal-code-style institutional address
patterns.context: An address formatted as region, postal code, and country after institutional affiliation information.

patterns.name: Sentence-final positions outside author lists
patterns.context: Occurs within body-text sentences, mathematical explanations, and institutional addresses, not in the common format of and before the final author in a list; strong triggers are scattered.
patterns.domain: Paper body text or metadata; may reflect independent triggers from different local word forms

3_158.concept: 论文作者及列表边界词
3_158.description: 主要响应论文文本中末位作者姓名前的 and，常伴作者字段与姓名列表格式；另对生物医学试剂/单位、公司名末尾、致谢、参考文献标记、数学措辞和机构邮编等局部模式有响应。

patterns.name: 作者名单中的末位 and
patterns.trigger: 作者名单末位姓名前的 «and»10（段1–4）或«and»9（段5、6、8–10）
patterns.context: 紧邻多个作者姓名、逗号分隔的作者列表；通常后接末位作者姓名，之后出现引文结束标记或作者元数据。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文致谢、作者信息与参考文献；也见 PMC 论文正文中的试剂供应商名单

patterns.name: 生物医学试剂名称及浓度单位
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法或试剂清单中，化学品、培养基、血清、抗生素与浓度单位相邻。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学实验方法

patterns.name: 试剂供应商名称末尾
patterns.context: 试剂或寡核苷酸供应商的公司全名末尾，后接句号及括号中的地点。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学材料与方法

patterns.name: 文献作者字段标记
patterns.context: 论文致谢或正文段落后，以固定元数据格式列出作者姓名；常与作者名单末位的 and 同现。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文抽取文本及作者元数据

patterns.name: 致谢中的帮助表达
patterns.context: 以感谢语气表达对他人讨论帮助的致谢句，随后进入致谢标题或作者元数据。

patterns.name: 引用式参考文献引导
patterns.context: 数学论文中参考文献或文献列表的引导标记，前文含公式与引用。

patterns.name: 表达值比较与杂交过程
patterns.context: 描述表达值比较策略，并将其联系到杂交过程及二项分布；该句引出图示。

patterns.name: 公式符号的替代写法
patterns.context: 数学语境中说明对特殊情形采用某个符号的简写，随后给出恢复的一般情形。

patterns.name: 地名邮编式机构地址
patterns.context: 机构隶属信息之后，以地区、邮政编码和国家组成的地址格式出现。

patterns.name: 作者名单之外的句末位置
patterns.trigger: 段7的«hybridization»1；段8的«instead»；段9的邮编片段
patterns.context: 分别处于正文句子内部、数学解释语句和机构地址中，不符合作者列表末位 and 的共同格式；强触发点分散。
patterns.domain: 论文正文或元数据；可能是不同局部词形的独立触发

en.description: Mainly occurs in biomedical papers: responds to section-structure sentences, cross-reference markers, reagents and institution names, and experimental-condition vocabulary; also includes method comparisons, biological terms, and scattered explanatory words. Passage 10 contains only local computational expressions and a figure reference, with no clear pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed section-transition language
patterns.context: At an introduction or section transition, describes the paper's structure and introduces a section reference; present in [2] and [4]

patterns.name: Comparisons and threshold expressions in methods or results
patterns.context: Describes computational filtering criteria or comparison methods; activation is scattered across methods and results explanations, not one fixed phrase

patterns.name: Biomedical proper names, reagents, and company information
patterns.context: Biomedical materials, reagents, or supplier names, usually adjacent to company, location, product, or experimental information; multiple activations fall on split proper names and their surroundings

patterns.name: Technical terms, figures, tables, and citation markers
