patterns.context: Section, figure, table, or supplementary-material cross-references and their markers in papers; overlaps with fixed section-transition language, but also occurs in figure-caption references

patterns.name: Biomedical experimental conditions and units
patterns.context: Records culture conditions, doses, concentrations, or experimental duration; scattered activation appears around numbers and units

patterns.name: Molecular biology and metabolomics vocabulary
patterns.context: Terms for specific biological objects or processes occur in paper narratives without a consistent syntactic environment

patterns.name: General explanatory collocations
patterns.context: Ordinary words in local explanations, definitions, or descriptions of research procedures; triggers are scattered, with no stable shared context

3_158.concept: 生物医学论文结构与术语
3_158.description: 主要出现在生物医学论文中：对章节结构句、交叉引用标记、试剂与机构专名及实验条件词汇有反应；另有方法比较、生物术语和零散说明词。第10段只有局部计算表达与图引用，模式不明。

patterns.name: 固定章节结构衔接语
patterns.trigger: «The rest»、«of the paper is organized as follows»、«Section 2»
patterns.context: 论文引言或章节过渡处，说明文章后续结构，并引出章节引用；[2]、[4]均出现

patterns.name: 方法或结果中的比较与阈值表达
patterns.context: 描述计算筛选条件或比较方法；激活分散在方法及结果说明中，并非同一固定短语
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法与结果

patterns.name: 生物医学专名及试剂、公司信息
patterns.context: 生物医学材料、试剂或供应商名称，通常邻接公司、地点、产品或实验信息；多个激活落在被分词的专名及其周边
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文材料与方法

patterns.name: 技术名词、图表和引用标记
patterns.context: 论文中的章节、图表或补充材料交叉引用及其标记；与固定章节衔接语重叠，但也出现在图注引用中
patterns.domain: 学术论文排版与交叉引用

patterns.name: 生物医学实验条件与单位
patterns.context: 记录培养条件、剂量、浓度或实验周期；数值和单位周围有零散激活

patterns.name: 分子生物学与代谢组学词汇
patterns.context: 特定生物学对象或过程的术语在论文叙述中出现，未呈现统一的句法环境
patterns.domain: 分子生物学与生物医学研究

patterns.name: 一般说明性搭配
patterns.context: 局部说明、定义或研究流程叙述中的普通词语，触发点分散，未见稳定共同上下文

en.concept: Structured methods and metadata in academic papers
en.description: Mainly responds to lists of reagents, culture media, suppliers, and experimental conditions in paper methods sections, as well as paper author metadata; also covers explanations of mathematical notation. The shared feature is structured proper names, parameters, and fields in academic papers.

patterns.name: Cell culture and antibiotic recipes
patterns.context: Describes cell culture conditions in biomedical methods sections, often listing medium, serum, penicillin, and streptomycin concentrations; includes HEK293, MCF-17, and other cell experiment contexts.

patterns.name: Reagent and company information
patterns.context: Lists the sources and company addresses of reagents, oligonucleotides, or drugs in experimental methods or drug lists.

patterns.name: Paper author field
patterns.context: Formatted author metadata appears after paper body text or references, with names separated by commas and “and”.

patterns.name: Mathematical references and notation transitions
patterns.context: Transitions from a citation or special case to notation conventions and a derivation in a mathematics paper.

patterns.name: Animal experiment conditions and disease induction
patterns.context: Describes housing conditions in animal experiment methods and introduces induction of a disease model.

3_158.concept: 学术论文结构化方法与元数据
3_158.description: 主要响应论文方法段中试剂、培养基、供应商及实验条件的列举，也响应论文作者元数据；另覆盖数学记号说明。共同特征是学术论文中的结构化专名、参数和字段。

patterns.name: 细胞培养与抗生素配方
patterns.trigger: “mL”前的剂量及“penicillin”“streptomycin”，以及培养基和血清名称
patterns.context: 生物医学方法段中描述细胞培养条件，常以培养基、血清、青霉素和链霉素的浓度列举配方；覆盖 HEK293、MCF-17 等细胞实验语境。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学实验方法

patterns.name: 试剂与公司信息
patterns.trigger: “Co., Ltd.”及其前后的试剂、供应商和地点，如“miR-149 ASO”“Shanghai, China”
patterns.context: 实验方法或药物清单中列出试剂、寡核苷酸或药物的来源及公司地址。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学方法

patterns.name: 论文作者字段
patterns.context: 论文正文或参考内容之后出现格式化作者元数据，姓名间以逗号和“and”分隔。

patterns.name: 数学参考文献与记号过渡
patterns.context: 数学论文中从引用或特殊情形过渡到符号约定和推导。

patterns.name: 动物实验条件与疾病诱导
patterns.context: 动物实验方法中说明饲养环境并引出疾病模型诱导。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学实验方法

en.description: Activations span several types of paper fragments: streptomycin dosage is especially prominent in cell-culture formulations, and other instances include funding acknowledgments, and+name in author lists, connectives in mathematical prose, and descriptions of miRNA/mimic reagents.

patterns.name: Biomedical medium ingredients and antibiotic formulations
patterns.context: Medium, serum, and penicillin/streptomycin formulations in cell-culture methods; strong triggers cluster near “mL…streptomycin,” often adjacent to “and 100”

patterns.name: Chinese funding agency names and grant identifiers
patterns.context: Chinese national or provincial research funding and project identifiers listed in the paper’s Funding information section

patterns.name: Names following and in author lists
patterns.context: ArXiv paper author line; typically appears in author metadata at the end of a body-text fragment

patterns.name: Conjunctions in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Connects parallel propositions, objects, or inferences in mathematical or theoretical papers; not an author list

patterns.name: miRNA names and mimic reagents
patterns.context: Lists RNA mimics, miRNAs, and reagent sources in a molecular biology methods section

3_158.concept: 论文中的结构化并列表达
3_158.description: 激活覆盖多种论文片段：细胞培养配方中尤其突出链霉素用量，另见基金致谢、作者列表中的 and+姓名、数学正文连接词，以及 miRNA/mimic 试剂描述。

patterns.name: 生物医学培养基成分与抗生素配方
patterns.trigger: “100»2« µg»2«/»2«mL»8 strept«omycin»3”，以及“10»1%…serum”和培养基名称
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法段落中，培养基、血清及青霉素/链霉素的配方描述；强触发集中在“mL…streptomycin”附近，常与“and 100”相邻

patterns.name: 资助信息中的中国基金名称与编号
patterns.context: 论文 Funding information 段落，列举中国国家或省级科研资助及项目编号

patterns.name: 作者列表中 and 后的姓名
patterns.trigger: 作者列表里的“and”及其后的人名，如“and T.M. Fromhold”“and Yao Xiang”“and Hagai Netzer”
patterns.context: ArXiv 论文作者行；通常出现在正文片段末尾的作者元数据中

patterns.name: 数学论文中的并列连接词
patterns.trigger: “and”，包括“and for algebras”“and references therein”“and we recover”
patterns.context: 数学或理论论文正文中连接并列命题、对象或推论；并非作者列表

patterns.name: miRNA 名称与 mimic 试剂
patterns.trigger: “miRNA mimics (miR-149, miR-145, miR-155, and miR-183)”及“circ-CFH2 mimic”
patterns.context: 分子生物学方法段落中列出 RNA mimic、miRNA 和试剂来源

en.description: Activation often occurs on and as a coordinator or connector in lists: experimental reagents and conditions, funding projects, mathematical objects, acknowledgment names, and author lists; with, in, and of are also marked in some biomedical methods lists. The common feature is list structure in academic text.

patterns.name: Connectives in methods or reagent lists
patterns.context: Connects ingredients, treatment conditions, or procedures in consecutive lists in paper methods, culture recipes, or experimental steps; and in lists is most prominent.

patterns.name: Coordination in funding acknowledgments
patterns.context: and connects coordinated items before the final item in a list of funding agencies or project numbers.

patterns.name: Coordination in mathematical descriptions
patterns.context: Connects propositions, objects, or conditions in technical statements, often between formulas or symbolic expressions.

patterns.name: Names coordinated in acknowledgments
patterns.context: Lists people being thanked in acknowledgments, with and before the final name.

patterns.name: Final-item connector in author lists
patterns.context: Connects the final two authors in author metadata; author: and a name list appear nearby.

patterns.name: Final-item connector in author lists
patterns.context: Connects the final two authors in author metadata; author: and a name list appear nearby.

3_158.concept: 学术列举中的并列连接
3_158.description: 激活多见于列表中表示并列或连接的 and：实验试剂与条件、资助项目、数学对象、致谢人名及作者名单；部分生物医学方法清单中的 with、in、of 也被标记。共同点是学术文本中的列举结构。

patterns.name: 方法或试剂清单中的连接词
patterns.context: 在论文方法、培养基配方或实验步骤的连续列举中，连接成分、处理条件或操作；最明显的是清单中的 and。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法与材料

patterns.name: 经费致谢中的并列连接
patterns.context: 资助机构或项目编号列表的末项之前，用 and 连接并列项目。

patterns.name: 数学描述中的并列连接
patterns.context: 技术陈述中连接命题、对象或条件，常位于公式或符号表达式之间。

patterns.name: 致谢中的人名并列
patterns.context: 致谢中列举受感谢者，and 位于姓名列表末项之前。

patterns.name: 作者名单中的末项连接
patterns.context: 作者元数据中连接最后两位作者；附近出现 author: 和姓名列表。

patterns.name: 作者名单中的末项连接
patterns.context: 作者元数据中连接最后两位作者；附近出现 author: 和姓名列表。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several corpora: and, serum, and antibiotic concentrations in cell-culture methods; mathematical symbols and Lie algebra text; and in paper citations/author sections; and word fragments in Polish, Greek, and Romanian parliamentary text. No unified semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Cell culture and antibiotic concentrations
patterns.context: Serum, penicillin, and streptomycin supplementation in a cell-culture methods sentence; high activations concentrate mainly around and and concentration units

patterns.name: Special LaTeX symbols and Pi notation
patterns.context: A math paper describes replacing Π¹ with Π when n=1; activations fall near instead of and formula symbols

patterns.name: Polish parliamentary forms-of-address fragments
patterns.context: Forms of address to the chair and the council president in Polish parliamentary speech; words are split into multiple subword tokens

patterns.name: Thin-film scattering and supplementary-material reference
patterns.context: Discussion of thin-film resistivity and a supplementary-material link, with activations across body text and reference markers

patterns.name: Syllables in Greek compound words
patterns.context: Greek parliamentary text, with activations on syllables within ordinary words split into subwords

patterns.name: Lie algebras and nilpotent structures
patterns.context: Enumerates Lie algebras and their complex-structure properties; stronger activations occur near and and algebra identifiers

patterns.name: and in author lists
patterns.context: A conjunction at the end of a paper author list, between author names

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary word-form fragments
patterns.context: Noun, suffix, or participle fragments in Romanian parliamentary speech, in contexts involving members of parliament and committee proposals

3_158.description: 激活分散于多种语料：细胞培养方法中的 and、血清及抗生素浓度，数学符号和 Lie 代数文本，论文引用/作者栏中的 and，以及波兰语、希腊语、罗马尼亚语议会文本的词片段。未见统一语义触发因素。

patterns.name: 细胞培养与抗生素浓度
patterns.trigger: « and»8、« 10»1%« fetal»4« calf»5« serum»5、« 100»3« »1«μg»2«/»1«mL»7« strept»1«omycin»3；另有相近的« 10»2«%»1« fetal»4« bovine»3« serum»5、« 100»2« µg»2«/»1«mL»8« strept»1«omycin»4
patterns.context: 细胞培养方法句中，培养基补充血清、青霉素和链霉素；高激活主要集中在 and 以及浓度单位附近

patterns.name: 特殊 LaTeX 符号与 Pi 记号
patterns.context: 数学论文中描述 n=1 时以 Π 代替 Π¹；激活落在 instead of 及公式符号附近

patterns.name: 波兰语议会称谓词片段
patterns.context: 波兰语议会发言中对主席及理事会主席的称呼；词语被分成多个子词 token

patterns.name: 薄膜散射与补充材料引用
patterns.trigger: « increased»2 contribution from the surface and grain boundaries «scattering»1；«Supplementary»1 Note
patterns.context: 薄层电阻率讨论及补充材料链接，激活分布在正文与引用标记上

patterns.name: 希腊语复合词中的音节
patterns.context: 希腊语议会文本，激活落在被子词切分的普通词内部音节

patterns.name: Lie 代数与幂零结构
patterns.context: 枚举 Lie 代数及其复结构性质；较强激活位于 and 和代数编号附近

patterns.name: 作者名单中的 and
patterns.context: 论文作者名单末尾的并列连接词，前后为作者姓名
patterns.domain: 天体物理学论文的作者栏

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会词形片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会发言中的名词、词尾或分词片段，出现在议员与委员会提案语境
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录（罗马尼亚语）

en.description: Activations are scattered across Portuguese possessives, the -ING fragment in English uppercase words, Hist in medical titles, and blank lines after email salutations; only local patterns are similar, with no single semantic feature accounting for them.

patterns.name: First-person plural possessive at the beginning or end of a sentence
patterns.context: Portuguese possessive forms in sentences expressing a shared stance, possession, or honorific; the same root triggers in different contexts
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary speeches and editorial notes

patterns.name: Internal subword fragments in English uppercase words
patterns.context: English words split into multiple subword tokens, especially words containing the -ING fragment; examples include shouting, screening, marketing, consulting
patterns.domain: Online text, business materials, research titles

patterns.name: Hist fragment in a title
patterns.context: At the beginning of a medical paper title, followed by “opathological”; activation is concentrated on the initial subword fragment

patterns.name: Informal email opening at the end of a sentence
patterns.context: A blank line follows the salutation “Mike:”, then the first-person expression “I am down to the last few”; the blank line itself is a strong trigger

3_277.description: 激活分散于葡萄牙语所有格、英语大写词中的 -ING 片段、医学标题的 Hist，以及邮件称呼后的空行；仅局部模式相似，无法由单一语义特征概括。

patterns.name: 句末或句中第一人称复数所有格
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中的所有格词形，位于表达共同立场、所属或敬称的句子中；相同词根在不同语境中触发
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语议会发言及编辑说明

patterns.name: 英语大写单词的内部子词片段
patterns.context: 英语词被切分成多个子词 token 时，包含 -ING 片段的词尤为突出；涉及 shouting、screening、marketing、consulting
patterns.domain: 网络文本、商业材料、科研标题

patterns.name: 标题中的 Hist 片段
patterns.context: 位于医学论文标题开头，后接“opathological”；激活集中在词首子词片段

patterns.name: 句末非正式邮件开场
patterns.context: 称呼“Mike:”之后空行，再接第一人称表达“I am down to the last few”；空行本身是强触发处

en.description: The strongest repeated cues are Portuguese “nossa” and the English suffix “ING”; other activations are scattered across names, mixed-case titles/spellings, punctuation and line breaks, and a few isolated subword fragments. The examples span languages and genres and cannot be explained by a single word meaning.

patterns.name: Lowercase “nossa”
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on within-word fragments of the Portuguese word “nossa,” including lowercase and sentence-initial capitalized forms; the surrounding text uses the possessive in complete sentences.

patterns.name: Word-final “ING”
patterns.context: The “ING” ending or participial fragment in English words; examples occur in titles/table of contents, project titles, and company names, with varying capitalization.
patterns.domain: Marketing materials, research project titles, business promotions

patterns.name: “ING” in an uppercase swear word
patterns.context: Embedded in the all-caps, split profanity “FUCKING,” in text asking someone to press the Caps Lock key. The context differs from ordinary suffix examples.

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names/entities
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments of names, forms of address, or proper nouns; the forms are inconsistent. Aside from [7], this also includes a company-name fragment already grouped under the “ING” pattern.

patterns.name: English uppercase letter names/spellings
patterns.context: Activations occur on letter-string fragments in mixed-case or all-caps text, including Caps Lock-related spellings, device/project titles, and English words in medical titles.
patterns.domain: Online text, titles/table of contents, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Boundaries, punctuation, and whitespace
patterns.context: Activations fall on boundary tokens such as colons, periods, or consecutive line breaks; some are adjacent to paragraph/title transitions, but they do not occupy a consistent syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Emails, web text, parliamentary text, titles

patterns.name: Local fragments without a stable pattern
patterns.context: Examples occur in the email phrase “the last few” and at the beginning of “Histopathological” in a medical title; the available samples show no repeated shared trigger condition.

3_277.description: 最强重复线索是葡语「nossa」及英语词尾「ING」；其余激活分散在姓名、大小写混杂的标题/拼写、标点换行和少数孤立词片段中。各类跨语言、跨文体，不能由单一词义解释。

patterns.name: 小写「nossa」
patterns.context: 激活集中在葡萄牙语单词「nossa」的词内片段上，包含小写和句首大写形式；周边是完整句子中的所有格用法。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语议会文本、编辑说明

patterns.name: 词尾「ING」
patterns.context: 英语词中的「ING」词尾或其分词片段；分别出现在标题/目录、项目标题和公司名称中，大小写不同。
patterns.domain: 营销材料、科研项目标题、商业宣传

patterns.name: 大写咒骂中的「ING」
patterns.context: 嵌在全大写、拆分标注的粗俗表达「FUCKING」中，文本要求对方按下 Caps Lock 键。与普通词尾用例语境不同。

patterns.name: 专名/实体中的若干片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名、称呼或专名的片段上；形式不统一，除[7]还含有已归入「ING」模式的公司名称片段。
patterns.domain: 邮件、商业署名、议会发言

patterns.name: 英文大写字母名称/拼写
patterns.context: 激活出现在大小写混杂或全大写文本中的字母串片段，包括 CAPS LOCK 相关拼写、设备/项目标题，以及医学标题中的英文词。
patterns.domain: 网络文本、标题/目录、医学摘要

patterns.name: 边界与标点、空白
patterns.context: 激活落在冒号、句点或连续换行等边界 token 上；部分紧邻段落/标题转换，但不是一致的句法位置。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网页文本、议会文本、标题

patterns.name: 未归入稳定模式的局部片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在邮件中的短语「the last few」和医学标题的「Histopathological」开头；现有样本中没有重复的共同触发条件。

en.description: Activations fall on the initial fragment of Portuguese “nossa,” within-word English subwords such as -ING in uppercase words, and on line-break punctuation and a few proper names, honorifics, and medical terms; trigger positions and contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: Portuguese possessive “nossa”
patterns.context: Occurs in structures such as “a nossa determinação,” “nossa editora,” “nossa Excelência,” and “nossa consciência”; the directly triggering fragment appears to be the initial n, not the whole word.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary text and editorial/publishing notes

patterns.name: English -ING suffix
patterns.context: The -ING ending in uppercase English words is split into subword tokens; examples span profanity, marketing terms, research terminology, and company names, with no specific semantic requirement.
patterns.domain: Online dialogue, business emails, research project titles

patterns.name: Punctuation and line breaks in fragmentary text
patterns.context: Activations fall on paragraph breaks, periods, or nearby formatting boundaries; at least one example is adjacent to an English email name and a short phrase.

patterns.name: Morpheme fragments within uppercase English words
patterns.context: In uppercase, split English text, activations fall within words; however, other uppercase subwords in the same fragment also activate to varying degrees.
patterns.domain: Online shouts, advertising/email titles, research titles

patterns.name: Hist fragment in a biomedical title
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of a breast cancer paper title, immediately followed by histopathological features.

patterns.name: Forms of address before a name or honorific
patterns.context: Activation fragments occur in an email salutation and a Portuguese parliamentary honorific; their forms and contexts differ, making a shared condition difficult to establish.

patterns.name: Portuguese within-word ia fragment
patterns.context: The final part of the Portuguese adjective “pacífica”; only one example.

patterns.name: spirit in an English business phrase
patterns.context: Listed alongside goals and ideas to describe company values; there are no other examples with the same semantic trigger.

3_277.description: 激活落在葡语“nossa”词首片段、英文大写词的 -ING 等词内子词，也出现在换行标点和少数专名、敬称及医学术语上；各段触发位置和语境差异较大。

patterns.name: 葡语所有格“nossa”
patterns.trigger: «n»10（词内片段，组成“nossa”）；另有 “nossa” 未标记
patterns.context: 出现在“a nossa determinação”“nossa editora”“nossa Excelência”“nossa consciência”等结构中；直接触发片段似为词首 n，而非整个词
patterns.domain: 葡语议会文本及编辑出版说明

patterns.name: 英文 -ING 词尾
patterns.context: 大写英文词中，词尾 -ING 被拆分成子词 token；覆盖粗口、营销词、科研术语和公司名，不要求特定语义
patterns.domain: 网络对话、商业邮件、科研项目标题

patterns.name: 残缺文本中的标点与换行
patterns.context: 激活落在段落换行、句点或周围格式边界；至少一例与英文邮件姓名和短句相邻

patterns.name: 英文大写词内部的词素片段
patterns.context: 大写、被拆分的英文文本中，激活落在词内部；但同一片段的其他大写子词也有不同程度激活
patterns.domain: 网络喊话、广告/邮件标题、科研标题

patterns.name: 生物医学标题中的 Hist 片段
patterns.context: 出现在乳腺癌论文标题开头，紧接着为组织病理学特征

patterns.name: 人名或敬称前的称谓结构
patterns.context: 激活片段分别位于邮件开头的称呼和葡语议会敬称中；形式和语境不同，难以确认共同条件

patterns.name: 葡语词内 ia 片段
patterns.context: 葡语形容词“pacífica”内部的词尾部分；仅此一例

patterns.name: 英文商业短语中的 spirit
patterns.context: 与 goals、ideas 并列，描述企业理念；没有其他相同语义触发例

en.description: Visible activations favor several uppercase English subword fragments, Portuguese fragments within nossa/Vossa, and medical title terms; other activations are scattered across Mike, MARK, PROJECT, HBV, and similar strings, with limited overall regularity.

patterns.name: CRE/SCREENING character fragments in uppercase titles or emphasized text
patterns.context: Triggers are concentrated in uppercase English strings that may be split into subwords; sometimes these are title-like terms, sometimes emphatic profanity.
patterns.domain: Email subject lines, project names, online conversations

patterns.name: Word-final fragments of Portuguese first-person plural possessive nossa/nossa
patterns.context: In Portuguese text, activation falls on fragments within nossa or Vossa; these occur respectively in political statements, editorial messages, and parliamentary forms of address.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary text and editorial prefaces

patterns.name: Research subject or pathological term in medical paper titles
patterns.context: Activation falls on proper-name/term fragments in English medical paper titles, involving population descriptions and histopathology; the shared context is title-style academic phrasing, but the meanings differ.

patterns.name: Scattered activations with no clear shared trigger
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different word or word fragment and is difficult to group with the possessive-ending, title-term, or uppercase-substring patterns above.

3_277.concept: 词片段与标题术语检测
3_277.description: 可见激活偏向若干大写英文子词片段、葡语nossa/Vossa词内片段及医学标题术语；另有分散于Mike、MARK、PROJECT、HBV等处的激活，整体规律有限。

patterns.name: 大写标题或强调文本中的 CRE/SCREENING 字符片段
patterns.context: 触发集中在英文大写、可能按子词切分的字符串中；有时是标题式术语，有时是粗口强调语。
patterns.domain: 邮件标题、项目名称、网络对话

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称复数所有格 nossa/nossa 的词尾
patterns.context: 葡语文本中，激活落在 nossa 或 Vossa 的词内片段；分别出现在政治陈述、编辑致辞和议会称谓中。
patterns.domain: 葡语议会文本及编辑前言

patterns.name: 医学论文标题中的研究对象或病理术语
patterns.context: 激活落在英文医学论文标题的专名/术语片段，分别涉及人群描述和组织病理学；共同上下文是标题式学术短语，但词义并不相同。

patterns.name: 无明显共享触发的零散激活
patterns.context: 各自出现在不同词或词片段中，难以归入上述词尾、标题术语或大写子串模式。
patterns.domain: 邮件、项目文本、医学摘要

en.concept: Within-word subword fragments and formatting boundaries
en.description: Most examples show activations on within-word subword fragments, often in long words, proper names, and all-caps titles, across medical, parliamentary, encyclopedic, and email text; newline markers also activate. Email phrases, Portuguese, and Finnish examples are sporadic, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Subword boundaries within words
patterns.context: Activations often fall on within-word fragments, especially in longer words split into multiple subwords; examples in the same feature need not share a semantic theme.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including medical abstracts, project titles, emails, and web text

patterns.name: CRE/ING fragments in uppercase words
patterns.context: Occurs when uppercase or emphatically spelled words are split into subwords; «ING» also appears in titles, marketing language, and other uppercase text.
patterns.domain: All-caps titles, email subjects, or emphatic statements

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in specific proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across internal fragments of proper nouns or scientific names, with no shared entity class or semantic relation.

patterns.name: Newlines and email formatting markers
patterns.context: Newline markers themselves activate, appearing in email bodies or at paragraph/entry boundaries.

patterns.name: Phrase fragments in emails
patterns.context: Several ordinary word fragments in email salutations and brief colloquial body text activate; this differs from the within-word subword pattern in other examples.

patterns.name: Portuguese relational contexts
patterns.context: Multiple within-word subword fragments activate in Portuguese parliamentary text, concentrated in expressions about relations and partnerships, but the evidence comes from only this one segment.

patterns.name: Domain-term fragments in medical research text
patterns.context: Fragments of split specialist terms activate in abstracts on medicinal plants and anti-hepatitis B compounds.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in research project titles
patterns.context: Subword fragments in compounds and long words activate in project titles and abstract-like uppercase text.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in marketing materials
patterns.context: Marketing material titles or concept drafts in emails contain several all-caps words split into subwords.

patterns.name: Fragments within Finnish word forms
patterns.context: Long words or endings split into fragments activate in Finnish parliamentary text; only one segment is observed.

3_277.concept: 词内子词片段及格式边界
3_277.description: 多数段落显示词内部子词片段激活，常见于长词、专名及全大写标题，跨医学、议会、百科和邮件文本；换行标记也有激活。邮件短语、葡萄牙语和芬兰语例子较零散，未见稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 单词中部的分词边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在词内部的片段上，尤其是被切成多个子词的较长词；同一段中不必有固定语义主题。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，含医学摘要、项目标题、邮件及网页文本

patterns.name: 全大写词中的 CRE/ING 片段
patterns.context: 大写或拼写强调的词被拆成子词时出现；«ING»也出现在标题、营销用语等大写文本中。
patterns.domain: 全大写标题、邮件主题或强调语句

patterns.name: 特定专名的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在专名或学名的内部片段上，没有共同的实体类别或语义关系。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、议会文本

patterns.name: 换行与邮件格式标记
patterns.context: 换行标记本身激活，出现在邮件正文或段落/条目分隔处。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及百科、摘要文本

patterns.name: 邮件中短语片段
patterns.context: 邮件开头称呼及简短口语正文中若干普通词片段激活；与其他段落中词内子词模式不同。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语关系词语境
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会文本中，多个词内部子词片段激活，集中于关系、伙伴关系等表达，但证据仅此一段。

patterns.name: 医学研究文本中的领域词片段
patterns.context: 药用植物及抗乙肝成分研究摘要中，专业词被拆分的片段激活。

patterns.name: 研究项目标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 项目标题与摘要式大写文本中，复合词及长词的子词片段激活。

patterns.name: 营销材料中的词内片段
patterns.context: 邮件中的营销材料标题或概念草稿，多个全大写词按子词拆分。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词形内部片段
patterns.context: 芬兰语议会文本中，长词或词尾被拆为片段并激活；仅见一段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and registers, mostly falling on subword fragments within words; nossa and Portuguese word-form fragments recur in Portuguese, alongside Finnish segmentation, English uppercase invective, and scientific terms. No single semantic theme explains them.

patterns.name: Tokenized English root fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within English words or proper names; unmarked neighboring words may occur in the same passage.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, phytochemistry papers, physics papers

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person plural possessive
patterns.context: Portuguese political speeches or editorial text contain nossa (“our”); Vossa Excelência is a polite form of address, similar in form but different in meaning.
patterns.domain: European Parliament debates, Portuguese editorial notes

patterns.name: Fragments within Portuguese words and morphological segmentation
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across internal fragments of Portuguese words or pieces created by subword segmentation; the same word need not occur in the sentence.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, Portuguese editorial text

patterns.name: Finnish word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on multiple subword fragments within Finnish words; there is not enough context to identify a specific triggering word sense.

patterns.name: English all-caps and spelling emphasis
patterns.context: An all-caps invective sentence splits colloquial words into multiple subword fragments; activation falls especially strongly on F-ING, LOCK, SCREAMING, and similar fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments of Portuguese political institutions or collective nouns
patterns.context: Portuguese political discourse contains vocabulary related to institutions and collectives, such as the EU, representatives, or committees; these words may overlap with general Portuguese segmentation patterns.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation in English scientific terms
patterns.context: Scientific abstracts contain technical terms or descriptions of instruments/processes, with activation on terms or their subwords.

3_277.description: 激活分散于多种语言与语域，主要落在词内子词片段；葡语中反复出现nossa及葡语词形片段，另见芬兰语切分、英文大写怒斥和科学术语。无法由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 分词化的英文词根片段
patterns.trigger: 词内被单独标记的片段，如 «etic»（Genetic）、«analysis»、«Chinese»、«women»、«glycos»（glycosides）、«investigation»、«constituents»、«pulse»、«extent»
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词或专名内部的子词片段；同段也可能有未标记的邻近词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、植物化学论文、物理学论文

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称复数所有格
patterns.context: 葡语政治发言或编辑文字中出现 nossa（“我们的”）；Vossa Excelência 是礼貌称谓，形式相似但语义不同。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会辩论、葡语编辑说明

patterns.name: 葡语词内片段与形态切分
patterns.context: 激活分布在葡语词的内部片段或由子词切分形成的部分；不要求句中出现同一词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、葡语编辑文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于芬兰语词内部的多个子词片段；没有足够上下文确定触发的是某个特定词义。

patterns.name: 英语全大写与拼写强调
patterns.context: 全大写、将口语词拆成多个子词片段的怒斥句；激活特别强地落在 F-ING、LOCK、SCREAMING 等片段。
patterns.domain: 网络口语、带脏话的喊话

patterns.name: 葡语政治机构或集体名词片段
patterns.context: 葡语政治论述中出现欧盟、代表或委员会等机构与集体相关词汇；这些词可能与一般葡语分词模式重叠。

patterns.name: 英文科学术语中的子词切分
patterns.context: 科学摘要中出现技术术语或仪器／过程描述，激活落在术语的词或子词上。

en.description: Activations most consistently fall on NS strings and their segmented fragments; they occur in contexts involving neutron stars, material compositions, disease names, code types, filenames, and data fields, with inconsistent meanings.

patterns.name: NS abbreviation or subword fragment
patterns.context: The abbreviation occurs in scientific text, code identifiers, or numeric fields; its meaning varies with context and may refer to neutron stars, glass composition, NS sector, a disease, or a variable field
patterns.domain: Primarily astrophysics and other scientific text; also Swift code and medical data

patterns.name: Neutron star in astrophysics
patterns.context: Occurs alongside terms such as spin frequency, accretion disk, magnetar/SGR, spectrum, astronomical names, or NS sector

patterns.name: NS in sodium silicate formulas
patterns.context: NS is followed by a number and appears in discussions of composition, simulation, or interatomic potential

patterns.name: NS substring in the virus abbreviation HBV
patterns.context: Appears in a list of disease names such as HIV and syphilis; activation falls on the character fragment in HBV

patterns.name: NS prefix in a Swift type name
patterns.context: NS is a prefix in a Swift function parameter type name

patterns.name: BV substring in a reference or filename
patterns.context: Appears in a list of bibliography filenames, with activation on the BV character fragment in a filename

patterns.name: NS nutrition data field
patterns.context: Immediately follows an equals sign and a microgram/milligram value, alongside fields such as Male/Female and LS

3_277.description: 激活最稳定地落在 NS 字符串及其切分片段上；它在中子星、材料组分、疾病名、代码类型、文件名和数据字段中均出现，语义并不一致。

patterns.name: NS 缩写或子词片段
patterns.context: 缩写出现在科技文本、代码标识或数值字段中；含义随上下文变化，可能指中子星、玻璃组分、NS sector、疾病或变量字段
patterns.domain: 主要为天体物理及其他科技文本；也包括 Swift 代码和医学数据

patterns.name: 天体物理中的 neutron star
patterns.context: 与旋转频率、吸积盘、磁星/SGR、光谱、天体名称或 NS sector 等术语共同出现
patterns.domain: 天体物理、弦论相关科技文本

patterns.name: 钠硅酸盐化学式中的 NS
patterns.context: NS 后接数字并处于组成、模拟或 interatomic potential 的讨论中

patterns.name: 病毒缩写 HBV 中的 NS 子串
patterns.context: 出现在 HIV、syphilis 等疾病名称列表中；激活落在 HBV 的字符片段上

patterns.name: Swift 类型名中的 NS 前缀
patterns.context: 作为 Swift 函数参数类型的一部分，NS 是类型名的前缀

patterns.name: 文献或文件名中的 BV 子串
patterns.context: 出现在 bibliography 文件名列表中，激活落在文件名的 BV 字符片段上

patterns.name: 营养数据字段 NS
patterns.context: 紧跟等号和微克/毫克数值，与 Male/Female、LS 等字段并列

en.description: All activations fall on the letter string “NS”, but in varied contexts: a mathematical abbreviation, neutron stars, chemical labels, grant numbers, biological terminology, an Apple class name, an influenza gene, and a superstring sector.

patterns.name: Nonstationary ideal abbreviation
patterns.context: NS appears in mathematical notation for a nonstationary ideal

patterns.name: Neutron star abbreviation
patterns.context: NS refers to a neutron star, appearing in contexts involving binaries, astronomical sources, and their surfaces

patterns.name: Chemical sample label
patterns.context: NS is connected to numbers and chemical formulas, serving as a sodium silicate composition or sample label

patterns.name: NS in a grant number
patterns.context: NS is part of an NIH grant number

patterns.name: NS in biology
patterns.context: In an experimental description of IMPDH2 inhibition and ribosomal stress, NS refers to an unspecified quantity or term

patterns.name: Apple object-context class
patterns.context: The NS prefix appears in iOS/macOS object management class names and is related to thread access

patterns.name: Influenza nonstructural gene
patterns.context: NS refers to the nonstructural gene of influenza virus and appears in descriptions of viral RNA genes

patterns.name: Superstring theory sector
patterns.context: NS is the name of a sector in superstring theory and appears in discussions of spacetime actions

3_277.description: 激活都落在字母串“NS”上，但语境各异：数学缩写、中子星、化学编号、资助号、生物学术语、Apple 类名、流感基因及超弦扇区。

patterns.name: 非平稳理想缩写
patterns.context: 非平稳理想的数学记号中出现 NS

patterns.name: 中子星缩写
patterns.context: NS 指中子星，出现在双星、天体来源及其表面等语境

patterns.name: 化学样品编号
patterns.context: NS 与数字及化学式相连，作为钠硅酸盐组成或样品标记

patterns.name: 资助编号中的 NS
patterns.context: NS 是 NIH 项目编号的一部分

patterns.name: 生物学中的 NS
patterns.context: IMPDH2 抑制与核糖体应激的实验描述中，NS 指代未展开的量或术语

patterns.name: Apple 对象上下文类
patterns.context: NS 前缀出现在 iOS/macOS 对象管理类名中，并与线程访问相关

patterns.name: 流感非结构基因
patterns.context: NS 指流感病毒的非结构基因，出现在病毒 RNA 基因描述中

patterns.name: 超弦理论扇区
patterns.context: NS 是超弦理论中的扇区名称，出现在时空作用量讨论中

en.description: The most consistent shared trigger is the tilde, especially when adjacent to numbers, letters, subscripts/superscripts, or units; other activated words are scattered across code, scientific terminology, tables, and equations, with no cross-passage semantic theme.

patterns.name: Tilde and adjacent numbers/symbols
patterns.context: Appears near subscripts/superscripts, ranges, approximations, or specialized scientific notation; sometimes occurs between numbers, letters, or units.
patterns.domain: Scientific notation, units, equations, and code across domains

patterns.name: Whitespace and comparison expressions in code
patterns.context: In Python-style code, whitespace indentation, comparison conditions, and output labels are adjacent; the tilde also appears before a string.

patterns.name: Time-of-death estimation terminology
patterns.context: Discusses entomological inference of time of death and PM​​I; these words have weaker activations and do not recur elsewhere.

patterns.name: Population strata and monetary values
patterns.context: Near stratum labels and income values expressed in CLP in a socioeconomic population description.

patterns.name: Biological terminology and Greek letters
patterns.context: Scattered activations occur on terms and Greek letters in academic descriptions of endonucleases and structural types.

patterns.name: Black-hole mass notation

patterns.name: Seafloor hydrothermal environment terminology
patterns.context: Describes hydrothermal vent ecosystems and their temperature, gases, and chemical environment.

patterns.name: Vitamin D metabolism notation
patterns.context: Near biochemical abbreviations and terminology for hydroxylases and vitamin D conversion.

patterns.name: Statistical/experimental labels in tables
patterns.context: Scattered activations occur in column names, experimental labels, and values in tables or extracted concatenated text.

patterns.name: Experimental protocols and measurement metrics
patterns.context: Near protocol names and metric headings in subsection titles and protocol descriptions.

3_277.description: 最稳定的共同触发是波浪号，尤其与数字、字母、上下标或单位相邻时；其余激活词分散于代码、科学术语、表格和公式，未形成跨段语义主题。

patterns.name: 波浪号及其邻接的数字/符号
patterns.context: 出现在上下标、范围、近似值或特殊科学记号附近；有时夹在数字、字母或单位之间。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的科学记数、单位、公式和代码文本

patterns.name: 代码中的空白与比较表达式
patterns.context: Python 风格代码中，空白缩进、比较条件和输出标签相邻；波浪号也出现在字符串前。

patterns.name: 死亡时间估计术语
patterns.context: 讨论昆虫学推断死亡时间及 PM​​I；这些词的激活较弱，未见其他段重复。

patterns.name: 人口阶层与货币数值
patterns.context: 社会经济人口描述中，阶层标签和以 CLP 表示的收入数值附近。

patterns.name: 生物学术语与希腊字母
patterns.context: 核酸内切酶及结构类型的学术描述中，术语和希腊字母被零散激活。

patterns.name: 黑洞质量记号
patterns.context: 天体物理介绍黑洞及其质量函数，包含 LaTeX 数学记号。

patterns.name: 海底热液环境术语

patterns.name: 维生素 D 代谢记号

patterns.name: 表格中的统计/实验标签
patterns.context: 表格或抽取后连写的列名、实验标签及数值中，出现零散激活。

patterns.name: 实验方案与测量指标
patterns.context: 小节标题和方案描述中，协议名称及指标标题附近。

en.concept: Capitalized proper names and document-label fragments
en.description: Activations mainly fall on judges’ names, court headers, and name fragments in legal documents; other examples include FASB/accrual terminology, proper names in book captions, and news category titles, often highlighting capitalized proper names or their internal subword fragments.

patterns.name: Court proceedings and judge signature
patterns.context: At the end of a court decision or opinion, lists judges’ names and titles, panel membership, or opinion status; names are often split into multiple subword fragments

patterns.name: Eleventh Circuit header and case information
patterns.context: Heading of an Eleventh Circuit Court of Appeals document, accompanied by a date, case number, and Judge Thomas K. Kahn’s name

patterns.name: Capitalized name fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Capitalized or title-case names appear in case citations or lists of attorneys/officials; no specific court is required

patterns.name: FASB and accounting terminology
patterns.context: Email context discussing corporate assets, government roles, and accounting standards or accrual items

patterns.name: Book illustration credit and proper names
patterns.context: A place or property name follows an illustration caption and ownership credit

patterns.name: Regional and economic categories in news section titles
patterns.context: Hyphenated news category titles under “Best of News”

3_277.concept: 大写专名及文书标签片段
3_277.description: 激活主要落在法律文书的法官姓名、法院页眉及人名片段；另见 FASB/应计术语、书籍图注专名和新闻分类标题，常突出大写专名或其内部子词片段。

patterns.name: 法院庭审及法官姓名署名

patterns.name: 法律文书中的大写人名片段

patterns.name: FASB 及会计术语
patterns.context: 讨论企业资产、政府角色及会计准则或应计项目的邮件语境

patterns.name: 书籍插图署名与专名
patterns.context: 插图说明及所有权署名之后出现地点或房产名称

patterns.context: “Best of News”下以连字符连接的新闻分类标题

en.description: Primarily responds to statutory section numbers in legal documents, especially “chapter” and the following number; it also responds to chapter numbers in book tables of contents. Other activations are scattered across decimal points, fragments within specific words, and sentencing terminology.

patterns.name: Chapter and statutory section numbers in legal text
patterns.context: Near chapter numbers, code sections, or statutory numbers, especially when legal discussion cites regulations or litigation procedures; activation often falls on “chapter” and the immediately following number/identifier.
patterns.domain: Decisions, appellate opinions, and legal documents such as bankruptcy law

patterns.name: Roman numeral chapter numbering in headings and tables of contents
patterns.context: In a book’s table of contents or chapter heading, numbering is adjacent to chapter titles, page numbers, and other layout elements.
patterns.domain: Tables of contents and headings in history books

patterns.name: Internal fragments of specific English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of segmented words; the available examples occur in a book title and a name in a table of contents, with no established shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Literary history book titles, table-of-contents entries

patterns.name: Decimal points in measurement values
patterns.context: In medical abstracts, activation occurs on decimal points and neighboring numeric characters.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragment in legal terminology
patterns.context: When a criminal appellate opinion mentions a sentencing enhancement, activation falls on “level” in “two-level sentence enhancement”; it is unclear whether this relates to the statutory chapter-number pattern.

3_277.description: 主要响应法律文书中的法规章节编号，尤其是“chapter”及后续编号；也响应书籍目录的章节编号。另有小数点、特定词内片段和量刑术语中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的章号与法条编号
patterns.context: 章号、法典章节或法条编号附近，尤其是法律论述中引用法规或诉讼程序时；激活常落在“chapter”及紧随其后的数字/编号上。
patterns.domain: 判决、上诉意见及破产法等法律文书

patterns.name: 章节标题和目录中的罗马数字编号
patterns.context: 书籍的目录或章节标题中，编号与章节标题、页码等排版元素相邻。
patterns.domain: 历史类书籍的目录与标题

patterns.name: 特定英文单词的内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在分词后的单词内部片段；现有例子分别出现在书名和目录人名中，尚不能确定共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 测量数值中的小数点
patterns.context: 医学摘要里，激活出现在小数点及其邻近数值字符处。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要、统计数据

patterns.name: 法律词语中的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 刑事上诉意见提到量刑上调时，激活落在“two-level sentence enhancement”的“level”部分；与法条章节编号模式是否相关不明。

en.concept: Fragments in place-related and legal text
en.description: Activations are scattered: locations, penalties, and procedural terms in legal passages are most prominent, alongside child-related wording and numbered symbols. Other examples include split uppercase words in book titles, public-health venue terms, and anatomical word fragments in emails.

patterns.name: Place or venue terms
patterns.context: Describes a venue, time and place, or placement in legal text; also appears in location descriptions in emails. Forms include place, home, location, and placed, which do not necessarily share a meaning.

patterns.name: Penalties and sentencing in legal decisions
patterns.context: Discusses penalties, sentencing enhancements, probation, or statutory maximum sentences.

patterns.name: Legal provisions and procedural notices
patterns.context: Describes written notice after an order of removal takes effect, and its time and place of delivery.

patterns.name: Child-related wording in legal cases
patterns.context: Children occur in family settings or sexual-assault conviction contexts; the markers are sporadic and show no stable, specific trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Titles and all-caps letter sequences
patterns.context: In scanned book title pages and table-of-contents titles, activations fall on split fragments of uppercase words.

patterns.name: Numeric or symbolic fragments in legal terminology
patterns.context: Occurs when legal citations, rule numbers, or compound terms are split; its relationship to other activation patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Venue characteristics in tobacco research
patterns.context: Discusses characteristics of tobacco retail environments and venues, including community demographics and policy.

patterns.name: Rare medical or anatomical word fragments
patterns.context: Anatomical or grotesque descriptions occur in emails, with activations on within-word fragments; no clear connection to the main pattern.

3_277.description: 激活较分散：法律段落中的地点、刑罚和程序词最突出，也覆盖儿童相关措辞、编号符号；另见书籍标题的大写拆词、公共卫生场所词及邮件中的解剖词片段。

patterns.name: 地点或场所词
patterns.context: 在法律文本中描述场所、时间地点或安置；也出现于邮件中的位置叙述。词形有 place、home、location、placed，未必是同一语义。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的刑罚与量刑
patterns.context: 谈及刑罚、量刑加重、缓刑或法定最高刑。

patterns.name: 法律条文与程序性告知
patterns.context: 描述驱逐令生效后的书面通知及交付时间、地点。

patterns.name: 法律案件中的儿童相关措辞
patterns.context: 儿童出现在家庭环境或性侵定罪语境中；标记较零散，未显示稳定的专属触发模式。

patterns.name: 标题与全大写字母序列
patterns.context: 扫描或分词后的书籍扉页、目录标题中，激活落在被拆分的大写词片段上。

patterns.name: 法律术语的数字或符号片段
patterns.context: 法律引文、规则编号或复合术语被切分时出现；与其他激活模式关系不明。

patterns.name: 烟草研究中的场所特征
patterns.context: 讨论烟草零售环境及社区人口、政策等场所特征。

patterns.name: 罕见医学或解剖词片段
patterns.context: 邮件中出现解剖或怪诞叙述，激活落在词内部片段；与主模式无明显联系。

en.description: Activation cues mainly involve segmented proper names and words, especially Tuscan; other examples include line breaks, whitespace, names, and capitalized fragments in legal decisions, book-title typography, Spanish names, and burrito fragments, with no unified semantic feature.

patterns.name: Tuscan place name
patterns.context: “Tuscan” is split into subword fragments and refers to Tuscany, Italy; it appears in architectural descriptions, child studies, and rural recollections.

patterns.name: Formatting and proper-name fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Court decision headers, dates, judge signatures, party names, and page whitespace; activation falls on line breaks, formatting whitespace, common words, and segmented names.

patterns.name: Capitalized fragments in literary titles and typography
patterns.context: Book titles, headings, and military ranks are capitalized or line-broken, with activation on segmented capitalized words.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of names or words
patterns.context: In a Spanish-language acknowledgments section, activations are scattered across abbreviations, organization names, and internal name fragments; no clear connection to Tuscan or legal formatting.

patterns.name: Food-word fragment
patterns.context: “burrito” is segmented, with a trigger in an ordering and restaurant-review context; only one example.

patterns.name: Scattered word fragments without a stable pattern
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences about children’s living environments and interpretations of legal provisions; apart from the legal genre matching passages 2, 4, and 9, no stable cues match the case-layout triggers.

3_277.description: 激活线索以被拆分的专名、词语片段为主，尤其是 Tuscan；另见法律判决的换行、空白、姓名与大写片段，以及书名排版、西语人名和 burrito 片段，缺少统一语义特征。

patterns.name: Tuscan地名
patterns.context: “Tuscan”被拆分成子词片段，指意大利托斯卡纳；出现在建筑描写、儿童研究和乡村回忆中。
patterns.domain: 文学、医学摘要、生活评论

patterns.name: 法律文书中的格式与专名片段

patterns.name: 文学标题与排版中的大写片段
patterns.context: 书名、标题和军衔以大写或分行排版，激活对应拆分后的大写词片段。

patterns.name: 姓名或词语的内部片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语致谢段中，激活散落于缩写、机构名及人名内部的子词片段；与 Tuscan 或法律格式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 餐饮词语片段
patterns.context: “burrito”被拆分，触发位于点餐与餐馆评论语境；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 未形成稳定模式的零散词片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于儿童居住环境及法律条文解释的句子中，除了法律文体与段2、4、9相同之外，未见与其判例版式触发相同的稳定线索。

en.description: Activations primarily occur on the degree symbol “°” in temperature markers and nearby numbers and units in scientific and technical text. Other examples include “Court” in legal documents, uppercase title strings on book title pages, and a local string in “Tuscan” in a medical title.

patterns.name: Degree symbol “°”

patterns.name: Court in legal documents
patterns.context: A court name occurs after case parties and appeal information.

patterns.name: Uppercase title strings on book title pages
patterns.context: Book title pages or front matter, often accompanied by author and publication information and line breaks.

patterns.name: Tuscan in a medical title
patterns.context: A medical abstract title about infection risk after tick bites, mentioning a pediatric cohort.

en.description: Primarily responds to headers, title formatting, and case-specific names in U.S. federal court decisions, as well as legal terminology. Other activations occur in book table-of-contents titles, fable titles, and split word fragments across contexts.

patterns.name: Court names and formatting in litigation documents

patterns.name: Case names and party names in legal citations
