3_277.description: 主要响应美国联邦法院判决的页眉、标题排版及案件专名，也覆盖法律术语；另有书籍目录标题、寓言篇名，以及跨语境的分词词片段激活。

patterns.name: 诉讼文书中的法院名称与版式
patterns.trigger: “United States Court of Appeals”“FOR THE”“United States District Court”，以及标题行中的空格、换行
patterns.context: 法院名称出现在判决书页眉或标题栏，常伴随居中排版和大量空白；第6–8段重复同一上下文
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院判决文书

patterns.name: 法律引文中的案件名与当事人姓名
patterns.trigger: “SUNRISE SECURITIES LITIGATION”“RICHARD M. ARNOLD”“MICHAEL A. DITTMANN”；姓名内部被分词标记的片段如“RICH”“DIT”
patterns.context: 案件引注、当事人栏或诉讼正文中的专名

patterns.name: 法条与法律术语短语
patterns.trigger: “due process”“under color of state law”“navigation panel”“REFERENCES TO ORDINANCES”
patterns.context: 法律论述或判决网页导航文字中，激活落在法律术语、制度词或导航标签的部分
patterns.domain: 法律文本及其网页界面

patterns.name: 分词边界内的复数词尾及词形片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在被切分的英文单词内部或相邻词片段上；文体并不一致
patterns.domain: 目录文字、法律专名及普通英文文本

patterns.name: 统计目录标题
patterns.context: 目录式、全大写的简短标题，列出各类统计资料

patterns.name: 目录中的寓言篇目
patterns.trigger: “THE JACKALS AND THE WOLF”“THE SHEPHERD AND THE ROGUE”“THE FRAN… AND THE TORTOISES”
patterns.context: 目录中以全大写显示的寓言或故事标题

en.description: Activations concentrate on Court in U.S. legal documents and judge biographies, especially in the names of appellate, circuit, and district courts; title formatting, party listings, and FILED are common adjacent formats.

patterns.name: Court in court names
patterns.context: Court appears in a court name, especially adjacent to “United States,” “of,” “Appeals,” “Circuit,” or “District”; capitalization and tokenization vary
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, docket titles, and judge biographies

patterns.name: Appellate court title format
patterns.context: Court heading or appeal-from field on the first page of an opinion or docket; often accompanied by aligned spaces, line breaks, and FILED

patterns.name: Litigant listing
patterns.context: Case title or party-information field, usually separated by spacing, dashes, and line breaks

patterns.name: Tax court heading
patterns.context: Tax court memorandum title, with the court name set in uppercase

patterns.name: Court titles in judge biographies
patterns.context: Biographical sentence stating a judge’s court and position

3_277.concept: 美国法院名称中的 Court
3_277.description: 激活集中于美国法律文书与法官简介中法院名称的 Court，尤其上诉法院、巡回法院和地区法院；标题排版、当事人栏及 FILED 等是常见邻接格式。

patterns.name: 法院名称中的 Court
patterns.trigger: “Court”或其分词片段，如«Court»10、«COURT»6；常见于“United States Court of Appeals”“Circuit Court”及“District Court”
patterns.context: 法院名称中出现 Court，尤其邻接“United States”“of”“Appeals”“Circuit”或“District”；大小写及分词形式不一
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、案卷标题及法官简介

patterns.name: 上诉法院标题格式
patterns.trigger: “United States Court of Appeals”“Appeal from”“Circuit Court”
patterns.context: 判决或案卷首页的法院抬头、上诉来源栏；常伴随对齐空格、换行和 FILED
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人栏
patterns.trigger: “Plaintiff - Appellee”“Defendant - Appellant”，以及姓名与“Deceased”“Appeal from”相邻
patterns.context: 案件标题或当事人信息栏，通常以排版空格、横线和换行分隔

patterns.name: 税务法院抬头
patterns.context: 税务法院备忘录标题，法院名称以大写形式排版

patterns.name: 法官简介中的法院职衔
patterns.context: 人物传记句中说明法官任职法院及职位

en.concept: Uppercase word fragments and layout text
en.description: Activations often fall on within-word fragments in uppercase proper nouns, titles, or typeset text, especially character sequences such as IN and OND. Legal abbreviations and ordinary word fragments also trigger, alongside sporadic institution names and a genealogy phrase; the examples resist a single semantic explanation.

patterns.name: INITED/IN-initial word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within words, often uppercase words, proper nouns, or split words; the triggering fragment is not always a complete word, and surrounding characters vary.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, medical papers, forums, old scanned books

patterns.name: Uppercase typography in titles or layout
patterns.context: Printed book tables of contents, titles, covers, or promotional pages; often accompanied by all caps, centered spacing, page numbers, and punctuation, with activations on within-word fragments.

patterns.name: U.S. statutory citations and legal titles
patterns.context: Legal passages contain statute abbreviations, section numbers, or all-caps section titles; the triggering fragment itself may also be only part of an ordinary word.

patterns.name: Fragments in proper nouns and institution names
patterns.context: Several marked words or subwords occur in institution names, place names, and formal names; activations are scattered and show no stable semantic category.

patterns.name: Sentence-final fragment in a genealogy narrative
patterns.context: An informal genealogy narrative describes searching for descendants of a branch; the passage is an ordinary English phrase.

3_277.concept: 大写词片段与版面文本
3_277.description: 激活多落在大写专名、标题或排版文本的词内片段，尤其是 IN、OND 等字符序列；法律缩写与普通词片段也会触发，另有零散机构名和家谱短语，难以归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: INITED/IN 开头的词片段
patterns.trigger: «IN»（[1] T«IN»TONEY；[2] T«IN»；[3] T«IN»ITED；[8] T«IN» met；[9] SARD«IN»IA、D«UR»«ING»；[10] L«OND»«ON»）
patterns.context: 出现在单词内部，常是大写词、专名或被切分的词；触发片段并不总是完整词，周围字符会变化。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、医学论文、论坛、旧书扫描文本

patterns.name: 标题或版面中的大写排印
patterns.context: 印刷书籍的目录、标题、封面或宣传页；常伴随全大写、居中空格、页码与标点，激活落在词内片段。

patterns.name: 美国法条引文与法律标题
patterns.context: 法律段落中出现法规缩写、条款编号或全大写章节标题；触发片段本身也可能只是普通词的一部分。

patterns.name: 专名与机构名称中的碎片
patterns.context: 机构、地名及正式名称中出现若干被标记的词或子词；激活分布较散，未显示稳定的语义类别。
patterns.domain: 科研机构介绍、医学论文

patterns.name: 家谱叙述中的句末片段
patterns.context: 非正式家谱叙述中，描述寻找某支系后代；该处为普通英语短语。

en.description: Activations often fall on subword fragments inside tokenized words, particularly TIN and London; also seen in U.S. court headings, layout spacing, and sporadic name and title substrings. A stable shared mechanism across contexts is unclear.

patterns.name: “TIN” letter fragment
patterns.context: The target letter fragment occurs inside words split by tokenization; examples include “introduction,” text related to “Tennessee,” “tinsy,” and names such as “Tinney.”

patterns.name: London text
patterns.context: “London” is split into multiple tokens, often in book catalogs or publication information, and also in newspaper names.
patterns.domain: Book catalogs, publication information, newspaper forms

patterns.name: Court in court names
patterns.context: Fixed legal institution names in U.S. court opinion headings; “Court” as a whole or its token has high activation.

patterns.name: Layout spacing
patterns.context: Large spans of spaces in document headings or covers are marked individually, possibly related to layout alignment.

patterns.name: Other internally split word forms
patterns.context: Activations fall on several subword fragments inside uppercase words, with no shared semantics or stable word form apparent.
patterns.domain: Legal materials, book catalogs and covers, German academic titles

patterns.name: Names and case names in legal documents
patterns.context: Parties, companies, or personal names in court opinions; besides the separately listed Court and TIN fragments, some name substrings also activate.

3_277.description: 激活多落在被切分的词内片段，尤见 TIN、London；也见美国法院抬头、排版空格及零散姓名和标题子串。不同语境共享的稳定机制不明确。

patterns.name: “TIN”字母片段
patterns.context: 目标字母片段出现在被分词切开的单词内部；可见于“introduction”“Tennessee”相关文本、“tinsy”及人名“Tinney”等不同词形。

patterns.name: 伦敦字样
patterns.context: “London”被拆分为多个 token，常出现在书籍目录或出版信息中，也出现在报纸名称中。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录、出版信息、报纸表单

patterns.name: 法庭名称中的 Court
patterns.context: 美国法院判决抬头中的固定法律机构名称；“Court”整体或其 token 获得高激活。

patterns.name: 排版空格
patterns.context: 文档抬头或封面中大段空格被单独标记，可能与版式对齐有关。

patterns.name: 其他内部拆分词形
patterns.context: 激活落在大写单词内部的若干子词片段，但未见统一语义或稳定词形。
patterns.domain: 法律材料、书籍目录与封面、德语学术标题

patterns.name: 法律文书姓名与案名
patterns.context: 法院判决中的当事人、公司或人名；除已单列的 Court 和 TIN 片段外，部分姓名子串也有激活。

en.description: Primarily responds to court names and appellate-document formatting, especially United States District Court and Court of Appeals; also appears on layout whitespace, all-caps table-of-contents titles, and London word forms, and responds strongly to a word fragment in a description of vehicle damage.

patterns.name: Formulaic language in federal appellate documents
patterns.context: Fixed headings or quotations containing federal court names and appellate origins, especially continuous institutional names such as “United States District Court”; passages may include case titles, attorney information, and jurisdiction.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal decisions and litigation documents

patterns.name: Centered layout and title formatting
patterns.context: Whitespace padding, line breaks, and uppercase split words occur alongside court-document formatting in document headings, party sections, headers, or table-of-contents-style titles.

patterns.name: London-related titles in book tables of contents
patterns.context: The uppercase place name London in book tables of contents or chapter titles, split into several subword fragments.

patterns.name: Damaged vehicle parts in descriptions
patterns.context: Colloquial vehicle description mentioning a small tear or damage on the left corner post of the body; activations concentrate on within-word fragments.
patterns.domain: Classified ads or vehicle description text

patterns.name: Token boundaries in court names
patterns.context: In court names such as “United States Court of Appeals” or “United States District Court,” Court is followed by an institutional level or circuit.

patterns.name: Decorative symbols and page numbers in book tables of contents
patterns.context: Asterisks serve as decoration or separators between table-of-contents entries, accompanied by page numbers.

patterns.name: Isolated high-activation fragments in split spellings
patterns.context: Uppercase/lowercase subword fragments in specific proper nouns or URLs, without a shared context sufficient to link them to the main pattern.

3_277.concept: 法律文书格式与词形碎片
3_277.description: 主要响应法院名称和上诉文书格式，尤其 United States District Court、Court of Appeals；也见排版空白、目录大写标题及伦敦词形，并对一则车辆破损描述中的词片段有强响应。

patterns.name: 联邦上诉法院文书程式语
patterns.context: 联邦法院名称及上诉来源等固定标题或引述中，尤其“United States District Court”一类连续机构名称；段落可含案件标题、律师信息和管辖区
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律判决与诉讼文书

patterns.name: 居中排版与标题格式
patterns.trigger: 多处空格、换行和分隔线，如«                        »、«____________»；标题中的全大写或分段词形，如«ROM»«ANCE»、«L»«OND»«ON»
patterns.context: 文档排版标题、案件当事人栏、页眉或目录式标题中，空白填充、换行及大写分词与法院文书格式并存
patterns.domain: 法律文书或书籍排版文本

patterns.name: 书名目录中的伦敦相关标题
patterns.trigger: «L»«OND»«ON»10，如“THE TWO GHOSTS OF NEW LONDON TURNPIKE”；另有“THE LONDON CHARIVARI”
patterns.context: 书籍目录或章节标题中的大写地名 London，词被分成若干子词片段

patterns.name: 车辆描述中的破损部位
patterns.context: 口语化车辆描述，提及车身左侧角柱上的小撕裂或破损；激活集中于词内片段
patterns.domain: 分类广告或车辆描述文本

patterns.name: 法院名称中的数字化 token 边界
patterns.context: “United States Court of Appeals”或“United States District Court”等法院名称中，Court 后接机构层级或巡回区

patterns.name: 书籍目录中的装饰符号与页码
patterns.context: 目录条目之间以星号作装饰或分隔，并附页码

patterns.name: 拼写碎片中的孤立高激活片段
patterns.context: 特定专名或网址中的大写/小写子词片段，缺少足以和主模式联系的共同语境

en.description: Activations concentrate on the layout and set phrasing of U.S. federal appellate opinions: court, circuit, appeal origin, litigant status, FILED markers, and case citations; names also show sporadic activations.

patterns.name: Appellate court name format
patterns.context: Court name in a federal opinion header or docket information; sometimes immediately followed by a circuit name

patterns.name: District court appeal-origin format
patterns.context: Below the case title, identifies the federal district court from which the case is appealed, often followed by the district name
patterns.domain: First pages of U.S. federal judicial opinions

patterns.name: Plaintiff and defendant status labels
patterns.context: Labels the parties’ litigation status in case-title formatting, often alongside names, separators, and appeal origin
patterns.domain: First pages of U.S. federal judicial opinions

patterns.name: Circuit ordinal name
patterns.context: Circuit designation after the federal appellate court name; some examples are truncated or split across layout

patterns.name: Case citation numbers
patterns.context: Federal reporter volume and page citations before the court name, with numbers split into multiple tokens

patterns.name: Docket punctuation and numbers
patterns.context: Case numbers after a case title or citation; activation falls on number punctuation and some digits

patterns.name: Filed stamp
patterns.context: FILED printed in spaced letters near the top of the page, with the appellate court name alongside or below

patterns.name: Individual party names and aliases
patterns.context: Party names in case titles that are split or include aliases; activation covers parts of names without showing a stable name-related trigger

patterns.name: Other name fragments in case names
patterns.context: Partial tokens from plaintiff or defendant names in citation lines; activations are sporadic

3_277.description: 激活集中于美国联邦上诉判决的版式与固定措辞：法院、巡回区、上诉来源、诉讼身份、FILED标记及引证案号；姓名局部也有零散激活。

patterns.name: 上诉法院名称格式
patterns.context: 联邦判决页眉或案号信息中的法院名称；有时紧接巡回区名称

patterns.name: 地区法院上诉来源格式
patterns.context: 案件标题下方说明上诉来自哪个联邦地区法院，常继续列出地区名称
patterns.domain: 美国联邦司法判决首页

patterns.name: 原被告身份标签
patterns.context: 案件标题页排版中标注双方的诉讼身份，常与姓名、分隔线和上诉来源并列
patterns.domain: 美国联邦司法判决首页

patterns.name: 巡回区序数名称
patterns.context: 联邦上诉法院名称后标出巡回区；部分样本被截断或拆分排版
patterns.domain: 美国联邦司法判决页眉

patterns.name: 判例引证数字
patterns.context: 法院名称前的联邦判例卷册与页码引证，数字被拆成多个 token

patterns.name: 案号标点与编号
patterns.context: 案件标题或引证之后出现案件编号；激活落在编号标点及部分数字上

patterns.name: 已归档印章
patterns.context: 页面上方以分隔字母排印的 FILED 字样，旁边或下方是上诉法院名称

patterns.name: 个别当事人姓名与别名
patterns.trigger: «Peter Terrell Redd»itt；«Jose Francisco Garza T»ov»ar；«-S«AL»«AS»；«Victor« Ort»iz»
patterns.context: 案件标题中出现被拆分或带别名的当事人姓名；激活覆盖姓名局部，未显示稳定的姓名语义触发

patterns.name: 其他案名姓名局部
patterns.context: 引证行中原告或被告姓名的局部 token，激活零散分布

en.description: Primarily activates on “Court” in “United States Court of Appeals” in U.S. federal appellate case headers, often alongside circuit and case metadata; it also activates on French premier and the character “以” in the Japanese expression “200以外.”

patterns.name: Appellate decision title formatting
patterns.context: In legal case headers or titles, especially “Court” in the court name “United States Court of Appeals”; often occurs with a circuit name.

patterns.name: French premier
patterns.context: Occurs before nouns such as “principe” and “point,” meaning “first/primary”; activation falls on premier.

patterns.name: Isolated activation in non-Latin script
patterns.context: Occurs within the expression “200以外” in an explanation of PayPal response status; differs from English legal formatting and French premier.

3_277.concept: 多语种格式与词项触发
3_277.description: 主要激活于美国联邦上诉判例页眉中“United States Court of Appeals”的Court，常伴随巡回区和案件元数据；另在法语 premier（首要/第一个）及日语“200以外”的“以”上激活。

patterns.name: 上诉法院判决标题格式
patterns.trigger: «United» States «Court» of Appeals；«Circuit»，以及相邻的案号、当事人姓名和引证
patterns.context: 法律判例的页眉或案件标题中，尤其是“United States Court of Appeals”法院名称里的“Court”；常与巡回区名称同现。

patterns.name: 法语中的 premier
patterns.context: 出现在“principe”“point”等名词前，表示“第一个／首要的”；激活落在 premier 上。

patterns.name: 非拉丁文字中的独立激活
patterns.context: PayPal 响应状态的说明中，出现在“200以外”这一表达内；与英文法律格式及法语 premier 不同。

en.description: Activations concentrate on court names and federal appellate opinion headings, and also respond to sporadic uppercase letter fragments (IN, CAN), blank-space formatting in legal documents, and diacritic letters in Turkish names; the patterns are not fully unified.

patterns.name: TIN strings in legal text
patterns.context: IN appears within uppercase letter strings, often inside words or separated by tokenization markers; the first segment is an abbreviation in parentheses after myosin-I, while another has «T»…«AX» forming TAX.
patterns.domain: NIH biomedical research text, U.S. Tax Court legal text

patterns.name: COURT in court names
patterns.context: Court appears in court names or opinion text, with varying capitalization; commonly in United States Court of Appeals, also in County Court.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and docket information

patterns.name: Federal jurisdiction format in opinion headings
patterns.context: Appears in court names on the first page of an opinion, usually with a circuit name; this pattern overlaps with the Court trigger.

patterns.name: CAN in a volcano alert title
patterns.context: In the title VOLCANO ALERT LEVELS, CAN is an internal letter fragment of VOLCAN(O), not an independent word.

patterns.name: Diacritic letters in Turkish names
patterns.context: Occurs in Turkish author names, involving the letters ü, ı and related name spellings.

patterns.name: Layout whitespace
patterns.context: Long runs of spaces in legal document titles are marked; no clear independent semantics, possibly reflecting layout or formatting.

3_277.description: 激活集中于法院名称及联邦上诉法院判决抬头，也响应零散的大写字母片段（IN、CAN）、法律文书空白排版，以及土耳其姓名中的变音字母；模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 TIN 字符串
patterns.context: 大写字母串中出现 IN，常位于单词内部或被分词标记拆开；第1段是 myosin-I 后的括号缩写，另有 «T»…«AX» 组成 TAX。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究文本、美国税务法院法律文本

patterns.name: 法院名称中的 COURT
patterns.context: 法院名称或判决正文中出现 Court，大小写不一；多见于 United States Court of Appeals，也见于 County Court。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及案头信息

patterns.name: 判决抬头中的联邦法院辖区格式
patterns.context: 出现在判决首页的法院名称中，通常带巡回区名称；该模式与 Court 触发重叠。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决抬头

patterns.name: 火山警报标题中的 CAN
patterns.context: 标题 VOLCANO ALERT LEVELS 中，CAN 是 VOLCAN(O) 的内部字母片段，而非独立单词。

patterns.name: 土耳其语姓名中的带变音字母
patterns.context: 出现在土耳其作者姓名中，涉及字母 ü、ı 及相关姓名拼写。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文作者名单

patterns.name: 排版空白
patterns.context: 法律文书标题中的长串空格被标记；无明显独立语义，可能反映版式或格式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across court decisions and jurisdiction, French “premier,” a song topping the charts, the letter string TIN, and tin-mining content. Apart from their local cues, no single trigger pattern spans all examples.

patterns.name: Court decisions and jurisdiction
patterns.context: Occurs in court names, decision or appeal narratives, jurisdiction, and criminal-case contexts.

patterns.name: French “premier”
patterns.context: Occurs in parliamentary speeches such as “«premier» principe” or “«premier» point,” referring to the first principle or issue.

patterns.name: Number one on the charts
patterns.context: Describes a popular song reaching number one on the charts and remaining there for several weeks.

patterns.name: TIN letter string and tin
patterns.context: The letter string IN occurs in legal names or within the word “UNITED”; separate content concerns tin mining and smelting.

3_277.description: 激活分散于法院判决与管辖权、法语“premier”、歌曲登顶榜单，以及 TIN 字母串和锡矿内容；除各自局部线索外，没有覆盖全部段落的统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 法院判决与管辖权
patterns.context: 出现在法院名称、判决或上诉叙述、管辖权及刑事案件语境中。

patterns.name: 法语“premier”
patterns.context: 出现在“«premier» principe”或“«premier» point”等议会发言中，指第一个原则或议题。

patterns.name: 排行榜第一名
patterns.context: 流行歌曲达到排行榜第一名并维持数周的叙述。

patterns.name: TIN 字母串与锡
patterns.context: 在法律姓名或“UNITED”一词内部出现 IN 字母串；另有锡矿开采与冶炼的内容。

en.concept: Local lexical and formatting features across corpora
en.description: Primarily responds to minutes and related questions in English time-arithmetic problems; also responds to court, party, and jurisdiction vocabulary in legal documents, as well as forms such as premier/première in French parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Minutes in English time calculations
patterns.context: Time-arithmetic problems asking for the number of minutes between two times, or for a number of minutes before or after a given time; “minutes” is followed by a value or appears in the question.

patterns.name: Court vocabulary in legal document format
patterns.context: Legal case titles, court jurisdiction sections, or party listings; often accompanied by uppercase text, indentation, and line breaks.

patterns.name: French words denoting precedence or first
patterns.context: References to a principle or the first agenda item in a French parliamentary context; activation falls on subword fragments within the word form.

3_277.concept: 多语料局部词汇与格式特征
3_277.description: 主要响应英语时间算术题中的分钟及相关问法；也响应法律文书的法院、当事人和管辖权词汇，以及法语议会文本中 premier/première 等词形。

patterns.name: 英文时间计算中的分钟
patterns.trigger: “minutes”及短语“how many minutes are there between”；也见“minutes after”“minutes before”
patterns.context: 时间算术题里询问两个时刻之间的分钟数，或在某时刻之前/之后若干分钟；“minutes”后接数值或出现在题干中。

patterns.name: 法律文书格式中的法庭词汇
patterns.context: 法律案件标题、法院管辖权段落或当事人列示；常伴随大写、缩进和换行排版。

patterns.name: 法语中表示先后或第一的词
patterns.context: 法语议会语境中提及原则或议程的第一项；激活落在词形内部的子词片段。

en.concept: Letter fragments in uppercase words and miscellaneous
en.description: Activation is most prominent on letter fragments such as IN in uppercase words or proper names; some examples also use federal court caption formatting. Other sporadic triggers include time calculations, discussions of predictive robots, descriptions of damaged objects, and name fragments, making it difficult to assign a single semantic function.

patterns.name: IN letter fragments within words
patterns.context: Uppercase proper names or words contain letter fragments such as IN/ENT; some occur in judicial captions, names, or place names, while others appear as TIN in ordinary text.
patterns.domain: Mixed; legal texts, proper names, and general text

patterns.name: U.S. federal court captions and formatting
patterns.context: Legal document caption pages or case-name sections, often with uppercase court names, circuit designations, parties, and spacing; activation does not occur only on IN fragments.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and case captions

patterns.name: Time expressions in elapsed-time questions
patterns.context: Questions about the number of minutes between AM/PM times and colon-separated numeric times, including short Q&A formats.

patterns.name: Discussions of predictive robots and randomness
patterns.context: Discussion of whether predictive robots could outperform random chance by relying on market fluctuations; activation mainly falls on ordinary words.

patterns.name: TIN related to the German census
patterns.context: TIN appears as an abbreviation for a Germany-related measure; the context mentions Nazi history, the census, and a boycott.

patterns.name: tear describing object damage
patterns.context: Describes a small tear near the object's left corner; tear is used as a noun.

patterns.name: Fragments in litigant names
patterns.context: Litigant names in court captions are set in uppercase; the triggering fragments do not form an obvious shared lexical pattern.

3_277.concept: 大写词中的字母片段及杂项
3_277.description: 激活最显著地出现在大写词或专名里的 IN 等字母片段；部分样本同时是联邦法院标题版式。另有时间计算、预测机器人讨论、物品破损描述及姓名片段等零散触发，难以归为同一语义功能。

patterns.name: 词内 IN 字母片段
patterns.context: 大写专名或词语中包含 IN/ENT 一类字母片段；有些出现在司法标题、姓名或地名中，也有普通文本中的 TIN。
patterns.domain: 混合；法律文本、专名与一般文本

patterns.name: 美国联邦法院标题与版式
patterns.trigger: « Court»、« Appeals»、« Circuit»、« District»、«UNITED STATES»及标题中的空白占位
patterns.context: 法律文书标题页或案名区域，常伴随大写法院名称、巡回区、当事人和排版空格；激活并不只落在 IN 片段上。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与案卷标题

patterns.name: 时间间隔问答中的时间表达
patterns.context: 以 AM/PM 时间和冒号分隔的数字时间询问分钟差，包含短问答格式。

patterns.name: 预测机器人与随机性讨论
patterns.context: 讨论预测机器人能否凭市场波动胜过随机机会；激活主要落在普通词语上。

patterns.name: 德国人口普查相关的 TIN
patterns.context: TIN 作为德国相关措施的缩写出现，语境提及纳粹历史、人口普查及抵制。

patterns.name: 描述物体破损的 tear
patterns.context: 描述物体左侧角落附近的小裂口，tear 出现在名词用法中。

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人姓名中的片段
patterns.context: 法院标题中的当事人姓名以大写排版呈现，触发片段不属于明显共同词义模式。

en.description: Most fragment activations fall on in/Tin letter strings with varying capitalization, appearing in proper nouns, common words, and the substance name “tin”; there are also sporadic activations on legal titles, names, and whitespace formatting, with unclear triggering relationships.

patterns.name: in/Tin substring within or at the start of a word
patterns.context: Activations often fall on differently capitalized in strings, especially word-initial Tin and word-internal chin; these examples alone do not establish whether a particular meaning is required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: legal documents, general text, encyclopedias, catalogs

patterns.name: Sporadic letter fragments in legal titles and names
patterns.context: Appears in formatted text such as court names, legal titles, or names; activations fall on punctuation, spaces, and split letter fragments, with no shared lexical trigger apparent.

patterns.name: Court jurisdiction heading fragment
patterns.context: Around jurisdiction headings and statute citations, activation falls on heading words and formatting fragments such as parentheses.

patterns.name: Tea party movement name
patterns.context: Activation occurs on Tin in a proper name; preceding text discusses rejecting tracking devices.

patterns.name: Formatting markers unexplained by shared word forms
patterns.context: Strong activations occur in long blank fields and legal case-title formatting, with no direct correspondence to the in/Tin word-form pattern.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw case titles or party listings

3_277.description: 多数片段激活落在大小写不一的 in/Tin 字母串上，见于专名、普通词和“tin”物质名；另有法律标题、姓名及空白排版片段的零散激活，触发关系不明。

patterns.name: 词内或词首的 in/Tin 子串
patterns.context: 激活常落在大小写不同的 in 字母串上，尤其是词首 Tin、词内 chin；单凭这些例子无法确定是否要求特定词义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：法律文书、普通文本、百科、目录

patterns.name: 法律标题与姓名中的零散字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在法院名称、法律标题或姓名等排版文本中；激活分布在标点、空格及被切分的字母片段，未见统一的词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 法院管辖权标题片段
patterns.context: 围绕管辖权标题及法规引用，激活落在标题词和括号等格式片段上。

patterns.name: 茶壶帽运动名称
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名中的 Tin；前文讨论拒绝追踪设备。

patterns.name: 无法由共同词形解释的格式标记
patterns.context: 长空白字段及法律案件标题排版处出现强激活，无法与 in/Tin 词形模式直接对应。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 案件标题或当事人栏

en.description: The most stable pattern is words denoting minutes and time intervals in time-calculation problems. Other occasional uppercase IN or lowercase in character fragments occur in court captions, German-related discussions, and book titles; Star is also activated in the title Star Fisher.

patterns.name: between in time-interval questions
patterns.context: Asks how many minutes separate two clock times, commonly in sequences of arithmetic problems and answer lists; activation concentrates on between and nearby text.

patterns.name: minutes in time arithmetic
patterns.context: Adds or subtracts AM/PM times in minutes; also appears outside between questions.

patterns.name: TIN in court captions
patterns.context: Character fragment inside an uppercase name or organization, apparently not triggered by its ordinary meaning; nearby context is a U.S. court case caption.

patterns.name: Star Fisher title
patterns.context: Appears in the book or series title “The Star Fisher,” surrounded by works and sequels.

patterns.name: Chinatown spelling fragment
patterns.context: The character fragment occurs inside Chinatown, before the novel title “Chinatown Mysteries.”

patterns.name: TIN in German political history
patterns.context: Uppercase character fragment in a passage about Germany's sensitivity to measures such as the census; the context mentions the Nazi era and a boycott.

patterns.name: Chinook in a catalog
patterns.context: Character fragment embedded in the title Chinook on a catalog page organized by title and author.

3_277.concept: 不一致的局部词形/子串检测
3_277.description: 最稳定的模式是时间计算题中表示分钟及时间间隔的词；另有若干偶发的大写 IN 或小写 in 字符片段，散见法院标题、德国议题及书名中，另在作品名 Star Fisher 中响应 Star。

patterns.name: 时间间隔问题中的 between
patterns.trigger: «between»2；尤见 «minutes»1/2 are there« between»2 H:MM AM/PM« and»3 H:MM AM/PM
patterns.context: 询问两个钟表时间之间相隔多少分钟，常见于连续的算术题与答案列表；激活集中在 between 及其附近。

patterns.name: 时间运算中的 minutes
patterns.context: 以分钟为单位，对 AM/PM 时间做加减；不只出现在 between 问句中。

patterns.name: 法院标题里的 TIN
patterns.context: 大写姓名或机构名内部的字母片段，不像是按其正常词义触发；相邻上下文为美国法院案件标题。

patterns.name: Star Fisher 标题
patterns.context: 出现在书名或系列名“The Star Fisher”中，周围列有作品与续作。

patterns.name: Chinatown 拼写片段
patterns.context: 字母片段位于 Chinatown 一词内部，出现在小说标题“Chinatown Mysteries”之前。

patterns.name: 德国政治史中的 TIN
patterns.context: 大写字母片段出现在谈德国对人口普查等措施敏感的段落中；语境提及纳粹时期及抵制。

patterns.name: 目录中的 Chinook
patterns.context: 字母片段嵌在书名 Chinook 中，出现在按标题与作者排列的目录页。

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on IN/in strings with variable casing and tokenization, often in spellings such as TIN, tin, and Chin; a few legal captions, catalog formatting, and proper-name fragments also trigger activation. Trigger locations in the fifth segment are sporadic and difficult to explain.

patterns.name: IN strings starting with T
patterns.context: Activation falls on the variably cased spelling fragment IN, which may span tokens; the fragment often occurs at the start of a word or in an uppercase abbreviation. No specific syntactic context is required.
patterns.domain: Multiple text types, including legal documents, catalogs, forum posts, encyclopedia entries, and literary catalogs

patterns.name: Tin and words containing tin
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts such as tin mining, smelting, tin-foil hats, or place names; in some forms, in is uppercase, and in others, lowercase.

patterns.name: Chin/Chinook in proper names
patterns.context: Activation corresponds to a character fragment within a proper name and need not be related to the meaning of tin.
patterns.domain: Literary catalogs, place names, and case narratives

patterns.name: IN in legal document formatting and captions
patterns.context: Unusual casing or tokenization appears in court captions, litigant names, or jurisdiction headings; activation may also fall on formatting spaces or Court, not just the IN fragment.

patterns.name: Occasional character fragments in proper names
patterns.context: The fragment occurs in a work title or ordinary word; available context is insufficient to identify a clear semantic pattern.

3_277.concept: IN/in 字母串及邻近拼写
3_277.description: 激活最稳定地落在大小写及切分多变的 IN/in 字母串，常见于 TIN、tin 和 Chin 等拼写；还伴随少数法律标题、目录排版及专名片段激活。第5段触发位置分散，难以解释。

patterns.name: T 开头的 IN 字母串
patterns.context: 激活落在大小写不一、可能跨 token 切分的拼写片段 IN；该片段常位于词首或大写缩写中。无需特定句法上下文。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、目录、论坛帖子、百科条目及文学目录等多种文本

patterns.name: 锡及含 tin 的词
patterns.context: 出现在锡矿开采、冶炼、锡箔帽或地名等语境；部分形式中的 in 大写，部分为小写。
patterns.domain: 百科说明与 HackerNews 讨论

patterns.name: 专名中的 Chin/Chinook
patterns.context: 激活对应专名内部的字母片段，不要求与锡义相关。
patterns.domain: 文学作品目录、地名及案件叙述

patterns.name: 法律文书排版与标题中的 IN
patterns.trigger: «T»«IN»，见 T«IN»ITED、T«IN»NEY；以及标题中突出的« Court»
patterns.context: 法庭标题、当事人姓名或辖权标题中出现异常大小写/切分；激活不只限于 IN 片段，也可能落在排版空白或 Court 上。

patterns.name: 专名中偶发的字母片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在作品名或普通词中，现有上下文不足以归入明确语义模式。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to continuous in/IN substrings in English spellings, commonly in Chinook, Chinatown, Chin, TINNEY, UNITED, tins, and Tin, across capitalization and word boundaries. Examples span catalogs, encyclopedias, legal documents, forums, and papers; other triggers also occur alongside vocabulary or list formats specific to their domains.

patterns.name: Strings containing chin/Chin
patterns.context: The letter sequence in/IN appears in English words or proper nouns, especially across capitalization, word boundaries, or punctuation; sometimes occurs in spellings such as China, Chinook, Chinatown, Chin, Tinney, United, and tins.
patterns.domain: Bibliography, Wikipedia, legal documents, speech transcripts, forums, and academic texts

patterns.name: Proper nouns in title and entry lists
patterns.context: Titles in lists of books or series contain common words such as Star and Dragon; Chinatown, which triggers in, also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Place names and geographic entries
patterns.context: Consecutive listing of place names, geographic entities, and their locations; no in-string trigger is marked in this passage.

patterns.name: Legal document format and court jurisdiction terms
patterns.context: Court names, case titles, and jurisdiction rules, among other uppercase or title-case legal terms; TINNEY/INITED strings also occur.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions or litigation documents

patterns.name: Tear in descriptive speech
patterns.context: Uppercase spoken transcript describing vehicle damage, repeatedly mentioning a small tear on the left pillar; TIN also occurs.
patterns.domain: Testimony or oral records in legal materials

patterns.name: Tin foil hat/conspiracy expression
patterns.context: Forum post uses Tin Foil Hat Movement to refer to people who reject tracking devices.

patterns.name: German history and statistics discussion
patterns.context: Discusses German resistance to statistical measures and the census in the context of Nazi history; TIN may be a string trigger across capitalization and tokenization.

patterns.name: Atomic interactions in academic terminology
patterns.context: Discusses atomic interactions in Bose lattice gases and antiferromagnets; also contains the citation Ch«in»92010.

patterns.name: Chinook entry in a bibliography
patterns.context: A catalog entry title followed by author Ezra H…; activation concentrates on the in substring in Chinook.

3_277.concept: 英文 in 字符串模式
3_277.description: 主要对英文拼写中连续的 in/IN 子串敏感，常见于 Chinook、Chinatown、Chin、TINNEY、UNITED、tins、Tin 等词，跨大小写和词边界出现。实例分布于目录、百科、法律、论坛和论文；其余触发也伴随各自领域词汇或列表格式。

patterns.name: 含 chin／Chin 的字符串
patterns.context: 英文单词或专名中出现字母序列 in/IN，尤其是跨大小写、词边界或被标点切分；有时落在 China、Chinook、Chinatown、Chin、Tinney、United、tins 等拼写中。
patterns.domain: 书目、维基百科、法律文书、口语转写、论坛及学术文本

patterns.name: 标题与条目列表中的专名
patterns.trigger: «Star»6 Fisher series、The «Star»6 Fisher；Dragon of the Lost Sea、Dragon Steel 等
patterns.context: 书名或系列名列表中，标题含常见词 Star、Dragon；同一段还出现触发 in 的 Chinatown。

patterns.name: 地名与地理条目
patterns.context: 连续列举地名、地理实体及其所在区域；本段未标出 in 字符串触发。

patterns.name: 法律文书格式与法院管辖词
patterns.context: 法院名称、案件标题和管辖规则等大写或标题式法律术语；另有 TINNEY/INITED 字样。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决或诉讼文书

patterns.name: 描述性口语中的 tear
patterns.context: 大写口语转录描述车辆损伤，重复提及左侧角柱上的小裂口；同时出现 TIN 字样。
patterns.domain: 法律材料中的证词或口述记录

patterns.name: tin foil hat／阴谋论表达
patterns.context: 论坛发言以 Tin Foil Hat Movement 指称拒绝追踪设备的人。

patterns.name: 德国历史与统计讨论
patterns.context: 谈及纳粹历史背景下德国对统计措施及人口普查的抵触；TIN 可能是大小写切分后的字符串触发。

patterns.name: 学术术语中的 atomic interactions
patterns.context: 讨论玻色晶格气体与反铁磁体中的原子相互作用；另含 Ch«in»92010 引文。

patterns.name: 书目中的 Chinook 条目
patterns.context: 目录条目标题后接作者 Ezra H…；激活集中在 Chinook 的 in 子串。

en.description: Activation often falls on within-word character fragments regardless of case, such as in, UNC, AN, ic, and or, especially in proper names. Legal documents predominate, but bibliographies, encyclopedias, and comments also occur. Formatting spaces, title words, and footnote markers are only sporadic co-occurrences.

patterns.name: Within-word IN character fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the in/IN sequence within words; it occurs at word beginnings and medially, in both uppercase and lowercase, without a consistent word meaning.
patterns.domain: Bibliographies, encyclopedias, legal documents, and online comments

patterns.name: Within-word UNC and subsequent character fragments
patterns.context: Concentrated in consecutive subword fragments within proper names; UNCAN corresponds to Duncan, and another occurrence falls in Ticor.
patterns.domain: Judges’ names and company names in legal opinions

patterns.name: Legal document formatting and spaces
patterns.context: In formatted legal text, spaces, headings, or proper-name fragments sometimes co-occur with character-substring activation; however, spaces are not an independent trigger shared across all segments.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal case files

patterns.name: Asterisks and terms in titles or proper names
patterns.context: Terms near numeric footnote markers or in titles and proper names occasionally activate; these have no clear shared meaning with the main character-fragment pattern.
patterns.domain: Legal citations, bibliographies, and encyclopedia entries

3_277.description: 激活常落在大小写不拘的词内字母片段，如 in、UNC、AN、ic、or，尤其见于专名；法律文书占多数，但书目、百科和评论也有。格式空白、标题词和脚注标记仅零散伴随出现。

patterns.name: 词内字母片段 IN
patterns.trigger: «in»（[1] Ch«in»ook；[2] Ch«in»atown；[3] T«IN»ney；[4] Ch«in»；[5] T«IN»ited；[9] T«IN»）
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的 in/IN 字母序列；词首、词中以及大小写形式均可见，具体词义不统一。
patterns.domain: 书目、百科、法律文书和网络评论

patterns.name: 词内 UNC 与后续字母片段
patterns.context: 集中出现在专名内部的连续子词片段；UNCAN 对应 Duncan，另一处落在 Ticor。
patterns.domain: 法律判决中的法官姓名、公司名称

patterns.name: 法律文书格式与空白
patterns.context: 格式化法律文本中，空格、标题或专名片段有时与字母子串激活同时出现；但空白并非各段共有的独立触发条件。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律案卷

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的星号及词项
patterns.context: 数字脚注标记附近或标题、专名中的词项偶有激活；这些内容与主要字母片段模式没有明确共同语义。
patterns.domain: 法律引文、书目及百科条目

en.description: Activation mainly falls on “in” within proper names, U.S. court headers and aligned spaces, and time expressions in minute-addition and time-difference problems. Other local patterns include “Star” in the book title “Star,” rule numbers, and z in “Ezra.”

patterns.name: The string “in” in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on a character fragment within a proper name, not the standalone preposition “in”; the proper name may be a place, person, or title.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic titles, encyclopedia narratives, legal-document names

patterns.name: Legal document captions and formatting spaces
patterns.context: Formal headers in court opinions or Tax Court memoranda, often with uppercase court names, district names, and long alignment spaces.

patterns.name: Time arithmetic Q&A
patterns.context: AM/PM times are inputs, and the question asks for a number of minutes to add, subtract, or calculate between two times, followed by a numeric answer.

patterns.name: Star Fisher in a book-title catalog
patterns.context: A bibliographic list of works or series; activation here concentrates on the title word “Star.”
patterns.domain: Works list in an encyclopedia entry

patterns.name: Rule numbers in legal language
patterns.context: An unpublished-opinion notice at the beginning of a court opinion mentions a rule number; it appears with the court header in the same passage.

patterns.name: Isolated name-fragment activation
patterns.context: Occurs within the author name “Ezra” in a catalog; there is insufficient evidence that this fragment shares a more specific pattern with other activations.

3_277.description: 激活主要落在专名内部的“in”、美国法院抬头及对齐空白，以及分钟加减和时差题的时间表达；另见书名“Star”、规则编号和“Ezra”中的z等局部模式。

patterns.name: “in”字串出现在专名中
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部的字母片段上，而非独立介词“in”；专名可以是地名、人物名或标题名。
patterns.domain: 书目标题、百科叙述、法律文书姓名

patterns.name: 法律文书标题与排版空白
patterns.context: 法院意见或税务法院备忘录的正式抬头，常见全大写法院名称、分区名称及用于对齐的长空白。

patterns.name: 时间算术问答
patterns.trigger: “« minutes»”“« before»”“« between»”“« and»”以及时间中的“«:»”
patterns.context: 以 AM/PM 时间为输入，询问分钟数的加减或两个时刻之间的间隔，随后给出数值答案。

patterns.name: 书名目录中的 Star Fisher
patterns.context: 书目式的作品或系列标题列表；这里的激活集中在标题词“Star”。
patterns.domain: 百科条目中的作品列表

patterns.name: 法律用语中的规则编号
patterns.context: 法院意见开头的未认证出版声明，提及规则编号；与同段法院抬头同时出现。

patterns.name: 孤立的姓名片段激活
patterns.context: 出现在目录中的作者姓名“Ezra”内部，未见足够证据表明该片段与其他激活共用更具体的模式。

en.concept: Specific character fragments and proper names
en.description: Activation often occurs on local character fragments (IN, ENTH, Ch-in, etc.) and the proper names containing them. It also appears in court captions, bibliographic titles, company lists, and a few narrative words, without fitting a single semantic category.

patterns.name: IN/ENTH/TICOR character fragments
patterns.context: Specific strings occur in names of people, phrases, or organizations; the marked items are mainly character fragments spanning words or occurring within words, not consistent complete words.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, bibliographies, encyclopedias, forum text

patterns.name: Ch/Chin in bibliographic titles
patterns.context: Titles or series names begin with the Ch-in character sequence.

patterns.name: Court captions and jurisdiction
patterns.context: Caption, court-name, or jurisdiction text in U.S. federal court case files; sometimes co-occurs with IN/ENTH fragments.

patterns.name: Star in book or series titles
patterns.context: Star Fisher and related work titles in bibliographic-style listings.

patterns.name: Words related to the German census
patterns.context: Discussion of Germany's sensitivity to or resistance against the census or similar measures.

patterns.name: Narrative about a club and people
patterns.context: A crime narrative mentions a club and related people.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entry about a criminal incident

patterns.name: Road and tear descriptions in testimony
patterns.context: Uppercase or near-uppercase spoken testimony describing a road, travel time, and the location of a tear in an object.

patterns.name: Title insurance company names
patterns.context: A consecutive list of multiple title insurance companies.
patterns.domain: Party list in a legal document

3_277.description: 激活多见于局部字母片段（IN、ENTH、Ch-in 等）及其所在的专名；也出现在法院标题、书目标题、公司名单和少数叙述词中，无法归为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 字母片段 IN/ENTH/TICOR
patterns.context: 特定字母串出现在人名、短语或机构名称中；被标出的主要是跨词或词内的字符片段，并非一致的完整词。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、书目、百科、论坛文本

patterns.name: 书目标题中的 Ch/Chin
patterns.context: 标题或系列名开头含 Ch-in 字母序列。

patterns.name: 法院标题与司法辖区
patterns.context: 美国联邦法院案卷的标题、法院名称或司法管辖权文本；有时与 IN/ENTH 片段同时出现。

patterns.name: 书名或系列名中的 Star
patterns.context: 书目式标题列举中，Star Fisher 及其相关作品名。

patterns.name: 德国人口普查相关词
patterns.context: 讨论德国对人口普查或类似措施的敏感与抵制。

patterns.name: 俱乐部与人名叙述
patterns.trigger: 「« club» patrons」「« club» dealer Wai « Y»ok Chin」
patterns.context: 犯罪叙述中提及俱乐部及相关人物。

patterns.name: 证词中的道路及撕裂描述
patterns.context: 大写或近似大写的口述证词，描述道路、行驶时间、物件破口位置。

patterns.name: 产权保险公司名称
patterns.context: 多个产权保险公司名称连续列举。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的当事方名单

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the letter fragment IN within words, commonly in spellings such as TIN, UNITED, Tenth, and Chinatown, across legal documents, news, catalogs, and narrative text; there is also activation on in in the book title Chinook.

patterns.name: In-word substrings containing TIN
patterns.context: Activation falls on continuous letter fragments inside uppercase or mixed-case words; they occur in UNITED, TIN, Ticor, and other words, with no independent semantic use apparent.
patterns.domain: Different genres, including legal documents, news discussion, bibliographies, and historical narrative

patterns.name: Ch-in fragment in a song title
patterns.context: An italicized title in a bibliography entry, with activation inside a title word.

3_277.description: 激活主要落在词内的字母片段 IN（常见于 TIN、UNITED、Tenth、Chinatown 等拼写），跨法律文书、新闻、目录与叙述；另在书目标题 Chinook 的 in 上激活。

patterns.name: 含 TIN 的词内子串
patterns.context: 激活落在大写或大小写混合的词内部连续字母片段上；分别嵌在 UNITED、TIN、Ticor 等词中，未见独立的语义用法
patterns.domain: 法律文书、新闻讨论、书目及历史叙述等不同文体

patterns.name: 歌曲标题中的 Ch-in 片段
patterns.context: 书目条目中的斜体标题，激活位于标题单词内部

en.concept: Text fragments containing IN and formal document formatting
en.description: Activation often falls on IN/in character fragments spanning word boundaries, but also covers court headers, legal captions, proper names, formatting words, and spaces in bibliographies and tables. The eighth segment contains only numbers, punctuation, and legal prose, with no clear correspondence.

patterns.name: TIN/IN character fragments
patterns.context: The marked fragment contains the contiguous letters in/IN, often embedded in a name, ordinary word, or abbreviation; casing varies, and word meaning and syntactic conditions are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, news commentary, catalogs, object descriptions, emails/tables, etc.

patterns.name: Court and legal document formatting
patterns.context: Formal legal document templates such as court names, jurisdiction headings, and appellate court headers, especially uppercase headings and formatting spaces.

patterns.name: Uppercase strings and tokenization in headings
patterns.context: Uppercase abbreviations, names, or locations near token boundaries activate in tables or lists; IN fragments also occur in the same segment.
patterns.domain: Flight/airport or itinerary tables in emails

patterns.name: Title and book-title formatting in catalogs
patterns.context: Titles appear in italics or as proper names in bibliographic catalogs; character fragments within titles co-occur with other activations.

patterns.name: Title in title insurance company names
patterns.context: Multiple company names repeat Title Insurance; character fragments within company names also activate.
patterns.domain: Party list in a legal case

patterns.name: Spaces and layout padding
patterns.context: Numerous alignment spaces in document headers or tables are marked, often alongside uppercase headings.

3_277.concept: 含 IN 的文本片段与正式文书格式
3_277.description: 激活常落在跨词边界的 IN/in 字母片段，但也覆盖法院抬头、法律标题、书目与表格中的专名、格式词及空白；第8段仅见数字、标点和法律文句，缺少明显对应。

patterns.name: TIN/IN 字母片段
patterns.context: 被标记片段包含连续字母 in/IN，常嵌在姓名、普通词或缩写中；大小写不一，词义和句法条件不统一。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、新闻评论、目录、物品描述、邮件/表格等

patterns.name: 法院及法律文书格式
patterns.context: 法院名称、管辖权标题、上诉法院抬头等正式法律文书模板中，尤其是大写标题和排版空白。

patterns.name: 标题中的大写字母串与切分
patterns.context: 表格或清单中的大写缩写、名称、分词边界附近出现激活；同段也有 IN 片段。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的航班/机场或行程表格

patterns.name: 标题目录与书名排版
patterns.context: 书目目录中，标题以斜体或专名格式呈现；标题内部字母片段与其他激活并存。

patterns.name: 保险公司名称中的 Title
patterns.context: 多个公司名称反复出现 Title Insurance；另有公司名内部的字母片段激活。

patterns.name: 空白与版式填充
patterns.context: 文书抬头或表格中大量对齐空格被标记，常与大写标题同现。

en.description: The most stable trigger is the IN subword fragment after the digit 9, across casing and corpora; it often falls inside tokenized words. Legal court headers, the Ninth Circuit, bibliographic titles, and a few technical or colloquial words also occur, but these contexts do not explain all activations.

patterns.name: IN token fragment after the digit 9
patterns.context: Appears immediately after the digit 9, often inside a word or a tokenized subword sequence; casing varies. Segment 4 has a similar «IN»9, but is spelled «T»IN«NS».
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including legal documents, forum text, catalogs, and patent technical text

patterns.name: U.S. federal court captions and Ninth Circuit names
patterns.context: Court headers or case captions contain standard legal formatting such as United States, court, or circuit court; several fragments also include the circuit ordinal “NINTH.” This pattern overlaps with IN fragments but does not explain IN elsewhere.

patterns.name: Ch-in sequence in bibliographic titles
patterns.context: In a catalog entry or series name, IN occurs inside a title word, preceded by Ch.
patterns.domain: Book catalogs, children’s literature series lists

patterns.name: Internal sequence in telomer in patent chemistry terms
patterns.context: In chemical patent text, IN occurs in the tokenized term telomer and related descriptions; this example has only a weak IN marking.

patterns.name: Within-word sequences in colloquial spellings such as tear/tiny
patterns.context: In an uppercase colloquial description, IN occurs within an informal spelling or tokenized word, alongside descriptions of an object's appearance such as tear and left corner.

3_277.description: 最稳定的触发是数字 9 后的 IN 子词片段，跨大小写与语料出现；常落在切分词内部。法律法院抬头、第九巡回法院、书目标题及少数技术或口语词中也出现，但这些语境不能统一解释全部激活。

patterns.name: 数字 9 后的分词片段 IN
patterns.context: 在数字 9 后紧接着出现，常处于单词内部或被切分的子词序列中；大小写不一。段 4 有近似的 «IN»9，但拼作 «T»IN«NS»。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、论坛文字、目录、专利技术文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 美国联邦法院标题与第九巡回法院名称
patterns.context: 法院抬头或案件标题中出现美国、法院、巡回法院等固定法律格式；多个片段还出现巡回序号 “NINTH”。该模式与 IN 片段重叠，但不足以解释其他领域中的 IN。

patterns.name: 书目标题中的 Ch-in 序列
patterns.context: 目录条目或系列名称中，IN 位于标题单词内部；前缀为 Ch。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录、儿童文学系列列表

patterns.name: 专利化学术语中的 telomer 内部序列
patterns.context: 化学专利文本中，IN 后接在被分词的术语 telomer 及相关描述中；此例只有较弱的 IN 标记。

patterns.name: 口语拼写中的 tear / tiny 等词内序列
patterns.context: 大写口语化描述中，IN 处于非正式拼写或被切分的词内，旁有 tear、left corner 等物品外观描述。
patterns.domain: 口语转写或用户生成文本

en.description: Activation reflects multiple local cues: court appellations and legal-procedure contexts, within-word IN fragments, formatted headers, and sporadic literary, travel, contract, forum, and patent strings. Trigger locations vary across segments.

patterns.name: “court” and nearby words
patterns.context: Legal text contains court appellations, often adjacent to “United States,” “of Appeals,” “district,” “jurisdiction,” or procedural rules; casing does not affect the trigger
patterns.domain: Judicial documents, court headers, and legal discussion

patterns.name: Tokenized IN fragments
patterns.context: The string IN occurs within a word, especially in tokenized or unusually formatted names, word fragments, and “NINTH”; there is no evidence that it triggers similarly as a standalone word
patterns.domain: Names in legal documents, court headers, and within-word substrings in other text

patterns.name: Book titles and name fragments in lists or catalogs
patterns.context: Tokenized strings occur in titles or author names in poetry or works catalogs; strong activation falls on the “in” fragment

patterns.name: of in a contract-performance sentence
patterns.context: Words in the phrase “part of the contract” activate in a legal account of specific contract provisions or performance.

patterns.name: Court-header formatting after extensive spacing
patterns.context: Spaces position text in a court document header; “NINTH” also occurs in the same segment

patterns.name: road and travel word fragments
patterns.context: Informal sentences about roads, travel time, and object descriptions; activation falls on tokenized English word fragments

patterns.name: Line break in money- and jurisdiction strings
patterns.context: A case caption or rule excerpt contains line-broken “Money-mandating” and court-jurisdiction language

patterns.name: Word fragments in a German census discussion
patterns.context: In a discussion of historical concerns about the census and similar measures in Germany, activation occurs in the tokenized “TIN” fragment and “years long”

patterns.name: telomer in patent chemistry text
patterns.context: “telomer chain” occurs in a technical description of fluorinated compounds and repeating units

patterns.name: Time and orders in a legal sentence
patterns.context: Procedural sentence describing service deadlines, a motion for extension, and a district court minute order

3_277.concept: 混合词串与法院文书线索
3_277.description: 激活呈现多种局部线索：法院称谓与法律程序语境、词内 IN 片段、格式化页眉，以及零散的文学、旅行、合同、论坛和专利词串。各段触发位置并不统一。

patterns.name: “court”及其邻近词
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现法院称谓，常与“United States”“of Appeals”“district”“jurisdiction”或程序规则相邻；大小写不影响触发
patterns.domain: 司法文书、法院抬头与法律论述

patterns.name: 分词 IN 的片段
patterns.context: 字母串 IN 位于单词内部，尤其出现在被切分或格式异常的姓名、单词片段和“NINTH”中；未见其作为独立单词时同样触发的证据
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的姓名、法院抬头，以及其他文本中的词内子串

patterns.name: 列表或目录中的书名与姓名片段
patterns.trigger: «Ch»1«in»9ook；另见“_The« Song»2 of the« Camp»2_”“_«Bay»2«ard»1 Taylor_”
patterns.context: 诗歌或作品目录的标题、作者名中出现被切分的字符串；强激活落在“in”片段

patterns.name: 合同执行句中的 of
patterns.context: 法律叙述具体合同条款或合同履行时，短语“part of the contract”中的词语激活

patterns.name: 大量空格后的法院抬头格式
patterns.trigger: 多段« »1至« »4空格标记，邻接“UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS”及“FOR THE NINTH CIRCUIT”
patterns.context: 法院文件页眉以空格排版定位文字；同段也出现词内“NINTH”
patterns.domain: 联邦上诉法院文书页眉

patterns.name: road 与 travel 的词片段
patterns.context: 道路、旅行时间及物品描述的非正式句子；激活落在被拆分的英文词片段

patterns.name: money- 的断行与管辖权词串
patterns.context: 案件标题或规则摘录中有跨行断开的“Money-mandating”及法院管辖权表述

patterns.name: 德国人口普查讨论中的词片段
patterns.trigger: T«IN»9 met massive,« years»5 long resistance
patterns.context: 讨论德国对人口普查等措施的历史顾虑时，激活出现在被拆分的“TIN”片段及“years long”

patterns.name: 专利化学文本中的 telomer
patterns.context: 含氟化合物和重复单元的技术描述中出现“telomer chain”

patterns.name: 法律句中的时间与命令
patterns.trigger: «minute»9« order»1；另见«day»3 good-«cause»2« extension»所在语境
patterns.context: 描述送达期限、延期申请及地区法院作出 minute order 的程序性句子

en.description: Activations often fall on letter fragments with T followed by IN, especially in names, court headings, and body text in U.S. legal documents; there are also sporadic responses to title-format whitespace, tear, chin in book titles, a title insurance company name, and a telomer fragment in a chemical patent.

patterns.name: TIN letter fragment in legal document titles
patterns.context: Appears in legal document titles, court names, party names, or body text; activation falls on tokens whose spelling contains T followed by IN (or adjacent letter fragments), without requiring the string to be a standalone word.

patterns.name: Heading hierarchy and court-name formatting
patterns.context: Court headings, opinion titles, and surrounding indentation, whitespace, and uppercase formatting; space tokens also activate.

patterns.name: Tear in descriptions of damage
patterns.context: Describes a small tear or split at the left corner of an object, with tear repeated nearby.

patterns.name: chin in book titles
patterns.context: Appears in word-initial spelling fragments in book or series titles; no clear legal context.

patterns.name: Title Insurance in company names
patterns.context: Lists several title insurance companies in legal text; related words recur in company names, along with a company-name fragment containing icor.

patterns.name: Telomer chains in chemical patents
patterns.context: Technical description of fluorinated compounds and the number of repeating units, discussing telomer chains and their fluorination.

3_277.concept: 含特定字母片段的文本
3_277.description: 激活常落在 T 后接 IN 的字母片段，尤其见于美国法律文书中的人名、法院抬头和正文；另对标题排版空白、tear、书名中的 chin、产权保险公司名及化学专利中的 telomer 片段有零星响应。

patterns.name: 法律文件标题中的 TIN 字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律文书标题、法院名称、当事人姓名或正文中；激活落在拼写中含有 T 后接 IN（或相邻字母片段）的 token 上，不要求该串独立构成单词。

patterns.name: 标题层级与法院名称排版
patterns.context: 法院抬头、判决标题及其周围的缩进、空白和大写排版；空格 token 也有激活。

patterns.name: 撕裂描述中的 tear
patterns.context: 描述物品左侧角落有小裂口或撕痕，附近重复出现 tear。

patterns.name: 书目标题中的 chin
patterns.context: 出现在书名或系列名称的词首拼写片段中；没有明显法律语境。

patterns.name: 公司名称中的 Title Insurance
patterns.context: 法律文本列举多家产权保险公司；相关词反复出现在公司名中，另有含 icor 的公司名片段。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的公司名单

patterns.name: 化学专利中的 telomer 链
patterns.context: 含氟化合物及重复单元数量的技术说明中，讨论 telomer 链及其氟化。

en.concept: Uppercase IN substrings and document formatting
en.description: Activation most consistently falls on uppercase IN substrings, especially embedded in proper names or words. Other occurrences include court headers and centered spacing, title insurance company names in legal lists, tear descriptions, chemical telomer-chain terminology, and literary catalog titles; semantic links between patterns are weak.

patterns.name: Uppercase IN substrings
patterns.context: Activation falls on the consecutive uppercase letters IN; they commonly occur inside proper names or words, with no consistent surrounding letters or meaning.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, news commentary, encyclopedias, catalogs, etc.

patterns.name: Court captions and formatting
patterns.context: Court names, court headers, or centered spacing in legal documents activate on both court words and indentation spaces.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and litigation documents

patterns.name: T-initial words in tear descriptions
patterns.context: Describes a small tear on the left corner post of an object; activation is distributed across subword fragments in tear and related location descriptions.
patterns.domain: Exhibit or object descriptions in legal materials

patterns.name: Title Insurance names
patterns.context: Multiple title insurance company names are listed consecutively; word fragments in Title, Insurance, and Company activate.
patterns.domain: Company list in a legal case

patterns.name: Chemical polymer-chain terminology
patterns.context: Technical sentence explaining the number of repeating units in a telomer and its chain length.

patterns.name: Terms in catalog titles
patterns.context: Poetry or works catalogs are formatted with titles and author names; activation falls on fragments within titles or names.

3_277.concept: 大写 IN 子串及文书格式
3_277.description: 激活最稳定地落在大写 IN 子串，尤其嵌于专名或词内部；另见法院抬头及居中空白、法律名单中的产权保险公司名称、撕口描述、化学 telomer 链术语和文学目录标题，模式间词义联系较弱。

patterns.name: 大写 IN 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在连续大写字母 IN 上；常处于专名或单词内部，周围字母和词义不固定。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、新闻评论、百科及目录等

patterns.name: 法院标题及排版
patterns.context: 法院名称、法院抬头或法律文书的居中空白排版中，法院词及缩进空白均有激活。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与诉讼文书

patterns.name: 撕裂描述中的 T 开头词
patterns.context: 描述物品左侧角柱上的小撕口；激活分布于 tear 及相关位置描述的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 法律材料中的证物或物品描述

patterns.name: Title Insurance 名称
patterns.context: 多个产权保险公司名称连续列举，Title、Insurance、Company 等词片段出现激活。
patterns.domain: 法律案件中的公司名单

patterns.name: 化学聚合物链术语
patterns.context: 解释 telomer 中重复单元数量及链长的技术句子。

patterns.name: 目录标题中的词项
patterns.context: 诗歌或作品目录以标题和作者名排版；激活落在标题或姓名内部片段。

en.concept: Letter sequences and triggers from proper nouns and legal terms
en.description: Activations often fall on the T-I-N letter sequence across or within words (including TIN, TINEY, TINN… and similar CHIN); other patterns include court formatting and terminology, vehicle tear descriptions, chemical chains, and title insurance company lists, possibly reflecting different lexical triggers in the same batch.

patterns.name: TIN letter string
patterns.context: The T-I-N letter sequence, sometimes within a longer word, is marked as a fragment; it may cross word boundaries or occur in proper nouns and abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Various text types, including legal documents, forum posts, encyclopedias, and bibliographies

patterns.name: Tax court title format
patterns.context: Formatting of court and case titles, especially the abbreviation T.C. and the text TAX COURT.

patterns.name: Court/jurisdiction terminology
patterns.context: Legal terms such as jurisdiction, court rules, and civil procedure rules; activations are distributed across heading and body words.

patterns.name: CHIN in court names and judge names
patterns.context: In appellate judge lists, the letter sequence in the name CHIN resembles the TIN pattern; also seen in the book title _Chinook_.

patterns.name: Vehicle parts and tear descriptions
patterns.context: Describes vehicle interiors and small tears on pillars; several vehicle-related words and short words are marked, with no unified legal semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Chemical repeat units and chains
patterns.context: Chemical description of fluorides/end-group polymers, describing molecule counts and chains of repeating units.

patterns.name: Title insurance company names
patterns.context: Lists title insurance companies consecutively; the words Title, Insurance, and Company appear repeatedly and are marked.

3_277.concept: 字母序列与专名、法律词项触发
3_277.description: 激活常落在跨词或词内的 T-I-N 字母序列（含 TIN、TINEY、TINN…及近似 CHIN）；另有法院格式与术语、汽车撕裂描述、化学链、产权保险公司名单等词项模式，可能是同一批次中不同的词汇触发。

patterns.name: TIN 字母串
patterns.context: 字母序列 T-I-N（有时位于更长单词内部）被分段标记；可能跨词边界或处于专名、缩写中。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、论坛文章、百科、书目等多种文本

patterns.name: 税务法院标题格式
patterns.context: 法院名称及案件标题的排版中，尤其是 T.C. 缩写与 TAX COURT 字样。
patterns.domain: 美国税务法院法律文书

patterns.name: 法院／司法管辖术语
patterns.trigger: 「Matter Jurisdiction」「Rules of the Court」「District Court Jurisdiction」「Fed. R. Civ. P.」
patterns.context: 司法管辖、法院规则及民事诉讼规则等法律术语；激活分散在标题与正文词语中。

patterns.name: 法院名称与法官姓名中的 CHIN
patterns.context: 上诉法院法官名单中，姓名 CHIN 的字母序列与 TIN 模式相近；也见书名 _Chinook_。

patterns.name: 汽车部件与撕裂描述
patterns.context: 描述车辆内饰及角柱上的小撕裂，多个汽车相关词与短词被标记；未见统一的法律语义。

patterns.name: 化学重复单元与链
patterns.context: 氟化物／端基聚合物的化学说明中，描述分子数及重复单元链。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、化学技术文本

patterns.name: 产权保险公司名称
patterns.context: 连续列举产权保险公司名称，Title、Insurance、Company 等词多次出现并被标记。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的公司名单

en.description: Activations are scattered across different text types: letter fragments in the name Michel, word fragments in terms or titles, numbers and units, and variables, fractions, and operators in mathematical expressions; no unified semantic condition is evident.

patterns.name: Michel strings and subsequent tokenization
patterns.context: Michel appears as a name or at the start of a string, followed immediately by different letter fragments; sometimes accompanied by a line break or another occurrence of Michel

patterns.name: Subword fragments in scientific terminology
patterns.context: Split word fragments appear within the term “prototypical G protein coupled receptors (GPCRs)”

patterns.name: Word fragments in technical names
patterns.context: Words such as Layer and Stack occur next to each other in the names of network protocols or technical mechanisms

patterns.name: Word fragments near numbers and units
patterns.context: In geographic descriptions, elevation is given as a number with units of meters; punctuation or characters occur between the number and unit

patterns.name: Symbols and numbers in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Variables, numbers, slashes, and operators are interspersed in expressions involving complex powers, fractions, and parentheses; “assuming … is positive” or “Simplify” often appears

patterns.name: Word fragments in bibliographic titles
patterns.context: Common English words or initial word fragments in book names and titles are embedded among authors, publication information, and punctuation

3_607.description: 激活分散在不同文本类型中：Michel 姓名的字母片段、术语或标题中的词片段、数字单位，以及数学式里的变量、分数和运算符；未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 数字与单位附近的词片段
patterns.context: 地理描述中以数字表示高度，单位为米；数字和单位之间夹有标点或字符

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的符号与数字
patterns.context: 复杂幂、分数和括号构成的表达式中，变量、数字、斜杠与运算符交错；常出现“assuming … is positive”或“Simplify”

patterns.name: 书目标题中的词片段
patterns.context: 书名及标题中的常见英文词或词首片段，嵌在作者、出版信息和标点之间

en.description: Activations occur across heterogeneous text types: names, networking and biomedical terms, numeric units, algebraic simplification expressions, and bibliographic fields. The mathematical examples share variable powers, fractions, and simplification instructions; the other examples show local lexical or formatting triggers.

patterns.name: Michel name fragment
patterns.context: Characters within a proper-name string and following it; the context is truncated and appears to involve a person’s name.

patterns.name: Layer Stack in technical terminology
patterns.context: Networking terms occur consecutively in a patent description of IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack migration, nodes, and tunnel sessions.

patterns.name: GPCR terminology and receptor signaling descriptions
patterns.context: Describes receptors, signaling complexes, and subtype-specific signaling; the GPCR abbreviation is split into tokens.

patterns.name: Numeral followed by unit m
patterns.context: Hill elevations are expressed as numbers and decimals, with meters as the unit, in geographic articles.

patterns.name: Symbolic algebra expressions and simplification prompts
patterns.context: Under the condition that variables are positive, algebraic expressions containing powers, fractions, and parentheses are simplified; variables and expression forms vary.

patterns.name: Publication information in bibliographic entries
patterns.context: Bibliographic fields such as title, author, place of publication, publisher, year, page count, and editor appear consecutively.
patterns.domain: PhilPapers book reviews or bibliography text

3_607.description: 激活分布于多类异质文本：姓名、网络与生物医学术语、数字单位、数学化简式和书目字段；数学段共同含变量幂、分数及化简指令，其余各段呈现局部词形或格式触发。

patterns.name: Michel 姓名片段
patterns.context: 专名字符串内部及其后的名字字符；上下文被截断，似乎涉及人名。

patterns.context: 描述受体、信号复合物及亚型特异性信号，GPCR 缩写被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 数字后接单位 m
patterns.context: 地理条目中以数字和小数表示丘陵高度，单位为米。

patterns.name: 符号化代数表达式与化简提示
patterns.trigger: «/»«)))**»、变量幂与分数；« assuming»…« is»…« positive»；«Simplify»
patterns.context: 正变量条件下，对含幂、分数和括号的代数式进行化简；多个变量与表达式形式不同。

patterns.name: 书目条目中的出版信息
patterns.trigger: « Hidden» Stru«ggle» for America’s Soul、« by»、« New» York、« pages»、« compiler»
patterns.context: 书名、作者、出版地、出版社、年份、页数及编者等书目字段连续出现。

en.description: Activations are scattered across the proper name Michel, networking protocol terminology, hill elevation values, receptor terminology, slashes and numbers in power expressions, and patent error values and identifiers; no unified semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Michel word form
patterns.context: Michel appears next to following word fragments, accompanied by line breaks or consecutive names/text; the specific named-entity relationship is unclear

patterns.name: IPv4/IPv6 and protocol terminology
patterns.context: Patent background text about network addresses, tunnel nodes, and dual-stack conversion mechanisms

patterns.name: Number before a unit
patterns.context: Geographic descriptions give hills’ elevations with values and units

patterns.context: Complex simplification problems involving variable powers, fractions, and parentheses; numbers are often split into separate tokens

patterns.name: Patent error values

3_607.description: 激活分散于专名 Michel、网络协议术语、山高数值、受体术语、幂式中的斜线与数字，以及专利误差和编号；未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: Michel 词形
patterns.context: Michel 与后续词片段相邻，伴随换行或连续人名/文本；具体命名实体关系不清楚

patterns.name: IPv4/IPv6 与协议术语
patterns.trigger: « RSV»«P»；« IPv»«4»；« IPv»«6»；« dual»；« Layer»；« Stack»

patterns.name: 受体与蛋白信号术语
patterns.context: 讨论受体亚型、信号复合物及 G 蛋白偶联受体

patterns.name: 幂运算表达式中的数字片段
patterns.context: 变量幂次、分数与括号构成的复杂化简题；数字常被拆成独立 token

patterns.name: 专利误差数字
patterns.context: 放大器校准误差的专利说明；专利号含数字，另有误差传播描述

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple text types: fragments of the name Michel, the number 460, Layer in technical terminology, and mathematical expressions; there are also sporadic responses to line breaks and other numbers. The contexts of these patterns differ substantially.

patterns.name: Michel in proper names
patterns.context: Appears in proper names or name fragments, followed by split name characters, a line break, or repeated names; the specific boundary condition is unclear

patterns.name: Number 460
patterns.context: Appears as a numeric string; may include a decimal and unit, or occur in a patent number, case citation, or mathematical expression
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, patents, legal texts, and mathematics

patterns.name: Layer
patterns.context: Appears in technical terminology: paragraph [3] contains «IP Layer Stack Transition», and paragraph [10] contains «Physical Layer Standard»
patterns.domain: Network protocol and communications standards patent text

patterns.name: Numerical expressions
patterns.context: Symbols, variables, and numbers form formulas or math problems; activations are scattered, with no single stable symbol evident

patterns.name: Unexplained formatting or number fragments
patterns.context: These local activations can be separately explained by line breaks, recurring numbers, or specific text formatting, but do not constitute an additional consistent trigger pattern

3_607.description: 激活分散在多类文本：Michel姓名片段、数字460、技术术语中的Layer，以及数学符号表达式；另有换行和其他数字的零散响应。各模式上下文差异明显。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Michel
patterns.context: 出现在专名或姓名片段中，后接拆分的姓名字符、换行或重复的人名；具体是哪种边界条件不明确

patterns.name: 数字 460
patterns.context: 作为数字字符串出现；可带小数和单位，也可出现在专利号、判例引文或数学表达式中
patterns.domain: 百科、专利、法律、数学等不同文体

patterns.name: Layer
patterns.context: 出现在技术术语中：第[3]段为 «IP Layer Stack Transition»，第[10]段为 «Physical Layer Standard»

patterns.name: 数字运算表达式

patterns.context: 符号与变量、数字组合成公式或数学题；激活较分散，未见单一稳定符号

patterns.name: 未解释的格式或数字片段
patterns.context: 这些局部激活可分别由换行、数字复现或具体文本格式解释，但不足以构成额外且一致的触发模式

en.concept: Specific lexical items and fragment triggers
en.description: The clearest activation pattern is short requests in emails that begin with “pls”; other activations occur in the name fragment Michel in Wikipedia and in specific word fragments in medical and networking patent texts. No unified semantic or stable grammatical pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Polite requests beginning with pl
patterns.context: Requests someone to perform an action, followed by verbs such as load, find, or print; common in short emails.

patterns.name: Michel string and following name fragments
patterns.context: A proper name appears at the start of a sentence or repeatedly; fragmented tokens form names, with the specific person or spelling varying by context.

patterns.name: Specific biochemical word fragments
patterns.context: Biomedical abstracts discuss N-acetylcysteine as an antidote for Amanita poisoning.

patterns.name: Layer in networking protocol terminology
patterns.context: In the name “Dual IP Layer Stack Transition Mechanism” for a dual-stack transition mechanism, Layer alone receives strong activation.

patterns.name: latex lexical item
patterns.context: latex appears twice in public health abstracts about condoms, medical examination gloves, and rubber products.

patterns.name: TRP word fragment
patterns.context: TRP channel terminology in research abstracts about sensory neurons, mitochondrial dysfunction, and pain.

3_607.description: 激活最清晰的规律是邮件中以“pls”开头的简短请求；此外也覆盖 Wikipedia 中的 Michel 名字片段，以及医学、网络专利文本里的若干特定词项片段，未见统一语义或稳定语法模式。

patterns.name: 以 pl 起始的礼貌请求
patterns.context: 请求对方执行动作，后接 load、find、print 等动词；常见于简短邮件。

patterns.name: Michel 字符串及后续名字片段

patterns.name: 特定生化词汇片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中，围绕乙酰半胱氨酸作为鹅膏毒蕈中毒解毒剂的表述。

patterns.name: 网络协议术语中的 Layer

patterns.name: The word compiler

patterns.context: 受体与信号复合体、亚型特异性信号或 G protein coupled receptors 相关的分子生物学叙述。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 s
patterns.context: 出现在幂、分数与括号构成的符号化简表达式中；没有明显的自然语言触发词。

patterns.name: 电容与负载描述
patterns.context: 描述导线的集总耦合电容及输出负载阻抗，句式为技术元件定义。

patterns.name: TRP 通道敏化
patterns.context: 疼痛及感觉神经元线粒体功能障碍的研究目标陈述。

patterns.name: 糖皮质激素受体表征
patterns.context: 说明受体纯化、分子量、等电点、亚基结构及抗血清制备。

patterns.name: 黏着斑与非受体激酶
patterns.context: 描述肌动蛋白骨架与细胞外基质的连接及下游信号通路。

patterns.name: 血蓝蛋白亚基协同
patterns.context: 标题式短语，讨论鲎血蓝蛋白亚基间的协同相互作用。

patterns.name: 嗅觉受体及共受体
patterns.context: 比较哺乳动物嗅觉受体结构，并描述 OR 与共受体形成异二聚体。

en.description: All examples activate on the substring Corp: it occurs both in the corporate abbreviation Corp. and at the start of Corpus; the pattern spans multiple genres and is primarily triggered by spelling in proper names, with both company and Corpus meanings.

patterns.name: Corp. in corporate names
patterns.context: Appears in organization or company proper names, often as a corporate designation at the end of a name; it can also be split by tokenization, as in «Corp»us
patterns.domain: News, legal, encyclopedia, email, and academic texts

patterns.name: Corpus Christi proper name
patterns.context: The trigger is the initial Corp substring of Corpus; it may be followed by Christi, Hippocraticum, or other continuations
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, school/sports profiles, medical history

patterns.name: Enron Corp. company designation
patterns.context: Corp. follows Enron as part of the company’s formal name

patterns.name: Corp. in other company names
patterns.context: Corp. appears within or at the end of a proper name, often alongside company-name elements such as Inc.

patterns.name: Isolated or boundary-positioned Corp substring
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the string Corp itself; the context still mostly supports either the corporate abbreviation or the initial substring of Corpus
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, emails, news, legal, and medical texts

3_607.description: 所有段均在 Corp 子串处激活：既包括企业简称 Corp.，也包括 Corpus 的词首 Corp-；跨多种文体，主要由专名中的拼写触发，语义上兼有公司与 Corpus 两类。

patterns.name: Corp. 法人名称片段
patterns.trigger: «Corp»9，常接«.», 且前面通常是公司或机构名称
patterns.context: 出现在组织/企业专名中，常作名称末尾的公司类型标记；也有被分词拆开的情形，如 «Corp»us
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律、百科、邮件及学术文本

patterns.name: Corpus Christi 专名
patterns.context: 触发点是 Corpus 的词首 Corp 子串；后续可为 Christi、Hippocraticum 或其他搭配
patterns.domain: 百科条目、学校/体育介绍、医学史

patterns.name: Enron Corp. 公司称谓
patterns.context: Enron 后接 Corp.，作为公司正式名称的一部分

patterns.name: 其他企业名称中的 Corp.
patterns.context: Corp. 出现在专名内部或末尾，常与 Inc. 等公司名称成分共现

patterns.name: 孤立或边界处的 Corp 子串
patterns.trigger: «Corp»9«us»（词中子串）或 «Corp»9«.», 且上下文为机构/实体名称
patterns.context: 激活集中于 Corp 字符串本身；语境仍多支持公司简称或 Corpus 词首两种读法
patterns.domain: 百科、邮件、新闻、法律、医学文本

en.description: Activations concentrate on several stems or subword fragments: creat and initial Cr in proper names, take, and embark, proced, point, and commun; these fragments occur across multiple genres and are difficult to assign a single semantic meaning.

patterns.name: Word fragment “creat”
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on the shared initial character fragment creat/Cr, followed by highly varied word forms; in [1] it is split across a word boundary as “creat”+“ures”, and in [5] as “creat”+“es”.
patterns.domain: Narrative, commentary, legal texts, encyclopedia categories

patterns.name: take
patterns.context: Appears in different semantic contexts involving course requirements, religious beliefs, or personal decisions; an unmarked use of the same word also occurs, suggesting that take alone may not be sufficient and that position or context may matter.
patterns.domain: Academic introductions, philosophical discussion, encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Process verb stem
patterns.context: Activation falls on verb stem fragments denoting starting or proceeding; [10] contains the Italian form procedendo.

patterns.name: Cr in proper names
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of names in proper nouns or classification entries, followed by “Crater”, “Crouter”, or “Crane”; may also overlap character-wise with creat.

patterns.name: Multiple senses of take
patterns.context: Different senses include taking a course, holding a religious belief, and starting to farm; the semantics are not unified, suggesting that the word form itself rather than a single concept may be the trigger.

patterns.name: Other verb fragments
patterns.context: In [5], point is followed by ing and means to indicate; in [10], the commun fragment occurs in the Italian word comunque. Their relation to the other examples is unclear.

3_607.description: 激活集中在若干词干/子词片段：creat 与专名开头 Cr、take，以及 embark、proced、point、commun；这些片段分布于多种文体，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 词语片段“creat”
patterns.context: 强激活落在单词开头的共享字符片段 creat/Cr，后续词形差异很大；在[1]中跨词界拆为“creat”+“ures”，在[5]中为“creat”+“es”。
patterns.domain: 叙述、评论、法律文本、百科分类

patterns.name: take
patterns.context: 出现在课程要求、宗教信念、人物决定等不同语义上下文中；还出现同一词的未标记用法，表明不只要有 take，具体位置或上下文可能也重要。
patterns.domain: 学术介绍、哲学论述、百科叙事

patterns.name: 过程动词词干
patterns.context: 激活落在表示开始或推进的动词词干片段；[10]为意大利语形式 procedendo。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Cr
patterns.context: 位于专名或分类条目中的名称开头，后续分别为“Crater”“Crouter”“Crane”；也可能与 creat 的字符片段重合。
patterns.domain: 百科列表、法律诉讼文书

patterns.name: take 的多义用法
patterns.context: 不同语义分别为修读课程、持有宗教信念、着手务农；语义不统一，可能是词形本身而非单一概念触发。

patterns.name: 其他动词片段
patterns.context: [5]中 point 后接 ing，表示指向；[10]中意大利语 comunque 的 commun 片段。二者与其他段的联系不明。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、意大利语议会文本

en.description: Primarily sensitive to take and its complement structures, covering considering, choosing a path or position, participating in or using an opportunity, locations where something occurs, and taking various forms; there is also one anomalously high activation on the taxonomic name Mon.

patterns.name: take followed by an action or result
patterns.context: take is followed by an infinitive, noun phrase, or other complement, expressing taking action, choosing a destination, or taking a form; occurs in varied syntactic environments.
patterns.domain: Academic, administrative, medical, technical, and patent explanatory prose

patterns.name: Mon in a proper name
patterns.context: Occurs within a taxon name in a plant taxonomy citation; no clear take pattern is present.

3_607.description: 主要对 take 及其补足结构敏感，涵盖采取考虑、选择路径或职位、参与或利用机会、发生地点、采取多种形式等用法；另有一次对分类名 Mon 的异常高激活。

patterns.name: take 后接动作或结果
patterns.context: take 后接不定式、名词短语或其他补足语，表示采取行动、选择去向或呈现形式；出现于多种句法环境。
patterns.domain: 学术、行政、医学、技术及专利说明文

patterns.name: 专名中的 Mon
patterns.context: 植物分类学引文中的分类群名称内部；没有明显的 take 模式。
patterns.domain: 生物分类学论文及参考文献

en.description: Activations are scattered across tokenized word fragments in multiple languages: Cyrillic fragments, English mar, and fragments within Portuguese and Latvian words; there are also sporadic English fragments and activations on URL paths, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Specific characters in Cyrillic text
patterns.context: Activates in Cyrillic words; examples occur in Tatar interface text, Russian code comments, and Bulgarian body text.

patterns.name: mar in Latin-script tokenized words
patterns.context: Appears in words formed from adjacent subword fragments, such as «mar»«oon» (maroon), «mar»«athon» (marathon); also «mar»«in» (Silymarin).
patterns.domain: English forums, news URLs, medical texts

patterns.name: Portuguese word-final or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur in inflected or tokenized Portuguese words, such as volt«ava»« a» rep«et»«ir», and g«endar»«mer»«ie».

patterns.name: Long vowels and word endings within Latvian words
patterns.context: Activations occur inside tokenized Latvian words, such as anal«ī»zēs, gra«u»d«aug»«u», and «sn»iedza.

patterns.name: Words beginning with English mis-
patterns.context: Appears in English narrative or commentary; activation involves an internal fragment of a word meaning miscalculation, as well as subword fragments adjacent to missing, so the precise trigger is not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Short fragments at English token boundaries
patterns.context: Ordinary words in English prose or forum dialogue are split into multiple tokens; no shared semantics or fixed context is evident.

patterns.name: London / l-marathon in paths and words
patterns.context: Appears in news URL paths and news headline link fragments; it also matches the «mar» substring pattern, but the London path has additional activation.

patterns.name: Unexplained local high activations
patterns.context: These fragments occur in the corresponding language or code contexts but cannot be consistently explained by the patterns above.
patterns.domain: Tatar, Latvian, English narrative, and code

3_607.description: 激活分散在多语种、切分后的词片段中：含西里尔字母片段、英语mar、葡语和拉脱维亚语词内片段；另有零散英语片段及网址路径激活，缺少统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 西里尔字母文本中的特定字符
patterns.context: 在西里尔字母词语中激活；可见于鞑靼语界面文本、俄语代码注释及保加利亚语正文。

patterns.name: 拉丁字母切分词中的 mar
patterns.context: 出现在相邻子词片段组成的词中，如«mar»«oon»（maroon）、«mar»«athon»（marathon）；另有«mar»«in»（Silymarin）。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛、新闻网址、医学文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在葡萄牙语屈折或切分词中，如 volt«ava»« a» rep«et»«ir»，以及 g«endar»«mer»«ie»。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内长元音及词尾
patterns.context: 激活位于拉脱维亚语切分词内部，如 anal«ī»zēs、gra«u»d«aug»«u»、«sn»iedza。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会拉脱维亚语文本

patterns.name: 英文 mis- 开头的词
patterns.context: 出现在英语叙事或评论中；激活涉及误算词内片段，也涉及 missing 词前后邻接的分词片段，具体触发不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 维基百科叙事、论坛评论

patterns.name: 英语中分词边界处的短片段
patterns.context: 英语散文或论坛对话里的普通词被切成多个 token；没有明显共同语义或固定上下文。

patterns.name: 路径和词语中的 London / l-marathon
patterns.context: 出现在新闻 URL 路径及新闻标题链接片段中；同时符合«mar»子串模式，但London路径本身另有激活。

patterns.name: Unexplained 的局部强激活
patterns.context: 这些片段处于相应语言或代码上下文，但无法由上述模式稳定解释。
patterns.domain: 鞑靼语、拉脱维亚语、英语叙事及代码

en.concept: In-word fragments and multilingual text patterns
en.description: Activations occur in word-internal fragments, proper names, and compounds: English word fragments and names, Russian and other Cyrillic text, and rear-view, armbands, and commemorative contexts. Corpus and part-of-speech variation is substantial, with no stable syntactic or semantic condition.

patterns.name: R-syllable fragments within English words
patterns.context: The activated fragment occurs inside English words, especially words formed from multiple subword fragments; there is no obvious shared syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, forum text, legal opinions, academic papers

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Cyrillic and Russian
patterns.context: The marker falls inside Russian words written in Cyrillic, often as part of a stem or affix.

patterns.name: Cyrillic calendar-name fragments
patterns.context: The marker occurs inside words in arrays of dates or weekday names; these are also Cyrillic word-internal fragments, but the language and specific vocabulary differ from the Russian examples.
patterns.domain: Github localization code, including Turkic-language text

patterns.name: Surname fragments in compound proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on first and last names in English, especially when a first name precedes the surname.

patterns.name: Postpositive directional term in a compound noun
