patterns.context: rear view occurs together as a modifying compound followed by mirror; the same pattern is repeated in one sentence.

patterns.name: Words related to black armbands
patterns.context: Trigger words are split into tokens in contexts describing black armbands worn for mourning and commemorative days.

3_607.concept: 词内片段与多语文字模式
3_607.description: 激活分布在词内片段、专名和复合词中：既见于英文词片段及人名，也见于俄语和其他西里尔文字，还见于 rear-view、臂章与纪念语境。跨语料和词类差异明显，未见稳定句法或语义条件。

patterns.name: 英语词内的 r 音节片段
patterns.context: 激活片段出现在英文单词内部，尤其是由多个子词片段拼成的词；没有明显统一的句法条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、论坛文本、法律判例、学术论文

patterns.name: 西里尔字母及俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 标记落在西里尔字母书写的俄语词内，常是词干或词缀的一部分。

patterns.name: 西里尔字母日历名称片段
patterns.context: 标记出现在日期或星期名称数组中的词内；与俄语词内片段同属西里尔文字，但语言和具体词汇不同。
patterns.domain: Github 本地化代码，含突厥语系文字

patterns.name: 复合专名中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文人名的名和姓上，尤其姓氏之前有名。
patterns.domain: 新闻或司法记录式叙述

patterns.name: 复合名词中的后置方位词
patterns.context: rear view 紧邻构成修饰性复合词，后接 mirror；相同模式在一句中重复。

patterns.name: 黑色臂章相关词
patterns.context: 在描述佩戴黑色臂章、悼念与纪念日的语境中，触发词被拆分标记。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on intraword character or subword fragments, especially st and re-st forms; there are also names, technical terms, formula symbols, and Russian character fragments, spanning domains with weak semantic connections.

patterns.name: Subword fragments beginning with re-st
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the contiguous letter fragment st in English words; sometimes it occurs in re-st... word forms, and also in spelling fragments in proper names or quotations.

patterns.name: Fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Activations fall within names or their spellings, with no shared semantics; they may be coincidental matches at the character or subword level.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in technical vocabulary
patterns.context: Character fragments in complex chemical names or academic author names; the trigger has no clear relation to general semantics.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous letters, symbols, and formatting
patterns.context: Formula typesetting, legal document formatting, or discontinuous symbol strings; triggers may arise from glyphs or token fragments.

patterns.name: Chinese character fragments
patterns.context: Cyrillic substrings from words split into tokens in Russian sentences; ordinary English code contexts also occur.

patterns.name: Semantically scattered intraword fragments
patterns.context: Local subword activations occur in ordinary or domain-specific words, with no stable shared semantics or contextual condition.

3_607.description: 激活主要落在词内字母或子词片段，尤以 st 及 re-st 形式突出；另见姓名、专业术语、公式符号和俄语字符片段，跨领域且语义联系较弱。

patterns.name: re-st 开头的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于英文词中连续的字母片段 st；有时位于 re-st... 词形中，也出现在专名或引文中的拼写片段。

patterns.name: 人名中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名或姓名拼写内部，缺少共同语义；可能是字符/子词层面的偶然匹配。
patterns.domain: 新闻/司法叙述、医学文献

patterns.name: 专业词汇内部片段
patterns.context: 复杂化学名称或学术作者名中的字母片段，触发点与一般语义关系不明显。

patterns.name: 杂项字母、符号及格式
patterns.context: 公式排版、法律文书格式或非连续符号串；触发可能来自字形或分词片段。

patterns.name: 中文字符片段
patterns.context: 俄语句子中词语被拆分后的西里尔字母子串；同时出现普通英文代码语境。

patterns.name: 语义上零散的词内片段
patterns.context: 普通词或领域词中出现局部子词激活，未见稳定共同语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 宗教/奇幻叙述、专利文本

en.description: Activations mostly fall on short letter fragments inside words: ol, st, ét, iqu, out, cur, str. ol often occurs in words related to discoloration, and st in re- words; the rest are scattered across French terminology, scientific names, devout, and book titles.

patterns.name: In-word fragment “ol”
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words containing ol, including words describing discoloration or fading. Contexts include technical descriptions, research materials, or disease descriptions.
patterns.domain: Patents, NIH project text, PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: In-word fragment “st”
patterns.context: Appears inside words beginning with re-, referring respectively to reignition and restabilization; both have a “again…” word form, but their meanings and domains differ.

patterns.name: In-word fragment “et”
patterns.context: Inside a French technical term describing the discretization of variables; nearby text mentions dividing into intervals.

patterns.name: In-word fragment “iqu”
patterns.context: Appears inside a word in a species’ Latin scientific name, as part of its spelling.

patterns.name: In-word fragment “out”
patterns.context: Appears inside the adjective devout, describing a devout player; nearby text discusses gaming and sacrifice.

patterns.name: In-word fragment “cur”
patterns.context: Appears in a judge’s signature in a legal opinion, marking a concurring opinion.

patterns.name: In-word fragment “str”
patterns.context: Appears in the uppercase spelling of the medical dictionary title ILLUSTRATED, as part of a citation or bibliographic format.

3_607.description: 激活多落在词内部的短字母片段：ol、st、ét、iqu、out、cur、str。ol多见于变色相关词，st见于re-起始词；其余分散于法语术语、学名、devout和书名。

patterns.name: 词中片段“ol”
patterns.context: 激活落在包含 ol 的单词内部；出现于描述变色、褪色等词时。上下文可为技术说明、科研材料或疾病描述。
patterns.domain: 专利、NIH 项目文本、PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 词中片段“st”
patterns.context: 出现在以 re- 开头的词内部，分别涉及重新点燃和重新稳定；都带有“重新……”的词形，但语义与领域不同。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、化学/胶体说明

patterns.name: 词中片段“et”
patterns.context: 法语技术词内部，描述将变量离散化；邻近文本提到按区间划分。

patterns.name: 词中片段“iqu”
patterns.context: 出现在物种拉丁学名的单词内部，属于名称拼写的一部分。

patterns.name: 词中片段“out”
patterns.context: 出现在形容词 devout 内，描述虔诚的玩家；附近谈及游戏与祭献。

patterns.name: 词中片段“cur”
patterns.context: 出现在法律意见的法官署名中，标记其协同意见。

patterns.name: 词中片段“str”
patterns.context: 出现在医学词典书名 ILLUSTRATED 的大写拼写中，属于引文或书目格式。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的医学参考文献

en.concept: Mixed intraword fragments and phrase features
en.description: Activations mostly fall on internal fragments such as st in tokenized words; there are also the seems…to…be construction, rearview mirrors, Portuguese lhe, volleyball, and medical and botanical terms; a few ordinary-word activations and individual fragments lack a stable explanation.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in English words
patterns.context: Activations fall on marked internal fragments of split words, especially st; meanings and contexts vary greatly, and the marked boundaries split the word forms
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including patents, legal, medical, and academic texts

patterns.name: seems to be construction
patterns.context: seems to be occurs in evaluative or argumentative text, with activations distributed across multiple words in the phrase

patterns.name: Words related to rearview mirrors
patterns.context: Discusses automatic dimming rearview mirrors and reflectance adjustment

patterns.name: Personal pronouns and function-word fragments
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary speech, the honorific pronoun lhe is used to address the listener, along with related verb forms; activations are distributed across internal word fragments

patterns.name: beach volleyball word forms
patterns.context: Discusses clothing choices of female beach volleyball players and related controversy

patterns.name: Internal fragments in medical vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical terms such as abdominal distension, constipation, and pseudo-obstruction occur in symptom descriptions

patterns.name: Internal fragments in plant and virus names
patterns.context: Names and terms in botany or plant virus research; activations fall on fragments within tokenized words

patterns.name: Opaque function words and ordinary-word activations
patterns.context: Occur sporadically in different syntactic positions and cannot be explained by the same stable local context

3_607.concept: 混合的词内片段与短语特征
3_607.description: 激活多落在被切分词的 st 等内部片段，另有 seems…to…be 构式、后视镜、葡语 lhe、排球及医学和植物术语；少数普通词激活及个别片段无稳定解释。

patterns.name: 英文词中部的断词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标注的词内部片段，尤其是 st；词义与语境差异很大，且标注边界切分了词形
patterns.domain: 专利、法律、医学、学术等多种文体

patterns.name: seems to be 构式
patterns.context: 评价或论证文本中出现 seems to be，激活分布在该短语的多个词上

patterns.name: rearview 镜相关词
patterns.context: 讨论自动防眩后视镜及反射率调节

patterns.name: 人称代词与虚词片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会发言中，对听者使用尊称代词 lhe，并出现相关动词形式；激活分布在词内片段

patterns.name: beach volleyball 词形
patterns.context: 讨论女子沙滩排球运动员的服装选择及相关争议

patterns.name: 医学词汇中的词内片段
patterns.context: 症状描述中出现腹胀、便秘及假性肠梗阻等医学术语

patterns.name: 植物与病毒名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 植物学或植物病毒研究中的名称与术语，激活落在拆分后的词内片段

patterns.name: 不透明的功能词及普通词激活
patterns.context: 零散出现在不同句法位置，无法由同一稳定局部语境解释
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、哲学论述

en.description: Activations are primarily associated with the in-word letter fragment st/ST, occurring in re-stabilize, re-strike, and various names of people and organizations; there are also sporadic activations on iterative, debauching, and several proper-name or in-word fragments.

patterns.name: In-word segmentation of st
patterns.context: The activation marker falls on the letter fragment st/ST across word boundaries, with varying meanings and positions; some examples have re- preceding it, but this is not required.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text, academic text, legal text, email names, etc.

patterns.name: Iteration-related words
patterns.context: Code and output strings contain spellings related to reiterative/iterative; activation concentrates on in-word fragments, not only standalone words.

patterns.name: In-word fragment deb…uching
patterns.context: Appears in a legal discussion listing improper or illegal conduct; activation falls on an internal fragment of debauching.

patterns.name: Scattered fragments in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Appears in names in parental-rights cases, music titles, and Italian sentences, with no clear shared semantics or stable word-form condition.

3_607.description: 主要激活与词内 st/ST 字母片段有关，出现在 re-stabilize、re-strike 及人名、机构名等不同词中；另对 iterative、debauching 及若干专名或词内片段有零散激活。

patterns.name: 单词内部的 st 分段
patterns.context: 激活标记落在跨越词内边界的字母片段 st/ST 上，词义和位置各异；部分例子中前面有 re-，但这不是必要条件。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、学术文本、法律文本、邮件姓名等

patterns.name: 迭代相关词语
patterns.context: 代码及输出字符串中出现 reiterative/iterative 相关拼写；激活集中于词内片段，不限于独立单词。

patterns.name: deb…uching 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律论述对不当或非法行为的列举中，激活落在 debauching 的内部片段。

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的零散片段
patterns.context: 在亲权案件中的人名、音乐标题及意大利语句子中出现，未见明确共同语义或稳定的词形条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、标题、议会文本

en.description: High activation often falls on the intra-word letter fragment 「st」, and also appears in French and Portuguese intra-word fragments, uppercase place-name spellings, and English close/closed; triggers are distributed across multilingual text, proper nouns, and common words.

patterns.name: Intra-word st sequences
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intra-word fragment beginning with st, or on an internal letter sequence in a name or proper noun; the preceding word-initial or stem portion is usually needed to form a complete word.

patterns.name: French intra-word syllables or letter fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on internal letters or syllabic fragments of French words, such as «disc«r»9«ét»4isation» and «inter«vall»4es»; the context is technical descriptions of variable classification.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Portuguese proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across intra-word fragments in the name of Italian politician 「Berlusconi」 and in Portuguese phrases.

patterns.name: Uppercase letter fragments in news place names
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the chunked spelling of the uppercase place name 「BRISTOL」 in a news headline and lead.

patterns.name: The word close and related forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on the complete English word close or its inflected forms; one instance concerns a closure question in platform rules, another a close question in a legal context.

3_607.description: 高激活常落在词内字母片段「st」，也分布于法语、葡语词内片段、全大写地名拼写，以及英语 close/closed；触发分散在多语种、专名和普通词中。

patterns.name: 词内 st 序列
patterns.context: 激活落在以 st 起始的词内片段，或姓名、专名的内部字母序列中；通常需要前面的词首或词干部分共同构成完整词。

patterns.name: 法语词内音节或字母片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在法语词的内部字母或音节片段，如 «disc«r»9«ét»4isation» 和 «inter«vall»4es»；上下文是变量分类的技术说明。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语专名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在意大利政治人物姓名「Berlusconi」及葡萄牙语词组中的词内片段。

patterns.name: 新闻地名中的大写字母片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在全大写地名「BRISTOL」的分块拼写中，段落是新闻标题与导语。

patterns.name: close 词及其相关形式
patterns.context: 激活落在英语 close 的完整词或词形中；一处是平台规则中的关闭问题，一处是法律语境的 close question。

en.description: Activations are distributed across different contexts of close, several in-word fragments after tokenization, and the email symbol; except for close, the fragments span domains and lack stable semantic connections.

patterns.name: close in legal questions, votes, or reviews
patterns.context: close modifies question, vote, or examination, meaning a question is contentious, a vote is closed, or an examination is thorough; the local meaning varies by context.

patterns.name: monocl-/mon- fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on in-word fragments after tokenization; they occur in monoclonality, myoclonus, and Monkelis, with no stable shared meaning.

patterns.name: @ symbol in email addresses
patterns.context: Appears in email addresses in an Enron email recipient list.

patterns.name: In-word fragment of the legal term reconsideration
patterns.context: Activation occurs in Reconsideration in a proper-name quotation, on the tokenized fragment consider.

patterns.name: close meaning nearby in distance
patterns.context: close is used with to to describe a ball being passed near the receiver.

patterns.name: on fragment in MRI terminology
patterns.context: Inside Reson in “Reson Imaging,” as part of a reference title.

3_607.description: 激活分布在 close 的多种语境、若干分词后的词内片段及邮箱符号；除 close 外，各片段跨领域且缺少稳定语义联系。

patterns.name: close 法律问题、表决或审查
patterns.context: close 修饰 question、vote 或 examination，表达问题有争议、投票关闭，或仔细审查；局部词义依上下文变化。

patterns.name: 专名中的 monocl-/mon- 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在分词后的词内片段；分别处于 monoclonality、myoclonus 和 Monkelis 中，未见稳定共同词义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、法律文书

patterns.name: 邮箱地址的 @ 符号
patterns.context: 出现在 Enron 邮件收件人列表中的电子邮件地址。

patterns.name: 法律术语 reconsideration 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于专名引述中的 Reconsideration，分词片段 consider。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、行政决定引文

patterns.name: close 作距离近
patterns.context: close 与 to 连用，形容球传得接近接球者。

patterns.name: MRI 专业词中的 on 片段
patterns.context: 位于“Reson Imaging”中的 Reson 词内，属于参考文献标题。

en.concept: Intra-word fragment triggers, biased toward medical terminology
en.description: Activation mainly falls on medical word fragments split across tokens, especially mon-ocl-on terms related to monoclonality and myoclonus; it also appears in Spanish historical forms, colloid restabilization, legal reconsideration, and an intestinal obstruction fragment, with dispersed semantics.

patterns.name: mon-ocl-on fragments related to monoclonality
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur in medical terms related to monoclonality, antibodies, or treatment; however, the «on» in [1] is extremely strong, and near-spelling triggers in [3][5][8][9] are also strong, suggesting the response does not depend entirely on the full-word meaning.

patterns.name: Strong activation on the intra-word fragment on
patterns.context: Occurs inside words split across tokens, such as mon«ocl»«on»ality, mon«ocl»«on»als, and my«ocl»«on»us; it also appears in different forms such as trem«or». The shared fragment may be more direct than the specific terminology.

patterns.name: Lowercase initial on/ion-like fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls inside historical bibliography/Spanish word forms and chemical engineering terminology; these are not obviously semantically related to the medical monoclonal fragments.
patterns.domain: Historical bibliography; colloid chemistry in patents

patterns.name: Legal word consider-ation
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on a stem fragment of reconsideration in court opinions and legal filings requesting reconsideration.

patterns.name: st-obstruct in medical terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls inside the medical term intestinal pseudo-obstruction; its connection to the other patterns is unclear.

3_607.concept: 词内片段触发，偏医学术语
3_607.description: 激活主要落在跨 token 切分的医学词片，尤其 mon-ocl-on 单克隆相关词及 myoclonus；此外见于西语历史词形、胶体再稳定、法律 reconsideration 和肠梗阻词片，语义分散。

patterns.name: 单克隆性相关的 mon-ocl-on 词片
patterns.context: 触发词片出现在单克隆性、抗体或治疗相关医学术语中；但[1]的 «on» 极强，[3][5][8][9]的近似拼写触发也强，提示不完全依赖完整词义。

patterns.name: 词内片段 on 的强激活
patterns.context: 出现在跨 token 切分的单词内部，如 mon«ocl»«on»ality、mon«ocl»«on»als、my«ocl»«on»us；也出现在 trem«or»等不同词形中。共同片段可能比具体术语更直接。

patterns.name: 小写词首 on/ion 类片段
patterns.context: 激活落在历史书目/西班牙语词形和化学工程术语内部；与医学单克隆词片并非明显同一语义。
patterns.domain: 历史书目；专利中的胶体化学

patterns.name: 法律词语 consider-ation
patterns.context: 激活集中在 reconsideration 的词干片段，出现在法院意见及请求重新审议的法律文书中。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 st-obstruct
patterns.context: 激活落在肠道假性梗阻这一医学术语内部；与其余模式的联系不明确。

en.description: Primarily responds to tokenized word segments containing “clon,” found in medical terms such as monoclonal antibodies, clonality, and myoclonus; there are also a few activations on function words and bibliographic proper names, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: “clon” segments related to clonality
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the tokenized clon sequence; it occurs in monoclonality/monoclonals and also in myoclonus.

patterns.name: Function words in phrases
patterns.context: Occurs sporadically in ordinary syntactic contexts, without forming a unified local phrase or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Research proposals and expository text; covers[3][6]

patterns.name: Other scattered lexical items
patterns.context: Appears only in citations, proper names, or bibliographic entries, making it difficult to link to the main fragment pattern.

3_607.description: 主要响应含“clon”的拆分词段，见于单克隆抗体、克隆性及肌阵挛等医学词汇；另有少量功能词和书目专名激活，缺乏明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 克隆性相关的“clon”词段
patterns.context: 激活集中在被拆分标记的 clon 序列；既出现于 monoclonality/monoclonals，也出现于 myoclonus。

patterns.name: 短语中的功能词
patterns.context: 在普通句法环境中零星出现，未形成统一的局部短语或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 科研提案及论述性文本；覆盖[3][6]

patterns.name: 其他分散词项
patterns.context: 仅在引文或专名、书目条目中出现，难以与主要词段模式联系。
patterns.domain: 医学书目与历史书目；覆盖[9][10]

en.description: Activation is dispersed across many word forms and contexts: French reconnaître, close in legal contexts, the author surname Slonczewski, Portuguese distanciar-se, Reinforcing in a list of energy measures, and close to in sports contexts; there are also sporadic academic word fragments, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: recognize / recognizeable expressions
patterns.context: In French, the stem of the verb reconnaître is marked by tokenization; it is followed by a que-clause or a disease object.

patterns.name: close question / close examination
patterns.context: In English legal argument, discussing whether an issue is difficult to decide or closely examining testimony, affidavits, and similar material.

patterns.name: Slonczewski name spelling
patterns.context: A tokenized author surname appears in a physics paper citing their work on spin-transfer torque.

patterns.name: distanciar-se form
patterns.context: The Portuguese reflexive verb distanciar-se occurs in a discussion of EU affairs; the passage concerns the relationship between the African Union and the court.

patterns.name: Gerund list of added policy measures
patterns.context: Appears in a sequence of parallel items beginning with Adding, describing energy use and infrastructure policy measures.

patterns.name: Spatial-proximity use of close
patterns.context: A sports narrative describes a ball approaching a group of children; this differs from the close question/examination uses in legal texts.

patterns.name: Truncated or other word fragments
patterns.context: Materials and nanowire terminology, author names, and other items are tokenized in papers; paragraph 1 also contains word fragments related to pollution sources and raw materials, but no clear, consistent trigger condition emerges.
patterns.domain: Materials science papers, European Parliament texts

3_607.description: 激活分散在多种词形与场景：法语 reconnaître、法律语境的 close、作者姓氏 Slonczewski、葡语 distanciar-se、能源措施列表中的 Reinforcing，以及体育语境的 close to；另有零散学术词片段，未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: recognize / recognizeable 表达
patterns.context: 法语中动词 reconnaître 的词干被切分标记；后接 que 从句或疾病宾语。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本、医学论文

patterns.name: close question / close examination
patterns.context: 英语法律论证中，讨论问题是否难以判断，或对证言、宣誓等进行仔细审查。

patterns.name: Slonczewski 姓名拼写
patterns.context: 物理论文中出现被切分的作者姓氏，介绍自旋转移力矩时引用其工作。

patterns.name: distanciar-se 词形
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语反身动词 distanciar-se，处于欧盟事务讨论中；此处谈非洲联盟与法庭的关系。

patterns.name: 添加政策措施的动名词列表
patterns.context: 与 Adding 开头的并列条目连续出现，描述能源使用与基础设施政策措施。

patterns.name: close 的空间邻近用法
patterns.context: 体育叙述中描述球接近一群儿童；与法律文本的 close question/examination 用法不同。

patterns.name: 残缺或其他词片段
patterns.context: 论文中材料与纳米线术语、作者名等被切分；第1段另有污染来源和原料相关词片段，但没有形成清楚一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 材料科学论文、欧盟议会文本

en.concept: Subword and formatting fragments in academic text
en.description: Activations are scattered across subword fragments in academic text, including multilingual word forms, medical terms, proper names, citation punctuation, and common English words. Citation formatting is prominent but cannot explain all examples.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and punctuation in scientific citation formats
patterns.context: Near references or in-text citations, especially formatted text such as journal names, volume and page numbers, author initials, and years; strong activations occur within punctuation and abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, patent, and academic paper citations

patterns.name: Spanish word-form fragments
patterns.context: Words are split into subword fragments in continuous Spanish text; activation falls within words or inflectional endings, near Spanish grammar and cited names.

patterns.name: Portuguese and historical proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Tokenized word fragments occur in Portuguese historical book titles, names, and proper-name contexts.

patterns.name: In-word subwords in medical terminology
patterns.context: Activates when terms or anatomical names are split into multiple subwords in English medical abstracts; the specific terms differ across passages.

patterns.name: Syllabic fragments within proper names
patterns.context: A Polish surname is split into multiple subwords in a physics paper; strong activation concentrates inside the surname.

patterns.name: Common word fragments in English academic prose
patterns.context: Specific subword fragments of common function words or academic verbs are marked in English expository sentences; triggers are scattered, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in patent text
patterns.context: An inventor’s or author’s surname is split in a patent citation; patent numbers, technical terms, and citation formats also occur, but activations primarily fall on name fragments.

3_607.concept: 学术文本中的子词与格式片段
3_607.description: 激活分散在学术文本中的子词片段：包括多语种词形、医学术语、专名，以及引文标点和英语常用词；引文格式较突出，但无法解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 科学论文引文格式中的缩写与标点
patterns.context: 参考文献或文内引用附近，尤其是期刊名、卷页、作者缩写及年份等格式化文本；标点和缩写内部出现强激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利及学术论文引文

patterns.name: 西班牙语词形片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语连续文本中，词被拆成子词片段；激活落在词内或屈折词尾，附近有西班牙语语法及人名引用。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语哲学学术文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语及历史专名片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语历史书名、人名及专名语境，激活位于被拆分的词片段。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语历史书目/百科文本

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词内子词
patterns.context: 英文医学摘要中，术语或解剖名称被切成多个子词时激活；不同段落中的具体术语并不相同。
patterns.domain: 神经生理学与肿瘤学摘要

patterns.name: 专名内部的音节片段
patterns.context: 物理学论文中，波兰姓氏被拆分为多个子词；强激活集中在姓氏内部。

patterns.name: 英语学术表达中的常用词片段
patterns.context: 英文论述句中，常见功能词或学术动词的特定子词片段被标记；触发分散，未显示稳定的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与数学/机器学习论文

patterns.name: 专利文本中的专名片段
patterns.context: 专利引用中，发明人或作者姓氏被拆分；另有专利编号、技术术语与引文格式，但激活主要落在人名片段。

en.description: Activation often falls on the string on after tokenization, including in monoclonal/monoclonality, Resonance, proper nouns, and email addresses, as well as the common preposition on; there is also an isolated activation on a French word fragment.

patterns.name: Monoclonal/monoclonal word forms
patterns.context: Occurs in terms related to monoclonality, antibodies, or immunoglobulins; the word itself may be split by tokenization.

patterns.name: on in magnetic resonance terminology
patterns.context: Embedded in “Resonance,” with surrounding text about MRI or magnetic resonance imaging/medicine.

patterns.name: The string on inside English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter fragments in proper nouns or email addresses, rather than on an obviously independent semantic word.

patterns.name: on in continuous narrative text
patterns.context: Used as a preposition in descriptions of scenery, followed by a place or surface.

patterns.name: French word-final or intra-word fragment
patterns.context: In French sentences about unsupervised analysis and clustering, activation falls on tokenized fragments of words such as “découvrir”.

3_607.description: 激活常落在分词后的 on 字符串：包括 monoclonal/monoclonality、Resonance、专名和邮箱，也见普通介词 on；另有法语词片段的孤立激活。

patterns.name: 单克隆／monoclonal 词形
patterns.context: 出现在单克隆性、抗体或免疫球蛋白相关术语中；词本身可能被分词切开。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、肿瘤学与免疫学论文

patterns.name: 磁共振术语中的 on
patterns.context: 嵌在“Resonance”中，周围涉及 MRI 或磁共振成像／医学。

patterns.name: 英文词内 on 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或邮箱地址中的字母片段，并非明显的独立语义词。

patterns.name: on 与连续叙事文本
patterns.context: 作为介词出现在景物描写中，后接地点或表面。

patterns.name: 法语词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 在法语关于无监督分析与聚类的句子中，激活落在“découvrir”等词的分词片段。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on monoclonal/monoclonality forms in biomedical text and myoclonus-related terminology fragments in neurology; there are also sporadic activations on fragments in a Portuguese book title, French exclure, and the name Clontech.

patterns.name: Monoclonality and antibodies
patterns.context: Biomedical text discusses IgH gene rearrangements, tumor clonality, or the localization and specificity of monoclonal antibodies; activation concentrates on tokenized fragments of monoclonal forms.

patterns.name: Myoclonus-related terminology
patterns.context: Neurology text mentions myoclonus, myoclonus-dystonia, or related movement symptoms; some activations fall on tokenized terms’ internal fragments.
patterns.domain: Clinical neurology and NIH research text

patterns.name: Portuguese historical bibliographic word form
patterns.context: The word “descobrimento” (discovery) is tokenized in a Portuguese book title; observed in only one bibliographic record so far.

patterns.name: French word ending and exclusion expression
patterns.context: A French sentence contains an expression meaning “does not rule out…”; activation concentrates on a verb-ending fragment and appears unrelated to the neurological terminology pattern.

patterns.name: Cloning technology name
patterns.context: When Clontech is mentioned in connection with gene expression or microarray services, activation falls on a fragment within the company name.

3_607.concept: 生物医学词形片段识别
3_607.description: 激活主要落在生物医学文本中的 monoclonal/monoclonality 词形及神经病学的 myoclonus 相关术语片段；另有葡语书名、法语 exclure 和 Clontech 名称中的零星片段激活。

patterns.name: 单克隆性及抗体
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中讨论 IgH 基因重排、肿瘤克隆性，或单克隆抗体的定位与特异性；激活集中在被拆分的 monoclonal 词形片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed/NIH 生物医学摘要与论文

patterns.name: 肌阵挛相关术语
patterns.context: 神经病学文本中出现肌阵挛、肌阵挛-肌张力障碍或相关运动症状时；部分激活落在术语内部的拆分 token 上。
patterns.domain: 临床神经病学与 NIH 研究文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语历史书目词形
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语书名中“descobrimento”（发现）一词被拆分时；目前只见于一条书目记录。

patterns.name: 法语词尾及排除表达
patterns.context: 法语句子中出现“不排除……”的表达；激活集中在动词词尾片段，和神经医学术语模式无明显联系。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会法语政治文本

patterns.name: 克隆技术名称
patterns.context: 提及 Clontech 的基因表达或微阵列服务时，激活落在公司名内部片段。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究经费/设备说明

en.description: The most stable commonality is activation on intra-word character fragments such as on/clon, cl, and ar, especially alongside clone-related vocabulary; however, it also covers common French words and other sporadic token fragments, with limited semantic selectivity.

patterns.name: on/onal character fragments
patterns.context: Activation often falls on character fragments inside English or French words; examples include monocl«on»ality, Cl«on»tech, uncl«on»able, Mal«on» et, as well as unrelated forms such as dé«cl»«ar»ations and ex«cl»«ure». A complete word or fixed meaning is not required.
patterns.domain: Cross-corpus; medicine, biology, technology, patents, French parliamentary texts, and Q&A

patterns.name: Molecular cloning and monoclonal antibody vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in words describing monoclonality, monoclonal antibodies, clone-derived reagents, or unclonable devices; trigger locations vary, but the shared strings on/clon are common.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, laboratory equipment, and computer security

patterns.name: Intra-word letter fragments in French
patterns.context: Activation is embedded inside common French words; paragraph 2 is in a parliamentary-procedure context, and paragraph 3 in an economic commentary context.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary texts and European economic commentary

patterns.name: Local spelling or tokenization-boundary patterns
patterns.context: Besides the main character fragments, activation also occurs at word beginnings, hyphens, or inter-word token fragments; no stable semantic condition can be identified from the fragments.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, research project texts, French parliamentary texts

3_607.description: 最稳定的共同点是激活落在 on/clon、cl、ar 等词内字符片段，尤其与克隆词汇相伴；但也覆盖普通法语词及其他零散分词片段，语义选择性有限。

patterns.name: on/onal 字符片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在英语或法语词中间的字符片段；可见于 monocl«on»ality、Cl«on»tech、uncl«on»able、Mal«on» et，也落在 dé«cl»«ar»ations 和 ex«cl»«ure» 等不相关词形中。并不要求完整单词或固定语义。
patterns.domain: 跨语料；医学、生物、科技、专利、法语议会文本及问答

patterns.name: 分子克隆与单克隆抗体词汇
patterns.context: 出现在描述单克隆性、单克隆抗体、克隆来源试剂或不可克隆设备的词中；触发位置各异，但常见共享字串 on/clon。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、实验设备与计算机安全

patterns.name: 法语词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活嵌在普通法语词的内部；段2为议会程序语境，段3为经济评论语境。
patterns.domain: 法语议会文本与欧洲经济评论

patterns.name: 局部拼写或分词边界模式
patterns.context: 除主要字符片段外，激活也出现在词首、连字符或词间分词片段上，无法从片段中确认稳定语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研项目文本、法语议会文本

en.description: Most passages activate on within words, especially clon-/monoclon-related words, but also Malon and Fenclonine. There is also ar within the French word déclarations, as well as sporadic fragment activations in disease names.

patterns.name: on substring inside English words
patterns.context: Activation centers on the consecutive letters on within words; these words mostly have Clon, clon, or monocl... as a stem, and also include the proper name Malon. Capitalization varies, and some examples also mark adjacent fragments.
patterns.domain: Biomedical texts, laboratory materials, and patents; also proper names

patterns.name: Fragment containing ar in a French word
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the in-word fragment ar in French déclarations, in the context of parliamentary speeches and meeting agendas; this differs from the on pattern in other passages.

patterns.name: Other in-word fragment activations
patterns.context: In medical titles, activation is scattered across several in-word substrings of the ophthalmic disease name Cl(o)acal exstrophy; it cannot be fully categorized as an on-substring pattern.

3_607.description: 多数段落在不同词中激活词内 on，尤其是 clon-/monoclon-相关词，但也见于 Malon、Fenclonine。另有法语 déclarations 的 ar，以及疾病名中的零散片段激活。

patterns.name: 英文单词内部的 on 子串
patterns.trigger: 分段 1 的“Cl«on»10tech”、2 的“Cl«on»10idine”、3 的“cl«on»10ality”、4 的“Cl«on»10tech”、5 的“Mal«on»9”、7 的“monocl«on»9«als»3”、8 的“Fen«cl»2«on»9ine”、9 的“monocl«on»9«als»3”
patterns.context: 激活集中在词内连续字母 on；这些词多以 Clon、clon 或 monocl... 为词干，也包括专名 Malon。大小写不一，部分例子还标记了相邻片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、实验材料与专利文本；也包括专名

patterns.name: 法语词中包含 ar 的片段
patterns.context: 激活位于法语 déclarations 的词内片段 ar，处在议会发言与会议议程语境；与其他段的 on 模式不同。

patterns.name: 其他词内片段激活
patterns.context: 在医学标题中，激活分散于眼科疾病名 Cl(o)acal exstrophy 的若干词内子串；不能完全归为 on 子串模式。

en.concept: Letter strings containing ar and proper-name fragments
en.description: Activation is concentrated in character fragments ar in proper nouns or inside words: Clonidine, Clontech, Clarice, Clarke, Cloutier, cited author Clarke, and French déclarations; trigger boundaries and semantics are inconsistent.

patterns.name: clonidine / Clontech strings
patterns.context: The consecutive character fragment Cl-on occurs in proper nouns, mainly drug names or biotechnology company names.

patterns.name: Clar in English names Clarke/Clarice
patterns.context: Proper nouns in personal names or book titles; activation is concentrated on the initial Clar string.
patterns.domain: Bibliography, sports reporting, academic citations, email, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in French déclarations
patterns.context: In formal French parliamentary procedure texts, the complete word déclarations is tokenized, and activation falls on the intra-word ar segment.

patterns.name: Clout in the name Cloutier
patterns.context: The name Cloutier in Canadian hockey coverage; the trigger fragment differs from English Clar/Clarke.

3_607.concept: 含 ar 的字母串及专名片段
3_607.description: 激活多集中于专名或词内的字符片段 ar：Clonidine、Clontech、Clarice、Clarke、Cloutier、引文作者 Clarke，以及法语 déclarations；触发边界和语义并不一致。

patterns.name: clonidine / Clontech 字符串
patterns.context: 专名中出现连续字符片段 Cl-on，主要涉及药名或生物技术公司名
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研设备描述

patterns.name: 英文 Clarke/Clarice 名称中的 Clar
patterns.trigger: «Cl»«ar»；后续常接«ke»，形成 Clarke；另见 Clarice
patterns.context: 人名或书名中的专名，激活集中在名称开头的 Clar 字符串
patterns.domain: 书目、体育报道、学术引文、邮件及百科条目

patterns.name: 法语 déclarations 中的词内片段
patterns.context: 法语正式议会程序文本中，完整词 déclarations 被分段标记，激活落在词内 ar 部分

patterns.name: Cloutier 人名中的 Clout
patterns.context: 加拿大冰球报道中的人名 Cloutier；触发片段与英文 Clar/Clarke 不同

en.description: Strong activations mostly fall on local letter fragments within proper names, technical terms, or common words, such as Clontech, clonidine, Fenclonine, and unclonable. Other activation locations are scattered across texts containing Cytoscape, Clarke, Karageorgiou, CLINTON, and other strings, with no unified semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation of Clontech
patterns.context: The fragment on occurs within a proper name or compound name; adjacent letters are not necessarily marked, and there is no evidence that activation is limited to complete words.
patterns.domain: Biomedical texts, research equipment, and chemical names

patterns.name: Fragment in unclonable
patterns.context: on occurs in an English word beginning with un- and ending with -able; the two contexts differ, referring respectively to unclonable devices in cryptography and unclimbed mountains in mountaineering records.

patterns.name: on within other English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on local substrings in different words, with no shared meaning or stable contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Research methods, physics, sports biographies, legal judgments

3_607.description: 强激活多落在专名、术语或普通词内部的局部字母片段，如 Clontech、clonidine、Fenclonine、unclonable；其余激活位置分散在 Cytoscape、Clarke、Karageorgiou、CLINTON 等文本中，缺乏统一语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: Clontech 拆分子词
patterns.context: 片段 on 位于专名或化合物名称内部；相邻字母未必被标记，且没有显示出只对完整单词激活的证据。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、科研设备与化学名称

patterns.name: unclonable 中的片段
patterns.context: on 位于以 un- 开头、以 -able 结尾的英文词中；两处语境不同，分别指密码学中不可克隆的设备和登山记录中的未攀登山峰。

patterns.name: 其他英文词内部的 on
patterns.trigger: 「Cyt«os»？」「Cl«ue»8GO」并非共同触发；较明确的片段是「Cl«ar»8ke」中的「ar」及「Kar」「V«l»8achos」「CL«INT»8ON」中的局部字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同词的局部子串上，未见共同词义或稳定上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 科研方法、物理学、体育传记、法律判决

en.description: Activations are scattered within word forms across different domains: Clonidine, Clontech, déclarations, Clark(e), Clooney, unclonable, and Vlachos. Most center on proper names and word forms containing cl/on or similar letter fragments, with no stable semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: Clonidine drug name
patterns.context: The drug name Clonidine appears in pharmacology or medical abstracts, especially in titles or at the beginning of a sentence; activation centers on the on fragment within the name.

patterns.name: Cloning-related biotechnology name
patterns.context: The brand name Clontech appears in contexts such as gene expression, laboratory equipment, or molecular biology methods.
patterns.domain: NIH research resources, PubMed Central experimental materials

patterns.name: French word form déclarations
patterns.context: The plural noun déclarations appears in French parliamentary records, often in formal agenda or speech contexts such as “les déclarations du...”.

patterns.name: Clark surname citations
patterns.context: In English academic texts, Clark(e) appears as an author surname in parenthetical citations; activation mainly falls on the ar substring.

patterns.name: Clooney surname
patterns.context: The surname of actor George Clooney appears in film descriptions, with activation on o.

patterns.name: clone root in unclonable
patterns.context: Describes devices that cannot be cloned in cryptography or security discussions; activation falls on the on portion of the clone root.

patterns.name: Vlachos surname fragment
patterns.context: The name Vlachos appears in a sports career narrative, with activation on characters near la within the word.

3_607.concept: 含 cl/on 的词形片段
3_607.description: 激活分散在不同领域的词形内部：Clonidine、Clontech、déclarations、Clark(e)、Clooney、unclonable、Vlachos。多数集中于含 cl/on 或相近字母片段的专名与词形，未见稳定的语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: Clonidine 药物名称
patterns.context: 药理或医学摘要中出现药物名 Clonidine，尤其在题目或句首；激活集中在名称内部的 on 片段。

patterns.name: 克隆相关生物技术名称
patterns.context: 基因表达、实验设备或分子生物学方法等语境中，出现 Clontech 品牌名。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究资源、PubMed Central 实验材料

patterns.name: 法语 déclarations 词形
patterns.context: 法语议会记录中出现复数名词 déclarations，常处于“les déclarations du...”一类正式议程或发言语境。

patterns.name: Clark 姓氏引文
patterns.context: 英语学术文本中，Clark(e) 作为作者姓氏出现在括号式文献引用中；激活主要落在 ar 子串。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及参考文献

patterns.name: Clooney 姓氏
patterns.context: 影视介绍中出现演员 George Clooney 的姓氏，激活落在 o。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的电影介绍

patterns.name: unclonable 中的 clone 词根
patterns.context: 密码学或安全讨论中描述无法克隆的设备；激活落在 clone 词根的 on 部分。

patterns.name: Vlachos 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 体育人物生涯叙述中出现人名 Vlachos，激活落在词内的 la 附近字符。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on strings containing the letter fragment “on”: clonidine, monoclonality/monoclonals, Clontech, and unclonable, as well as an initial fragment in Karageorgiou; it spans domains and favors local word forms rather than a unified meaning.

patterns.name: clonidine and related drug names
patterns.context: The “clon” or “clonidine” fragment inside a drug name; appears in titles or medication lists.

patterns.name: Monoclonal-related words
patterns.context: In words such as “monoclonality” or “monoclonals,” activation falls on the intra-word “on” fragment.

patterns.name: Clontech brand name
patterns.context: Occurs in the brand name Clontech in descriptions of reagents, expression systems, or laboratory services.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology methods and equipment descriptions

patterns.name: Word fragment in unclonable
patterns.context: Occurs in a cryptography context, referring to an unclonable trusted device; not a biomedical meaning.

patterns.name: Name fragment in Karageorgiou
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of a name in a narrative about a football coach’s career.

3_607.description: 激活集中于包含字母片段“on”的字符串：clonidine、monoclonality/monoclonals、Clontech、unclonable，另有 Karageorgiou 的词首片段；跨领域，偏向局部词形而非统一语义。

patterns.name: clonidine及相关药名
patterns.context: 药名内部的“clon”或“clonidine”片段；出现在标题或药品清单中
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、化学试剂记录

patterns.name: 单克隆相关词
patterns.context: “monoclonality”或“monoclonals”等词中，激活落在词内的“on”片段
patterns.domain: 肿瘤学、免疫学及研究计划

patterns.name: Clontech 品牌名
patterns.context: 出现在试剂、表达系统或实验服务的品牌名称 Clontech 中
patterns.domain: 分子生物学方法与设备描述

patterns.name: unclonable 中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在密码学语境中，指无法克隆的可信设备；并非生物医学含义

patterns.name: Karageorgiou 姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在足球教练生涯叙述中的人名开头

en.description: All passages are U.S. case citations or nearby body text. Stable cues include v. between case-party names and the accompanying S. Ct. and L. Ed. citation formats; punctuation, page numbers, and a few body-text words also show sporadic activation.

patterns.name: v in case names
patterns.context: Appears between the names of two litigants, often following a case name with marked subword fragments and preceding a period and the defendant's name; activation is not always limited to v, as other parts of the case name also activate.

patterns.name: S. Ct. reporter marker in case citations
patterns.context: Appears in U.S. Supreme Court citations, after U.S. volume and page information and before L. Ed. information; activation is scattered across punctuation, abbreviations, and page-number fragments.

patterns.name: L. Ed. reporter marker in case citations
patterns.context: Appears in complete U.S. case citations, often alongside S. Ct., the year, and U.S. page numbers; multiple markers and page-number digits can activate.

patterns.name: Year and parentheses after citations
patterns.context: Appears near the year in parentheses at the end of a case citation; only some passages show clear activation.

patterns.name: Whitespace or line breaks after citations
patterns.context: Appears near the end of a citation or paragraph, with no clear lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Specific word fragments in citations
patterns.context: These word fragments each occur in only an individual case discussion and have no stable shared local syntactic condition; they may be sporadic activations in body text surrounding citations.

3_607.description: 所有片段均为美国判例引证或其邻近正文。稳定线索是案名间的 v. 及并列的 S. Ct.、L. Ed. 引证格式；标点、页码、年份和少数正文词也有零散激活。

patterns.name: 判例名称中的 v
patterns.context: 出现在两个诉讼当事人名称之间，常跟随被拆分标记的案名，后接句点和被告方名称；并非每次都只激活 v，案名其他部分也有激活。

patterns.name: 判例引证中的 S. Ct. 标记
patterns.context: 出现在美国最高法院判例引证中，位于 U.S. 卷页信息后、L. Ed. 信息前；激活散布于标点、缩写和页码片段。

patterns.name: 判例引证中的 L. Ed. 标记
patterns.context: 出现在完整的美国判例引证中，常与 S. Ct.、年份及 U.S. 页码并列；多个标记和页码数字都可激活。

patterns.name: 引证后年份与括号
patterns.context: 出现在判例引证末尾的年份括号附近；仅部分段落明显激活。

patterns.name: 引证后的空白或换行
patterns.trigger: 引证结束后的空格、换行，或孤立的“«9»”
patterns.context: 出现在引证或段落结束附近，缺乏明确词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 引证中的特定词语碎片
patterns.context: 这些词碎片各只见于个别判例论述语境，没有稳定共同的局部句法条件；可能是引证周围正文中的零散激活。

en.description: Responses are scattered, with a clear bias toward digits, punctuation, and segmented fragments in citations, references, and legal case formats. Also observed are in-word fragments in Portuguese and the in-word on in the drug name clonidine; no stable single semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: “10” in patent/legal report citations
patterns.context: Local tokenized fragments in numbers, volume and page numbers, case citations, or reference entries; activation often falls on 10 or a segmented token containing 10
patterns.domain: Academic references, legal case citations, patent background references

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Portuguese
patterns.context: Words are segmented in Portuguese text, with activation on in-word substrings; the context discusses the translation and discussion of a book
patterns.domain: Philosophy book review or course description

patterns.name: In-word fragment in the drug name clonidine
patterns.context: The drug name is segmented, with activation on on in clonidine; occurs in the title and the beginning of the body text

patterns.name: Unexplained trailing numeric fragments in entries
patterns.context: Numbers occur in page numbers or citations in legal case citations, but activation does not consistently fall on the same character sequence; may be related to tokenization of citation numbers

patterns.name: Unexplained reference-format fragments
patterns.context: Appears near author, journal, or publication information in references; may be a local response to citation formatting or segmentation of numbers and punctuation, and cannot be explained by thematic semantics alone

3_607.description: 响应较分散，明显偏向引文、参考文献及法律判例格式中的数字、标点和被切分片段；也见于葡语词内片段及药物名 clonidine 的词内 on，未显示稳定的单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 专利/法律报告引文中的“10”
patterns.context: 数字、卷页码、判例引文或参考文献条目中的局部 token 化片段；激活常落在 10 或包含 10 的切分 token 上
patterns.domain: 学术参考文献、法律判例引注、专利背景文献

patterns.name: 葡语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语文本中词语被切分，激活落在词内子串；上下文谈论一本书的翻译与讨论

patterns.name: 药物名 clonidine 的词内片段
patterns.context: 药物名称被切分，激活落在 clonidine 中的 on；出现在标题及正文开头

patterns.name: 未充分解释的条目尾部数字片段
patterns.context: 数字位于法律判例引文的页码或引注中，但激活并非稳定落在同一字符序列；可能与引文数字的 token 化有关

patterns.name: 未充分解释的参考文献格式片段
patterns.context: 在文献作者、期刊或出版信息附近出现，可能是引文格式或数字/标点切分的局部响应，无法由主题语义单独解释
patterns.domain: 医学及天体物理学参考文献

en.description: Responses mainly involve recurring reporter abbreviations, the connector v., and their numeric subword fragments in U.S. case citations; there are also isolated activations on “to be” in body text and on several name substrings.

patterns.name: “L. Ed. 2d” citation format
patterns.context: In U.S. case citations, the reporter abbreviation L. Ed. 2d is segmented into multiple tokens; each passage includes high activation on the “Ed” and “2d” portions.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal judgments and case citations

patterns.name: “S. Ct.” citation format
patterns.context: In U.S. case citations, the Supreme Court reporter abbreviation S. Ct. appears next to volume and page numbers or citation information.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal judgments and case citations

patterns.name: “v.” in case citations
patterns.context: The connector v. between party names in a case name; often appears with reporter abbreviations such as U.S., S. Ct., and L. Ed. 2d.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal judgments and case citations

patterns.name: Numeric and abbreviation subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur when volume numbers, page numbers, years, or reporter numbers in a citation are segmented into multiple tokens within a standard case citation structure.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal judgments and case citations

patterns.name: “to be” in legal argumentation
patterns.context: In ordinary judgment body text, the phrase “to be” states the nature of or makes a judgment about something; activation there is markedly higher than on surrounding words.

patterns.name: Unusual name fragments in case names
patterns.context: Surnames in cited case names are split into subword tokens; these sporadic name fragments activate but do not clearly form a shared semantic category.

patterns.name: “Kwok” fragment in a case name
patterns.context: Appears as part of a litigant's name in the citation “Cheng Fan Kwok v. I.N.S.”.

patterns.name: “aro” fragment in a case name
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a truncated case-name citation, with insufficient context to determine an independent pattern.

3_607.description: 主要响应美国判例引注中反复出现的报告集缩写、v.连接词及其数字分词片段；另有正文“to be”和若干姓名子串的孤立激活。

patterns.name: “L. Ed. 2d”引注格式
patterns.context: 美国判例引注中，报告集缩写 L. Ed. 2d 被拆分为多个 token；各段同时出现高激活的“Ed”及“2d”部分。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与判例引注

patterns.name: “S. Ct.”引注格式
patterns.context: 美国判例引注中，最高法院报告集缩写 S. Ct. 紧邻卷页码或引用信息出现。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与判例引注

patterns.name: 判例引注中的“v.”
patterns.context: 当事人名称之间的判例名称连接词 v.；常与 U.S.、S. Ct.、L. Ed. 2d 等报告集缩写共同出现。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与判例引注

patterns.name: 数字与缩写的分词片段
patterns.context: 引注中卷号、页码、年份或报告集编号被切分成多个 token 时，若处在标准判例引注结构中会有激活。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与判例引注

patterns.name: 法律论证中的“to be”
patterns.context: 普通判决正文中，短语“to be”用于陈述某事的性质或判断；该处激活明显高于周边词。

patterns.name: 案件名称中的非常规姓名片段
patterns.context: 引注案件名称中的姓氏被分词拆开；这些零散姓名片段有激活，但并不明显构成共同语义类别。

patterns.name: 案件名称中的“Kwok”片段
patterns.context: 作为判例当事人姓名的一部分，出现在“Cheng Fan Kwok v. I.N.S.”引注中。

patterns.name: 案件名称中的“aro”片段
patterns.context: 出现在被截断的案件名称引注开头，缺乏足够上下文确定其独立规律。

en.concept: Word forms and citation fragments in academic texts
en.description: Activation mainly falls on the discuss/discutir stem and on citation abbreviations, punctuation, and number formats in biomedical literature; there is also an isolated response to on in the name Fenclonine. The passages span philosophy, law, parliamentary, medical, and patent corpora.

patterns.name: Stem of the English verb discuss
patterns.context: Occurs in verb forms expressing discussion or argument, or stating that an issue is discussed; the stem may be split across multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Philosophy papers, European Parliament texts; also legal texts discussing semantics

patterns.name: Biomedical paper citation format
patterns.context: Abbreviations, punctuation, and number combinations in references or journal publication details, especially journal names, volume/page numbers, and copyright lines.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, patent background sections, and academic citations

patterns.name: Chemical name Fenclonine
patterns.context: An intra-word fragment of the compound name Fenclonine, adjacent to experimental material purity, batch numbers, and chemical names.

3_607.concept: 学术文本中的词形与引文片段
3_607.description: 激活主要落在 discuss/discutir 词干，以及生物医学文献的引文缩写、标点和数字格式；另对 Fenclonine 名称中的 on 有孤立响应。各段分布于哲学、法律、议会、医学和专利语料。

patterns.name: 英语动词 discuss 的词干
patterns.context: 出现在句中表达讨论、争辩或某事项被讨论的动词形式中；词干会跨分词边界拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文、欧盟议会文本；也见于法律文本中讨论语义的语境

patterns.name: 生物医学论文引文格式
patterns.trigger: «J»、«.»、«et»、«al»、«Inc»及期刊/卷页/年份附近的标记，如 «;»、«10»、«14»
patterns.context: 参考文献或期刊出版信息的缩写、标点和数字组合，尤其是期刊名、卷页码与版权行。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、专利背景及学术文献引文

patterns.name: Fenclonine 化学名称
patterns.context: 化合物名称 Fenclonine 的词内片段，紧邻实验材料纯度、批号和化学名称。
patterns.domain: 生化实验材料/方法文本

en.description: Activations often fall on in-word subword fragments: prominent examples include reporter abbreviations, volume and page numbers, and statutory formats in U.S. case citations. Also observed are multilingual word forms, ordinary legal body-text words, bibliographic publication information, and a few formatting symbols; no single semantic theme emerges.

patterns.name: In-word fragments and inflectional word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on in-word fragments across subword boundaries; in 1 and 3, the relevant words are Portuguese/Spanish forms appearing in sentences. In 2, it is part of an English phrase. The trigger is not a complete-word boundary.
patterns.domain: Multilingual academic texts and legal argumentation

patterns.name: Statutory abbreviations and numbers in U.S. case citations
patterns.context: Appears in fixed U.S. case citation formats, especially volume and page numbers and edition abbreviations for the Supreme Court Reporter and Lawyers’ Edition; activation falls on abbreviation or numeric subword fragments.

patterns.name: Bibliographic identifiers and publication information
patterns.context: Appears in bibliographies or journal publication information, including years, page numbers, and publishers; not all instances are legal citations.
patterns.domain: Academic bibliographies, journal articles, and publication information

patterns.name: Ordinary English function words and semantic phrase fragments
patterns.context: Ordinary English words are marked as segmented in sentences or phrases in legal body text; these words alone do not reveal stable semantic trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Text structure symbols
patterns.context: Appears near line breaks or paragraph boundaries in legal texts; may relate to numbering or formatting, but evidence is limited.

patterns.name: Medical term fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in pathology abstracts and journal citations; triggers are distributed across medical descriptions and publication information, with no unified medical semantic feature.

3_607.description: 激活多落在词内子词片段：突出美国判例引证中的 reporter 缩写、卷页数字及法条格式；另见多语种词形、普通法律正文词、书目出版信息和少量排版符号，未形成单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 切分词内与词形屈折片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨子词切分的词内片段上；在1、3中，相关词是葡萄牙语/西班牙语形式，出现在句中；2中为英语短语的一部分。触发点并非完整词边界。
patterns.domain: 多语种学术文本及法律论述

patterns.name: 美国判例引证中的法条缩写与编号
patterns.context: 出现在美国判例引证的固定格式中，尤其是 Supreme Court Reporter、Lawyers’ Edition 的卷页与版本缩写；激活落在缩写或数字子词片段。

patterns.name: 文献标识符和出版信息
patterns.context: 出现在书目或期刊出版信息中，包括年份、页码、出版方等；并非都属于法律引证。
patterns.domain: 学术书目、期刊论文及出版信息

patterns.name: 普通英语功能词及语义短语片段
patterns.context: 法律论述正文中，普通英语词语在句法或短语中被切分标记；单凭这些词难以归纳出稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 文本结构符号
patterns.context: 出现在法律文本的换行或段落边界附近；可能与编号或格式有关，独立证据有限。

patterns.name: 医学术语片段
patterns.context: 病理学摘要及期刊引文中；触发分布于医学描述与出版信息，未见统一的医学语义特征。

en.description: Mainly responds to dense academic and legal citation formats, especially reporter abbreviations, volume and page numbers, and punctuation in U.S. cases; also responds to fixed function-word phrases in judgment reasoning and identifiers in medical/biomedical references.

patterns.name: Statutory reporter abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in U.S. case citations and includes court reporter names, volume and page numbers, years, or case-name abbreviations; activation often falls on numeric fragments, abbreviation internals, and punctuation such as periods and commas

patterns.name: Fixed grammatical phrases in legal argumentation
patterns.context: In judgment body text, when arguing, evaluating claims, or describing proceedings; activation centers on function words in phrases or nearby, rather than being limited to legal citations

patterns.name: Identifiers in medical paper publication information
patterns.context: In references or journal volume and page information in medical abstracts, activation falls on page-number fragments and nearby publication labels

patterns.name: Biomedical reference numbers
patterns.context: In references to biomedical papers in patent background sections, number strings form part of page ranges

3_607.description: 主要响应密集的学术与法律引文格式，尤其美国判例中的报告缩写、卷页数字和标点；也响应判决论证里的固定功能词短语，以及医学/生物医学文献出处中的编号。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的法典报告缩写
patterns.trigger: “S.Ct.”、“L.Ed.2d”、“U.S.”、“v.”及其相邻引文中的卷页、年份和标点；尤其如“L.Ed.2d 1081 (2007)”
patterns.context: 出现在美国判例引证中，包含法院报告名称、卷号页码、年份或案件名缩写；激活常落在数字片段、缩写内部及句点、逗号等标点上

patterns.name: 法律论证中的固定语法短语
patterns.trigger: “to be”，以及“seems to us to be”；另有“fails to cite to the record”
patterns.context: 判决正文中论证、评价主张或描述诉讼程序时；激活集中在短语中的功能词或其附近，而非仅限法律引文

patterns.name: 医学论文出版信息中的编号
patterns.trigger: “10”及“© 2016 Wiley Periodicals, Inc.”附近的数字和标点
patterns.context: 医学摘要的文献出处或期刊卷页信息中，激活落在页码数字片段及出版标注附近

patterns.name: 生物医学文献引文编号
patterns.trigger: “7806-10”及其附近的年份、卷号和标点
patterns.context: 专利背景中的生物医学论文参考文献，数字串作为页码范围的一部分

en.concept: Text formatting and local syntactic cues
en.description: Activations are scattered across infinitives and inferential expressions in legal texts, legal citation formats, and medical bibliographic records; sporadic word fragments also occur in medical terms and judgment body text. Some activations may be affected by tokenization, punctuation, and numeric formatting, and no single semantic feature can be confirmed.

patterns.name: to in consecutive verb phrases
patterns.context: to follows verbs such as seem or will and introduces an infinitive; it often forms a syntactic sequence together with neighboring words.

patterns.name: Legal citation and volume/page formats
patterns.context: Appears in citation strings consisting of case names, court reporter abbreviations, and citation page numbers; triggers may relate to local abbreviation and numeric formatting.

patterns.name: Bibliographic records and publication information
patterns.context: Occurs in references or journal publication records at the end of medical paper abstracts or body text; marked fragments are scattered within abbreviations and numeric formats.

patterns.name: Semantic and legal argumentation words
patterns.context: Sentences in legal argumentation expressing inference, judgment, or argumentative relations; overlaps partly with the infinitive pattern but cannot explain all activations in the passage.

patterns.name: Ordinary function words in legal narratives
patterns.context: Occurs in legal opinion body text recounting facts, discussing procedure, or explaining the court's handling of a case; activations are scattered across word classes and sentence positions, with no clear shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: Technical words and word fragments in medical abstracts or papers; topics and trigger words differ across passages, and samples do not support a unified subpattern.

patterns.name: Unclassifiable isolated high-activation fragments
patterns.context: Occur respectively in semantic interpretation, project approval narratives, and research results; aside from overlap between a few fragments and other patterns, there is no clear shared condition.

3_607.concept: 文本格式与局部句法线索
3_607.description: 激活分散于法律文本的不定式与推断表达、法律引证格式及医学文献著录；另有医学术语和判决正文中的零散词片段。部分激活可能受分词、标点和数字格式影响，无法确认单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 连续动词短语中的 to
patterns.trigger: «to»（[3]“seems to us to be”；[4]“seems to be”；[8]“would seem to have”）
patterns.context: to 位于似乎、将会等动词之后，引出不定式；本身常与邻近词一起形成句法序列。

patterns.name: 法律引文与卷页码格式
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称、法院报告缩写及引文页码构成的引证串中；触发可能与缩写和数字的局部格式有关。

patterns.name: 文献著录与出版信息
patterns.trigger: 期刊名、年份及卷页码附近的标记，如 [1]“Diagn.Cytopathol. 2016;144:194-297”，[2]“J.Surg.Oncol. 2017;1115:84-89”，[5]“Anat Rec, 301:1488-1490”，[7]“Mol Psychiatry. Jan;”
patterns.context: 位于医学论文摘要或正文末尾的参考文献、期刊出版著录中；所标记片段分散在缩写和数字格式内。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要或生物医学文献

patterns.name: 语义与法律论证词
patterns.trigger: «seems»（[4]“seems to be”）及«seems»（[3]“seems to us”）；另有«to»（[3]“to us”）
patterns.context: 法律论证中表达推断、判断或论证关系的句子；与不定式模式部分重叠，但不能解释该段所有激活。

patterns.name: 法律叙述中的普通功能词
patterns.context: 法律意见正文叙述事实、讨论程序或说明法院处理方式时出现，激活分散于不同词类和句子位置，缺少明显共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的零散词片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要或论文语境中的专业词及词片段；各段主题和触发词不一致，无法从样本确认统一子模式。

patterns.name: 无法归并的孤立高激活片段
patterns.trigger: «falling out»（[4]）、«completely controlled-access highway»及«would seem»（[8]）、起首的«~T~»（[7]）
patterns.context: 分别处于语义解释、项目审批叙述及研究结果文本中；除个别片段与其他模式重叠外，没有清晰共享条件。

en.concept: Formatting and judgment expressions in formal documents
en.description: Activation is most clearly concentrated on journal copyright attributions and reference formatting, and also occurs in the “seems to be” inference expression in legal opinions. Other sporadic patterns include German “diskutiert,” scientific terminology, and formatting boundaries, which do not form a single semantic class.

patterns.name: Journal publisher copyright attribution
patterns.context: Occurs in citations or copyright information at the end of PubMed abstracts, with activation concentrated on “Inc.” and often accompanied by words such as “Periodicals”; years vary.
patterns.domain: Biomedical journal abstracts and paper footnotes

patterns.name: Author initials and journal information in reference entries
patterns.context: Bibliographic formatting such as references, volume/issue numbers, and page numbers after the main text or at the end of an abstract; appears across disciplines.
patterns.domain: Medical and life science papers, citations in patent background sections

patterns.name: Inference statements in legal argument
patterns.context: Court opinions make judgments based on evidence, defenses, or legal classifications; activation is especially strong near “seems to be”.

patterns.name: Sentence-final grammar and punctuation boundaries in publications
patterns.context: Across different corpora, activation falls near abbreviations, sentence-final punctuation, and citation formatting; this may overlap with bibliographic/copyright formatting but does not explain all examples.

patterns.name: Discussion verb in German policy texts
patterns.context: After a European security strategy report is submitted, the text describes how it will be discussed in national parliaments and the European Parliament.

patterns.name: Specific term fragments in scientific texts
patterns.context: Occur respectively in discussion of AGN X-ray emission and comparison of non-covalent bond types; there is no clear shared local semantic condition.

patterns.name: Residual activation near paragraph starts or special formatting markers
patterns.context: Occurs where the main text transitions to references or in scientific texts with special typesetting markers; it is unclear whether these formatting markers themselves trigger activation.

3_607.concept: 正式文献中的格式与判断表达
3_607.description: 激活最明显地聚集于期刊版权署名和参考文献格式，也出现在法律意见中的“seems to be”推断表达。另有德语“diskutiert”、科学术语及格式边界等零散模式，不能归入单一语义类。

patterns.name: 期刊出版商版权署名
patterns.trigger: “© 2016 Wiley Periodicals, Inc.”、“© 2018 Wiley Periodicals, Inc.”及变体“© 2017 Wiley Periodicals, Inc.”
patterns.context: 出现在 PubMed 摘要末尾的引文或版权信息中，激活集中在“Inc.”，并常伴随“Periodicals”等词；年份不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学期刊摘要与论文尾注

patterns.name: 参考文献条目中的作者缩写与期刊信息
patterns.trigger: 如“Diagn. Cytopathol.”、“J. Surg. Oncol.”、“Mol Psychiatry”、“J Biol Chem.”及作者名后的“et al.”
patterns.context: 论文正文后或摘要末尾的参考文献、卷期页码等书目格式；不同学科均有出现。
patterns.domain: 医学与生命科学论文、专利背景技术中的引文

patterns.name: 法律论证中的推断语句
patterns.trigger: “seems to be”（段4、7），以及段4的“fails to cite to the record”“difference between a feud and a ‘falling out’”
patterns.context: 法院意见书以证据、抗辩或法律分类为依据作判断；“seems to be”附近激活尤强。

patterns.name: 出版物中句末语法及标点边界
patterns.trigger: “Inc.”、“et al.”、“…”之后的句号、逗号或分号等相邻标记
patterns.context: 在不同语料中，激活落在缩写、句末标点及引文格式附近；可能与书目／版权格式重叠，但不能解释所有例子。

patterns.name: 德语政策文本中的讨论动词
patterns.context: 欧盟安全战略报告提交后，文本描述其将在各国议会及欧洲议会被讨论。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的特定术语片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 AGN X 射线辐射讨论和非共价键类型比较中；没有明显共同的局部语义条件。

patterns.name: 段首或特殊格式标记附近的残余激活
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文转参考文献处或带有特殊排版标记的科学文本中，无法确定这些格式标记本身是否触发。
patterns.domain: 科学论文及其语料格式

en.concept: Case citation format in U.S. judgments
en.description: Apart from one Spanish-language research paper passage, activations center on case citations in U.S. judgments: v. between case names, S.Ct./L.Ed. reporter abbreviations, volume and page numbers, years, and punctuation; nearby litigation and public-law terminology also occurs.

patterns.name: 《S.Ct.》 in U.S. case citations
patterns.context: In U.S. Supreme Court case citations, S.Ct. is followed by volume and page information from the 《Supreme Court Reporter》 and often appears alongside L.Ed.; activation mostly falls on abbreviations, numeric fragments, and punctuation
patterns.domain: U.S. court judgments and legal citations

patterns.name: v. in case names and court citation format
patterns.context: Party names appear before and after the case name, followed by the court, volume number, and page number; may co-occur with reporter abbreviation citations

patterns.name: Citation punctuation and sentence boundaries after case citations
patterns.context: Appears after the page number and year in a case citation, or where a citation sentence ends and a new sentence begins

patterns.name: Year digits in case citations
patterns.context: The year of the decision appears in parentheses at the end of a U.S. case citation; parts of the digits are marked

patterns.name: Presenting collective results in a law paper
patterns.context: A Spanish sentence describes focus groups as used solely to present and discuss collective results; no U.S. case citation format is present
patterns.domain: Academic paper abstract or research-methods description

patterns.name: Procedural or judgment language in legal texts
patterns.context: Legal argumentation mentions dismissal of pleadings, misdirection, defendants, or transitions to conclusions; these are usually near case citations, but the words themselves are not common triggers across all passages

patterns.name: Statutory and judicial review language
patterns.context: Discussion of constitutional provisions, application of legislation, or judicial review standards, followed or preceded by case citations

3_607.concept: 美国判决中的判例引证格式
3_607.description: 除一段西班牙语研究论文外，激活集中于美国判决中的判例引证：v. 案名、S.Ct./L.Ed. reporter 缩写、卷页数字、年份与标点；周边亦有诉讼及公法措辞。

patterns.name: 美国判例引证中的《S.Ct.》
patterns.context: 在美国最高法院判例引证中，S.Ct. 后跟《Supreme Court Reporter》卷页信息，常与 L.Ed. 并列；激活多落在缩写、数字片段及标点上
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律引证

patterns.name: 判例名称中的 v. 与法院引证格式
patterns.trigger: « v»3«.»2 或 « v»4«.»4，如 «Ericks«on»3« v»4«.»2 Pardus»
patterns.context: 案例名称前后有当事方名称，后接法院、卷号及页码；可能与 reporter 缩写引证同现

patterns.name: 判例引证后的引文标点与句界
patterns.context: 出现在判例引证的页码、年份之后，或引证句结束并衔接新句时

patterns.name: 判例引证中的年代数字
patterns.context: 作为美国判例引证末尾括号内的裁判年份；数字内部部分片段被标记

patterns.name: 法学论文中呈现集体结果
patterns.context: 西班牙语句子描述焦点小组仅用于呈现和讨论集体结果；未见美国判例引证格式
patterns.domain: 学术论文摘要或研究方法描述

patterns.name: 法律文本中的程序或判决措辞
patterns.context: 法律论述中谈及诉状驳回、指示错误、被告或结论衔接；通常邻近判例引证，但这些词本身并非各段共同触发点

patterns.name: 条文与司法审查措辞
patterns.context: 宪法条文、法案适用或司法审查标准等论述，后接或前接判例引证

en.description: Primarily responds to the digit 2 in 「2d」 in the case citation 「L.Ed.2d」; it also responds to to in the legal expression 「seems to be」 and to several sporadic citation-number markers.

patterns.name: Ed. 2d in federal case citations
patterns.context: Occurs in the name of a legal reporter in U.S. federal case citations, usually adjacent to a page number and before the year in parentheses; activation is concentrated on the digit 2 in 「2d」.

patterns.name: The semantic expression 「seems to be」
patterns.context: Used in ordinary legal discussion to introduce a judgment about something; the strongest activation falls on to.

patterns.name: Other possible low-level responses to numbers/citation formatting
patterns.context: Occurs on volume numbers, page numbers, years, or citation-number strings in case citations; these markers are sporadic compared with the recurring 「2d」, so it is unclear whether they form an independent pattern.

3_607.description: 主要响应判例引注中「L.Ed.2d」的「2d」数字2；另有法律论述「seems to be」中的to及若干零散引注数字标记。

patterns.name: 联邦判例引注中的 Ed. 2d
patterns.context: 出现在美国联邦判例引注的法律汇编名称中，通常紧邻页码，并位于年份括号之前；激活集中在「2d」中的数字 2。

patterns.name: 语义表达「seems to be」
patterns.context: 普通法律论述中以「seems to be」引出对某事的判断；最强激活落在 to。

patterns.name: 其他可能的低层数字/引注格式响应
patterns.context: 出现在判例引注中的卷号、页码、年份或引注数字串；相较于反复出现的「2d」，这些标记零散，无法确定是否为独立模式。

en.concept: Mixed responses to the word forms sacrificed and homomorphism
en.description: Strong responses concentrate on sacrificed (the killing of an animal, also used to mean “sacrifice”) and the mathematical term homomorphism; formula symbols, title fragments, and several isolated words and punctuation marks also activate, with no unified condition apparent.

patterns.name: English word sacrificed
patterns.context: The word occurs in a sentence, usually describing an animal or research subject being killed; it also has nonliteral uses.
patterns.domain: Biomedical methods, news commentary, literary narrative

patterns.name: homomorphism in mathematics
patterns.context: Appears in abstract algebra or category-theory contexts involving groups, objects, or mappings, often paired with modifiers such as injective or bijective.

patterns.name: Unmarked word endings/subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on split words or title fragments; no clear semantic trigger condition shared with the other high-activation patterns is evident.
patterns.domain: Biomedical titles, names, or labeled text

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula fragments
patterns.context: Symbols are embedded in mathematical formulas involving manifolds, gradient flows of energy, and conjugacy classes; the high-activation word homomorphism is assigned to the homonymous pattern.

patterns.name: Isolated high-frequency words and punctuation
patterns.context: Local activation falls on common words, word fragments, or punctuation; the available context is insufficient to identify a stable semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, literary texts, biomedical texts

3_612.concept: 词形 sacrificed 与 homomorphism 的混合响应
3_612.description: 强响应集中在 sacrificed（动物处死，也用于“牺牲”）和数学术语 homomorphism；另有公式符号、标题碎片及若干孤立词标点激活，未显示统一条件。

patterns.name: 英文词 sacrificed
patterns.context: 该词出现在句子中，通常是动物或研究对象被处死；也有非字面用法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法、新闻评论、文学叙述

patterns.name: 数学中的 homomorphism
patterns.context: 出现在群、对象、映射等抽象代数或范畴论语境中，常与 injective 或 bijective 等修饰语搭配。

patterns.name: 未标记的词尾/子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的单词或标题片段上；未见与其他高激活模式相同的明确语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学标题、姓名或标记文本

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式片段
patterns.context: 符号嵌在流形、能量梯度流和共轭类等数学公式中；高激活词 homomorphism 另归入同名模式。

patterns.name: 孤立的高频词与标点
patterns.context: 局部激活落在普通词、词片段或标点上；现有上下文不足以确定稳定语义条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、文学文本、生物医学文本

en.concept: Mixed triggers from sacrifice and homomorphism terminology
en.description: The most stable trigger is sacrificed: it refers both to euthanizing experimental animals and to abstract acts of “sacrifice”; homomorphism in mathematical passages is also a strong trigger. There are also local co-occurrences with the negation haven’t and with credibility and factual narration.

patterns.name: Sacrificing experimental animals
patterns.context: Animals or experimental subjects are euthanized after experimental procedures, sampling, or the observation period; the trigger often appears in the passive voice.

patterns.name: Homomorphism as a homograph
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical texts as a term for a homomorphism, mapping, or algebraic structure; apart from “sacrificed” in biomedical contexts, it is another recurring, clear trigger.

patterns.name: Negation marker haven’t
patterns.context: An English colloquial auxiliary negation followed by a past participle; in this example it forms a negative expression related to sacrifice.

patterns.name: Credibility and factual narration
patterns.context: Discussion of how storytelling should accord with known facts and may sacrifice dramatic events to maintain credibility.

3_612.concept: 牺牲与同态术语的混合触发
3_612.description: 最稳定触发是 sacrificed：既指处死实验动物，也用于抽象的“牺牲”事件；数学段落的 homomorphism 也强触发。另有 haven’t 否定形式及可信度、事实叙述的局部共现。

patterns.name: 牺牲实验动物
patterns.context: 动物或实验对象在实验处理、取样或观察期结束后被处死；触发词常位于被动语态中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验方法与结果

patterns.name: 同形词 homomorphism
patterns.context: 数学文本中作为同态、映射或代数结构术语出现；在生物医学中的“sacrificed”之外，是反复出现的另一种明确触发。

patterns.name: 否定标记 haven’t
patterns.trigger: “haven”与“’t”（原文分成两个 token），尤其是“haven’t sacrificed”
patterns.context: 英语口语中助动词否定，后接过去分词；本例恰与牺牲主题形成否定表达。

patterns.name: 可信度与事实叙述
patterns.context: 讨论故事叙述需符合已知事实、并可能牺牲戏剧性事件以维持可信度。

en.concept: Triggers from terms such as sacrificed/homomorphism
en.description: Activation most consistently falls on “sacrificed”: in medical corpora it refers to euthanizing experimental animals, and it also appears as figurative “sacrifice” in narrative and promotional contexts. “Homomorphism” is also a strong trigger in mathematical corpora; there are also some typography, subword fragment, and isolated-phrase activations.

patterns.name: Euthanizing experimental animals
patterns.context: Animals or experimental groups are euthanized after research, surgery, drug administration, or the end of an experiment; often followed by a time point, tissue sampling, or experimental results.

patterns.name: Sacrificing facts for narrative credibility
patterns.context: Abstractly or figuratively describes abandoning certain events to meet standards such as factual accuracy or chronology.

patterns.name: Giving up promotional hype
patterns.context: Evaluates a product or team for not sacrificing hype or promotional impact while developing other features; this is a distinct sense from euthanizing animals.

patterns.name: Group homomorphism terminology
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical contexts such as Lie group representations, conjugacy classes, object automorphisms, or definitions of isomorphism; the word itself is a strong trigger.

patterns.name: Isolated experimental-group comparison term
patterns.context: Appears alongside another surgical tool to describe experimental groups; no clear connection to other trigger patterns.

patterns.name: Isolated heading format and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Section headings, Markdown heading anchors, and marked in-word tokens; strong activation is scattered across heading formats and subword fragments and cannot be fully explained by a shared word sense in the main content.

patterns.name: Isolated abstract mathematical manifold context
patterns.context: Describes energy gradient flows, solutions, and Lie group homomorphisms, but the main strong trigger falls on “homomorphism”; it is uncertain whether the preceding mathematical phrases trigger independently.

patterns.name: Isolated word-initial and broken-word fragments
patterns.context: Appears at sentence or segment boundaries, or in truncated positions, without enough context to support a stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Isolated text fragments
patterns.context: One is a fragment at the beginning of a forum paragraph and the other looks like a username; they co-occur with later homomorphism terminology but do not clearly belong to that mathematical pattern.

3_612.concept: 牺牲/同态等词项触发
3_612.description: 激活最稳定地落在“sacrificed”：医学语料中指处死实验动物，也见于叙事和宣传语境中的比喻性“牺牲”。数学语料中“homomorphism”也强触发；另有若干排版、词片段和孤立短语。

patterns.name: 动物实验处死
patterns.context: 动物或实验组在研究、手术、给药或实验结束后被处死；常接时间点、组织取样或实验结果。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法与结果

patterns.name: 牺牲事实以符合叙事可信度
patterns.context: 抽象或比喻地说，为满足事实、时间顺序等标准而舍弃某些事件。

patterns.name: 舍弃炒作表象
patterns.context: 评价产品或团队在开发其他功能时没有牺牲炒作或宣传效果；此处与动物处死是不同义项。

patterns.name: 群同态概念术语
patterns.context: 出现在李群表示、共轭类、对象自同构或同构定义等数学语境中；该词本身是强触发点。

patterns.name: 孤立的实验组比较词
patterns.context: 与另一种手术工具并列，描述实验分组；没有明显连接到其他触发模式。

patterns.name: 孤立的标题格式与词形片段
patterns.context: 小节标题、Markdown 标题锚点和带标记的词内 token；强激活分散于标题格式和词片段，无法由主体内容中的共同词义充分解释。

patterns.name: 孤立的抽象数学流形语境
patterns.context: 描述能量梯度流、解和李群同态，但主要强触发落在“homomorphism”；前述数学词组是否独立触发不确定。

patterns.name: 孤立的词首与断词片段
patterns.context: 出现在句段边界或截断位置，缺乏足够语境支持稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 孤立的文本碎片
patterns.context: 分别是论坛段落开头的残片和看似用户名的字符串；与后续同态术语并存，但不明显属于该数学模式。

en.concept: Triggers for killing and homomorphism terms
en.description: Most segments describe animals being killed in biomedical experimental methods, with “sacrificed” as the strongest trigger; “homomorphism” also activates strongly in two mathematical texts. Several other scattered terms are highlighted, with no shared pattern identified so far.

patterns.name: Killing experimental animals
patterns.context: Experimental procedures or sampling time points describe animals (mice, rats, animals) being killed, often followed by a time, method, or subsequent tissue collection.

patterns.name: Mathematical homomorphism term
patterns.context: homomorphism appears in mathematical texts, especially in Lie group representations or mappings between objects; this is not a biomedical killing context.

patterns.name: Other highly activated common words
patterns.context: Appear respectively in database promotion, a liver-sampling title, and mathematical discussion; they lack shared local or semantic trigger conditions.
patterns.domain: Technology forums, medical titles, mathematical texts

3_612.concept: 处死／同态词项触发
3_612.description: 多数段在生物医学实验方法中描述动物被处死，且“sacrificed”是最强触发词；两段数学文本中“homomorphism”也强激活。另有若干分散词项高亮，暂无共同模式。

patterns.name: 实验动物处死
patterns.context: 实验过程或取样时间点中，描述动物（mice、rats、animals）被处死，常接时间、方法或后续取材。

patterns.name: 数学同态术语
patterns.context: 数学文本中出现 homomorphism，尤其是 Lie 群表示或对象间映射；不是生物医学处死语境。

patterns.name: 其他高激活的普通词
patterns.context: 分别出现在数据库宣传、肝脏取样标题及数学论述中，缺乏共同的局部或语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 科技论坛、医学标题、数学文本

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to the word form “sacrificed”: often in contexts involving euthanizing experimental animals, sampling, and time points, and also responds once to a nonliteral use meaning not giving up promotional impact. Another segment responds to a heading fragment containing “channel,” which cannot be explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: Animals euthanized
patterns.context: Experimental animals or research subjects are euthanized after completing an experiment, reaching a specified time point, or being sampled; the word appears in several syntactic constructions.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research and animal experimental methods

patterns.name: Sacrificing or giving something up
patterns.context: Nonliteral use describing not giving up hype or promotional impact to develop other features.

patterns.name: Open-channel block
patterns.context: A heading describes open-channel block of sodium channels; “sacrificed” does not appear.

3_612.concept: sacrificed 词形
3_612.description: 主要对词形“sacrificed”强烈响应：多见于实验动物处死及其取样、时间点等语境，也响应一次表示未放弃宣传效果的非字面用法。另有一段对“channel”的标题片段响应，无法与主模式解释。

patterns.name: 动物被处死
patterns.context: 实验动物或研究对象完成实验、到达指定时间点或取样后被处死；该词在多种句法结构中出现
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与动物实验方法

patterns.name: 牺牲、放弃某物
patterns.context: 非字面用法，描述没有为了开发其他功能而放弃炒作或宣传效果

patterns.name: 开放通道阻滞
patterns.context: 标题中描述钠通道的开放通道阻滞，未出现“sacrificed”

en.concept: Mixed patterns, not reducible to a single summary
en.description: Responses primarily involve EGFR and tumor-related biomedical terms, as well as killing experimental animals, tissue sampling, and clinical sample collection; literal or metaphorical uses of sacrificed, Russian interface text, and Romanian military descriptions also occur, making it difficult to identify a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: EGFR/cancer biomedical terms
patterns.context: Appears in medical descriptions of receptors, mutations, inhibitors, cancer types, or risk studies; related terms may be split into multiple token fragments.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and PMC tumor studies

patterns.name: Experimental animal sampling and tissue examination
patterns.context: Experimental methods describe killing animals, group time points, sampling, or tissue examination.

patterns.name: Clinical research resources and sample collection
patterns.context: Describes how research support facilities recruit participants, collect samples, and reduce the burden on researchers.

patterns.name: Metaphorical use of sacrifice in promotional copy
patterns.context: “sacrificed” is used metaphorically to describe product development that did not diminish promotional buzz; this is not the biomedical sense.

patterns.name: Russian interface strings
patterns.context: Russian program interface or configuration text containing interface labels such as opening logs or registration records.

patterns.name: Romanian description of military aggression
patterns.context: A Romanian sentence describes Palestine experiencing violent military aggression; it has no obvious lexical connection to the other patterns.

3_612.concept: 混合模式，无法单一概括
3_612.description: 主要响应EGFR及肿瘤相关生物医学术语，也覆盖实验动物处死、组织取样和临床样本采集；另有字面或比喻的sacrificed、俄语界面文本及罗马尼亚语军事表述，难以归入统一语义模式。

patterns.name: EGFR/癌症生物医学术语
patterns.trigger: “epidermal growth factor receptor”“EGFR”“mutant”“tyrosine kinase”“glioma”“lung cancers”“lung adenocarcinoma”
patterns.context: 出现在受体、突变、抑制剂、癌症类型或风险研究等医学表述中；相关术语可被分词标记为多个片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要及 PMC 肿瘤研究

patterns.name: 实验动物取材与组织检查
patterns.trigger: “groups were sacrificed”“mice were sacrificed”“Liver Sampling and Microscopical Examination”“liver tissue”
patterns.context: 实验方法叙述中，涉及处死动物、分组时间点、取样或组织检查。

patterns.name: 临床研究资源与样本采集
patterns.context: 说明研究支持设施如何招募受试者、采集样本并减轻研究者负担。

patterns.name: 宣传文案中的牺牲表达
patterns.context: “sacrificed”作比喻，描述产品开发没有削弱宣传热度；不是生物医学意义。

patterns.name: 俄语界面字符串
patterns.context: 俄语程序界面或配置文本，包含打开日志/注册记录等界面标签。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语军事侵略描述
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子描述巴勒斯坦遭受暴力军事侵略；与其他模式没有明显词汇联系。

en.description: Activation strongly targets “EGFR,” a tumor-related target name; another pattern involves indentation and structural boundaries after line breaks in code and HTML. The code subpattern covers C#, C++, JavaScript, and page templates, with Russian-mixed text also present.

patterns.name: EGFR target/receptor name
patterns.context: Appears in medical descriptions of receptors, EGFR-driven tumors, or anti-EGFR antibodies; this token activates prominently, often surrounded by cancer, cell, or experimental contexts.

patterns.name: Indentation and structural boundaries in code
patterns.context: In code or structured text, activation occurs at tab/indentation positions after line breaks; visible near statement, block, or member boundaries in multiple languages.

patterns.name: C# DataSourceSelecting type name
