patterns.context: Appears in .NET type declarations, especially the event-argument class for the SqlDataSource Selecting event and its base class.

patterns.name: C++ template access and move
patterns.context: Appears in C++ code snippets involving template access to a return value or string and move assignment.

patterns.name: JavaScript script state and edit path
patterns.context: Browser-side code checks window.scripted and extracts the file path to edit from location.search.

patterns.name: C# collection class constructor region
patterns.context: A class declaration inherits from DictionaryBase, followed by the constructor region.

patterns.name: HTML content-area markers
patterns.context: A Wikipedia page template uses div id to mark content areas such as siteSub and contentSub.

patterns.name: Atypical Russian garbled text
patterns.context: Text mixes Latin characters, Cyrillic letters, and encoding or splitting artifacts; activation falls on multiple Russian fragments and surrounding whitespace.

3_612.concept: EGFR与结构边界的混合特征
3_612.description: 激活强烈落在“EGFR”这一肿瘤学靶点名；另有代码和 HTML 中换行后的缩进/结构边界模式。代码子模式覆盖 C#、C++、JavaScript 与页面模板，另见俄文混杂文本。

patterns.name: EGFR 靶点/受体名称
patterns.context: 出现于受体、EGFR 驱动肿瘤或抗 EGFR 抗体等医学表述中；该 token 激活突出，周边常见癌症、细胞或实验语境。

patterns.name: 代码中的缩进与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或结构化文本中，换行后的制表符/缩进位置激活；不同语言的语句、块或成员边界附近均可见。

patterns.name: C# DataSourceSelecting 类型名
patterns.context: 出现在 .NET 类型声明中，尤其是 SqlDataSource 的 Selecting 事件参数类及其基类。

patterns.name: C++ 模板访问与 move
patterns.context: 出现在对返回值或字符串进行模板访问、移动赋值的 C++ 代码片段中。

patterns.name: JavaScript 脚本状态与编辑路径
patterns.context: 浏览器端代码检查 window.scripted，并从 location.search 截取待编辑文件路径。

patterns.name: C# 集合类构造区域
patterns.context: 类声明继承 DictionaryBase，随后进入构造函数区域。

patterns.name: HTML 内容区标记
patterns.context: Wikipedia 页面模板中，用 div id 标记 siteSub、contentSub 等内容区。

patterns.name: 非典型俄文混淆文本
patterns.context: 混有拉丁字符、俄文字母和编码/拆分痕迹的文本；激活落在多个俄文片段及其周围空白。

en.concept: Specific letter strings and affix fragments
en.description: Activation often falls on AT and subsequent characters, and also occurs on OLOG in a philosophical term; triggers are scattered across model names, proper nouns, titles, and terminology, spanning domains and depending on local spelling.

patterns.name: AT string and following letters
patterns.context: Upper- or lowercase AT is followed by different letters or numbers, often within a split word, model name, or other name; it is not always a standalone word.
patterns.domain: Lists, news, book layouts, legal documents, life-science papers

patterns.name: -ological in philosophical terms
patterns.context: Appears within words such as theological, chronologia, and ontology, surrounded by philosophical titles or academic book titles.

patterns.name: Jack in chapter titles
patterns.context: The name Jack repeatedly appears in uppercase chapter titles.

patterns.name: Model and product name lists
patterns.context: Various motorcycle and all-terrain vehicle models appear in lists; activation falls on ATC here.

patterns.name: AT&T news context
patterns.context: A news post discusses competition involving a US telecommunications company.

patterns.name: Book and periodical title formatting
patterns.context: Uppercase periodical titles in scanned books, with letters split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Transaction terminology in legal documents
patterns.context: Rule numbers appear next to transaction settlement terms.

patterns.name: Gene/protein name ATX
patterns.context: Discusses substrate specificity and local LPA signaling.

patterns.name: Intraocular lens model containing AT
patterns.context: Part of an intraocular lens model in cataract surgery research.

3_612.concept: 特定字母串与词缀片段
3_612.description: 激活常落在 AT 及其后续字符上，也见于哲学词中的 OLOG；具体触发分散在型号、专名、标题和术语中，跨领域且依赖局部拼写。

patterns.name: AT 字符串及后续字母
patterns.context: 大小写 AT 后紧接不同字母或数字，常处在被切分的词、型号或名称中；并非总是独立词。
patterns.domain: 列表、新闻、书籍版式、法律文件、生命科学论文

patterns.name: 哲学术语中的 -ological
patterns.context: 出现在 theological、chronologia、ontology 等词内，周围是哲学标题或学术书名。

patterns.name: 章节标题中的 Jack
patterns.context: 大写章节标题中反复出现人物名 Jack。

patterns.name: 型号与产品名列表
patterns.context: 多种摩托车、全地形车型号以列表形式排列；此处激活落在 ATC。

patterns.name: AT&T 新闻语境
patterns.context: 新闻帖子谈及美国电信公司的竞争。

patterns.name: 书刊刊名排版
patterns.context: 扫描书籍中的大写刊名，字母被分割成多个 token。

patterns.name: 法律文件中的交易术语
patterns.context: 规则编号与交易结算条款相邻。

patterns.name: 基因/蛋白名称 ATX
patterns.context: 讨论底物特异性及局部 LPA 信号传导。

patterns.name: 人工晶体型号含 AT
patterns.context: 白内障手术研究中作为人工晶体型号的一部分。

en.description: All segments contain strong “OLOG” activation, usually at the ending of an -ology discipline term or proper noun; domains include philosophy, medicine, geology, theology, news, and directory text. Titles and line breaks may co-occur, but there is insufficient evidence to identify them as separate patterns.

patterns.name: ology suffix
patterns.context: The trigger string occurs at a word ending or within a suffix; the beginning and remainder of the word are often split into multiple subword tokens. It corresponds to -ology in disciplines, academic topics, or proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Philosophical bibliographies, academic papers, medical titles, directories, news headlines, and related text

patterns.name: Layout and title structure
patterns.context: Appears in the same segment as “OLOG”; layout in directories, bibliographies, or newspaper clippings may be a secondary cue, but there is no evidence of a stable independent trigger.
patterns.domain: Book directories, newspaper text, web or paper section headings

3_612.concept: -ology词尾
3_612.description: 所有段都含“OLOG”强激活，通常是 -ology 学科或专名词尾；跨哲学、医学、地质、神学、新闻及目录文本。标题和换行等版式可能伴随，但不足以判定为独立模式。

patterns.name: ology 词尾
patterns.context: 触发串位于词尾或词内后缀，词首及其余部分常分成多个子词 token；对应学科、学术主题或专名中的 -ology。
patterns.domain: 哲学书目、学术论文、医学标题、目录与新闻标题等

patterns.name: 版面与标题结构
patterns.trigger: 换行、空白、页码、“CONTENTS”“PAGE”及大写标题
patterns.context: 与“OLOG”同段出现；目录、书目或报刊剪贴中的排版结构可能是伴随线索，但本身未见稳定独立触发证据。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录、报刊文本、网页或论文分节标题

en.description: Activation prominently involves Unix environment variables and path syntax, as well as the ambiguous abbreviation DSL: domain-specific language, digital single-lens reflex camera, and broadband access; the dollar sign in Excel absolute cell-reference strings also appears.

patterns.name: PATH environment variable and Unix directory paths
patterns.context: Shell or container configuration sets or expands environment variables, often with colon-separated paths, variable expansion, or Docker RUN instructions.
patterns.domain: Software development, Unix shell, Docker configuration

patterns.name: DSL abbreviation (domain-specific language)
patterns.context: Discusses language design, expressing a problem domain with a DSL, or writing, using, or reverse-engineering a DSL.

patterns.name: DSL abbreviation (digital single-lens reflex camera)
patterns.context: Discusses cameras, lenses, photos, or image quality; the abbreviation refers to a DSLR camera, and tokenization may split DSL from R/s.

patterns.name: DSL broadband access
patterns.context: Used as a type of network access, co-occurring with contexts such as Comcast, cable networks, internet speed, or distance from the central office.

patterns.name: Excel cell addresses and range strings
patterns.context: Runtime errors and Excel Range string examples; activation falls on dollar signs and tokens related to column names or addresses.

3_612.concept: 技术缩写与路径语法
3_612.description: 激活突出 Unix 环境变量与路径语法，以及 DSL 这一多义缩写：领域特定语言、数码单反相机和宽带接入；另见 Excel 绝对单元格引用字符串中的美元符号。

patterns.name: PATH 环境变量与 Unix 目录路径
patterns.context: Shell 或容器配置中设置、扩展环境变量，常出现冒号分隔的路径、变量展开或 Docker RUN 指令。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、Unix shell、Docker 配置

patterns.name: DSL 缩写（领域特定语言）
patterns.context: 讨论语言设计、用 DSL 表达问题领域，或编写、使用、反向工程 DSL。

patterns.name: DSL 缩写（数码单反相机）
patterns.context: 讨论相机、镜头、照片或图像质量；缩写指 DSLR 相机，分词标记可能将 DSL 与 R/s 拆开。

patterns.name: DSL 宽带接入
patterns.context: 作为网络接入类型，与 Comcast、有线网络、网速或距中心局距离等语境共现。

patterns.name: Excel 单元格地址与范围字符串
patterns.context: 运行时错误及 Excel Range 字符串示例；激活落在美元符号和列名/地址相关 token 上。

en.description: Most segments are structured markup or configuration in code repositories; activation often accompanies angle-bracket tags, attribute assignments, and quoted values. Other patterns include interface controls, build/test configurations, Shell and JavaScript discussions, and Objective-C identifiers.

patterns.name: HTML/XML markup boundaries and attributes
patterns.context: In structured markup composed of tags, attributes, and values, activation often falls on angle brackets, tag fragments, and nearby attribute names and values; some segments also contain entities or template interpolation.
patterns.domain: HTML/XML, build configurations, and markup text in code repositories

patterns.name: Key-value/index fields in code and configuration
patterns.context: In structured data or configuration, a field name is followed by a quoted string, number, index, or template value; especially apparent when accompanied by markup structure.
patterns.domain: XML query fragments, map/table data, build configurations

patterns.name: Test and build configuration
patterns.context: Configuration elements for test filtering, test execution, or build targets; marker names such as `test`, `target`, and `fileset` appear.

patterns.name: Interface controls and option settings
patterns.context: In form controls or application settings interfaces, control types, option identifiers, and label text occur near one another.

patterns.name: Commands, attributes, and technical identifiers in code
patterns.context: Commands, boolean configuration values, or programming language/API names appear in technical discussions or code configuration; an XML context is not required.
patterns.domain: Android build configuration, JavaScript technical discussions

patterns.name: Shell conditions and filename patterns
patterns.context: Shell scripts organize filenames by time conditions and control branches using range comparisons.

patterns.name: Objective-C methods and logging identifiers
patterns.context: Method names, class names, and session-token parameters occur in Objective-C asynchronous task code.

3_612.concept: 代码与结构化配置标记
3_612.description: 多数片段是代码仓库中的结构化标记或配置，激活常伴随尖括号标签、属性赋值及引号值；另有界面控件、构建测试配置，以及 Shell、JavaScript 讨论和 Objective-C 标识符等代码模式。

patterns.name: HTML/XML 标记边界与属性
patterns.trigger: `<`、`>`、`</`、标签名及属性赋值，如 `input type="hidden"`、`<target name="isInstalled">`
patterns.context: 在标签、属性和值构成的结构化标记中，激活常落在尖括号、标签片段及属性名和值附近；部分片段还包含实体或模板插值。
patterns.domain: HTML/XML、构建配置及代码仓库中的标记文本

patterns.name: 代码与配置中的键值/索引字段
patterns.context: 结构化数据或配置中，字段名后跟引号包围的字符串、数字、索引或模板值；与标记结构相伴时尤其明显。
patterns.domain: XML 查询片段、地图/表格数据、构建配置

patterns.name: 测试与构建配置
patterns.context: 测试筛选、测试执行或构建目标等配置元素；出现 `test`、`target`、`fileset` 等标记名。

patterns.name: 界面控件与选项设置
patterns.context: 表单控件或应用设置界面中，控件类型、选项标识与标签文本相邻。

patterns.name: 代码中的命令、属性与技术标识符
patterns.context: 技术讨论或代码配置中出现命令属性、布尔配置或编程语言/API 名称；不要求 XML 语境。
patterns.domain: Android 构建配置、JavaScript 技术讨论

patterns.name: Shell 条件与文件名模式
patterns.context: Shell 脚本按时间条件组织文件名，并以范围比较控制分支。

patterns.name: Objective-C 方法与日志标识符
patterns.context: 方法名、类名和会话令牌参数出现在 Objective-C 异步任务代码中。

en.concept: Structured identifiers and parameters in code
en.description: Activation spans various code snippets: PHP, SQL, R, PowerShell, shell, and unknown languages. Common local cues include identifiers, field/property names, array indices, and comma-separated parameters, as well as POST bindings, forms, regular expressions, and build options; no single semantic trigger condition is evident.

patterns.name: SQL column names, identifiers, and string concatenation
patterns.context: An SQL INSERT statement uses backticks around field names and concatenates PHP variables into SQL values.

patterns.name: Delete submission field in an HTML form
patterns.context: PHP echo outputs a delete form whose hidden field value comes from `$row['id']`.

patterns.name: Conditional column selection in an R data frame
patterns.context: Discusses filtering by the value in one column, then modifying other columns rather than the matched column; activation is concentrated on column names and conditional expressions.

patterns.name: Numbers and comma-separated parameters in code
patterns.context: Repeated function calls contain integer expressions and comma-separated parameter sequences; parameter names are Greek-letter-style identifiers.

patterns.name: PowerShell object property assignment and command-line prompt
patterns.context: A PowerShell example creates a hash table with a string property, then runs an Az command.

patterns.name: PHP POST parameters and database binding
patterns.context: Reads a username and password from a POST request and binds two string parameters to a database statement.

patterns.name: Array indices, isset, and string accumulation
patterns.context: Checks each array index for existence and, when present, appends the element and a space to a string; adjacent code shows repeated handling of multiple indices.

patterns.name: Protocol Buffers field types and data insertion
patterns.context: Describes proto message field types and fills a Measurement instance with data before attempting an insert.

patterns.name: Ordinal numbers and time regular expressions
patterns.context: An object lists ordinal numbers and then defines a regular expression matching time formats; activation is scattered across ordinal suffixes and digits and colons in the regular expression.

patterns.name: Build configuration and error-output redirection
patterns.context: A shell configuration script calls a configuration tool and redirects output, then writes error information to a configuration log or error variable.

3_612.concept: 代码中的结构化标识符与参数
3_612.description: 激活覆盖多种代码片段：PHP、SQL、R、PowerShell、shell及未知语言；常见局部线索是标识符、字段/属性名、数组索引与逗号分隔参数，也包括POST绑定、表单、正则和构建选项等，未见单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: SQL列名、标识符及字符串拼接
patterns.context: SQL INSERT 语句中用反引号包字段名，并把 PHP 变量拼接进 SQL 值。

patterns.name: HTML表单的删除提交字段
patterns.context: PHP echo 输出删除表单，隐藏字段值来自 `$row['id']`。

patterns.name: R语言数据框按条件选列
patterns.context: 讨论按一列的值筛选，再修改其他列而非匹配列；触发集中在列名和条件表达式。

patterns.name: 代码中的数字与逗号分隔参数
patterns.context: 重复的函数调用中，整数表达式和逗号分隔的参数序列；参数名为希腊字母风格标识符。

patterns.name: PowerShell对象属性赋值及命令行提示符
patterns.context: PowerShell示例中创建含字符串属性的哈希表，随后运行 Az 命令。

patterns.name: PHP POST参数及数据库绑定
patterns.context: 从POST请求读取用户名和密码，并以两个字符串参数绑定数据库语句。

patterns.name: 数组下标、isset与字符串累加
patterns.context: 逐个检查数组下标是否存在，存在时把元素和空格追加到字符串；相邻代码显示重复处理多个索引。

patterns.name: Protocol Buffers字段类型与数据写入
patterns.context: 描述proto消息的字段类型，并将数据填入Measurement实例后尝试插入。

patterns.name: 序数词及时间正则表达式
patterns.context: 对象列举序数词后定义正则，匹配时间样式；激活分散于序数后缀和正则中的数字、冒号。

patterns.name: 构建配置与错误输出重定向
patterns.context: shell配置脚本调用配置工具并重定向输出，再把错误信息写入配置日志或错误变量。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to angle brackets/greater-than signs in text and code, covering quotation markers, command prompts, comparison operators, and closing tags; also activates on code-structure punctuation and a few numbers, units, and chat symbols.

patterns.name: Angle brackets/greater-than sign
patterns.context: The greater-than sign and adjacent characters, punctuation, or code symbols; sometimes a quotation marker, sometimes part of a comparison operator or command prompt.
patterns.domain: Forum text, chat, code, HTML, and Q&A

patterns.name: Code punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Syntax symbols, prompts, and structural boundaries in code or command-line snippets; co-occurs with the greater-than pattern, but may not be semantically related.
patterns.domain: PowerShell, program code, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Markup languages and attribute syntax
patterns.context: HTML attributes and closing-tag symbols, or percent signs in financial contexts; activation concentrates on special characters and nearby text.
patterns.domain: StackExchange web code; HackerNews financial discussions

patterns.name: Forum quoting and formatting
patterns.context: A leading > is used as a quotation marker in HN, and asterisks surround quotations; activation covers the symbols used in this formatting.

patterns.name: Unusual token fragments
patterns.context: Local token combinations such as numbers, units, slashes, chat usernames, and emoji, without an obvious unified semantics.

patterns.name: Commas and argument separators in code
patterns.context: Function calls use commas to separate arguments, with activation near argument boundaries; the cause may be code punctuation rather than a specific algorithm.

3_612.concept: 尖括号与结构标点
3_612.description: 主要对文本与代码中的尖括号/大于号敏感，涵盖引用符、命令提示符、比较符及标签闭合；也对代码结构标点和少数数字、单位、聊天符号产生激活。

patterns.name: 尖括号/大于号
patterns.trigger: «>»（包括独立的 >、命令提示符中的 >、HTML 标签闭合处及比较运算符）
patterns.context: 大于号及其相邻字符、标点或代码符号；有时是引用标记，有时是比较符号或命令提示符的一部分。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、聊天、代码、HTML 与问答

patterns.name: 代码标点与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或命令行片段中的语法符号、提示符和结构边界；与大于号模式同现，但未必语义相关。

patterns.name: 标记语言与属性语法
patterns.context: HTML 属性和标签闭合符号，或金融语境中的百分号；激活集中在特殊字符及其邻近文本。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 网页代码；HackerNews 金融讨论

patterns.name: 论坛引用与排版
patterns.context: HN 中行首的 > 用作引用标记，星号用于包裹引用；激活覆盖引用排版的符号。

patterns.name: 奇异 token 片段
patterns.context: 数字、单位、斜线、聊天用户名及表情符号等局部 token 组合，没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: 代码中的逗号与参数分隔
patterns.context: 函数调用中以逗号分隔参数，激活落在参数边界附近；原因可能是代码标点，而非特定算法。

en.description: The most stable response is to the greater-than sign, especially when it appears alone or in quotation, comparison, command-line redirection, and markup syntax. There are also sparse activations on angle-bracket tags, code symbols, and chat fragments, but it is unclear whether they share a mechanism.

patterns.name: Greater-than sign and following content
patterns.context: The greater-than sign appears as a standalone symbol or markup; activation usually falls on the symbol itself. It may be followed by a number, percentage sign, path text, or newline.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: forum text, code, terminal logs, chat logs

patterns.name: Angle brackets and HTML-like markup
patterns.context: Angle brackets enclose HTML/XML tags or markup; activation also occurs near tag boundaries, beyond the greater-than sign.

patterns.name: Command-line prompts and redirection
patterns.context: A command-line prompt ends in an angle bracket, or a greater-than sign redirects command output to a file.
patterns.domain: PowerShell, batch scripts, and terminal documentation

patterns.name: Greater-than sign in comparison or threshold expressions
patterns.context: The greater-than sign denotes a numerical comparison or threshold, followed on the right by a multiplier, probability percentage, or amount of money.

patterns.name: Explanation of HN quotation formatting
patterns.context: Explicitly discusses using a greater-than sign at the start of a line to mark a quotation and explains the formatting.

patterns.name: Corrupted characters and angle-bracket fragments in chat
patterns.context: An IRC message contains text enclosed in angle brackets with split annotations and an emoticon-like suffix; it is not clearly comparison or code syntax.

patterns.name: Other symbol fragments in code and technical contexts
patterns.context: Appears near text, HTML attributes, or signal-processing terminology, but has no unified independent trigger pattern; may reflect secondary symbol or tokenization-boundary activation.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, HTML, and patent background text

3_612.concept: 大于号及尖括号语法
3_612.description: 最稳定的反应是大于号，尤其独立出现或处于引用、比较、命令行重定向及标记语法中；另有少量尖括号标签、代码符号和聊天碎片激活，无法确认它们是否共享机制。

patterns.name: 大于号及其后的内容
patterns.context: 大于号作为独立符号或标记出现，激活通常落在符号本身；其后可接数字、百分号、路径文本或换行。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；论坛文本、代码、终端记录、聊天记录

patterns.name: 尖括号与类 HTML 标记
patterns.context: 尖括号用于包围 HTML/XML 标签或标记；除大于号外，标签边界附近也有激活。

patterns.name: 命令行提示符与重定向
patterns.context: 命令行提示符以尖括号结尾，或大于号用于将命令输出重定向到文件。
patterns.domain: PowerShell、批处理脚本与终端文档

patterns.name: 比较或阈值表达式中的大于号
patterns.context: 大于号表示数值比较或门槛，右侧接倍率、概率百分比或金额。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、交易讨论、消费讨论

patterns.name: HN 引用格式说明
patterns.context: 明确讨论在行首用大于号标示引用，并说明排版方式。

patterns.name: 损坏字符与聊天中的尖括号片段
patterns.context: IRC 发言中出现被拆分标注的尖括号包围文本及表情式尾缀；并非明显的比较或代码语法。

patterns.name: 代码与技术语境中的其他符号碎片
patterns.context: 在文本、HTML 属性或信号处理术语附近出现，但没有统一的独立触发规律；可能是次要的符号或分词边界激活。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、HTML 与专利背景文本

en.description: Activation is distributed across HTML/XML tags and attributes, LaTeX mathematical symbols, and key-value and range strings in code; racing proper-name abbreviations and proper nouns and symbols in email also occur. The commonality may be punctuation, delimiters, and local markers in structured text rather than a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: HTML/XML attributes and tag fragments
patterns.context: Triggers occur in HTML/XML tags, attributes, or closing tags, especially in structured markup composed of attribute names and values, angle brackets, and quotation marks; no particular attribute value appears necessary.
patterns.domain: Web markup, code, and web forms

patterns.name: Local symbols and delimiters in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Triggers occur in LaTeX mathematical expressions, often adjacent to backslash commands, braces, commas, or equations; the specific symbols triggering activation vary across segments.

patterns.name: Ranges, key-value pairs, and identifiers in code or tables
patterns.context: Appears in code, configuration, or form snippets containing quoted values, range strings, indices, or identifiers; partly overlaps with the HTML attribute pattern.
patterns.domain: Web/code text and spreadsheet programming Q&A

patterns.name: Proper nouns and sports event abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation appears in racing reports, concentrated near names, event or organization abbreviations, and team names; observed in only one segment.

patterns.name: Proper nouns, abbreviations, and special symbols in email
patterns.context: Appears in business email text involving company abbreviations, place names, or proper nouns, with activation concentrated near symbols such as `&`; its connection to the other patterns is unclear.

3_612.concept: 结构化文本标记与分隔符
3_612.description: 激活分布在HTML/XML标签与属性、LaTeX数学符号、代码中的键值和范围字符串；另见赛车专名缩写及邮件中的专名与符号。共同点可能是结构化文本中的标点、分隔符和局部标记，而非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: HTML/XML 属性与标签片段
patterns.context: 触发点位于 HTML/XML 标签、属性或闭合标签中，尤其是属性名和值、尖括号与引号构成的结构化标记；未见某个特定属性值是必要条件。
patterns.domain: 网页标记、代码及网页表单

patterns.name: 数学公式中的局部符号与分隔符
patterns.context: 触发于 LaTeX 数学表达式中，常邻接反斜杠命令、花括号、逗号或等式关系；不同片段触发的具体符号并不一致。

patterns.name: 代码或表格中的范围、键值及标识符
patterns.context: 出现在代码、配置或表单片段中，包含带引号的值、范围字符串、索引或标识符；与 HTML 属性模式有部分重叠。
patterns.domain: 网页/代码文本及电子表格编程问答

patterns.name: 专名及体育赛事缩写
patterns.context: 激活出现在赛车报道中，集中于人名、赛事或组织缩写及车队名称附近；只见于单段。
patterns.domain: 维基百科赛车赛事条目

patterns.name: 邮件中的专名、缩写与特殊符号
patterns.context: 出现在商务邮件正文中，涉及公司缩写、地名或专名，且激活集中在 `&` 等符号附近；与其他模式联系不明确。

en.concept: Local boundary symbols in structured text
en.description: Markers occur on angle brackets, arrows, and code/mathematical syntax symbols, and are scattered across English function words, technical terms, and string fragments; there is no stable, single semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Inline right angle bracket/arrow marker
patterns.context: Activation falls directly on the right angle bracket character, appearing near ordinary text boundaries, code prompts, or comparison operators; contexts vary widely across examples.
patterns.domain: Mixed text, terminal instructions, code, and mathematical notation

patterns.name: Structural symbols in code or commands
patterns.context: Trigger points are often punctuation, operators, and short identifiers in code, LaTeX, or commands; they are usually embedded in structured syntax.
patterns.domain: Programming, mathematical typesetting, and technical documentation

patterns.name: English function words and common phrases
patterns.context: A few activations fall on common English words or word components, in both prose and technical explanations; no stable semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Filename or technical string fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the FTP command “get energy-2.0-win32.exe”; activation covers the beginning of the filename.

patterns.name: Quantifier or distribution-description term
patterns.context: Appears in a paper sentence describing positive and negative class distributions and the distance between their means; activation covers only the local term.

patterns.name: In-word English fragment and numerical estimate
patterns.context: Activation falls on an in-word substring, pixel units, an approximation sign, or a greater-than sign in a sentence discussing model size and runtime.

patterns.name: PHP arrays and sorting comparison
patterns.context: Appears in array-key access and a comparison callback in PHP code; multiple local tokens are marked.

patterns.name: Repeated fragment
patterns.context: Two text segments and their marked positions are identical, possibly duplicated samples of the same command example; they do not form an independent semantic pattern.

3_612.concept: 结构化文本中的局部边界符号
3_612.description: 标记分布在尖括号、箭头及代码/数学语法符号上，也零散落在英文功能词、技术术语和字符串片段上；没有稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 行内右尖括号/箭头标记
patterns.context: 激活直接落在右尖括号字符上，出现在普通文本边界、代码提示或比较运算符附近；各例上下文差异很大。
patterns.domain: 混合文本、终端说明、代码与数学记号

patterns.name: 代码或命令中的结构符号
patterns.context: 触发点多为代码、LaTeX 或命令中的标点、运算符及短标识符；通常嵌在结构化语法中。
patterns.domain: 编程、数学排版与技术文档

patterns.name: 英文功能词及常见短语
patterns.trigger: « very»、« subject»、« data»、« being»、« but»、« can»、« for»、« to»、« easy»、« reason»、« between»、« mean»、« so»
patterns.context: 少量激活落在常见英文词或词组成分上，既有句子正文，也有技术说明；未显示稳定的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 文件名或技术字符串片段
patterns.context: 出现在 FTP 命令“get energy-2.0-win32.exe”中，激活覆盖文件名开头片段。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的终端/软件使用说明

patterns.name: 量词或分布描述术语
patterns.context: 在描述正负类分布及其均值间距的论文句子中出现；激活只覆盖术语局部。

patterns.name: 英文词内部片段与数字估计
patterns.context: 激活落在词内子串、像素单位、近似号或大于号上，所在句讨论模型规模与运行速度。

patterns.name: PHP 数组与排序比较
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP 代码的数组键访问及比较回调中，多个局部 token 被标记。

patterns.name: 片段重复
patterns.context: 两段文本及标记位置完全相同，可能是同一命令示例的重复采样；不构成独立语义模式。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的 FTP 操作说明

en.concept: Angle brackets and technical text symbols
en.description: Activations are broadly distributed. A prominent shared cue is angle brackets/comparison and arrow symbols, especially in code, markup, or quantity thresholds. Other examples span unrelated contexts such as SQL, data structures, statistics, comments, technical planning, mathematics, and record websites, and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Greater-than/angle-bracket symbols
patterns.context: A greater-than sign or arrow appears in ordinary text, code, pseudo-markup, or near numeric thresholds; it usually serves as an expression, comparison, or direction symbol
patterns.domain: Forum comments, technical discussions, code, and data descriptions

patterns.name: Code operators in angle brackets
patterns.context: Symbols are embedded in program code or serial-command examples, alongside variables, method calls, or assignments

patterns.name: SQL UNION query keyword
patterns.context: UNION ALL is used in an SQL query to combine SELECT result sets

patterns.name: Code structure delimiters and punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation is adjacent to code, configuration, or hierarchical descriptions and may separate fields, types, or statements

patterns.name: List/hierarchy terms and fields
patterns.context: Describes the hierarchy and fields of a Q&A data structure, with numbers or code markers beside terms

patterns.name: Statistical distributions and classification evaluation
patterns.context: Discusses positive and negative class distributions, class proportions, and simulation results

patterns.name: Rebuttal or disagreement
patterns.context: A commenter apologizes and then disputes the credibility of a video or claim

patterns.name: Discussion and failure-scenario planning
patterns.context: Discusses observer configuration and emphasizes understanding, planning, and handling failure scenarios in advance

patterns.name: Date and database update code
patterns.context: Python-style code constructs a date string and updates a database field

patterns.name: Geometric theorem and grade conditions
patterns.context: A geometry theorem demonstration mentions grade conditions for variables a and b; the specific relationship is truncated or malformed

patterns.name: Scale of a record-auction website
patterns.context: Introduces a website that collects vinyl record auction and sales data daily and indicates its scale with a greater-than sign

3_612.concept: 尖括号及技术文本符号
3_612.description: 激活分布很散，较突出的共同线索是尖括号/比较与箭头符号，尤其出现在代码、标记或数量阈值中；另覆盖 SQL、数据结构、统计、评论、技术规划、数学及唱片网站等各自不同语境，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 大于/尖括号符号
patterns.context: 大于号或箭头出现在普通文本、代码、伪标记或数字阈值附近；通常属于表达式、比较或方向符号
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、技术讨论、代码与数据描述

patterns.name: 尖括号中的代码运算符
patterns.context: 符号嵌在程序代码或串口命令示例中，周围有变量、方法调用或赋值

patterns.name: SQL 联合查询关键字
patterns.context: SQL 查询中用 UNION ALL 拼接 SELECT 结果集

patterns.name: 代码结构分隔符与标点
patterns.context: 标点紧邻代码、配置或层级说明，可能用于分隔字段、类型或语句

patterns.name: 列表/层级术语及字段
patterns.context: 说明问答数据结构的层级与字段，词语旁有编号或代码标记

patterns.name: 统计分布与分类评估
patterns.context: 讨论正负类别分布、类别比例及模拟结果

patterns.name: 反驳或不认同表达
patterns.context: 评论者表示歉意后否定某视频或说法的可信度

patterns.name: 讨论与失败场景规划
patterns.context: 谈观察器配置，强调预先理解、规划和处理故障情形

patterns.name: 日期与数据库更新代码
patterns.context: Python 风格代码构造日期字符串并更新数据库字段

patterns.name: 几何定理与成绩条件
patterns.context: 几何定理演示中提及变量 a、b 的成绩条件；具体关系被截断或格式异常

patterns.name: 唱片拍卖网站规模
patterns.context: 介绍每日收集黑胶唱片拍卖与销售数据的网站，并用大于号给出规模

en.concept: Local patterns in markup and delimiters
en.description: Activation is scattered across contexts, more often near boundary markers such as angle brackets and quotation marks and neighboring tokens; it also appears around email addresses, code fields, HTML attributes, and mathematical symbols. There is no clear, consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Angle-bracket marker before an English word or phrase
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the closing angle bracket and the following number; subsequent content may be colloquial, technical, or mathematical, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Comma and local email-address context
patterns.context: Contains names, commas, angle brackets, and email addresses in an email header; activation is scattered.

patterns.name: Strings and field names in code
patterns.context: Code or explanations of code structure, with activation on quotation marks, field names enclosed in angle brackets, and placeholder-like identifiers.

patterns.name: Near HTML/CSS attribute values
patterns.context: In HTML documents and form markup, attributes, quotation marks, tag boundaries, and values occur together.

patterns.name: Local mathematical notation and formulas
patterns.context: Punctuation and mathematical symbols in formulas, modulo expressions, or theorem statements; no consistent mathematical-semantic trigger is evident.

3_612.concept: 标记与分隔符局部模式
3_612.description: 激活分散在不同语境，较常见于尖括号/引号等边界标记及其邻近 token；也出现在邮件地址、代码字段、HTML 属性和数学符号周围。没有清晰一致的语义主题。

patterns.name: 英文词或短语前的尖括号标记
patterns.context: 激活集中在尖括号闭合符号以及紧随其后的数字；后续内容可为口语、技术描述或数学文字，没有稳定的语义主题

patterns.name: 逗号及邮箱地址局部
patterns.context: 包含姓名、逗号、尖括号和邮箱地址的邮件头部；激活较分散

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串与字段名
patterns.context: 代码或对代码结构的说明，激活落在引号、尖括号包裹的字段名及类似编号占位符上

patterns.name: HTML/CSS 属性值附近
patterns.context: HTML 文档及表单标记中，属性、引号、标签边界与值交错出现

patterns.name: 数学记号及公式局部
patterns.context: 公式、取模表达式或定理陈述中的标点与数学符号；未见统一的数学语义触发项

en.description: Activations occur on punctuation, syntax boundaries, strings, and path fragments in various code, SQL, HTML, and URL contexts. There are also email address/forwarding formats and sporadic words in a technical prose passage, with no single stable triggering feature.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax boundaries in code
patterns.context: Appears in code, SQL, HTML, or URLs, often at statement separators, assignments, parameter separators, concatenations, and tag boundaries; the specific punctuation trigger varies by fragment.

patterns.name: URL and path fragments
patterns.context: In URLs, API endpoints, short links, or request paths assembled from variables, activations fall on URL components and their delimiters.

patterns.name: Email addresses and forwarding formats
patterns.context: Addresses, mailto markers, and encoded recipient information in email headers or forwarded messages.

patterns.name: String literals and field names in code
patterns.context: Quoted strings, identifiers, and configuration names in code or HTML attributes; activations occur across these literals and surrounding punctuation.

patterns.name: Ordinary English phrases
patterns.context: Ordinary English sentences in technical explanatory prose, with only sporadic words marked and no clear trigger condition consistent with code punctuation.

patterns.name: SQL query structure
patterns.context: Table names, clause keywords, conditions, and grouping structure in SQL queries; activations span different elements, including keywords, identifiers, and quotation marks.

patterns.name: Names/recipient encoding in email addresses
patterns.context: Names embedded in email addresses and forwarding/routing encodings; whether the names themselves trigger activations is uncertain because the entire span contains several email-format components.

patterns.name: Numbers, variables, and assignment fragments in code
patterns.context: Variable declarations, initialization, and function calls in C-style example code; markers are concentrated around assignment symbols, variables, and delimiters.

patterns.name: Query parameter concatenation
patterns.context: URL query parameters are constructed by string concatenation, with parameter names and values joined by an encoding function.

patterns.name: HTML attributes and control text
patterns.context: In HTML form control tags, attribute names, values, and closing-tag symbols are all marked.

3_612.concept: 代码与结构化文本片段
3_612.description: 激活出现在多种代码、SQL、HTML及URL中的标点、语法边界、字符串和路径片段；另有邮件地址/转发格式与一段技术散文中的零星词语，未呈现统一而稳定的单一触发特征。

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与语法边界
patterns.context: 出现在代码、SQL、HTML 或 URL 中，常位于语句分隔、赋值、参数分隔、拼接及标签边界处；具体触发标点随片段而异。

patterns.name: URL 与路径片段
patterns.context: 网址、API 端点、短链接或由变量拼接的请求路径中，激活落在 URL 组成部分及其分隔符上。
patterns.domain: 网页/API 与超链接文本

patterns.name: 邮件地址和转发格式
patterns.context: 邮件头或转发邮件中的地址、mailto 标记及编码后的收件人信息。

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串字面量与字段名
patterns.context: 代码或 HTML 属性中的带引号字符串、标识符及配置项名称；激活分布在这些字面量及其周边标点。

patterns.name: 普通英语短语
patterns.context: 技术说明性散文中的普通英语句子，只有零星词语被标记，未见与代码标点一致的明确触发条件。

patterns.name: SQL 查询结构
patterns.context: SQL 查询中表名、子句关键字、条件及分组结构；激活覆盖关键字、标识符和引号等不同成分。

patterns.name: 邮件地址中的姓名/收件人编码
patterns.trigger: « Timothy»、«M»及地址中«smith»«tm»等姓名与本地部分
patterns.context: 姓名嵌入邮件地址及转发/路由编码中；是否由姓名本身触发不确定，因整段包含多种邮箱格式成分。

patterns.name: 代码中数字、变量及赋值片段
patterns.context: C 风格示例代码的变量声明、初始化与函数调用；标记主要集中在赋值符号、变量和分隔符。

patterns.name: 查询参数拼接
patterns.context: 通过字符串连接构造 URL 查询参数，参数名和值由编码函数拼接。

patterns.name: HTML 属性与控件文本
patterns.context: HTML 表单控件标签中，属性名、属性值和标签闭合符号均有标记。

en.description: Activation often occurs in string concatenation in code, especially when variables are inserted into URL query parameters; it is also scattered across code punctuation, SQL structure, HTML tags, conditionals, identifiers, and specific formatting or voting logic, with no unified lexical theme.

patterns.name: String concatenation and plus signs
patterns.context: Code uses plus signs to join strings, variables, parameters, or expressions; the local content immediately following «+» is often a number, variable name, or quoted string.
patterns.domain: Java, JavaScript, SQL, and other code snippets

patterns.name: URL query parameter construction
patterns.context: Variables are concatenated into URL query strings, often with parameter names, equals signs, and encoding or request calls; this overlaps with the previous pattern but may also trigger independently.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntactic boundaries
patterns.context: Marks structural boundaries of expressions, statements, or tags; some activations fall on parentheses, braces, or periods rather than string concatenation.
patterns.domain: Program code, including Java, JavaScript, and HTML

patterns.name: SQL query structure
patterns.context: Tables, join conditions, and filters in relational database queries; activation in this example is distributed over query keywords and identifiers.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Subword fragments within variable names, property names, or strings, usually inside code identifiers or paths; the fragments vary considerably and show no unified semantics.
patterns.domain: Web/API, frontend code, and general program code

patterns.name: HTML tags and attributes
patterns.context: HTML elements, their attributes, and values; activation points occur near button markup.

patterns.name: Conditional expressions and equality comparisons
patterns.context: Uses strict equality and logical OR to check string values, then enters a conditional branch.

patterns.name: Number formatting and duration display
patterns.context: Branches on whether the seconds value is less than 10, then concatenates minutes, a colon, and seconds to display a duration; the trigger is mainly punctuation in formatting code.

patterns.name: Voting calls and redirection
patterns.context: Updates a vote count, handles a callback, and redirects the response to a page containing an id; activation combines object structure and general code punctuation.

3_612.concept: 代码拼接与结构标点
3_612.description: 激活多见于代码中的字符串拼接，尤其是将变量接入 URL 查询参数；也散见于代码标点、SQL 结构、HTML 标签、条件判断、标识符及特定格式化或投票逻辑，未显示统一的词义主题。

patterns.name: 字符串拼接与加号
patterns.trigger: «+»，尤其是变量、引号或 URL 片段之间的 «+»
patterns.context: 代码中用加号连接字符串、变量、参数或表达式；局部常紧接 «+» 的是数字、变量名或带引号的字符串。

patterns.name: URL 查询参数构造
patterns.context: 把变量拼入 URL 查询字符串，常包含参数名、等号及编码或请求调用；与上一模式有重叠，但也可能独立触发。

patterns.name: 标点与语法边界
patterns.context: 标记表达式、语句或标签的结构边界；有些激活落在括号、花括号或句点上，而非字符串拼接。

patterns.name: SQL 查询结构
patterns.context: 关系数据库查询中的表、连接条件和筛选语句；本例激活分布在查询关键字和标识符上。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的词片段
patterns.context: 变量名、属性名或字符串中包含的词片段，通常处于代码标识符或路径名内；片段彼此差异较大，没有显示出统一语义。
patterns.domain: Web/API、前端代码及一般程序代码

patterns.name: HTML 标签与属性
patterns.context: HTML 元素及其属性和值；激活点落在按钮标记附近。

patterns.name: 条件表达式与相等比较
patterns.context: 用严格相等和逻辑或判断字符串值，随后进入条件分支。
patterns.domain: JavaScript 配置或目录判断代码

patterns.name: 数字格式化与时长显示
patterns.trigger: «(»、«+»、«:0»、«+»，位于 durationmin 与 durationsec 的格式化表达式中
patterns.context: 按秒数是否小于 10 分支，拼接分钟、冒号和秒数以显示时长；触发主要是格式化代码中的标点。

patterns.name: 投票调用与重定向
patterns.context: 更新投票计数后处理回调，并将响应重定向到带 id 的页面；激活点混合了对象结构和通用代码标点。
patterns.domain: JavaScript/服务器端 Web 代码

en.description: Primarily responds to punctuation and strings used to concatenate URL query parameters in code and links. It also activates on a pointer-alignment warning, two encoded email names, and colon concatenation in a time display.

patterns.name: URL query parameter concatenation and encoding
patterns.context: Code constructs URLs or query strings, often joining variables with parameter names and values using &, =, and +; some parameter values are URL-encoded.
patterns.domain: Programming code, web/API requests, and links with tracking parameters

patterns.name: Pointer type-cast safety text
patterns.context: A warning about pointer conversion and memory alignment appears in a safety rule or technical document; activations are concentrated on multiple words in the English rule sentence.

patterns.name: Formatting and encoding names and email addresses
patterns.context: Names, email addresses, or email header information are represented in a format resembling printable encoding, with punctuation and spaces encoded or replaced by plus signs.

patterns.name: Colon concatenation in time display
patterns.context: Code combines minutes and seconds into a time-display string; activations fall especially on the colon and adjacent string-concatenation symbols.

3_612.concept: 字符串拼接与编码标点
3_612.description: 主要响应代码和链接中拼接 URL 查询参数的标点与字符串；另对一段指针对齐警告、两段邮件姓名编码，以及时间显示中的冒号拼接激活。

patterns.name: URL 查询参数拼接与编码
patterns.context: 代码中构造 URL 或查询字符串，常把变量与参数名、参数值用 &、=、+ 拼接；部分参数值经过 URL 编码。
patterns.domain: 编程代码、网页/API 请求及带追踪参数的链接

patterns.name: 指针类型转换安全性文字
patterns.trigger: «Do not cast pointers into more strictly aligned pointer types»
patterns.context: 安全规则或技术文档中出现关于指针转换和内存对齐的警告；激活集中在英文规则句的多个词上。

patterns.name: 姓名与邮箱地址的格式化编码

patterns.name: 时间显示的冒号拼接
patterns.context: 代码将分钟和秒拼成时间显示字符串；激活尤其落在冒号及其相邻的字符串拼接符号上。

en.concept: Symbols and structural boundaries in technical text
en.description: Activation is scattered across code, structured data, formulas, URLs, and scientific-results text, often falling on punctuation, symbols, and field boundaries; the medical passages also involve significance tests, group differences, or ratio reporting.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula delimiters
patterns.context: Appears in formulas, mathematical expressions, or inline mathematical notation; activation falls on dollar signs, backslashes, and parts of formulas rather than a single unified mathematical theme.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, ArXiv mathematical or physics text

patterns.name: Punctuation and delimiters
patterns.context: Functions as punctuation, operators, or field delimiters in code, URLs, formulas, or numerical expressions.

patterns.name: Configuration and assignment syntax in code
patterns.context: Appears in shell/autoconf-style code involving macros, variable expansion, conditional branches, and assignments.

patterns.name: JSON keys, values, and data fields
patterns.context: Appears in JSON or similar structured configuration, with activation near field names, string values, and their boundaries.

patterns.name: Technical URLs and instruction phrases in code examples
patterns.context: In URL paths and URL-encoded security rule titles, periods, plus signs, and English words all receive activation.

patterns.name: Statistical significance and comparisons
patterns.context: Appears when reporting group differences, significance tests, or comparisons with a control group; activation also covers neighboring common words and punctuation.

patterns.name: Ratios and numerical values in biomedical results
patterns.context: Reports proportions such as fusion rates in embryonic experimental results, along with statistical test values.

3_612.concept: 技术文本中的符号与结构边界
3_612.description: 激活分散于代码、结构化数据、公式、URL及科研结果文本，常落在标点、符号和字段边界；医学段另涉及显著性检验、组间差异或比率报告。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式分隔符
patterns.context: 在公式、数学表达式或行内数学符号中；激活落在美元符号、反斜杠和公式局部，而非某个统一数学主题。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、ArXiv 数学或物理文本

patterns.name: 标点与分隔符
patterns.context: 在代码、网址、公式或数值表达中充当标点、运算符或字段分隔符。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术问答、科学文本

patterns.name: 代码中的配置与赋值语法
patterns.context: 出现在 shell/autoconf 风格代码中，涉及宏、变量展开、条件分支和赋值。

patterns.name: JSON键值与数据字段
patterns.context: 出现在 JSON 或类似结构化配置中，字段名、字符串值及其边界附近激活。

patterns.name: 代码示例中的技术URL与指令短语
patterns.context: URL 路径及被 URL 编码的安全规则标题中，点号、加号和英文词均有激活。

patterns.name: 统计显著性与比较表述
patterns.context: 在报告组间差异、显著性检验或与对照组比较时；激活也覆盖邻近常见词和标点。

patterns.name: 生物医学结果中的比率与数值
patterns.context: 在胚胎实验结果中报告融合率等比例，并附统计检验值。

en.description: Activations occur on formula markers and technical terms in several types of academic text, as well as author-name fragments and JavaScript search-suggestion code; no shared triggering pattern is clear.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formulas in body text
patterns.context: Near mathematical expressions or formula formatting, activations often fall on LaTeX markers, set symbols, and formula interiors rather than a single mathematical concept; contexts include inline formulas, definitions, and tensor expressions.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and other academic papers

patterns.name: Technical terms or noun phrases in academic text
patterns.context: In scientific paper prose, markers fall on technical terms or noun phrases; the topics vary across passages, with no consistent field-specific semantics.
patterns.domain: Biomedical and instrument-physics papers, among other academic texts

patterns.name: Syllable fragment in an author name
patterns.context: Occurs in the author list name Jaramillo; the activation covers only part of the name and may reflect the name or a subword fragment.

patterns.name: Search-suggestion-related identifiers in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript function and URL query-parameter concatenation code, activations involve identifiers related to search suggestions and string-concatenation operators.

3_612.concept: none
3_612.description: 激活分布于多类学术文本的公式标记与专业术语，也出现在作者姓名片段和 JavaScript 搜索建议代码中；共同触发规律不明确。

patterns.name: 正文中的数学符号与公式
patterns.context: 数学表达式或公式排版附近，激活常落在 LaTeX 标记、集合符号及公式内部，而非单一数学概念；覆盖含行内公式、定义和张量表达式的上下文。

patterns.name: 学术文本中的专业术语或名词搭配
patterns.context: 科学论文正文叙述中，标记落在专业名词或名词短语上；各段所涉主题不同，未见统一领域语义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、仪器物理等学术论文

patterns.name: 作者姓名的音节片段

patterns.name: 代码中的搜索建议相关标识符
patterns.context: JavaScript 函数及 URL 查询参数拼接代码中，激活涉及建议搜索功能的标识符和字符串连接符。

en.concept: Local features of LaTeX and academic text
en.description: Activation often occurs in ArXiv LaTeX formulas, formatting boundaries, and scientific terminology, and also covers author affiliations and forum English; cross-passage shared patterns are weak, and specific triggers vary by context.

patterns.name: Local markers in mathematical/scientific symbols
patterns.context: In formulas, set definitions, or mathematical derivations, activation falls on variables, relation symbols, backslashes, and nearby LaTeX fragments; topics include tensors, functional analysis, congruences, and partial derivatives.
patterns.domain: LaTeX text in mathematics and theoretical science

patterns.name: LaTeX commands and formatting structure
patterns.context: Commands, brackets, line breaks, and formatting boundaries in formulas or paper source; some trigger points are near formula definitions or author information.

patterns.name: English scientific nouns and descriptive words
patterns.context: Descriptions in scientific papers concerning phase and temperature, device performance, or experimental detectors and instrument components; trigger words are mostly nouns or adjectives.
patterns.domain: Physics, materials, devices, and experimental papers

patterns.name: Common grammatical words in ordinary English
patterns.context: Natural English sentences, especially informal remarks about a technology or learning experience; multiple common words in the same passage are marked.

patterns.name: Markers near names and author affiliations
patterns.context: Around paper author lists and institutional affiliations, activation is scattered across punctuation, names, conjunctions, and symbols.

3_612.concept: LaTeX与学术文本局部特征
3_612.description: 激活多见于 ArXiv 的 LaTeX 公式、排版边界及科学术语，也覆盖署名和论坛英语；跨段的共同模式较弱，具体触发随语境而变。

patterns.name: 数学/科学符号中的局部标记
patterns.context: 公式、集合定义或数学推导中，激活落在变量、关系符号、反斜杠及其周围的 LaTeX 片段；涉及张量、泛函分析、同余和偏导等不同内容
patterns.domain: 数学与理论科学的 LaTeX 文本

patterns.name: LaTeX 命令与排版结构
patterns.context: 公式或论文源码中的命令、括号、换行和排版边界；有些触发点紧邻公式定义或作者信息

patterns.name: 英文科学名词及描述词
patterns.context: 科学论文正文中关于相态与温度、器件性能，或实验探测器和仪器部件的描述；触发词多为名词或形容词
patterns.domain: 物理、材料、器件及实验论文

patterns.name: 普通英文中的常见语法词
patterns.context: 自然英文句子中，尤其是讨论某项技术或学习体验的非正式表达；同一段中多个普通词被标记

patterns.name: 姓名及作者署名附近的标记
patterns.context: 论文作者列表和机构署名周围，激活分散在标点、名字、连词及符号上

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and formatting symbols
en.description: Activations are distributed across formulas and scientific typography, code/markup syntax, and ordinary word fragments. They often fall on punctuation, LaTeX/HTML tokens, and substrings within words; the examples lack stable semantic or stylistic conditions.

patterns.name: Numbers, exponents, and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Near mathematical expressions, physical quantities, subscripts/superscripts, or parameter ranges; activations sometimes concentrate on punctuation and formatting tokens rather than ordinary word meaning

patterns.name: Specific letter fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: In technical or academic text, the triggering fragment is embedded in a full term or name; these fragments have no obvious shared meaning

patterns.name: Code, markup languages, and entities
patterns.context: Near LaTeX, HTML entities, or code syntax
patterns.domain: Web pages, code, and typesetting source

patterns.name: Ordinary English word fragments
patterns.context: English words or intra-word fragments in different contexts; no stable semantic or syntactic condition is apparent
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, forums, and code documentation

patterns.name: Lowercase Greek letters and formula variables
patterns.context: Occurs in formula variables, parameters, or angle notation

patterns.name: Line breaks and document-structure boundaries
patterns.context: Near text line breaks or document-environment boundaries

3_612.concept: 异质文本片段及格式符号
3_612.description: 激活分布于公式与科学排版、代码/标记语法及普通词片段，常落在标点、LaTeX/HTML token 和词内子串上；各例缺乏稳定的语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 数字、指数及数学符号

patterns.context: 数学表达式、物理量、上下标或参数范围附近；有时激活集中在标点和格式 token 上，而非普通词义

patterns.name: 技术术语中的特定字母片段

patterns.name: 代码、标记语言与实体

patterns.name: 普通英语词语片段
patterns.context: 不同语境中的英语词语或词内片段；未见稳定的语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 科学论文、论坛及代码说明

patterns.name: 小写希腊字母及公式变量

patterns.name: 换行与文档结构边界
patterns.context: 文本换行或文档环境边界附近

Their commonality is not specific enough; marked tokens often fall on subword fragments, punctuation, or format tokens.

patterns.name: Terminology and measurements in technical papers

patterns.domain: Physics, detectors, experiments, and electricity market papers or reports

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematics and typesetting markers
patterns.context: Commands, brackets, variables, and punctuation appear in mathematical formulas, probability expressions, equation numbers, or LaTeX document structure
patterns.domain: Mathematics and natural science paper typesetting

patterns.name: Email addresses and header fields

patterns.name: Visual Basic / AutoCAD code and exception handling
patterns.context: Code snippets contain types or namespaces, exception handling, message boxes, and string concatenation

patterns.name: Author names and institutional affiliations

patterns.name: Conference titles, dates, and document artifacts

patterns.name: 科技论文中的术语与量值
patterns.context: 论文正文或技术说明中出现领域术语，常邻接测量值、实验条件或设备描述；各段具体触发词并不相同

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学与排版标记

patterns.name: 作者姓名与机构署名

patterns.context: Operators or SQL keywords occur in expressions, URL parameters, string concatenations, or queries, often adjacent to variables, punctuation, and quotation marks

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and units in technical documents

patterns.name: Electric in proper names

3_612.description: 激活分布于代码中的运算符、连接符与 SQL 语法，科学论文的公式符号和单位，以及少数商务文本里的 Electric 电力市场标题、Python city 属性和日程 room 信息。

patterns.name: 代码中的符号与连接运算

patterns.name: 技术文档中的数学符号与单位
patterns.trigger: 公式或科学记号中的 «$»、«,»，以及 «	heta»、«^{\circ}»、«K» 等

patterns.name: 地点字段 city

patterns.name: 时间与房间信息
patterns.context: 活动日程中给出会议室、时间和费用信息

en.description: Four segments activate on speculative structures using looks/seem/looked as though/if; another three activate on dense punctuation, parameters, and field syntax in Ruby or R code. The two patterns span different domains and have visibly different surface forms.

patterns.name: “looks as though” speculative structure
patterns.context: Uses looks as though to introduce a speculation or judgment about what follows; often preceded by it, with a full clause after though.
patterns.domain: News, email, forums, and general narration

patterns.name: “seem as if” speculative structure
patterns.context: Uses seem as if to introduce the speaker’s speculation about what follows.

patterns.name: “looked as if” speculative structure
patterns.context: Past-tense look followed by as if, expressing that a situation seemed likely to occur.

patterns.name: Ruby hash parameters and symbol punctuation
patterns.context: In Ruby/Rails code, colons, arrows, and do occur in sequence near hash key-value pairs and block parameters.

patterns.name: Key-value parameters in test code
patterns.context: A parameter list of multiple symbol keys and string values in Ruby/Puppet test code.

patterns.name: Statistical fields and assignment in R code
patterns.context: R code contains function-call arguments, assignments, and access to statistical result fields using $.

patterns.name: Formatting and column references in R code
patterns.context: R code formats data with sprintf and references data-frame columns using $; activations fall on code identifiers and punctuation.

3_612.concept: 推测从句与代码标点
3_612.description: 四段激活于 looks/seem/looked as though/if 推测结构；另三段激活于 Ruby 或 R 代码中密集的标点、参数和字段语法。两个模式跨域且表面差异明显。

patterns.name: “looks as though”推测结构
patterns.context: 以 looks as though 引出对后续情况的推测或判断；前面常有 it，though 后接完整分句。
patterns.domain: 新闻、邮件、论坛和一般叙述

patterns.name: “seem as if”推测结构
patterns.context: 以 seem as if 引出说话者对后续情形的推测。

patterns.name: “looked as if”推测结构
patterns.context: 过去时 look 后接 as if，表达某种情况似乎可能发生。

patterns.name: Ruby 哈希参数与符号标点
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails 代码中，哈希键值及块参数附近的冒号、箭头和 do 连续出现。

patterns.name: 测试代码中的键值参数
patterns.context: Ruby/Puppet 测试代码中，多个符号键及字符串值组成的参数列表。

patterns.name: R 代码中的统计字段与赋值
patterns.context: R 代码中出现函数调用参数、赋值和用 $ 访问统计结果字段。

patterns.name: R 代码中的格式化与列引用
patterns.context: R 代码中以 sprintf 格式化数据，并通过 $ 引用数据框列；激活落在代码标识符及标点上。

en.description: Activations are concentrated on structural markers, URL/query-parameter punctuation, and subword fragments of technical identifiers; sporadic patterns also involve electricity-related words, possessive apostrophes, and code fields. Text types and semantic spans vary widely, and some activations may arise from subword or punctuation forms.

patterns.name: Markup and format delimiters
patterns.context: Structural delimiters formed by consecutive hyphens, line breaks, or equal signs; activation falls on the delimiters themselves rather than adjacent semantic text

patterns.name: Punctuation and separators in URLs/query parameters
patterns.context: Encoding, parameter boundaries, and connecting punctuation in URLs, query strings, or paths; a segment may also contain partial activations on domain or parameter names

patterns.name: Subword fragments of technical identifiers
patterns.context: Several fragments activate individually after long domains, paths, variables, or identifiers are split into subwords; no consistent lexical condition is evident

patterns.name: Electricity-related word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in electricity market conference titles and forecasting contexts

patterns.name: Possessive apostrophes and adjacent text
patterns.context: Marked near possessive apostrophes, as in “Today’s”“Economist.com’s”“author’s”; occurs in in-sentence text, not only URLs

patterns.name: Numeric/object markers in web text
patterns.context: Image placeholders or question-mark-style markers appear in conference document excerpts

patterns.name: Attribute assignment structure in code
patterns.context: JavaScript assigns response text to a property and constructs a request with query parameters; some activations also match the URL/punctuation pattern

patterns.name: API paths and parameter fields
patterns.context: Path segments, tokens, and query parameters in Foursquare API URLs; overlaps with the URL/punctuation pattern

patterns.name: JSON/GitHub repository fields
patterns.context: JSON repository objects and GitHub URLs, with activations scattered across subword fragments in fields and values

patterns.name: Python data manipulation expressions
patterns.context: Code that constructs a pandas Series, concatenates data, and renames columns; activations mainly fall near assignments, dots, commas, and arguments

patterns.name: RSS source labels in web addresses
patterns.context: FeedBurner tracking parameters and Ars Technica source markers; mainly overlaps with the URL substring pattern

patterns.name: VR discussion links
patterns.context: Reddit Oculus Quest discussion links; activations fall on domain and path subwords

patterns.name: Residual activations near a developer handle and plant text
patterns.context: Occurs near the username “fible” after a divider and “Sassafras leaves”; difficult to explain through shared semantics

3_612.concept: 结构标点与标识符片段

patterns.name: 标记与格式分隔符
patterns.context: 连续横线、换行或等号构成的结构分隔符；激活落在分隔符本身，而非相邻语义文本上

patterns.name: URL/查询参数中的标点与连接符

patterns.domain: 网页链接、API 请求、代码

patterns.name: 技术标识符的子词片段
patterns.context: 长域名、路径、变量或标识符被切成子词后，若干片段单独激活；未见统一的词义条件

patterns.name: 电力相关词片段
patterns.context: 出现在电力市场会议标题及预测语境中

patterns.name: 所有格撇号及其邻接
patterns.context: 所有格撇号附近被标记，见“Today’s”“Economist.com’s”“author’s”；在句内文本中而非仅限 URL

patterns.name: 网页文本中的数字/对象标记
patterns.context: 图像占位符或问号样式标记出现在会议文档摘录中

patterns.name: 代码中的属性赋值结构
patterns.context: JavaScript 将响应文本赋给属性，并构造带查询参数的请求；其中部分激活也符合 URL/标点模式

patterns.name: API 路径与参数字段
patterns.context: Foursquare API 地址中的分段路径、令牌和查询参数；与 URL/标点模式重叠

patterns.name: JSON/GitHub 仓库字段
patterns.context: JSON 仓库对象及 GitHub URL，激活分散在字段和值的子词片段

patterns.name: Python 数据操作表达式
patterns.context: pandas 中构造 Series、拼接数据并重命名列的代码；激活主要位于赋值、点号、逗号及参数附近

patterns.name: 网页地址中的 RSS 来源标签
patterns.context: FeedBurner 的追踪参数及 Ars Technica 来源标记；主要与 URL 子串模式重叠

patterns.name: VR 讨论链接
patterns.context: Reddit 的 Oculus Quest 讨论链接；激活落在域名及路径子词上

patterns.name: 开发者名片与植物文本中的残余激活
patterns.context: 出现在分隔线后的用户名“fible”和“Sassafras leaves”邻近位置，难以由共同语义解释

en.description: Activations are scattered across Polish word fragments, English phrases, technical URLs and code, Reddit links, and sports text. They recur around URL punctuation, path fragments, and “looks as though,” but the triggering conditions are not uniform.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment pos
patterns.context: Occurs inside Polish words such as “posła” and “posiedzeniu”; adjacent word fragments also activate, but the primary trigger falls on this word segment.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment of
patterns.context: Embedded in words such as “Ecofin” and “ecofriendly,” with adjacent word fragments also activating.

patterns.name: Web and code markup
patterns.context: Multiple punctuation and proper-name fragments activate in URLs, HTML tags, or API paths.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, program code, and web links

patterns.name: English phrase fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in the English expressions “looks as though” or “seem as if,” but activation is inconsistent across tokens.

patterns.name: Technical intra-word fragment sender
patterns.context: Located in the phrase “power or sender wire.”

patterns.name: File and parameter fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in the path, file extension, and query parameters of a Microsoft download URL.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A and software installation instructions

patterns.name: Separator lines and adjacent text
patterns.context: Activations occur near usernames or random strings after forum separator lines; no stable lexical condition can be identified.

patterns.name: Reddit link fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in Reddit URL paths and their substrings; path separators and some site and path tokens activate.

patterns.name: Basketball proper names and date markers
patterns.context: In NBA player/team news and date or statistics fields; some activations overlap with English phrases, and «OR» may also be an intra-name fragment.
patterns.domain: Sports news or forwarded email content

3_612.concept: 文本片段与标点模式
3_612.description: 激活分散于波兰语词片段、英语短语、技术网址与代码、Reddit链接及体育文本。多次出现在网址标点、路径片段和“looks as though”附近，但触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: 词内片段 pos
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语词内部，如“posła”“posiedzeniu”；后续紧邻词片段也有激活，但触发主要落在该词段。

patterns.name: 词内片段 of
patterns.context: 嵌在“Ecofin”“ecofriendly”等词中，并伴随相邻词片段激活。

patterns.name: 网页与代码标记
patterns.context: 网址、HTML 标签或 API 路径中，多个标点和专名片段连续激活。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、程序代码、网页链接

patterns.name: 英语短语片段
patterns.context: 出现在英语“looks as though”或“seem as if”表达中；但各 token 的激活并不一致。

patterns.name: 技术词内片段 sender
patterns.context: 位于“power or sender wire”短语中。

patterns.name: 文件与参数片段
patterns.context: 出现在微软下载网址的路径、文件后缀及查询参数中。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、软件安装说明

patterns.name: 分隔线及紧邻文本
patterns.context: 论坛分隔线后、用户名或随机字符串附近出现激活；难以确定稳定的词汇条件。

patterns.name: Reddit 链接片段
patterns.context: 嵌在 Reddit URL 路径及其子串中，路径分隔符和部分站点、路径 token 激活。

patterns.name: 篮球专名与日期标记
patterns.context: NBA 球员／球队新闻及日期、统计字段中；部分激活与英语短语重合，«OR» 也可能是专名内部片段。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻或邮件转发内容

en.description: Activations are distributed across heterogeneous text: word-internal fragments, URL parameters and encoding symbols, formulas and LaTeX punctuation, scientific terminology, and a passage of electricity market conference material. No clear shared semantics explain all segments.

patterns.name: Morpheme fragments within English words
patterns.context: Trigger fragments are embedded in ordinary English words, such as “ec«of»10«riend»1ly” and “Ec«of»9in”; surrounding contexts concern organic products or European institutions.

patterns.name: URL and query-parameter symbols
patterns.context: Triggers are separators, operator-like characters, and parameter fragments in URLs or encoded query strings, often mixed with digits and letters.

patterns.name: Mathematical or LaTeX punctuation
patterns.context: Symbols occur in formulas, LaTeX markup, or mathematical typesetting; formula content differs across segments.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in English
patterns.context: LaTeX commands, physics terminology, or ordinary English word fragments in scientific text; no single lexical meaning matches the preceding punctuation-trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Electricity market vocabulary
patterns.context: Activations occur on topic words and nearby symbols in electricity market conference titles and forecasting-related text.

3_612.concept: none
3_612.description: 激活分布在异质文本中：包括词内片段、URL参数与编码符号、公式及LaTeX标点和科学术语，以及一段电力市场会议材料。没有能覆盖所有片段的清晰共同语义。

patterns.name: 英语词内部的词素片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在普通英语词中，如“ec«of»10«riend»1ly”和“Ec«of»9in”；周围语境涉及有机产品或欧洲机构。

patterns.name: 网址与查询参数符号
patterns.context: 触发的是URL或编码查询串中的分隔符、运算符样式字符及参数片段，常与数字和字母混排。

patterns.name: 数学或LaTeX标点符号
patterns.context: 符号出现在公式、LaTeX标记或数学排版中；不同片段的公式内容并不相同。

patterns.name: 英语词中的词内片段
patterns.context: 科学文本中的LaTeX命令、物理术语或普通英文词片段；未见与前述标点触发模式一致的单一词义。

patterns.name: 电力市场词汇
patterns.context: 在电力市场会议标题及预测相关文字中，激活分布于主题词和邻近符号。

en.description: Strong responses occur to separators and fields in structured strings: URL tracking parameters, XML/XAML attributes, and code syntax; two natural-language segments also contain internal fragments of the word of, along with interface configuration containing Korean labels.

patterns.name: URL encoding and tracking parameters
patterns.context: Triggers are concentrated in encoded or concatenated links, especially Feedburner parameters and values; ordinary article text has no such parameters

patterns.name: XML/XAML attribute assignments
patterns.context: Attribute configuration in markup tags, with attribute names adjacent to numbers and enum values

patterns.name: Punctuation and structured syntax in code
patterns.context: Code structures composed of SQL and JavaScript keywords, operators, quotes, and identifiers; not limited to XAML attributes

patterns.name: Local character fragments in multilingual words
patterns.context: Activations fall on character fragments inside natural-language words rather than whole words; surrounding contexts concern Slovakia joining a common currency and organic farming, respectively
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary text, English encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Korean interface text and interface attributes
patterns.context: Properties and values of mobile-app interface controls, with Korean button text

3_612.concept: 结构化文本中的字段边界
3_612.description: 强烈响应结构化字符串中的分隔符与字段：URL追踪参数、XML/XAML属性及代码语法；另有两段自然语言中单词内部的of片段，以及含韩语标签的界面配置。

patterns.name: URL 编码与追踪参数
patterns.context: 触发主要集中在被编码或拼接的链接文本中，尤其是 Feedburner 参数和值；普通文章文字中没有这类参数

patterns.name: XML/XAML 属性赋值
patterns.trigger: HorizontalAlignment="Center"、Grid.Row="0"、Grid.Column="1"、Margin="0,3,0,3" 等属性名、引号和赋值符号
patterns.context: 标记语言标签中的属性配置，属性名与数字、枚举值相邻

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与结构化语法
patterns.trigger: xmlhttp.open("GET", "kiesklant.php?q="+str, true)、inner join questions、where descriptions.question = N'…' 等
patterns.context: 代码中 SQL、JavaScript 的关键字、运算符、引号及标识符组成的结构；不只是 XAML 属性

patterns.name: 多语言词内的局部字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在自然语言单词内部的字符片段，而非完整词；周边分别涉及斯洛伐克加入共同货币及有机农业
patterns.domain: 波兰语议会文本、英语百科文字

patterns.name: 韩语界面文本与界面属性
patterns.context: 移动应用界面控件的属性和值，夹有韩语按钮文本

en.description: Primarily responds to query-parameter separators and path structure within URLs; a few activations fall on details, encoded news headlines, or sporadic body words, and some examples do not reveal a distinct trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Query-parameter separators in URLs
patterns.context: Activations concentrate in the query-parameter portion of links; typically preceded by a hostname and path, followed by parameter names, values, and other parameters.
patterns.domain: Web links, search results, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: details in URL paths
patterns.context: Occurs in webpage or download paths, such as /store/apps/details or /download/details.aspx; not necessarily the word in ordinary body text.
patterns.domain: App store links, software support and download pages

patterns.name: Path/punctuation structure in URLs
patterns.context: Activations fall within URL paths, filenames, or parameter values, often alongside query strings, encoded text, or longer links.

patterns.name: URL-encoded media titles
patterns.context: Occurs in feedburner utm_campaign parameter values, with titles percent-encoded and separated by plus signs; both links have a similar format.
patterns.domain: News article links and tracking parameters

patterns.name: Opaque or unexplained local activations
patterns.context: These words or fragments occur in different sentences, code, or technical text; activations are sometimes adjacent to link structures, but this does not establish an independent semantic trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Forum dialogue, technical Q&A, academic papers, and cached webpages

3_612.concept: URL结构与查询参数
3_612.description: 主要响应 URL 内的查询参数分隔符和路径结构；少数激活落在 details、编码新闻标题或零散正文词上，部分样例无法确定独立触发模式。

patterns.name: URL 中的查询参数分隔符
patterns.trigger: «?»、«=»、«&»，尤其是 URL 查询串中反复出现的 «=» 与 «&»
patterns.context: 激活集中在链接的查询参数部分；前面通常有主机名和路径，后面跟参数名、参数值及其他参数。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、搜索结果与技术问答

patterns.name: URL 路径中的 details
patterns.context: 出现在网页或下载链接的路径中，如 /store/apps/details 或 /download/details.aspx；不一定是普通正文里的该词。
patterns.domain: 应用商店链接、软件支持与下载页面

patterns.name: 网址中的路径/标点结构
patterns.context: 激活落在 URL 路径、文件名或参数值内部，常与查询串、编码文本或较长链接同时出现。
patterns.domain: 网页链接及被引用的 URL

patterns.name: URL 编码的媒体标题
patterns.trigger: «%»，以及 «+» 连接的标题词，如 «Laughing Squ»、«arstechnica»
patterns.context: 出现在 feedburner 的 utm_campaign 参数值中，标题以百分号编码、加号分隔；两段链接均包含类似格式。
patterns.domain: 新闻文章链接与追踪参数

patterns.name: 不透明或无法由可见模式解释的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些词或片段各自处于不同句子、代码或技术文本中；激活与链接结构有时邻近，但无法据此确认独立语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、技术问答、学术论文及网页缓存

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on URLs, query strings, encoded delimiters, and parameters, spanning news-tracking links, search/API requests, bug reports, technical documentation, and e-commerce links. Some body-text words activate weakly as well, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: URL query parameters and encoded delimiters
patterns.context: Occurs in URL query strings, often adjacent to parameter names, values, encoded spaces, or special characters.
patterns.domain: Web links, news aggregation, and tracking parameters

patterns.name: Feedburner source-tracking string
patterns.context: A tracking parameter in news article links, commonly found in HackerNews posts citing Ars Technica, Laughing Squid, or TechCrunch links.
patterns.domain: News aggregation, web analytics, and URL encoding

patterns.name: Plus-encoded article titles or paths
patterns.context: A plus sign serves as the URL encoding for a space, joining article titles, site names, or search terms.

patterns.name: Search and pagination parameters
patterns.context: Parameters submit search terms, specify result formats, or control page/result pagination.

patterns.name: External resource and bug-report links
patterns.context: Activations fall near link paths or hostnames; links point to bug reports, API queries, and technical documentation.
patterns.domain: Ubuntu collaboration, Q&A, and technical documentation

patterns.name: Article slugs and hyphens in links
patterns.context: Hyphens separate multiple title words or filename fragments in URL paths.
patterns.domain: News article links and earnings-call transcript links

patterns.name: ref parameter in e-commerce links
patterns.context: Located at the end of product-detail links, containing parameters such as referral sources and search/request identifiers.

patterns.name: Discussion text around links
patterns.context: Adjacent to links or their target content, but not clearly sharing the same URL structure; activations may reflect a mixture of URL fragments and ordinary body text.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions, Q&A, and technical materials

3_612.concept: URL结构与参数
3_612.description: 激活主要集中在 URL 及其查询串、编码分隔符和参数；覆盖新闻追踪链接、搜索/API 请求、缺陷报告、技术文档和电商链接。部分正文词也有弱激活，未见统一解释。

patterns.name: URL 查询参数与编码分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在网址的查询串中，常与参数名、参数值、编码后的空格或特殊字符相邻。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻聚合与追踪参数

patterns.name: Feedburner 来源追踪串
patterns.context: 作为新闻文章链接的追踪参数，常见于 HackerNews 帖子引用的 Ars Technica、Laughing Squid 或 TechCrunch 链接。
patterns.domain: 新闻聚合、网页分析与 URL 编码

patterns.name: 加号编码的文章标题或路径
patterns.context: 加号充当 URL 中空格的编码形式，连接文章标题、站点名或搜索词。

patterns.name: 搜索及分页参数
patterns.context: 参数用于提交搜索词、指定结果格式或控制页面/结果分页。

patterns.name: 外部资源与缺陷报告链接
patterns.context: 激活落在链接路径或主机名附近；链接分别指向缺陷报告、API 查询和技术文档。
patterns.domain: Ubuntu 协作、问答及技术文档

patterns.name: 链接中的文章 slug 与连字符
patterns.context: 连字符分隔 URL 路径中的多个标题词或文件名片段。
patterns.domain: 新闻文章链接与财报文字记录链接

patterns.name: 电商链接的 ref 参数
patterns.context: 位于商品详情链接尾部，包含引用来源和搜索/请求标识等参数。

patterns.name: 链接周边的讨论文本
patterns.context: 与链接或链接所指内容相邻，但并非明显共享同一 URL 结构；可能是 URL 片段和普通正文混合导致的激活。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论、问答和技术材料

en.concept: Structured fragments in code and links
en.description: Activations occur on structured string fragments in code and links: variable names, format specifiers, punctuation, and URL parameters are most prominent; CSS declarations and Chinese link descriptions are also covered, with no single stable semantic category evident.

patterns.name: R code identifiers and numeric formatting
patterns.context: Occurs in R examples involving data-frame column names, matrices, string formatting, or conditional filtering; some marked fragments are variable names or format strings.

patterns.name: English identifiers and format strings in code
patterns.context: Occurs in Python method definitions, log output, or date format strings; trigger fragments span identifiers and format placeholders.

patterns.name: URL parameters, encoded symbols, and URL fragments
patterns.context: Activations concentrate in link paths and query parameters, commonly FeedBurner parameters, percent encoding, and hyphen-separated title text.

patterns.name: CSS custom variables and color values
patterns.context: Occurs in CSS/SCSS style declarations, where variable references are followed by color functions or default values.

patterns.name: Chinese address text and link markers
patterns.context: A Github file link follows the Chinese word “地址”; activations fall on the Chinese characters and link path fragments.

3_612.concept: 代码与链接中的结构化片段
3_612.description: 激活出现在代码与链接中的结构化字符串片段：变量名、格式符、标点及 URL 参数最突出；也覆盖 CSS 声明和中文链接说明，未见单一稳定语义类别。

patterns.name: R 代码标识符与数字格式化
patterns.context: 出现在 R 示例中，涉及数据框列名、矩阵、字符串格式化或条件筛选；有些被标记的是变量名或格式串片段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 R 编程问答

patterns.name: 代码中的英文标识符与格式字符串
patterns.context: 出现在 Python 方法定义、日志输出或日期格式串中，触发片段横跨标识符和格式占位符。

patterns.name: URL 参数、编码符号与网址片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在链接路径和查询参数中，常见 FeedBurner 参数、百分号编码及连字符分隔的标题文字。

patterns.name: CSS 自定义变量与颜色值
patterns.context: 出现在 CSS/SCSS 样式声明中，变量引用后接颜色函数或默认值。

patterns.name: 中文地址文字与链接标记
patterns.context: 中文“地址”附近紧接 Github 文件链接，激活落在中文字和链接路径片段上。

en.concept: Punctuation and separators in structured text
en.description: Activations concentrate in dense structured text: symbols and data markers in R code, and separators, query parameters, encoding, and path fragments in long HackerNews URLs; also responds to words and numbers within links and post-boundary markers.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax symbols in R code
patterns.context: Occurs in R data-frame manipulation, formatting, plotting, or filtering code, often adjacent to column names, function names, and arguments.

patterns.name: URL structural punctuation
patterns.context: Occurs in long URLs, query parameters, percent encoding, or path fragments.

patterns.name: Numbers or encoded fragments in links
patterns.context: Numbers, years, page numbers, percent encoding, or URL parameter values are embedded in links and their surrounding text.

patterns.name: Dividers and message/link boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs in HackerNews post dividers, message labels, or search-link paths.

patterns.name: Structured data and tabular text
patterns.context: Occurs near printed data frames, missing-value markers, or data processing code.

patterns.name: Ordinary English words and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: These words are embedded in link slugs, source names, or book-title URLs rather than standalone ordinary sentences.

3_612.concept: 结构化文本中的标点与分隔符
3_612.description: 激活集中于高密度结构化文本：R 代码的符号与数据标记，以及 HackerNews 长网址中的分隔符、查询参数、编码和路径片段；也响应链接内的词、数字及帖子边界标记。

patterns.name: R 代码中的标点与语法符号
patterns.context: 出现在 R 数据框操作、格式化、绘图或筛选代码中，常与列名、函数名及参数相邻。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 的 R 编程问答

patterns.name: 网址中的 URL 结构标点
patterns.context: 出现在长网址、查询参数、百分号编码或路径片段中。

patterns.name: 链接中的数字或编码片段
patterns.context: 数字、年份、页码、百分号编码或网址参数值嵌在链接及其周边文本中。

patterns.name: 分隔线与消息/链接边界
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 帖子分隔线、消息标签或搜索链接路径中。

patterns.name: 结构化数据与表格文本
patterns.context: 出现在数据框打印结果、缺失值标记或数据处理代码附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 的 R 编程问答

patterns.name: 普通英文词与专名片段
patterns.context: 这些词嵌在链接 slug、来源名称或书名 URL 中，而非独立的普通句子。

en.description: Activations occur in code, formulas, URLs, and technical text, often on structural punctuation such as dots, commas, slashes, equal signs, and dollar signs; also occurs on webpage divider lines, with trigger conditions not fully consistent.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematics and scientific symbols
patterns.context: Occurs in physical quantities, measurements, angle ranges, or matrix notation; surrounding symbols often use LaTeX syntax

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting syntax in program code
patterns.context: Embedded in variable names, function calls, strings, CSS declarations, or template code
patterns.domain: Code Q&A, Github stylesheets, HTML templates

patterns.name: URL and query-parameter separators
patterns.context: Occurs in URL paths, query parameters, or page slugs joined with hyphens
patterns.domain: Web/API examples, app links, news page links

patterns.name: Ordinary punctuation in English technical text
patterns.context: Punctuation connects phrases or proper names in technical descriptions and is not necessarily part of code or formulas

patterns.name: Sparse structural boundary markers
patterns.context: Appears as a horizontal divider in webpage excerpts, with no clear semantic connection

3_612.concept: 技术文本中的结构性标点
3_612.description: 激活分布在代码、公式、URL及技术文本中，常落在点、逗号、斜杠、等号、美元符号等结构性标点；也见于网页分隔横线，触发条件并不完全一致。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学与科学符号
patterns.trigger: «$»、«\»、«<»，以及数学表达式中的数字和标点
patterns.context: 出现在物理量、测量结果、角度范围或矩阵记号中；符号周围常有 LaTeX 语法
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文、技术讨论

patterns.name: 程序代码中的标点与格式化语法
patterns.context: 嵌在变量名、函数调用、字符串、CSS 声明或模板代码中
patterns.domain: 代码问答、Github 样式表、HTML 模板

patterns.name: URL 与查询参数分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在网址路径、查询参数或由连字符拼接的页面 slug 中
patterns.domain: 网页/API 示例、应用链接、新闻页面链接

patterns.name: 英文技术文本中的普通标点
patterns.context: 标点连接技术说明中的短语或专名，不一定属于代码或公式

patterns.name: 稀疏的结构边界符
patterns.context: 作为网页摘录中的横线分隔符出现，缺少明显语义联系

en.description: Primarily responds to web links and URL structure: domains, paths, query parameters, assignment signs, and parameter values. Common in forums, Q&A, API examples, and HTML/Markdown. Activations on a few ordinary words remain unexplained.

patterns.name: URL query parameters and delimiters
patterns.context: When URLs, links, or URL paths/query strings appear, activations concentrate near parameter boundaries, assignment signs, and parameter values; common in web text containing links.
patterns.domain: Web links, search, and API examples

patterns.name: URL domains and path structure
patterns.context: A URL is embedded in body text, a Markdown link, or an HTML script tag; domain and path components can also trigger activations.

patterns.name: Structured URL-encoded parameter values
patterns.context: Parameter names and values appear adjacent in a URL query string; activations may fall on parameter values, numbers, or Boolean values.
patterns.domain: Search links, APIs, web configuration, and data charts

patterns.name: Web-text fragments with links
patterns.context: The context is an embedded link, separator line, or link tail in a forum or Q&A page, often accompanied by Markdown/HTML markup; isolated incomplete links also occur.

patterns.name: Unexplained ordinary words and proper names
patterns.context: Web- or link-related content is nearby, but these words themselves have no clear connection to URL structure; the trigger cannot be determined from the fragment.

3_612.concept: 网页 URL 结构
3_612.description: 主要响应网页链接及 URL 的结构：域名、路径、查询参数、赋值符和参数值；常见于论坛、问答、API 示例及 HTML/Markdown。少数普通词语的激活无法解释。

patterns.name: URL 查询参数与分隔符
patterns.trigger: URL 中的 «=», «&», «?», «/» 及参数值，如 «q=Bootstrap», «format=json», «controls=0»
patterns.context: 出现网址、链接或 URL 路径/查询串时，激活集中在参数边界、赋值符和参数值附近；常见于带链接的网页文本。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、搜索和 API 示例

patterns.name: 网址域名及路径结构
patterns.context: 网址被内嵌在正文、Markdown 链接或 HTML 脚本标签中，域名及路径组成部分也会触发。

patterns.name: URL 编码的结构化参数值
patterns.context: 参数名和值以 URL 查询串形式相邻出现；激活可落在参数值、数字或布尔值上。
patterns.domain: 搜索链接、API、网页配置与数据图表

patterns.name: 带链接的网页文本残片
patterns.context: 上下文是论坛或问答页面中嵌入的链接、分隔线或链接尾部，常伴随 Markdown/HTML 标记；单独的残缺链接也出现。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 与 StackExchange 网页语料

patterns.name: 未解释的普通词语与专名
patterns.context: 在附近存在网页或链接相关内容，但这些词本身与 URL 结构并无明显联系；触发原因不能由片段确定。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to URL structures embedded in forum, Q&A, and email text, especially paths, query-parameter separators, and numeric/alphanumeric identifiers; a few activations fall on words near URLs or in body text.

patterns.name: URL paths and query parameters
patterns.context: Activations fall on URL paths, query parameters, separators, or fragments adjacent to URLs; URLs are often embedded in text, Markdown links, or quotes.
patterns.domain: Web links, forum posts, technical Q&A, and email

patterns.name: Numbers and alphanumeric strings in URLs
patterns.context: Occurs in URL paths, parameter values, or document/folder identifiers, usually adjacent to slashes, hyphens, or equal signs.
patterns.domain: Web links, search and sharing links, technical documents

patterns.name: Common structural words near URLs
patterns.context: Appears as a URL host, path, or nearby link label; activations are not concentrated on one particular service or a single semantic word.

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments in ordinary text
patterns.context: A few activations fall on body words or word fragments, usually near links or URL parameters, but these words alone do not establish a stable trigger condition.

3_612.concept: 网址与查询参数格式
3_612.description: 主要对嵌入论坛、问答和邮件文本中的网址结构敏感，尤其是路径、查询参数分隔符及数字/字母数字标识符；少量激活落在 URL 周边词或正文词上。

patterns.name: URL 路径与查询参数
