patterns.trigger: “the patients are themselves infertile” [1]；“rollers are themselves” [3]；“which itself comprises” [8]；“capsules are themselves held” [8]；“authorities are themselves responsible” [6]；“which are themselves already far lower” [5]
patterns.context: 英语句中，反身代词自身或带有反身强调意味的形式，常位于系动词或关系从句之后；也可出现在“which itself comprises”结构中。
patterns.domain: 医学、专利、医保、技术说明等英语说明性文本

patterns.name: 法语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 法语词被分词标注拆开，激活落在词内片段；第2段尤其涉及撇号、词尾及连字符拆分。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语词内部片段被标记，分布于词形或词缀拆分后的片段中。

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在驼峰式标识符“applicationDidBecomeActive”中的内部子串，而非完整单词。

patterns.name: 缩写内部片段
patterns.context: 大写缩写“UBER”中间的字母片段被标记；附近是法庭文书中的 IRS 案件描述。

en.description: One prominent group of activations falls on the English reflexive pronouns themselves/herself; the rest are scattered across Romanian clitic pronouns and word fragments, French apostrophes, a Spanish copula, and fragments of place and drug names, with no unified semantics or stable syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed activation after themselves
patterns.context: Peak activation is concentrated on the reflexive pronoun itself, especially themselves; it occurs after a copula and is followed by or introduces supplementary information.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, technical Q&A, encyclopedia biographies, policy commentary

patterns.name: -și at sentence ends or boundaries
patterns.context: A Romanian reflexive pronoun form attached to a verb; occurs within a verb phrase in a request.

patterns.name: Apostrophe in French negation
patterns.context: The apostrophe occurs between the elided French ne form n’ and an auxiliary, in a conditional negative sentence.

patterns.name: Fragment within a Romance-language copula
patterns.context: The Spanish verb eran (“to be”) is split into subword tokens; here it refers to a bilateral agreement’s incompatibility with EU law.

patterns.name: Romanian word-internal diacritic fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on split Romanian word fragments, respectively in măsuri (measures) and trebuie (must).

patterns.name: Place-name fragment in an English legal title
patterns.context: CALIFORNIA in a California court title is split, with activation on the middle of the place name.
patterns.domain: U.S. Court of Appeals decision titles

patterns.name: Fragment within a drug name
patterns.context: The fragment occurs in the generic drug name ibuprofen.

3_704.description: 激活最明显的一组落在英语反身代词 themselves/herself 上；其余分散于罗马尼亚语附着代词与词片段、法语撇号、西班牙语系词，以及地名和药名片段，未见统一语义或稳定句法规律。

patterns.name: themselves 后的固定激活
patterns.context: 最高激活集中在反身代词本身，尤其是 themselves；出现在系词之后，后接或引出补充说明。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、技术问答、百科传记、政策评论

patterns.name: 句末或边界处的 -și
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语动词后附着的反身代词形式；处于请求句中动词词组内部。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语政治发言

patterns.name: 法语否定结构中的撇号
patterns.context: 撇号位于法语 ne 的省略形式 n’ 与助动词之间，出现在条件式否定句中。

patterns.name: 罗马语系词内部的词片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语动词 eran（“是”）被分成子词 token；此处指双边协定与欧盟法律不相容。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 西班牙语法律／政治文本

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内重音字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的罗马尼亚语词片段上，分别属于 măsuri（措施）与 trebuie（必须）。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语政治发言

patterns.name: 英语法律标题中的地名词片段
patterns.context: 加州法院标题中的 CALIFORNIA 被切分，激活落在地名中段。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院判决标题

patterns.name: 药名内部的词片段
patterns.context: 该片段出现在药物通用名 ibuprofen（布洛芬）中。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术／药理文本

en.concept: Multilingual text fragments and legal formatting
en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual parliamentary texts and U.S. legal documents, often falling on subwords within words, word endings, hyphens, punctuation, and formal layout elements; there is no stable cross-lingual semantic trigger. The legal examples also include California court titles and litigation formatting.

patterns.name: French word-internal suffixes
patterns.context: Activation fragments often occur within or at the ends of French words; the surrounding text is complete French sentences involving commentary, greetings, or European history.

patterns.name: Romanian word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across Romanian words, inflectional endings, and hyphenated constructions, in contexts involving requests for U.S. authorities to act or parliamentary questions.

patterns.name: Spanish word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on Spanish word endings or internal fragments; the content discusses bilateral agreements and European Court of Justice rulings.

patterns.name: State name in a California Court of Appeals title
patterns.context: Segmented activations spell CALIFORNIA in a formal court title; the title also contains formatting text such as appellate district, division, and People.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw California Court of Appeals decisions

patterns.name: English word fragments in legal texts
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments in ordinary English legal narrative, party labels, or legal phrases; it is not tied to one fixed word or unified meaning.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw decision body text and litigation narratives

patterns.name: Parties and punctuation in litigation formatting
patterns.context: Activation occurs in layout structures such as case titles, party identities, case numbers, and attorney information; some activations cover punctuation or word beginnings.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw decision titles and attorney sections

3_704.concept: 多语种文本片段与法律格式
3_704.description: 激活遍布多语种议会文本及美国法律文书，常落在词内子词、词尾、连字符、标点和正式排版元素上；没有稳定的跨语种语义触发点。法律段另见加州法院标题与诉讼格式。

patterns.name: 法语词内后缀
patterns.context: 激活片段多出现在法语词的内部或词尾；周围是完整法语句子，涉及评论、致意或欧洲历史。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在罗马尼亚语单词、屈折词尾及连字符结构中，语境为请求美国当局采取行动或议会质询。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会发言

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语词尾或词内；内容讨论双边协议及欧盟法院判决。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 西班牙语法律／政策讨论

patterns.name: 加州上诉法院标题中的州名
patterns.context: 分段激活拼出 CALIFORNIA，出现在法院名称的正式标题中；标题同时含上诉区、分区及 People 等格式化文字。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 加州上诉法院判决书

patterns.name: 法律文本中的英语词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英语法律叙述、当事人称谓或法律短语中；并非固定单一词或统一语义。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决书正文及诉讼叙述

patterns.name: 诉讼格式中的当事人及标点
patterns.context: 激活出现在案件标题、当事人身份、案号及律师信息等排版结构中，部分激活覆盖标点或词首。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决书标题与律师栏

en.description: Activations are distributed across in-word fragments in multiple languages, English become, common conjunctions, and fixed phrases, proper names, and layout in legal documents; there are also sporadic word fragments in medical sentences. No unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in English become
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur within become/becomes in an Objective-C lifecycle method, prose, and philosophical discussion; there is no single word sense or syntactic environment.

patterns.name: English function-word fragments
patterns.context: Between party designations in legal documents; only two instances, with activation on fragments within common conjunctions.

patterns.name: Fragments in a specific English phrase
patterns.context: The fixed legal expression “hereinafter referred to as” introduces an abbreviated party designation; markers are distributed across multiple words in the phrase.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in French
patterns.context: In the same French passage, multiple in-word subword fragments are marked, including devoir, primait, tiens, ému, ont; no consistent lexical or syntactic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Spanish
patterns.context: In a Spanish legal/trade passage, in-word fragments in multiple words are marked, such as mercados, noviembre, Europeo, eran, Derecho; there is no single semantic condition.

patterns.name: Proper names and layout fragments
patterns.context: Capitalized proper names, numbers, punctuation, and formatted legal designations in court headings or party sections; some triggers overlap with the “and” pattern in [6] and [9].
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and formatted case files

patterns.name: Word fragments in reproductive medicine sentences
patterns.context: Institutional abbreviation fragments and common words are marked in medical sentences about IVF, embryo transfer, and patient outcomes; there is no clear unified semantic trigger.

3_704.description: 激活分散在多语种词内片段、英语 become、常见连接词，以及法律文书的固定短语、专名和版式；另有医学句中的零散词片段。没有统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语 become 词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在 become/becomes 的词内，见于 Objective-C 生命周期方法、散文及哲学论述；不是单一词义或句法环境。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、葡萄酒宣传散文、哲学文本

patterns.name: 英语功能词片段
patterns.context: 法律文书中的当事人称谓之间；仅两例，激活落在常见连接词内部。

patterns.name: 英语特定短语片段
patterns.context: 法律文本用固定表达“hereinafter referred to as”引入当事人的简称；各标记分布在短语中的多个词。

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 同一法语句段中多个词内子词片段被标记，包括 devoir、primait、tiens、ému、ont；未见一致的词义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语法律/贸易句段中，多个词的词内片段被标记，如 mercados、noviembre、Europeo、eran、Derecho；未见单一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会西班牙语文本

patterns.name: 专名与排版片段
patterns.context: 法院抬头或诉讼当事人栏中的大写专名、数字、标点及格式化法律称谓；部分触发与[6]、[9]中的“and”模式重合。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决书及版式化案卷

patterns.name: 生殖医学句内词片段
patterns.context: 关于 IVF、胚胎移植及患者结局的医学句子中，机构缩写片段和普通词均被标记；没有明显统一的语义触发条件。

en.concept: Reflexive expressions and local word-form markers
en.description: Primarily responds to English reflexive pronouns (themselves, himself, itself), especially when they refer to the subject after a copula; also repeatedly responds to the hyphenated word segment in editor-in-chief, with sporadic responses to Romanian clitics, Spanish past tense, French emotion words, and legal-title layout.

patterns.name: English reflexive pronouns
patterns.context: Often immediately follows a be verb (such as «are» or «was») and refers to the subject; can be emphatic or reflexive.
patterns.domain: Medicine, technical Q&A, law, patent descriptions

patterns.name: Hyphenated structure in editor-in-chief
patterns.context: Occurs in the compound title editor-in-chief; the hyphen and following word segment are marked.

patterns.name: Romanian reflexive/dative clitics
patterns.context: A hyphen connects a clitic pronoun form, as in «să-și folosească».

patterns.name: Spanish imperfect form
patterns.context: In a legal context, describes a provision as incompatible with law; the verb is a past-tense copula.

patterns.name: French emotion adjective
patterns.context: Modifies «hommage» in a laudatory context, expressing being moved or touched.

patterns.name: Names and layout punctuation in legal case files
patterns.context: Occurs in all-caps party names in court case-file titles and in aligned parenthetical layouts.

3_704.concept: 反身表达与局部词形标记
3_704.description: 主要响应英语反身代词（themselves、himself、itself），尤其是系词后表示主语自身；另对 editor-in-chief 的连字符词段有重复响应，并零星响应罗马尼亚语附着形式、西班牙语过去时、法语情感词及法律标题版式。

patterns.name: 英语反身代词
patterns.context: 常紧跟 be 动词（如 «are»、«was»），指主语自身；可作强调或反身用法
patterns.domain: 医学、技术问答、法律、专利说明

patterns.name: editor-in-chief 中的连字符结构
patterns.context: 出现在复合职衔 editor-in-chief 中，连字符及其后的词段被标记

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语反身/与格附着形式
patterns.context: 连字符连接代词附着形式，如 «să-și folosească»

patterns.name: 西班牙语未完成过去时形式
patterns.context: 法律语境中描述规定与法律不相容，动词作过去时系词

patterns.name: 法语情感形容词
patterns.context: 在赞扬语境中修饰 «hommage»，表达感动、动情

patterns.name: 法律案卷中的姓名与版式标点
patterns.context: 出现在法院案卷标题的全大写当事人姓名及对齐式括号版面中

en.description: Strong activations are distributed across word segmentation in multiple languages and English themselves; ont in French seront, the Italian member-word ending, Romanian hyphens, and Spanish -endo also stand out. There is also an isolated instance of now in a legal context, so the overall trigger is not uniform.

patterns.name: English reflexive pronoun themselves
patterns.context: Themselves follows an English noun and emphasizes the relevant entities themselves or their own state; activation falls on themselves.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions, medical research texts

patterns.name: French future-tense plural ending
patterns.context: In the French verb seront (or participial form seront pr…), ser and ont appear as separate segments, with activation concentrated on ont; the context states future applicability, validity, or measures to be taken.

patterns.name: Italian plural ending ri
patterns.context: The Italian word membri (members) is tokenized, with activation concentrated on memb; nearby words include forniti and Stati.

patterns.name: Romanian hyphenated structure
patterns.context: A hyphen connects a pronoun structure within a word, such as să-și; strong activation is on the hyphen.

patterns.name: Spanish verb form and connected ending
patterns.context: Siendo is tokenized as Si and endo, with activation concentrated on the gerund ending; the same passage contains several other weak activations on word-internal splits.

patterns.name: Dates and personal-name forms in legal text
patterns.context: After a date in an English sentence, now modifies someone’s status as a janitor; this strong activation does not clearly match the preceding reflexive-pronoun or French-ending patterns.

3_704.description: 强激活分布于多语种词内切分及英语 themselves；法语 seront 的 ont、意大利语成员词尾、罗马尼亚语连字符和西班牙语 -endo 也突出。另有法律语境 now 的孤例，整体触发条件不统一。

patterns.name: 英语反身代词 themselves
patterns.context: 英语名词后出现 themselves，强调相关对象自身或其自身状态；激活落在 themselves
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、医学研究文本

patterns.name: 法语将来时复数词尾
patterns.context: 法语动词 seront（或分词形式 seront pr…）中 ser 与 ont 分段呈现，激活集中在 ont；语境为陈述未来适用、有效或将采取的措施

patterns.name: 意大利语复数词尾 ri
patterns.context: 意大利语 membri（成员）一词被分词，激活集中在 memb；同时附近有 forniti、Stati 等词
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会意大利语发言

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语连字符结构
patterns.context: 词内连字符前后连接代词结构，如 să-și；强激活位于连字符
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会罗马尼亚语发言

patterns.name: 西班牙语动词词形及连接词尾
patterns.context: Siendo 被分词为 Si 与 endo，激活集中在动词进行/副动词词尾；同段另有多处弱激活的词内切分
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 西班牙语哲学文本

patterns.name: 法律文本日期与人名词形
patterns.context: 英文句中日期叙述后，now 修饰某人被列为 janitor 的状态；该强激活没有明显对应前述反身代词或法语词尾模式

en.concept: Multilingual local word forms and boundary features
en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual parliamentary texts and English legal and encyclopedia texts; local patterns include French future-tense «seront», English «was now», legal-party punctuation, and multilingual function words, pronouns, proper nouns, and numeric fragments, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Future auxiliary and participle
patterns.context: In French, «seront» is followed by a past participle, such as «efficaces», «applicables», or «prises», forming a future passive or state expression.
patterns.domain: EU Parliament French texts, meeting records

patterns.name: «was now» in relative clauses
patterns.context: In English narrative, «was now» introduces a person’s or institution’s current identity or status, often followed by «known as» or an adverb.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, encyclopedia biographies, or institutional histories

patterns.name: Party markers in legal cases
patterns.context: Commas appear before or after company or litigant names, followed by an identification; activation occurs near punctuation and legal terminology in legal texts.

patterns.name: Pronouns, conjunctions, and phrase boundaries
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across high-frequency function words, word-internal fragments, and punctuation in Spanish, French, and Romanian sentences; no stable shared syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Romanian action expressions
patterns.context: In Romanian imperative or obligation expressions, activation occurs near word fragments meaning “take measures” and “must do.”

patterns.name: Romanian clitic pronouns
patterns.context: A hyphen connects a pronoun form attached after a verb.

patterns.name: Amounts and speaking turns
patterns.context: A statement of an amount is followed by the chair’s remarks and thanks; activation falls near numeric fragments and polite expressions.

patterns.name: Word segments in organization names and place names
patterns.context: Local fragments activate within proper names, abbreviations, or place names, but no consistent proper-name category or semantic condition is apparent.

3_704.concept: 多语种局部词形与边界特征
3_704.description: 激活散布于多语种议会文本、英语法律与百科文本；局部模式包括法语将来时 «seront»、英语 «was now»、法律当事方标点，以及多语种功能词、代词、专名和数字片段，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 将来时助动词与分词
patterns.context: 法语中 «seront» 后接过去分词，如 «efficaces»、«applicables»、«prises»，构成将来时被动或状态表达。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会法语文本、会议记录

patterns.name: 关系从句中的 «was now»
patterns.context: 英语叙述中以 «was now» 引出人物或机构当前身份、状态，常接 «known as» 或副词。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科传记或机构沿革

patterns.name: 法律案件中的当事方标记
patterns.trigger: «,»5 Safety Mutual Casualty Corporation«,»3；Appellant«,»5 Hunt Developers«,»3 Inc«.,»3
patterns.context: 公司或诉讼方名称前后的逗号，以及后续身份说明；激活落在法律文本的标点和法律术语附近。

patterns.name: 代词、连词与短语边界
patterns.context: 激活分布在西班牙语、法语、罗马尼亚语句中的高频功能词、词内片段及标点附近；看不出稳定的共同句法条件。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会或哲学文本

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语动作表达
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语祈使或义务表达中，激活出现在“采取措施”和“必须做”的词内片段附近。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语代词附着形式
patterns.context: 连字符连接的动词后附代词形式。

patterns.name: 金额与发言轮次
patterns.context: 金额陈述后接主席发言及感谢语，激活落在数字片段和礼貌表达附近。

patterns.name: 机构名称与地名中的词段
patterns.context: 专名、缩写或地名中出现局部词段激活，但未显示一致的专名类别或语义条件。

en.concept: English state or transition expressions and multilingual word fragments
en.description: The main pattern is English was now, describing a new state of a person or institution; there are also multilingual in-word fragments, comes within becomes, and mean in patent definition sentences, none of which can be grouped under the same clear trigger condition.

patterns.name: now after an English be-verb
patterns.context: In English sentences, now usually follows was and describes a change in a person's identity or an institution's state; now may be followed by an identity, state, or judgment.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in inflected forms
patterns.context: Trigger fragments are often word endings, affixes, or internal portions of Spanish, French, or Romanian words; there is no clear shared meaning or syntactic position.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in English comes
patterns.context: English comes is embedded in becomes; both instances describe a result or change of identity, but activation falls on an in-word fragment.
patterns.domain: Religious book introductions, business news headlines

patterns.name: mean in patent definitions
patterns.context: Patent text uses shall mean to introduce a term's definition.

3_704.concept: 英语状态或转变表达及多语词片段
3_704.description: 主要模式是英语 was now，描述人物或机构的新状态；另有跨语种词内片段、becomes 中的 comes，以及专利定义句中的 mean，均无法归为同一明确触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语 be 动词后的 now
patterns.context: 英文句子中，通常在 was 后接 now，叙述人物身份或机构状态的变化；now 后可接身份、状态或判断。

patterns.name: 屈折形式中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 触发片段常是西班牙语、法语或罗马尼亚语词语的词尾、词缀或词内部分；没有明显统一的词义或句法位置。

patterns.name: 英语 comes 的词内片段
patterns.trigger: «comes»，出现在“Be«comes» F«lesh»”和“As Former State Health Official Be«comes» CEO”
patterns.context: 英语 comes 嵌在 becomes 中；两处都描述某种结果或身份转变，但激活落在词内片段上。
patterns.domain: 宗教书籍介绍、商业新闻标题

patterns.name: 专利定义语中的 mean
patterns.context: 专利文本以 shall mean 引出术语的定义。

en.concept: Multilingual word forms and tokenization boundaries
en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual texts, primarily falling on word-internal subword fragments, inflectional endings, and hyphen boundaries; Spanish progressive forms and French future forms recur, as do Romanian reflexive forms and English compounds. No single semantic theme is stable.

patterns.name: Romance word-internal subword fragments and endings
patterns.context: Activation often falls on word-form fragments spanning tokens, inflectional endings, or hyphens; especially French future-tense ending «ser»…«ont» and Spanish verb form «si»…«endo». These examples alone do not establish the semantics of any single word.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary records, philosophy papers, and legal texts mixing Spanish, French, Romanian, and English

patterns.name: Expressions of continuation, futurity, and persistence of state
patterns.context: Local contexts express continuation, continuing to become a state, or an action that will occur or apply; they appear across languages and genres, and not every case corresponds to the same tense or meaning.
patterns.domain: PhilPapers Spanish discourse; EuroParl French and Romanian parliamentary speeches; also English legal texts

patterns.name: Hyphens and reflexive pronouns/word-form boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls near hyphens followed by Romanian reflexive forms or word forms, Romanian «într-adevăr», and the boundary in the English compound adjective «man-made». Grammatical functions differ, suggesting a possible word-fragment or tokenization-boundary effect.

3_704.concept: 多语种词形与分词边界
3_704.description: 激活遍布多语种文本，主要落在词内分词片段、屈折词尾及连字符边界；其中反复出现西班牙语持续式和法语将来式，也见于罗马尼亚语反身形式及英语复合词。未见稳定的单一主题语义。

patterns.name: 罗曼语词内分词片段与词尾
patterns.trigger: 词内被标记的片段，如 «ser»3«ont»9、«si»1«endo»9、«vir t»（实际为 «virt»3«ió»1）、«com»1«pañ»；也包括边界附近的 «-»9、«-»10
patterns.context: 激活常落在跨 token 的词形片段、屈折词尾或连字符上；尤其是法语将来时词尾 «ser»…«ont»、西班牙语动词词形 «si»…«endo»。不能仅凭这些例子判定是某个单独词的语义。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语、法语、罗马尼亚语及英语混合的议会记录、哲学论文和法律文本

patterns.name: 持续、将来与状态延续的表达
patterns.context: 局部上下文表达持续、继续成为某状态，或将发生/适用的动作；出现于不同语言和文体，且不是每例都对应同一种时态或语义。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 西班牙语论述；EuroParl 法语、罗马尼亚语议会发言；另有英语法律文本

patterns.name: 连字符及反身代词/词形边界
patterns.context: 激活落在连字符后接罗马尼亚语反身形式或词形、罗马尼亚语 «într-adevăr»，以及英语复合形容词 «man-made» 的边界附近。上下文语法功能并不一致，可能只是词片段或分词边界效应。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语；英语议会发言

en.concept: Multilingual word-internal fragments and inflected forms
en.description: Activations often occur on inflectional or derivational fragments of multilingual verbs, and are also scattered across function words, proper names, and encoded characters; there is no unified semantic theme, and some activations may reflect word-internal boundaries or local syntax.

patterns.name: Romance compound verb forms
patterns.context: Activation falls at the boundary between verb stems and inflectional/derivational suffixes, or on the suffixes themselves; common forms include progressive, future, and third-person forms, across multiple languages.
patterns.domain: Spanish, French, Romanian, and English academic or parliamentary texts; passages [1][2][4][5][7][8][9][10]

patterns.name: Emphasized function words or internal phrase fragments
patterns.context: Activation sometimes falls on common small words, conjunctions, prepositions, negative phrases, or word-internal fragments, with no stable semantic theme; it may relate to local syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Multilingual philosophical texts and parliamentary speeches; passages [1][2][3][4][5][7][8][9]

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names or word forms
patterns.context: Internal characters or substrings in proper names, alphanumeric strings, or technical terms are marked; the semantic trigger is unclear.
patterns.domain: History of philosophy, parliamentary texts, patent texts; passages [2][3][5][6]

patterns.name: Malformed encoding in patent terminology
patterns.context: When defining patent terminology, activation occurs around garbled encoded strings and nearby definition verbs.

3_704.concept: 多语种词内片段与屈折形式
3_704.description: 激活常见于多语种动词的屈折或派生片段，也散见于功能词、专名和编码字符；没有统一语义主题，部分激活可能反映词内边界或局部句法。

patterns.name: 罗曼语动词复合形式
patterns.context: 激活落在动词词干与屈折/派生后缀的边界或后缀上，常见进行、将来、第三人称等形式；不局限于某一种语言。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语、法语、罗马尼亚语及英语学术或议会文本；段[1][2][4][5][7][8][9][10]

patterns.name: 被强调的功能词或词组内部片段
patterns.context: 激活有时落在常见小词、连词、介词、否定短语或词内片段，未见稳定的语义主题；可能与局部句法位置有关。

patterns.name: 专名或词形内部片段
patterns.context: 专名、字母数字串或技术术语的内部字符/子串被标记，语义触发条件不明确。
patterns.domain: 哲学史、议会文本、专利文本；段[2][3][5][6]

patterns.name: 不规则编码的专利术语
patterns.context: 定义专利术语时，乱码式编码串及定义动词附近出现激活。

en.concept: Tendency toward copulas and state expressions
en.description: Activations span Spanish, Romanian, and English, often falling on copulas, expressions of continuation/state, and nearby morphemes; there are also word-internal fragments, punctuation, and quantity-classification contexts, which resist reduction to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “Being” verb forms for state or continuation
patterns.context: In sentences stating identity, state, continuation, or passive state, activation often occurs near copulas/auxiliaries, participles, or adverbs; it falls on fragments of English was/are/is or Spanish siendo.
patterns.domain: Spanish philosophical discourse, English legal and technical descriptions, forum technical discussions

patterns.name: Spanish subjunctive verb endings
patterns.context: In Romanian sentences, a hyphen connects a pronoun or word form, or a Spanish word is split and marked; activation is not consistently triggered by a particular ending and sometimes falls on a hyphen or adjacent morpheme.
patterns.domain: European Parliament Romanian texts; also Spanish corpus

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names and terminology
patterns.context: Activation occurs within or near the boundaries of personal names, place names, and legal/patent terminology; no stable shared lexical meaning is apparent.
patterns.domain: Philosophical texts, European Parliament texts, patent texts

patterns.name: Punctuation near parentheticals or sentence links
patterns.context: Punctuation or short linking words activate near inserted material, supplementary explanations, or coordination; strength and position vary.
patterns.domain: Spanish philosophical texts, legal case quotations

patterns.name: Quantity/set and classification expressions
patterns.context: Contexts describe multiple objects, categories, lists, or individual components; activation itself usually falls on nearby function words or endings, with weak semantic association.
patterns.domain: Patent descriptions, technical forums, philosophical arguments

3_704.description: 激活分布跨西语、罗马尼亚语和英语，常落在系词、持续/状态表达及其邻近词素上；另有词内片段、标点和数量分类语境，难以归为单一语义规律。

patterns.name: 状态或持续性的“being”动词形式
patterns.context: 在陈述事物身份、状态、持续性或被动状态的句子中，常出现在系词/助动词、分词或副词附近；激活位置落在英语 was/are/is 或西语 siendo 等形式的片段上。
patterns.domain: 西语哲学论述、英语法律与技术说明、论坛技术讨论

patterns.name: 西语虚拟式动词词尾
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句中连字符与代词/词形相接，或西语词被拆分标注；是否由特定词尾触发并不稳定，片段位置有时落在连字符或相邻词素上。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会罗马尼亚语文本；另见西语语料

patterns.name: 专名与术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在人名、地名、法律/专利术语等词内部或词边界附近；未见稳定的共同词义条件。
patterns.domain: 哲学文本、欧洲议会文本、专利文本

patterns.name: 插入语或句间连接处的标点
patterns.context: 标点或短连接词在句中插入、补充说明或并列结构附近激活，强度和位置不一致。
patterns.domain: 西语哲学文本、法律判例引文

patterns.name: 数量/集合及分类表达
patterns.context: 涉及多个对象、类别、列表或个体部件的说明；激活本身多落在邻近功能词或词尾，语义关联较弱。
patterns.domain: 专利说明、技术论坛、哲学论证

en.concept: Multilingual subword fragments and high-frequency words
en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual in-word subwords, inflectional suffixes, and high-frequency small words; a few English commas and phrases also activate. Although many occur in Romance-language texts, trigger positions and functions vary considerably, making it difficult to assign a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Spanish progressive/continuous forms
patterns.context: Spanish verbs ending in -iendo/-endo express continuity or progression; they appear respectively in «Siendo, como fue» and «se puede ... lo siguió siendo».

patterns.name: Romanian verb inflection fragments
patterns.context: In Romanian sentences, the stem is adjacent to verb inflection or in-word spelling fragments; example sentences discuss taking measures and having to do something.

patterns.name: In-word segmentation fragments in Romance languages
patterns.context: Activation falls on continuous subword fragments within different Romance-language words or inflected forms; these examples do not share a clear meaning or grammatical function.
patterns.domain: Spanish, Romanian, Italian, and French, including Romanian parliamentary texts

patterns.name: English function words and common-word fragments
patterns.context: In English sentences, activation falls on common function words, prepositions, or phrase fragments; appears in discussions of particle transitions and legal insurance texts.

patterns.name: Short fragments in non-English political texts
patterns.context: Activation falls on in-word fragments in Italian parliamentary speech, with no clear semantic trigger shared with other fragments.

patterns.name: English parenthetical punctuation and phrases
patterns.context: Commas and phrase fragments activate in English sentences; appears in a discussion of cognitive uncertainty and may be unrelated to other in-word fragments.

patterns.name: Punctuation and continuation of proper names in legal names
patterns.context: In legal cases, the current name follows an insurance company name; activation is concentrated on the comma and the name-introduction phrase.

patterns.name: Cross-language high-frequency small words or suffix fragments
patterns.context: In several Spanish, Romanian, Italian, and French contexts, high-frequency conjunctions, articles, or short-word fragments are marked; they are distributed across languages, with no stable shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Multilingual philosophy, parliamentary, and legal texts

3_704.concept: 多语种子词片段与高频词
3_704.description: 激活分散在多语种词内子词、屈折尾缀及高频小词上；少量英语逗号和短语也激活。虽多见于罗曼语文本，但触发位置和功能差异很大，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 西班牙语持续体/进行形式
patterns.context: 西班牙语动词以 -iendo/-endo 结尾，表示持续或进行；分别出现在「Siendo, como fue」和「se puede ... lo siguió siendo」。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语动词屈折片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句中，词干与动词屈折或词内部分拼写片段相邻；例句谈论采取措施、必须去做。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会罗马尼亚语发言

patterns.name: 罗曼语系词内切分片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同罗曼语词汇或屈折形式内部的连续子词片段；这些例子并不共享一个明确的词义或语法功能。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语、罗马尼亚语、意大利语、法语及罗马尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 英语功能词与常用词片段
patterns.trigger: 「« is»」「« are»」「to« a»」「« by»」「« now»」「known« as»」
patterns.context: 英语句子中，激活落在常见功能词、介词或短语片段；出现于粒子转变论述和法律保险文本。
patterns.domain: 英语哲学论述、法律判例

patterns.name: 非英语政治文本中的短片段
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语议会发言的词内片段，缺少与其他片段共有的明显语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语发言

patterns.name: 英语插入语标点及短语
patterns.context: 英语句中逗号和短语片段激活；出现在对认知不确定性的论述中，可能与其他词内片段无关。

patterns.name: 法律名称中的标点与专名续接
patterns.context: 法律判例中保险公司名称之后接续其现用名称，激活集中于逗号及名称介绍短语。

patterns.name: 跨语言高频小词或词尾片段
patterns.context: 若干西班牙语、罗马尼亚语、意大利语和法语语境中，高频连接词、冠词或短词片段被标记；跨语言分布广，未见稳定共同语义。
patterns.domain: 多语种哲学、议会及法律文本

en.description: Activations are concentrated most strongly on party labels, punctuation, and citation formatting in legal case titles; there are also Romanian hyphenated clitics, patent definitions, and scattered word fragments in Spanish and English philosophical passages, which are difficult to explain with a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Party-status labels in legal case names
patterns.context: In legal case titles, party status is hyphenated; activation concentrates on the hyphen and nearby label boundaries.

patterns.name: Hyphens and clitic attachment in Romanian
patterns.context: In Romanian sentences, a hyphen connects a pronoun or clitic form; nearby words often concern leaving, measures, or obligations.

patterns.name: Commas around parentheticals or titles
patterns.context: Commas occur between names and status labels in legal titles, or at parenthetical boundaries in English sentences; commas and nearby punctuation are marked.

patterns.name: Case citations after a line break
patterns.context: A volume/page number, case citation, or court case name appears immediately after a line break.

patterns.name: Connective in standalone legal citations
patterns.context: A volume number is adjacent to a reporter abbreviation, with a prominent period; the remaining context consists of case citations and names.

patterns.name: Term definitions in patent texts
patterns.context: A patent specification defines a term using “shall mean” and includes an escaped or garbled term fragment.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in Spanish phrases
patterns.context: In continuous Spanish narrative, activation is scattered across several common words or subword fragments within words; no clear local structure is shared with legal or other fragments.

patterns.name: Function words and parentheticals in English philosophical discourse
patterns.context: In English passages discussing mind, particles, and transformation rules, a few function words and phrases are marked; no stable specific trigger is apparent.

3_704.description: 激活最集中于法律判例标题中的当事人标签、标点和引注格式；另见罗马尼亚语连字符附着、专利定义，以及西班牙语和英语哲学段落中的零散词片段，难以由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 法律案名中的当事人身份标签
patterns.context: 法律判例标题中，当事人身份以连字符连接；激活集中在连字符及标签边界附近。
patterns.domain: 美国判例标题/法律文书

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语中的连字符与代词附着
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子中，连字符连接代词或附着形式；邻近词常涉及离开、措施或义务。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会罗马尼亚语文本

patterns.name: 逗号标记的插入语或称谓
patterns.context: 逗号出现在法律标题的姓名/身份标签之间，或英语句子的插入语边界；逗号及附近标点被标记。

patterns.name: 句首换行后的判例引注
patterns.context: 换行后立即出现卷页号、判例引注或法院案名。

patterns.name: 独立法律引注中的连接词
patterns.context: 卷号与 reporter 缩写相邻，句点标记明显；其余上下文是判例引注和姓名。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的术语定义
patterns.context: 专利说明书以“shall mean”定义术语，且出现被转义或乱码化的术语片段。
patterns.domain: 专利背景/技术法律文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语短语中的词形片段
patterns.context: 连续西班牙语叙述中，激活分散于若干常见词或词内子词片段；没有与法律或其他片段明显一致的局部结构。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文/西班牙语文本

patterns.name: 英语哲学论述中的功能词与插入语
patterns.context: 讨论心智、粒子及转化规则的英语段落中，少数功能词和短语被标记；未见稳定专属触发条件。

en.description: The strongest shared clues are the ending of Spanish siendo and English now; the remaining activations are distributed across multilingual word endings, in-word fragments, and punctuation, including a possibly corrupted escape string in a patent. They are difficult to group into a single semantic or genre pattern.

patterns.name: Suffix of siendo
patterns.context: The Spanish gerund of ser, «siendo», appears at the beginning of a sentence in «Siendo, como fue», in descriptions of a continuing state in «siguió siéndo», and in «continúa siendo».

patterns.name: Word boundary of now
patterns.context: In English, now appears after noun or verb phrases to indicate a current state or identity: «now known as» and «was now officially reckoned».

patterns.name: Portuguese verb endings
patterns.context: One token covers the ending of «tendo»; another covers the Romanian reflexive-pronoun structure «să-și folosească».
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, Portuguese and Romanian

patterns.name: French future-tense ending
patterns.context: ser-ont after mercure forms the future tense in «seront applicables»; high activation falls on the ending ont.

patterns.name: Escaped angle-bracket characters
patterns.context: A byte string resembling UTF-8/HTML escaping or corruption appears in patent text, embedded around the term crude ketone.

patterns.name: Comma and following text
patterns.context: In a philosophical English sentence, a comma is followed by by no means; in a legal sentence, a comma precedes a company name and now known as.

patterns.name: In-word character fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on in-word fragments in Romanian, Turkish, or words with special characters; no shared meaning or stable syntactic position is evident.

patterns.name: Residual activations without a clear common trigger
patterns.context: These activations are distributed across different languages and in-word positions; the available fragments are insufficient to determine a more specific shared condition.

3_704.description: 最强共同线索是西语 siendo 的词尾和英语 now；其余激活分散于多语种词尾、词内片段及标点，包含专利中的疑似损坏转义串，难以归为单一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: siendo 的后缀
patterns.context: 西班牙语中动词 ser 的 gerundio「siendo」，分别出现在句首「Siendo, como fue」、描述持续状态「siguió siéndo」及「continúa siendo」中。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语哲学或学术论述

patterns.name: now 的词界
patterns.context: 英语中 now 出现在名词或动词短语之后，表示当前状态或身份：「now known as」「was now officially reckoned」。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语动词词尾
patterns.context: 一个 token 覆盖「tendo」的结尾；另一个覆盖罗马尼亚语反身代词结构「să-și folosească」。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本，葡萄牙语及罗马尼亚语

patterns.name: 法语未来时词尾
patterns.context: mercure 后的 ser-ont 构成将来时「seront applicables」，高激活落在词尾 ont。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会法语政策文本

patterns.name: 被转义的尖括号字符
patterns.context: 专利文本中出现类似 UTF-8/HTML 转义或损坏的字节串，嵌在 crude ketone 术语周围。

patterns.name: 逗号及后续语流
patterns.context: 哲学英语句中逗号后接 by no means；法律句中逗号位于公司名称和 now known as 之前。

patterns.name: 词内字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在罗马尼亚语、土耳其语或含特殊字符的词内片段，未见共同词义或稳定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本、哲学文本

patterns.name: 缺乏明显统一触发的残余
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在不同语言及词内位置；现有片段不足以确定更具体的共同条件。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语、英语、葡萄牙语、罗马尼亚语、法语

en.description: The most stable trigger is the string “2002”, across biographical dates, literature citations, patent/copyright/experiment identifiers, and body text. A few numbers and King also show strong activation, but often co-occur with the year, so whether they are independent triggers is unclear.

patterns.name: Year 2002
patterns.context: The year string 2002 appears in dates, citations, identifiers, or body text; no fixed domain or syntactic position is required.

patterns.name: Hyphenated date ranges with 2002
patterns.context: 2002 is the starting year of a year range, followed by a hyphen and another year.

patterns.name: 2002 as a year in a date
patterns.context: The year appears in a person’s birth/death dates or in a date composed of year, month, and day.

patterns.name: 2002 as a publication year
patterns.context: The year is embedded in bibliographic or technical identifiers such as references, patent document numbers, URLs, or experiment labels.
patterns.domain: Academic literature, patents, software licenses, biomedical papers

patterns.name: 2002 as a point in time in body text
patterns.context: The year appears as a standalone time marker within or at the end of a sentence, rather than solely as a bibliographic identifier.

patterns.name: Year in a category heading
patterns.context: The year immediately follows an encyclopedia category label and marks a year of death.

patterns.name: King co-occurring with the year
patterns.context: The proper name King (including a person’s name or a category name) appears near 2002; it is unclear whether King is an independent trigger or merely co-occurs.

patterns.name: Year in a patent document number
patterns.context: The year field appears in a patent number; other numeric fragments in patent numbers containing 2002 also activate.

3_915.concept: 年份字符串“2002”
3_915.description: 最稳定的触发是字符串“2002”，横跨传记日期、文献引用、专利/版权/实验编号及正文时间。少数数字和 King 也有较强激活，但多与年份共现，是否独立触发不明。

patterns.name: 年份 2002
patterns.context: 年份字符串 2002 出现在日期、引用、标识符或正文中；无需固定领域或句法位置。

patterns.name: 2002 的连字符日期范围
patterns.context: 2002 作为年份区间的起始年份，后接连接号和另一年份。

patterns.name: 2002 作为日期中的年份
patterns.context: 年份处于人物生卒日期或年、月、日构成的日期中。

patterns.name: 2002 作为文献年份
patterns.trigger: «2002»10 出现在文献卷期、专利号、版权路径或研究编号中
patterns.context: 年份嵌在参考文献、专利文档编号、URL 或实验标记等书目/技术标识中。
patterns.domain: 学术文献、专利、软件许可、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 2002 作为正文时间点
patterns.context: 年份作为句中或句末的独立时间标记，而非纯书目编号。

patterns.name: 分类标题中的年份
patterns.context: 年份紧接百科分类标签，标记去世年份。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 King 与年份共现
patterns.context: 专名 King（包括人名或分类名）附近同时出现 2002；无法判断 King 是独立触发条件还是仅共现。

patterns.name: 专利文档编号中的年份
patterns.context: 专利号中年份字段出现，2002 所在专利号也有其他数字片段激活。

en.description: The prominent trigger shared across the segments is the year string “2002”, appearing in birth and death years, work dates, citations, classifications, paths, identifiers, and prediction contexts; styles and semantic roles vary widely.

patterns.name: 2002 in a year
patterns.context: Appears in a date, year, or year range; the year may be part of a person's birth or death dates, a publication year, a market forecast date, or an identifier.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, especially encyclopedias, academic literature, business emails, code, and patents

patterns.name: 2002 in a year suffix or identifier
patterns.context: The trigger itself remains the year number, but its surrounding structure may be a range, classification label, path, experiment number, or citation.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia categories, software licenses, paper and patent identifiers, medical papers

patterns.name: Date and identifier fragments adjacent to numbers
patterns.context: Associated with activation for 2002, but the fragments also contain other years or patent numbers; it is unclear whether these adjacent numbers independently trigger activation.

3_915.concept: 年份“2002”的字符串特征
3_915.description: 各段共同的显著触发是年份字符串“2002”，遍及生卒年、作品年份、引用、分类、路径、编号及预测语境；不同文体和语义角色差异很大。

patterns.name: 年份中的2002
patterns.context: 在日期、年份或年份范围中出现；年份可能是人物生卒年、文献年份、市场预测时间或标识符的一部分。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，尤见百科、学术文献、商业邮件、代码与专利

patterns.name: 年份后缀或编号中的2002
patterns.context: 触发本身仍是年份数字，但所在结构分别是范围、分类标签、路径、实验编号或引用。
patterns.domain: 百科分类、软件许可证、论文与专利编号、医学论文

patterns.name: 数字邻接的日期与编号片段
patterns.context: 与2002年的激活相关，但片段中也有其他年份或专利号；无法确定这些邻接数字是否独立触发。

en.description: The strongest activation in all segments falls on the string “2002”, spanning birth and death years, dates, patent numbers, business years, problem numbers, paper identifiers, and film years; its contextual functions vary.

patterns.name: Year 2002
patterns.context: The year string 2002 appears in dates, citations, identifiers, or narration; most passages also contain surrounding years or date formats.

patterns.name: 2002 in a year range
patterns.context: 2002 appears in parenthetical birth and death years or a year range, often adjacent to a hyphen, another year, and parentheses.

patterns.name: 2002 in a date or patent number
patterns.context: 2002 is part of a date or appears in a patent document number.
patterns.domain: Patent background text, software legal notices

patterns.name: Year as a time point
patterns.context: 2002 denotes a year in a business forecast, the denominator in a math problem number, or a year fragment in an experimental-method identifier.
patterns.domain: Business emails, math problems, life-sciences papers

patterns.name: Film year
patterns.context: 2002 follows a film title in parentheses, serving as the work's release or indicated year.

3_915.description: 所有片段中最强激活均落在字符串“2002”上，涵盖生卒年、日期、专利编号、商业年份、题目编号、论文标识和影片年份；上下文功能多样。

patterns.name: 年份 2002
patterns.context: 年份字符串 2002 出现在日期、引文、编号或叙述中；多数段落同时有周边年份或日期格式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本与多种文体

patterns.name: 年份区间中的 2002
patterns.context: 2002 位于括号中的生卒年或年份范围中，常与连字符、另一年份及括号相邻。

patterns.name: 日期或专利编号中的 2002
patterns.context: 2002 是日期的一部分，或出现在专利文献编号中。
patterns.domain: 专利背景文本、软件法律声明

patterns.name: 年份作为时间节点
patterns.context: 2002 表示商业预测中的年份、数学题编号中的分母，或实验方法标识中的年份片段。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、数学题、生命科学论文

patterns.name: 影片年份
patterns.context: 2002 紧跟影片名称并置于括号内，作为作品发行或标示年份。

en.description: The clearest shared trigger is the numeric year 2002, appearing in biographical dates, references, emails, patent numbers, license URLs, probability problems, and legal citations. Other date or numeric structures may be related, but the evidence is weaker; this pattern is not seen in PubMed excerpts.

patterns.name: Occurrences of the year 2002
patterns.context: The year appears as a number in dates, eras, references, or legal citations; other years or identifiers often appear nearby.
patterns.domain: Multidomain text, including biographies, email, patents, software licenses, math problems, and legal texts

patterns.name: Variants of the year 2002 or adjacent date numbers
patterns.context: 2002 appears in a year range, a parenthesized era, a category label, or a date/number sequence; other excerpts highlight date numbers such as 1951 and 2003.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, references, patents, and legal texts

3_915.description: 最明确的共同触发是数字年份 2002，出现在传记日期、参考文献、邮件、专利号、许可网址、概率题和法规引文中。其他日期或数字结构可能相关，但证据较弱；PubMed 片段未见该模式。

patterns.name: 年份 2002 的出现
patterns.context: 年份作为日期、年代、参考文献或法规引文中的数字出现；周围常有其他年份或编号。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本，包括传记、邮件、专利、软件许可、数学题和法律文本

patterns.name: 年份 2002 的变体或相邻日期数字
patterns.context: 2002 位于年份范围、括号中的年代、类别标签或日期／编号序列中；另有片段突出年份 1951、2003 等日期数字。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、参考文献、专利及法律文本

en.concept: Local features of years and subword fragments
en.description: Activation is most clearly concentrated on the year 2002 (in various numeric contexts) and subword fragments of the medical term lithotripsy; other highlights are scattered across paper titles, code comments, gardening announcements, and encyclopedia text, with no shared semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Year 2002 and neighboring tokens
patterns.context: Appears in number strings such as birth years, tenure ranges, or document identifiers; the strongest trigger form is the complete year 2002.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies, natural history text, patent documents, and number strings

patterns.name: extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy terminology
patterns.context: Subword fragments of this term in a medical abstract; the preceding extracorporeal/shock wave fragments also activate.

patterns.name: Specific highlighted words or identifiers
patterns.context: Appear respectively in a visual-stimulus study title, code comments, and C/C++ file-header comments; there is insufficient evidence to combine them into a consistent lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Botanical garden and gardening terms
patterns.context: In a botanical garden lecture announcement, involving plants, summer growth, and event information; activation is scattered across different words.

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments and punctuation
patterns.context: Multiple activations occur in encyclopedia biographies and category fields, but no shared trigger condition can be confirmed apart from the year 2002.

3_915.concept: 年份与分词片段的局部特征
3_915.description: 激活最明确地集中在年份 2002（含多种数字上下文）及医学术语 lithotripsy 的分词片段；其余高亮分散于论文标题、代码注释、园艺公告和百科词句，缺乏共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 年份 2002 及其邻近 token
patterns.context: 出现在生卒年份、任职时间范围或文献编号等数字串中；强度最高的触发形式是完整年份 2002。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、自然史文字、专利文献及数字串

patterns.name: extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy 术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中该术语的分词片段；前面的 extracorporeal/shock wave 片段也有激活。

patterns.name: 特定高亮词或标识符
patterns.context: 分别出现于视觉刺激研究标题、代码注释，以及 C/C++ 文件头注释；没有足够证据将它们合并为一致的词义模式。

patterns.name: 植物园与园艺主题词
patterns.context: 植物园讲座公告中，涉及植物、夏季生长及活动介绍；激活分散在不同词上。

patterns.name: 零散词片段与标点
patterns.context: 百科人物条目及分类字段中激活多处，但除年份 2002 外未见可确认的共同触发条件。

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and structural markers
en.description: Activation often falls on subword fragments of particular words and also appears in document structures such as headings, sections, notes, and definitions. Domains and semantics vary widely, so no single topic explains the pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in names
patterns.context: Character or subword fragments in the names Devinen and Nehru are split into multiple tokens, with activation on the fragments; the fragments recur.

patterns.name: Fragments in censored profanity
patterns.context: In uppercase colloquial sentences, profanity and words related to “CAPS LOCK” are split into multiple tokens; activation concentrates on these fragments.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in place names
patterns.context: In “Montenegrins” and its repeated forms, activation concentrates on tokenized fragments of the place name or demonym.

patterns.name: Medical terms and intraword fragments
patterns.context: In medical abstracts or papers, activation falls on technical terms, intraword fragments, or the beginning of section text; the sentences concern surgery, inflammation, or obesity.

patterns.name: Text structure and section markers
patterns.context: A newline and separator follow an Introduction heading and numbering in a paper; activation covers the structural markers and nearby section-opening text.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in headings and narrative text
patterns.context: English words and foreign words/proper names in headings or body text are split into subwords; activation is distributed across the fragments.

patterns.name: Code comments and license text
patterns.context: In asterisk-delimited comments at the beginning of code files, activation falls on uppercase notices or license names.

patterns.name: Punctuation and term fragments in definitions
patterns.context: In dictionary-style or database-style definitions, tokenized field labels and abbreviations/terms in parentheses activate.

patterns.name: Fragments of psychology construct terms
patterns.context: In an academic title developing an account of novelty and pleasure evaluation, activation falls on construct nouns.

3_915.concept: 特定子词与结构标记
3_915.description: 激活常落在特定词语的子词切分片段上，也见于标题、章节、注释和定义等文档结构；领域与语义差异很大，无法由单一主题解释。

patterns.name: 人名中的切分片段
patterns.context: 名字 Devinen、Nehru 的字符或子词片段被切成多个 token，激活落在片段上；片段重复出现。

patterns.name: 被遮掩的粗俗词中的片段
patterns.context: 大写口语句中，粗俗词与“CAPS LOCK”相关词被拆分成多个 token；激活集中在这些片段上。

patterns.name: 地名中的子词片段
patterns.context: “Montenegrins”及其重复形式中，激活集中在地名或国民称谓的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 医学术语及词内片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要或论文中，激活落在专业词、词内切分片段或章节正文起始处；所处句子涉及手术、炎症或肥胖。

patterns.name: 文本结构与章节标记
patterns.context: 论文的 Introduction 标题和编号之后出现换行、分隔线；激活覆盖结构标记及附近章节起始内容。

patterns.name: 标题及叙事文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 标题或正文中的英语词及外来语/专名被拆成子词；激活分布在片段上。

patterns.name: 代码注释和许可证文本
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的星号分隔注释中，激活落在全大写提示语或许可证名称上。

patterns.name: 定义文本中的标点和术语片段
patterns.context: 词典式或数据库式定义中，字段标签和括号内缩写/术语的切分 token 激活。

patterns.name: 心理学构念词的片段
patterns.context: 关于新奇性与愉悦评价逐步展开的学术标题中，激活落在构念名词上。

en.description: Activation is scattered across mathematical sets and cardinality statements, code elements/fields and event callbacks, paper structure and citations, uppercase angry statements, and botanical garden event descriptions. There is insufficient evidence to group these triggers into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Sets and object cardinality in mathematical text
patterns.context: Mathematical definitions or discussion describe finite sets, numbers of elements, roots, or subsets; set and root contexts also appear in unmarked portions.

patterns.name: Structured fields or members in code and technical documents
patterns.context: Code or markup languages contain elements, fields, object members, or type definitions; activation is distributed over identifiers and nearby tokens.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, code, and technical documents

patterns.name: Interactive events and callbacks in code examples
patterns.context: Code or Q&A examples involve click events, callback functions, or element selection; activation falls on local code structures and adjacent markers.

patterns.name: Uppercase emphasis
patterns.context: An entire sentence uses uppercase letters to express a strong command or complaint; activation is distributed over uppercase word fragments.

patterns.name: Botanical garden event description
patterns.context: Describes summer talks or events about plants in Houston, mentioning whether plants can survive and grow.

patterns.name: Paper structure and literature citations
patterns.context: Introduces related work or paper structure in an academic paper.

3_915.concept: none
3_915.description: 激活分散于数学集合与基数表述、代码中的元素/字段和事件回调、论文结构与引用、大写怒斥及植物园活动介绍；没有足够证据将这些触发归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的集合与对象基数
patterns.context: 数学定义或论述中，描述有限集合、元素数量、根或子集；未标记部分也出现集合与根的语境。

patterns.name: 代码与技术文档中的结构化字段或成员
patterns.context: 代码或标记语言中出现 element、字段、对象成员或类型定义；激活分布在标识符及其附近。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、代码与技术文档

patterns.name: 代码示例中的交互事件与回调
patterns.context: 代码或问答示例涉及点击事件、回调函数或元素选择；激活落在局部代码结构及相邻标记上。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、JavaScript 示例

patterns.name: 大写强调语气
patterns.context: 整句以大写字母表达强烈命令或抱怨；激活分布在大写词语片段。

patterns.name: 植物园活动介绍
patterns.context: 介绍休斯敦夏季植物相关讲座或活动，提及植物能否存活及生长。

patterns.name: 论文结构与文献引用
patterns.context: 学术论文中介绍相关研究或论文结构。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the “depos” subword fragment within “depositing”, across patent, forum, and paper contexts, often involving films, materials, or surface fabrication. Weaker or separate activation also appears in capacitance terminology and LaTeX formula environments.

patterns.name: Split stem in “depositing”
patterns.context: Activation is adjacent to the subword fragment “depos”, occurring within the word “depositing”; an object or prepositional phrase often follows.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text, materials and device fabrication; also forum discussions and paper abstracts

patterns.name: Capacitance-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in technical descriptions of capacitive sensing, pressure-change measurement, and membrane structures; activation here is weaker than in the “depos” pattern.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background, sensors and measurement electronics

patterns.name: Formula formatting and conditional probability notation
patterns.context: Occurs in a LaTeX math environment, with activation distributed around formula commands, brackets, and symbols; the substring “depos” is absent.
patterns.domain: ArXiv math or machine learning papers

3_915.concept: depositing词干
3_915.description: 主要对单词“depositing”内部的“depos”子词片段强烈响应，跨专利、论坛及论文语境，常与薄膜、材料或表面制造有关；另有电容术语和LaTeX公式环境中的较弱或独立激活。

patterns.name: “depositing”的拆分词干
patterns.context: 激活紧邻子词片段“depos”，出现在“depositing”这一词的内部；周围常接宾语或介词短语。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、材料与器件制造，也见于论坛讨论和论文摘要

patterns.name: 电容相关词汇
patterns.context: 出现在描述电容传感、压力变化测量及膜结构的技术说明中；此处激活弱于“depos”模式。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，传感器与测量电子学

patterns.name: 公式排版与条件概率记号
patterns.context: 处于 LaTeX 数学公式环境中，触发分布在公式命令、括号和符号附近；未见“depos”子串。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学或机器学习论文

en.concept: Frequent structures and phrasing in academic text
en.description: Activation is distributed across English function words and academic sentence patterns, formula symbols, medical paper title phrasing, and patent terminology, project text, and philosophical discussion. No single stable content-word topic is apparent.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase frames
patterns.context: Frequent function words in common English grammatical frames; sometimes adjacent to specific academic nouns.

patterns.name: Numerical values, formulas, and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: In mathematical expressions or symbolic discussion, activation falls on formula symbols or short tokens in mathematical contexts.
patterns.domain: StackExchange math Q&A, math papers, and mathematical discussion

patterns.name: Medical terminology and title-style phrasing
patterns.context: Medical topic nouns or paper title/abstract-style phrases; some activation concentrates on prepositions and title phrasing.

patterns.name: Research and public institution phrasing
patterns.context: Describes cutting-edge research or the purpose of strengthening institutional capacity or projects.

patterns.name: Specific rare proper names or compound terms
patterns.context: In patent background sentences, activation falls on uncommon shape descriptions and engineering material nouns; triggers are difficult to reconcile with those in other passages.

patterns.name: Philosophical discussion and explanatory asides
patterns.context: Discussion compares theoretical superiority and introduces an explanation with “i.e.”; activation is distributed across comparative phrases, asides, and ordinary function words.

patterns.name: Generic academic definition phrasing
patterns.context: Introduces a mathematical object by defining it or describing its origin or theoretical use; the specific terms themselves are not consistent strong triggers.

3_915.concept: 学术文本中的高频结构与措辞
3_915.description: 激活分布在英语功能词和学术句式、公式符号、医学论文标题措辞，以及专利术语、项目文本和哲学论述等处；未见单一稳定的内容词主题。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及短语框架
patterns.context: 常见英语语法框架中的高频功能词；有时与具体学术名词相邻

patterns.name: 数值、公式与数学符号
patterns.context: 数学表达式或符号化论述中，激活落在公式组成符号或数学语境中的简短词元
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数学问答、数学论文及数学论述

patterns.name: 医学论文术语与标题式短语
patterns.context: 医学主题名词或论文标题、摘要式短语；部分激活集中在介词和标题措辞
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、医学相关材料

patterns.name: 研究与公共机构措辞
patterns.context: 描述发展前沿研究、提升机构能力的目的或项目表述

patterns.name: 具体罕见专名或复合术语
patterns.context: 专利背景句中，激活落在不常见的形状描述及工程材料名词；与其他段的触发难以归并

patterns.name: 哲学论述及解释性插入语
patterns.context: 比较理论优越性并以“i.e.”引出解释的论述；激活分布在比较短语、插入语及普通功能词上

patterns.name: 通用学术定义措辞
patterns.context: 以定义、来源或理论用途介绍数学对象；具体术语本身并非一致的强触发项

en.concept: Mixed word fragments and numbering patterns
en.description: Activation is scattered across English function words and intraword fragments, Portuguese/French word fragments, and numbers, identifiers, and citation markers in scientific text. A few i fragments occur in words expressing unease or research mechanisms, but cross-language and cross-domain evidence is insufficient to treat them as a unified semantic feature.

patterns.name: “i” in words related to questions or anxiety
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intraword letter fragment; the word often expresses unease, worry, or inquiry, but also occurs in technical terms, so semantics alone cannot explain it.
patterns.domain: Portuguese opinion and political texts, English scientific/medical texts

patterns.name: Numbers and alphanumeric strings in technical text
patterns.context: Appears in sequence coordinates, reference numbers, measurement ranges, or quantified patent units in scientific papers; the marker covers part of a mixed alphanumeric string.

patterns.name: English function words and their tokenized fragments
patterns.context: Appears as a function word or phrase component in English sentences; activation within the same passage is not restricted to a particular semantic role and may reflect an independent high-frequency word-form pattern.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia, forum, and scientific text

patterns.name: Tokenized English intraword and word-final fragments
patterns.context: The marker crosses or falls at subword boundaries, with inconsistent morphological positions; no shared semantic condition explains all examples.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia, patents, forums, and scientific text

patterns.name: Citation or reference markers attached to numbers
patterns.context: Activation is embedded in bracketed citation markers or similar reference numbers in papers, often mixing digits, hyphens, and letters.

patterns.name: A fragment expressing concern in a French word
patterns.context: A French sentence discusses the precarious situation of Portuguese workers; multiple markers fall within different words, and only inquiétante is clearly related to the meaning of worry.
patterns.domain: French speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Intraword letter fragments in Portuguese words
patterns.context: Appears in a Portuguese passage about young philosophers wanting to be heard; markers are scattered across multiple words, some related to unease, but there is no unified word-form or semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Unclassified local word-form activations
patterns.context: The words belong to different syntactic and thematic contexts; beyond English word forms or scientific contexts, there is insufficient evidence for a more specific shared trigger pattern.

3_915.concept: 混合词片段与编号模式
3_915.description: 激活散布于英语功能词与词内片段、葡萄牙语/法语词片段，以及科学文本中的数字、编号和引文标记。少数 i 片段落在表示不安或研究机制的词中，但跨语种、跨领域证据不足以将其视为统一语义特征。

patterns.name: 疑问、焦虑相关词中的「i」
patterns.context: 激活落在词内的字母片段；所在词常表达不安、担忧或探究，但也见于技术术语，不能只归结为词义
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语议论与政治文本、英语科学/医学文本

patterns.name: 技术文本中的数字与字母串
patterns.context: 出现在科学论文的序列坐标、参考文献编号、测量范围或专利量化单位中；标记覆盖的是混合数字与字母串的一部分

patterns.name: 英语功能词及其分词片段
patterns.trigger: « to»、« of»、« the»、« for»、« from»、« absolutely»、« nothing» 等
patterns.context: 在英语句子中作为虚词或短语组成部分出现；同一段内激活并不局限于特定语义角色，可能是独立的高频词形模式
patterns.domain: 英语百科、论坛与科学文本

patterns.name: 英语词内分词与词尾片段
patterns.context: 标记跨越或落在词的子词边界处，形态位置不一致；未见能解释全部词例的共同语义条件
patterns.domain: 英语百科、专利、论坛及科学文本

patterns.name: 数字附带的引文或参考标记
patterns.context: 激活嵌在论文的方括号引文标识或类似文献编号中，常与数字、连字符及字母混排

patterns.name: 法语词中表示忧虑的片段
patterns.trigger: «i»«ét»«5» 位于 «inquiétante»；另有 «milli»、«travaille» 等词片段
patterns.context: 法语句子谈及葡萄牙工人的不稳定处境；多个标记落在不同词内，只有 inquiétante 与忧虑语义较明确相关

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语关于年轻哲学家渴望被倾听的段落；标记分散于多个词，部分词涉及不安，但没有统一词形或语义触发条件

patterns.name: 未能归入的局部词形激活
patterns.context: 词项分属不同句法和主题；除了英语词形或科学语境外，没有足够证据支持更具体的共同触发模式

en.description: Activation covers olfaction-related words, gut/gastrointestinal words, and fragments related to wood texture, fatty acid oxidation, and a protein family; these signals span multiple biomedical topics and are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Olfaction-related words
patterns.context: The word appears in contexts involving olfactory input, olfactory perception, or the name of an olfaction-related tumor; the trigger does not depend on a single context.

patterns.name: Gut and gastrointestinal terms
patterns.context: Describes gut homeostasis, defense, microbes, or gastrointestinal tissue; also includes contexts involving stomach lesions.

patterns.name: Touch and wood stimuli
patterns.context: Co-occurs with touching wood, tactile stimulation, and its physiological effects on the human body.

patterns.name: Fatty acids and β-oxidation
patterns.context: Involves fatty acid composition, isomer degradation, or β-oxidation; the strong trigger may be a tokenized string fragment.

patterns.name: Fragment with unclear trigger
patterns.context: Appears in a description of a protein family signature pattern; the local context provided shows no stable connection to the other strong triggers.

3_915.concept: 生物医学术语片段
3_915.description: 激活覆盖嗅觉相关词、肠道/胃肠道词，以及木材触觉、脂肪酸氧化和一个蛋白质家族词片段；这些信号跨多个生物医学主题，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 嗅觉相关词
patterns.context: 该词出现在嗅觉输入、嗅觉感知或嗅觉相关肿瘤名称中；触发不依赖单一语境。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、嗅觉生理、肿瘤医学

patterns.name: 肠道与胃肠道
patterns.context: 描述肠道稳态、防御、微生物或胃肠道组织；也包括胃部病变语境。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、胃肠病学、肿瘤病理

patterns.name: 触觉与木材刺激
patterns.context: 与触摸木材、触觉刺激及其对人体的生理效应同现。

patterns.name: 脂肪酸及β-氧化
patterns.context: 涉及脂肪酸组成、异构体降解或β-氧化；强触发词可能是分词后的字符串片段。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、昆虫嗅觉生理

patterns.name: 触发依据不明的片段
patterns.context: 在蛋白质家族签名模式描述中出现；给出的局部上下文未显示与其他强触发词的稳定联系。

en.description: Primarily activates strongly on colonic in medical text, involving colonic tissue, function, transit, and disease; there are also isolated activations on ic within words (varicose, colic), i in corrupted text, and g in vulgars.

patterns.name: Colon-related medical terms
patterns.context: Used as a noun modifier in medical text to describe colonic tissue, function, length, weight, transit, or disease; often near words such as mucosa, epithelium, and transit.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, clinical studies, and abstracts

patterns.name: Word-internal colic fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter fragment ic inside words: once in varicose («var»3«ic»10), and once in colic («col»1«ic»10); the former refers to varicose veins, the latter to infantile colic.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on suspected token fragments or remnants
patterns.context: Appears in the incomplete, marked garbled/transcription fragment “DiThi↵I”; context is insufficient to confirm a connection to medicine or another topic.
patterns.domain: Formatted fragment in a HackerNews post

patterns.name: Profanity fragment
patterns.context: Falls within the word vulgars, in a passage discussing negative characters, gore, and profanity in games.

3_915.concept: 结肠医学词汇（兼有词片段噪声）
3_915.description: 主要在医学文本的 colonic 上强激活，涉及结肠组织、功能、转运与疾病；另有词内 ic（varicose、colic）、乱码中的 i 和 vulgars 中的 g 等孤立激活。

patterns.name: 结肠相关医学术语
patterns.context: 在医学文本中作为名词修饰语，描述结肠组织、功能、长度、重量、转运或疾病；常邻近 mucosa、epithelium、transit 等词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、临床研究及摘要

patterns.name: 词内 colic 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的 ic 字母片段：一处出现在 varicose（«var»3«ic»10），另一处出现在 colic（«col»1«ic»10）；前者指静脉曲张，后者指婴儿肠绞痛。

patterns.name: 疑似分词或残片偶发激活
patterns.context: 出现在不完整、带标记的乱码/转录片段 “DiThi↵I”；上下文不足以确认与医学或其他主题相关。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 帖文中的格式化片段

patterns.name: 粗俗词片段
patterns.context: 落在 vulgars 一词内部，周围讨论游戏中负面角色、血腥和脏话。

en.concept: Medical terms and specific word-form fragments
en.description: Activation concentrates on medical terms and their intraword fragments: gut/intestinal mucosa, hyaluronidase, and punctal atresia; it also responds to fragments in obfuscation and sporadic forum text. The triggers do not form a single semantic category.

patterns.name: “intestinal mucosa” terminology
patterns.context: “intestinal” is adjacent to “mucosa” in descriptions of intestinal mucosa and its inflammation or TNFα levels; activation falls on intestinal.

patterns.name: Intestinal and digestive system terminology
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of intestinal disease symptoms, complications, or anatomy; includes intestinal stenosis and ileus.

patterns.name: Hyaluronidase-related word form
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intraword fragment of hyaluronidase, in descriptions of enzyme purification and allergic reactions.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in obfuscation
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intraword fragment of obfuscation or obfuscated, in contexts involving code obfuscation or information concealment.

patterns.name: Punctal atresia term fragment
patterns.context: An intraword fragment forms part of punctal atresia, in descriptions of eyelid- and tarsus-related disorders.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in DiThi
patterns.context: Appears in a username or identifier in a HackerNews post; the surrounding content discusses plant protein and health.

patterns.name: Local activation on initial this
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a HackerNews excerpt, followed by a period and newline separator; the subsequent content has a different topic.

patterns.name: Developmental timing word
patterns.context: Describes enzyme activity or a biological developmental process continuing over time; activation falls on throughout.

3_915.concept: 医学术语与特定词形片段
3_915.description: 激活集中于医学术语及其词内片段：肠道/肠黏膜、透明质酸酶、泪点闭锁；另对 obfuscation 及零散论坛文本片段响应。触发机制并非单一语义类别。

patterns.name: intestinal mucosa 术语
patterns.context: “intestinal”紧邻“mucosa”，描述肠黏膜及其炎症或 TNFα 水平；激活落在 intestinal 上
patterns.domain: 生物医学、消化道疾病与免疫学

patterns.name: 肠道及消化系统术语
patterns.context: 出现在肠病症状、并发症或解剖描述中；包括 intestinal stenosis、ileus 等

patterns.name: 透明质酸酶相关词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 hyaluronidase 的词内片段，分别处于酶纯化和过敏反应描述中
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、医疗案例

patterns.name: obfuscation 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 obfuscation 或 obfuscated 的词内片段，语境涉及代码混淆或信息遮蔽

patterns.name: 泪点闭锁术语片段
patterns.context: 词内片段构成 punctal atresia，位于眼睑及睑板相关病变描述中

patterns.name: DiThi 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 帖子的用户名或标识符中，周围内容谈及植物蛋白及健康

patterns.name: 开头 this 的局部激活
patterns.context: 位于 HackerNews 片段开头，后接句点与换行分隔符；其后内容主题不同

patterns.name: 发育时序词
patterns.context: 描述酶活性或生物发育过程持续发生；激活落在 throughout

en.concept: Primarily intestinal medical vocabulary, with sporadic word-internal fragments
en.description: Primarily activates in medical contexts involving the intestine, small intestine, and intestinal mucosa, and also covers abdominal digestive diseases; there are also word-internal activations in hormone and jejunal terminology, as well as bloodshed and obfuscation.

patterns.name: Intestinal vocabulary and intestinal mucosa
patterns.context: Activates when describing intestinal mucosa, small-intestinal tissue, or intestinal physiology and pathology; often co-occurs with words such as inflammation, antibodies, function, or barrier.

patterns.name: Abdominal and digestive-system diseases
patterns.context: Activates when describing abdominal pain, abdominal tumors or peritonitis, as well as digestive diseases such as Crohn's disease and their complications.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on subwords within medical terms; one occurs in a hormone secretion context, the other in the title of a rat intestinal transplantation study.

patterns.name: Violence-related word ending
patterns.context: In an anti-war discussion, activation is concentrated on the ending of “bloodshed”, near mentions of nuclear weapons, bioterrorism, and peace.

patterns.name: Obfuscation fragment in legal text
patterns.context: Appears in a legal discussion of government information concealment and misrepresentation; strong activation is concentrated on an internal word fragment.

3_915.concept: 肠道医学词汇为主，兼有零散词内片段
3_915.description: 主要对肠道、小肠及肠黏膜相关医学语境激活，也覆盖腹部消化疾病；另有激素、空肠术语，以及bloodshed和obfuscation中的词内片段激活。

patterns.name: 肠道相关词汇与肠黏膜
patterns.context: 在描述肠黏膜、小肠组织或肠道生理与病理时激活；常与炎症、抗体、功能或屏障等词同现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、胃肠病学论文

patterns.name: 腹部与消化系统疾病
patterns.context: 描述腹痛、腹部肿瘤或腹膜炎，以及克罗恩病等消化系统疾病与并发症时激活。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学术语的词内子词上；前者处于激素分泌语境，后者处于大鼠肠移植研究标题中。

patterns.name: 血腥暴力词尾
patterns.context: 在反战论述中，激活集中于“bloodshed”的词尾，邻近提到核武器、生物恐怖主义与和平。

patterns.name: 法律词内的混淆片段
patterns.context: 出现在政府信息遮掩与误述的法律论述中；强激活集中于单词内部片段。

en.description: Primarily responds to the obfuscate word family and its split spellings, covering code obfuscation, information concealment, and concealed intent; activation also occurs on ic in silicone and f in roman à clef, possibly reflecting weak orthographic associations.

patterns.name: The obfuscate word family
patterns.context: The word describes code, intent, or information being concealed or confused; includes obfuscated code, obfuscate code, and government information obfuscation in a legal context.
patterns.domain: Programming discussions, comments, legal texts, and general online articles

patterns.name: Local trigger on the letter f
patterns.context: In excerpt 8, activation falls on ic within “silicone”; in excerpt 10, it falls on f in “clef”. Neither has a clear obfuscate-related meaning, so these may be secondary orthographic or tokenization triggers.

3_915.concept: 混淆、遮掩（尤指 obfuscate）
3_915.description: 主要响应 obfuscate 词族及其分片拼写，涵盖代码混淆、信息遮掩和隐瞒意图；另在 silicone 的 ic 与 roman à clef 的 f 处激活，可能是字形层面的弱关联。

patterns.name: obfuscate 词族
patterns.context: 词语用于描述代码、意图或信息被遮掩、混淆；包括被 obfuscated 的代码、obfuscate code，以及法律语境中的政府信息混淆。
patterns.domain: 编程讨论、评论、法律文本及一般网络文章

patterns.name: 字母 f 的局部触发
patterns.trigger: “polyamides”中的“f”并未出现；可见触发为“sil«ic»9one”中的 ic 片段及“roman a cle«f»9”中的 f
patterns.context: 第8段激活落在“silicone”内部的 ic；第10段落在“clef”中的 f，均没有明确的 obfuscate 词义语境，可能是次要的字形或分词触发。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本；文学评论

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on English infinitive to; it is also widely distributed across segmented word-internal fragments, technical suffixes, and formatting boundaries in academic, technical, code, and online text, with sporadic appearances in expressions of difficulty and multilingual spellings.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Activation falls on English infinitive to, which may be followed by a verb, as in “to say”, “to find”, and “to download”, and also appears in expressions of purpose or result.
patterns.domain: English prose, technical and academic text

patterns.name: Word-internal suffixes or morpheme fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within words split by tokenization, often on endings, spelling fragments, or morphological boundaries; examples occur in multilingual text, proper names, and technical terms.

patterns.name: Literal difficulty word hard
patterns.context: hard combines with the following to to mean difficult to find a developer or difficult to download and use.

patterns.name: Parentheses, punctuation, and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Weak activation also appears near structural boundaries such as parentheses, commas, and line breaks, often alongside technical abbreviations or delimiter formats.

patterns.name: Emphatic word in a concluding expression
patterns.context: In the fixed expression “suffice it to say”, it and to activate; to also fits the infinitive pattern.

patterns.name: Animal-behavior terminology fragments
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments and related words are marked in academic descriptions of animal communication and semiochemicals.

patterns.name: Neurochemical terminology fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of neurochemical(s) in a taste neuroscience context.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in pathogen and neurological-symptom terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal fragment of neurologic in a description of Bornavirus pathogenesis and dysfunction.

patterns.name: Slovenian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Slovenian commands and nouns in code strings are segmented, with multiple word-internal fragments activating.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in misspellings
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal word fragments in nonstandard spellings or misspelled user-generated text.

3_915.concept: 不定式标记与词内片段
3_915.description: 激活最稳定地落在英语不定式 to；另广泛分布于被切分的词内片段、术语后缀及格式边界，跨学术、技术、代码和网络文本，难度表达与多语种拼写亦有零星表现。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 激活落在英语不定式 to；后续可接动词，如“to say”“to find”“to download”，也见于目的或结果表达。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、技术与学术文本

patterns.name: 词内后缀或词素片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的词内部，常见于词尾、拼写片段或形态边界；多语种及专名、术语中均出现。
patterns.domain: 英语、斯拉夫语及专业术语文本

patterns.name: 字面难度词 hard
patterns.context: hard 与后续 to 连用，表示难以找到开发者或难以下载使用。

patterns.name: 括号、标点与格式边界
patterns.context: 括号、逗号、换行等结构边界附近也有弱激活，常伴随术语缩写或分隔格式。

patterns.name: 完成表达中的强调词
patterns.context: 固定表达“suffice it to say”中，it 与 to 有激活；to 同时符合不定式模式。

patterns.name: 动物行为学术语片段
patterns.context: 在动物交流、半化学物质的学术描述中，词内片段和相关词被标记。

patterns.name: 神经化学术语片段
patterns.context: 味觉神经科学语境下，激活落在 neurochemical(s) 的内部片段。

patterns.name: 病原体与神经症状词内片段
patterns.context: 在 Bornavirus 致病及功能障碍的描述中，激活落在 neurologic 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 代码字符串中的斯洛文尼亚语命令及名词被切分，多个词内片段激活。
patterns.domain: 代码与本地化界面文本

patterns.name: 错误拼写中的词内片段
patterns.context: 非标准拼写或拼写错误的用户生成文本中，激活落在词内部片段。

en.concept: Specialized word-internal fragments and sporadic word forms
en.description: Most activations occur on the ic fragment within medical, materials, and chemical terminology; others occur on local forms such as tarsus, terbinafine, bacterial names, and neuronal, as well as sporadic activations in villain-related commentary and entertainment narratives.

patterns.name: Word-internal ic fragment
patterns.context: Activations occur on the letter sequence ic inside English words, commonly in specialized terms containing ic; the word need not appear sentence-initially or in a particular syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Medical, materials science, and chemical terminology

patterns.name: ars/us fragments in medical words
patterns.context: Occur in subword fragments of “tarsus”; the context concerns the eyelid and eyelid margin.

patterns.name: Word fragments in negative-evaluation contexts
patterns.context: Warnings about playing villainous roles include negative evaluative terms such as bloody and vulgar; activations are distributed across multiple word fragments and adjacent function words.

patterns.name: is at the end of a plural or proper name
patterns.context: Occurs in a word fragment of the bacterial name “Capnocytophaga gingivalis”; there is insufficient evidence to identify an independent trigger condition.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment of terbinafine
patterns.context: Activates in both occurrences of terbinafine; surrounding text discusses oral antifungal drugs and treatment of athlete’s foot.

patterns.name: you and say in colloquial phrasing
patterns.context: An entertainment narrative discusses actors’ commitment to a story and uses “Suffice it to say” to introduce a summary; this does not clearly match the other activation patterns.

patterns.name: neuronal in neuroscience
patterns.context: Describes coordination of upper- and lower-limb muscles and neural control; activations concentrate on fragments of terms such as neuronal and interlimb.

patterns.name: Common sentence-initial function words and research phrasing
patterns.context: Activates in the academic formula “the best of our knowledge” and the following text; this may be a phrase-specific phenomenon.

patterns.name: Local fragments not assignable to the patterns above
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of “dihedral angle”; the available fragment is insufficient to determine whether it represents an independent lexical or semantic pattern.

3_915.concept: 专业词内部片段与零散词形
3_915.description: 激活多数落在医学、材料与化学术语内部的 ic 片段；另有 tarsus、terbinafine、细菌名、neuronal 等局部词形，以及反派评论和娱乐叙述中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 词内碎片 ic
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词内部的 ic 字母片段，常见于含 ic 的专业术语；不要求该词出现在句首或特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 医学、材料科学及化学术语

patterns.name: 医学词中的 ars/us 片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 “tarsus” 一词跨 token 的片段中，语境涉及眼睑和睑缘。

patterns.name: 负面评价语境中的词片段
patterns.context: 围绕扮演反派角色的警告，出现血腥、粗俗等负面评价词；激活分布在多个词片段及相邻功能词上。

patterns.name: 复数或专名末尾的 is
patterns.context: 出现在细菌名称 “Capnocytophaga gingivalis” 的词内片段，未见足够证据确定其独立触发条件。

patterns.name: terbinafine 词内片段
patterns.context: 在两次出现的 terbinafine 中激活，周边讨论口服抗真菌药及足癣治疗。

patterns.name: 口语句式中的 you 与 say
patterns.context: 娱乐性叙述中谈演员对故事的投入，并以 “Suffice it to say” 引出总结；与其他激活模式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 神经科学中的 neuronal
patterns.context: 描述上下肢肌肉协调及神经控制，激活集中在 neuronal 和 interlimb 等术语片段。

patterns.name: 句首常见功能词及研究措辞
patterns.context: 在 “the best of our knowledge” 这一论文惯用语及其后续表述中激活；可能是短语特定现象。

patterns.name: 无法归入上述模式的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 “dihedral angle” 一词开头，当前片段不足以确认是否为独立词汇或语义模式。

en.concept: Subword fragments and local form responses
en.description: Activation is scattered across word-internal subwords, function words, and code punctuation; examples occur in medical terminology, recipes, patents, code, and online text, with no unified semantic pattern yet, possibly influenced by subword boundaries or local form.

patterns.name: Cross-boundary word-internal fragment “ic”
patterns.context: Activation falls on one or more subwords within a word; word meaning, initial letters, and context vary considerably, and some examples mark ic while others do not.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, patent background, technical text

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments within terminology
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments in medical terms activate; their positions and lengths vary, surrounded by contexts involving oral antifungal drugs and tinea pedis studies.

patterns.name: Ingredient or cooking-word fragments in recipes
patterns.context: In recipe steps, internal fragments of ingredient names or action words are marked, surrounded by instructions such as grinding, mixing, and adding oil.

patterns.name: Code symbols, types, and identifier fragments
patterns.context: In Swift-style code snippets, subwords in identifiers/types and near line breaks and parentheses are marked; the code contains function parameter declarations.

patterns.name: Proper names and irregular word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation appears within game-related proper names, misspelled user text, and a proper name before a title/URL, with no consistent lexical meaning or context.

patterns.name: Common function words in patents
patterns.context: Multiple function words are marked in patent background or method-claim-like text, but these words also appear in many non-activating contexts and cannot individually explain the segments.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or paragraph-boundary words
patterns.context: Marked words occur at sentence or section beginnings in PubMed text; it is uncertain whether position triggers activation.

3_915.concept: 词片段与局部形式响应
3_915.description: 激活分散在词内子词、功能词及代码标点等位置；医学术语、食谱、专利、代码和网络文本均有例，尚无统一语义规律，可能受子词边界或局部形式影响。

patterns.name: 词内跨边界片段「ic」
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的一段或数段子词上；词义、词首及上下文差异很大，且有的例子标记的是 ic，有的并非 ic。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利背景、技术文本

patterns.name: 术语内部的分词片段
patterns.context: 医学术语中的词内片段被激活；片段位置和长短不一，周围是口服抗真菌药及足癣研究语境。

patterns.name: 食谱中的食材或烹饪词片段
patterns.context: 食谱步骤中，食材名称的内部片段或操作词被标记，周围有研磨、混合、加油等指令。

patterns.name: 代码符号、类型与标识符片段
patterns.context: Swift 风格代码片段中，换行、括号附近及标识符/类型的子词被标记；代码包含函数参数声明。

patterns.name: 专名及词内不规则片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在游戏相关专名、拼写不规范的用户文本，以及一个标题/URL 前的专名内部，缺乏一致的词义或语境。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 用户文本、HackerNews 标题

patterns.name: 专利中的常见功能词
patterns.context: 专利背景或方法权利要求式文本中，多个功能词被标记，但这些词也出现在许多未激活的语境，无法单独解释各段。

patterns.name: 句首或段落边界词
patterns.context: 标记出现在 PubMed 文本的句首或章节开头；是否由位置触发不确定。

en.description: Activations often fall on letter fragments inside segmented words, across domains and without a unified semantics. More prominent local clusters include silic-, terbinafine, recipe words, laboratory instrument terms, and ophthalmic terminology, alongside sporadic function words.

patterns.name: b or following word fragments in words containing b
