patterns.context: Activations usually fall on annotated fragments within segmented words rather than stable complete words; fragments may occur at the beginning, middle, or end of a word, with no consistent syntactic or semantic condition evident.
patterns.domain: Mixed domains: architecture, medicine, chemistry, cooking, software, neuroscience, etc.

patterns.name: silic-related word fragments
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments “Sil” and “ic” are marked in words referring to silicone, silica, or containing silicon; they occur across different word forms, word boundaries, and contexts.
patterns.domain: Patent materials, medical research, chemistry and materials science

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment of terbinafine
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments of the drug name terbinafine are marked consecutively, especially b and ina, in the context of research on oral antifungal drugs.

patterns.name: Fragments of cooking steps and ingredient words
patterns.context: In imperative recipe text, fragments of action words and herb and spice names are marked; activations are not limited to any one ingredient.

patterns.name: Word fragments related to discrete analyzers
patterns.context: Fragments of instrument names or terms activate in descriptions of assay range and analyzer performance.

patterns.name: Eyelid and lacrimal-duct terminology fragments
patterns.context: In ophthalmic case discussions, word-internal fragments of anatomical terms and punctal atresia are marked.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment of pain
patterns.context: In a discussion of software tools, pain and the nearby line break activate in the phrase “figuring out the magic combination 很麻烦”.

patterns.name: General function-word fragments
patterns.context: These common words occur sporadically in different syntactic positions. Their intensity is usually lower than the peaks of word-internal fragments, and they show no stable domain or semantic condition.

3_915.concept: 词内片段/子词响应
3_915.description: 激活多落在被切分词内部的字母片段，跨领域且缺少统一语义；较明显的局部聚类包括 silic-、terbinafine、食谱词、检验仪器词及眼科术语，另有零散功能词。

patterns.name: 含 b 的词中 b 或其后续词片段
patterns.context: 激活通常落在被拆分标注的词内片段，而非稳定的完整词；片段可能处于词首、词中或词尾，未见一致的句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 多领域混合：建筑、医学、化学、烹饪、软件、神经科学等

patterns.name: silic-相关词片段
patterns.context: 在硅酮、二氧化硅或含 silicon 的词中，词内片段“Sil”“ic”被标记；不同词形、词界和上下文均出现。
patterns.domain: 专利材料、医学研究、化学与材料科学

patterns.name: terbinafine 词内片段
patterns.context: 药物名称 terbinafine 的词内片段被连续标记，尤其是 b 与 ina；处于口服抗真菌药研究语境。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤及食材词片段
patterns.context: 祈使式食谱文字中，动作词及香草、香料名称的部分词片段被标记；激活并不局限于单一食材。

patterns.name: 离散分析仪相关词片段
patterns.context: 围绕 assay range 与分析仪性能描述时，仪器名称或术语的片段激活。

patterns.name: 眼睑与泪道术语片段
patterns.context: 眼科病例讨论中，解剖部位及术语 punctal atresia 的词内片段被标记。

patterns.name: pain 的词内片段
patterns.context: 软件工具讨论中，表达“figuring out the magic combination 很麻烦”时，pain 及邻近换行处激活。

patterns.name: 通用功能词片段
patterns.context: 这些常见词在不同句法位置零散出现，强度通常低于词内片段的峰值，未显示稳定的领域或语义条件。

en.description: Most segments mention molybdenum or molybdenum-containing substances across different fields; there is also an oral terbinafine antifungal study and an isolated word-internal b-fragment activation in “corbelled”.

patterns.name: Molybdenum / molybdenum compounds
patterns.context: The element name or molybdenum-containing materials appear in lists of metal layers, catalysts, silicides, enzyme cofactors, environmental pollutants, or essential metal ions; word-internal segmentation marks vary in position.
patterns.domain: Patent materials and chemistry, biomedicine, environmental science, and mineral/element descriptions

patterns.name: Terbinafine and oral antifungal drugs
patterns.context: The drug name ter(b)ina(fine) appears in an abstract discussing oral antifungal treatment and dosing regimens.
patterns.domain: Clinical pharmacy / tinea pedis study abstract

patterns.name: Sporadic occurrence of subword fragment b
patterns.context: The word-internal b fragment is marked, but the word has no apparent connection to molybdenum, drugs, or the other patterns.

3_915.concept: 钼相关词项识别
3_915.description: 多数段落在不同领域中提及钼或含钼物质；另有特比萘芬口服抗真菌研究，以及一处孤立的“corbelled”词内 b 片段激活。

patterns.name: 钼／钼化合物
patterns.context: 钼元素名称或含钼材料出现在金属层、催化剂、硅化物、酶辅因子、环境污染物或必需金属离子的列表中；词内分片标记位置有所不同。
patterns.domain: 专利材料与化学、生物医学、环境科学及矿物／元素介绍

patterns.name: 特比萘芬及口服抗真菌药
patterns.context: 药物名称 ter(b)ina(fine) 在讨论口服抗真菌治疗及给药方案的摘要中出现。
patterns.domain: 临床药学／足癣研究摘要

patterns.name: 分词片段 b 的零星出现
patterns.context: 词内的 b 片段被标记，但所在词与钼、药物等其他模式无明显联系。
patterns.domain: 教堂建筑描述／维基百科

en.description: The most stable pattern is to following pain/painful, covering tasks that are troublesome, difficult to handle, or painful. Other isolated activations occur on word-internal substrings in a drug name, an insect species name, the architectural term corbelled, and the physics term corbino, with no evidence of shared semantics.

patterns.name: pain to + verb
patterns.context: A noun pain is followed by a to-infinitive, expressing that doing something is difficult, annoying, or painful; following verbs vary, including figure out, manage, do, and get.
patterns.domain: Colloquial or informal expressions in forums, chats, and Q&A

patterns.name: Subword fragment in the drug name terbinafine
patterns.context: The drug name terbinafine is split into multiple subwords; activation concentrates on internal fragments such as b and ina. The context discusses oral antifungal drugs and their study.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in an entomological name
patterns.context: An insect’s Latin name appears in italics, with activation on an internal substring; the context lists the most-studied insect species.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment of corbelled
patterns.context: Activation falls on b in corbelled, describing the form of an architectural element that projects outward.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment of corbino
patterns.context: Activation falls on a word-internal fragment of the term corbino; it occurs in physics text following a figure caption.

patterns.name: Form variant painful to
patterns.context: The adjective painful is followed by to, expressing the speaker’s distress while watching a child fail; it resembles pain to + verb but differs in part of speech and syntactic structure.

3_915.concept: to 附近及特定词内子串
3_915.description: 最稳定的模式是 pain/painful 后出现 to：涵盖做事麻烦、难以处理或感到痛苦。另有若干孤立激活落在药名、昆虫学名、建筑词 corbelled 和物理术语 corbino 的词内子串，缺少共同语义证据。

patterns.name: pain to + 动词
patterns.trigger: «pain»« to»，以及「pain« to»10« figure»」「pain« to»9« manage»」「pain« to»9« do»」「pain« to»9« me»」「pain« to»9 get」
patterns.context: 名词 pain 后接 to 不定式，表达做某事困难、令人厌烦或痛苦；其中 figure out、manage、do、get 等后续动词不同。
patterns.domain: 论坛、聊天、问答等口语或非正式表达

patterns.name: 药名 terbinafine 的子词片段
patterns.context: 药名 terbinafine 被分成多个子词，激活集中在 b、ina 等内部片段；语境谈口服抗真菌药及其研究。

patterns.name: 昆虫学名内部片段
patterns.context: 昆虫拉丁学名以斜体呈现，激活落在词内子串；语境列举研究最多的昆虫物种。

patterns.name: corbelled 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 corbelled 词中的 b；描述建筑构件向外挑出的形态。
patterns.domain: 维基百科建筑史或建筑描述

patterns.name: corbino 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 corbino 这一术语的词内片段；出现在图示说明之后的物理学文本中。

patterns.name: painful to 的形态变体
patterns.context: 形容词 painful 后接 to，表达说话者看着孩子失败时感到痛苦；与 pain to + 动词形式相似，但词性和句法结构不同。
patterns.domain: 个人经历或育儿类非正式写作

en.description: Most segments activate when infinitive to is followed by a base-form verb, often in “a pain to …” expressions, but also in combinations with worry and do. There are also sporadic word-internal activations in the plant term obovate and the scientific name Tenebrio, possibly due only to letter overlap.

patterns.name: to followed by a base-form verb
patterns.context: Strong activation is concentrated on the infinitive marker to, followed by a base-form verb; some contexts contain “a pain to ...”, but not all examples do.
patterns.domain: Primarily HackerNews and StackExchange conversations and commentary

patterns.name: Word-internal letter sequence to
patterns.context: The word obovate in a description of plant morphology; activation falls on an internal letter fragment, possibly sharing only the letters to with the main pattern.

patterns.name: T in a classification label
patterns.context: The classification abbreviation T before the scientific name Tenebrio molitor and an internal fragment of the scientific name both activate; its relation to the to pattern is unclear.

3_915.concept: 不定式 to
3_915.description: 多数段在不定式 to 后接动词原形时激活，常见于“a pain to …”表达，但也包括 worry、do 等搭配。另有植物词 obovate 和学名 Tenebrio 的零散词内激活，可能只是字母重合。

patterns.name: to 后接动词原形
patterns.trigger: « to»9 « do»2、« to»9 « get things translated»、« to»9 « manage»、« to»9 « finish»、« to»10 « figure»
patterns.context: 显著激活集中在不定式标记 to，后面接动词原形；有的上下文出现“a pain to ...”，但并非所有例子都如此。
patterns.domain: 以 HackerNews 和 StackExchange 对话、评论为主

patterns.name: 词内 to 字母序列
patterns.context: 植物形态描述中的单词 obovate（倒卵形）；激活落在词内字母片段，可能与主模式中的 to 仅有字母重合。

patterns.name: 分类标签中的 T
patterns.context: 学名 Tenebrio molitor 前的分类缩写 T，以及学名内部片段均有激活；与 to 模式关系不明。

en.description: Most strong activations fall on the infinitive marker to, often followed by a verb; they also occur in expressions such as little to no and pain to. A few activations fall on sporadic subwords in technical terms, proper names, or common words, without a unified condition.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: The English infinitive marker to is followed by a verb or verb phrase; in some examples, to and the following word form a fixed expression.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including HackerNews, news, and discussion posts

patterns.name: to followed by an expression of degree or quantity
patterns.context: to occurs between little and no, forming an expression meaning very little or none; this differs from the infinitive use.

patterns.name: Fixed expression with pain
patterns.context: pain means trouble or difficulty and is followed by an infinitive describing what is troublesome.

patterns.name: Token subwords in technical corpora
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within technical nouns or units, without clear consistent semantic or syntactic conditions.

patterns.name: Subwords within proper names or terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal subwords of Latin names, surrounded by insect species names.

patterns.name: Word-final or word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on short character fragments in misspelled words or proper names, with no stable syntactic function evident.

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall only on short subwords in individual words, with no obvious shared context or semantics.

3_915.concept: 不定式 to 及邻近短语
3_915.description: 多数强激活落在不定式 to 上，常接动词，也包括 little to no、pain to 等表达；另有少数激活落在技术术语、专名或普通词的零散子词上，缺乏统一条件。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.trigger: «to»，尤见 «to»« figure»« out»、«to»« be»、«to»« no»、«to»« cure»、«to»« finish»、«to»« get»
patterns.context: 英文中的不定式 to 后接动词或动词短语；有些例子中 to 与后续词共同构成固定表达。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括 HackerNews、新闻、讨论帖

patterns.name: to 后接程度或数量表达
patterns.context: to 位于 little 与 no 之间，构成表示极少或没有的表达；与不定式用法不同。

patterns.name: pain 固定表达
patterns.context: pain 表示麻烦或费劲，后接不定式说明令人费劲的事情。

patterns.name: 技术语料中的 token 子词
patterns.context: 激活落在技术名词或单位内部的子词片段，缺乏明显一致的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 专名或术语内部子词
patterns.context: 激活落在拉丁学名的内部子词，周围是昆虫物种名称。

patterns.name: 词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在拼写不规范或专名中的短字符片段，未见稳定句法功能。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 激活仅落在各自词中的短子词，彼此没有明显共同上下文或语义。

en.description: Primarily responds to the combination of yet and to in “have yet to”, and also to to in the “too…to” construction; other activations include though, several word-internal subword fragments, and marked words in “This already in place / nothing to do with” contexts.

patterns.name: “have yet to” expressing something not yet done
patterns.context: The subject or context indicates that someone has not yet completed, found, or heard of something; “to” typically introduces the action that has not occurred.

patterns.name: “too … to” expressing a consequence of degree
patterns.context: “too” modifies a degree or state, while the following “to” introduces an action that is therefore difficult or impossible to accomplish.

patterns.name: Though in a contrast or addendum
patterns.context: Adds a contrast or qualification within or at the end of a sentence; in this example it immediately follows “tricky”.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within proper names, affixes, or words; the surrounding contexts do not show a consistent semantic function.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial demonstrative and “already in place”
patterns.context: Discusses something that already exists and need not be attributed to technology; “to” occurs in the “nothing to do with” construction.

3_915.concept: 英文中的 to 构式
3_915.description: 主要响应“have yet to”中yet与to的组合，也响应“too…to”结构里的to；另有though、若干词内子词片段，以及“This already in place / nothing to do with”语境中的标记。

patterns.name: “have yet to”表达尚未发生
patterns.trigger: «yet» + «to»，多见完整短语“have yet to”；后接“find / finish / hear”等动词
patterns.context: 主语或语境表达某人尚未完成、找到、听说某事；“to”通常引出未发生的动作

patterns.name: “too … to”表达程度导致的结果
patterns.trigger: «too» … «to»，包括“too much … to figure out”“too late to cure”
patterns.context: “too”修饰程度或状态，后续“to”引出因此难以或无法实现的动作

patterns.name: 转折或补充语境中的 though
patterns.context: 句末或句中转折补充前述判断；本例紧接“tricky”

patterns.name: 英文词内的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、词缀或词内部的分词片段，周围语境并未呈现一致的语义功能
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、维基百科音乐条目

patterns.name: 句首指示语与“already in place”
patterns.context: 论述某事已存在、无需归因于技术；“to”位于“nothing to do with”结构中

en.description: Activations primarily fall on the infinitive marker to, especially after have yet to. It may be followed by find, hear, finish, and other verbs, and also occurs in figure out, to be sure, and various expressions of purpose, operation, and result.

patterns.name: yet to construction
patterns.context: In negative, interrogative, or first-person contexts, expresses that something has not yet been done; the clearest form is “have yet to + verb”.

patterns.name: Infinitive to followed by a verb
patterns.context: to introduces an infinitive followed by an action or state verb; it is not limited to the “yet to” construction.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, encyclopedia text, political commentary, and Q&A

patterns.name: Difficulty explaining/figuring out complex things
patterns.context: Expresses difficulty figuring out or finding a complex configuration; activations concentrate on to, with figure out nearby.

patterns.name: Purpose infinitives and interface instructions
patterns.context: to introduces a specific operation or action, possibly embedded in advice, purpose, or task descriptions.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase to be sure
patterns.context: to be sure expresses a cautious judgment or reservation, followed by a conjecture about the situation.

patterns.name: to meaning inclusion in to incorporate
patterns.context: A quantity of too many makes it impossible to incorporate ads into a page; to introduces an action related to the result.

patterns.name: to indicating persuasion in to convince
patterns.context: to introduces the purpose or action of convincing someone, in a sentence with contentious political argumentation.

patterns.name: to hear and serious use
patterns.context: have yet to hear is followed by discussion of whether a product has been used seriously in production.

patterns.name: to find and alternatives or outcomes
patterns.context: have yet to find is followed by an alternative or suitable option that the speaker wants to find.

patterns.name: Infinitive to finish
patterns.context: have yet to finish is followed by a book, expressing that it has not yet been completed.

3_915.concept: 不定式 to
3_915.description: 激活主要落在不定式标记 to，尤其是 have yet to 后；其后可接 find、hear、finish 等，也出现在 figure out、to be sure 及多种目的、操作和结果表达中。

patterns.name: yet to 搭配
patterns.context: 否定、疑问或第一人称语境中，表示尚未做某事；最明显的是“have yet to + 动词”。

patterns.name: 不定式 to 后接动词
patterns.context: to 引出不定式，后接动作或状态动词；并非只限于“yet to”结构。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、百科文本、政治评论及问答

patterns.name: 解释/弄清复杂事物的困难
patterns.trigger: « to»10« figure»3« out»2；« to»10« the»1 magic combination
patterns.context: 表达难以弄清或找出复杂配置；激活集中在 to，且附近出现 figure out。

patterns.name: 目的性不定式及界面操作说明
patterns.trigger: « to»3« operate»；« to»2 go；« to»3« invite»
patterns.context: to 引出具体操作或行动，可能嵌在建议、目的或任务描述中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 操作说明、HackerNews 评论

patterns.name: 固定短语 to be sure
patterns.context: to be sure 表示谨慎判断、保留意见，后接对情况的推测。

patterns.name: 表示纳入的 to incorporate
patterns.context: too many 的数量造成无法将广告纳入页面，to 引出结果相关动作。

patterns.name: 表示说服的 to convince
patterns.context: to 引出说服某人的目的或动作，处于带有争议性政治论述的句子中。

patterns.name: to hear 与严重使用
patterns.context: have yet to hear 后接有关产品是否被认真用于生产环境的内容。

patterns.name: to find 与替代品或结果
patterns.context: have yet to find 后接想找到的替代品或合适对象。

patterns.name: 不定式 to finish
patterns.context: have yet to finish 后接书籍，表示尚未完成。

en.description: Primarily activates on the infinitive marker “to,” especially when preceded by nothing or yet; also appears in too…to, to be sure, and to See in a title. The following context is often a verb.

patterns.name: “nothing to” construction
patterns.context: “nothing” appears first, followed by the marked “to,” usually meaning there is nothing to do, test, or contact; it can also occur in expressions such as “nothing to fear.”
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, forum comments, and general discussion

patterns.name: “yet to” construction
patterns.context: “yet” precedes “to” followed by a verb, indicating something is not yet completed or found; common in accounts of personal experience and progress.

patterns.name: “too … to” construction
patterns.context: The degree word “too” introduces a following “to” infinitive, meaning too … to … .

patterns.name: Infinitive expressing purpose or inference
patterns.context: “to” follows “There’s not enough detail,” forming an expression of the conditions needed to make a judgment.

patterns.name: Infinitive in a title
patterns.context: “to” appears in the song title “Too Bright to See,” as part of an infinitive construction within the title.

3_915.concept: 不定式标记to
3_915.description: 主要对不定式标记“to”激活，尤其偏好前接nothing或yet，也见too…to、to be sure及标题中的to See；上下文多为后接动词。

patterns.name: “nothing to”结构
patterns.context: “nothing”先出现，后接被标记的“to”，通常表示没有某事可做、可测试或可联系，也可进入“nothing to fear”一类表达。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、论坛评论及一般论述

patterns.name: “yet to”结构
patterns.context: “yet”在前、“to”后接动词，表示尚未完成或尚未找到；常见于个人经验与进度陈述。

patterns.name: “too … to”结构
patterns.context: 程度词“too”引出后续“to”不定式，表示过于……以至于……。

patterns.name: 目的或推断中的不定式
patterns.context: “to”位于“There’s not enough detail”之后，构成判断所需条件的表达。

patterns.name: 标题中的不定式
patterns.context: “to”出现在歌曲标题“Too Bright to See”中，属于标题内部的不定式结构。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to the infinitive marker “to”, especially in structures such as “have yet to”; two other activations are on word-internal fragments, one from a bacterial term and one from a place name, with no shared context.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Introduces an infinitive before a verb or expression; often occurs in structures such as “have yet to…” and “can’t wait to…”, and also in uses expressing purpose or result.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, news, and general text

patterns.name: Bacteriological word ending
patterns.context: Occurs inside the word “Bacteriophages”, marking an affix fragment in terminology related to bacteriophages.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in a place name
patterns.context: Occurs inside the word “Coral” in the place name “Coral Gables”.
patterns.domain: Lawyers’ addresses or listings in legal documents

3_915.concept: 不定式 to（主模式）
3_915.description: 主要对不定式标记“to”强烈响应，尤其是“have yet to”等结构；另有两处词内片段响应，分别来自细菌学术语和地名，缺少共同语境。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 在动词或表达式前引出不定式；多出现在“have yet to…”，“can’t wait to…”等结构，也有表示目的或结果的用法。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、新闻及一般文本

patterns.name: 细菌学词尾
patterns.context: 位于“Bacteriophages”一词内部，标记细菌噬菌体相关术语的词缀片段。

patterns.name: 地名词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在地名“Coral Gables”中的“Coral”一词内部。
patterns.domain: 法律文件中的律师地址或名单

en.concept: English to marker and neighboring uses
en.description: Primarily sensitive to the infinitive marker to, especially in constructions such as too late to… and have yet to…; also includes the degree use of too, an isolated literal match in the code attribute target, and to within a term.

patterns.name: Structures beginning with to
patterns.context: Activation centers on to, commonly in infinitives expressing purpose, plans, attempts, ability, or results; segments 3, 4, and 10 notably contain “too late to …,” though the pattern is not limited to too late.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, Q&A, news, academic abstracts, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Degree expressions with too much / too late
patterns.context: too modifies degree or a time limit and is followed by an adjective or noun phrase; some segments then have a to infinitive, as in “too late to start,” “too late to cure,” and “too late to pursue.”

patterns.name: Yet to in the perfect tense
patterns.context: After the perfect auxiliary have, expresses something not yet completed or occurring as of now; activation falls on to, followed by a verb such as “finish,” “find,” or “hear.”

patterns.name: target attribute in a webpage tag
patterns.context: In HTML or code snippets, to may be the beginning of the attribute name target rather than an independent infinitive; this instance may simply share the literal token with other uses.

patterns.name: The string to within an academic term
patterns.context: Within a proper name or biological term in an academic abstract, to is not an infinitive marker.

3_915.concept: 英语 to 标记及邻近用法
3_915.description: 主要对不定式标记 to 敏感，尤其是 too late to…、have yet to…等结构；另有 too 的程度用法，以及代码属性 target 和术语内部 to 的孤立字面匹配。

patterns.name: to 后续起始结构
patterns.trigger: “to”后接动词原形或动词短语，如 “to figure out”“to finish”“to start”“to cure”“to find”“to hear”“to achieve”“to See”“to pursue”
patterns.context: 激活集中在 to，常见于表达目的、计划、尝试、能力或结果的 to 不定式；第 3、4、10 段尤其出现 “too late to …”，但该结构并不限于 too late。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、问答、新闻、学术摘要、百科条目

patterns.name: too much / too late 程度表达
patterns.context: too 修饰程度或时间界限，后接形容词或名词短语；部分段落随后接 to 不定式，如 “too late to start”“too late to cure”“too late to pursue”。

patterns.name: 完成时中的 yet to
patterns.context: 在完成时助动词 have 后，表达截至当前尚未完成或发生的事；激活落在 to，后接动词，如 “finish”“find”“hear”。

patterns.name: 网页标签中的 target 属性
patterns.context: HTML 或代码片段中，to 可能是属性名 target 的开头，而非独立不定式；该例与其他用法可能只是字面 token 重叠。

patterns.name: 学术术语内部的 to 字符串
patterns.context: 学术摘要中的专名或生物学术语内部，to 并非不定式标记。

en.concept: Infinitive marker to and following verb
en.description: Primarily responds to the infinitive construction yet to followed by a verb, and also activates on infinitive to and the following verb; other examples include the entomological word antennal, though, names, sporadic word-internal fragments, and punctuation, with some instances unexplained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: yet to + verb
patterns.context: In the “I have/have … yet to” construction, yet is followed by to and a verb, expressing that something has not yet been done; surrounding text often gives personal opinions or accounts of experience.

patterns.name: to + bare verb
patterns.context: Does not necessarily include yet; activation falls on infinitive marker to, followed by an action verb.
patterns.domain: Forums, encyclopedia-style narratives, and other texts

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in antenna-related terms
patterns.context: The fragment is embedded in antennal; used to describe contact or sensory organs, neural signals, and related brain regions.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in a name
patterns.context: Activation falls within a person’s or place’s name in legal text, with no clear semantic connection.

patterns.name: Contrastive/conjunctive though
patterns.context: Sentence-initial Still though is followed by a comma, linking to the preceding text and adding a contrasting comment.

patterns.name: Fragments within common nouns or names
patterns.context: Activation falls within an editor name, a word, or near a literature citation; there is no stable shared context.

patterns.name: Standalone punctuation and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs near sentence-final punctuation or formatting separators, without consistent semantic or syntactic conditions.

3_915.concept: 不定式标记 to 及后续动词
3_915.description: 主要响应 yet to 后接动词的不定式结构，也会落在不定式 to 和其后动词上；另见昆虫学词 antennal、though、姓名及零散词内片段和标点，部分例子无法由主模式解释。

patterns.name: yet to + 动词
patterns.context: 在“I have/have … yet to”结构中，yet 后接 to 和动词，表达尚未做某事；周围常有个人评价或经验陈述。

patterns.name: to + 动词原形
patterns.trigger: « to»9« find»、« to»9« figure»、« to»9« incorporate»、« to»9« hear»
patterns.context: 不一定含 yet；激活落在不定式标记 to，后面接动作动词。
patterns.domain: 论坛、百科等叙述性文本

patterns.name: 天线触角相关词的词内片段
patterns.context: 片段嵌在 antennal 中；用于描述接触或感受性器官、神经信号及相关脑区。

patterns.name: 姓名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于法律文本中人名或地名词内部，未见明确语义联系。

patterns.name: 转折／承接词 though
patterns.context: 句首 Still though 后接逗号，承接前文并转折补充评价。

patterns.name: 普通名词或名称内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在编辑器名称、单词内部或文献引用附近；没有稳定的共同语境。

patterns.name: 独立标点与格式片段
patterns.context: 句末标点或分隔格式附近出现激活，缺少一致的语义或句法条件。

en.concept: to introducing unrealized or constrained actions
en.description: Primarily responds to to introducing a following verb in “yet to” and “too…to” constructions. It also responds to the subword ni in funniest, co in Disco, the conjunction But, and a small number of punctuation-boundary activations.

patterns.name: Negative “yet to” construction
patterns.context: Occurs in “I have yet to …” or “I’ve yet to …”, followed by a verb and expressing something not yet completed, occurred, or found; the strongest marker is often “to”.
patterns.domain: HackerNews forums, personal comments, and other informal writing

patterns.name: “too … to” result construction
patterns.context: “too” indicates an excessive degree, followed by “to” introducing an action that is consequently impossible or difficult; activation concentrates on “to”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic text, news, and personal comments

patterns.name: Superlative fragment
patterns.context: In a few examples, the superlative “funniest” is split into subword fragments and “ni” activates; “co” in “Disco” is another isolated case, with no confirmed connection to the other patterns.
patterns.domain: Email subjects, diaries, and general narratives; “Disco” comes from an encyclopedia

patterns.name: Punctuation and line-break boundaries
patterns.context: These markers occasionally show weak activation near sentence endings, paragraph breaks, or forum text formatting; there is no stable independent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations not otherwise classified
patterns.context: A sentence-initial contrastive word in paragraph 6 activates strongly, but the paragraph also contains “too late to start”, so it is unclear whether the contrastive word forms an independent pattern.

3_915.concept: to 引导的未然或受限动作
3_915.description: 主要响应“yet to”与“too…to”结构中引出后续动词的 to；另对 funniest 的子词 ni 有响应，并见 Disco 中 co、转折词 But 及少量标点边界激活。

patterns.name: 否定式“yet to”结构
patterns.context: 出现在“I have yet to …”或“I’ve yet to …”中，后接动词，表达尚未完成、尚未发生或尚未找到；最强标记常落在“to”。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 论坛、个人评论及其他非正式文字

patterns.name: “too … to”结果结构
patterns.context: “too”引出程度过高，随后“to”引出因此无法或难以完成的动作；激活集中在“to”。

patterns.name: 趣味最高级词尾
patterns.context: 少数例子中最高级“funniest”被拆分为子词片段并激活“ni”；另有“Disco”中的“co”孤例，不能确认与其他模式有关。
patterns.domain: 邮件主题、日记与一般叙述；“Disco”出自百科

patterns.name: 标点与换行边界
patterns.context: 这些标记偶尔有弱激活，出现在句末、段落分隔或论坛文本格式附近；没有稳定的独立语义条件。

patterns.name: 无法归入的零散激活
patterns.context: 第6段句首转折词有较强激活，但该段同时含“too late to start”，无法判断转折词是否构成独立模式。

en.description: The most prominent recurring trigger is the English infinitive marker to; in patent text, there is also a response to though. Other activations are scattered across English function words, punctuation, and fragments within Spanish words, with no stable shared conditions.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Follows a verb or adjective to introduce an infinitive or purpose complement; some segments also contain nearby punctuation, conjunctions, or sentence-final structures.
patterns.domain: Various English genres, including encyclopedia entries, forums, patents, literature, and email

patterns.name: Concessive conjunction though
patterns.context: Used as a concessive conjunction within a sentence or at its beginning; segments 4 and 6 include commas nearby, and segment 6 occurs in the “Further though” construction in a technical description.

patterns.name: Stress/syllable fragments within Spanish words
patterns.context: Activation falls within segmented Spanish words rather than stable complete words or a unified affix; examples include accented characters and ordinary syllable fragments.

patterns.name: Various English function words and punctuation
patterns.context: These markers occur in different syntactic positions with no clear shared local trigger; some appear in the same segment as the primary to or though patterns.

3_915.concept: 英语功能词片段（以 to 为主）
3_915.description: 最突出的重复触发是英语不定式标记 to；另在专利文本中响应 though。其余激活分散于英语功能词、标点及西班牙语词内片段，缺乏稳定共同条件。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 出现在动词或形容词后引出不定式或目的补语；部分段中邻近其他标点、连接词或句末结构。
patterns.domain: 英语百科、论坛、专利、文学、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 让步连接词 though
patterns.context: 句中或句首作让步连接词；段 4 前后有逗号，段 6 位于技术说明中的 Further though 结构。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内重音/音节片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的西班牙语单词内部，而非稳定的完整词或统一词缀；包括重音字符和普通音节片段。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语网页答复、学术目录

patterns.name: 多种英语功能词与标点
patterns.trigger: « but»、« on»、« there»、« within»、« it»、« of»、« a»、« the»、« and»、« yet»、« until»、« because»、« if»、«.»、«↵» 等
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在不同句法位置，没有明显统一的局部触发条件；部分与主要的 to 或 though 同段出现。

en.concept: Local English word forms and infinitive constructions
en.description: Activations are distributed across several patterns, notably to infinitives, yet to, a fragment within funniest, and several one-off phrases or fragments within proper names; the examples span domains, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: to followed by a verb in an infinitive
patterns.context: to marks an infinitive, with the following verb expressing purpose, result, an attempt, or a need; this form appears in varied syntactic contexts.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including forums, encyclopedias, legal text, and Q&A

patterns.name: Fragment within the superlative funniest
patterns.context: An English superlative adjective occurring before nouns such as joke, things, and movies; this pattern spans narratives, email, and online text.

patterns.name: yet to meaning not yet completed
patterns.context: yet combines with an infinitive to indicate that something has not yet been completed; followed by finish or find.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in a machine-related phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in “machine can keep up with the additional load,” as part of keep up with.

patterns.name: Too many after a growing quantity
patterns.context: Describes the number of small advertisements increasing as an idea becomes popular, eventually becoming too numerous to fit on the page; “too many to” is followed by an infinitive.

patterns.name: Trump-related joke and audience response
patterns.context: In a political satire passage, a host tells a Trump joke and the audience responds with laughter and applause; also includes “funniest joke.”

patterns.name: Insufficient evidence in legal argument
patterns.context: The appellant questions whether the evidence is sufficient for conviction, particularly the reliability of witness identification; two to-infinitive constructions occur.

patterns.name: Tutorial and conditional expressions in Q&A
patterns.context: A technical Q&A explains an example and notes that multiple conditions are not needed to achieve the goal.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in a biochemical analyte name
patterns.context: Occurs in the laboratory instrument name “Olli CD,” listed alongside instruments such as Optimate; activation is within a proper-name fragment.

3_915.concept: 英语局部词形与不定式结构
3_915.description: 激活位置分散于多种模式：尤其包括 to 不定式、yet to、funniest 的词内片段，以及若干单例短语或专名片段；整体跨领域，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 不定式 to 后接动词
patterns.trigger: “to”后接动词，如 “to incorporate”、“to justify”、“to achieve”、“to find”、“to finish”、“to figure out”
patterns.context: to 表示不定式，后续动词表达目的、结果、尝试或需要；该形式在多种句法环境中出现。
patterns.domain: 论坛、百科、法律、问答等多种文体

patterns.name: 最高级 funniest 的词内片段
patterns.context: 英语最高级形容词，出现在 joke、things、movies 等名词前；该模式跨叙述、邮件和网络文本。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、邮件、个人叙述

patterns.name: yet to 表示尚未完成
patterns.context: yet 与不定式连用，表示迄今尚未完成某事；后接 finish 或 find。

patterns.name: 机器短语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 “machine can keep up with the additional load” 中，构成 keep up with。

patterns.name: 数量递增后的过多表达
patterns.trigger: “but as the idea caught on, there were too many to incorporate”
patterns.context: 描述小广告数量随想法流行而增加，最终多到无法纳入页面；“too many to”后接不定式。

patterns.name: 特朗普相关笑话与观众反应
patterns.trigger: “Trump hates women.”、“Trump is a Cheeto.”、“Trump is in love with his daughter.”
patterns.context: 政治讽刺段落中，主持人讲特朗普笑话，观众以笑声和掌声回应；同时含有 “funniest joke”。
patterns.domain: 网络评论或政治文化评论

patterns.name: 法律论证中的证据不足
patterns.trigger: “evidence is insufficient to support a conviction”及“too weak to justify”
patterns.context: 上诉人质疑证据足以定罪，尤其质疑证人辨认的可靠性；出现两个 to 不定式结构。

patterns.name: 问答中教程与条件表达
patterns.trigger: “Did you take a look at this tutorial?”、“Because, as this example illustrates”及“conditions to achieve this”
patterns.context: 技术问答解释示例，并指出不需要多个条件即可实现目标。

patterns.name: 生化分析物名称的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在实验室分析仪器名称 “Olli CD” 中，与 Optimate 等分析仪并列；激活位置是专名内部片段。

en.concept: Expressions of constrained or incomplete action
en.description: Primarily responds to “too … to” constructions indicating that the degree or quantity is too high to perform a subsequent action or that doing so is inadvisable, especially to; also includes of/a in “too much of a pain to,” a fragment within the superlative funniest, and to in “have yet to finish.”

patterns.name: too … to construction
patterns.context: “too + degree/quantity adjective or adverb + to + verb” indicates that the degree is too high to do something or makes it inadvisable; activation mainly falls on to, often preceded by too much/many, too large, or too weak.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: encyclopedias, forum Q&A, legal text, technical patents, etc.

patterns.name: of in “too much of a pain”
patterns.context: Embedded in “too much of a pain to …,” describing something as so troublesome that it is difficult to start; activation here is on of, not the core to.

patterns.name: Superlative funniest
patterns.context: A fragment within the word “funniest,” meaning “most amusing”; the two examples occur in a response to a joke and in an email evaluating an amusing anecdote.

patterns.name: Something not yet completed
patterns.context: “have yet to finish” means not completed so far; activation centers on to and the surrounding perfect construction.

3_915.concept: 受限或未完成的动作表达
3_915.description: 主要响应表示程度或数量过高、以致无法或不宜执行后续动作的“too … to”结构，尤其是 to；另有“too much of a pain to”中的 of/a、最高级 funniest 的词内片段，以及“have yet to finish”中的 to。

patterns.name: too … to 结构
patterns.context: “too + 程度/数量形容词或副词 + to + 动词”表示程度过高而无法或不宜做某事；激活主要落在 to，前文常有 too much/many、too large、too weak。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：百科、论坛问答、法律、技术专利等

patterns.name: “too much of a pain”中的 of
patterns.context: 嵌在 “too much of a pain to …”结构中，描述某事麻烦到难以着手；此处激活在 of，而非核心 to。

patterns.name: 最高级 funnest
patterns.context: 单词 “funniest” 的词内片段，表示“最有趣的”；两例分别处于笑话反应和邮件中的趣事评价。

patterns.name: 尚未完成某事
patterns.context: “have yet to finish”表示迄今尚未完成；触发集中在 to 及其前后的完成表达。

en.description: Activations fall mainly on to, especially in yet to, too…to, and to + bare verb constructions. A few anomalous triggers come from segmented strings or word endings. These patterns occur in every segment, but the structures are so common that a unified syntactic feature is difficult to establish.

patterns.name: yet to followed by a verb
patterns.context: The common structure “I have yet to + bare verb” makes to a strong trigger; the context expresses that something has not yet been completed, discovered, or heard about.
patterns.domain: Forums and technical discussions, colloquial English

patterns.name: to followed by a verb
patterns.context: The infinitive to is followed by a bare verb, especially in “too…to…” or constructions describing a need, or reaching a condition.
patterns.domain: Forums, Q&A, medical papers, and comments

patterns.name: it in a segmented word
patterns.context: Occurs in isolation inside a username or string, without a verifiable syntactic context.

patterns.name: Incomplete gun-related word ending
patterns.context: The fragment is truncated and tokenization is abnormal; it may belong to an expression such as gun-toting, but context alone cannot confirm a connection to the other patterns.

3_915.concept: 英文不定式标记 to
3_915.description: 激活主要落在 to 上，尤见 yet to、too…to 及 to+动词原形结构；少数异常触发来自拆分字符串或词尾。覆盖所有段，但这些结构过于常见，难以确认统一句法特征。

patterns.name: yet to 后接动词
patterns.context: 常见结构“I have yet to + 动词原形”，其中 to 是强触发点；上下文表达尚未完成、发现或听说某事。
patterns.domain: 论坛与技术讨论，口语化英文

patterns.name: to 后接动词
patterns.context: 不定式 to 后接动词原形，尤其在“too…to…”或需要说明、达到某条件的结构中。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、医学论文及评论

patterns.name: 被拆分词中的 it
patterns.context: 孤立出现于用户名或字符串内部，缺乏可确认的句法语境。
patterns.domain: 论坛用户名或文本噪声

patterns.name: 不完整的枪支相关词尾
patterns.context: 片段截断且 token 切分异常；可能属于 gun-toting 一类表达，但无法仅凭上下文确认其与其他模式相关。

en.description: Primarily activates on infinitive to, especially in too…to and have yet to constructions; also includes scattered function words, punctuation, and word fragments with no consistent explanation.

patterns.name: “too … to” construction
patterns.context: The trigger centers on infinitive marker to, commonly in too + adjective/adverb + to + verb; also includes other to infinitives, such as yet to do.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: forums, encyclopedias, legal text, astrophysics, Q&A

patterns.name: Delay or non-occurrence with yet to
patterns.context: Perfect-tense have yet to + verb expresses something not yet completed, heard, or found as of now; activation centers on yet/to.

patterns.name: Other isolated function-word or affix activations
patterns.context: These positions have no clear shared local syntactic or semantic conditions; they may reflect context or subword-fragment boundaries and are difficult to generalize from the samples alone.

3_915.concept: 不定式 to 及相关构式
3_915.description: 主要对不定式 to 激活，尤其是 too…to 和 have yet to 结构；另有若干零散功能词、标点和词片激活，缺少一致解释。

patterns.name: “too … to”结构
patterns.trigger: « to»10« figure»1« out»4（1）；« to»10 incorporate（3）；« to»9 summarise（4）；« to»9« support»3（7）；« to»9« say»1（8）；« it»2 becomes too weak« to»9 identify（9）；« yet»2« to»9« be»4（10）
patterns.context: 触发点集中在不定式标记 to，常见于 too + 形容词/副词 + to + 动词；也包括其他带 to 的不定式，如 yet to do。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：论坛、百科、法律、天体物理、问答

patterns.name: yet to 的延迟或未发生
patterns.trigger: «I»1« have»1« yet»5« to»10« finish»6（2）；«I»1« have»1« yet»5« to»9 hear（5）；«I»1« have»1« yet»6« to»9« find»1（6）
patterns.context: 完成时 have yet to + 动词，表达截至目前尚未完成、听说或找到某事；激活集中在 yet/to。

patterns.name: 其他孤立的功能词或词缀激活
patterns.context: 这些位置没有明显共享的局部句法或语义条件；可能受上下文或词片边界影响，单凭样本难以归纳。

en.concept: Infinitive to mixed with word fragments
en.description: Strong triggers are distributed across too much/many…to infinitives, the ni subword in funniest, and a few other to-infinitive positions; there is also a sporadic But it. The shared mechanism is unclear, and some cases may be fragment or annotation coincidences.

patterns.name: too much to + verb
patterns.context: Expresses that a quantity or complexity is too great to complete something; modifiers or other material may intervene.

patterns.name: too many to + verb
patterns.context: Expresses that the number is too large to include or assess; a clause or other material may intervene.

patterns.name: to in a too + to infinitive construction
patterns.context: A to infinitive occurs, but strong activation appears concentrated on to, especially in contexts expressing something not yet completed or awaiting creation; segments 1, 3

patterns.name: Fragment within funniest
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the subword fragment ni in funniest, followed by est; the context concerns jokes or amusing movies.

patterns.name: to in the make a mistake construction
patterns.context: Warns someone that they may make a mistake; to is followed by make a mistake.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial But and negative-interrogative construction
patterns.context: A programming Q&A begins with But it and then discusses a return value; the trigger here is weak.

3_915.concept: 不定式 to 与词片段混合
3_915.description: 强触发分散于 too much/many…to 不定式、funniest 的 ni 子词及少数其他 to 不定式位置；另有零星 But it。共同机制不明确，部分可能是片段或标注偶合。

patterns.name: too much to + 动词
patterns.trigger: «too»« much»…« to»« summarise» / «too»« much»…« to»« figure»…« out»
patterns.context: 表达数量或复杂度过大，以致难以完成某事；中间可有修饰语或其他成分。

patterns.name: too many to + 动词
patterns.trigger: «too»« many»…« to»« incorporate» / «too»« many»…« to»« say»
patterns.context: 表达数量过多，以致无法纳入或判断；可隔着从句或其他成分。

patterns.name: too + to 不定式结构中的 to
patterns.trigger: « too»« to»« finish»、« too»« to»« be»；以及 «to»« be»« created»
patterns.context: 出现 to 不定式，但强触发位置似乎集中在 to，尤其是表达尚未完成、待创建等语境；段 1、3

patterns.name: funniest 的词内片段
patterns.context: 触发点落在 funniest 的子词片段 ni，后接 est；上下文谈笑话或电影有趣。

patterns.name: make a mistake 结构中的 to
patterns.context: 告诫他人可能犯错；to 后接 make a mistake。

patterns.name: 词首 But 与否定疑问结构
patterns.context: 编程问答中以 But it 开头，随后讨论返回值；此处触发较弱。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the infinitive marker to and the verb that follows it, especially in too + degree, quantity, or time judgment + to, expressing difficulty, inability, or inability so far to do something; also responds to general infinitives expressing purpose, advice, or expectation. There are also scattered activations on But, however, yet, and newline characters.

patterns.name: to + infinitive, especially a boundary of ability or possibility
patterns.context: Common in constructions expressing difficulty, too much/too early to do something, or a need or intention to do something, especially too ... to ...; not every instance includes too
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, forum Q&A, legal argument, and news

patterns.name: too ... to ... construction
patterns.context: too modifies a degree, quantity, or time judgment, followed by to introducing an action that cannot, is difficult to, or cannot yet be completed; segment 2 also has “too much of a pain to”
patterns.domain: Technical discussion, encyclopedia explanations, Q&A, legal text, and news commentary

patterns.name: Infinitive expressing purpose or subsequent action
patterns.context: to introduces advice, expectation, purpose, or an intended action, and does not necessarily express too ... to ... or a boundary of ability
patterns.domain: Forum comments, entertainment news, or promotional copy

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or inter-sentence contrastive But
patterns.context: But introduces a contrast; segment 5 also has however and but, but does not show a to + infinitive trigger

patterns.name: Weak function-word activations that do not fit the infinitive pattern
patterns.context: These occur sporadically, without the same local syntactic or semantic conditions as the other fragments; to finish in segment 1 still fits the infinitive pattern, but yet and the newline cannot be explained by it

3_915.concept: 不定式 to，尤以 too...to... 为主
3_915.description: 主要对不定式标记 to 及其后动词敏感，尤其是 too + 程度、数量或时间判断 + to，表达难以、不能或尚不能做某事；也响应目的、建议、预期等一般不定式。另有零散 But、however、yet 和换行符激活。

patterns.name: to + 不定式，尤指能力或可能性边界
patterns.trigger: “to”后接动词原形，如 “to figure out”“to summarise”“to incorporate”“to support”“to justify”“to tell”“to be”；多处最强标记落在 “to” 上
patterns.context: 常见于表达难以、太多／太早而不能、需要或打算做某事的结构，尤其是 too ... to ...；但并非每例都含 too
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、论坛问答、法律论述和新闻

patterns.name: too ... to ... 结构
patterns.trigger: “too much of a pain to figure out”“too many to incorporate”“too much information to summarise”“too weak to justify”“too early to tell”
patterns.context: too 修饰程度、数量或时间判断，随后以 to 引出无法、难以或尚不能完成的动作；第2段还出现 “too much of a pain to”
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、百科说明、问答、法律文本及新闻评论

patterns.name: 不定式表示目的或后续行动
patterns.trigger: “recommend trying them”“to finish that book”“bringing Jane’s first novel to life”“Prepare to”
patterns.context: to 引出建议、预期、目的或将要进行的动作，并不一定表达 too ... to ... 或能力边界
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、娱乐新闻或宣传文案

patterns.name: 句首或句间转折词 But
patterns.trigger: “But it doesn’t ...”“But, however this may be”
patterns.context: 以 But 引出转折；第5段另有 however 与 but，但该段未显示 to + 不定式触发

patterns.name: 文中难以归入不定式模式的弱功能词激活
patterns.trigger: 第1段的 “yet”“to” 及换行符，和第5段的 “however”“this”“may”“fact”“is”
patterns.context: 零散出现，缺少与其他片段相同的局部句法或语义条件；第1段的 to finish 仍符合不定式模式，但 yet 与换行符无法由此解释

en.description: Primarily responds to the infinitive marker to: one class occurs in result constructions of the form too + degree description + to, and another occurs in yet to + verb constructions expressing that something has not yet happened or been completed.

patterns.name: too + adjective + to
patterns.context: The preceding text describes an excessively high or low degree, followed by to introducing an action that is consequently difficult or impossible to complete; activation is primarily on the infinitive marker “to”.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including forums, legal texts, patents, encyclopedias, and academic papers

patterns.name: yet to + verb
patterns.context: yet indicates that something has not yet occurred or been completed, followed by to and a verb; activation concentrates on “to”.

3_915.concept: 不定式标记 to
3_915.description: 主要响应不定式标记 to：一类出现在 too + 程度描述 + to 的结果结构中，另一类出现在 yet to + 动词、表示尚未发生或完成的结构中。

patterns.name: too + 形容词 + to
patterns.trigger: “too much of a pain to figure out”[2]、“too weak to justify”[3]、“too large to secure”[4]、“too much information to summarise”[5]、“too weak to identify”[6]、“too many to incorporate”[7]、“too low to be generally detected”[9]
patterns.context: 前文描述程度过高或过低，随后用 to 引出因此难以或无法完成的动作；主要激活在不定式标记“to”。
patterns.domain: 论坛、法律、专利、百科及学术论文等多种文体

patterns.name: yet to + 动词
patterns.trigger: “yet to finish”[1]、“yet to hear”[8]、“yet to be created”[10]
patterns.context: yet 表示某事截至当前尚未发生或完成，紧接 to 加动词；激活集中在“to”。

en.description: Strong activations often fall on to-introduced infinitives, especially yet to indicating that something has not yet occurred; there are also how to and figure out constructions about how to handle or understand something, as well as sentence-final though and concessive however. The triggers and syntactic positions are similar, but not all patterns can be attributed to the same function.

patterns.name: to + bare verb construction
patterns.context: Activation primarily falls on infinitive marker to and often extends to the following verb; it may be preceded by modal, evaluative, or purpose expressions and is not limited to a particular verb.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including forums, Q&A, academic papers, and email

patterns.name: yet to indicating non-occurrence
patterns.context: yet combines with to to express something not yet completed, occurred, or found; a newline may intervene.

patterns.name: how in an indirect question/object clause
patterns.context: Occurs when describing not knowing how to handle or understand something; some examples contain how to, while another has an object following figure out.

patterns.name: however as a contrastive connector
patterns.context: however introduces a concession or contrast within the sentence, followed by a statement of fact.

patterns.name: Sentence-final supplementary where though
patterns.context: where is followed by though as a sentence-final supplementary expression, indicating that the speaker is unsure about the specifics.

3_915.concept: 不定式及相关衔接词
3_915.description: 强激活多落在 to 引出的不定式，尤其是 yet to 表示尚未发生；另见 how to、figure out 等“如何处理/弄清”结构，以及句末 though 和让步转折 however。触发词与句法位置相似，但并非所有模式都能归为同一功能。

patterns.name: to + 动词原形结构
patterns.trigger: « to»9 achieve this；« to»9 achieve good classification performance；« to»9« be»4 added；« to»10 figure« out»3；« to»10« be»4 created；« to»9 hear；«to»9« find
patterns.context: 主要激活在不定式标记 to 后，常延伸至后续动词；前面可有情态、评价或目的表达，不限于某个具体动词。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、学术论文及邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: yet to 表示尚未发生
patterns.trigger: « yet»5« to»10« finish»5；« yet»2« to»10« be»4 created；« yet»4« to»9 hear；« yet»4↵«to»9« find
patterns.context: yet 与 to 连用，表达尚未完成、发生或找到；可隔着换行。

patterns.name: 间接疑问/宾语从句中的 how
patterns.trigger: « how»2« to» treat；« out»3« the»1 magic combination
patterns.context: 在说明不知道如何处理或弄清某事的语境中；部分例子含 how to，另一例为 figure out 后接宾语。

patterns.name: however 转折衔接
patterns.context: 句中 however 引出让步或转折，从句后继续陈述事实。
patterns.domain: 文学叙述（维多利亚时代散文）

patterns.name: where though 句末补充
patterns.context: where 后接 though，作为句末补充语气，表示说话者不确定具体情况。

en.description: Primarily activates on the infinitive marker to and nearby verbs, covering purpose, ability, result, incompletion, and legal argumentation. It also occurs in common collocations such as little to no and yet to, across forum, technical, academic, and legal texts.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Introduces an infinitive after a verb or adjective, or expresses purpose, result, or requirement; activation sometimes falls on to and sometimes on the verb immediately following it.
patterns.domain: Forum, legal, academic, and technical texts

patterns.name: Negative quantity phrase to no
patterns.context: Combines with little to express “almost none”; activation may fall on to or no.

patterns.name: yet to construction
patterns.context: In perfect-tense or similar constructions, expresses that something has not yet been done; the activation peak falls on to.

patterns.name: Passive/incomplete construction yet to be
patterns.context: Describes an instance that has not yet been created in a noun phrase; to be introduces a passive infinitive.

patterns.name: to in reporting, adding, and resetting relations
patterns.context: In technical descriptions, to indicates an object being added; a subsequent to indicates purpose.

patterns.name: Legal argumentative use of to justify
patterns.context: An adjective in a too + adjective + to infinitive construction indicates that the evidence is insufficient to justify jury acceptance.

patterns.name: Purpose or result in to achieve
patterns.context: The infinitive expresses a condition that is needed or an action to take in order to reach a goal.

patterns.name: to in other phrase combinations
patterns.context: to occurs in different fixed or semi-fixed combinations, expressing a relation, an action goal, or support for a conclusion; the commonality remains that to introduces an infinitive or complement structure.

3_915.concept: 英语不定式标记 to
3_915.description: 主要对不定式标记 to 及其邻近动词激活，涵盖目的、能力、结果、未完成与法律论证；另见 little to no、yet to 等常见搭配，跨论坛、技术、学术和法律文本。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 在动词或形容词后引出不定式，或表示目的、结果、要求；有时激活落在 to，有时落在紧随其后的动词。
patterns.domain: 论坛、法律、学术及技术文本

patterns.name: 否定数量短语 to no
patterns.context: 与 little 连用，表达“几乎没有”；激活可落在 to 或 no。

patterns.name: yet to 结构
patterns.context: 完成时或类似结构中表示“尚未做某事”；激活峰值落在 to。

patterns.name: yet to be 的被动/未完成结构
patterns.context: 名词短语中描述尚未创建的实例，to be 引出被动不定式。

patterns.name: 报告、添加及重置关系中的 to
patterns.context: 技术描述中，to 表示添加对象，随后另一个 to 表示目的。

patterns.name: to justify 的法律论证用法
patterns.context: too + 形容词 + to 不定式，说明证据不足以支持陪审团采信。

patterns.name: to achieve 的目的或结果
patterns.trigger: “require additional features «to» «achieve» good classification performance”及“conditions «to» «achieve» this”
patterns.context: 不定式表示需要某条件或采取某做法以达到目标。

patterns.name: to 与其他短语搭配
patterns.trigger: “«to» do with technology”“«to» figure out”“«to» support a conviction”
patterns.context: to 位于不同固定或半固定搭配中，分别表示关联、行动目标或支持某结论；共同点仍是 to 引出的不定式/补足结构。

en.description: Activation spans multiple domains, often occurring around structured layout, field boundaries, numbers, or split proper names/technical strings; “verify” recurs across several technical styles. The remaining vocabulary and domain cues do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Special tokenization and formatting markers with spaces
patterns.context: Special symbols, spaces, and formatting boundaries in alignment, indentation, line breaks, or mathematical typesetting; several activations occur near these structures, but no single punctuation mark consistently triggers every passage.

patterns.name: Dates, numbers, and table fields
patterns.context: Dates, times, years, identifiers, or table values appear in structured records; sometimes adjacent to whitespace, slashes, or field boundaries.
patterns.domain: Email, financial headers, and structured records

patterns.name: Email headers and field labels
patterns.context: Email headers contain separators and fields such as recipient, CC, and subject.

patterns.name: Letter segmentation in proper names
patterns.context: Proper names or place names are split into multiple subword fragments; Baghdad also reaches a very strong activation in this passage.

patterns.name: Terminology or technical strings
patterns.context: Uppercase abbreviations or coded/technical markers in patents are split into subword fragments; the trigger is not limited to one domain.
patterns.domain: Email memos and patent technical text

patterns.name: Verification language in research writing
patterns.context: Academic or technical narratives describe verifying or checking results; the same word strongly activates in both NIH abstracts and mathematics papers.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patents, and mathematics papers

patterns.name: Special letter within Swedish words
patterns.context: A special letter occurs inside Swedish words; activation concentrates on the subword fragment “öppnats”.

patterns.name: Institution names and title layout in legal documents
patterns.context: Court dockets or legal document headers display uppercase institution names with line breaks and indentation; some words are split.

patterns.name: Uppercase words in administrative or business headings
patterns.context: Heading-style uppercase words describe quarterly, annual, or financial performance, followed by portfolios and numbers.

patterns.name: Unexplained content and domain triggers
patterns.context: The available samples show no stable shared condition, so these fragments cannot be assigned to a more specific trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Email, medicine, parliament, mathematical physics, and law

3_1236.concept: 结构化文本与分词边界
3_1236.description: 激活横跨多领域，常落在结构化排版、字段边界、数字或被切分的专名/技术字符串；“verify”在多种技术文体重复出现。其余词汇与领域线索不构成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 带空格的特殊分词与格式标记
patterns.context: 对齐、缩进、换行或公式排版中的特殊符号、空格和格式边界；多处激活落在这些结构附近，但并非每段都有一致的单一标点触发。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本格式与排版

patterns.name: 日期、数字与表格字段
patterns.context: 日期、时间、年份、编号或表格数值出现在结构化记录中；有时与空白、斜杠或字段边界相邻。
patterns.domain: 邮件、财务标题与结构化记录

patterns.name: 邮件标题与字段标签
patterns.context: 邮件头部中出现分隔线及收件人、抄送、主题等字段。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母分段
patterns.context: 专名或地名被切成多个子词片段；该段中 Baghdad 也达到很强激活。

patterns.name: 术语或技术字符串
patterns.context: 大写缩写或专利中的编码/技术标记被拆成子词片段；触发不局限于一种领域。
patterns.domain: 邮件备忘录与专利技术文本

patterns.name: 科研文体中的验证表述
patterns.context: 学术或技术叙述中出现验证、核实结果的表述；同词在 NIH 摘要和数学论文中均有强激活。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利与数学论文

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内的特殊字母
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子中，特殊字母出现在词内；激活集中于“öppnats”一词片段。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的机构名称与标题布局
patterns.context: 法院案卷或法律文书标题，以大写机构名称和分行、缩进的版式呈现；部分词被拆分。

patterns.name: 行政或业务标题中的大写词
patterns.context: 标题式大写词描述季度、年度或业绩，后接投资组合和数值。

patterns.name: 解释不了的内容与领域触发
patterns.context: 在现有样本中找不到稳定的共同条件，不能仅凭这些片段归入更具体的触发模式。
patterns.domain: 邮件、医学、议会、物理数学与法律

en.description: Mixed activation pattern: recurring in verify (medical, patent, and paper contexts), line breaks, indentation, and dates/numbers in structured text; also seen in proper-name/abbreviation segmentation, mathematical typesetting, Swedish economic text, and performance headings. Not explainable by a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Sentence-final or formatted whitespace
patterns.context: In email schedules, emails with fields, or legal documents, a newline is followed by a tab/whitespace; activation often falls on whitespace or newline tokens.
patterns.domain: Email, legal documents, and structured text

patterns.name: Letter fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Proper names or abbreviations are split into multiple subword tokens, with activation distributed across internal fragments; text includes place names, email subject abbreviations, or institutional abbreviations.

patterns.name: verify and validation expressions
patterns.context: Appears in technical statements describing the validation of an action, procedure, or mathematical property; the word is strongly activated.

patterns.name: Transliterated Arabic place names
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry describes events in Baghdad, with activation on transliterated proper names and place names.

patterns.name: Date, time, and numeric fields
patterns.context: Numbers, dates, or times are embedded in email schedules, email headers, performance headings, or legal document fields.

patterns.name: Swedish European Parliament economic discussion
patterns.context: Swedish sentences discuss EU production, market liberalization, and imports; activation concentrates on within-word fragments and nearby semantic words.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and typesetting code
patterns.context: In LaTeX mathematical expressions, array typesetting, or paper arguments, activation occurs near mathematical commands and validation expressions.

patterns.name: Battery programming terminology and verify
patterns.context: Patent text describes multilevel-cell programming and the program-and-verify technical process.

patterns.name: Investment performance and portfolios
patterns.context: A business report-style heading summarizes quarterly/annual performance, followed by portfolio return figures.

patterns.name: Legal institution names and dense abbreviations
patterns.context: Institution or department names in legal case files are split into multiple subword tokens, alongside indentation and field formatting.

patterns.name: Medication adherence in abstracts
patterns.context: A research abstract discusses electronic monitoring technology and its inability to confirm whether patients actually took medication.

patterns.name: Unclear activation on disciplinary content words
patterns.context: Beyond identifiable formatting, proper-name, or verify phenomena, several highlights fall on field-specific words or symbols and are difficult to group under a shared semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Email, Swedish parliamentary texts, mathematical papers

3_1236.description: 激活模式混杂：反复出现在 verify（医学、专利、论文）、结构化文本的换行缩进与日期数字；另见专名/缩写切分、数学排版、瑞典语经济文本及业绩标题。无法由单一语义特征解释。

patterns.name: 句末或格式化空白
patterns.context: 在邮件日程、带字段的邮件头或法律文件中，换行后接制表符/空白；激活常落在空白或换行 token 上。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文书及结构化文本

patterns.name: 专名内部字母片段
patterns.context: 专名或缩写被分成多个子词 token，激活分布在内部片段；文本含地名、邮件主题缩写或机构缩写。

patterns.name: verify 及验证表述
patterns.context: 出现在技术性陈述中，描述验证某种行为、程序或数学性质；该词激活很强。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利、学术论文

patterns.name: 阿拉伯语地名转写
patterns.context: 百科条目介绍巴格达事件，专名转写及地点名处有激活。

patterns.name: 日期、时间及数字化字段
patterns.context: 数字、日期或时间嵌在邮件日程、邮件头、业绩标题或法律文件字段中。
patterns.domain: 邮件、商业报告、法律文书

patterns.name: 欧洲议会瑞典语经济论述

patterns.name: 数学符号与排版代码
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式、数组排版或论文论证中，数学命令和验证表述附近激活。

patterns.name: 电池编程术语与 verify
patterns.context: 专利文本描述多级单元编程及 program-and-verify 技术流程。

patterns.name: 投资业绩与组合
patterns.context: 标题式商业报告中概述季度/年度业绩，随后给出组合收益数字。

patterns.name: 法律机构名称与密集缩写
patterns.context: 法律案卷中的机构或部门名称被切成多个子词 token，且伴随缩进和字段格式。

patterns.name: 摘要中的药物依从性表述
patterns.context: 研究摘要讨论电子监测技术及其无法确认患者实际服药的问题。

patterns.name: 未明确的学科内容词激活
patterns.context: 除可辨认的格式、专名或 verify 现象外，若干高亮落在特定领域词或符号上，难以归入共同语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、瑞典语议会文本、数学论文

en.concept: Heterogeneous text markers and formatting strings
en.description: Activation is distributed across date slashes, historical place names, email abbreviations, Swedish letters, legal letterheads, software disclaimers and source-code comments, and patent technical strings; “verify” and asterisk comment lines recur across passages.

patterns.name: Slashes in date/number fields
patterns.context: Slashes in dates, identifiers, or similar fields; the date format in [1] is incomplete, while other passages use slashes differently.

patterns.name: Baghdad and Al-Wathbah
patterns.context: Historical entry about the 1948 Al-Wathbah uprising in Baghdad.

patterns.name: Abbreviations in email subjects
patterns.context: Uppercase abbreviations appear in the Subject field of an email header.

patterns.name: Validation/verification terms
patterns.context: Discusses electronic monitoring that cannot verify whether medication was actually taken; the same word also appears in a patent technical description.

patterns.name: Swedish diacritic letters
patterns.context: Diacritic letters appear in continuous Swedish text about EU production and markets.

patterns.name: Institution names and capitalization in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal document letterheads or party names use all-uppercase institutional titles.

patterns.name: License disclaimer and comment boundaries
patterns.context: A software license disclaimer is followed by a C/C++ preprocessor directive; a long asterisk divider also appears in passage [10].

patterns.name: Baghdad and the Gulf War
patterns.context: Describes the Basra museum in southern Iraq and the transfer of artifacts during the Gulf War.

patterns.name: Technical variables and verify in patents
patterns.context: Patent background explains multilevel-cell programming technology, interspersed with encoded quotation marks and variable strings.

patterns.name: Source file headers and author information
patterns.context: Author, URL, and Java package declaration appear in an asterisk comment block.

3_1236.concept: 异质文本标记与格式串
3_1236.description: 激活分散于日期斜线、历史地名、邮件缩写、瑞典语字母、法律版头、软件免责声明与源码注释、专利技术串等格式和词语；「verify」及星号注释线有跨段复现。

patterns.name: 日期/编号字段中的斜线
patterns.context: 日期、编号或类似字段中的斜线；[1] 的日期格式不完整，其他段则是不同的斜线用途。

patterns.name: 巴格达与 Al-Wathbah
patterns.context: 关于 1948 年巴格达 Al-Wathbah 起义的历史条目。

patterns.name: 邮件标题中的缩写
patterns.context: 邮件头部的 Subject 字段中出现大写缩写。

patterns.name: 验证/核实词
patterns.context: 谈及电子监测无法核实药物是否实际服用；同一词也出现在专利技术描述中。

patterns.name: 瑞典语变音字母
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中出现变音字母，语境涉及欧盟生产与市场。

patterns.name: 法律文书的机构名称与大写格式
patterns.context: 法律文件版头或当事方名称，以全大写机构称谓排版。

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明与注释边界
patterns.context: 软件许可证免责声明之后紧接 C/C++ 预处理指令；长星号分隔线也出现于段 [10]。

patterns.name: 巴格达与海湾战争
patterns.context: 描述伊拉克南部巴士拉博物馆及海湾战争期间文物转移。

patterns.name: 专利中的技术变量与 verify
patterns.context: 专利背景中说明多层单元编程技术，夹有编码后的引号和变量串。

patterns.name: 源码文件头与作者信息
patterns.context: 星号注释块中的作者、网址及 Java package 声明。

en.description: The response pattern is scattered: dates and layout in email, historical proper names, legal institutional formatting, biomedical terminology and abstract phrasing, code disclaimer separators, Swedish economic word forms, and financial headings and portfolios; no single trigger feature explains all samples.

patterns.name: Date fields and whitespace separators in tables or email
patterns.context: Line breaks, tabs, and alignment whitespace occur around dates, times, or schedule content; not all dates trigger with equal strength

patterns.name: Proper names and historical event narratives
patterns.context: Encyclopedic paragraphs introduce event names, etymologies, places, and dates, with proper names appearing in continuous narrative

patterns.name: Institutional and case layout in legal documents
patterns.context: Headings, parties, dates, and institution names are arranged in uppercase or fixed indentation

patterns.name: Biomedical receptor terminology
patterns.context: Scientific abstracts mention biological entities and their abbreviations, followed by functional or definitional statements

patterns.name: Verification or confirmation wording in research abstracts
patterns.context: An abstract describes technical capabilities and their limitations, emphasizing the inability to verify actual medication or intake

patterns.name: Software license disclaimers and code boundaries
patterns.context: A copyright or liability disclaimer ends with an asterisk separator line, immediately followed by a preprocessing directive or package declaration
patterns.domain: Source code and software license text

patterns.name: In-word character fragments in Swedish economic policy language
patterns.context: Swedish parliamentary text discusses imports, production, or market opening; activation falls on words containing diacritics

patterns.name: Financial report headings and portfolios
patterns.context: A quarterly or annual performance heading is followed by a description of model portfolio returns

3_1236.description: 响应模式分散：邮件中的日期与排版、历史专名、法律机构格式、生物医学术语及摘要措辞、代码免责声明分隔线、瑞典语经济词形、财务标题与投资组合；没有一个触发特征能解释全部样本。

patterns.name: 表格或邮件中的日期字段与空白分隔
patterns.context: 日期、时间或日程内容周围出现换行、制表符和对齐空白；并非所有日期都触发同等强度
patterns.domain: 邮件、日程或结构化记录

patterns.name: 专名与历史事件叙述
patterns.context: 百科式段落介绍事件名称、词源、地点和时间，专名在连续叙述中出现

patterns.name: 法律文书的机构与案件版式
patterns.trigger: 「SECRETARY OF HEALTH AND」「Special Processing Unit」「Filed: March 10, 2020」
patterns.context: 标题、当事方、日期和机构名称以大写或固定缩进排布

patterns.name: 生物医学受体术语
patterns.context: 科学摘要中出现生物学实体及其缩写，后接功能或定义性陈述

patterns.name: 研究摘要中的验证或确认措辞
patterns.context: 摘要描述技术能力及其局限，强调无法核实实际服药或摄入

patterns.name: 软件许可免责声明与代码边界
patterns.context: 版权或责任免责声明以星号分隔线结束，随后紧接预处理指令或包声明
patterns.domain: 源代码及软件许可文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语经济政策表述中的词内字符片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本讨论进口、生产或市场开放；激活落在带变音符号的词内

patterns.name: 财务报告标题与投资组合
patterns.context: 季度或年度业绩标题后描述模型投资组合收益

en.description: Activation is distributed across proper names and within-word fragments, headings and formatting boundaries, domain terminology, and specific words such as verify and Neither; local triggers differ across passages, with no consistent single semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in headings or proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-initial or stem fragments split within proper names; examples include headings, place names, and personal names, with some instances next to a newline or heading-style formatting.

patterns.name: Address and date formats
patterns.context: A list of dates following vacation plans in an email, with local structure formed by line breaks, tabs, and numeric/slash formats.

patterns.name: Scavenger receptors terminology
patterns.context: Within-word segmentation of the technical term “Scavenger receptors”; surrounding text scientifically describes cell-surface proteins.

patterns.name: Validation wording in abstracts
patterns.context: An abstract says that a technology cannot verify actual medication use; the same token also appears in patent text, referring to checks to verify an email list.

patterns.name: Quarterly performance and portfolio
patterns.context: Discusses a model investment portfolio after a performance heading; “portfolio” is strongly activated.

patterns.name: License disclaimer clauses
patterns.context: Disclaimer phrasing in a list of license conditions, followed by restrictions on use of the name Rice University.

patterns.name: Baghdad and historical event narrative
patterns.context: The place name is most strongly activated in a description of urban riots in January 1948; the passage also contains historical names such as Al-Wathbah uprising.

3_1236.description: 激活分散于专名及词内片段、标题和格式边界、领域术语，以及 verify、Neither 等特定词；各段局部触发条件不同，未见一致的单一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名中被分词切开的词首或词干；包括标题、地名和人名，部分例子紧邻换行或标题式排版。

patterns.name: 地址与日期格式
patterns.context: 邮件中休假安排后的日期列表，换行、制表符和数字/斜杠格式构成局部结构。

patterns.name: Scavenger receptors 术语
patterns.context: 专业名词“Scavenger receptors”的词内分段；周围是对细胞表面蛋白的科学描述。

patterns.name: 摘要中的验证措辞
patterns.context: 在摘要中表达技术无法验证实际服药；同一 token 也出现在专利文本中，指检查以验证邮件清单。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 季度业绩与投资组合
patterns.context: 业绩标题后谈及模型投资组合；“portfolio”激活强。
patterns.domain: 金融业绩报告、邮件正文

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明条款
patterns.context: 许可证条件列表中的免责句式，后续列出 Rice University 名称的使用限制。

patterns.name: Baghdad 与历史事件叙述
patterns.context: 描述 1948 年一月城市骚乱时，地名激活最强；同段还出现 Al-Wathbah uprising 等历史名称。

en.description: The main pattern is recognition of the letter ö in Swedish, German, and Hungarian words, across different word forms in each context; a separate email date table activates at a tab after a line break, possibly due to formatting.

patterns.name: The grapheme “ö” in Swedish words
patterns.context: Activation consistently falls on ö in Swedish words; words may be split into multiple tokens, with hit locations including “öppnats”, “ökande”, “öppning”, “övergripande”, “ögat”, “översynen”, and “öppenheten”.

patterns.name: The German grapheme “öff”
patterns.context: In German “öffentliche”, ö is followed by ff; it is the same grapheme as the ö in Swedish, but occurs in a German sentence.

patterns.name: The Hungarian grapheme “öss”
patterns.context: In Hungarian “összehangolt”, ö is followed by ss; it is the same grapheme as the ö in other passages, but occurs in a Hungarian sentence.

patterns.name: Table whitespace/tab
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the date-schedule formatting of an email, immediately after a line break and in whitespace separated by a tab; this is not an obvious lexical-semantic trigger.

3_1236.description: 主要模式是在瑞典语、德语和匈牙利语词中识别字母 ö，命中各语境中不同的词形；另有一段邮件日期表在换行后的制表符处激活，可能是格式触发。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词中「ö」字素
patterns.context: 激活稳定落在瑞典语单词里的 ö；词可被切分成多个 token，命中位置包括「öppnats」「ökande」「öppning」「övergripande」「ögat」「översynen」「öppenheten」等。
patterns.domain: 以瑞典语为主的欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 德语「öff」字素
patterns.context: 德语「öffentliche」中 ö 后接 ff；与瑞典语中的 ö 同字素，但语境是德语句子。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会社会政策文本

patterns.name: 匈牙利语「öss」字素
patterns.context: 匈牙利语「összehangolt」中 ö 后接 ss；与其他段的 ö 同字素，但语境是匈牙利语句子。

patterns.name: 表格空白/制表符
patterns.context: 激活出现在邮件里的日期安排格式，紧跟换行并位于制表符分隔的空白处；并非明显的词汇语义触发。

en.concept: Contrast and verification words, and code formatting
en.description: The most prominent recurring words in activation are rather (contrast, correction) and verify (verification); there are also local patterns involving line breaks in email date lists, shell script paths, and function code.

patterns.name: The contrastive word rather
patterns.context: rather corrects, contrasts with, or redefines preceding text; in [1] it occurs in rather any, and in [7] and [10] it marks contrast
patterns.domain: Academic papers, email, and legal text

patterns.name: The word form verify
patterns.context: verify occurs in sentences describing checking, verifying, or proving a result
patterns.domain: Code, patents, academic papers, and patent-related email text

patterns.name: Line breaks and numbers in date lists
patterns.context: Holiday date lists with blank lines and indentation before dates

patterns.name: Shell script paths and code blocks
patterns.context: Shell script snippets contain paths, commands, and function definitions

3_1236.concept: 转折与验证词及代码格式
3_1236.description: 激活最突出的重复词是 rather（转折、纠正）和 verify（验证）；另有邮件日期列表换行及 shell 脚本路径、函数代码等局部模式。

patterns.name: rather 转折词
patterns.context: rather 与前文形成纠正、对照或重新界定；在 [1] 中出现在 rather any，在 [7]、[10] 中转折对照
patterns.domain: 学术论文、邮件及法律文本

patterns.name: verify 词形
patterns.context: verify 出现在描述检查、验证或证明某项结果的句子中
patterns.domain: 代码、专利、学术论文及专利邮件文本

patterns.name: 日期列表中的换行与数字
patterns.context: 假期日期列表，日期前有空行和缩进

patterns.name: shell 脚本路径及代码块
patterns.context: shell 脚本片段中出现路径、命令及函数定义

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the verb “verify” used predicatively to mean checking or confirming, across academic, patent, medical, and code contexts; there is also a weaker isolated response to “rewritten” meaning reformulated equations in a mathematics paper.

patterns.name: Explicit verification action
patterns.context: The word is used predicatively to mean checking or confirming whether a result, property, relationship, or implementation holds; it often takes a that-clause or a noun object.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: scientific papers, patents, medical research, code

patterns.name: Rewriting mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Describes a mathematical relationship being rewritten in another form in the passive voice.

3_1236.description: 主要对动词“verify”作为谓语、表示检查或确认的用法强烈响应，跨学术、专利、医学与代码语境；另对数学论文中“rewritten”表示公式改写有较弱的孤立响应。

patterns.name: 显式验证动作
patterns.trigger: “verify”；尤其是 “verify and compare”“verify expression”“verify the association”
patterns.context: 该词作为谓语，表示检查或确认某项结果、性质、关联或实现是否成立；常接 that 从句或名词宾语。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：科学论文、专利、医学研究、代码

patterns.name: 数学表达式改写
patterns.trigger: “rewritten”；“inequalities … can be rewritten”“equation can be rewritten”
patterns.context: 被动语态中描述将数学关系改写为另一种形式。

en.concept: Common local function words and formatting fragments
en.description: Activation concentrates on think used to express opinions or suggestions in email and Q&A, and also covers email address/name fields, sentence-initial As, SQL conditional words, and several style-specific fragments; no single word-sense pattern explains all examples.

patterns.name: think and opinion/suggestion clauses
patterns.context: A first-person speaker or email author expresses an opinion or asks for advice, often followed by a that-clause, with or without that; also appears in suggestions in answers.

patterns.name: Address or signature fields in email
patterns.context: Names appear alongside Enron departments and email/address formats, or service addresses are mentioned in the email body.
patterns.domain: Enron email and its contact-list/email-header formats

patterns.name: Sentence- or paragraph-initial As
patterns.context: Appears in a heading or at the beginning of a sentence; one instance is the technical heading “Aspect-Oriented”, and the other begins the sentence “As e-book war rages”.

patterns.name: SQL conditional and branching keywords
patterns.context: In code, WHEN/THEN form conditional branches, and WHERE introduces a filtering condition.

patterns.name: Time commitments in email
patterns.context: An email author reports preparing files and promises to finish by a future time.

patterns.name: Conditional sentences with If
patterns.context: A reported statement or comment introduces a hypothetical condition with If.

patterns.name: Worth judgments in Q&A
patterns.context: A respondent assesses whether a repair is worth doing, then gives a recommendation.

patterns.name: Japanese katakana and spelling segmentation
patterns.context: A narrative contains the Japanese spelling of Amazon and segmented spelling, embedded in English and Japanese name text.

3_1236.concept: 局部常见功能词与格式片段
3_1236.description: 激活集中在邮件、问答中表达判断或建议的 think，也覆盖邮件地址/姓名字段、句首 As、SQL 条件词及若干文体特有片段；不存在能解释所有例子的单一词义模式。

patterns.name: think 及意见/建议从句
patterns.context: 第一人称或邮件作者表达判断、询问建议，常接 that/省略 that 的从句；也见于回答中的建议。

patterns.name: 邮件中的地址或签名字段
patterns.context: 姓名与 Enron 部门、邮箱/地址格式并列，或在邮件正文提及服务地址。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及其通讯录/邮件头格式

patterns.name: 段落或句子起始的 As
patterns.context: 位于标题或句首；一个是技术标题“Aspect-Oriented”，另一个是句子开头“As e-book war rages”。

patterns.name: SQL 条件及分支关键字
patterns.context: 代码中以 WHEN/THEN 构成条件分支，并以 WHERE 引出筛选条件。

patterns.name: 邮件中的时间承诺
patterns.context: 邮件作者报告正在准备文件，并承诺在未来时间点前完成。

patterns.name: 带有 If 的条件句
patterns.context: 转述或评论中以 If 引出假设条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件转发内容、幽默评论

patterns.name: 问答中的 worth 评价
patterns.context: 回答者评估某项维修是否值得，随后给出行动建议。

patterns.name: 日文片假名及拼读拆分
patterns.context: 叙事中出现 Amazon 的日文写法及分段拼读，夹在英文与日文姓名文本中。
patterns.domain: 小说/叙事文本，多语言文本

en.concept: Primarily navigation-bar markers, plus miscellaneous items
en.description: Activation occurs mainly on HTML/Bootstrap navigation-bar tags and class names; it also appears in Python code that catches ImportError. Additional in-word fragments of English nav, trading-rule wording, and Latvian administrative text cannot be unified with the main pattern.

patterns.name: HTML navigation-bar markers
patterns.context: The nav element, navbar class name, and their combinations in HTML; often adjacent to Bootstrap styles, navigation menus, or button code.

patterns.name: Python import exception handling
patterns.context: An except branch catches ImportError after a Python import statement; the snippet includes compatibility imports or CLI code.

patterns.name: nav as a substring within an English word
patterns.context: nav appears inside ordinary English words rather than in an HTML tag or class name; the examples refer to a navigator and a small transport vehicle.

patterns.name: Trading-rule wording
patterns.context: Describes NYMEX trading price fluctuation limits and actual quotes; token activation is scattered across related financial wording.
patterns.domain: Energy futures trading rules or legal text

patterns.name: Latvian administrative terminology
patterns.context: Latvian sentences contain terms related to administration, control systems, and agreement of opinions; no clear connection to nav usage in code.

3_1236.concept: 导航栏标记为主，另有杂项
3_1236.description: 主要激活于 HTML/Bootstrap 导航栏标签与类名；也见于 Python 捕获 ImportError 的代码。另有英文 nav 词内片段、交易规则措辞及拉脱维亚语行政文本，无法统一归入主模式。

patterns.name: HTML导航栏标记
patterns.context: HTML 中的 nav 元素、navbar 类名及其组合；常与 Bootstrap 样式、导航菜单或按钮代码相邻。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 HTML/CSS/前端模板代码

patterns.name: Python 导入异常处理
patterns.context: Python 的导入语句之后，用于捕获 ImportError 的 except 分支；片段中伴随兼容导入或 CLI 代码。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Python 源码

patterns.name: nav 作为英文词内子串
patterns.context: nav 出现在普通英文单词内部，而非 HTML 标签或类名；分别指航海员和小型交通车。

patterns.name: 交易规则措辞
patterns.trigger: « bona»« fide»、« high»« price»、« low»、« limit»
patterns.context: 描述 NYMEX 交易价格波动限制与真实报价，token 激活分散在相关金融措辞中。
patterns.domain: 能源期货交易规则或法律文本

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语行政术语
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语句子中出现行政管理、控制系统及意见一致性相关词语；与代码中的 nav 用法无明显联系。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种行政文本

en.description: The most stable pattern is activation on basis, covering usages meaning grounds, classification, frequency, and basis points. There are also isolated activations on of, PER, Lack, and or, each in a different context and difficult to assign to a shared trigger pattern from these fragments.

patterns.name: basis phrases
patterns.context: “basis” means grounds, a classification standard, frequency, or a financial unit of measurement; it usually occurs in fixed collocations
patterns.domain: Academic papers, encyclopedias, energy email, financial email

patterns.name: Isolated activation on of
patterns.context: The preposition occurs in a noun phrase; there is no clear basis collocation here

patterns.name: PER financial metric
patterns.context: A financial or valuation metric is followed by a numeric threshold

patterns.name: Lack of control
patterns.context: Indicates a lack of some degree of control, followed by an of phrase

patterns.name: or as a disjunction
patterns.context: Lists two alternative food-processing tools

3_1236.description: 最稳定的模式是激活 basis，涵盖依据、分类、频率和 basis points 等用法。另有 of、PER、Lack、or 的单例激活，分属不同语境，难以从这些片段归入同一触发模式。

patterns.name: basis 短语
patterns.trigger: «basis»，包括“on the basis of”“on this basis”“on a … basis”“basis points”
patterns.context: “basis”用于表示依据、分类标准、频率或金融计量单位；通常出现在固定搭配中
patterns.domain: 学术论文、百科、能源邮件、金融邮件

patterns.name: of 的孤立激活
patterns.context: 介词出现在名词短语中；此处没有明显的 basis 搭配

patterns.name: PER 财务指标
patterns.context: 财务或估值指标后接数值阈值

patterns.name: Lack of 控制
patterns.context: 表示缺乏某种控制程度，后接 of 短语

patterns.name: or 选择连接词
patterns.context: 列举两种可选的食物加工工具

en.concept: Local features of over and text boundaries
