en.description: The most prominent shared cue is over, especially near sentence endings, newlines, or numbers/proper names; other signals include paragraph boundaries, proper-name fragments, and formatting in various encyclopedic and technical texts. These cues do not all reduce to the same trigger mechanism.

patterns.name: over at document boundaries
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a preceding sentence or phrase, especially when the marked over is followed by a period, newline, or number/proper name; in [2], it is over masses. Several passages also contain preceding function words such as «of» and «for», but this is not shared by all passages
patterns.domain: Local word-form and boundary context across domains

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation and paragraph/line boundaries
patterns.context: A period occurs at the end of an excerpted paragraph or near a new paragraph, heading, or entry boundary; this co-occurs with local forms such as adjacent over, a number before the period, or a proper name
patterns.domain: Patent text, encyclopedias, television descriptions, etc.

patterns.name: Morphemes or name fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Activation occurs within or next to proper names, possibly involving segmentation boundaries in personal or place names; not all proper names trigger it
patterns.domain: EU Parliament, game music lists, wine descriptions, paper acknowledgments

patterns.name: Adjacent numbers and measurements/identifiers
patterns.context: Numbers, units, channel numbers, or time expressions occur next to local prepositions; numbers themselves may also be marked, but there is no uniform numeric-format condition
patterns.domain: Patents, wine descriptions, television broadcast descriptions, aircraft entries

patterns.name: Formatting markers at section or entry openings
patterns.context: A new paragraph, body text after a heading, or the start of a new entry; activation is distributed around boundary words and openings, with no consistent syntactic trigger

patterns.name: Multilingual or fragmented word forms
patterns.context: Appears as segmented fragments in a Finnish passage; newlines, sentence endings, and proper names also occur, but it is unclear which condition dominates

patterns.name: Image descriptions in critical narration
patterns.context: Describes scenes above or covering people/groups in a film image; here over is not used at the end of a passage
patterns.domain: PhilPapers film review or academic discussion

patterns.name: Encyclopedia heading and broadcast-date format
patterns.context: After an entry heading or section newline, the text opens with information such as season number or broadcast time

3_1236.description: 激活最突出的共同线索是 over，尤其与句末、换行或数字/专名邻接；另有段落边界、专名碎片及各类百科和技术文本格式信号。不同线索并非都能归为同一触发机制。

patterns.name: 文档边界处的 over
patterns.context: 在前文句子或短语末尾出现，尤其是被标注的 over 后紧接句号、换行或数字/专名；[2]中则是 over masses。多个片段还出现前置 «of»、«for» 等功能词，但并非每段都共有
patterns.domain: 跨领域语料中的局部词形与边界上下文

patterns.name: 句末标点及段落/行边界
patterns.context: 句号位于截取段落末端或靠近新段落、标题、条目边界；与相邻的 over、句点前数字或专名等局部形式并存
patterns.domain: 专利文本、百科、电视台说明等

patterns.name: 人名中的词素或姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部或专名相邻位置，可能涉及姓名/地名的分词边界；不是所有专名都会触发
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会、游戏音乐名单、葡萄酒描述、论文致谢

patterns.name: 数字与度量/编号邻接
patterns.context: 数字、单位、频道号或时间词紧邻局部介词；数字本身也可能被标记，但未见统一的数字格式条件
patterns.domain: 专利、葡萄酒介绍、电视广播说明、航空器条目

patterns.name: 章节或条目开头的格式标记
patterns.context: 新段落、标题后正文或条目新段开始；激活分布在边界词和开头附近，未显示一致的句法触发条件

patterns.name: 多语种或碎片化词形
patterns.context: 芬兰语句段中以分词碎片形式出现；同时有换行、句末和专名，但无法确定是哪项条件主导

patterns.name: 评论性叙述中的影像描述
patterns.context: 描述电影画面中人物/群体上方或覆盖其上的场景；这里 over 不是段末用法

patterns.name: 百科标题及播出日期格式
patterns.context: 条目标题或章节换行后，以季数、播出时间等信息开篇

en.description: Activation is mainly on scattered word fragments; more stable recurring cues are premise/on-premise and the letter sequence ator, alongside scattered hits in names, numbers, sports, and architectural text. Overall, there is no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: The substring “premise” within a sentence/word
patterns.context: Hits premise at an in-word tokenization position, or the compound on-premise; the first two instances are in argumentative/philosophical contexts, and the latter is in a cloud-computing context.
patterns.domain: Forum discussion, philosophy paper, cloud-computing article

patterns.name: The word-final fragment “ator”
patterns.context: Occurs inside the name Alatorre and at the end of the drug-class term vasodilator; the shared feature is the letter fragment ator, not a clear shared meaning.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in names
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized fragments of names or proper nouns, but there is no stable, consistent name type or spelling pattern.
patterns.domain: Game descriptions, football categories, sports reporting

patterns.name: Scattered fragments in words/phrases
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across common words, proper nouns, and phrase components, with no stable semantic or syntactic trigger across passages.
patterns.domain: Email, encyclopedias, philosophy, sports, and web text

patterns.name: Quantity and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Occasional activation occurs near numbers, dates, or years, but the forms vary across examples.

patterns.name: Fragments in place names/category names
patterns.context: Local fragments in sports categories, clubs, or school names; no clear shared trigger condition with the other patterns.

patterns.name: Architectural description fragments
patterns.context: Multiple scattered word fragments activate within the same historical architectural description, without forming a specific, consistent architectural term.

3_1236.description: 激活以零散词片段为主；较稳定的重复线索是 premise/on-premise 与 ator 字母串，另有姓名、数字、体育及建筑文本中的分散命中，整体缺少统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 句中/词内子串“premise”
patterns.context: 在词内分词位置命中 premise，或复合词 on-premise；前两处为论证/哲学语境，后一处为云计算语境。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、哲学论文、云计算文章

patterns.name: 词尾片段“ator”
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Alatorre 的词内，以及药物类别词 vasodilator 的词尾；共同的是字母片段 ator，并非明显的共同词义。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、专利/药理文本

patterns.name: 人名词内片段
patterns.trigger: [4] Pas«cal»2« Michael»4 St«ief»1el；[7] «C»«aud»al« Dep»«ort»«ivo»；[8] «J»«ake»« Waters»、Tyler« Lock»«ett»
patterns.context: 激活落在人名或专名的分词片段中，但没有稳定一致的姓名类型或拼写模式。
patterns.domain: 游戏介绍、足球分类、体育报道

patterns.name: 词语/短语中的零散片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在普通词、专名及短语成分上，未见跨段稳定的语义或句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科、哲学、体育及网页文本

patterns.name: 数量与格式片段
patterns.context: 数字、日期或年代附近偶有激活，但不同例子形式不一致。

patterns.name: 地名/类别名称片段
patterns.context: 体育类别、俱乐部或学校名称中的局部片段；与其他模式没有清楚的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 足球分类、大学橄榄球报道

patterns.name: 建筑描述片段
patterns.context: 同一段历史建筑描述中多个分散词片段激活，未能归纳为具体一致的建筑术语。

en.concept: Subword fragments and heterogeneous text features
en.description: The most salient reproducible cues are the within-word fragments “ator” and “eg”; other activations are scattered across semantic words, Chinese code-button comments, and within-word German fragments. Overall, the examples span languages and genres, with no single stable semantic interpretation.

patterns.name: Word fragments containing “ator”
patterns.context: Appears inside complete words or stems, for example “equatorward,” “Aleatoric,” and “Alatorre”; “ator” may be followed by a suffix or word ending.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, forum text, email, and other genres

patterns.name: Within-word “eg” fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on cross-token or within-word substrings, without a stable shared meaning; passage 10 is in Estonian.

patterns.name: Semantically salient words and collocations
patterns.context: In narration or discussion, activation falls on words related to time, state, hierarchy, war, and speech; no shared trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Button-related fragments in program code
patterns.context: A Chinese comment mentions a record button, near Java/Kotlin-style event listener and button code.

patterns.name: Within-word character fragments in German
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented fragments inside German words, without an obvious consistent semantic category.

patterns.name: Name fragments in acknowledgments
patterns.context: A paper acknowledgment lists collaborators or reviewers by name.

patterns.name: Within-word English character fragments
patterns.context: Falls on ordinary English words or phrases in a narrative passage, with no shared semantic trigger condition.

3_1236.concept: 词片段与异质文本特征
3_1236.description: 激活最显眼的可复现线索是词内“ator”及“eg”片段；另有分散的语义词、代码按钮中文注释和德语词内片段，整体跨语言、跨文体，未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 包含“ator”的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在完整词或词干内部，例如“equatorward”“Aleatoric”“Alatorre”；“ator”后可继续接后缀或词尾。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、论坛文本、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: “eg”词内片段
patterns.trigger: «eg»，如“disrep«air»”附近的“state« of»9”“Kri«eg»9”“Pra«eg»9”等局部字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词切分或词内子串上，未见稳定一致的完整词义；第10段为爱沙尼亚语。
patterns.domain: 百科、议会文本、爱沙尼亚语文本

patterns.name: 语义突出词和固定搭配
patterns.trigger: «During»“«state» of disrepair”、“third «tier»”、“Questions of «war» and peace”、“walked … «without» «saying» a «word»”
patterns.context: 在叙述或论述中，激活落在时间、状态、层级、战争及言语相关词上；这些词之间看不出统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、议会文本、叙事文本

patterns.name: 程序代码中的按钮相关片段
patterns.context: 中文注释提到录制按钮，附近是 Java/Kotlin 风格的事件监听与按钮代码。

patterns.name: 德语词内字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在德语单词内部的分词片段，不构成显然一致的语义类别。

patterns.name: 致谢中的人名片段
patterns.context: 论文致谢列举合作者或评论者姓名。

patterns.name: 英语词内字符片段
patterns.context: 落在叙事段落中的普通英语词语或短语，未见共同语义触发条件。

en.description: Activation occurs mainly on the substring containing Greek «λο» in Greek words, across forms related to simplification and membership; there are also English biographical geographic phrasing, season-year numbers, and a single Japanese bibliographic kanji, with no unified explanation yet.

patterns.name: Greek word forms related to «απλο-»
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the Greek-letter substring «λο» and its continuation; it occurs in words such as «απλοποιηθεί», «απλούστευσης», and «αναλογη», possibly responding to a shared subword fragment rather than the complete word meaning.

patterns.name: Greek membership word form
patterns.context: «μέλος» means member and occurs in statements about membership in an institution or organization; its triggering fragment overlaps with the «λο» found above, but the full word meaning differs.

patterns.name: Number and place-name fragments in English/Spanish biographies
patterns.context: Activation falls on «of» in a location description and the following place-name fragment in an English biography; similar pages also contain birth information and football career details, but it is unclear whether these contexts form a trigger condition.

patterns.name: Kanji fragment in a foreign-language bibliography
patterns.context: Activation occurs in Japanese book-title text embedded in an English Wikipedia passage, especially around the kanji «上» and adjacent characters; seen only once.

patterns.name: Number fragments in year and season headings
patterns.context: Months, years, and numbers in a person's birth date or sports-season heading; no clear semantic connection to the Greek main pattern or adjacent English words.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia biographies and sports entries

3_1236.concept: 多语言局部子词/字符片段响应
3_1236.description: 主要激活于希腊语词中含「λο」的子串，跨简化、类似词形和成员身份词；另见英文人名地理表述、赛季年份数字及一次日文书目汉字，尚无统一解释。

patterns.name: 希腊语「απλο-」相关词形
patterns.context: 激活集中在希腊字母子串「λο」及其后续部分；出现在「απλοποιηθεί」「απλούστευσης」「αναλογη」等词中，可能对共享的子词片段而非完整词义响应。

patterns.name: 希腊语成员身份词形
patterns.context: 「μέλος」表示成员，出现在机构或组织成员身份的陈述中；触发片段与上面出现的「λο」重合，但完整词义不同。

patterns.name: 英西语人物传记中的数字与地名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文人物简介中地点描述的「of」及后续地名片段；同类页面还含出生信息和足球履历，但这些上下文是否构成触发条件不确定。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物传记

patterns.name: 异语种参考书目中的汉字片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在英文维基百科片段内嵌的日文书名文字中，尤其集中于汉字「上」及其邻近字符；仅见一次。

patterns.name: 年份与赛季标题中的数字片段
patterns.context: 人物出生日期或体育赛事赛季标题中的月份、年份和数字；与希腊语主模式及相邻英语词无明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物传记及体育条目

en.concept: English discourse frames and manner expressions
en.description: The most stable cue is the English discourse frame “to say (that)”; other activations include the manner expression “such (a) way,” French “au plus tard,” and a few independent academic name subwords.

patterns.name: Fixed discourse frame “to say that”
patterns.context: Often appears after a negative or concessive expression to qualify or clarify a prior point; activation falls on infinitive to, say, and following that.
patterns.domain: News, sports, technical discussion, email, and other genres

patterns.name: Manner expression “such a way”
patterns.context: Introduces a manner or approach, followed by a that-clause or colon; activation concentrates on way.

patterns.name: French superlative phrase
patterns.context: Means “at the latest” in a French sentence, in the context of scheduling a proposal submission.

patterns.name: Name fragments in acknowledgments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments in personal names in academic acknowledgments.

3_1236.concept: 英语话语框架与方式表达
3_1236.description: 最稳定的线索是英语话语框架“to say (that)”；另有“such (a) way”方式表达，以及法语“au plus tard”和学术人名子词等少数独立触发。

patterns.name: 固定话语框架“to say that”
patterns.trigger: «to»« say»« that»（多段中标记到 “say” 或 “that”）
patterns.context: 常出现在否定或让步表达后，用来限定、澄清前述观点；激活落在不定式 to、say 及后续 that 上。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育、技术讨论、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: “such a way”表达方式
patterns.context: 引出某种做法或方式，后接 that 从句或冒号；激活集中在 way。
patterns.domain: 百科、编程问答、数学说明

patterns.name: 法语最高程度短语
patterns.context: 法语句中表示“最迟”，出现在安排提案提交时间的语境。

patterns.name: 致谢中的人名片段
patterns.context: 学术致谢段落中，激活落在人名的子词片段上。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on say (especially to say in negative or concessive constructions) and way, which expresses manner; one instance also occurs on Hz in the display specification “60 Hz”.

patterns.name: “to say” inferential construction
patterns.context: Activation falls on say in negative, concessive, or reported-speech constructions; common forms include “isn’t/not to say…” and “called…to say”.

patterns.name: Manner expression “way”
patterns.context: way denotes a manner of doing something, often preceded by such a or a normal; it modifies an action or relationship.

patterns.name: Hz in numbers and units
patterns.context: Occurs in the display specification “60 Hz”; activation seems related to technical units or frequency notation.

3_1236.description: 激活主要集中在 say（尤其否定/让步句式中的 to say），以及表示方式的 way；另有一次出现在显示器规格“60 Hz”的 Hz。

patterns.name: “to say”推论框架
patterns.trigger: «to»…«say»（段1、2、7、8、10中为«to»«say»，段6为“in a normal way”中的«way»）
patterns.context: 否定、让步或引述框架中，激活落在 say；常见形式为“isn’t/not to say…”，也有“called…to say”。

patterns.name: 方式表达“way”
patterns.trigger: «way»，多见于“in such a way”或“in a normal way”
patterns.context: way 表示做事的方式，前面常接 such a 或 a normal；修饰动作或关系。

patterns.name: 数字与单位中的 Hz
patterns.context: 出现在“60 Hz”显示器规格中，激活似与技术单位或频率标注相关。

en.description: The strongest recurring pattern is the English phrase “not to say,” used to state a point and then qualify or clarify it, appearing in five passages. Other activations are scattered across way, over, saying, and Chinese localization and comment text, and are difficult to unify.

patterns.name: Negative qualifying turn of phrase
patterns.context: Adds to, qualifies, or clarifies a preceding point; activation on “say” is stronger than on surrounding words.
patterns.domain: Reviews, news, technical discussions, and dialogue

patterns.name: Specific discourse connective
patterns.context: Describes adopting an approach or method; often preceded by a preposition and demonstrative.

patterns.name: over in direction/path expressions
patterns.context: A preposition expressing a time span or a position above/across space; meanings and contexts differ.

patterns.name: Chinese localized technical terms
patterns.context: Appears in a msgstr translation field, containing Chinese technical terminology and character-level annotations.

patterns.name: Chinese code-comment words
patterns.context: Traditional Chinese comment describes button-click handling, next to code declarations.

patterns.name: Definition-introducing expression
patterns.context: Introduces a definition or construction method in mathematical text.

patterns.name: Expression for not speaking during a performance
patterns.context: Narrates a character leaving without speaking; “saying” is marked.

patterns.name: saying in a contrastive explanation
patterns.context: In a comparative or rebuttal expression, say occurs in an infinitival construction; unlike the common “not to say” phrasing.

3_1236.concept: 英语话语表达中的 say
3_1236.description: 最强且重复的模式是英语短语 “not to say”，用于先提出观点再作限定或澄清，覆盖五段。其余激活分散于 way、over、saying 及中文本地化和注释文本，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 否定限缩式转折短语
patterns.trigger: “not to say”及相邻的 “That’s not to say”
patterns.context: 在先前观点后补充、限定或澄清；其中 “say” 的激活强于周围词。
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻、技术讨论及对话文本

patterns.name: 特定话语连接词
patterns.context: 说明采取某种做法或方法；前面常有介词和指示词。

patterns.name: 方向/路径表达中的 over
patterns.context: 介词表达时间跨度或空间上的上方、越过；词义和语境不同。

patterns.name: 中文本地化技术词
patterns.trigger: “發射機應答器”及附近的中文字符，如“電台”
patterns.context: 出现在 msgstr 翻译字段中，包含中文技术术语及字符级标注。

patterns.name: 中文代码注释词
patterns.trigger: “處理解除按鈕的單擊”中的“處理”“按”
patterns.context: 繁体中文注释描述按钮点击处理，紧邻代码声明。

patterns.name: 定义引导表达
patterns.context: 数学文本中引出某个定义或构造方法。

patterns.name: 演出中不发言的表达
patterns.context: 叙述人物离场且没有说话；“saying”被标记。

patterns.name: 反转说明中的 saying
patterns.context: 比较或反驳性表达中，say 位于不定式结构；此处与常见 “not to say” 句式不同。

en.concept: “to say” phrase and local word forms
en.description: Primarily responds to the English sequence “to say”, especially the concessive sentence “That’s not to say (that)…”, and also occurs in other infinitive constructions; sporadic activations involve a place-name fragment, such way, no way, and a French phrase, which are difficult to explain with one clear shared meaning.

patterns.name: “to say” followed by “that”
patterns.context: English phrases expressing concession, elaboration, or reported speech, commonly “That’s not to say that …”; [4] has “to say that they …”.
patterns.domain: Spoken English, commentary, forum discussions, and business email

patterns.name: say in English speech
patterns.context: Only covers [8]; the context is “begging me to never say anything critical”, namely the infinitive “to never say”. It does not have the “to say that” construction common in [1–5].

patterns.name: Place-name fragment in Rio Grande do Norte
patterns.context: Occurs in the place name “state of Rio Grande do Norte”; activation falls on a subword fragment after a word split.

patterns.name: Fixed expression in code documentation
patterns.context: Occurs in a code-fix description, “I fixed it in such way”; activation is concentrated on the expression itself, though the grammatical form is usually “in such a way”.

patterns.name: way in a negative context
patterns.context: In “They have no way of knowing …”, it denotes a method or possibility; unlike the “such way” usage in [7].

patterns.name: French phrase fragment
patterns.context: In French parliamentary text, activation falls on word or phrase fragments such as “tout-à-fait judicieux”, “au plus tard”, and “façon”; there is no obvious English construction.

3_1236.description: 主要响应英语中“to say”这一串，尤其是让步句“That’s not to say (that)…”，也见于其他不定式用法；另有零散激活涉及地名分词、such way、no way及法语短语，彼此难由同一明确语义解释。

patterns.name: “to say”后接“that”
patterns.context: 英语中表示让步、补充或转述的短语，常见形式是 “That’s not to say that …”；[4]则是 “to say that they …”。
patterns.domain: 英语口语、评论、论坛讨论及商务邮件

patterns.name: 英语语流中的 say
patterns.context: 只覆盖[8]；上下文是 “begging me to never say anything critical”，即不定式 “to never say”。不具备[1–5]常见的 “to say that”结构。

patterns.name: Rio Grande do Norte 地名片段
patterns.context: 位于地名 “state of Rio Grande do Norte” 中；激活落在分词后的词片段上。

patterns.name: 代码说明中的固定表达
patterns.context: 出现在 “I fixed it in such way” 的代码修复说明中；激活集中于表达本身，语法上通常会说 “in such a way”。

patterns.name: 否定语境中的 way
patterns.context: 在 “They have no way of knowing …” 中表示方法或可能性；与[7]的 “such way”用法不同。

patterns.name: 法语短语片段
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中，激活落在 “tout-à-fait judicieux”“au plus tard”“façon”等分词或短语片段上；没有明显英语句式。

en.description: Activation is distributed across several English fixed constructions (“to say that,” “such a way”), French “premier,” and various isolated contexts; triggers are not uniform, and some activations fall on different words within the constructions.

patterns.name: Concessive/qualifying expression with to say that
patterns.context: Introduces an additional explanation after denying, correcting, or qualifying a prior judgment; activation occurs near “to,” “say,” and “that.”
patterns.domain: English prose, reviews, forums, news; see passages 2, 3, 5

patterns.name: such a way (that) construction
patterns.context: Describes something being done or designed in a certain manner; activation concentrates on the fixed phrase “such a way,” and does not require that to appear.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, encyclopedias, technical reviews; see passages 6, 8, 10

patterns.name: Structures related to French “premier”
patterns.context: Mentions a primary issue, principle, or item in formal French speech or parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Quantity and demand negotiation
patterns.context: An email reports resource allocation figures and relays a request from the other party.

patterns.name: Ranking/list context
patterns.context: Describes playing something over a period of time, then discusses its chart rank or position.

patterns.name: Sports event reporting
patterns.context: Appears as part of a championship event name in a sports report; superficially resembles the French “premier” pattern, but the context differs.

patterns.name: “nearly” in narrative
patterns.context: Narrates a character or event nearly causing a certain outcome; no obvious shared construction is evident.

3_1236.description: 激活分散在若干英语固定结构（“to say that”“such a way”）、法语“premier”及多个孤立语境；触发点并不统一，且有些激活落在结构中的不同词上。

patterns.name: to say that 让步/限定表达
patterns.context: 在否定、纠正或限定前述判断后，引出补充说明；“to”“say”“that”附近均有激活。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、评论、论坛、新闻；见段2、3、5

patterns.name: such a way（that）结构
patterns.context: 描述某事以某种方式进行或设计；激活集中在固定短语“such a way”，不要求一定出现that。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科、技术评论；见段6、8、10

patterns.name: 法语“premier”相关结构
patterns.context: 法语正式发言或议会文本中，提及首要议题、原则或条目。

patterns.name: 数量与需求谈判
patterns.context: 邮件中报告资源配置数值，并转述对方提出的需求。

patterns.name: 排序/榜单语境
patterns.context: 表示在一段时间内播放某内容，随后谈论榜单排名或位置。

patterns.name: 体育赛事报道
patterns.context: 作为赛事名称的一部分，出现于冠军赛报道；与法语“premier”模式表面相似，但语境不同。

patterns.name: 叙事中的“nearly”
patterns.context: 叙述人物或事件差点造成某种结果；未见明显共享句式。

en.description: Responds primarily to say in the concessive clarification structure “not to say” and to constructions where almost is followed by a degree, state, or time complement; other activations involve names, email dates and times, formatting markers, and several one-off lexical triggers.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “to say”
patterns.context: Introduces a qualification, clarification, or elaboration in a negative or concessive context; activation falls mainly on say

patterns.name: almost followed by a degree or time complement
patterns.context: almost denotes approaching a degree, state, or time; activation falls on almost
patterns.domain: Online discussions, legal texts, news narratives

patterns.name: Nominal elements in names
patterns.context: Common titles, name fragments, or initials appear in names or email signatures; activation strength varies

patterns.name: Date and email header fields
patterns.context: Dates, times, and sender/address fields in forwarded email headers, interspersed with numbers and delimiters

patterns.name: near/nearly meaning close to or almost
patterns.context: Describes coming close to an event or degree; almost may be the same lexical trigger as almost in other passages

patterns.name: Other local lexical triggers
patterns.context: The passages do not contain enough repeated context to confirm a shared semantic pattern; these may be local collocations or incidental high activations
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, music reviews, forums, fiction

patterns.name: Email forwarding separator
patterns.context: Email forwarding format and line-break boundaries co-occur with date and name fields

3_1236.description: 主要对“not to say”让步澄清结构中的 say，以及 almost 后接程度、状态或时间补语的结构响应；另有姓名、邮件日期时间与格式标记，以及若干仅单次出现的词汇触发。

patterns.name: 固定搭配“to say”
patterns.trigger: «to»« say»，尤其 “That’s not to say” / “that’s not to say”
patterns.context: 在否定或让步语境中，引出限定、澄清或补充说明；激活集中落在 say 上
patterns.domain: 评论、论坛讨论、叙述性文章

patterns.name: almost 后接程度或时间性补语
patterns.context: almost 表示接近某种程度、状态或时间；激活落在 almost 上
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、法律文本、新闻叙述

patterns.name: 人名中的名词成分
patterns.context: 人名或邮件署名中出现常见称谓、姓名片段或首字母；激活强度不一

patterns.name: 日期及邮件头字段
patterns.context: 转发邮件头中的日期、时间及发件人/地址字段，数字和分隔符交错

patterns.name: near/ nearly 接近或险些
patterns.context: 描述接近发生某事、接近某种程度；其中 almost 与其他语段中的 almost 可能是同一词汇触发

patterns.name: 其他局部词汇触发
patterns.trigger: « Premier»« League»；« Motion»；« over»；« lack»；« sign»；« reluctant»；« zero»
patterns.context: 片段中没有足够重复的上下文来确认共同语义模式，可能是局部搭配或偶然高激活
patterns.domain: 体育报道、音乐评论、论坛、小说

patterns.name: 邮件转发分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件转发格式及换行边界与日期、姓名字段共同出现

en.description: Most passages activate near expressions such as way/no way or not to say; other isolated triggers include Japanese “一定”, Abu Dhabi, French word forms, and internal fragments in bibliographic names, with no single shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: way and negation expressions
patterns.context: Commonly appears in expressions such as “no way to describe / no way of knowing” and “not to say,” with activation near way or say; also includes the exclamation “no way!”.

patterns.name: “定” within a sentence fragment
patterns.context: A Japanese sentence describes something happening within a certain period; strong activation falls on “定,” unrelated to English way/say phrases.

patterns.name: Ending fragment of the place name Abu Dhabi
patterns.context: The place name occurs in a list of international opera house performance venues; activation falls on an internal subword fragment of Dhabi.

patterns.name: French articles and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on within-word fragments in French parliamentary speech; the same passage also contains “premier”10, but it is unclear whether these share a trigger condition.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in bibliographic names
patterns.context: Internal word fragments in uppercase names in a book index or list of people are activated; other names in the same passage show weaker activation.

3_1236.description: 多数段落在 way/no way 或 not to say 一类表达附近激活；另有日文“一定”、Abu Dhabi、法语词形及书目姓名内部片段等孤立触发，无法归入同一语义模式。

patterns.name: way 与否定表达
patterns.context: 常见于“no way to describe / no way of knowing”“not to say”等表达，激活落在 way 或 say 附近；也包括感叹语“no way!”。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、问答、新闻评论

patterns.name: 句中片段中的“定”
patterns.context: 日文句子描述某事在一定期间内发生；强激活落在“定”，并非英语 way/say 词组。

patterns.name: 地名 Abu Dhabi 的末段
patterns.context: 地名位于国际歌剧院演出地点列表中，激活落在 Dhabi 的内部子词片段。

patterns.name: 法语冠词与词形片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言文字中，激活落在词内部片段；同段还有“premier”10，但无法确认它与这些片段共享触发条件。

patterns.name: 书目姓名中的内部片段
patterns.context: 书末索引或人物名单中，大写姓名的内部词片段被激活；同段其他姓名也有较弱激活。

en.description: The most prominent pattern is way, especially no way and no way of knowing; other isolated triggers include Japanese 一番, French premier, the genus name Naucoria, and the phrase to say, spanning different languages and contexts.

patterns.name: Fixed expressions with way
patterns.context: way denotes a method, possibility, or ability, often following no; it also appears in exclamations «no way!» and «no other way». In passages 1 and 2, «way» is also accompanied by word splits or punctuation, with different meanings and syntax.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, Q&A, and general narrative

patterns.name: Ordinal first
patterns.context: The French ordinal premier follows a definite article and modifies point.
patterns.domain: Formal European Parliament speeches in French

patterns.name: Japanese positional expression with a numeral
patterns.context: In Japanese URL instructions, it follows 「上記URLの」 and means the most… or first; the surrounding text describes an item on a webpage.

patterns.name: Fungal taxonomic name
patterns.context: Embedded in the genus name Naucoria; the same sentence lists other fungal genera and discusses fungal classification.

patterns.name: say in a lyric phrase
patterns.context: An infinitive phrase introduces an elaboration, followed by «the girls are wrong»; occurs in an account about music charts.

3_1236.concept: 弱相关的局部词形触发
3_1236.description: 最显著模式是 way，尤其 no way 及 no way of knowing；另有日语一番、法语 premier、属名 Naucoria 和短语 to say 等孤立触发，分属不同语言与语境。

patterns.name: way 固定表达
patterns.trigger: «way»，尤其是 «no way», «no way of knowing», «there is no way»
patterns.context: way 用于表示方法、可能性或是否能够做到，常处于 no 后；也出现在感叹句 «no way!» 和 «no other way» 中。第1、2段的 «way» 前后还伴随分词或标点，词义和句法各异。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、问答及一般叙述

patterns.name: 序数 first
patterns.context: 法语定冠词后接序数 premier，修饰 point。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会法语正式发言

patterns.name: 日语数字位置表达
patterns.context: 日语 URL 指引中，位于「上記URLの」之后，表示最……或第一；周边文字在说明网页上的项目。

patterns.name: 菌类分类名称
patterns.context: 嵌在属名 Naucoria 内；同句列举其他真菌属名，讨论菌类分类。

patterns.name: 歌词短语 say
patterns.context: 不定式短语引出补充说明，后接 «the girls are wrong»；位于关于音乐榜单的叙述中。
patterns.domain: 网络评论或流行音乐讨论

en.concept: Local word forms and proper-name fragments
en.description: Strong activations mostly fall on local word forms or proper-name fragments: way, so/above, French fixed phrases, institution names, abbreviations, genus names, and email text vary; only low-strength function words recur sporadically.

patterns.name: way followed by to
patterns.context: In negative or exclamatory expressions, way means “method, possibility” and is followed by to or an exclamation mark; the exact neighboring words vary.

patterns.name: so in degree or range expressions
patterns.context: Appears in expressions of degree, approximation, or comparison: [10] “or so” means approximately; [3] “or above” means reaching or exceeding a level. Both examples occur near expressions of range or degree.

patterns.name: French plus
patterns.context: Occurs in the fixed phrase “au plus tard” (at the latest).

patterns.name: of in a university name
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper name “University of Bahia,” connecting parts of the institution’s name.

patterns.name: C in the abbreviation UNC
patterns.context: Together with preceding «UN», forms the university abbreviation UNC, followed by head coach.

patterns.name: auc in a genus name
patterns.context: Embedded within the fungal genus name “Naucoria,” in a taxonomic list.

patterns.name: ONE in an Enron name
patterns.context: Together with preceding «D», forms “DONE!”; appears to be a name, signature, or shout in an email, but the context is unclear.

patterns.name: IPN letter string in PayPal context
patterns.context: In “PayPalからIPNメッセージ”, IPN is an abbreviation related to payment notification messages; activation is distributed across the letters, with no single strongly activated token.

patterns.name: Common function words or local formatting fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across passages, with no stable semantic, syntactic-position, or cross-domain trigger pattern.

3_1236.description: 强激活多数落在局部词形或专名碎片上：way、so/above、法语固定短语、机构名、缩写、属名及邮件文字各异；仅低强度功能词有零散重复。

patterns.name: way 后接 to
patterns.context: 在否定或感叹表达中，way 表示“方法、可能性”，后接 to 或感叹号；具体邻接词不同。
patterns.domain: 非正式英语对话、论坛文本

patterns.name: 程度或选择中的 so
patterns.context: 出现在程度、近似或比较表达中：[10] “or so”表示大约；[3] “or above”表示达到或超过。两例都处在范围或程度表述附近。

patterns.name: 法语 plus
patterns.context: 处于“au plus tard”（最迟）这一固定短语中。

patterns.name: 大学名称中的 of
patterns.context: 位于专名“University of Bahia”中，连接机构名称的组成部分。

patterns.name: UNC 缩写中的 C
patterns.context: 与前面的«UN»共同组成大学缩写 UNC，后接 head coach。

patterns.name: 属名中的 auc
patterns.context: 嵌在真菌属名“Naucoria”内部，处于分类学列举中。

patterns.name: Enron 人名中的 ONE
patterns.context: 与前面的«D»组成“DONE!”，看起来是邮件中的名字、署名或呼喊；具体语境不明。

patterns.name: PayPal 字母串 IPN
patterns.context: 在“PayPalからIPNメッセージ”中，IPN 是支付通知消息相关缩写；激活分散在字母上，非单一强 token。

patterns.name: 常见功能词或局部格式碎片
patterns.context: 散见于各段，未形成稳定的词义、句法位置或跨领域触发模式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and genres: they commonly occur in Virginia proper names split across tokens, and also respond to Japanese 「即時」, French 「plusieurs」, English 「no way」, and local strings such as Velocette and Spanish 「aún」; no unified semantic or grammatical function is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-split fragment in the string Virginia
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in the place name or proper name Virginia split across tokens; capitalization, word boundaries, and neighboring letters vary.
patterns.domain: Book titles, author names, legal texts, television program descriptions

patterns.name: Japanese 「即時」 in an instant-payment expression
patterns.context: The Japanese sentence discusses a PayPal account, updates, and payment notifications.

patterns.name: Fragment in French 「plusieurs」
patterns.context: Occurs in 「de plusieurs États membres」, meaning multiple member states.

patterns.name: English negative idiom “no way”
patterns.context: Occurs as a fixed expression; one instance emphasizes that something does not imply another, and another expresses surprise or a negative response.

patterns.name: Motorcycle name in a racing biography
patterns.context: Occurs in a motorcycle-racing biography and refers to the Velocette motorcycle brand.

patterns.name: Spanish 「aún」
patterns.context: Occurs in a Spanish sentence discussing visits to a running page.

3_1236.description: 激活分散在多种语言和文体中：常见于跨 token 切分的 Virginia 专名，也响应日语「即時」、法语「plusieurs」、英语「no way」，以及 Velocette 和西语「aún」等局部字符串；未见统一语义或语法功能。

patterns.name: Virginia 字符串中的分词片段
patterns.context: 触发点位于跨 token 切分的地名或专名 Virginia 中；大小写、词边界及前后字母不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 书籍标题、人物署名、法律文本、电视节目介绍

patterns.name: 日语「即時」的即时支付表述
patterns.context: 日文句子谈及 PayPal 账户、更新及支付通知。
patterns.domain: 日语问答或技术支持文本

patterns.name: 法语「plusieurs」中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在「de plusieurs États membres」中，表示多个成员国。
patterns.domain: 法语欧洲议会政策文本

patterns.name: 英语否定习语「no way」
patterns.context: 作为固定表达出现；一处用于强调不代表某事，另一处用于惊讶或否定回应。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件免责声明、网络论坛对话

patterns.name: 赛车手传记中的车名
patterns.context: 出现在摩托车竞赛传记中，指 Velocette 摩托车品牌。

patterns.name: 西班牙语「aún」
patterns.context: 出现在谈论 running 页面访问量的西班牙语句子中。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语网页或社交文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual subword fragments, proper nouns, numbers, and time expressions. A few English samples contain “it depends” or “That is to say,” and another contains a French modal expression. Overall, there is no consistent semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Final fragments of words or subwords
patterns.context: Activations land on fragments of words or proper nouns in multilingual text, often involving cross-language scripts, proper nouns, or subword segmentation; there is no stable, shared lexical or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed Russian, Japanese, English, French, and other corpora; entries 1–10

patterns.name: say in explanatory or reported-speech expressions
patterns.context: Appears in English expository text in expressions that report, explain, or introduce a conditional clarification; however, activations in other entries do not all correspond to this expression.
patterns.domain: Patent technical texts and StackExchange Q&A

patterns.name: Numbers and time or ratio expressions
patterns.context: Activations appear near numbers, ratios, or time measurements, but the instances are sporadic and show no consistent numeric-format pattern.

patterns.name: Consecutive subword fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Strong activations appear within personal names, place names, or work-related proper nouns; fragment boundaries and strengths vary, so they cannot be attributed to a specific class of proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Satirical comments, game entries, and film/TV plot summaries

patterns.name: Time or period words
patterns.context: Activations appear in references to temperature conditions, early-morning periods, or instant payments; the semantic range is broad, suggesting possible responses to local subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, schedule announcements, and Japanese payment instructions

patterns.name: French subjunctive and modal expression
patterns.context: Appears in the French phrase “J’aurais bien entendu souhaité que …” as part of a polite, hypothetical, or desiderative expression; observed only once.

3_1236.description: 激活分散于多语种词片段、专名、数字和时间表达中；少数英语样本含“it depends”或“That is to say”，另有法语情态词。整体缺少统一语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 词或子词的末尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多语言文本中词语或专名的片段上，常见于跨语言书写、专名或子词切分；没有稳定的统一词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 俄语、日语、英语、法语等混合语料；编号 1–10

patterns.name: 说明、转述表达中的 say
patterns.trigger: «say»9，见“That is to say”与“it depends, at …”
patterns.context: 在英语说明性文本中出现在转述、解释或引出条件说明的表达里；但其他段的激活并不都对应此表达。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本与 StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 数字及时间、比例表达
patterns.context: 数字、比例或时间量度附近可见激活，但实例零散，未显示一致的数字格式规律。
patterns.domain: 新闻/日程、专利和技术问答

patterns.name: 专名中的连续词片段
patterns.context: 人名、地名或作品相关专名中出现较强激活；片段边界和强度不一致，不能归纳为特定类别的专名。
patterns.domain: 讽刺评论、游戏条目、影视剧情简介

patterns.name: 时间或时段词
patterns.context: 涉及温度条件、清晨时段或即时支付时出现激活；语义跨度较大，可能只是局部词片段反应。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、日程公告、日语支付说明

patterns.name: 法语虚拟式及情态表达
patterns.context: 出现在法语“J’aurais bien entendu souhaité que …”中，是礼貌、假设或愿望表达的一部分；仅见一次。

en.description: Activations occur on intra-word fragments in French, Russian, Greek, and English, often splitting stems, suffixes, or proper names; they also appear in paths and numbers. They occur across languages and genres, with sensitivity to local subword fragments as their main commonality.

patterns.name: Fragments within French words
patterns.context: Activation falls on one or more internal subword fragments of French words, often involving stems or affixes; ordinary French syntax surrounds them.

patterns.name: Fragments within Russian words
patterns.context: Activation falls on contiguous or split fragments inside Cyrillic Russian words, especially endings or internal syllables; embedded in Russian sentences.

patterns.name: Fragments within Greek words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within Greek-script words, including initial, medial, and final positions; surrounded by Greek syntax.

patterns.name: English intra-word fragments and proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on internal fragments of English words or proper names, often involving mixed capitalization, word boundaries, or proper-name spelling; also occurs in paths, names, and legal entity names.
patterns.domain: English news, encyclopedias, forums, code errors, and legal texts

patterns.name: Numeric or identifier fragments
patterns.context: Occurs when numbers are embedded in file paths or citations; the available context is insufficient to determine a specific numeric-format condition.

3_1236.description: 激活散布于法语、俄语、希腊语及英语的词内片段，常切分词干、词尾或专名；也出现在路径和编号中。跨语言、跨文体均见，主要共同点是对局部子词片段敏感。

patterns.name: 法语词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在法语词的一个或多个内部子词片段上，常涉及词干或词缀；周围有普通法语句法。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西里尔字母俄语词内部的连续或分段片段上，尤其是词尾或词内音节；嵌在俄语句子中。

patterns.name: 希腊语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在希腊字母词语内部的片段上，包含词首、词中和词尾；周围是希腊语句法。

patterns.name: 英文词内片段及专名
patterns.context: 激活出现在英语词或专名的内部片段上，常与大小写混合、词界或专名拼写有关；也见于路径、姓名和法律实体名称。
patterns.domain: 英语新闻、百科、论坛、代码错误和法律文本

patterns.name: 数字或编号片段
patterns.context: 数字嵌在文件路径或引用信息中时出现；现有上下文不足以确定具体数字格式条件。
patterns.domain: 代码错误信息及参考文献

en.description: Strong activations span multiple languages and genres: French parliamentary text favors «plus», «de», and within-word fragments; the rest are sporadically found in Python tracebacks, Chinese comments, biographies, court decisions, news line breaks, C/C++ identifiers, and Russian word fragments, with no shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: French « plus » and following expressions
patterns.context: Appears in French sentences as « plus », followed by an element indicating quantity, degree, or time; tokenization may cross word-internal boundaries.

patterns.name: French « de » within words or at word boundaries
patterns.context: The French preposition or article « de » appears before institutions, sources, or noun phrases; in this batch it often occurs in the same passage as « plus ».

patterns.name: French within-word segmentation and morphological fragments
patterns.context: When French words are split into subwords, activations occur on roots, affixes, or endings; these may also be adjacent to common function words in the sentence.

patterns.name: Python traceback and thread-start symbols
patterns.context: In a Python 2.7 thread exception traceback involving shutdown, threading.py, and the bootstrap function.

patterns.name: Loader state in Chinese code comments
patterns.context: A code comment explains loader state values and their meanings; activations concentrate on words related to “startup.”
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and Chinese comments

patterns.name: Names and birth-information format
patterns.context: An encyclopedia biography entry begins with a person's name, followed by their birth date and birthplace.

patterns.name: U.S. federal appellate decision formatting
patterns.context: Formatted sections of a decision, such as the source of the appeal, circuit court judge listings, and the opinion author’s signature.

patterns.name: Line breaks and headline structure in news titles
patterns.context: Begins with a line break, followed by a news headline and link; the headline discusses a former CIA director’s response to a leak.

patterns.name: C/C++ Android function identifiers and code separators
patterns.context: A C/C++ declaration or comment block for an Android display-information function, containing macros, function names, and asterisk separator lines.

patterns.name: Within-word morphological fragments in Russian
patterns.context: A word in a Russian sentence is split into subwords, with activation on a within-word fragment; the text discusses initializing something to an empty object.

3_1236.concept: 多语言子词与格式片段
3_1236.description: 强激活跨多种语言与文体：法语议会文本偏向 «plus»、«de» 及词内片段；其余零散落在 Python 回溯、中文注释、传记、判决、新闻换行、C/C++ 标识符和俄语词片段，未见统一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 法语 « plus » 及其后续表达
patterns.context: 法语句子中出现 « plus »，后接表示数量、程度或时间的成分；分词标记可能跨越词内边界。

patterns.name: 法语词内/词边界的 « de »
patterns.context: 法语介词或冠词 « de » 出现在机构、来源或名词短语前；本批数据中常与 « plus » 同段出现。

patterns.name: 法语词内切分及形态片段
patterns.context: 法语词被切分成子词时，词根、词缀或词尾片段有激活；也可能与句中常见功能词相邻。

patterns.name: Python traceback 与线程启动符号
patterns.context: Python 2.7 线程异常回溯中，涉及 shutdown、threading.py 和 bootstrap 函数。

patterns.name: 中文代码注释中的加载器状态
patterns.context: 代码注释说明加载器的状态值及其含义，激活集中在“启动”相关字词。

patterns.name: 人物姓名与出生资料格式
patterns.context: 百科人物条目以姓名开头，随后给出出生日期和出生地。

patterns.name: 美国联邦上诉判决版式
patterns.context: 判决文本的上诉来源、巡回法院法官列名及意见作者署名等格式化部分。

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的换行与标题结构
patterns.context: 以换行开头，随后是新闻标题及链接；标题谈论前 CIA 局长对泄密事件的回应。

patterns.name: C/C++ Android 函数标识符与代码分隔
patterns.context: Android 显示器信息函数的 C/C++ 声明或注释块，包含宏、函数名和星号分隔线。

patterns.name: 俄语词内形态片段
patterns.context: 俄语句子中的词被切分为子词，激活落在词内片段；文本讨论将某物初始化为空对象。

en.description: Activations are distributed across languages and genres: premier and parliamentary terminology in French parliamentary text; the place name North Carolina; code identifiers and credited names; news domains and an internal fragment of dozen. No single obvious semantic pattern explains them all.

patterns.name: French « premier » related
patterns.context: Appears in «premier semestre 2004» (entry 2) and «du premier point de notre séance» (entry 6); the trigger span may involve segmented French tokens.

patterns.name: French parliamentary and administrative terminology
patterns.context: Appears in formal political and administrative contexts involving parliamentary reports, meeting agendas, committees, or the European Council; this group also includes references to funds and resources.

patterns.name: Carolina in place names
patterns.context: The place name ends with North Carolina; the preceding text describes a church location and an institutional address in a legal document, respectively.

patterns.name: drv/DR in code identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in Android driver-related C/C++ identifiers or comments, with activation on short fragments within identifiers.

patterns.name: Name fragments in software credits
patterns.context: Activation falls within a person’s name in the arguments to the CREDIT_LINE macro, rather than on the macro name itself.
patterns.domain: Github software metadata or copyright-credit code

patterns.name: Link-domain fragment in a news headline
patterns.context: Falls within the domain MuckRock in a HackerNews headline and URL.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of the quantity word dozen
patterns.context: Occurs in “about a half-dozen bodyguards,” meaning approximately six bodyguards.

3_1236.description: 激活分布在多种语言和文体中：法语议会文本中的 premier、议会术语；North Carolina 地名；代码标识符及致谢人名；新闻域名和 dozen 的内部片段。无法由单一明显语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 法语「premier」相关
patterns.context: 出现在 «premier semestre 2004»（第2段）和 «du premier point de notre séance»（第6段）中；触发跨度可能涉及被拆分标记的法语词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会法语发言记录

patterns.name: 法语议会及行政术语
patterns.context: 出现在议会报告、会议议程、委员会或欧洲理事会等正式政治行政语境；本组中另有基金和资源相关表述。

patterns.name: 地点名称中的 Carolina
patterns.context: 地名以 North Carolina 收尾；前文分别为教堂所在地和法律文书中的机构地址。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 drv/DR
patterns.context: 出现在 Android 驱动相关 C/C++ 标识符或注释中，激活落在标识符内部的短片段。

patterns.name: 软件致谢名单中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 CREDIT_LINE 宏参数中的人名内部，而非宏名本身。
patterns.domain: Github 软件元数据或版权致谢代码

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的链接域名片段
patterns.context: 落在 HackerNews 标题及 URL 中的域名 MuckRock 内部。

patterns.name: 数量词 dozen 的内部片段
patterns.context: 位于 about a half-dozen bodyguards 中，表达约六名保镖。

en.description: Activations occur in French parliamentary text, build configurations and source code, system/hardware terminology, medical abstracts, and event announcements; rare proper names also appear, with no obvious common semantic signal.

patterns.name: Rare place names and proper names
patterns.context: Narrates an Italian concert promoter’s expansion and jokes about the North Korean capital and Dennis Rodman

patterns.name: Configuration script options
patterns.context: Environment variables and GNU configure argument lists

patterns.name: French parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Formal French speech and agenda descriptions, including split French word forms

patterns.name: Build command in a Ruby recipe
patterns.context: A Homebrew-style recipe defines dependencies and runs a configuration command

patterns.name: Event dates and ordinal years
patterns.context: Dates and years of event editions in an event update

patterns.name: Linux CPU performance fields
patterns.context: Comments explain differences between target and actual frequency and refer to processor registers

patterns.name: Auditory research terminology
patterns.context: Studies cochlear nerve responses after noise exposure and mentions 500 Hz

patterns.name: Android C graphics code
patterns.context: C-style function declarations, comment separators, and Android graphics device identifiers

3_1236.description: 激活分布于法语议会文字、构建配置与源码、系统/硬件术语、医学摘要及活动公告，也见罕见专名；共同语义线索不明显。

patterns.name: 罕见地名与专名
patterns.context: 叙述意大利演出经纪人扩张，并以朝鲜首都和 Dennis Rodman 作笑谈

patterns.name: 配置脚本选项
patterns.context: 环境变量及 GNU configure 参数列表

patterns.name: 法语议会发言
patterns.context: 法语正式发言及议程叙述，包含拆分的法语词形

patterns.name: Ruby 配方中的构建命令
patterns.context: Homebrew 风格配方定义依赖并运行配置命令

patterns.name: 活动日期与序数年份
patterns.context: 活动更新中的日期和活动举办年数
patterns.domain: 能源行业邮件/活动公告

patterns.name: Linux CPU 性能字段
patterns.context: 注释解释目标与实际频率差异及处理器寄存器

patterns.name: 听觉研究术语
patterns.context: 研究噪声暴露后耳蜗神经反应，提及 500 Hz

patterns.name: Android C 图形代码
patterns.context: C 风格函数声明、注释分隔线及 Android 图形设备标识符

en.description: Activations are scattered across rare subword fragments: birth dates in biographies, code structures and hardware identifiers, technical abbreviations, and segmented proper nouns and terms. Series-article ordinals and wording expressing legal doubt also occur; no single semantic pattern covers all examples.

patterns.name: Dates and numeric birth information
patterns.context: Biographical text uses a “born on/birth date” format, with the date and location appearing consecutively.

patterns.name: Structures and identifiers in technical code
patterns.context: Near function declarations, variables, or hardware register names in C/C++ code; also includes code structures such as parentheses, braces, and comment delimiters.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and hardware/frequency terminology
patterns.context: Abbreviations, numbers, and technical terms occur together in descriptions of CPU frequency, registers, or experimental acoustic parameters.
patterns.domain: Systems software documentation; medical experiment abstracts

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Pyongyang
patterns.context: The proper noun Pyongyang is split into subwords, appearing in humorous news context involving North Korea, Rodman, and related topics.

patterns.name: Ordinal/quantity phrase
patterns.context: An introduction describes the structure of a series of articles as “the first article (of two).”

patterns.name: Expression of dissent in legal argument
patterns.context: In a formal legal context, the phrase “state of dubiety” expresses doubt about the purpose of an investigation.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation in proper nouns
patterns.context: An author’s name or theoretical proper noun in a mathematical physics text is segmented; it occurs alongside terms such as self-dual and connection.

patterns.name: Unclear local word fragments and punctuation
patterns.context: Subword fragments in the opening title and within terms in an abstract; the available context is insufficient to establish a stable connection to other patterns.

3_1236.concept: 词片段与结构标记检测
3_1236.description: 激活分散于多种稀有词片段：人物传记的出生日期、代码结构与硬件标识、技术缩写，以及被切分的专名和术语。另见系列文章序数和法律疑虑措辞；无单一语义模式覆盖全部例子。

patterns.name: 日期与数字化出生信息
patterns.context: 人物传记中按“出生于/出生日期”格式叙述，日期和地点连续出现。

patterns.name: 技术代码中的结构与标识符
patterns.context: C/C++ 代码片段中，函数声明、变量或硬件寄存器名称附近；也包括括号、花括号、注释分隔符等代码结构。

patterns.name: 缩写及硬件/频率术语
patterns.context: 描述 CPU 频率、寄存器或实验声学参数时，缩写、数字和技术术语相邻出现。
patterns.domain: 系统软件说明；医学实验摘要

patterns.name: 词内片段 Pyongyang
patterns.context: 专名 Pyongyang 被拆分成子词片段，出现在带有朝鲜、Rodman 等内容的幽默新闻语境。

patterns.name: 序数/数量短语
patterns.context: 文章导言中以“第一篇（共两篇）”说明系列文章结构。

patterns.name: 法律论述中的异议表述
patterns.context: 正式法律语境中，短语“state of dubiety”表达对调查目的的疑虑。

patterns.name: 专名的子词切分
patterns.context: 数学物理文本中的作者姓名或理论专名被切分；与 self-dual 和连接等术语同现。

patterns.name: 未明的局部词片段与标点
patterns.context: 摘要开头标题及术语内部的子词片段；现有上下文不足以确认它们与其他模式有稳定联系。

en.description: Activations are varied: months and dates, ordinal or quantity expressions stand out, and code comments/declarations, proper nouns, and tokenized word fragments also occur. These cues coexist across domains and cannot be fully explained by a single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Month names in dates
patterns.context: Dates consist of a day, month, and year; the month names August or June activate most strongly. Numbers in dates are also often marked, but more weakly or with variation by subword fragment.
patterns.domain: Biographies, sports entries, and histories of religious institutions

patterns.name: Date numbers and years
patterns.context: Occurs in birth dates, founding dates, or historical dates; entry 3’s « June»2 « 10»4«,»3 « 1953»2 also follows a date pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinal and ranking language
patterns.context: Marks sequence or precedence before a noun; temporary threshold shift also occurs in a scientific context, without forming a consistent phrase pattern.
patterns.domain: Abstracts, sports entries, aircraft descriptions, and scientific abstracts

patterns.name: Letters or fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations fall on parts of entity names or code identifiers, spanning place names, code types, and tokenization boundaries, making it difficult to assign them to one lexical class.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, code, news commentary, and scientific abstracts

patterns.name: Code comments and function declaration format
patterns.context: Appears near comment delimiters and function declarations in C/C++-style code; activations also cover function return types.

patterns.name: Quantity or range expressions
patterns.context: Numbers, quantity words, or ranges occur near nouns, years, or measurement descriptions; the examples are not consistent in meaning or form.
patterns.domain: Scientific abstracts, news, sports entries, and commentary

patterns.name: Incomplete or local word-fragment activations
patterns.context: Activations cover word fragments split by tokenization, with no stable lexical meaning or contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Scientific abstracts, commentary, and encyclopedia entries

3_1236.concept: 日期与结构化文本线索
3_1236.description: 激活分布较杂：突出月份与日期、序数或数量表达，也出现代码注释/声明、专名和分词词片；这些线索跨领域共存，无法由单一稳定语义充分解释。

patterns.name: 日期中的月份名称
patterns.context: 日期由日、月份和年份构成，月份名称 August 或 June 激活最明显；日期中的数字也常被标记，但强度较弱或因词片而异。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、体育条目、宗教机构历史

patterns.name: 日期数字及年份
patterns.context: 出现在出生日期、成立日期或历史日期中；第3段的« June»2 « 10»4«,»3 « 1953»2也符合日期模式。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式传记与历史条目

patterns.name: 序数与排名措辞
patterns.trigger: « first»1« of»10；« first»4« of»9；« third»1；« temporary»1 « threshold shift»1
patterns.context: 在名词前标示序列位置或先后关系；另有科学语境中的 temporary threshold shift，未形成一致词组规律。
patterns.domain: 摘要、体育赛事条目、航空器介绍及科学摘要

patterns.name: 专名中的字母或词片
patterns.context: 激活落在实体名称或代码标识的一部分，跨越地名、代码类型和分词边界，难以归为同一词汇类。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、代码、新闻评论、科学摘要

patterns.name: 代码注释与函数声明格式
patterns.context: C/C++风格代码中，注释分隔符和函数声明附近出现；整体激活也覆盖函数返回类型。

patterns.name: 数量或范围表达
patterns.context: 数字、数量词或区间出现在名词、年份或测量描述附近；各例语义和形式不统一。
patterns.domain: 科学摘要、新闻、体育条目、评论

patterns.name: 残缺或局部词片激活
patterns.context: 激活覆盖被分词切开的词片，未显示稳定的词义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 科学摘要、评论、百科条目

en.concept: Initial-item marking and several heterogeneous word forms
en.description: Primarily responds to the phrase “first of,” which marks the first item in a set; other independent triggers include code width/type fragments, the real-estate directional term “northernmost,” and the acoustic term “octave-band.”

patterns.name: Ordinal “first of”
patterns.context: Used in prose to introduce the first item in a set of articles, questions, competitions, objects, or projects; often followed by a quantity or category.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including academic abstracts, encyclopedias, forums, and newsletters

patterns.name: Type and width markers in code
patterns.context: Part of a type or field name in C-style hardware or driver code, near function declarations, register information, or structures.

patterns.name: Boundary word in legal real-estate descriptions
patterns.context: Indicates the northernmost part when describing a parcel’s orientation, area, boundaries, or ownership.

patterns.name: “octave-band” in a noise-type term
patterns.context: Used with noise exposure, center frequency, and auditory experiment parameters to form a frequency-band type term.

3_1236.concept: 首项标示及若干异质词形
3_1236.description: 主要响应短语“first of”，用于标示一组内容中的首项；另有代码位宽/类型片段、地产方位词“northernmost”和声学术语“octave-band”等独立触发。

patterns.name: 序数词 first of
patterns.context: 正文中用来引出某组文章、问题、赛事、对象或项目的首项；后续常接数量或类别
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、百科、论坛、新闻通讯等多种文体

patterns.name: 代码中的类型与位宽标记
patterns.context: C 风格硬件或驱动代码中，作为类型/字段名的一部分，邻近函数声明、寄存器信息或结构体

patterns.name: 法律地产描述中的边界词
patterns.context: 描述地块方位及面积、边界或所有权时，表示最北端部分

patterns.name: 噪声类型术语中的 octave-band
patterns.context: 与噪声暴露、中心频率及听觉实验参数连用，构成频带类型术语

en.description: Activations are scattered across several formats: first of series expressions, encyclopedia name-and-birth details, legal expressions of doubt, code structures, and music and sports entry titles. Some co-occurrences may arise from text formatting or tokenization and cannot be reduced to one semantic category.

patterns.name: English ordinal first/of collocation
patterns.context: When describing a series of articles, a monthly survey, or a competition, first is followed by of to indicate the first in a series; activation falls on first, of, and nearby tokens.

patterns.name: English names and split intra-word fragments
patterns.context: At the beginning of an encyclopedia biography, a name is split into multiple tokens, then typically repeated after a line break with a birth date. The name forms and marked fragments vary, so a shared triggering substring cannot be determined.

patterns.name: Expression of caution or doubt
patterns.context: In legal argument, state of dubiety expresses doubt; activation falls on state, of, and an intra-word fragment of dubiety.

patterns.name: Structures and numeric literals in code
patterns.context: Closing braces, declaration keywords, and register-information identifiers in C-style code; triggers are scattered, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Album-entry title format
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry begins with a work title, followed by an introduction to the debut studio album and its release information; both the title and descriptive words may be relevant.

patterns.name: Numeric names or identifiers in text
patterns.context: The title and competition year of a sports encyclopedia entry; the other activations in the passage do not show a clear pattern independent of numbers.

3_1236.description: 激活分散于多种格式：first of 系列表达、百科人物名与出生信息、法律疑虑措辞、代码结构，以及音乐和体育条目标题。部分共现可能来自文本格式或分词，无法归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: 英语序数 first/of 搭配
patterns.context: 描述系列文章、每月调查或赛事时，first 后接 of，表示系列中的首个；激活落在 first、of 及附近 token 上。

patterns.name: 英文人名及分词式词内片段
patterns.context: 百科人物条目开头，姓名被分成多个 token，通常换行后重述姓名并附出生日期。姓名字形和所标记片段不完全一致，无法确定共同触发子串。

patterns.name: 审慎或疑虑表达
patterns.context: 法律论述中，state of dubiety 表示产生疑虑；激活落在 state、of 及 dubiety 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构与数字字面量
patterns.context: C 风格代码中的闭合花括号、声明关键词和寄存器信息标识符；触发点分散，缺少明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 专辑条目标题格式
patterns.context: 百科条目以作品名标题开头，随后介绍首张录音室专辑及发行信息；标题和描述词均可能相关。

patterns.name: 文中数字化名称或编号
patterns.context: 赛事百科条目的标题及赛事年份；该段的其余激活未显示清晰、独立于数字的模式。

en.concept: Local detection of subword fragments and numeric forms
en.description: Activations are scattered across segmented proper-name fragments, dates and biographical templates, as well as code identifiers, technical frequency expressions, and sports descriptions; they are difficult to reduce to a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Rodrig(o) character fragment in a proper noun
patterns.context: The person’s name is split into multiple tokens, with the final «o» activating strongly; it appears in lists of historical figures or paper authors.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia lists of people, academic papers

patterns.name: August in dates
patterns.context: Appears in birth dates or sports dates, usually followed by the day and year; related numbers also activate.

patterns.name: Opening format of biographical entries
patterns.context: After the name heading, the person is introduced with birth information and an “is a” sentence; date numbers also activate.

patterns.name: Segmented fragments in proper nouns or titles
patterns.context: Scattered activations appear in titles, band names, and album names, followed by release dates and chart information; no stable shared word form is apparent.

patterns.name: Year and ordinal competition description
patterns.context: Under a competition heading, the text describes an edition of the competition and its ordinal position as an unranked event.

patterns.name: Number of women and lists of people
patterns.context: States the number of women honored in a given year, followed by a list of names.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and numeric constants
patterns.context: Types, structure fields, or hexadecimal constants in C/C++-style code activate after segmentation.

patterns.name: Frequency and measurement-unit expressions
patterns.context: A technical abstract describes frequency, ratios, or measurements spaced by octaves; numeric and unit fragments activate.

patterns.name: Duhem in a name
patterns.context: Appears as part of a philosopher’s name, near the article title and author information.
patterns.domain: Philosophy and history of science papers

patterns.name: Giant in a New Zealand rock band name
patterns.context: Appears in a band name; this fragment occurs only once, with no confirmable independent pattern.

patterns.name: Place-name-like proper noun in an architect’s name
patterns.context: An architect’s name appears in a list of developments in architectural style; activations are scattered across several proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: Granada, a Spanish place name
patterns.context: Appears in a narrative about women honored by the city; it is an apparent exception to name- or date-related triggers.

3_1236.concept: 词片与数字形式的局部检测
3_1236.description: 激活分散于专名拆分片段、日期及人物传记模板，也见于代码标识符、技术频率表达和赛事叙述；难以归结为单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Rodrig(o) 字符片段
patterns.context: 该人名拼写被拆成多个 token，尤其词尾的 «o» 激活强；出现在历史人物名单或论文作者名单中。
patterns.domain: 百科人物名单、学术文章

patterns.name: 日期中的 August
patterns.context: 出现在人物出生日期或赛事日期中，通常后接日、年份；相关数字也有激活。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、体育赛事条目

patterns.name: 人物传记开头格式
patterns.context: 姓名标题后以出生信息和“is a”句式介绍人物；激活也覆盖日期数字。

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的拆分片段
patterns.context: 标题、乐队名和专辑名处出现零散激活，后接发行日期与榜单信息；未见稳定的共同词形。

patterns.name: 年份与序数赛事表述
patterns.context: 赛事标题下描述某届比赛及其作为非排名赛事的序次。

patterns.name: 女性人数与人物名录
patterns.context: 在年份背景下说明获表彰的女性人数，随后列出人物姓名。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与数字常量
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码中，类型名、结构字段或十六进制常量被拆分后出现激活。

patterns.name: 频率与测量单位表达
patterns.context: 技术摘要中描述频率、比值或按倍频程间隔进行的测量，数字与单位分片激活。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Duhem
patterns.context: 作为哲学家姓名的一部分出现，邻近文章题名与作者信息。

patterns.name: 新西兰摇滚乐队名中的 Giant
patterns.context: 出现在乐队名称中；该片段只有一次，缺少可确认的独立规律。

patterns.name: 建筑师姓名中的地名式专名
patterns.context: 建筑师姓名出现在建筑风格演变的列举中；激活分散在若干专名片段。

patterns.name: 西班牙地名 Granada
patterns.context: 出现在城市表彰女性的叙述中，非姓名或日期触发的明显例外。

en.description: Activation locations are scattered: within-word fragments in German, “first of” and “bank of” constructions, date numbers, and several English proper nouns or academic phrases. There is no stable shared trigger across entries, and many highlights may be incidental word fragments.

patterns.name: Within-word suffix in “gleichzeitig”
patterns.context: The German word “gleichzeitig” (“simultaneously”) is segmented, with activation on the internal suffix “zeit”; the context concerns regulatory revision or relations and oppositions in philosophical discussion.

patterns.name: “of” after the ordinal first
patterns.context: In the English phrase “the first of …”, activation concentrates on “of”; it is followed by noun phrases such as issues or articles.

patterns.name: 06 in a date
patterns.context: A year number in a historical biographical account, with activation on the final “06” of the year.

patterns.name: “of” in a geographical phrase
patterns.context: In an English geographical description, the preposition of is followed by the definite article the and a geographical entity.

patterns.name: Atmosphere in a humid-environment description
patterns.context: Activation appears on atmosphere in experimental methods text describing cell culture conditions.

patterns.name: August in a proper-noun date
patterns.context: An English date in album release information; activation occurs after the month.

patterns.name: Random-equation description after a mathematical formula
patterns.context: After a formula, “equation of this type” introduces an explanation of the equation.

patterns.name: Place-name ending in a proper noun
patterns.context: The place name Calabozo in an entry about a Venezuelan parish, with activation on an internal fragment.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia religious and geographical entries

3_1236.description: 激活位置分散：德语词内片段、first of 与 bank of 等of结构、日期数字，以及若干英文专名或学术短语。跨段缺乏稳定的共同触发条件，许多高亮可能是偶然词片段。

patterns.name: “gleichzeitig”词内后缀
patterns.context: 德语词“gleichzeitig”（同时）被拆分标记，激活落在词中后缀“zeit”；上下文涉及法规修订或哲学论述中的关系、对立。
patterns.domain: 德语议会文本、哲学文本

patterns.name: 序数词 first 后的 of
patterns.context: 英语短语“the first of …”中，激活集中在“of”；后接 issues 或 articles 等名词短语。

patterns.name: 日期中的数字 06
patterns.context: 历史人物生平叙述中的年份数字，激活落在年份末尾“06”。

patterns.name: 地理短语中的 of
patterns.context: 英语地理描述中，介词 of 后接定冠词 the 与地理实体名词。

patterns.name: 湿润环境描述中的 atmosphere
patterns.context: 实验方法文本描述细胞培养条件时，激活出现在 atmosphere 一词。

patterns.name: 专名中的 August 日期
patterns.context: 专辑发行信息中的英文日期，激活在月份之后。

patterns.name: 数学公式后的随机方程表述
patterns.context: 公式之后以“equation of this type”引出方程的说明。

patterns.name: 专名中的地名词尾
patterns.context: 委内瑞拉教区条目中的地名 Calabozo，激活落在词内片段。
patterns.domain: 英文百科宗教与地理条目

en.description: The strongest pattern is a within-word fragment of German gleichzeitig; there is also sensitivity to month names and year numbers in English encyclopedia dates. Other scattered activations involve proper nouns, program titles, experimental frequencies, and biomedical terms, with no shared trigger apparent.

patterns.name: Segmentation activations in German “gleichzeitig”
patterns.context: The adverb gleichzeitig occurs in German text discussing regulatory simplification or philosophical relationships; activations concentrate on subword tokens within the word.

patterns.name: Months in English dates
patterns.context: English encyclopedia entries describe album releases, institutional founding, performances, births, or program broadcast dates; month tokens are especially prominent.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia biographies, historical entries, and work entries

patterns.name: Numeric fragments in English years
patterns.context: Years appear as numeric tokens in date expressions in English encyclopedia entries, often immediately after the month or day.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia historical, biographical, and work entries

patterns.name: Experimental stimulus frequency
patterns.context: Frequency is given as a value and Hz unit in an abstract about a noise-exposure experiment.

patterns.name: Rare word fragments in place names
patterns.context: Research sites or communities are listed as proper nouns, with activation on internal fragments of rare place names; this differs from the prominent lexical patterns in other entries.

patterns.name: Fragments in English proper nouns
patterns.context: A Venezuelan place name in an English encyclopedia geography entry, with activation inside the proper noun rather than on a general narrative word.

patterns.name: Numeric word forms in titles
patterns.context: A program title and its broadcast time are mentioned in the text; the same word form varies in capitalization and position, and only some tokens are marked.

patterns.name: Local fragments in audio-domain terminology
patterns.context: An auditory neuroscience abstract describes temporary threshold shift and octave-band noise; the main activation falls on a segmented fragment of octave.

patterns.name: Other cases with no confirmable commonality
patterns.context: An internal fragment of a German word meaning “restricted” in a philosophical context; apart from co-occurring with gleichzeitig in entry 2, there is insufficient evidence to assign it to another pattern.

3_1236.description: 强烈模式是德语 gleichzeitig 的词内片段；另对英文百科日期中的月份、年份数字敏感。其余零散激活涉及专名、节目标题、实验频率及生物医学术语，彼此未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 德语“gleichzeitig”分词激活
patterns.context: 德语文本中出现副词 gleichzeitig，周围谈论简化法规或哲学上的相互关系；激活集中在该词内部的分词 token。
patterns.domain: 德语议会文本、哲学论述

patterns.name: 英文日期中的月份
patterns.context: 英文百科条目叙述专辑发行、机构成立、演出、人物出生或节目播出日期；月份 token 尤其突出。
patterns.domain: 英文百科传记、历史及作品条目

patterns.name: 英文年份中的数字片段
patterns.context: 年份以数字 token 形式出现在英文百科条目的日期表述中，常紧接月份或日期。
patterns.domain: 英文百科历史与人物/作品条目

patterns.name: 实验刺激频率
patterns.context: 噪声暴露实验摘要中，以数值和 Hz 单位给出频率。

patterns.name: 地名中的罕见词片段
patterns.context: 研究地点或社区名称以专名形式列举，激活落在罕见地名的内部片段；该现象与其他段的明显词汇模式不一致。

patterns.name: 英文专名中的片段
patterns.context: 英文百科地理条目中的委内瑞拉地名，激活出现在专名内部，而非一般叙述词。

patterns.name: 标题中的数字化词形
patterns.context: 节目标题及正文提到节目名称或播出时间；同一词形大小写和位置不同，只有部分 token 标记。
patterns.domain: 英文百科电视节目条目

patterns.name: 音频领域术语的局部片段
patterns.context: 听觉神经实验摘要描述暂时性阈移和倍频程带噪声；主要激活落在 octave 的分词片段。

patterns.name: 其余缺乏可确认共性
patterns.context: 德语哲学语境中的“受限制的”一词内部片段；除与第2段的 gleichzeitig 同现外，没有足够证据归入其他模式。

en.description: Across code, encyclopedias, papers, chat, email, and medical abstracts, activations often fall on internal fragments of mixed-case or compound words, and also occur in names, place names, dates, and formatting markers; there is no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Mixed-case identifiers in code
patterns.context: In Objective-C code, camel-case identifiers and type names are split into fragments with different capitalization; activation falls inside or adjacent to identifiers.

patterns.name: Dates and comment formatting in C++ file headers
patterns.context: File-header comments contain fixed-format text such as author, creation date, and copyright year; activation concentrates on date numbers, punctuation, and name fragments.

patterns.name: Mixed-case fragments within place names or proper names
patterns.context: In encyclopedic geography text, place names, organization names, and other proper names are split into mixed-case or intra-word fragments; descriptive terms about places also occur.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments and title formatting in technical text
patterns.context: Academic text contains citation markers, footnotes, Markdown-style section headings, and technical terms; activations are scattered across word fragments and ordinary words.

patterns.name: Username fragments in IRC conversations
patterns.context: Chat logs contain angle-bracketed usernames, informal technical discussion, and URLs; activation falls on fragments within usernames.

patterns.name: Email signatures, forwarding headers, and dates/times
patterns.context: At the boundary between email body text and forwarding/quoted headers, formatted fields include polite expressions, names, dates, and times.

patterns.name: Compound-term tokenization in medical titles
patterns.context: Abstract titles or bodies contain medical or experimental terms made up of multiple morphemes; activation falls on word beginnings or compound fragments.

3_1236.description: 跨代码、百科、论文、聊天、邮件和医学摘要，激活常落在大小写混合或复合词的内部片段，也见于姓名、地名、日期及格式标记；没有单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 代码中的大小写混合标识符
patterns.context: Objective-C 代码中，驼峰式标识符及类型名被拆成不同大小写片段；激活落在标识符内部或相邻位置。

patterns.name: C++ 文件头中的日期与注释格式
patterns.context: 文件头注释中出现作者、创建日期、版权年份等固定格式文本，激活集中在日期数字、标点和名字片段。

patterns.name: 地名或专名内部的大小写片段
patterns.context: 百科地理文字中，地名、机构名等专名被拆成大小写或词内片段；同时出现地点描述词。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的词内片段及标题格式
patterns.context: 学术文本含引用标记、脚注、Markdown 式章节标题及专业术语，激活分散在词片段和普通词上。

patterns.name: IRC 对话中的用户名片段
patterns.context: 聊天记录中有尖括号用户名、口语化技术讨论及 URL；激活落在用户名内部片段。

patterns.name: 邮件署名、转发头及日期时间
patterns.context: 邮件正文与转发/引用头交界处，出现礼貌用语、姓名、日期和时间等格式化字段。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的复合术语分词
patterns.context: 摘要标题或正文中出现由多个词素构成的医学/实验术语，激活落在词首或复合词片段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across different texts: German “gleichzeitig,” numbers and scientific units, proper-name fragments, English of, and code identifiers and symbols. No single semantic pattern covers all corpora.

patterns.name: Within- or between-word fragments of “gleichzeitig”
patterns.context: The complete German word “gleichzeitig” (“simultaneously”) appears, with activation on its segmented subwords; surrounding contexts concern regulatory revision and philosophical relations, respectively.

patterns.name: Numbers, ordinals, and numeric units in ranges
patterns.context: Numbers or numbers next to units, ordinals, ranges, or technical parameters; includes code/API examples and scientific measurement descriptions.
patterns.domain: IRC technical conversation, PubMed scientific abstracts, optical research

patterns.name: Proper nouns and internal proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Personal names, place names, or judges’ names; activations fall on whole proper nouns or subword fragments, but the listed names vary in language and genre.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, IRC conversations, Swedish parliamentary text

patterns.name: “of” in English prepositional phrases
patterns.context: The preposition of introduces a possessive, constituent, or associated element in English noun phrases; one concerns a paper topic, and another experimental stimulus parameters.

patterns.name: Types and parameters in Objective-C method signatures
patterns.context: Near an Objective-C button-construction method declaration and call, activations are distributed across type names, parameter identifiers, and syntax symbols.

patterns.name: Closing brace in C code
patterns.context: A static constant array declaration follows near the end of a C-style function body; the same code fragment also contains bitwise operations and hexadecimal constants.

3_1236.description: 激活分散在多种文本中：德语“gleichzeitig”、数字与科学单位、专名片段、英文of，以及代码中的标识符和符号。没有覆盖所有语料的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 词内或词间“gleichzeitig”片段
patterns.context: 德语中出现完整词“gleichzeitig”（同时），激活落在词的分段子词上；周边分别涉及法规修订和哲学关系。
patterns.domain: 德语议会文本、哲学论述

patterns.name: 数字、序数与范围中的数字单位
patterns.context: 数字或数字与单位、序数、范围、技术参数相邻；包括代码/API 示例及科学测量描述。
patterns.domain: IRC 技术交流、PubMed 科学摘要、光学研究

patterns.name: 专名及专名内部片段
patterns.context: 人名、地名或法院法官姓名；激活落在专名的完整词或子词片段上，但所列专名与语种和文体不一致。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、IRC 对话、瑞典语议会文本

patterns.name: 英文介词短语中的 of
patterns.context: 英文名词短语中介词 of 引出所属、组成或关联成分；一个是文章主题，一个是实验刺激参数。

patterns.name: Objective-C 方法签名中的类型和参数
patterns.context: Objective-C 按钮构造方法声明与调用附近，激活分布于类型名、参数标识符和语法符号。

patterns.name: C 代码中的闭合花括号
patterns.context: C 风格函数体结束后，附近紧接静态常量数组声明；同一代码片段还出现位运算和十六进制常量。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across intra-word fragments, common short words, names, numbers, and code markers; “ave” recurs in both acoustic terminology and a personal name, while “of” recurs in two academic passages. Most other triggers are sporadic.

patterns.name: “ave” substring
patterns.context: The substring occurs inside words; there is no obvious shared syntactic or semantic condition
patterns.domain: Acoustic terminology in PubMed abstracts, and a name/code discussion in IRC

patterns.name: “o” fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the Italian word “quello” and the English fragment “prem-oistened”; the languages and contexts differ

patterns.name: “of” and following words
patterns.context: Both occur in English noun phrases, commonly in the structure “first of …”; however, the other activated words differ

patterns.name: Local fragments in names
patterns.context: A list of judges’ names in a legal document; activation falls on capitalized name fragments

patterns.name: XML/numbers and markup fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in Android XML code and attribute values

patterns.name: Date and time number fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in email header timestamps

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Each occurs in only one passage; no stable shared lexical, syntactic, or formatting condition is evident

3_1236.description: 强激活分散于词内片段、常见短词、姓名、数字及代码标记；“ave”跨声学术语与人名重复出现，“of”也在两段学术叙述中重复，其余多为零散触发。

patterns.name: “ave”子串
patterns.context: 该子串出现在词内部；没有明显统一的句法或语义条件
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的声学术语，以及 IRC 中的人名/代码讨论

patterns.name: “o”片段
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语词“quello”及英语片段“prem-oistened”中；两处语言和上下文不同
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学文本、清洁产品讨论

patterns.name: “of”及其后续词
patterns.context: 均处于英语名词短语中，常见结构为“first of …”；但其他激活词并不相同

patterns.name: 姓名中的局部片段
patterns.context: 法律文书的法官姓名列表；激活落在大写姓名片段

patterns.name: XML/数字与标记片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Android XML 代码和属性值中

patterns.name: 日期与时间数字片段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头的日期时间戳中

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 各自只在单段中出现，未见稳定共同的词义、句法或格式条件

en.concept: Dialysis subword fragments and common-word responses
en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the dialysis fragment in medical contexts related to dialysis; also responds to often, adverbs, and high-frequency function words across different genres, as well as XML tags and several isolated domain-specific words. Local triggers vary across segments, with no single semantic pattern covering all activations.

patterns.name: Dialysis- and kidney-disease-related terms
patterns.context: Dialysis, kidney disease, and related treatments or patient descriptions appear in medical text; several prominent activations fall on the suffix fragment in hemodialysis

patterns.name: Contextual use of often
patterns.context: Often is followed by a verb or participle to describe something common or frequent; not limited to a single topic

patterns.name: Adverbial use of primarily
patterns.context: Placed before a verb to indicate that an intervention is mainly aimed at early use

patterns.name: XML string resource tags
patterns.context: Android-style XML string resource entries, with attributes and values tokenized

patterns.name: High-frequency function words and local collocations
patterns.context: Function words such as prepositions and conjunctions in cross-topic text; responses may depend on local collocations or common phrases

patterns.name: Other sporadic domain-specific vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving poisoning symptoms, theoretical modeling, and espionage, respectively; apart from highlighted words, no stable shared trigger is evident

3_1742.concept: 透析词片段及常见词响应
3_1742.description: 主要对透析相关医学语境中的 dialysis 片段强烈响应；另在不同文体中响应 often、副词及高频功能词，并出现 XML 标记和若干孤立领域词。各段局部触发多样，未见单一语义模式覆盖全部激活。

patterns.name: 透析及肾病相关术语
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现透析、肾病及相关治疗或患者描述；多处显著激活落在 hemodialysis 的后缀片段

patterns.name: often 的上下文用法
patterns.context: often 后接动词或分词，描述某事常见或经常发生；不受单一主题限制

patterns.name: primarily 的副词用法
patterns.context: 置于动词前，说明干预措施主要针对早期使用

patterns.name: XML 字符串资源标记
patterns.context: Android 风格 XML 字符串资源条目，属性和值被分词标记

patterns.name: 高频功能词及其局部搭配
patterns.context: 跨主题文本中的介词、连词等功能词，似乎依赖局部搭配或常见短语

patterns.name: 其他零散领域词汇
patterns.context: 分别处于中毒症状、理论建模和间谍活动语境；除高亮词外未见稳定共同触发条件

en.concept: Dialysis terminology and diverse text fragments
en.description: Responds primarily to hemodialysis and related dialysis contexts in medical text; also activates on often in statements across domains, XML strings, physical modeling, intervention limitations, symptom lists, and espionage text, with no consistent pattern.

patterns.name: Hemodialysis terminology
patterns.context: Medical text containing hemodialysis, haemodialysis, or related treatment descriptions; also «micro»…«d»…«ialysis»10
patterns.domain: Nephrology, clinical research, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Discussion following often
patterns.context: often appears in general statements, followed by an explanation of common situations or practices

patterns.name: Software localization XML strings
patterns.context: XML string resource entries, including attributes and values

patterns.name: Target populations and intervention limitations
patterns.context: Discussion of the goals, implementation scope, or insufficient coverage of preventive interventions

patterns.name: Physical modeling and thermodynamic potentials
patterns.context: Discussion of modeling driven systems and equilibrium or nonequilibrium thermodynamic potentials

patterns.name: Poisoning symptom lists
patterns.context: Lists of symptoms and onset times following exposure to toxic agents

patterns.name: Economic and industrial espionage
patterns.context: Distinguishes government-led economic espionage from industrial espionage between companies

patterns.name: Local high-frequency word fragments
patterns.context: Token fragments within descriptions of kidney failure or drug names; no evidence sufficient to establish an independent trigger

3_1742.concept: 透析术语及多类文本片段
3_1742.description: 主要强响应于医学文本中的 hemodialysis 及相关透析语境；另在多领域陈述中的 often、XML 字符串、物理建模、干预局限、症状列表和间谍活动文本中激活，模式并不统一。

patterns.name: 血液透析术语
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现 hemodialysis、haemodialysis 或相关治疗描述；另有 «micro»…«d»…«ialysis»10
