patterns.trigger: «unaware» of its annual expenditures；«unaware» «of» the many hidden benefits
patterns.context: 机构或公众不知道未显明的支出或潜在利益。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生经济、法律营销类网络文本

patterns.name: 未观察到天文现象
patterns.context: 现象发生时，潜在观察者因天气等条件未能察觉。

patterns.name: 未解释的激活
patterns.context: 该段未出现 unaware 或明显的未察觉/无知语义触发，激活集中在人物名、换行及描述词上。

en.concept: Lack of awareness and failure to notice
en.description: Primarily activates on unaware and contexts of negated awareness, covering lack of awareness of disease, knowledge gaps, stimuli, astronomical phenomena, technical requirements, and business costs; there are weaker activations on words related to knowledge, information, unconsciousness, and visual attention. The Finnish fragment is difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Explicit unawareness or lack of knowledge
patterns.context: Describes a person or group that does not know something, fails to notice a stimulus, or is unaware of their own knowledge gap; usually followed by of or regarding, or directly by an object.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, psychology and vision research, encyclopedias, technical and business explanations

patterns.name: Less salient cognition/knowledge-related words
patterns.context: Adjacent to knowing, knowledge, information, or states of awareness, often in contexts contrasting “thinking one knows” with actually not knowing, or describing unconscious learning; may be related to the unaware pattern, but the trigger words differ.

patterns.name: Words related to attention or visual anomalies
patterns.context: Describes whether a stimulus is noticed, whether a visual phenomenon occurs, or how neurological symptoms manifest; [3] explicitly says the patient was unaware because they did not attend to the stimulus, and [6] lists inattentional blindness.
patterns.domain: Vision and perception encyclopedias, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Semantically opaque Finnish fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in Finnish parliamentary text, with the marker on a fragment of the word; the surrounding context discusses civilian protection and destruction of ammunition stockpiles, with no clear link to the English awareness pattern.

3_1742.description: 主要对 unaware 及其否定觉察语境激活，涵盖对疾病、知识缺口、刺激、天文现象、技术要求和商业成本的不知情；另对知识、信息、无意识、视觉注意相关词有较弱激活。芬兰语片段难以解释。

patterns.name: 明确的无意识或不知情
patterns.context: 描述个人或群体不知道某事、未觉察刺激，或未意识到自身知识缺口；通常接 of、regarding，或直接接宾语。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、心理学与视觉研究、百科、技术和商业说明

patterns.name: 显著性较低的认知/知识相关词
patterns.context: 与知道、知识、信息或意识状态相邻，常出现在对比“自以为了解”与实际不知情，或无意识学习的语境中；可能与 unaware 模式有关，但触发词并不相同。

patterns.name: 注意力或视觉异常相关词
patterns.context: 描述刺激是否被注意、视觉现象是否出现，或神经症状的表现；其中[3]明确说患者因未注意刺激而 unaware，[6]列举注意盲。
patterns.domain: 视觉与知觉百科、医学摘要

patterns.name: 语义不透明的芬兰语片段
patterns.context: 出现在芬兰语议会文本中，标记落在该词的片段上；附近语境谈平民保护和弹药储备销毁，与英语中的不知情/觉察模式看不出明确联系。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会芬兰语政治文本

en.description: Most passages activate on unaware, indicating that a person or institution is unaware of a fact, risk, or knowledge gap; other patterns include a Finnish intra-word fragment, the contact field CONTACT, and silent describing a street, none of which have a clear semantic link to this pattern.

patterns.name: Unaware as a state or lack of knowledge
patterns.context: Directly describes an individual, group, institution, or government as not knowing a fact, risk, or behavior, or as unaware of its own knowledge gap; often followed by of/regarding.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, public health, neuropsychology, business, law, engineering explanations

patterns.name: Incomplete or tokenized aware
patterns.context: Part of a Finnish word form, adjacent to a context involving “resources/reserves”; it does not convey the English meaning of unaware here.

patterns.name: CONTACT in contact information
patterns.context: An uppercase contact-information field followed by a colon and institutional contact details; activation falls within CONTACT.

patterns.name: Silent state
patterns.context: Describes the quiet, soundless state of a street near a factory; has no apparent connection to the unaware/aware word forms.

3_1742.description: 多数段落激活于 unaware，表示人或机构未意识到某事实、风险或知识缺口；另有芬兰语词内片段、联系方式 CONTACT 和描述街道的 silent，均与该模式缺乏明确语义联系。

patterns.name: unaware 的状态或认知缺失
patterns.context: 直接描述个人、群体、机构或政府不知道某事实、风险、行为或自身知识缺口；常接 of / regarding。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、公共卫生、神经心理、商业、法律、工程说明

patterns.name: 不完整或分词中的 aware
patterns.context: 芬兰语词形的一部分，邻接“资源/储备”一类语境；此处未见英语 unaware 含义。

patterns.name: 联系方式中的 CONTACT
patterns.context: 全大写联系信息字段，后接冒号及机构联系方式；激活落在 CONTACT 的词内。

patterns.name: 静默状态
patterns.context: 描述工厂周边街道安静、无人声的状态；与 unaware / aware 词形无明显联系。

en.concept: Noun phrases at the beginning of titles
en.description: Primarily responds to noun phrases at the beginning of paper titles or abstracts, especially structures like “Study/Utility/process/importance/cause/objective of”; also covers titles of various medical studies, title colons and line breaks, and a few titles about sexual health and vegetarianism, as well as business email salutations.

patterns.name: “of” and its preceding structure in medical paper titles
patterns.context: In noun phrases at the beginning of titles or abstracts, especially when of introduces the study subject, cause, or objective; stronger activations center on “of” and the immediately adjacent structure

patterns.name: “Study” in research titles
patterns.context: Title-like expressions at the beginning of a sentence, with of followed by the research topic

patterns.name: Colon and line break in abstract titles
patterns.context: A line break after a title, or a subtitle introduced by a colon

patterns.name: Specific terms and topic words in medical research
patterns.context: Specialty topic words in biomedical titles or abstracts; topics differ across examples, with no single shared term

patterns.name: Sexual behavior research titles
patterns.context: Titles describing sexual behavior and its determinants among unmarried young people in Malaysia

patterns.name: Vegetarianism transition research titles
patterns.context: Titles discussing the process of leaving vegetarianism

patterns.name: Email salutation and body introduction
patterns.context: Begins with the recipient’s name followed by a colon, then introduces new material on the next line

3_1777.description: 主要响应论文标题或摘要开头的名词短语，尤其是“Study/Utility/process/importance/cause/objective of”结构；也覆盖多类医学研究题名、标题冒号换行，以及少量性健康、素食主义题名和商务邮件称呼。

patterns.name: 医学论文标题中的“of”及其前置结构
patterns.trigger: “Study of”“Utility of”“process of”“importance of”“principal cause of”“principal objective of”
patterns.context: 标题或摘要开头的名词短语中，尤其是 of 引出研究对象、原因或目标时；较强激活集中在“of”及紧邻结构
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题与摘要

patterns.name: 研究题名中的“Study”
patterns.context: 句首标题式表达，Study 后接 of 及研究主题

patterns.name: 摘要标题中的冒号与换行
patterns.context: 题名后接换行，或标题以冒号引出副标题

patterns.name: 医学研究中的特定术语与主题词
patterns.trigger: “vitreous potassium”“protein expression”“protein-protein interaction”“human sis/PDGF-β gene”“cancer mortality”“magnetic resonance imaging”“appendicitis”“insulin injection”
patterns.context: 生物医学标题或摘要中的专科主题词；各例主题不同，未见单一共同术语

patterns.name: 性行为研究标题
patterns.context: 标题描述马来西亚未婚青年的性行为及其决定因素

patterns.name: 素食主义转变研究标题
patterns.context: 标题讨论退出素食主义的过程

patterns.name: 邮件称呼与正文引入
patterns.context: 以收件人名字加冒号开头，换行后引入最新材料

en.description: Activations cluster around abstract-style openings in biomedical research text, especially “Study of,” “importance of,” and research-purpose constructions; specific medical terms vary. Also covers titles on sexual behavior research, with no consistent subtopic identified.

patterns.name: Research openings in abstracts
patterns.context: Trigger words often appear at the beginning of biomedical abstracts or research project descriptions, especially nominalized research topics, statements of purpose, or statements of importance; high activations often fall on words such as Study, of, importance, cause, and is.

patterns.name: Topic or purpose complement introduced by of
patterns.context: Across multiple snippets, of follows a title-style opening or noun phrase and introduces a research topic, the subject of importance, a cause, or a research objective; there is no evidence that every ordinary of triggers activation.

patterns.name: Biomedical research terminology
patterns.context: Medical, biological, or clinical research content; specific terms appear only once or a few times each, with no shared narrow topic identified.

patterns.name: Research-purpose constructions
patterns.context: Begins with principal objective of, followed by is and a research intention; similar constructions appear in both passages.

patterns.name: Sexual behavior research title and line break
patterns.context: A title about sexual behavior research among unmarried young people in Malaysia; the colon and end-of-sentence line break are also marked, but there is insufficient evidence to generalize them as an independent, universal trigger rule.

3_1777.concept: 生物医学研究摘要开篇
3_1777.description: 激活集中于生物医学研究文本的摘要式开篇，尤其是“Study of”“importance of”和研究目的句式；具体医学术语各异。另覆盖性行为研究标题，未见统一的细分主题。

patterns.name: 摘要中的研究开篇
patterns.trigger: “Study of”“Our previous studies”“The principal cause”“The importance of”“The principal objective of”“The process of”“Utility of”
patterns.context: 触发词多出现在生物医学摘要或研究项目描述的开头，尤其是名词化研究主题、研究目的或重要性陈述；高激活常落在 Study、of、importance、cause、is 等词上。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: of 引出的主题或目的补语
patterns.context: 在多个片段中，of 位于标题式开头或名词短语之后，引出研究主题、重要性对象、原因或研究目标；并非所有普通 of 都有证据表明会触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与研究描述

patterns.name: 生物医学研究术语
patterns.trigger: “vitreous potassium”“protein expression”“protein-protein interaction”“sis/PDGF-2 gene”“cancer mortality”“magnetic resonance imaging”“insulin injection”
patterns.context: 医学、生物学或临床研究内容；这些具体术语各自只出现一次或少数几次，未见共同的窄主题。

patterns.name: 研究目的句式
patterns.trigger: “The principal objective of these studies is to investigate”“The principal objective of this study is to increase”
patterns.context: 以 principal objective of 开头，随后陈述 is 和研究意图；两段都出现相近句式。

patterns.name: 性行为研究标题及换行
patterns.trigger: “Sexual practices in Malaysia: determinants of sexual intercourse among unmarried youths.”及其后的“↵”
patterns.context: 关于马来西亚未婚青年的性行为研究标题；标点冒号和句末换行也被标记，但没有足够证据将其推广为独立的普遍触发规则。

en.description: Activations cluster around paper- or patent-title-style text, especially nominal research-topic phrases and their relational or introductory constructions, such as “Study of,” “importance of,” and “process of”; other specialized title phrasings also occur.

patterns.name: “Study of” at the start of a title
patterns.context: A title or research heading begins with “Study of,” followed by a research subject or association; this is the strongest shared local pattern.

patterns.name: “importance of” in a title
patterns.context: The noun importance is followed by of, introducing a research subject; occurs within a sentence or title.

patterns.name: “cause of” in a title
patterns.context: The noun cause is followed by of, introducing a cause or subject.

patterns.name: “determinants of” in a title
patterns.context: Determinants is followed by of, introducing a behavior or factor in the study population.
patterns.domain: Public health, sexual behavior research titles

patterns.name: “utility of” in a title
patterns.context: Utility is followed by of, introducing the use of a technology or method.

patterns.name: “process of” in a title
patterns.context: Process is followed by of, introducing a process or behavioral change; used for both quitting vegetarianism and a measurement method.

patterns.name: “interval between” in a title
patterns.context: Time interval is followed by between, describing the time relationship between two events.

patterns.name: “implications of” in a title
patterns.context: Implications is followed by of, introducing the effects or significance of a mutation.

patterns.name: Other high-activation title structures
