patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts: encyclopedias, law, academia, patents, Buddhist introductions, sports reporting

patterns.name: Suffix of miscellaneous
patterns.context: Joins with misc- to form miscellaneous, commonly modifying items, types, expenses, physical systems, and so on, to mean miscellaneous or various types.
patterns.domain: Explanatory texts on law, home repair, physics, patents, education, living expenses, and more

patterns.name: Baseball term miscues
patterns.context: In baseball game narration, refers to batting or fielding errors; one example uses miscues as a verb, another as a noun.

patterns.name: Unrelated local activation
patterns.context: The class name RedeemedCouponCollection in code; the context contains neither miscellaneous nor miscues.

3_1777.description: 主要响应 misc- 词干：涵盖 miscellaneous（杂项、各类）及体育报道中的 miscues（失误）；跨领域出现。另有代码类名局部激活，难以归入主模式。

patterns.name: miscellaneous 词干
patterns.context: 出现在完整单词 miscellaneous 的词干内部，或棒球报道中 miscues 的词干内部；不要求特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：百科、法律、学术、专利、佛教介绍、体育报道

patterns.name: miscellaneous 的后缀
patterns.context: 与 misc- 连成 miscellaneous，常修饰 items、types、expenses、physical systems 等，表达杂项或多种类型。
patterns.domain: 法律、家装维修、物理、专利、教育与生活费用等说明性文本

patterns.name: miscues 棒球用语
patterns.context: 棒球比赛叙述中，指击球失误或防守失误；一例以 miscues 作动词，一例作名词。

patterns.name: 不相关的局部激活
patterns.context: 代码中的类名 RedeemedCouponCollection；上下文没有 miscellaneous 或 miscues。

en.concept: Specific word-final fragments and legal dispute wording
en.description: The most consistent response is to controverted in legal documents, expressing that facts are disputed, especially the word ending “verted”; it also covers litigation phrasing, paper acknowledgment headings, code identifiers, and word-final fragments in confers and communicates in patent/research contexts. The latter categories have unclear links to the main pattern.

patterns.name: controverted in legal texts
patterns.context: In legal arguments or statements of fact, describes whether facts, evidence, or allegations are disputed; activation often centers on the word ending “verted”, and the split spelling “controverted” also appears.

patterns.name: Findings and procedural wording in legal documents
patterns.context: Litigation procedure or court hearing contexts, involving motions, affidavits, parties, and findings of fact; co-occurs with highly activated controverted or appears in adjacent arguments.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and litigation documents

patterns.name: Section heading and acknowledgment marker
patterns.context: An acknowledgments section heading and its Markdown/formatting anchor appearing after the end of a paper appendix.

patterns.name: License terms and software identifiers
patterns.context: A Java package name immediately follows a license comment; strong activation falls on a split identifier fragment and is not obviously the same as the keyword in court opinions.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and license comments

patterns.name: Communication wording in patent specifications
patterns.context: Describes a system communicating with a data processing center to record an employee’s time at a location; activation centers on a word-final fragment of communicates.

patterns.name: confers in biomedicine
patterns.context: Describes a locus conferring resistance to tumor development; activation falls on a word-final fragment of confers.
patterns.domain: NIH biomedical research abstracts or project descriptions

patterns.name: communicates in business information processing
patterns.context: Introduces an information processing system that processes, stores, or transmits business and personal information; activation falls on a word-final fragment of communicates.

3_1777.concept: 特定词尾片段与法律争议措辞
3_1777.description: 最稳定的响应是法律文书中表示事实有争议的 controverted，尤其是词尾“verted”；还覆盖法律诉讼措辞、论文致谢标题、代码标识符，以及专利/科研语境中 confers、communicates 的词尾片段，后几类与主模式联系不明。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 controverted
patterns.context: 在法律论证或事实陈述中，描述事实、证据或指控是否存在争议；重点常落在单词结尾的“verted”，也出现拆分拼写的“controverted”。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的判断与程序措辞
patterns.trigger: « summary»1« judgment»2、« motion»2、« affidavits、« facts、« Court、« plaintiff、« defendant
patterns.context: 诉讼程序或法院审理语境，围绕动议、宣誓书、双方当事人及事实认定；与高激活的 controverted 同现或处于相邻论证中。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判例与诉讼文书

patterns.name: 章节标题与致谢标记
patterns.context: 论文附录结束后出现的致谢章节标题及其 Markdown/排版锚点。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文、文档标记

patterns.name: 许可证条款与软件标识符
patterns.context: 许可证注释之后紧接 Java 包名；强激活落在被拆分的标识符片段，并非显然与法律判例中的关键词相同。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码与许可证注释

patterns.name: 专利说明书中的通信表述
patterns.context: 描述系统与数据处理中心通信，以记录员工在某地点的时间；激活集中在 communicates 的词尾片段。

patterns.name: 生物医学中的 confers
patterns.context: 描述某基因座赋予对肿瘤发展的抗性；激活落在 confers 的词尾片段。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要或项目说明

patterns.name: 商业信息处理中的 communicates
patterns.context: 介绍信息处理系统处理、存储或传递商业及个人信息；激活落在 communicates 的词尾片段。
patterns.domain: 专利背景/信息技术说明

en.description: Activations mainly fall on word-final or word-internal fragments of several English verbs: appease, presented, dismissed, paraphrase, and reconvened. Contexts span news, legal documents, and forum text, with no shared semantic condition identified.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in appease
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal suffix fragment in appease/appeas-; used respectively to appease critics, Iran, and teammates.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in presented
patterns.context: Describes materials or arguments having been submitted in legal opinions; the two passages are nearly identical.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in dismissed
patterns.context: Appears in a court heading or brief disposition format, indicating that a case was dismissed.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in paraphrase
patterns.context: In expressions involving paraphrasing or imitation, activation clusters on the final part of paraphrase; [5] is legal discussion, while [8][9] are forum text.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in reconvened
patterns.context: Describes a city council reconvening in public after a closed session; activation falls on the word-final part of reconvened.

3_1777.concept: 英语动词词内/词尾片段
3_1777.description: 激活主要落在若干英语动词的词尾或词内片段：appease、presented、dismissed、paraphrase、reconvened；语境横跨新闻、法律文书和论坛文本，未见共同语义条件。

patterns.name: appease 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 appease/appeas- 的词内后缀片段；分别用于安抚批评者、伊朗、队友。
patterns.domain: 新闻、政治评论、体育报道

patterns.name: presented 的词尾片段
patterns.context: 法律意见书中描述材料或论据已被提交；两段几乎重复。

patterns.name: dismissed 的词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在法院标题或裁判结果的简短格式中，标示案件被驳回。

patterns.name: paraphrase 的词内片段
patterns.context: 在转述或仿述的表达中，激活集中于 paraphrase 的词尾部分；[5]为法律论述，[8][9]为论坛文字。

patterns.name: reconvened 的词尾片段
patterns.context: 描述市议会闭门会议后重新公开开会，激活落在 reconvened 的词尾。

en.concept: Past tense and procedural narration in legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to the past-tense/past-participle suffix ed in legal opinions and litigation narratives; it also covers adjudicative procedure terms, references to courts and parties, denials and rebuttals, and criminal search facts. There are also sporadic activations on dates, code copyright comments, and technical discussions.

patterns.name: Past participle ed in legal opinions
patterns.context: Activation often falls on the suffix ed, especially in past-tense or past-participle forms describing testimony, responses, evidence submissions, or court findings; in some examples the word stem is also activated.

patterns.name: Numbers in case numbers and dates
patterns.context: Years in legal document titles or date fields in code comments.

patterns.name: Fixed procedural terms in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in court opinion titles, procedural histories, or judicial reasoning.

patterns.name: Entities and litigation relation words in legal texts
patterns.context: Refers to courts, government agencies, parties, or immigration status in legal cases; activations are scattered.
patterns.domain: Judicial opinions, especially state law and immigration cases

patterns.name: Negation or rebuttal expressions
patterns.context: Negates a judicial conclusion, describes a party’s denial, or expresses a rebuttal to evidence; usually in legal argumentation.

patterns.name: Vehicle searches and police encounters
patterns.context: Describes police questioning, vehicle searches, and related testimony.

patterns.name: Code copyright disclaimer
patterns.context: A comment at the top of a code file states that the author waives copyright.

patterns.name: System complexity and manageability
patterns.context: Discusses inadequate manageability as systems scale and quotes Alan Kay.

3_1777.concept: 法律文本中的过去时与程序叙述
3_1777.description: 主要响应法律判决及诉讼叙述中的过去时/过去分词词尾 ed，也覆盖裁判程序词、法院与当事人称谓、否定反驳及刑事搜查事实；另有日期、代码版权注释和技术讨论中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的过去分词 ed
patterns.context: 激活常落在词尾 ed，尤其出现在描述证言、回应、提交证据或法院认定的过去时/过去分词中；部分例子中词根也有激活。

patterns.name: 案件编号与日期中的数字
patterns.context: 法律文书标题中的年份，或代码注释中的日期字段。

patterns.name: 法律文书的固定程序术语
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决标题、程序经过或裁判理由中。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的实体与诉讼关系词
patterns.context: 法律案件中指称法院、政府机构、当事人或移民身份；激活较零散。
patterns.domain: 司法判决，尤其州法与移民案件

patterns.name: 否定或反驳表达
patterns.context: 否定裁判结论、描述当事人的否认，或表达对证据的反驳；通常处于法律论证语境。
patterns.domain: 判决意见、证言与法律论证

patterns.name: 车辆搜查与警察接触
patterns.context: 描述警察询问、搜查车辆及相关证词。

patterns.name: 代码版权免责声明
patterns.context: 代码文件头部以注释声明作者放弃版权。

patterns.name: 系统复杂性与可管理性
patterns.context: 讨论系统规模扩张后可管理性不足，并引述 Alan Kay。

en.description: Activations often fall on internal fragments or near inflectional endings, frequently in legal text involving procedure, participation, and disposition of rights; they also occur in communications, politics, web content, and several sporadic word forms, with no single semantic category accounting for them.

patterns.name: Past-tense or perfect forms at the stem ending
patterns.context: Activations cluster at the boundary between a split word’s stem and inflectional ending; these are often past-tense, present-tense, or -ing verb forms, though the stem and ending are not always separately activated.
patterns.domain: Legal, news, academic texts, and web content

patterns.name: Words involving participation or procedural progress
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts involving participation in a decision, litigation or hearing procedures, testimony, or rebuttal of an argument; not all examples trigger the same word form.
patterns.domain: Primarily legal documents, also philosophical discussion

patterns.name: Waiver or loss of rights/interests
patterns.context: Combines with rights or interests such as parental rights or royalty, indicating voluntary relinquishment or inability to transfer or release the relevant interest.

patterns.name: Editing-, advocacy-, or communication-related terms
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts such as calls for participation, research on communication theory, or political endorsement; the topics are not entirely alike.
patterns.domain: Web promotion, academic papers, news commentary

patterns.name: Other words with clear internal segmentation
patterns.context: Activations fall within names, legal terms, institutional abbreviations, or ordinary plural words; these examples do not support a unified semantic condition.

3_1777.description: 激活多落在词内片段或屈折词尾附近，常见于法律文本中的程序、参与及权利处置用语；也见于传播、政治、网页内容及若干零散词形，无法归结为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 词干结尾的过去式或完成形式
patterns.context: 激活集中在拆分词的词干与屈折词尾交界处；多为动词的过去式、现在式或 -ing 形式，但词干和词尾并不总是分别激活。
patterns.domain: 法律、新闻、学术文本及网页内容

patterns.name: 涉及参与或程序进程的词
patterns.context: 出现在参与某项决定、诉讼或听证程序、作证、反驳论证等行动或程序语境；并非所有例子都触发相同词形。
patterns.domain: 主要为法律文书，另有哲学论述

patterns.name: 放弃或丧失权利／利益
patterns.context: 与 parental rights 或 royalty 等权利、利益搭配，表示自愿放弃或无法转让、释放相关利益。

patterns.name: 编辑、倡议或传播相关用语
patterns.context: 出现在号召参与、研究传播理论或政治背书等语境，彼此主题并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 网页宣传、学术论文、新闻评论

patterns.name: 其他带明显词内分段的词
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名、法律术语、机构缩写或普通复数词的内部片段；这些实例不支持统一的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 以法律文书为主，也包括新闻

en.description: Activations cluster on the endings of several words: they occur repeatedly in relinquish (waiving rights or property), and also in embraces, acknowledges, disagrees, disregarded, again, and speak; these word endings occur across legal, news, and online texts.

patterns.name: Waiving, transferring, or releasing rights
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts describing someone voluntarily waiving, releasing, or transferring rights, interests, or property; the same stem triggers in both legal texts and fictional narratives.

patterns.name: Ending of embraces
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending «aces» of embrace; one instance is “embraces white nationalism”, another is “Britain embraces nuclear power”.

patterns.name: Ending of acknowledges
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of acknowledge; the sentence subject is state, and the content concerns acknowledging the trial court’s findings.

patterns.name: Ending of disagrees
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of disagrees, which the court uses to introduce a rebuttal to the preceding argument.

patterns.name: Ending of disregarded
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of disregarded, describing how the majority opinion ignored a factor.

patterns.name: Ending of again
patterns.context: In “again sampled”, activation covers again, meaning that sampling was performed once more.

patterns.name: speak ending in a nonstandard spelling
patterns.context: Appears in the underscore-separated nonstandard string “i_have_to_speak”; activation falls on the ending of speak, with HackerNews text nearby.

3_1777.description: 激活集中于若干词的词尾：多次出现于 relinquish（放弃权利或财产），也见于 embraces、acknowledges、disagrees、disregarded、again 和 speak；这些词尾分布跨法律、新闻及网络文本。

patterns.name: 放弃、让渡或释放权利
patterns.trigger: “relinquish” [1][3][9]；“relinquish her parental rights”“relinquish the same”“relinquish all their fortunes”
patterns.context: 出现在说明某人自愿放弃、释放或让渡权利、权益或财产的语境中；同一词干在法律文本和虚构情节中均触发。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、奇幻故事叙述

patterns.name: embraces 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 embrace 的词尾 «aces»；一处是“embraces white nationalism”，另一处是“Britain embraces nuclear power”。

patterns.name: acknowledges 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活在 acknowledge 的词尾，句中主语为 state，内容是承认审判法院的认定。

patterns.name: disagrees 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 disagrees 的词尾，法院以此引出对前述论点的反驳。

patterns.name: disregarded 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 disregarded 的词尾，描述多数意见忽视了某项因素。

patterns.name: again 的词尾
patterns.context: 在“again sampled”中，激活覆盖 again，表示再次进行取样。

patterns.name: 特殊拼写中的 speak 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在带下划线分隔的非标准字符串“i_have_to_speak”中，激活的是 speak 的词尾；周围是 HackerNews 文本。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛、非标准格式文本

en.description: Activations cluster on English verb endings or final internal segments, especially -ish (as in relinquish) and -s/-es and -ed forms; they occur mainly in legal argumentation, but also in economic commentary and fiction.

patterns.name: Verbs ending in -ish
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal suffix in an English verb or gerund, especially -ish; the frequent word relinquish occurs in different semantic and syntactic environments.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, economic commentary, fictional narrative

patterns.name: Verbs ending in -s/-es
patterns.context: Activation falls on the verb ending or final internal segment; often third-person singular or past-tense forms, with surrounding statements and arguments commonly from legal documents.
patterns.domain: Primarily legal decisions, also reports on advocacy litigation

patterns.name: Predicate endings in legal argumentation
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the final segment of verbs expressing a court’s judgment, claim, or disposition; forms and endings vary, with no fully consistent triggering substring identified.

3_1777.description: 激活集中在英语动词的词尾或词内后段，尤其是 -ish（relinquish 等）及 -s/-es、-ed 形式；多见于法律论证，但也出现在经济评论和小说中。

patterns.name: -ish 结尾的动词
patterns.context: 激活位置落在英语动词或动名词的词内后缀，尤其是 -ish；高频的 relinquish 出现于不同语义和句法环境中。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、经济评论、小说叙述

patterns.name: 以 -s/-es 结尾的动词
patterns.context: 激活落在动词词尾或词内末段；多为第三人称单数或过去式，周边常是法律文书中的陈述与论证。
patterns.domain: 主要为法律判决，另有倡议诉讼报道

patterns.name: 法律论证中的谓词词尾
patterns.context: 激活位于表示法院判断、主张或处置的动词末段；不同词形和词尾，未见完全一致的触发子串。

en.description: Activations cluster on internal or word-final fragments in several words: relinquish, promote, -gen/-gence, inherits, and acknowledges. Their meanings and registers differ substantially; the main commonality appears to be local word form rather than shared semantics.

patterns.name: relinquish and its forms
patterns.context: Occurs near the stem or ending of relinquish; semantics involve giving up rights, interests, or property.

patterns.name: Forms related to promoting or publicizing
patterns.context: The trigger is at the end of promote; used respectively to publicize denialism and jointly promote a drug.
patterns.domain: News links and discussion (3); business/pharmaceutical text (6)

patterns.name: Word endings such as -gen/-gence
patterns.context: Activation falls on intraword fragments containing gen, in different words such as resurgence, urgencia, and convergencia; no consistent semantic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Public health reporting (5); Spanish political text (10)

patterns.name: Forms of inherit
patterns.context: Activation falls near the end of inherits; contexts involve inheritance of kernel flags or values in subtasks.

patterns.name: Ending of acknowledge
patterns.context: Activation falls at the end of acknowledge; used to acknowledge a court finding.

3_1777.description: 激活集中在若干词的内部或词尾片段：relinquish、promote、-gen/-gence、inherits 和 acknowledges。各词义与语域差异较大，主要共同点似乎是局部词形，而非统一语义。

patterns.name: relinquish 及其词形
patterns.context: 出现在 relinquish 词的词干或词尾附近；语义涉及放弃权利、利益或财产。

patterns.name: 促成、宣传类词形
patterns.context: 触发位置在 promote 的词尾；分别用于宣传否认论、共同推广药品。
patterns.domain: 新闻链接与讨论（3）；商业/制药文本（6）

patterns.name: 词尾 -gen/-gence 一类
patterns.context: 激活落在含 gen 的词内片段，涉及 resurgence、urgencia、convergencia 等不同词；未见一致语义条件。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生报道（5）；西班牙语政治文本（10）

patterns.name: inherit 词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 inherits 的词尾附近；语境涉及内核标志继承或子任务的值继承。

patterns.name: acknowledge 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 acknowledge 的词尾；用于承认法院作出的认定。

en.description: Mainly responds to the stem or suffixes of promote/co-promote and relinquish; the former concerns promotion or facilitation, the latter relinquishment of rights, interests, or property. Also activates on the internal substring “ERV” in PSL_RESERVED_DEFAULT.

patterns.name: Forms of promote
patterns.context: The stem or ending of the root promote is marked as segmented; it often means to promote or facilitate, and also appears in an active-promotion news headline.

patterns.name: Forms of relinquish
patterns.context: A final fragment of relinquish occurs in contexts of relinquishing rights, interests, or property; passage 2 is voluntarily relinquish her parental rights, passage 6 is relinquish the same, and passage 9 is relinquish all their fortunes.

patterns.name: English word-final fragment “ERV”
patterns.context: An internal substring in the uppercase identifier PSL_RESERVED_DEFAULT; there is no evident semantic or syntactic connection supporting its combination with the other patterns.
patterns.domain: C code comments and macro definitions

3_1777.description: 主要响应 promote/co-promote 与 relinquish 的词干或后缀，前者涉及推广或促成，后者涉及放弃权利、权益、财产；另在 PSL_RESERVED_DEFAULT 的内部子串「ERV」上激活。

patterns.name: promote 词形
patterns.context: 词根 promote 的词干或词尾被切分标记，常表示推广、促成；也出现新闻标题中的主动推广。

patterns.name: relinquish 词形
patterns.context: relinquish 的词尾片段出现在放弃权利、权益或财产的语境中；段2为 voluntarily relinquish her parental rights，段6为 relinquish the same，段9为 relinquish all their fortunes。

patterns.name: 英文词尾片段「ERV」
patterns.context: 大写标识符 PSL_RESERVED_DEFAULT 中的内部子串；没有明显的语义或句法联系支持与其他模式合并。
patterns.domain: C 代码注释与宏定义

en.description: Activations often fall on intraword fragments, word endings, and case variants across English, Portuguese, and Spanish; uppercase text in two similar legal templates is especially dense. Sporadic activations also occur on short English words, with no overall shared semantic or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: English intraword fragments or endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within English words or at their endings, often in participles and nominalized endings, and also within proper nouns or abbreviations; there is no consistent syntactic role.
patterns.domain: English news, legal, encyclopedic, and academic texts

patterns.name: Portuguese intraword fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs within Portuguese inflected or derived words; in Segment 2, activation is on an intraword fragment of «Infelizmente».

patterns.name: Spanish intraword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within Spanish words, such as «urgencia» and «convergencia», with no apparent syntactic or semantic commonality.

patterns.name: Uppercase word fragments in legal citation formats
patterns.context: Multiple adjacent word fragments activate persistently in fully capitalized legal template text; the same or similar template appears in both segments.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal documents; explanatory notes quoting summary orders

patterns.name: Frequent short words in sentences
patterns.context: Sporadic activations in ordinary English legal narrative, especially in Segment 3; they do not form a stable semantic or syntactic combination.

3_1777.concept: 词内片段与大小写敏感模式
3_1777.description: 激活多落在词内片段、词尾及大小写变体上，跨英语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语；两段相似法律模板的大写文字尤为密集。另有零散英语小词激活，整体缺少统一语义或语法条件。

patterns.name: 英语词内片段或词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在英语单词内部的片段或词尾，常见于分词、名词化词尾，也包括专名或缩写内部；没有一致的句法角色。
patterns.domain: 英语新闻、法律、百科、学术文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在葡萄牙语屈折或派生词内部；第2段激活在«Infelizmente»的词内片段。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语词内部，如«urgencia»和«convergencia»，未见明显句法或语义共性。

patterns.name: 法律引用格式中的大写词片段
patterns.context: 整段大写的法律模板文字中，多个相邻词片段持续激活；相同或近似模板在两段重复出现。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书、摘要命令引用说明

patterns.name: 句中高频小词
patterns.context: 普通英语法律叙述中零散激活，尤其在第3段；不构成稳定的语义或句法组合。

en.concept: Specific word fragments and legal boilerplate
en.description: Patterns are dispersed: three passages share federal decision boilerplate stating that a ruling is nonprecedential and discouraging citation; the others separately match ambush, relinquish, lawyer and personal-name fragments, dispense, undertakes, and the Portuguese word-final segment in ocorreram.

patterns.name: Standard boilerplate in federal appellate decisions
patterns.context: The decision states that an order or judgment is nonprecedential and that the court generally discourages citation; activation falls especially on “disfavors” and its internal subword fragments.

patterns.name: “ambush” in a conspiracy case
patterns.context: Describes a location where conspirators expected to ambush and attack the FBI; the trigger word occurs in a factual account of the crime.

patterns.name: “relinquish” voluntary waiver of parental rights
patterns.context: At a disposition hearing, the petitioner says that she is willing to voluntarily relinquish her parental rights.

patterns.name: “Malamauth” fragment in a lawyer’s name
patterns.context: Appears in a list of state prosecutors and assistant attorneys general; a fragment of the segmented name activates.

patterns.name: “Hamroush” fragment in a personal name
patterns.context: In a historical account related to the Egyptian Free Officers, the final segment of the segmented name activates.

patterns.name: “dispense”
patterns.context: The appellate court states that it can dispense with oral argument because the facts and legal materials are sufficient; the phrase is “dispense with oral argument”.

patterns.name: “undertakes”
patterns.context: An association provision discusses the rules that apply if the association undertakes to provide useful materials or services.

patterns.name: Portuguese verb ending “ram”
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary text, recounts two things that happened in succession; activation falls on a final fragment after the participle.

3_1777.concept: 特定词片段与法律套语
3_1777.description: 模式分散：三段同现联邦判决“不具约束力、少引用”的套语；其余分别命中 ambush、relinquish、律师与人物姓名片段、dispense、undertakes 及葡语 ocorreram 词尾。

patterns.name: 联邦上诉判决标准套语
patterns.trigger: “disfavors”10，周围常见“order and judgment”“not binding precedent”“citation of orders and judgments”
patterns.context: 裁判声明某命令或判决不具约束力，并说明法院通常不鼓励引用；激活尤其落在“disfavors”及其内部子词片段
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决

patterns.name: 阴谋案中的“ambush”
patterns.context: 描述共谋者预期埋伏并袭击联邦调查局的地点；触发词处于犯罪事实叙述中

patterns.name: 自愿放弃亲权的“relinquish”
patterns.context: 请愿人在处分听证会上表示愿自愿放弃其父母权利

patterns.name: 律师姓名中的“Malamauth”片段
patterns.trigger: “Mal”4及“uth”9（同一姓名 Malamauth 的分段）
patterns.context: 出现在州检察官及助理总检察长名单中；姓名被分词后片段激活
patterns.domain: 法律文件中的律师名单

patterns.name: 人物姓名中的“Hamroush”片段
patterns.context: 埃及自由军官相关历史叙述中，姓名被分词后末段激活

patterns.name: “dispense”
patterns.context: 上诉法院表示因事实和法律材料足够而免于口头辩论，短语为“dispense with oral argument”
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决

patterns.name: “undertakes”
patterns.context: 物业协会条款中，讨论协会若承诺提供有益的材料或服务时的规则
patterns.domain: 房地产协会章程／契约条款

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语动词词尾“ram”
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会文本中，叙述两件事情随后发生；激活落在分词后的词尾片段
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

en.description: A shared surface feature across segments is that activations often fall on subword fragments within words or at word endings, sometimes spanning line breaks or whitespace. Across languages and domains, this does not establish a shared meaning or topic.

patterns.name: Intraword/affix fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within complete words, across diverse vocabulary and languages, rather than on fixed word meanings.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text and English legal and economic texts

patterns.name: Portuguese intraword fragments
patterns.context: In Portuguese, activation markers occur in the middle or at the end of words, covering inflections and common forms; the contexts have no shared topic.

patterns.name: German intraword fragments
patterns.context: Letter fragments within German compounds or inflected words are marked.

patterns.name: Internal and final fragments in English legal words
patterns.context: Activation occurs within or at the end of English words in legal text; content includes case law, litigation, and criminal cases, but the markers do not correspond to a stable legal concept.

patterns.name: Document layout symbols and whitespace
patterns.context: Line breaks and whitespace are also marked, often in court documents that preserve visible formatting; they co-occur with intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Sporadic English intraword fragments
patterns.context: Markers fall within or at the boundaries of several words in business emails; no single semantic trigger condition can be confirmed.

3_1777.description: 各段的共同表面特征是激活常落在词内部、词尾的子词片段上，且偶尔覆盖换行或空白。跨语言与领域，无法据此确定统一语义或主题。

patterns.name: 词内/词缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词的内部子词片段上；跨多种词汇和语言，并非固定词义
patterns.domain: 多语种及英语法律、经济文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中，激活标记位于词的中段或词尾，涵盖屈折变化与常见词形；上下文没有统一主题
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 德语复合词或屈折词内部的字母片段被标记

patterns.name: 英语法律词中及词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在法律文本中英语词内部或词尾；内容包含判例、诉讼及刑事案件，但标记并未对应某个稳定法律概念

patterns.name: 文书排版符号与空白
patterns.context: 换行符及空白也被标记，常见于排版保留明显的法院文书；与词内片段同时出现

patterns.name: 零散英语词内片段
patterns.context: 标记落在经济邮件中若干词的内部或边界，未见可确认的单一语义触发条件

en.description: Activations often fall on internal fragments, endings, or local word forms in multiple languages, scattered across legal, parliamentary, music-encyclopedia, and financial email texts; a few fragments correspond to legal decision phrasing, German stehen, financial terminology, or opera proper names. Overall semantic regularity is unclear.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations often fall on suffixes, internal fragments, or whole words across multiple languages, without requiring a specific syntactic or semantic context; includes English, Portuguese, German, and Spanish.
patterns.domain: Multilingual natural text, including legal and parliamentary texts, encyclopedias, and emails

patterns.name: Near sentence or paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Markers often occur at passage ends, in the latter half of sentences, or near line breaks; however, not all paragraph boundaries activate, so this alone cannot explain the pattern.

patterns.name: Litigation and decision language in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in legal discussion of pleadings, court jurisdiction, judgment effect, and citations to court orders; activations are distributed over multiple words and are not limited to a single legal term.

patterns.name: Forms related to “stand/stehen”
patterns.context: Occurs in German sentences about troops being stationed or parties facing a situation; the two similar forms have different meanings and arguments.

patterns.name: Financial market terminology
patterns.context: Appears in emails discussing tax-loss selling, Y2K, interest rates, and market trends; activation points are mainly local fragments of English words.

patterns.name: Opera characters and work titles
patterns.context: Occurs within names or proper nouns of operas and characters, in passages discussing composers, performances, and conductors.

patterns.name: Possible word form meaning “happen/occur”
patterns.context: Occurs within a word form meaning “two things happened” in Portuguese parliamentary text; no clear semantic connection with activations in the other passages is evident.

3_1777.description: 激活多落在多语种词的内部片段、词尾或局部词形，散见于法律、议会、音乐百科和金融邮件；少数片段对应法律裁判措辞、德语stehen、金融术语或歌剧专名。整体语义规律不清。

patterns.name: 词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在多语种词的后缀、词内片段或完整词上，且上下文并不要求特定句法或语义；包括英语、葡萄牙语、德语、西班牙语。
patterns.domain: 多语种自然文本，包括法律、议会文本、百科与邮件

patterns.name: 句末或段落边界附近
patterns.context: 标记常出现在片段末尾、句子后半段或换行附近；但并非所有段落边界处都有激活，不能单独解释该模式。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的诉讼与裁判表述
patterns.context: 出现在诉状、法院管辖权、判决效力及引用法院命令等法律论述中；激活分布于多个词，并不局限于单一法律术语。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见书与判决

patterns.name: “stand/stehen”相关形式
patterns.context: 出现在德语关于军队驻扎或有关方面面临处境的句子中；两处形式相近，但语义与论元不同。

patterns.name: 金融市场术语
patterns.context: 在讨论税损抛售、Y2K、利率及市场趋势的邮件中出现，激活点主要是英语词的局部片段。

patterns.name: 歌剧人物与作品名
patterns.context: 出现在歌剧作品及角色名的人名或专名内部，周围谈及作曲家、演出与指挥。

patterns.name: 可能的词形“发生/出现”
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会文本中出现在“发生了两件事”的词形内；与其他段的激活未见明确语义联系。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

en.description: Primarily responds to later inflectional or derivational fragments within words, especially the German verb ending «en» and noun endings; also responds to English verb endings, Spanish verb forms, and a few proper nouns or intraword fragments.

patterns.name: German infinitive endings
patterns.context: Activation often falls on German verb infinitive endings or similar conjugational endings; «entstehen» is especially prominent in Segments 1–3.
patterns.domain: German parliamentary text, patent descriptions, and philosophical texts

patterns.name: German noun plural or inflectional endings
patterns.context: In German noun plurals, case forms, or other inflected forms, activation falls at the word ending; this may overlap with the verb-ending pattern.

patterns.name: English verb endings
patterns.context: Activation is at English inflectional verb endings, specifically past participle and third-person singular forms; examples are sparse.

patterns.name: Internal letter fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls on character fragments inside English words or proper nouns, without an obvious shared morphological function.

patterns.name: Spanish verbal morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within or at the end of inflected Spanish verbs; similar to the German and English ending patterns, but examples are limited.

3_1777.description: 主要响应词内靠后的屈折或派生片段，尤其德语动词词尾「en」及名词词尾；也响应英语动词词尾、西班牙语动词形式，以及少数专名或词内片段。

patterns.name: 德语不定式词尾
patterns.trigger: 词干后接未标记或高亮的「en」，如「entste«hen»10」「erbring«en»9」「eingeg«ang»5«en»9」「erinner«n»4」「anmel«den»3」
patterns.context: 激活常落在德语动词的不定式词尾或类似动词变位词尾；第1—3段的「entstehen」尤其突出。
patterns.domain: 德语议会文本、专利说明及哲学文本

patterns.name: 德语名词复数或屈折词尾
patterns.context: 在德语名词的复数、格或其他屈折形式中，激活落在词尾；可能与动词词尾模式重叠。

patterns.name: 英语动词词尾
patterns.context: 激活位于英语动词的屈折词尾，分别是过去分词形式和第三人称单数形式；样本稀少。

patterns.name: 专名内部字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词或专名内部的字符片段，不明显对应统一的词法功能。

patterns.name: 西班牙语动词形态片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语动词的屈折形式内部或词尾；与德语、英语词尾现象相似但样本有限。

en.description: Activations are distributed across internal fragments and word endings in multilingual text: German, French, and Portuguese show different word-form fragments; English legal texts activate on legal vocabulary, proper names, and phrase components, and common words and split word fragments also appear in baseball narratives.

patterns.name: German suffixes or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments or endings of German words; content concerns risks, consequences, crises, legal matters, or administrative matters.

patterns.name: French internal fragments and verb inflection
patterns.context: Activation falls on accented letters, word endings, or inflected forms in French words.

patterns.name: Portuguese verb endings and internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on word endings or internal fragments in Portuguese words, including verb inflections and noun endings.

patterns.name: Scattered word fragments in English legal texts
patterns.context: Legal vocabulary, headings, and segmented proper names in U.S. judicial opinions or pleadings; activations are distributed across multiple words, with no consistent word-form position.

patterns.name: Phrases and internal word fragments in English baseball narratives
patterns.context: In baseball record narratives, activation involves common function words and split fragments of “re-acquired”.

3_1777.description: 激活分布于多语种文本的词内片段和词尾：德、法、葡语呈现不同词形片段；英语法律文本中落在法律词汇、专名和短语成分，另见棒球叙述中的常用词及拆分词片段。

patterns.name: 德语后缀或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在德语单词的词内片段或词尾；内容涉及风险、后果、危机、法律或行政事项。
patterns.domain: 德语议会文本、商标说明

patterns.name: 法语词内片段与动词屈折
patterns.context: 激活落在法语单词的重音字母、词尾或屈折形式中。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语动词词尾及词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词的词尾或词内片段，包含动词变位及名词词尾。

patterns.name: 英语法律文本中的分散词片段
patterns.context: 美国司法意见或诉状中出现的法律词汇、标题及被拆分的专名；激活分布在多个词上，未见一致的词形位置。

patterns.name: 英语棒球叙述中的短语及词内片段
patterns.context: 棒球记录叙述中，激活涉及常见功能词及“re-acquired”一词的拆分片段。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科体育传记

en.description: Strong activations often fall on intraword or word-final fragments, especially German and French verb endings (-en, -ons), as well as English verb -s; internal fragments in transliterated Russian proper nouns also occur, with no shared morphosyntactic condition.

patterns.name: German verb ending «-stehen»
patterns.context: «entstehen» appears as a complete verb in sentences describing consequences, risks, or the emergence of new things; strong activation is marked at the word ending.

patterns.name: French verb ending «-ons»
patterns.context: First-person plural present-tense verbs end in -ons and appear in parliamentary speeches or academic explanations; activation falls at the word ending.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary speeches and academic papers

patterns.name: German verb ending «-en»
patterns.context: Infinitive verbs end in -en in legal or administrative contexts involving obligations or requirements.

patterns.name: English sentence-/clause-final inflectional ending «-s»
patterns.context: The English third-person singular verb ending -s occurs in descriptions of court pleadings.

patterns.name: English noun ending «-s»
patterns.context: English third-person singular verbs end in -s; the activation marker covers the verb ending in sentences discussing a court’s attitude toward cited decisions.

patterns.name: English plural ending «-s»
patterns.context: A syllable or letter fragment within a proper noun is marked; no apparent regular inflectional or syntactic condition is evident.

3_1777.description: 强激活多落在词内或词尾片段，尤其是德语、法语动词词尾（-en、-ons），也见英语动词 -s；另有俄语转写专名内部片段，缺乏统一形态句法条件。

patterns.name: 德语动词词尾「-stehen」
patterns.context: 「entstehen」作为完整动词，出现在描述后果、风险或新事物产生的句子中；强激活标在词尾。

patterns.name: 法语动词词尾「-ons」
patterns.context: 第一人称复数现在时动词以 -ons 结尾，出现在议会发言或学术说明中；激活落在词尾。
patterns.domain: 法语议会发言、学术论文

patterns.name: 德语动词词尾「-en」
patterns.context: 不定式动词以 -en 结尾，处于法律或行政文本的义务／要求语境。

patterns.name: 英语句末/分句末屈折词尾「-s」
patterns.context: 英语第三人称单数动词词尾 -s，出现在法院对诉状内容的描述中。

patterns.name: 英语名词词尾「-s」
patterns.context: 英语第三人称单数动词以 -s 结尾；激活标记覆盖动词词尾，句子讨论法院对引用判决的态度。

patterns.name: 英语复数词尾「-s」
patterns.context: 专名内部的音节/字母片段被标记；未见明显的常规屈折或句法条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-final fragments in multilingual words and English legal formatting: Romance verbs and derivations, wording in rulings granting motions by U.S. courts, legal citation fragments, and one technical-context instance of “re-synthesizing the output”. These examples lack a consistent, clear semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Verb-final inflectional fragments
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on word-final or internal suffixes in Romance verbs and derived forms in parliamentary speeches, discussions, and chats.

patterns.name: Court ruling format
patterns.context: Headings and concluding paragraphs in U.S. court judgments or orders, especially formal wording granting motions.

patterns.name: English word-final fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in case citations, legal entity names, or U.S. reporter abbreviations; activation falls on internal word fragments or fragments adjacent to punctuation.

patterns.name: Progressive form of re-synthesize
patterns.context: Discusses constructing a spatially coherent 3D space from input and re-synthesizing the output; activation falls on the progressive verb ending and subsequent words.

3_1777.description: 激活分散在多语种词内词尾及英语法律格式：罗曼语动词/派生词、美国法院批准动议的裁定措辞、法律引证片段，以及一次技术语境中的“re-synthesizing the output”。这些用例缺乏统一明确的语义触发点。

patterns.name: 动词词尾分词
patterns.trigger: 葡语/意大利语中被拆分标记的动词后缀，如「rem」「ram」「ere」「are」「izzare」「ità」
patterns.context: 激活集中于词尾或词内后缀；出现于议会发言、讨论和聊天中的罗曼语动词或派生词。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语、意大利语文本

patterns.name: 法院裁定格式
patterns.context: 美国法院判决或命令的标题、正文结论段；尤其是法院批准动议的正式措辞。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的英文词尾
patterns.context: 出现在判例引证、法律实体名称或美国法报告缩写中，激活落在词内部分或标点相邻的片段。

patterns.name: 重合成的进行形式
patterns.context: 谈论从输入构造空间连贯的 3D 空间并重新合成输出；激活落在进行式动词词尾及其后续词。

en.description: Activations occur in Italian and Swedish intraword morphemes and in citations, legal terminology, and title fragments in U.S. decisions; there are also intraword fragments in labor cases and biomedical methods vocabulary, with no shared semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Italian intraword subword activation
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-final or morphological fragments within Italian words, including infinitive endings and inflected forms; it is not at whole-word boundaries.

patterns.name: Swedish intraword subword activation
patterns.context: Activation occurs on morphemes or endings within Swedish words, concentrated in compounds and inflected or derived forms.

patterns.name: Court abbreviations in U.S. case citations
patterns.context: Near case citations or standards of judicial review in legal text, especially abbreviations and numbers in U.S. Reports citations; some citation characters are unmarked.

patterns.name: Legal terms and fixed phrases in decisions
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of case-law arguments, litigation procedure, constitutional issues, or federal jurisdiction; trigger points are scattered across legal terms and common legal phrases.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in uppercase legal titles
patterns.context: In fully capitalized party titles or headers, activation falls on internal word fragments and final letters.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw decision titles and layout text

patterns.name: Intraword substrings in decision language
patterns.context: Occurs inside the name Lieckfelt and the word reinstate; accompanied by labor dispute narratives involving rulings, reinstatement, and compensation.

patterns.name: Research methods and biomedical vocabulary
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across experimental methods, detection techniques, and biomedical terminology, with no apparent local pattern shared with legal or European parliamentary text.

3_1777.description: 激活分布在意大利语、瑞典语词内词素，以及美国判决的引文、法律术语和标题片段；另见劳动案词内片段与生物医学方法词汇，缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内子词激活
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语单词内部的词尾或词素片段，包含动词不定式词尾和屈折形式；并非整词边界。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语议会发言

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内子词激活
patterns.context: 激活出现在瑞典语词内部的词素或词尾，集中于复合词及屈折、派生形式。

patterns.name: 美国判例引文中的法院缩写
patterns.context: 法律文本的判例引用或法院审查标准附近，尤其是 U.S. Reports 引文中的缩写和数字；部分引文字符未标记。

patterns.name: 判决中的法律术语与固定短语
patterns.trigger: 「«summary» judgment」「«cited»« before» any court」「«res» judicata」「collateral estoppel」「«the» law of «the»« case」「«constitutional» right」「«sovereign entities»」「«federal» court」
patterns.context: 出现在判例法论证、诉讼程序、宪法或联邦管辖权讨论中，触发点散布于法律术语和常见法律短语。

patterns.name: 法律标题中的大写词内部片段
patterns.context: 全大写的诉讼当事人标题或页眉中，激活落在单词内部片段及结尾字母。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决的标题、版式文本

patterns.name: 判决措辞中的词内子串
patterns.context: 在姓名 Lieckfelt 及 reinstate 一词内部出现；同时伴随裁决、复职和赔偿等劳动争议叙述。

patterns.name: 科研方法与生物医学词汇
patterns.context: 激活散布于实验方法、检测技术和生物医学术语中，没有明显与法律或欧洲议会文本相同的局部模式。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 生物医学研究描述

en.description: Strong activations often fall on plural or verbal inflectional fragments such as S/os at word ends: Portuguese os and S in English legal texts are most prominent; Spanish en and S in email abbreviations also occur. Transcription terms such as run-on in the NIH passage show no clear corresponding trigger.

patterns.name: Word-final “os” in Portuguese
patterns.context: In plural forms of Portuguese verbs or nouns, the final component os is marked as a subword fragment; [1] also contains «om»«os»10 within “dispomos”.

patterns.name: Capitalized plural S in court documents
patterns.context: In all-caps titles and court orders in English legal documents, final S forms plural nouns or third-person singular verbs.
patterns.domain: U.S. court judgments and litigation documents

patterns.name: Plural or inflectional word-final fragments in English
patterns.context: In legal English, final fragments occur inside complete words or at word ends; apart from the strongest S, commonly activated fragments are plural inflectional endings.

patterns.name: Organizational abbreviation S in Enron email addresses
patterns.context: S is part of a capitalized abbreviation in department or organizational identifiers in company email recipient addresses; activation is weaker than in the strongest examples.

patterns.name: Internal inflectional fragment in Spanish verbs
patterns.context: In conjugated Spanish verbs, en occurs at the word end; the passage concerns possible U.S. amendments to the law.

3_1777.description: 强激活常落在词尾 S/os 一类复数或动词屈折片段：葡萄牙语 os、英语法律文本的 S 最突出；另有西语 en、邮件缩写 S。NIH 段的 run-on 等转录术语未见清晰对应触发。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词中词尾的「os」
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语动词或名词的复数形式中，词尾成分 os 被分词标记；[1]中还出现 «om»«os»10，位于「dispomos」词内。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言

patterns.name: 法院文书中的大写复数词尾 S
patterns.context: 英语法律文书的全大写标题、法院命令中，词尾 S 构成复数名词或第三人称单数动词。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及诉讼文书

patterns.name: 英语词内的复数或屈折词尾
patterns.trigger: «'»«rs»10（[3]，Operating Engineers 中的 Engineers 词尾）；另见 [2] 的 «S»10
patterns.context: 法律英语中，词尾片段位于完整词内部或词末；除最强的 S 外，常见被激活片段是复数屈折结尾。

patterns.name: Enron 邮件地址中的组织缩写 S
patterns.context: 公司邮件收件人地址的部门或组织标识中，S 作为大写缩写的一部分；激活低于最强样本。

patterns.name: 西班牙语动词词内屈折片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语动词的变位形式中，en 位于词尾；这里描述美国可能修改法律。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会西班牙语发言

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on short internal or word-final fragments, especially plural S in court orders, but also multilingual word forms, legal citations, and abbreviations; there is no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Plural verb ending in court orders
patterns.context: In court orders, preceded by Court and followed by parties and objects such as motion; activation concentrates on the final S of a capitalized verb.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual internal or final word endings and affixes
patterns.context: Activation falls on short fragments inside or at the end of words rather than on stable complete words; occurs in inflected words, proper names, and abbreviations.

patterns.name: Local fragments in legal terms and citations
patterns.context: Appears in fixed legal formats such as case citations, legal principles, or attorney signatures; the specific activated fragments vary.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and litigation documents

patterns.name: Fragment activations in verb forms
patterns.context: Occurs inside or at the ends of German or Italian verbs, including inflected forms; not limited to a particular meaning.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in philosophical discussion
patterns.context: Embedded in complex words in German philosophical discussion; no clear local pattern shared with court orders or other strong activations.

3_1777.description: 强激活主要落在词内或词尾短片段，尤见法院命令的复数S，也见多语词形、法律引文和缩写；尚无单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 法院命令中的复数动词词尾
patterns.context: 法院命令中，前接 Court，后接申请人及 motion 等宾语；激活集中在大写动词的词尾 S。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 跨语言词内词尾或词缀
patterns.trigger: 意大利语 «rem»9、«o»5、«a»3；德语 «stehen»9、«fass»2、«z»2、«ren»3；英语法语式语境中的 «S»9、«S»8、«.»4
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部或词尾的短片段，而非稳定的完整词；在屈折变化词、专名及缩写中均出现。
patterns.domain: 意大利语、德语及英语文本

patterns.name: 法律术语及引文中的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在判例引文、法律原则或律师署名等固定法律格式中；具体激活片段不一致。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见及诉讼文书

patterns.name: 动词词形中的片段激活
patterns.context: 出现在德语或意大利语动词的词内/词尾，含词形变化；不局限于某一语义。

patterns.name: 哲学论述中的词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在德语哲学论述的复杂词中；没有明显与法院命令或其他强激活形式相同的局部模式。

en.description: High activations often fall on word-final or intraword subword fragments: English legal text commonly has final s, with Italian -re and Dutch -ren also present; ed in biomedical terms state and pasting are sporadic examples.

patterns.name: English word-final s
patterns.context: The final s of English words, including third-person verb endings, possessives, or plurals; common in legal document titles and decision text.

patterns.name: Non-English verb endings
patterns.context: Verb inflectional elements at the ends of Italian and Dutch words.

patterns.name: state in steady-state
patterns.context: Fixed term steady-state mRNA levels in molecular biology contexts.

patterns.name: ed in past­ing
patterns.context: Occurs within an English word near the end of a HackerNews sentence; no clear legal ending or multilingual inflection pattern is evident.

3_1777.description: 高激活多落在词尾或词内子词片段：英语法律文本常见 s 词尾，另有意大利语 -re、荷兰语 -ren；生物医学术语 state 与 pasting 中 ed 是零散例子。

patterns.name: 英语词尾 s
patterns.context: 英语词语末尾的 s，包括第三人称动词词尾、所有格或复数；多见于法律文书标题和判决正文

patterns.name: 非英语动词词尾
patterns.context: 意大利语、荷兰语词语末尾的动词屈折成分

patterns.name: steady-state 中的 state
patterns.context: 分子生物学语境中的固定术语 steady-state mRNA levels

patterns.name: past­ing 中的 ed
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 句子末尾附近的英语词内部；未见明确法律词尾或多语种屈折模式

en.concept: Multimodal word fragments and legal granting language
en.description: Strong activations often occur in wording in U.S. court orders granting motions; other examples include word-final fragments in multilingual parliamentary texts, name fragments in email addresses, and the biomedical term steady-state, without forming a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Granting rulings in court orders
patterns.context: In court orders or headings, grants a motion, application, or judgment; often accompanied by words such as Court, motion, ORDER, and JUDGMENT

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in multilingual European Parliament texts
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-final or inflectional fragments within European-language word forms; no shared semantic or fixed syntactic condition is apparent

patterns.name: Name fragments in Enron email addresses
patterns.context: Names embedded in Enron email addresses and recipient/CC lists

patterns.name: State ending in biomedical terminology
patterns.context: In an experimental-method context describing mRNA levels, activation falls on state in a compound term

3_1777.concept: 多模式词片段与法律授予措辞
3_1777.description: 强激活常见于美国法院授予动议的命令措辞；另见多语种议会文本中的词尾片段、邮件地址姓名片段，以及生物医学 steady-state 术语，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 法院命令中的授予裁定
patterns.context: 法院命令或标题中，授予动议、申请或判决；常伴随 Court、motion、ORDER、JUDGMENT 等词

patterns.name: 欧洲议会多语种词尾
patterns.trigger: 意大利语 «rem»«o»、葡萄牙语 «te»«ce»«u»«8»，以及荷兰语 «garande»«ren»8
patterns.context: 激活落在欧洲语言词形内部的词尾或屈折片段；未见共同的语义或固定句法条件

patterns.name: Enron 邮件地址中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 姓名嵌在 Enron 邮件地址及收件人/抄送列表中

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的状态词尾
patterns.context: 描述 mRNA 水平的实验方法语境，激活落在复合术语 state 上

en.concept: Judicial text formatting and word-form fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to capitalized GRANTS in court orders and judgment-title formatting; also appears in fixed litigation phrases, balance sheet, Italian and Portuguese future-tense endings, and internal fragments in email names. These are difficult to explain with a single semantic account.

patterns.name: GRANTS in judgment-order headings
patterns.context: In the heading or conclusion of a court order, begins with capitalized GRANTS, followed by parties and an application or motion; strong activation falls on the final S.
patterns.domain: U.S. court judgments and procedural orders

patterns.name: Court order headings and case identifiers
patterns.context: Near formatted headings containing the court caption, level/jurisdiction, case number, and ORDER; GRANTS need not appear.

patterns.name: Temporary restraining order phrase
patterns.context: When describing an application or request for a temporary restraining order, activation falls on order.

patterns.name: Open issue phrase
patterns.context: Describes a judge who has not yet decided a legal issue; activation concentrates on open.

patterns.name: Financial statement phrase
patterns.context: When criticizing company accounting or the treatment of marketing costs, activation falls on sheet.

patterns.name: Italian future-tense endings in the European Parliament
patterns.context: In Italian parliamentary speeches, future-tense verb stems are followed by the endings rem, o; activation concentrates on those endings.

patterns.name: Portuguese future-tense endings in the European Parliament
patterns.context: Future-tense verb forms in Portuguese parliamentary speeches, especially the endings rem, os; gu also occurs within prosseguir.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in names in Enron addresses
patterns.context: Before the email recipient/CC address name Britt, activation falls on an internal fragment of Elan; no visible semantic or syntactic cues.

3_1777.concept: 司法文本格式与词形片段
3_1777.description: 主要响应法院命令中的大写 GRANTS 及判决标题格式；另见诉讼固定短语、balance sheet、意大利语与葡萄牙语将来时词尾，以及邮件姓名中的词内片段，难由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: 判决命令标题中的 GRANTS
patterns.trigger: GRANT«S»10« the»2 Appellant’s third motion« for»2 extension；GRANT«S»10 plaintiff’s motion
patterns.context: 法院命令的标题或结论处，以大写 GRANTS 开头，后接当事人及申请/动议；强激活落在词尾 S。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、程序命令

patterns.name: 法院命令标题与案情标识
patterns.context: 法院抬头、审级/辖区、案号和 ORDER 等格式化标题附近；未必出现 GRANTS。

patterns.name: 临时限制令短语
patterns.context: 描述申请或请求临时限制令时，激活落在 order。

patterns.name: 未决问题短语
patterns.context: 叙述法官暂未决定某法律问题；激活集中在 open。

patterns.name: 财务报表短语
patterns.context: 批评公司会计或营销成本处理时，激活落在 sheet。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会意大利语将来时词尾
patterns.context: 意大利语议会发言中，将来时动词词干后接词尾 rem、o；激活集中在该词尾。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语将来时词尾
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会发言中，将来时动词形式，尤其词尾 rem、os；另有 gu 出现在 prosseguir 的词内。

patterns.name: Enron 地址名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 邮件收件人/抄送地址中的姓名 Britt 前，激活在 Elan 的词内片段；缺少可见的语义或句法线索。

en.concept: Local word forms and term fragments in heterogeneous texts
en.description: Activations occur mainly in U.S. court orders, especially at the end of GRANT; other examples involve litigation roles, legal headings, and principles. A few activations occur in genomics research terminology, Italian verb endings, accounting phrases, and company email addresses, and cannot be grouped into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Ending of GRANT in court orders
patterns.context: In legal rulings or orders, the court grants or allows a motion; activation concentrates on the suffix S in GRANT, with one instance of ING.

patterns.name: Litigants and their role labels
patterns.context: Legal documents list parties, attorneys, or subjects of court rulings; activations on party labels and nearby markers are weaker.

patterns.name: Legal opinion and order headings
patterns.context: Headings or ruling sections of formal court documents; also occurs with order headings granting motions.

patterns.name: Citation restrictions and preclusion principles
patterns.context: Discusses restrictions on citations of decisions and principles such as res judicata, issue preclusion, or case law; activation falls near relevant legal terms.

patterns.name: Genomic association research terminology
patterns.context: Describes genome-wide SNPs, genetic diversity, candidate genes, or breast cancer risk association studies.
patterns.domain: Genetics and biomedical papers, research grant abstracts

patterns.name: Italian verb endings
patterns.context: In Italian parliamentary speeches, activation concentrates on verb inflections or word-final fragments, rather than an apparent legal or genomics-related meaning.

patterns.name: Accounting and balance sheet
patterns.context: Discusses whether company marketing costs should be included on the balance sheet, in a commentary questioning accounting rules.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and name fragments in company email addresses
patterns.context: Names, department abbreviations, and company email addresses appear in email CC or recipient lists; activations are scattered across name and abbreviation fragments.

3_1777.concept: 异质文本中的局部词形与术语片段
3_1777.description: 主要在美国法院命令中激活，尤其是 GRANT 的词尾；另涉及诉讼身份、法律标题与原则。少量激活见于基因组研究术语、意大利语动词词尾、会计短语及公司邮件地址，无法归入单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 法院命令中 GRANT 的词尾
patterns.context: 法律裁定或命令中，法院作出批准、准许等裁决；激活集中在 GRANT 的后缀 S，另有一次 ING。

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人及其身份标签
patterns.context: 法律文书列明当事人、代理律师或法院裁定对象；对当事人称谓及其附近标记的激活较弱。

patterns.name: 法律意见及命令标题
patterns.context: 正式法院文件的标题或裁定部分；与准许动议的命令标题同时出现。

patterns.name: 法律引证限制及既判类原则
patterns.context: 讨论裁判引用限制及既判力、争点排除或案件法等原则；激活落在相关法律术语附近。

patterns.name: 基因组关联研究术语
patterns.context: 描述基因组范围 SNP、遗传多样性、候选基因或乳腺癌风险关联研究。
patterns.domain: 遗传学与生物医学论文、研究资助摘要

patterns.name: 意大利语动词词尾
patterns.context: 意大利语议会发言中，激活集中在动词变位或词尾片段，而非明显的法律或基因组语义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语记录

patterns.name: 会计与资产负债表
patterns.context: 讨论公司营销成本是否计入资产负债表，处于质疑会计规则的评论语境。

patterns.name: 公司邮箱地址中的缩写与名称片段
patterns.context: 邮件抄送或收件人列表中出现人名、部门缩写及公司邮箱；激活分散在名称和缩写片段上。

en.description: Activations occur separately in GRANTS in court orders, ET&S in Enron email addresses, the accounting term balance sheet, and association studies/GWAS and steady state in biomedicine; apart from biomedical terminology, the patterns have little semantic overlap.

patterns.name: grants in court orders
patterns.context: In court orders, often in the construction “The Court GRANTS … motion/application,” near an application by a party or appellant.

patterns.name: ET&S in email addresses
patterns.context: Occurs in Enron employee email addresses or contact fields, often adjacent to “/Enron@ENRON”.

patterns.name: Financial accounting phrase
patterns.context: When discussing marketing costs, accounting rules, or corporate integrity, activation concentrates on sheet in the accounting term “balance sheet”.

patterns.name: association studies
patterns.context: In genetic research contexts, mentions candidate genes or genome-wide association studies; the abbreviation GWAS also triggers activation.

patterns.name: steady state
patterns.context: Describes drug concentrations, mRNA levels, or oxidation products reaching a steady state; activation falls on state.

3_1777.description: 激活分别出现在法院命令的 GRANTS、Enron 邮件地址的 ET&S、会计术语 balance sheet，以及生物医学中的 association studies/GWAS 和 steady state；除生物医学内部术语外，各模式缺少共同语义。

patterns.name: 法院命令中的 grants
patterns.context: 法院命令中，常出现在“The Court GRANTS … motion/application”句式，且附近有案件当事人或上诉人的申请内容

patterns.name: 邮件地址中的 ET&S
patterns.context: 出现在 Enron 员工邮件地址或通讯录字段中，常与“/Enron@ENRON”相邻

patterns.name: 财务会计短语
patterns.context: 讨论营销成本、会计规则或公司诚信时，激活集中在会计术语“balance sheet”的 sheet

patterns.name: association studies
patterns.context: 遗传学研究语境中，提及候选基因或全基因组关联研究；GWAS 缩写也触发
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划与文献

patterns.name: steady state
patterns.context: 描述药物浓度、mRNA 水平或氧化产物等达到稳态的状态；激活落在 state
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与研究计划

en.concept: Rulings and judgment terminology in legal documents
en.description: Occurs mainly in U.S. court documents, in ruling headings, orders, and summary judgment contexts, especially on the S ending of ruling verbs or party names; also includes temporary restraining orders and one company accounting comment about a balance sheet.

patterns.name: Ruling-result word-final S in court orders
patterns.context: In court orders or litigation headings, ruling verbs or party names end in S; activation often falls at a subword or word-final boundary

patterns.name: SUMMARY JUDGMENT in litigation document headings
patterns.context: Judgment headings or legal discussion mention summary judgment, often alongside court ruling language

patterns.name: TRO legal term
patterns.context: Narrates a party's request to the court for a temporary restraining order

patterns.name: Company accounting and balance sheet criticism
patterns.context: Comments on the integrity of a company's attempt to change accounting rules so marketing costs do not appear on the balance sheet

3_1777.concept: 法律文书中的裁决与判决术语
3_1777.description: 主要出现在美国法院文书的裁决标题、命令及简易判决语境，尤其是裁决动词或当事人名的词尾 S；另有临时限制令和一条公司会计评论中的 balance sheet。

patterns.name: 法院命令中的裁决结果词尾 S
patterns.context: 法院命令或诉讼标题中，裁决动词或当事人名称以 S 结尾；激活常落在分词/词尾边界

patterns.name: 诉讼文书标题中的 SUMMARY JUDGMENT
patterns.trigger: “SUMMARY JUDGMENT”及其分词片段，如«G»MENT；也包括“grant of summary judgment”
patterns.context: 判决标题或法律论述提及简易判决，常伴随法院裁决用语
patterns.domain: 美国民事诉讼法律文书

patterns.name: TRO 法律术语
patterns.context: 叙述当事人向法院请求临时限制令

patterns.name: 公司会计与资产负债表批评
patterns.context: 评论公司试图改变会计规则、使营销成本不出现在资产负债表上的诚信问题

en.concept: Local word fragments and term suffixes
en.description: Activations mainly fall on several local word fragments: plural or third-person S endings in legal texts, state in the scientific term steady state, and sheet in balance sheet; also includes S fragments in email addresses and ian in the mathematical term Liouvillian.

patterns.name: S in GRANTS
patterns.context: S occurs as a verb ending in GRANT«S» or a plural ending in APPE«LL»ANT«S»; these appear respectively in court orders and party labels.

patterns.name: state in steady state
patterns.context: state in the term steady state / steady-state, referring to concentration, imaging, or mRNA levels.

patterns.name: sheet in sheet
patterns.context: The fixed phrase balance sheet; one instance refers to an accounting statement and another to a financial document in a court record.

patterns.name: S in email addresses
patterns.context: «S» occurs in the /S/ fragment of an Enron email address.

patterns.name: ian in Liouvillian
patterns.context: The suffix fragment in the mathematical term Liouvillian functions.

3_1777.concept: 局部词片段与术语后缀
3_1777.description: 激活主要落在若干局部词片段：法律文本中的复数或第三人称词尾 S，科学文本术语 steady state 的 state，以及 balance sheet 的 sheet；另有邮件地址片段 S 和数学术语 Liouvillian 的 ian。

patterns.name: GRANTS 中的字母 S
patterns.context: S 在 GRANT«S» 中作为动词词尾，或在 APPE«LL»ANT«S» 中作为复数词尾；分别出现在法院命令和当事方标签中。

patterns.name: steady state 中的 state
patterns.context: 术语 steady state / steady-state 中的 state，涉及浓度、影像或 mRNA 水平。

patterns.name: sheet 中的 sheet
patterns.context: balance sheet 这一固定搭配；一次指会计报表，一次指法院记录中的财务文件。

patterns.name: 邮件地址中的 S
patterns.context: «S» 位于 Enron 邮件地址的 /S/ 片段中。

patterns.name: Liouvillian 中的 ian
patterns.context: 数学术语 Liouvillian functions 中的后缀片段。

en.concept: Multilingual word fragments and legal terms
en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual word-form fragments and fixed legal expressions: these include internal or final fragments in Portuguese, Spanish, and Italian, as well as sheet, order, and legal-heading fragments in U.S. judgments. No single word meaning or topic explains all passages.

patterns.name: Balance sheet
patterns.context: sheet in “balance sheet”, in contexts involving accounting or how an asset or obligation is reported.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Portuguese words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal or final fragments of Portuguese words, often in verb conjugations, plurals, or articles; the surrounding text is continuous Portuguese.

patterns.name: Court order terminology
patterns.context: order in the legal procedural term “temporary restraining order” in U.S. judicial texts.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in legal texts
patterns.context: Activation often falls on internal fragments or plural endings in capitalized legal headings, personal names, or organization names; no single fixed word.
patterns.domain: U.S. court judgments, attorney signatures, and headings

patterns.name: Spanish word-final morphology
patterns.context: Activation falls near the first-person plural future-tense ending of a Spanish verb, in the context of parliamentary speech or voting procedures.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Italian words
patterns.context: Activation falls inside or at the ends of Italian verbs; the surrounding context concerns parliamentary chairs and speaking procedures.

3_1777.concept: 多语种词片段及法律术语
3_1777.description: 激活分布在多语种词形片段和法律固定用语中：包括葡萄牙语、西班牙语、意大利语的词内或词尾，以及美国判决中的 sheet、order 和法律标题片段。没有单一词义或主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 资产负债表
patterns.context: “balance sheet”中的 sheet，涉及会计或对某项资产/义务如何列报的描述。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词的内部或词尾片段，常见于动词变位、复数或冠词等形态；附近是连续的葡萄牙语文本。

patterns.name: 法院命令用语
patterns.context: 美国司法文本中，“temporary restraining order”这一法律程序术语的 order。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在大写法律标题、人名或组织名的词内片段及复数词尾；并非单一固定词。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、律师署名及标题

patterns.name: 西班牙语词尾形态
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语动词将来时第一人称复数词尾附近，且上下文是议会发言或投票说明。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会西班牙语文本

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语动词词内及词尾；相邻语境是议会主席与发言流程。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语文本

en.description: Activations are most concentrated in legal orders and litigation document formats, and also occur in balance sheet; strong activations appear on verb endings in several Romance languages and German plural endings, along with sporadic function-word fragments. Overall, this is not a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Legal order terminology
patterns.context: Legal pleadings refer to orders, temporary restraining orders, judgments, or court-approved motions; several high-activation points fall on order or nearby.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and court orders, [4][5][7][8]

patterns.name: Words related to balance sheet
patterns.context: “balance sheet” occurs in contexts involving corporate accounting and evidence in court records; strong activations fall respectively on sheet and balance.

patterns.name: Multilingual verb endings
patterns.context: In Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, and German, activation falls on the final part of tokenized verb or noun forms; some are first-person plural future forms, while the German example is a plural noun ending.
patterns.domain: Philosophical texts, European Parliament speeches, and discussion, [2][3][9][10]

patterns.name: Language of pending legal proceedings
patterns.context: Descriptions of legal proceedings involve whether litigation may continue, waiting for a later hearing, or requests for extensions; highly activated words are not fully consistent with one another.

patterns.name: Litigation document formats and identifiers
patterns.context: Includes case citations, signatory information, docket numbers, or formatting symbols; activations are scattered across legal-format fragments.

patterns.name: Semantically hard-to-classify function words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation points occur on general English function words, Portuguese intraword fragments, and other locations; local context is insufficient to classify them under the clearer topics above.

3_1777.description: 激活最集中于法律命令及诉讼文书格式，也见balance sheet；多种罗曼语动词词尾和德语复数词尾有强激活，另有零散虚词片段，整体并非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 法律命令术语
patterns.context: 法院诉讼文书中出现命令、临时限制令、判决或法院批准动议等表述；若干高激活点落在 order 或其附近。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见及法院命令，[4][5][7][8]

patterns.name: balance sheet 相关词
patterns.context: 出现“balance sheet”，分别涉及公司会计与法院记录中的证据；强激活分别落在 sheet、balance。

patterns.name: 多语言动词词尾
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语、意大利语、西班牙语及德语中，激活落在被拆分标注的动词或名词词形末段；部分为第一人称复数将来形式，德语例则是复数名词词尾。
patterns.domain: 哲学文本、欧洲议会发言及讨论，[2][3][9][10]

patterns.name: 未决法律程序措辞
patterns.trigger: «may»3« be»1 maintained« as»2 a class« action»2；«pending»3 a further hearing；«extension»
patterns.context: 法律程序描述中涉及诉讼可否继续、待后续听证或申请延期；强激活词彼此不完全一致。

patterns.name: 诉讼文书格式与标识
patterns.context: 出现法院判例引注、签署方信息、案号或排版符号；激活分散在法律格式片段中。

patterns.name: 语义上难归类的虚词及词形片段
patterns.context: 激活点分布在一般英语虚词、葡萄牙语词内片段等位置，局部语境不足以归入上述明确主题。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 与葡萄牙语哲学文本，[1][2]

en.concept: Legal document formatting and word endings
en.description: Primarily responds to party labels and plural S endings in U.S. court document headings, and GRANTS in ruling sentences; also responds to line breaks in legal typesetting. Other scattered activations include Portuguese word endings and restraining order, with some cases not unified by these patterns.

patterns.name: Plural possessive in court judgment headings
patterns.context: Appears in all-caps legal document headings, party role labels, or ruling headings; especially plural noun endings in S or S immediately followed by a possessive apostrophe
patterns.domain: U.S. court rulings, judgments, and case-file headings

patterns.name: GRANTS in ruling sentences
patterns.context: The court is the subject (“The Court”), followed by the subject of the ruling or motion; the verb ends in third-person singular S
patterns.domain: U.S. court orders and ruling text

patterns.name: Line breaks in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs at line breaks in court document formatting, including headers, headings, or party sections; activation does not correspond to just one type of semantic content

patterns.name: Portuguese word endings
patterns.context: In continuous Portuguese prose, markers occur at or near word endings
patterns.domain: Portuguese philosophical or social theory texts

patterns.name: Restraining order in TRO
patterns.context: After describing employee benefit plans and an insurance regulatory dispute, mentions a request to the court for a temporary restraining order

patterns.name: Unexplained word-final markers in legal documents
patterns.context: A few activations are scattered through body text or docket information and cannot be fully explained by the patterns above involving plural headings, GRANTS, line breaks, or word endings

3_1777.description: 主要响应美国法院文书中的当事人标签和标题复数词尾 S、裁定句中的 GRANTS；也响应法律排版换行。另有葡语词尾和 restraining order 等零散激活，部分无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 法院判决标题中的复数所有格
patterns.trigger: “PLAINTIFFS”“DEFENDANTS”“APPELLANTS”“APPELLEES”等，常拆成 «S»9 或 «S»8；有时标题中还标记相邻的 “MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT”
patterns.context: 出现在法律文书的全大写标题、当事人身份标签或裁定标题中；尤其是名词复数词尾 S，或紧接所有格撇号的 S
patterns.domain: 美国法院裁定、判决及案卷标题

patterns.name: 裁定句中的 GRANTS
patterns.context: 法院主语为 “The Court”，后接裁定对象或动议；动词以第三人称单数 S 结尾
patterns.domain: 美国法院命令及裁定正文

patterns.name: 法律文书中的换行符
patterns.context: 出现在法院文书排版换行处，包括页眉、标题或当事人栏；激活不只对应某一种语义内容

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词尾
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语连续散文中，标记落在词尾或词尾附近
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语哲学或社会理论文本

patterns.name: TRO 中的 restraining order
patterns.context: 描述员工福利计划及保险监管争议后，提到向法院请求临时限制令
patterns.domain: 美国保险监管诉讼正文

patterns.name: 未解释的法律文书词尾标记
patterns.context: 少数激活散落于正文或案卷信息中，不能由上述标题复数、GRANTS、换行或词尾模式充分解释

en.description: Activations are scattered: plural endings, procedural terms, and restraining orders in legal text; German, Portuguese, and English intraword fragments; and mathematical terminology and an accounting collocation. The examples lack a stable shared semantic or morphological trigger condition.

patterns.name: Plural endings in legal text
patterns.context: Strongest activations often fall on the endings of legal nouns or verbs, especially plural -s/-S; nearby text commonly concerns court rulings, litigants, or legal procedure.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal documents

patterns.name: Temporary restraining order phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in legal narratives requesting or approving a temporary restraining order; activation falls on order.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal documents

patterns.name: Other procedural words in legal contexts
patterns.context: Occurs in court rulings or procedural narratives and may favor common function words or inflectional endings; it co-occurs with the legal texts above, but trigger points are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: German intraword tokenized fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in segments within German compounds, especially «en» in Aufgabenbereich; the context discusses freedom of the press and scope of responsibilities.
patterns.domain: European Parliament debates and German political text

patterns.name: English balance sheet collocation
patterns.context: Activation falls on sheet; the context discusses accounting rules, marketing costs, and balance sheets.

patterns.name: Word endings in mathematical terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within mathematical terms, especially the ending of Liouvillian; the context discusses algebraic groups and differential equations.

patterns.name: Portuguese intraword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within Portuguese words; the context is a philosophical comment on understanding an initial choice.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in philosophical bibliographies
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within German book titles or quotations, near bibliographic information for a collection of philosophical papers.

3_1777.description: 激活落点分散：法律文本中的复数词尾、程序术语及限制令；另见德语、葡萄牙语和英语词内片段，以及数学术语和会计搭配。各例缺少稳定统一的语义或词法触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的复数词尾
patterns.context: 最强激活常落在法律名词或动词的词尾，尤其是复数 -s/-S；附近多为法院裁定、诉讼当事人或法律程序用语。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律文书

patterns.name: 临时限制令短语
patterns.context: 出现在请求或批准临时限制令的法律叙述中；激活落在 order。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律文书

patterns.name: 法律语境中的其他程序词
patterns.context: 位于法院裁定或程序性叙述中，可能偏向常见功能词或屈折词尾；与上述法律文本共现，但触发点不完全一致。

patterns.name: 德语词内切分片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在德语复合词内部的分段，尤以 Aufgabenbereich 中的「en」最强；上下文谈新闻自由及职责范围。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会辩论、德语政治文本

patterns.name: 英语 balance sheet 搭配
patterns.context: 激活落在 sheet；上下文讨论会计规则、营销成本及资产负债表。

patterns.name: 数学术语词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在数学术语内部的片段，尤其是 Liouvillian 的词尾；上下文讨论代数群与微分方程。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词内部片段；上下文是关于理解某项初始选择的哲学评论。

patterns.name: 哲学书目中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在德语书名或引文中的词内片段，附近是哲学论文集的书目信息。

en.description: All snippets contain Height/height-related forms, mainly referring to height attributes in interfaces or code; common uses include reading dimensions, assignment, and layout configuration, as well as debug fields and adjustable-height crutches.

patterns.name: Height as a dimension attribute
patterns.context: The trigger appears in code identifiers, property names, object fields, or natural-language terms, with capitalization varying; it is often listed alongside width, dimensions, or layout attributes.
patterns.domain: Code, interface layout, and technical text

patterns.name: Reading or setting a height value
patterns.context: Height appears as a readable or writable numeric or style property, involving element measurement, assignment, minimum height, or line height.
patterns.domain: JavaScript, Java, frontend testing, and interface code

patterns.name: Width, height, and dimension combinations
patterns.context: Height appears alongside Width, x, dimension fitting, or Auto layout settings.
patterns.domain: Interface layout, geometry data, and configuration code

patterns.name: Interface element height and hiding behavior
patterns.context: A div’s height is measured before adjusting CSS, or element dimensions are read from the DOM/view.

patterns.name: Adjustable device height
patterns.context: Height describes a physical device that can be adjusted, rather than a program attribute.

patterns.name: Height in object state fields
patterns.context: Height appears as part of a longer camel-case state field, surrounded by debug output object properties.

3_1908.description: 所有片段都含有 Height/height 相关词形，主要指界面或代码中的高度属性；常涉及尺寸读取、赋值、布局配置，也有调试字段和可调高度拐杖等用法。

patterns.name: 尺寸属性词 Height
patterns.context: 触发词出现在代码标识符、属性名、对象字段或自然语言术语中，大小写不固定；常与宽度、尺寸或布局属性并列。
patterns.domain: 代码、界面布局与技术文本

patterns.name: 读取或设置高度值
patterns.context: 高度作为可读写的数值或样式属性出现，涉及测量元素、赋值、最小高度或行高。

patterns.name: 宽高及尺寸组合
patterns.context: Height 与 Width、x、尺寸拟合或 Auto 等布局设置同时出现。
patterns.domain: 界面布局、几何数据及配置代码

patterns.name: 界面元素高度及隐藏处理
patterns.context: 测量 div 高度后调整 CSS，或在 DOM/视图中读取元素尺寸。

patterns.name: 设备高度可调
patterns.context: 高度用于描述可调节的物理器具，而非程序属性。

patterns.name: 对象状态字段中的 Height
patterns.context: Height 作为较长驼峰式状态字段的一部分出现，周围是调试输出对象属性。

en.description: Primarily responds to Height/height and compound identifiers involving them, including reading, calculating, setting, or declaring the height of elements, controls, layouts, and devices. Also responds to Width fields paired with Height, dimension settings, and patent descriptions of adjustable height.

patterns.name: Height identifiers and properties
patterns.context: Height/height and compound identifiers appear in code or technical text, usually referring to the height of an element, control, layout, dimension, or state; sometimes used to read, set, display, or configure height.
patterns.domain: Software code, technical discussions, and patent text

patterns.name: Width and Height dimension fields
patterns.context: Width and Height appear together in dimension objects, configuration items, layout properties, or UI options; Height is one field in a width/height pair.

patterns.name: Height calculations and DOM operations
patterns.context: Code reads an element's current height, retrieves a height value, or hides or adjusts an element's height.

patterns.name: Height settings and layout constraints
patterns.context: Height is set to a calculated value, pixel value, or resource value, or a height property is declared for a control or layout.
patterns.domain: Application code, UI layouts, and configuration

patterns.name: Height-adjustable devices in patents
patterns.context: When describing a cane's structure and background technology, height modifies adjustable to mean adjustable in height.

patterns.name: UI dimension options for width and height
patterns.context: UI window dimensions adapt to content, with both width and height specified.

en.description: Activations are scattered: there are repeated responses to the stem segmentation of entangling, the substring yt (often in URLs/identifiers), and the prefix unle; there are also isolated cases such as pul, auc, and numbers after colons, spanning domains and difficult to unify.

patterns.name: Sporadic strong activations in varied contexts

en.description: Activations occur across the util word family, the string tf, an internal fragment of permittivity, and the mathematical symbol ||; several isolated word fragments also appear. The domains and trigger locations are mixed, with no unified semantics or stable context.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbol ||
