en.description: Activations are scattered across many texts, often falling on letter fragments such as tf and gg, as well as code identifiers, mathematical symbols, and special-format tokens; fragment positions vary, with no stable semantic or syntactic conditions.

patterns.name: tf substring
patterns.context: Appears within English words or domains, in varying positions and with varying meanings; sometimes adjacent to numbers or code markers.

patterns.name: gg substring
patterns.context: Appears within longer strings such as brand names or domains, and also in ordinary inflected forms.

patterns.name: Code identifier and parameter-name fragments
patterns.context: Part of an identifier, adjacent to underscores, uppercase or lowercase letters, version numbers, or parentheses.

patterns.name: Scientific symbols and mathematical notation
patterns.context: Activation falls near formula variables, values, or operators, embedded in method descriptions or theorem conditions.

patterns.name: English word fragments
patterns.context: The fragment occurs within a word, attribute name, or domain, with no consistent semantic or grammatical position.

patterns.name: Special tokens and formatting markers
patterns.context: Appears near code pipe operators and formatted-printing functions.

patterns.name: Leapfrogging expression in promotional text
patterns.context: Occurs in the expression “leapfrogging towards,” describing research progress.

patterns.name: Repeated fragment in a natural building materials title
patterns.context: Appears in a book title and repeated title text, surrounded by words such as “Clay and Lime Renders.”

3_1908.concept: 不稳定的字符片段响应
3_1908.description: 激活分散在多种文本中，常落在 tf、gg 等字母片段，也出现在代码标识符、数学符号和特殊格式 token 上；片段位置多变，未见稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: tf 子串
patterns.context: 出现在英文单词或域名内部，位置和语义不固定；有时邻近数字或标记代码。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、软件、科研文本

patterns.name: gg 子串
patterns.context: 出现在较长字符串内部，如品牌或域名，也出现在普通词形变化中。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与参数名片段
patterns.context: 作为标识符的一部分，邻接下划线、大小写字母、版本号或括号。

patterns.name: 科学符号与数学记号
patterns.context: 激活落在公式变量、数值或运算符附近，嵌于方法描述或定理条件中。

patterns.name: 英文词片段
patterns.context: 片段位于单词、属性名或域名中；没有一致的语义或语法位置。

patterns.name: 特殊 token 与格式标记
patterns.context: 出现在代码管道符和格式化打印函数附近。

patterns.name: 宣传文本中的跃进表达
patterns.context: 位于“leapfrogging towards”这一表达中，描述研究进展。

patterns.name: 自然建材书名中的重复片段
patterns.context: 出现在书名及重复标题文本中，周围是“Clay and Lime Renders”等词。

en.concept: Local relations and symbols in technical text
en.description: Activations occur across various academic texts and one R Q&A, often on function-related wording, relational terms, and formula notation; they also involve domain-specific terminology from astronomy, physics, and mathematics. These triggers span fields and do not present a single stable theme.

patterns.name: Function syntax in mathematics and code
patterns.context: Near function names, function expressions, or function arguments, especially in code and mathematical papers; also occurs in descriptions of a parameter varying with a variable.
patterns.domain: R code, mathematics, and physics papers

patterns.name: Local collocations of prepositions and relational words
patterns.context: Phrases in technical prose expressing relations, causes, units, basis, source, position, or conditions between objects; specific collocations vary across passages.

patterns.name: Scientific symbols and formula notation
patterns.context: Symbols and structures in mathematical typesetting, equation labels, or formulas; activation falls on different kinds of symbols, with no common formula template.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and variables in astronomical color diagrams
patterns.context: Astronomical abbreviations and variables appear when describing stellar samples, colors, and magnitude diagrams.

patterns.name: Text markers and topic terms in paper abstracts
patterns.context: Opening of an abstract and phrases about the power of density fluctuations and their relation to wavenumber.

patterns.name: Statistical analysis terminology
patterns.context: When discussing particle correlations, nonflow effects, and anisotropic-flow analysis methods.

patterns.name: Physical models and simulation conditions
patterns.context: Specifies the potential function, system size, and density used in molecular dynamics simulations.

patterns.name: Velocity and structure descriptions in astronomical observations
patterns.context: Describes observed stellar-stream samples, their velocity distributions, and structural features.

patterns.name: Group theory notation and divisibility conditions
patterns.context: Defines or enumerates positive divisors satisfying divisibility conditions and related transformations.

patterns.name: Energy and unit expressions
patterns.context: Reports energy gain per unit area along with physical dimensions.

patterns.name: Temperature, density, and critical values
patterns.context: Discusses how a temperature parameter varies with density and approximates the critical temperature.

patterns.name: Non-standard evaluation Q&A in R
patterns.context: A StackExchange answer recommends using dplyr's mutate_ to handle expression arguments.

3_1908.concept: 技术文本中的局部关系与符号
3_1908.description: 激活分布在多种学术文本与一段 R 问答中，常落在函数用语、关系词和公式记号，也涉及天文、物理、数学等各自专属术语；这些触发点跨领域，未呈现单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 数学与代码中的函数语法
patterns.context: 函数名、函数式或函数参数附近，尤其是代码及数学论文；也可见于参数随某变量变化的表述。
patterns.domain: R 代码、数学与物理论文

patterns.name: 介词与关系词的局部搭配
patterns.context: 技术叙述中表达对象间关系、原因、单位、依据、来源、位置或条件的短语；具体搭配各段不同。

patterns.name: 科学符号与公式标记
patterns.context: 数学排版、方程标签或公式内部的符号和结构；激活落在不同类型的符号上，未见统一公式模板。

patterns.name: 天文颜色图中的缩写与变量
patterns.context: 描述恒星样本、颜色及星等图时出现的天文缩写和变量。

patterns.name: 论文摘要中的文本标记与主题词
patterns.trigger: “---” “abstract:” “Intriguing parallels between density fluctuation power versus wavenumber”
patterns.context: 摘要开头及关于密度涨落功率与波数关系的短语。

patterns.name: 统计分析术语
patterns.context: 讨论粒子相关、非流效应及各向异性流分析方法时。

patterns.name: 物理模型与模拟条件
patterns.context: 交代分子动力学模拟所用势函数、体系规模和密度。

patterns.name: 天文观测中的速度与结构描述
patterns.trigger: “RR Lyrae stars” “Sagittarius tidal stream” “velocities is quite narrow” “coherent”
patterns.context: 描述恒星流观测样本及其速度分布和结构特征。

patterns.name: 群论记号与整除条件
patterns.context: 定义或枚举满足整除条件的正因子及相关变换。

patterns.name: 能量与单位表达
patterns.context: 以面积为基准报告能量增益，并附带物理量纲。

patterns.name: 温度、密度与临界值
patterns.context: 讨论温度参数随密度变化及临界温度的近似。

patterns.name: R 语言非标准求值问答
patterns.context: StackExchange 答案建议使用 dplyr 的 mutate_ 处理表达式参数。

en.concept: Relational and behavioral expressions, alongside isolated word fragments
en.description: Activations are fairly scattered: prominent are role or manner relations introduced by “as,” and predicates describing behavior, evolution, pursuit, and following; there are also isolated triggers such as a fragment within Bethe, a fragment within degrees, and “::” in R, which are difficult to group into the same semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “as” comparison/manner structure
patterns.context: Appears in structures such as “acts as” and “vanishes as,” connecting an object with its role, property, or manner of change.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers; quantum gravity, patent technology, mathematical physics

patterns.name: Behavioral or evolutionary predicates
patterns.context: Describes objects changing with conditions, exhibiting behavior, following a relation, or chasing movement on a graph.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and graph theory papers

patterns.name: Proper-name fragment Bethe
patterns.context: Appears in the theoretical method name “Bethe Ansatz”; activation falls on a fragment within the proper name.
patterns.domain: Nonequilibrium scattering and quantum many-body physics papers

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in degrees
patterns.context: Appears in the angle expression “$90 degrees$ instead of the full $360$”; activation falls on an internal fragment of degrees.

patterns.name: R namespace separator
patterns.context: Occurs within the package-qualified function name “dplyr::mutate_” in R code.

3_1908.concept: 关系与行为表述，兼有孤立词片段
3_1908.description: 激活分布较散：突出“as”引出的角色或方式关系，以及描述行为、演化、追逐和遵循的谓词；另有 Bethe、degrees 内部片段与 R 的“::”等孤立触发，难归入同一语义模式。

patterns.name: “as”比较/方式结构
patterns.context: 出现在“acts as”“vanishes as”等结构中，连接对象与其角色、性质或变化方式。
patterns.domain: 科学论文；量子引力、专利技术、数学物理

patterns.name: 行为或演化谓词
patterns.trigger: « o»2«sc»4«il»10«ates»2；« $»1P«/»4«k»2« »3« will»2« behave»2；“follows”附近的« as»9；« purs»9
patterns.context: 描述对象随条件变化、表现出某种行为、遵循某关系，或在图上追逐移动。

patterns.name: Bethe 专名片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Bethe Ansatz”这一理论方法名称中；激活落在专名的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 非平衡散射与量子多体物理论文

patterns.name: 度数词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“$90 degrees$ instead of the full $360$”的角度表述中；激活落在 degrees 的内部片段。

patterns.name: R 的命名空间分隔符
patterns.context: 处于 R 语言代码中的包限定函数名“dplyr::mutate_”内。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答，R 语言

en.concept: Mixed local substrings and formatting features
en.description: Activations occur in equ-id strings, mathematical formula boundaries, func in code, the grammatical word as, and local substrings in backhoes and deflected. Apart from equ-id, triggers are scattered and difficult to explain with a single semantic account.

patterns.name: equ- strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on the id substring following equ, forming equidistant, equi-spaced, and equidimensional; the breakpoint varies slightly across spellings.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions and mathematics papers

patterns.name: Formula and LaTeX structure
patterns.context: At the introduction of a formula or mathematical expression, especially before the formula marker $$; nearby text often contains equation, functional, or a label.

patterns.name: func code identifier
patterns.context: In a JavaScript/React props object, func is the type declaration PropTypes.func; the code snippet has no matching equ pattern.

patterns.name: as and theoretical exposition
patterns.context: The grammatical word as appears in “acts as an independent …” and “equation can be rewritten as $$”; its position and meaning differ.

patterns.name: ho in backhoes
patterns.context: In a patent background passage, activation falls within the word backhoes; surrounding text discusses excavators.

patterns.name: Word ending in beam deflection
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated at the beginning of deflected, describing a beam deflected by a polygon mirror.

3_1908.concept: 混合的局部子串与格式特征
3_1908.description: 激活分布于 equ-id 字符串、数学公式边界、代码中的 func、语法词 as，以及 backhoes 和 deflected 的局部子串；除 equ-id 外，触发条件分散，难以由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: equ- 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在 equ 后续的 id 子串中，形成 equidistant、equi-spaced、equidimensional；不同拼写中断位置略有不同。
patterns.domain: 专利技术描述、数学论文

patterns.name: 公式与 LaTeX 结构
patterns.context: 公式或数学表达式的引入处，尤其是公式标记 $$ 前；附近常有 equation、functional 或标签。

patterns.name: func 代码标识符
patterns.context: JavaScript/React 属性对象中，func 是 PropTypes.func 的类型声明；代码片段中没有相同的 equ 模式。

patterns.name: as 与理论叙述
patterns.context: 语法中的 as，分别出现在“acts as an independent …”和“equation can be rewritten as $$”中；位置与语义不同。

patterns.name: backhoes 中的 ho
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中，激活落在 backhoes 一词内部；周围讨论挖掘机。

patterns.name: 光束偏转词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中于 deflected 一词开头，描述多面镜偏转的光束。

en.concept: equ/id stems and academic formula fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to equ/id stems and properties such as equal spacing and equal dimension; also activates on local fragments involving formula introductions, mathematical terms and symbols, and enzyme parameter labels, across several academic styles.

patterns.name: Equidimensional geometric objects
patterns.context: Describes the dimensional properties of a variety in the context of analytic varieties/algebraic geometry

patterns.name: Equidistant grating
patterns.context: A Moire measurement process forms equally spaced gratings on a test object

patterns.name: Double mathematical notation/formula transcription
patterns.context: Section headings and formula-introduction statements for the double Fourier transform and dispersion equation

patterns.name: Atkin–Lehner and divisibility conditions
patterns.context: Lists involutions in modular forms or number theory, and states conditions on positive divisors and greatest common divisors

patterns.name: Equally spaced sampling and time averages
patterns.context: Defines a time average and assumes equally spaced measurement or sampling times

patterns.name: Equation-rewriting phrasing
patterns.context: Introduces compact notation and rewritten equations for formulas involving stochastic systems/state variables

patterns.name: Enzyme kinetics parameter labels
patterns.context: Lists units for enzyme kinetics parameters in an erratum
patterns.domain: Erratum to a structural biology paper

patterns.name: Formula expression on the right-hand side of an inequality
patterns.context: States in a proof that the right-hand side of an inequality can be written as a sum

patterns.name: Equidistant gold atom spacing
patterns.context: Describes equidistant Au–Au separations between adjacent gold clusters in an extended chain structure

patterns.name: Specialized quantum gravity terminology
patterns.context: Discussion of quantum gravity and Chern–Simons boundary theory

3_1908.concept: equ/id 词干与学术公式片段
3_1908.description: 主要响应 equ/id 词干及等间隔、等维等性质；另对公式导入、数学术语与符号、酶参数标签等局部片段有激活，分布于多种学术文体。

patterns.name: equidimensional 几何对象
patterns.context: 解析簇/代数几何语境中描述 variety 的维数性质

patterns.name: 等距光栅
patterns.context: Moire 测量过程在测试物体上形成间距相等的光栅

patterns.name: 双重数学记号/公式转写
patterns.context: 双 Fourier 变换及色散方程的小节标题、公式导入语句

patterns.name: Atkin–Lehner 与整除条件
patterns.context: 模形式或数论中列举 involution，并陈述正因子及最大公因数条件

patterns.name: 等间隔采样与时间平均
patterns.context: 定义时间平均，并假设测量或采样时刻等间隔

patterns.name: 方程重写措辞
patterns.context: 随机系统/状态变量公式中引出紧凑记法和改写后的方程

patterns.name: 酶动力学参数标签
patterns.context: 勘误说明中列出酶动力学参数的单位

patterns.name: 不等式右侧的公式表达
patterns.context: 证明中说明不等式右侧可写为某个求和式

patterns.name: 等距金原子间距
patterns.context: 描述延展链结构中相邻金团簇之间的等距 Au–Au 间隔

patterns.name: 量子引力专门术语
patterns.context: 量子引力与 Chern–Simons 边界理论的讨论

en.description: Activations occur across internal subwords, symbols, and short collocations in diverse contexts: as constructions, gambler/cop narratives, function labels, oscillates, R code, doctest, statistical symbols, mathematical proper nouns, and physiological terminology. No clear unified semantic or stylistic pattern emerges.

patterns.name: “as” and following constructions
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on “as” or falls within the collocation “acts as a,” followed by a noun phrase expressing identity, function, or manner.
patterns.domain: ArXiv quantum gravity and USPTO patent background

patterns.name: Fragments in gambler/cop strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments in gambler and pursues, as well as on on; gambler and on recur in the same passage.

patterns.name: Function-related terms and labels
patterns.context: In technical contexts involving functions, functionals, metric graphs, and equation labels, activation falls within words such as function/functionals or within labels.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of oscillates
patterns.context: When describing a sequence alternating between +1 and -1, activation is concentrated on an internal subword fragment of oscillates.

patterns.name: R code identifiers and function calls
patterns.context: In R code and its explanatory text, activation falls on fragments of drm, fit, data arguments, and function identifiers.

patterns.name: Fragment in Sphinx extension name
patterns.context: In a Python configuration list, activation falls within the extension module name doctest.

patterns.name: Statistical significance and degrees-of-freedom symbols
patterns.context: In medical research results, activation falls on the chi-square symbol, degrees-of-freedom symbol, and related equals signs.

patterns.name: Fragments of proper nouns in mathematical literature
patterns.context: Near mathematical terms and names such as finite fields, local fields, adeles, and Weil, activation falls on internal word fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments in physiological terms and species names
patterns.context: When describing current types, hair cells, and the saccular organ of toadfish, activation falls within abbreviations and species/anatomical terms.

3_1908.description: 激活分布于多种语境中的词内子词、符号及短搭配：as结构、gambler/cop叙述、函数标签、oscillates、R代码、doctest、统计符号、数学专名和生理术语；没有明显统一的语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: “as”及其后续结构
patterns.trigger: « as»10 an independent Chern-Simons；« acts»3« as»9« a»1 filter
patterns.context: 激活集中在“as”上，或落在“acts as a”这一搭配中，后接名词短语，表示身份、功能或方式。

patterns.name: gambler/cop 词串中的碎片
patterns.trigger: A« gamb»5ler moves« on»5；A« cop»2« purs»10ues the« gamb»2ler« on»3
patterns.context: 激活落在 gambler、pursues 的子词片段及 on；同一段中反复出现 gambler 和 on。

patterns.name: 函数相关术语与标签
patterns.context: 在函数、泛函、度量图及公式标签等技术语境中，激活落在 function/functionals 一类词或标签内部片段。

patterns.name: 振荡词内部片段
patterns.context: 在描述数列在 +1 与 -1 之间交替时，激活集中于 oscillates 的内部子词片段。

patterns.name: R代码标识符及函数调用
patterns.context: 在R代码及其说明文字中，激活落在 drm、fit、数据参数和函数标识符的片段。

patterns.name: Sphinx扩展名称片段
patterns.context: Python配置列表中，激活落在扩展模块名称 doctest 的内部片段。

patterns.name: 统计显著性与自由度符号
patterns.context: 医学研究结果报告中，激活落在卡方符号、自由度符号及其等号等统计记号。

patterns.name: 数学文献中的专名碎片
patterns.context: 有限域、局部域、阿代尔以及 Weil 等数学术语或专名附近，激活落在词内片段。

patterns.name: 生理术语与物种名称片段
patterns.context: 描述电流类型、毛细胞和 toadfish 囊状器官时，激活落在缩写及物种/解剖术语内部片段。

en.description: Activates across different fields and styles, often on split subword fragments and near formula symbols; outside formula/paper contexts, trigger-word meanings vary and are difficult to group into a unified theme.

patterns.name: Fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations often fall on split fragments inside words; the fragments are inconsistent and have no clear shared meaning. Tokenization boundaries in different words may be important.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, including web text, mathematical physics, biomedicine, and astrophysics

patterns.name: Formula and mathematical symbol sequences
patterns.context: In mathematics papers, activations occur near formulas, LaTeX commands, and symbol-dense expressions; some trigger words are ordinary words split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Technical terms and English fragments in scientific papers
patterns.context: Technical vocabulary, word-form fragments, and technical phrasing in paper bodies or titles; no unified specific discipline or stable meaning.
patterns.domain: ArXiv physics and astrophysics papers, also NIH biomedical text

patterns.name: Items or prohibited objects in a list
patterns.context: A bulleted list of guest conduct rules lists weapons; the word is split in the sentence.
patterns.domain: Web rules or venue policy text

3_1908.description: 激活跨不同领域与文体，常落在被拆分的词片段及公式符号附近；除公式/论文语境外，触发词语义分散，难以归为统一主题。

patterns.name: 单词内部的片段触发
patterns.context: 激活常落在被拆分的词内部片段上；片段本身并不一致，也没有明显共同词义。不同词的分词边界可能是关键。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，包括网页文本、数学物理、生物医学和天体物理

patterns.name: 公式与数学符号序列
patterns.context: 数学论文中，激活出现在公式、LaTeX 命令及符号密集的表达式附近；有些触发词本身是普通词被分词拆开。

patterns.name: 科技论文中的专业术语与英文片段
patterns.context: 论文正文或标题中的专业词汇、词形片段和技术表述；没有统一的具体学科或稳定语义。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 物理及天体物理论文，也包括 NIH 生物医学文本

patterns.name: 名单中的物品或禁用品
patterns.context: 宾客行为规范的项目符号清单中，列举武器；该词在句中被拆分。
patterns.domain: 网页规则或场馆政策文本

en.concept: Internal subword fragments and academic notation
en.description: Activations span rule lists and papers across multiple fields, often falling on subword fragments within compound words; LaTeX formula commands, technical terminology, and several academic relational expressions also occur. The topics vary greatly across passages and are difficult to reduce to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Token boundaries within compound words
patterns.context: Activation often falls on subword fragments or adjacent subword fragments inside a word, rather than on the whole word; it may be sensitive to particular token fragments or local word forms.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; passage 1 is a rule list, passages 2–10 are academic papers

patterns.name: Mathematical notation and formula markers
patterns.context: Occurs in LaTeX equations, equation labels, or formula formatting fragments; activation is distributed across commands and their components.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical physics papers, including LaTeX

patterns.name: “as” followed by descriptive or quantitative expressions
patterns.context: Relational, analogical, or results descriptions in academic exposition; high-activation fragments fall on words such as acts / as / an, scale / as / a, and what.

patterns.name: on in mathematical or technical contexts
patterns.context: Occurs near motion on graphs, function definitions, or theoretical statements; activation is low and may reflect common collocations, so it is difficult to establish as an independent semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Graph theory, mathematical physics, and scientific papers

patterns.name: knife in a list of prohibited items
patterns.context: A list enumerates prohibited or inappropriate items; weapons appears earlier, followed by Guest may be detained if.

patterns.name: Vocabulary of rotation and angular momentum transport
patterns.context: Astrophysical exposition about accreting material, disks, and radial transport of angular momentum, adjacent to formulas.

patterns.name: Vocabulary of flow profiles and energy dissipation
patterns.context: Discusses stable modes, shear flow, and energy injection scales; activated words are scattered among descriptive terminology.

patterns.name: Critical lines and the term dressing
patterns.context: Discusses non-universality of critical lines and the failure of perturbative methods, and compares the dressing of critical lines with second-order phase transition theory.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter or phase transition research papers

patterns.name: Nonlinear Schrödinger energy functional
patterns.context: Introduces the nonlinear Schrödinger energy functional on a graph and its corresponding equation label.

patterns.name: Pursuit-evasion game on a graph
patterns.context: Describes a gambler moving between graph vertices and police pursuing them on the graph; the internal fragment of pursues is particularly prominent.

patterns.name: Quantum gravity and boundary theory
patterns.context: Mentions quantum gravity, holonomies around punctures, and the role of boundary theory as an independent Chern-Simons theory.

patterns.name: Temperature scaling and linear resistivity
patterns.context: Distinguishes phonon-scattering temperature regimes and states that resistivity varies linearly with temperature in the high-temperature regime.

patterns.name: Representation-theoretic branching rules and projection operators
patterns.context: Contains abstract branching rules, projection onto a term, and representation-theoretic formulas with citations.

patterns.name: Atkin-Lehner involutions and divisibility conditions
patterns.context: Defines Atkin-Lehner involutions and explains that e is a positive divisor of N, with a coprimality condition.

patterns.name: Sporadic high-activation words that are difficult to classify
patterns.context: Occur respectively in analogical expressions, number-theoretic notation, and astrophysical formulas; the available passages do not establish whether they share an independent trigger condition.

3_1908.concept: 词内子词片段与学术记号
3_1908.description: 激活跨规则清单与多领域论文，常落在复合词内部的子词片段；另见LaTeX公式命令、技术术语及若干学术关系表达。各段的主题差异很大，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 复合词内部的 token 边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在单词内部的子词片段或相邻子词片段上，而非完整单词；可能对特定分词片段或局部词形敏感。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；第1段规则清单，第2–10段学术论文

patterns.name: 数学记号与公式标记
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学公式、方程标签或公式排版片段中；激活分布在命令及其组成部分。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论物理论文，含 LaTeX

patterns.name: “as”后接描述或量化表达
patterns.trigger: «acts»« as»« an»（4）；« scale»« as»« a»（6）；« analogous»« to»« what»（5、9）
patterns.context: 学术论述中的关系、类比或结果描述；片段中的高激活落在 acts / as / an、scale / as / a、what 等词上。

patterns.name: 数学或技术语境中的 on
patterns.context: 出现在图上的运动、函数定义或理论表述附近；激活强度较低，可能只是常见搭配，难以确定为独立语义模式。
patterns.domain: 图论、数学物理及科学论文

patterns.name: 禁带物品清单中的 knife
patterns.context: 清单列举禁止或不适当物品，前文有 weapons，后接 Guest may be detained if。

patterns.name: 旋转与角动量输运语汇
patterns.context: 围绕吸积物质、盘及角动量径向输运的天体物理论述，并紧邻公式。

patterns.name: 流动剖面与能量耗散语汇
patterns.trigger: « flow»« profile»、« constant» shear、« fluctuation» energy
patterns.context: 讨论稳定模态、剪切流及能量注入尺度；激活词分散在描述性术语中。
patterns.domain: 流体或等离子体物理论文

patterns.name: 临界线与 dressing 术语
patterns.context: 讨论临界线非普适性及微扰方法无效，并把临界线的 dressing 与二阶相变理论作类比。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态或相变研究论文

patterns.name: 非线性薛定谔能量泛函
patterns.context: 介绍图上的非线性薛定谔能量泛函及相应方程标签。

patterns.name: 图上的追逃博弈
patterns.context: 描述赌徒在图的顶点间移动、警察在图上追逐；主要突出 pursues 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 量子引力与边界理论
patterns.trigger: « quantum» gravity、« hol»onom«ies»、« punct»ures、« acts»« as»« an»
patterns.context: 谈及量子引力、绕 punctures 的 holonomies，以及边界理论作为独立 Chern-Simons 理论的作用。

patterns.name: 温度标度与线性电阻率
patterns.context: 区分声子散射温区，并陈述高温区电阻率随温度线性变化。

patterns.name: 表示论分支律与投影算子
patterns.context: 含抽象分支律、投影到某项及带引用的表示论公式。

patterns.name: Atkin-Lehner involutions 与整除条件
patterns.context: 定义 Atkin-Lehner involutions，并解释 e 是 N 的正因子及互素条件。

patterns.name: 无法明确归类的零散高激活词
patterns.context: 分别处于类比表达、数论符号及天体物理公式中；难以由现有片段判定是否有独立共同触发条件。

en.description: Activations span many fields, often on academic terminology, formulas/markup, and within-word fragments; they also appear in lists, domain names, experimental records, and patent descriptions. They cannot be reduced to a single stable semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: k/i/e letter fragments in knife or weapon names
patterns.context: Appears in a list of prohibited items, followed by “Guest may be detained if…”; the activation falls on a tokenized fragment inside a word.

patterns.name: on/using/distribution/cop/pursues in a graph pursuit problem
patterns.context: Describes a gambler and a cop moving among graph vertices and pursuing each other; several prepositions, method words, and role/action words activate.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in domain suffixes
patterns.context: Lists domains beginning with the same string; activations concentrate on different suffixes or suffix fragments, without a clear semantically consistent word class.

patterns.name: Formula formatting and representation/equation vocabulary in mathematics papers
patterns.context: After a section heading, introduces a double-integral representation, dispersion equation, and double Fourier transform; activations involve both terminology and LaTeX/section markup.

patterns.name: Functionals and integral-functional formulas
patterns.context: NLS energy functional on a metric graph and formula labels; some activations fall on functionals, formula environments, and label strings.
patterns.domain: Mathematical physics paper, nonlinear Schrödinger equation

patterns.name: Facts, dressing, and theoretical analogies in scientific discussion
patterns.context: Explains the non-universality of a critical line and its dressing, using second-order phase-transition theory as an analogy; different activated words occur in explanatory/comparative discussion.

patterns.name: Mean field and gap equation in field theory
patterns.context: Discusses the effect of a constant term on fluctuations and observables, then introduces a variable satisfying the gap equation; activations occur on both terminology and general words.

patterns.name: Flow/shear and energy-injection terminology
patterns.context: Describes shear flow within a fixed layer, nonlinear excitation of a stable mode, and a fluctuation energy cascade; activations include compound-word fragments and physics terms.

patterns.name: Instrument labels in diffraction scan records
patterns.context: Experimental parameter table for a graphite sample, with detector and scan notes and crystallographic indices; activations fall on punctuation, Greek-letter fragments, and measurement terms.

patterns.name: Descriptions of material surfaces and mechanical component properties
patterns.context: Explains the use of a star washer on a metal surface and how its teeth deform like springs and return to flat; activations involve surface materials and action/shape words.

3_1908.description: 激活覆盖多种领域，常落在学术术语、公式/标记及词内片段，也见清单、域名、实验记录和专利描述；无法归结为单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 刀具或武器名称中的 k/i/e 字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在禁止携带物品清单中，后接“Guest may be detained if…”；激活落在单词内部的分词片段。

patterns.name: 图论追逐问题中的 on/using/distribution/cop/pursues
patterns.trigger: «on» the vertices；«using» the probability «distribution»；«cop» «purs»ues；«on» the graph
patterns.context: 描述 gambler 与 cop 在图的顶点上移动及追逐，若干介词、方法词和角色/动作词均有激活。

patterns.name: 域名后缀中的字母片段
patterns.context: 连续列举以同一字符串开头的域名；激活集中在不同后缀或后缀片段，未形成明显语义一致的词类。

patterns.name: 数学论文中的公式排版与表示/方程词汇
patterns.context: 小节标题后引出双重积分表示、色散方程及双重傅里叶变换，激活同时涉及术语和 LaTeX/章节标记。
patterns.domain: 数学/物理论文及公式排版

patterns.name: 函数泛函及积分泛函公式
patterns.context: 度量图上的 NLS 能量泛函与公式标签；激活部分落在泛函、公式环境及标签字符串中。
patterns.domain: 数学物理论文，非线性薛定谔方程

patterns.name: 科学论述中的事实、 dressing 与理论类比
patterns.context: 解释临界线非普适及其修饰，并用二阶相变理论作类比；不同激活词都处于说明/比较论述中。

patterns.name: 场论中的平均场与 gap equation
patterns.context: 讨论常数项对涨落和可观测量的作用，并引出满足 gap equation 的变量；激活分布在术语与一般词上。

patterns.name: 流动/剪切及能量注入术语
patterns.context: 描述固定层内的剪切流、稳定模非线性激发及涨落能量级联；激活包含复合词片段和物理术语。
patterns.domain: 流体/等离子体物理论文

patterns.name: 衍射扫描记录中的仪器标注
patterns.context: 石墨样品的实验参数表格，出现探测器和扫描说明及晶体学索引；激活落在标点、希腊字母片段和测量词上。

patterns.name: 材料表面与机械部件的性质描述
patterns.context: 说明星形垫圈在金属表面上的应用，以及齿部像弹簧一样变形并恢复平坦；激活涉及表面物质与动作/形状词。

en.concept: Mixed word fragments and short academic words
en.description: Activations are scattered: what is prominent in academic comparison structures; internal fragments of Scifinder/Scifres also occur, along with sporadic short words or substrings in formulas, proper nouns, and academic terminology. The examples have no single clear trigger condition.

patterns.name: what introducing a comparison or analogy
patterns.context: what is followed by a clause or comparison, explaining what would happen, what something resembles, or how it contrasts with an existing result; word order and preceding structures vary.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially scientific and technical exposition

patterns.name: Fragment within the proper name Scifinder
patterns.context: Occurs only inside a proper name: in one case a patent inventor's surname, in another a database name; no shared syntactic function is required.

patterns.name: Isolated internal fragment if
patterns.context: Occurs within a word in one case (“g«if»t”) and as a conditional conjunction in another (“«if» the direct scheme was used”). The contexts differ markedly.

patterns.name: as in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Occurs in academic text near formulas, used respectively in “as follows” and in an equation/formula context; the activated target is a common short word.

patterns.name: Scattered short words or affix fragments
patterns.context: Occur sporadically within academic English words, abbreviations, or LaTeX/mathematical expressions, with no shared clear syntactic or topical condition.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of an RNA abbreviation
patterns.context: Occurs in a parenthesized abbreviation for an RNA structural classification; there is insufficient evidence of a connection to other activations.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in fluid physics terminology
patterns.context: Occurs within the physics term “gyroradius”; it is an internal word fragment with no repeated cross-passage pattern.

patterns.name: Fragment in functionals terminology
patterns.context: Part of “functionals,” in a mathematical context discussing the energy functional for stationary NLS on a graph.

3_1908.concept: 混合词片段与学术短词
3_1908.description: 激活分布较散：突出出现在学术比较结构中的 what；另有 Scifinder/Scifres 的词内片段，以及公式、专名和学术词语中的零散短词或子串。各例没有统一的明确触发条件。

patterns.name: what 引导比较或类比
patterns.trigger: « what»，以及“than « what»”“analogous to « what»”“similar to « what»”“« what» has been found”等结构
patterns.context: what 后接从句或比较项，用来说明会怎样、与什么相似或与既有结果对照；词序和前置结构各异。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其科学技术论述

patterns.name: Scifinder 专名中的片段
patterns.context: 仅在专名内部触发；一处是专利发明人姓氏，另一处是数据库名称，不要求相同句法功能。

patterns.name: 孤立的词内片段 if
patterns.context: 出现在词内部：一处为“g«if»t”，另一处为“«if» the direct scheme was used”；前者是词片段，后者是条件连词。两例语境差异明显。

patterns.name: 数学排版中的 as
patterns.context: 出现在公式附近的学术文本中，分别用于“as follows”和算式/公式上下文；激活对象是常见短词。

patterns.name: 分散的短词或词缀片段
patterns.context: 零散出现在英语学术词语、缩写或 LaTeX/数学表达内部，未见共享的明确句法或主题条件。

patterns.name: RNA 缩写内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 RNA 结构分类名称的括号缩写中；没有足够证据表明它与其他激活有联系。

patterns.name: 流体物理词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“gyroradius”这一物理术语内部，属于词内片段，未形成跨段重复模式。
patterns.domain: 等离子体/流体物理论文

patterns.name: 函数泛函术语片段
patterns.context: 组成“functionals”，出现在讨论图上的驻态 NLS 能量泛函的数学语境中。

en.concept: what comparative constructions and Schafer spelling fragments
en.description: Activations are most clearly concentrated on comparisons, analogies, or counterfactual clauses introduced by what, and on Schafer/Schaefer spelling fragments; several instances of to and technical words and symbols also highlight, but are difficult to explain as part of the main pattern.

patterns.name: what followed by a counterfactual or similar object
patterns.context: In a what-clause, what and the following predicate form a comparative, analogical, or counterfactual construction; examples include “faster than what…would be”, “similar to what…”, and “analogous to what…”.
patterns.domain: Academic papers in computational physics, plasma physics, and phase-transition theory

patterns.name: Comparative preposition to in sentences
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on to, but its structures vary: the first two introduce objects of analogy, while the last introduces a switch to a different product; not every to triggers activation.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and HackerNews blog text

patterns.name: Schafer/Schaefer name fragments in citations
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized fragments of the Schafer/Schaefer name spelling; they occur mainly in academic citations, and also in a personal blog domain.

patterns.name: Other sporadic highlighted words and symbols
patterns.context: These highlights appear in different grammatical or technical contexts; the available snippets are insufficient to establish a shared trigger condition, so they cannot reliably be grouped with the patterns above.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics formulas, crystallographic tables, StackExchange questions and answers, and academic papers

3_1908.concept: what 比较结构与 Schafer 拼写片段
3_1908.description: 激活最明确地集中于 what 引导的比较、类比或反事实从句，以及 Schafer/Schaefer 拼写片段；若干 to 和技术词、符号也有高亮，但难以与主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: what 后接反事实或相似对象
patterns.trigger: “what would be” [2]；“what has been found” [3]；“what happens” [4]
patterns.context: 在 what 引导的从句中，what 与后续谓语构成比较、类比或反事实结构；分别出现在“faster than what…would be”“similar to what…”及“analogous to what…”中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，涉及计算物理、等离子体物理和相变理论

patterns.name: 句中比较介词 to
patterns.context: 激活集中在 to，但它所处结构不同：前两处引出类比对象，后一处引出改换到的产品；并非所有 to 都触发。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及 HackerNews 博客文字

patterns.name: 文献引用中的 Schafer/Schaefer 姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的 Schafer/Schaefer 姓名拼写片段中；主要位于学术文献引用，另见个人博客域名。

patterns.name: 其他零散高亮词及符号
patterns.context: 这些高亮出现在各自不同的语法或技术语境中；现有片段不足以确定它们共享触发条件，不能可靠归入上述模式。
patterns.domain: 天体物理公式、晶体学表格、StackExchange 问答及学术论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across scientific terminology, cited names, code identifiers, abbreviations, table symbols, and formula symbols, as well as ordinary words and word fragments; there is no stable, consistent semantic or stylistic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Grid before domain-specific nouns
patterns.context: In scientific and technical papers, a term itself or a noun in a noun phrase is marked; topics include QCD, conformal field theory, higher-curvature gravity, and magnetic field models.

patterns.name: Author-name fragments in citations
patterns.context: Letter fragments appearing in bibliographic citations or author names are activated, usually embedded in names or citation identifiers.

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and code word fragments
patterns.context: Ordinary English fragments in code, filenames, or class names are marked, such as testdll, test, and stdafx.h.

patterns.name: Character fragments in RNA classification abbreviations
patterns.context: Characters in the abbreviation for the bioinformatics database RNA (scAR) are marked.

patterns.name: Patent inventor name fragments
patterns.context: Scifres and Burnham in a patent background are split into fragments and marked.

patterns.name: Table symbols and experimental terminology
patterns.context: Angle symbols, scanning descriptions, and technical terms appear in experimental data tables.

patterns.name: English function words and ordinary word fragments
patterns.context: Common words or initial/internal fragments in scientific prose are marked, with no consistent local semantic condition.

patterns.name: AdS name fragment
patterns.context: The name anti-de Sitter (AdS) is tokenized in a higher-curvature gravity context.

patterns.name: Astrophysical event name fragments
patterns.context: In sentences describing supernova observations and SN 1987A, both ordinary words and fragments of cited author names are activated.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous journal/author-name fragments in citations
patterns.context: Internal fragments of various surnames or bibliography entries are marked in reference lists.

patterns.name: Isolated formal symbols
patterns.context: Mathematical symbols near magnetohydrodynamic/solar dynamo model formulas are marked, while ordinary prose words also occur in the same passage.

3_1908.description: 激活分散于科学术语、引文姓名、代码标识、缩写、表格符号和公式符号，也包括普通词及词片段；没有稳定一致的语义或文体触发条件。

patterns.name: 格位于领域性名词前
patterns.context: 科学技术论文中，术语名词本身或名词短语中的名词被标记；涉及 QCD、共形场论、高曲率引力及磁场模型等

patterns.name: 引用文献中的作者名片段
patterns.context: 文献引用或作者姓名中出现的字母片段被激活，通常夹杂在姓名或引文标识内

patterns.name: 技术标识符与代码词片段
patterns.context: 代码、文件名或类名中的普通英文片段被标记，如 testdll、test 和 stdafx.h

patterns.name: RNA分类缩写中的字符片段
patterns.context: 生物信息学数据库名称 RNA (scAR) 的缩写字符被标记

patterns.name: 专利发明人姓名片段
patterns.context: 专利背景中的人名 Scifres 和 Burnham 被拆分后标记

patterns.name: 表格符号与实验术语
patterns.context: 实验数据表格中出现角度符号、扫描描述及技术术语

patterns.name: 英文功能词及普通词片段
patterns.context: 科学叙述中的常见词或词首/词内片段被标记，缺少一致的局部语义条件

patterns.name: AdS专名片段
patterns.context: 高曲率引力语境下的 anti-de Sitter (AdS) 名称被分词标记

patterns.name: 天体物理事件名称片段
patterns.context: 描述超新星观测及 SN 1987A 的句子中，普通词和引用作者名片段均有激活

patterns.name: 引文中的期刊/作者名杂项
patterns.context: 参考文献列表中各类姓氏或条目文本的内部片段被标记

patterns.name: 孤立的形式化符号
patterns.context: 磁流体/太阳发电机模型公式附近的数学符号被标记，但同段还出现普通叙述词

en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments in patent search names, academic citation author names, and physics and biomedical terminology; apart from proper names and citation formats, no unified meaning or stable word class is apparent.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in patent citations
patterns.context: Personal names and database names appear in patent or patent-search backgrounds; activations concentrate on spelling fragments like Scif/Sciffer.

patterns.name: Author name fragments in literature citations
patterns.context: Authors or citation keys are listed with brackets or @ markers in academic text; activations fall on fragments of name spellings.

patterns.name: Wave-related vocabulary in physical descriptions
patterns.context: Describes physical phenomena involving particle collisions, photons, and undulating propagation along a wire.

patterns.name: Anti-de Sitter spacetime terminology
patterns.context: AdS terminology appears in theoretical results on high-curvature gravity and conformal field theory.

patterns.name: Stillwell spelling fragments in a proper name
patterns.context: A historical figure's name appears in the references of an encyclopedia entry.

patterns.name: RNA structural classification abbreviation
patterns.context: Introduces a database for classifying RNA structural data and gives its abbreviation.

3_1908.description: 激活分散在专利检索名、学术引文作者名及物理、生物医学术语等局部片段；除专名和引用格式外，未见统一语义或稳定词类。

patterns.name: 专利引用中的姓氏片段
patterns.trigger: «Sc»1«if»10res and« Burn»1ham；The Sc«if»9inder and Delphion databases
patterns.context: 专利或专利检索背景中出现人名、数据库名；激活集中在 Scif/Sciffer 一类拼写片段。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、药物化学综述

patterns.name: 文献引文中的作者姓名片段
patterns.context: 学术文本中以方括号、@标记列举作者或文献键；激活落在姓名拼写的片段上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及参考文献

patterns.name: 物理描述中的波动词汇
patterns.context: 描述粒子碰撞、光子以及沿导线起伏传播的物理现象。

patterns.name: 反德西特时空术语
patterns.context: 高曲率引力与共形场论的理论结果中出现 AdS 术语。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Stillwell 拼写片段
patterns.context: 历史人物姓名出现在百科条目的参考资料中。

patterns.name: RNA 结构分类缩写
patterns.context: 介绍 RNA 结构数据分类数据库并给出其缩写。

en.description: Activations often occur on name fragments spelled Schäfer or similarly, and also on author names in paper citations. Sporadic triggers include scientific terms, common function words, and patent inventors’ names, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Schäfer surname and variants
patterns.context: The spelling Schäfer/Schaffer or similar appears in a personal name or cited author name; capitalization and variants differ.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, QCD papers, blogs, and forum comments

patterns.name: Author names in paper citations
patterns.context: Author names occur in a bracketed citation list, usually alongside other references separated by semicolons.

patterns.name: Local strings in scientific terms or proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations occur inside terms or abbreviations in scientific text; the specific meanings and topics vary across instances.
patterns.domain: Supernovae, RNA structure, biophysics, and astrophysics

patterns.name: Common function words or symbols at tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on common words, whitespace, or phrase components in discussion or formula explanations, with no stable topical condition.

patterns.name: Local spellings other than Schäfer in names
patterns.context: Occurs in names cited in patents; differs from the academic citation or forum-name contexts in other passages.

3_1908.concept: 姓名与局部字符串片段
3_1908.description: 激活常落在 Schäfer/近似拼写的人名片段，也见于论文引用中的作者名；另有科学术语、普通功能词及专利人名等零散触发，缺乏统一语义条件。

patterns.name: Schäfer 姓氏及其变体
patterns.context: 人名或文献作者名中出现 Schäfer/Schaffer 一类拼写；大小写和变体不同。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、QCD 文献、博客与论坛评论

patterns.name: 论文引用中的作者名
patterns.context: 作者姓名位于方括号引用列表中，通常与分号分隔的其他文献引用并列。

patterns.name: 科学术语或专名中的局部字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在科学文本的术语或缩写内部；各处对应的具体词义和主题不同。
patterns.domain: 超新星、RNA 结构、生物物理与天体物理

patterns.name: 分词边界处的常用功能词或符号
patterns.context: 在论述或公式说明中，激活落于普通词、空白位置或短语成分，未见稳定主题条件。
patterns.domain: 宗教文本分析、量子信息论文

patterns.name: 姓名中非 Schäfer 的局部拼写
patterns.context: 出现在专利所引的人名中；与其他段落的学术引用或论坛人名场景不同。

en.concept: Specific name tokenization and academic technical text fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to tokenized fragments of the name Scha(e)fer, and also to fragments of the name Faddeev; there are also activations on collocations such as in/terms/of in scientific papers and on scattered technical words, citations, and proper names.

patterns.name: Subwords of the name Schafer/Schaefer
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized subwords of the name Schafer/Schaefer; sometimes it is an author in a reference, sometimes a HackerNews username or URL.
patterns.domain: ArXiv citations, technical blogs, and HackerNews comments

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of Faddeev
patterns.context: Occurs in the physics terms Faddeev–Popov determinant or Faddeev techniques; activation corresponds to a specific tokenized fragment within the name.

patterns.name: in terms of collocation in scientific text
patterns.context: Academic phrasing includes the preposition in, especially in combinations with terms, of, and field in formulas or descriptions of decomposition and expansion; the examples are not all identical continuous phrases.

patterns.name: Local vocabulary in other technical papers
patterns.context: Appears respectively in contexts of quantum gate evolution decomposition, conformal field theory, and anti-de Sitter space; no obvious shared trigger structure is apparent.
patterns.domain: Quantum information, field theory, and gravity papers

patterns.name: Sporadic scientific vocabulary
patterns.context: These activations occur in nuclear reactions, relativistic physics, and astrophysics texts, and are difficult to group into the same stable collocation.

patterns.name: Citation fragments that do not fit other patterns
patterns.context: Includes local subword activations in author names or product names; apart from their proper-name character, there is insufficient evidence that they share the main pattern.

3_1908.concept: 特定姓名分词与学术技术文本片段
3_1908.description: 主要响应 Scha(e)fer 姓名的分词片段，也响应 Faddeev 姓名片段；另有科学论文中 in/terms/of 等搭配及分散的技术词、引文和专名激活。

patterns.name: 人名 Schafer/Schaefer 的子词
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名 Schafer/Schaefer 的分词子词上；有时是参考文献中的作者，有时是 HackerNews 用户名或 URL。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 引文、技术博客及 HackerNews 评论

patterns.name: Faddeev 的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在物理学术语 Faddeev–Popov determinant 或 Faddeev techniques 中，激活对应姓名内部的特定分词片段。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的 in terms of 搭配
patterns.trigger: « in»4 the« background»2« field»2（[4]）、« in»4« terms»9（[8]）、« in»6« terms»9« of»2« a»1（[9]）
patterns.context: 学术表述中出现介词 in，尤其与 terms、of、field 等组成公式或描述分解、展开的搭配；各段并非完全相同的连续短语。

patterns.name: 其他技术论文中的局部词汇
patterns.context: 分别出现在量子门演化分解、共形场论及反德西特空间语境中，未见共同的明显触发结构。
patterns.domain: 量子信息、场论与引力论文

patterns.name: 零散科学词汇
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在核反应、相对论物理和天体物理文本中，难以归为同一个稳定搭配。

patterns.name: 难以归入其他模式的引用片段
patterns.context: 包含作者姓名或产品名的局部子词激活；除姓名/专名性质外，没有足够证据表明它们与主模式相同。
patterns.domain: 学术引文与 HackerNews 博客

en.description: Activations are scattered across substrings within words, proper nouns and citation fragments, as well as English phrases near formulas (especially “can be rewritten” and “in terms of”); there is no single stable semantic pattern. Blog words and URL fragments also occur.

patterns.name: Embedded subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur inside common words or names and cited surnames; they often fall at subword boundaries after tokenization. Other activations in the same passage may occur in formulas or phrases.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper text, references, and names; also surnames in HackerNews blog links

patterns.name: Phrase fragments in formula expressions
patterns.context: Occurs near mathematical or physical formulas in expressions describing probability, action, or evolution, including reformulations and decompositions. Some activations cover consecutive words in English phrases; others occur next to formula markers.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics, mathematics, and quantum computing papers

patterns.name: Possible prepositional phrases or syntactic connectors
patterns.context: Connects objects, methods, or expression relations in technical explanations; often occurs near formulas, reactions, or effective descriptions, though not every instance belongs to a formula phrase.

patterns.name: Characters/subwords in references and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations occur inside citation keys, theory names, researcher surnames, and other proper nouns, without consistent lexical meaning or contextual semantic conditions.

patterns.name: Common words and URL fragments in blog text
patterns.context: Activations occur in conversational HackerNews posts and personal blog URLs; unrelated to paper formulas or arguments.

3_1908.concept: 英文子词与公式语境片段
3_1908.description: 激活分散在词内子串、专名与引文片段，以及公式附近的英语短语（尤以“can be rewritten”“in terms of”等为显）；没有单一稳定语义，另有博客词和网址片段。

patterns.name: 嵌入式词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通单词或人名、引文姓氏中的内部字符片段；常见于分词后的子词边界，段内其他激活又可能出现在公式或短语中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文正文、参考文献与人名；另有 HackerNews 博客链接中的姓氏

patterns.name: 公式表达中的短语片段
patterns.trigger: “« expression»1« for»1”、“« can»1 be« rewritten»1”、“« action»1”、“« decomposed»5« in»5« terms»9« of»1”、“« evolution»1”
patterns.context: 出现在数学或物理公式附近，描述概率、作用量或演化的表达、改写、分解；部分激活是英文短语中的连续词，部分紧邻公式标记。
patterns.domain: 理论物理、数学、量子计算论文

patterns.name: 可能的介词短语/句法连接词
patterns.context: 在技术说明中连接对象、方法或表达关系；多与公式、反应或有效描述相邻，但并非每处都属于公式短语。

patterns.name: 文献名与专名中的字符/子词
patterns.trigger: “«D»11”、“«F»1«ad»9«de»2ev”、“«het»4ikhin”及多处参考文献作者姓氏片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在引文键、理论名称、研究者姓氏等专名内部，缺乏一致的词义或上下文语义条件。

patterns.name: 博客文本中的常见词及网址片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 HackerNews 帖子的口语句子和个人博客 URL 中；与论文公式或论证无关。

en.concept: Mixed local word-form and technical-context features
en.description: One group of activations consists of name or username fragments containing schä/scha. Others occur sporadically in physical formulas and descriptions of null infinity, experimental procedure statements, astronomical terms, and discussions of edge states, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: schä fragments in surnames such as Schäfer
patterns.context: Occurs in personal names or cited author surnames, with activations on surname fragments split by tokenization. Contexts include supernova papers, QCD reviews, reference lists, and Hacker News usernames or URLs.
patterns.domain: ArXiv research papers and Hacker News discussions

patterns.name: Radiation integrals at null infinity
patterns.context: Describes sending a detector to future null infinity and integrating over null time to collect radiation.

patterns.name: Experimental procedure verbs and phrases
patterns.context: Cell-culture experimental steps describing loading dye with a scraper and washing cells with PBS containing calcium and magnesium.

patterns.name: Formula-structure tokens in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical derivations of vortex-pair action and in LaTeX formula environments; activations involve variables, operators, and formula-structure markers.

patterns.name: latitudes in astronomical-geographical terms
patterns.context: Describes an object far above the Galactic plane and uses this to discuss low dust extinction.

patterns.name: Terms related to topological edge states
patterns.context: Discusses the finite fraction of eigenstates concentrated at the system edge, the decay of skin modes, and their number scaling with volume.

3_1908.concept: 混合的局部词形与技术语境特征
3_1908.description: 激活以含 schä/scha 的人名或用户名片段为一组；另零散落在物理公式与零无穷远描述、实验操作语句、天文术语及边缘态论述中，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: schäfer 等姓氏中的 schä 碎片
patterns.context: 出现在人名或文献作者姓氏中，激活落在被分词拆开的姓氏片段上；上下文分别涉及超新星文献、QCD 综述、参考文献列表，以及 Hacker News 用户名或网址。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文与 Hacker News 讨论

patterns.name: null 无穷远处的辐射积分
patterns.trigger: «to»、«future null infinity»、«integrate over the null working time»
patterns.context: 描述把探测器送到未来零无穷远，并对零工作时间积分以收集辐射。
patterns.domain: 理论物理 / 相对论论文

patterns.name: 实验操作动词及其短语
patterns.context: 细胞培养实验步骤中，描述用刮刀装载染料，以及用含钙镁的 PBS 冲洗细胞。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的公式结构 token
patterns.context: 出现在涡旋对作用的数学推导及 LaTeX 公式环境中；激活涉及变量、运算符和公式结构标记。
patterns.domain: 数学物理 / LaTeX 论文

patterns.name: 天文地理术语中的 latitudes
patterns.context: 描述天体位于银河平面上方较远处，并据此讨论尘埃消光很小。

patterns.name: 拓扑边缘态相关词语
patterns.context: 讨论本征态集中于系统边缘的有限比例、skin modes 的衰减及其数量随体积标度。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理 / 理论论文

en.concept: Mixed triggers from word fragments and formula markup
en.description: Activations are scattered across letter fragments in names and citations, a few within-word fragments in ordinary words, French word segments, and theoretical physics formulas and terminology; name fragments are most common, but the trigger types are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Schafer/Schäfer spelling fragments in names
patterns.context: When personal names are tokenized, activations occur on letter fragments inside the names; spellings vary and may include hyphens or appear as cited authors.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, QCD literature, technical forum usernames, and blog links

patterns.name: extr (extra- word-initial fragment)
patterns.context: Appears within the word extragalactic, referring to a supernova outside the Milky Way.

patterns.name: Negative n't
patterns.context: The stem in doesn't is marked; the context describes a background operation that does not block rendering.

patterns.name: French agriculture and Finnish word endings
patterns.context: Appears in French sentences concerning the term of office and cooperation of the President of the European Parliament's Agriculture Council; activations fall on fragments within phrases or words.

patterns.name: lat in a latitude word
patterns.context: In an astronomical context, describes distant regions of the galactic plane with lower dust extinction; the activated fragment is part of latitudes.

patterns.name: Dense activations on theoretical physics terminology and mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In theoretical physics passages, formula-introduction wording and LaTeX equation environments show multiple activations, including gravity theory, Horndeski action, and two-dimensional dilaton theory.
patterns.domain: ArXiv theoretical physics papers and LaTeX mathematical formulas

patterns.name: Diverse author citation fragments with no unified explanation
patterns.context: Appears in literature author lists and parenthetical citations; somewhat resembles the name-fragment pattern, but the trigger forms are scattered and a common trigger condition is unclear.

patterns.name: Possible Schlegel proper-name fragment
patterns.context: An astrophysics paper mentions the Schlegel map; activation falls within the personal name in the map name.

3_1908.concept: 词片段与公式标记的混合触发
3_1908.description: 激活分散于姓名及引用中的字母片段、少数普通词内部片段、法语词段，以及理论物理公式和术语；姓名片段最常见，但各类触发并不一致。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Schafer/Schäfer 拼写片段
patterns.context: 人名被拆分标注时激活姓名内部的字母片段；形式存在变体，且可能包含连字符或用作文献引用作者名。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、QCD 文献、技术论坛用户名及博客链接

patterns.name: extr（extra-词首片段）
patterns.context: 出现在 extragalactic 一词内部，指银河系外的超新星。

patterns.name: 表示否定的 n't
patterns.context: doesn't 中的词干部分被标记；语境是在描述某个后台操作不会阻塞渲染。

patterns.name: 法语农业与芬兰语词尾
patterns.context: 出现在法语句子中，涉及欧洲议会农业理事会主席任期及合作；激活落在短语或词内部的片段。

patterns.name: 纬度词中的 lat
patterns.context: 天文学语境中描述尘埃消光较小的 galactic-plane 远距离区域；激活片段属于 latitudes。

patterns.name: 理论物理术语与数学表达式的密集激活
patterns.trigger: «deriv»、«ative»、« equations»、« of»、« motion»、« by»、« Horn»、«deski»、« action»；以及 «dil»、«aton»、« action»、«begin»、«aligned»、«S»、«int»、«sqrt» 等
patterns.context: 理论物理段落中，公式引入语及 LaTeX 方程环境出现多处激活，包括引力理论、Horndeski action 和二维 dilaton theory。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论物理论文与 LaTeX 数学公式

patterns.name: 多样且无法统一解释的作者引用片段
patterns.trigger: «Bert»、«rand»、«Cl»、«app»、«J»、«as»、«ra» 等，嵌在作者姓名或文献引用中
patterns.context: 出现在文献作者列表和括号引用内；与姓名片段模式有一定相似，但触发形式分散，难确认共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文参考文献

patterns.name: 可能的 Schlegel 专名片段
patterns.context: 天文学文献中提到 Schlegel map；激活落在地图名称对应的人名内部。

en.description: Activations often occur on substrings within words, split word fragments, and proper names or citation text. Other isolated cases involve formula LaTeX structure, collisionally excited emission, and latitude phrases. flaunt recurs in two genres, but the other triggers are scattered and difficult to group under a single semantic function.

patterns.name: Internal word splits and specific spelling fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on consecutive or nearby subword fragments inside words, often involving proper nouns and author names in citations, and may also cover ordinary technical phrases; they do not correspond to a fixed word or semantic category.
patterns.domain: Primarily ArXiv research text, also HackerNews and Pile-CC

patterns.name: Words beginning with fl and their collocations
patterns.context: Activations cluster on flaunt and local word-form fragments; contexts involve showing off ability or titles. The two examples come from different texts.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and structure
patterns.context: Activations occur near LaTeX commands, brackets, or formula structure in mathematical expressions; some also fall within the formula body.
patterns.domain: ArXiv physics, mathematics, or theoretical research text

patterns.name: collisionally excited emission
patterns.context: Activates in an astrophysical description of collisionally excited emission from cold gas flows; this local term occurs in only one passage.

patterns.name: Latitude-related statements
patterns.context: Activations cluster on a phrase in a sentence describing a distant location above the Galactic plane and dust extinction; a single instance.

patterns.name: Citation markers and reference strings
patterns.context: Activations occur in a QCD review’s reference string, scattered across author names and citation text; this may overlap with general within-word activations.

patterns.name: Local semantic fragments across words
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across common words in a HackerNews sentence discussing whether Google will withdraw or exercise its influence; apart from flaunt in the same passage, they do not fit a stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous common words and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Local activations are scattered across research narratives, dust-map citations, or formula boundaries, with insufficient repeated evidence for a unified condition.

3_1908.description: 激活多落在词内子串、拆分词片段及专名或引用文字中；另有公式LaTeX结构、碰撞激发辐射、纬度短语等单例。flaunt在两种文体中重复出现，但其余触发分散，难以归为单一语义功能。

patterns.name: 词内拆分与特定拼写片段
patterns.trigger: 多个词被拆分标记激活，如 «extr»«al»«gal»、«Sch»«a»«ef»«er»、«Vet»«im»；另有 «deriv»«ative»« equations»
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的连续或近邻子词片段，常涉及专名、引用中的作者名，也可能覆盖普通技术词组；并非某个固定词或固定语义类别。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术文本为主，也见 HackerNews 和 Pile-CC

patterns.name: fl开头词及其搭配
patterns.context: 激活集中在 flaunt 及其局部词形片段；语境涉及炫耀能力或头衔。两个例子分属不同文本。

patterns.name: latex数学符号与结构
patterns.context: 数学公式中的 LaTeX 命令、括号或公式结构附近出现激活，部分激活也落在公式正文。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 物理、数学或理论研究文本

patterns.name: collisionally excited emission
patterns.context: 在天体物理中描述冷气流的碰撞激发辐射时激活；这一局部术语现象仅见一段。

patterns.name: 纬度相关表述
patterns.context: 激活集中在描述星系平面上方远距离位置及尘埃消光的句子中的短语，单例。

patterns.name: 引用标记与文献串

patterns.name: Get Lit 专名
patterns.context: 作为非营利组织名称“Get Lit”的组成部分

en.concept: Multiple local word-form and formatting patterns
en.description: Activations mix that-clauses, place-related vocabulary, HTML/XML attributes and indentation, and a few formatting fragments, the abbreviation e.g., and an energy-related proper name; no single pattern explains all passages, and some may reflect local word forms or grammar.

patterns.name: that in English subordinate clauses
patterns.context: Introduces a relative or content clause in English, adding a qualification to a preceding noun or proposition; the marker is concentrated on that itself or its immediate context.
patterns.domain: English prose, argumentative writing, and explanatory text

patterns.name: HTML/XML attribute assignments and markup structure
patterns.context: Appears in tags or XML-like structured text, where an attribute name is adjacent to a quoted attribute value; [7] and [8] contain duplicate content.

patterns.name: Letters within the abbreviation e.g.
patterns.context: Appears in parentheses to give examples with e.g., preceded by a general statement and followed by a list of instances; activation falls on multiple subword fragments of the abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Patent background section, examples involving electronic systems

patterns.name: Place-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Refers to a physical location; [5] asks about car-service locations, while [10] discusses location entry, addressing, or delivery issues.

patterns.name: Energy-security proper name
patterns.context: Appears after “Energy security” as a subword fragment of an energy-related name or proper noun; its specific reference cannot be determined from the passage alone.

patterns.name: Indentation and tag starts after HTML line breaks
patterns.context: After a line break in HTML code, a tab indents the next line before a new tag begins; this co-occurs with the attribute-structure pattern above, but may also be sensitive to line breaks or indentation itself.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial question “Are there places”
patterns.context: A sentence-initial general question asking whether locations offering a service exist; aside from places, the constructional cue appears only once.

patterns.name: Discuss after a number and line break
patterns.context: A document begins with what appears to be a number or formatting fragment, followed by an issue introduced with Discuss; the relationship between the number and activation is unclear.
patterns.domain: Web/text formatting fragments and argumentative writing

patterns.name: Sex-related vocabulary and taboo relationships
patterns.context: Discusses psychological inhibition of sexual behavior between relatives and genetic explanations; strong activations are scattered and may relate to the syntax of a that-clause, so it is unclear whether the topic independently triggers them.

3_2061.concept: 多种局部词形与格式模式
3_2061.description: 激活混合了 that 从句、地点词汇、HTML/XML 属性与缩进，以及少量格式残片、e.g. 缩写和能源专名；没有单一模式能解释全部片段，部分模式可能来自局部词形或语法。

patterns.name: 英文限定从句中的 that
patterns.trigger: «that»（[1]“that The United States face…”，[9]“that stops us…”，[10]“places that have…”）
patterns.context: 英语关系从句或内容从句中，引出对前述名词或命题的补充限定；标记集中在 that 本身，或其紧邻上下文。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、议论及说明文

patterns.name: HTML/XML 属性赋值与标记结构
patterns.context: 出现在标签或类似 XML 的结构化文本中，属性名与引号括起的属性值相邻；[7]与[8]内容重复。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 HTML/XML 源码

patterns.name: e.g. 缩写内部字母
patterns.context: 位于括号中，用 e.g. 举例，前接概括性陈述、后接实例列表；激活落在缩写的多个子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，电子系统举例

patterns.name: 地点相关词汇
patterns.context: 指实际地点；[5]询问汽车服务地点，[10]谈论地点的入口、寻址或配送问题。
patterns.domain: 网络问答与商业/配送说明

patterns.name: 能源安全专名
patterns.context: 出现在“Energy security”之后，作为能源相关名称或专名的分词片段；具体指代无法仅凭片段确定。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会讨论、能源政策

patterns.name: HTML 换行后的缩进与标签起始
patterns.context: HTML 代码换行后以制表符缩进，再开始新标签；与前述属性结构模式同现，但可能对换行/缩进本身也敏感。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 HTML 源码

patterns.name: 问句开头的 Are there places
patterns.context: 句首一般疑问句，询问是否存在可提供某项服务的地点；除 places 外，句式信号仅出现一次。

patterns.name: 编号及换行后的 Discuss
patterns.context: 文档开头出现似乎是编号或格式残片，随后以 Discuss 开始议题；无法确定编号与激活的关系。
patterns.domain: 网页/文本格式残片与议论性文章

patterns.name: 性相关词汇及禁忌关系
patterns.context: 讨论亲属间性行为的心理抑制及遗传学理由；强激活词分散，可能与句法上的 that 从句有关，主题是否独立触发不确定。
patterns.domain: 通俗说明或议论性文章

en.description: Primarily responds to the Swedish sentence-initial causal word “Därför” and the English exclusive qualifier “only”; it also activates on x in hexadecimal number prefixes and on that introducing a relative clause in a patent sentence.

patterns.name: Swedish causal connective
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or clause, introduces a result, conclusion, or action following a previously stated reason; may be preceded by the question “Varför?”
patterns.domain: Swedish political argumentation in the European Parliament

patterns.name: English exclusive qualifier only
patterns.context: Qualifies applicable subjects or conditions, expressing “only …” or “merely …”; common in technical restrictions, commentary, and contrastive sentences

patterns.name: x in hexadecimal constants
patterns.context: Appears in hexadecimal numbers with a 0x prefix, surrounded by a tab-aligned table of constants

patterns.name: that introducing a relative clause
patterns.context: Follows “problems” and introduces a clause describing the problems

3_2061.description: 主要响应瑞典语句首因果词“Därför”和英语排他限定词“only”；另对十六进制数值前缀中的 x、专利句中引出关系从句的 that 激活。

patterns.name: 瑞典语因果连接词
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头，用来引出前文所述原因的结果、结论或行动；有时前接问句“Varför?”
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会瑞典语政治论述

patterns.name: 英语排他限定词 only
patterns.context: 限定适用对象或条件，表达“只有……才……”或“仅仅……”；常见于技术限制、评论和对比句

patterns.name: 十六进制常量中的 x
patterns.context: 出现在 0x 前缀的十六进制数值中，周围是制表符对齐的常量表

patterns.name: 关系从句引导词 that
patterns.context: 接在“problems”之后，引出描述问题的从句

en.concept: Swedish “Därför” and a few technical markers
en.description: The strongest and most repeated pattern is Swedish “Därför” (therefore), at the beginning of a conclusion after an argument. Other activations are scattered across exception-related technical terms, the English listing marker namely, and the code branch label case; their contexts do not clearly match the main pattern.

patterns.name: Swedish sentence-initial “Därför”
patterns.context: In Swedish sentences, usually after preceding reasons or arguments, “Därför” (therefore) introduces a conclusion, action, or subsequent result; activation is concentrated on the “Där” portion of the word.

patterns.name: exception-related words
patterns.context: Appears in questions about storing exception messages, exception-handling class names in code repositories, or property access; occasionally it is an ordinary technical word in context.

patterns.name: Listing “namely”
patterns.context: Introduces a specific list or explanation in an English sentence, followed by “we have first priority”.

patterns.name: switch case label
patterns.context: Acts as a branch label in a C-style switch statement, followed by “FIOCLEX:”.

3_2061.concept: 瑞典语“Därför”及少量技术标记
3_2061.description: 最强且重复的模式是瑞典语“Därför”（因此），位于论证后的结论句首。其余激活分散在 exception 相关技术用语、英语列举标记 namely 和代码分支标签 case，未见与主模式明显相同的上下文。

patterns.name: 瑞典语句首“Därför”
patterns.context: 瑞典语句中，通常在前文给出理由或论据后，以“Därför”（因此）引出结论、行动或后续结果；激活集中在词内“Där”部分。

patterns.name: exception 相关词
patterns.context: 出现在异常消息存储的提问、代码库中的异常处理类名或属性访问中；个别处为上下文中的普通技术词。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Github 代码

patterns.name: 名词化“namely”
patterns.context: 英语句中引出具体列举或说明，后接“we have first priority”。

patterns.name: switch 的 case 标签
patterns.context: C 风格代码的 switch 语句中，作为分支标签，后接“FIOCLEX:”。

en.description: Strong activations occur mainly on the example-introducing word as (such as), sentence-initial Should/Shouldn't questions, and explanatory namely; there is also one trigger in a question about uploading large files. Overall, the pattern tends toward introducing examples or asking questions.

patterns.name: Examples after such as
patterns.context: Introduces specific examples after a description of drawbacks, problems, or conditions; the trigger falls on as.

patterns.name: Should questions
patterns.context: Sentence-initial Should in a question, often in a title or post asking for advice or posing a normative question.

patterns.name: Shouldn't questions
patterns.context: Sentence-initial negative question with Shouldn't; activation is distributed across the split form.

patterns.name: namely introducing an explanation
patterns.context: Uses namely after a statement to introduce a specific explanation or list.

patterns.name: Large-file upload issue
patterns.context: Raises an issue encountered when uploading files larger than a specified size.

3_2061.description: 强激活主要出现在举例引导语 as（such as）、句首 Should/Shouldn't 疑问句，以及 namely 说明语；另有一次关于大文件上传问题的触发。整体偏向引出例子或提出问题。

patterns.name: such as 后举例
patterns.context: 在说明缺点、问题或条件后，引出具体例子；触发落在 as。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利技术文本

patterns.name: Should 疑问句
patterns.context: 疑问句开头的 Should，常见于征求意见或提出规范性问题的标题、发帖正文。

patterns.name: Shouldn't 疑问句
patterns.context: 句首否定疑问 Shouldn't；激活分布在分词形式上。

patterns.name: namely 引出说明
patterns.context: 在陈述后用 namely 引出具体说明或列举。

patterns.name: 大文件上传问题
patterns.context: 提出上传超过特定大小文件时遇到的问题。

en.description: The most stable pattern is such as introducing examples; require(s)/requirement also express necessity. Other activations are scattered across technical proper nouns, medical or ecological terms, and configuration fields, with no reliable shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: such as introducing examples
patterns.context: Lists examples, categories, or conditions; may be followed by common nouns, coordinated items, or numbers, usually in explanatory sentences.
patterns.domain: Academic, patent, medical, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Requirements or necessity with require
patterns.context: Describes measures, resources, or conditions that something needs; may be require followed by a gerund or noun, or the noun requirement.
patterns.domain: Medical, technical, and Q&A explanatory writing

patterns.name: Proper nouns and markers in technical text
patterns.context: Abbreviations, product names, or protocol names occur in technical contexts; however, evidence for this trigger is sporadic, and these words are not necessarily adjacent to highly activated tokens in the passage.

patterns.name: Medical and ecological terms without an apparent shared trigger
patterns.context: Domain-specific terms in medical research, screening, or ecological descriptions; it is difficult to determine whether they constitute an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Structured code or configuration fields
patterns.context: JSON-style key-value or list structures, with field names in quotes and separated by punctuation.

3_2061.description: 最稳定的模式是 such as 引出例子；另有 require(s)/requirement 表达必要性。其余激活分散于技术专名、医学或生态术语及配置字段，未见可靠的共同语义触发。

patterns.name: such as 举例引出
patterns.context: 列出例子、类别或条件；可后接普通名词、并列项或编号，通常出现在解释性句子中。
patterns.domain: 学术、专利、医学及一般说明文

patterns.name: require 的要求或必要性
patterns.context: 描述某事需要采取的措施、资源或条件；可能是 require 后接动名词或名词，也可能是名词 requirement。
patterns.domain: 医学、技术及问答说明文

patterns.name: 技术文本中的专名与标记
patterns.context: 技术语境中出现缩写、产品或协议名称；但触发证据零散，且这些词在段内未必与高激活 token 直接相邻。

patterns.name: 无明显共同触发的医学与生态术语
patterns.context: 医学研究、筛查或生态学叙述中的领域词；难以确认它们本身是否构成独立模式。
patterns.domain: 医学与生态学学术文本

patterns.name: 结构化代码或配置字段
patterns.context: JSON 风格的键值或列表结构，字段名带引号并以标点分隔。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to sentence-initial Should in English questions asking whether advice or an action is appropriate; it also responds consistently to word-initial Issues in titles. The remaining activations are sporadic fragments involving Cyrillic text, punctuation, and layout, with no clear unifying condition.

patterns.name: Should in English questions
patterns.context: In English questions, Should occurs at the beginning of the sentence or an embedded interrogative clause, asking whether advice, responsibility, or an action is appropriate; it is followed by a subject and verb.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A and commentary; topics include healthcare policy, conference bans, personal behavior, and code operations

patterns.name: Word-initial Issues in English
patterns.context: The word is split into two tokens, Iss and ues, combining to form Issues; each appears at the start of a title or short heading, followed by a prepositional phrase specifying the topic.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal fragments in Cyrillic text
patterns.context: Activations fall on parts of Russian or Bulgarian Cyrillic word forms; the scripts and lexical contexts of the two passages differ, so the material does not establish a stable shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Russian copyright notice; Bulgarian parliamentary text

patterns.name: Numbers and layout markers
patterns.context: Appears in web-text line breaks, separators, font-size descriptions, or punctuation and layout; activation locations are sporadic and show no consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Code repository comments and scraped web/forum text

patterns.name: Unclear isolated marker
patterns.context: The marker is sparse; it is unclear whether it represents an independent pattern or merely an incidental activation adjacent to a highly activating word.

3_2061.description: 主要对英文疑问句中的句首 Should 强烈响应，询问建议或行动是否恰当；另对标题中的词首 Issues 有稳定响应。其余激活分散于西里尔文字、标点与版式片段，缺乏明确统一条件。

patterns.name: 英文疑问句中的 Should
patterns.context: 在英文疑问句中，Should 位于句首或从句疑问部分开头，询问建议、责任或行动是否适当；后接主语和动词。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、评论讨论；涵盖医疗政策、会议禁令、个人行为、代码操作等主题

patterns.name: 英文词首 Issues
patterns.context: 词被分成 Iss 与 ues 两个 token，合成词 Issues；分别出现在标题或短标题开头，后接介词短语说明议题。
patterns.domain: 标题、出版物或学术文本

patterns.name: 西里尔文字内的词尾/词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在俄语或保加利亚语西里尔文字词形的部分 token 上；两段的文字与词法环境不同，无法从材料中确定稳定的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 俄语版权声明；保加利亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 数字与版式标记
patterns.context: 出现在网页文本的换行、分隔线、字号描述或标点版式中；具体激活位置零散，未显示一致语义条件。
patterns.domain: 代码仓库注释及网页/论坛抓取文本

patterns.name: 不明的孤立标记
patterns.trigger: ««»等（段[2]中分散的功能词也有弱标记）
patterns.context: 标记稀疏，无法确认是独立模式，或只是与高激活词相邻的偶发激活。

en.description: The most stable clue is highlighted Should in forum questions, suggestions, or normative judgments, across varied topics. Other clues include code punctuation, Russian copyright comments, webpage formatting, and sporadic technical terms; some passages are difficult to explain with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Interrogative auxiliary Should
patterns.context: Introduces suggestions, normative judgments, possibilities, or truth-value judgments in questions or embedded questions; it is often followed by a subject and verb, and also occurs in Should be.
patterns.domain: HackerNews and StackExchange posts and comments

patterns.name: Should in other question structures
patterns.context: Should likewise introduces questions, but topics vary, including political positions, meeting bans, account help, code security, and variable conditions; topics differ considerably.

patterns.name: Code punctuation, comments, and Russian text
patterns.context: Code/comment snippets contain numerous slashes, newline markers, and Russian copyright statements; this differs from the Should-question pattern in other passages.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and Russian copyright comments

patterns.name: Web markup and formatted headings
patterns.context: Webpages or comment text contain language parameters, dividers, code fences, and formatting descriptions; the same passage also contains a Should question, but these formatting tokens may provide additional activation cues.

patterns.name: Sporadic technical terms and error messages
patterns.context: Code, error, account, or security terms in technical Q&A; apart from co-occurring with Should questions, these words do not recur consistently across passages.

3_2061.description: 最稳定的线索是句中高亮的 Should，用于论坛里的疑问、建议或规范判断，主题多样。另有代码标点、俄语版权注释、网页格式与零散技术词等线索，部分段落难以由主模式解释。

patterns.name: 句中疑问助动词 Should
patterns.context: 在疑问句或嵌入式问题中引出建议、规范判断、可能性或真假判断；其后常接主语与动词，也见 Should be。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 与 StackExchange 帖子及评论

patterns.name: 其他疑问结构中的 Should
patterns.context: 同样由 Should 引出问题，但问题涉及政治立场、会议禁令、账户求助、代码安全或变量条件等不同主题；主题差异较大。

patterns.name: 代码标点、注释与俄语文本
patterns.context: 代码/注释片段中出现大量斜线、换行标记以及俄语版权声明；与其他段落的 Should 疑问句模式不同。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码与俄语版权注释

patterns.name: 网页标记和格式化标题
patterns.context: 网页或评论文本含语言参数、分隔线、代码围栏和排版描述；同一段也出现 Should 问句，但这些格式 token 可能构成额外激活线索。

patterns.name: 零散技术词与错误消息
patterns.context: 技术问答中的代码、错误、账户或安全术语；除与 Should 问句共现外，未见这些词跨段稳定复现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 HackerNews 技术讨论

en.description: The most prominent pattern is advice or judgment questions introduced by Should/Shouldn’t, across forums, Q&A, and titles. It also responds to Cyrillic fragments and appears around line breaks and the starts of new posts/comments on HackerNews.

patterns.name: Should I/Shouldn’t this question form
patterns.context: Should appears at the beginning or within a sentence, often followed by the first-person I or this/the, to ask for advice, judgment, or a normative opinion; the word itself is a prominent trigger.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, StackExchange comments and help-seeking posts; also interrogative topics in PubMed titles

patterns.name: Word-initial Cyrillic fragments
patterns.context: Words in Russian or related Cyrillic scripts, especially initial letters or subword fragments; all examples are in non-English text.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Pile-CC, and Russian code comments

patterns.name: Post/comment start markers after line breaks
patterns.context: In HackerNews text, line breaks separate posts or comments; activation occurs near the line break and the start of a following question.

3_2061.description: 最突出的模式是 Should/Shouldn’t 引出的建议或判断问题，跨论坛、问答及标题；另对俄语西里尔字母片段有反应，也出现在 HackerNews 的换行和新帖/评论开头。

patterns.name: Should I/Shouldn’t this 提问句式
patterns.context: 句首或句中出现 Should，常接第一人称 I 或 this/the，提出建议、判断或规范性问题；该词本身是突出触发点。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、StackExchange 评论与求助帖，也见 PubMed 标题中的疑问式主题

patterns.name: 西里尔字母词首片段
patterns.context: 俄语或相关西里尔文字词语中，尤其词首字母/子词片段；这些例子均处于非英语文本。

patterns.name: 换行后新帖/评论起始标记
patterns.context: HackerNews 文本中换行分隔帖子或评论，激活出现在换行及后续提问开头附近。

en.concept: English sentence markers and a few miscellaneous items
en.description: Activation mainly falls into two types of English question frames: inversion after Not only and suggestion questions introduced by sentence-initial Should; there is also the rhetorical question Why shouldn’t and a Russian subword fragment in a code copyright statement.

patterns.name: Not only construction
patterns.context: The phrase is often followed by inversion with a copula, auxiliary, or modal verb, such as “Not only is”, “Not only will”, and “Not only do”; activation is concentrated on only, and adjacent is/will/do may also activate.

patterns.name: Should question construction
patterns.context: Should introduces questions about suggestions or whether to take action, at the beginning of a sentence or in a question, followed by subjects such as I or the.

patterns.name: Rhetorical “Why shouldn’t this be”
patterns.context: A rhetorical question beginning with Why and containing the negative modal shouldn’t, asking why something cannot be so.

patterns.name: Copyright statement in code comments
patterns.context: A copyright and rights-reserved statement at the beginning of a code file; multiple Russian letters/fragments in the rights statement activate.

3_2061.concept: 英语句式标记及少量杂项
3_2061.description: 激活主要落在两类英语问句框架：Not only 后的倒装结构，以及句首 Should 引出的建议性问题；另见 Why shouldn’t 反问和代码版权声明中的俄语词片段。

patterns.name: Not only 句式
patterns.context: 该短语后常接系动词、助动词或情态动词倒装，如“Not only is”“Not only will”“Not only do”；片段中激活集中在 only，且相邻的 is/will/do 也可能激活。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、论坛讨论、文章

patterns.name: Should 提问句式
patterns.context: 句首或疑问句中以 Should 引出建议、是否采取行动等问题，后接 I、the 等主语。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、技术讨论、评论

patterns.name: “Why shouldn’t this be”反问
patterns.context: 以 Why 开头、含否定情态词 shouldn’t 的反问句，询问某事为何不能如此。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的版权声明
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的版权与权利保留声明；俄语权利声明中多个字母/片段激活。

en.description: Strong activation is concentrated on Should (at the start of advice-seeking requests), only in the Not only construction, and a tokenized fragment of PHP Illuminate; there are also isolated cases involving the Russian word-final а and a period, with differing trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Initial subword fragment of Should
patterns.context: Appears in questions or requests for advice, followed by subjects such as I/we and advice, actions, or decisions; it may also begin a sentence in a quotation.

patterns.name: Not only inversion
patterns.context: Appears in the “Not only” construction, followed by an auxiliary or modal verb, such as “Not only will...” or “Not only was...”

patterns.name: PHP Illuminate namespace code
patterns.context: PHP code spelling the Laravel Illuminate namespace; the tokenized token falls within Illuminate.

patterns.name: Russian genitive ending
patterns.context: In a Russian copyright notice, the token corresponds to the final letter of “права”.

patterns.name: Ordinary period
patterns.context: Sentence-final punctuation; in this example it is preceded by a space and followed by a new sentence or line break.

3_2061.concept: 常见但异质的文本片段
3_2061.description: 强激活最集中于 Should（建议请求句开头）、Not only 结构中的 only、PHP Illuminate 的分词片段；另有俄文词尾 а 与句号的孤例，触发条件各异。

patterns.name: Should 的首词片段
patterns.context: 出现在疑问句或请求建议的句子中，后接 I/we 等主语及建议、行动或决策内容；也可能是引用中的句子开头

patterns.name: Not only 倒装结构
patterns.context: 位于“Not only”结构中，后接助动词或情态动词，如“Not only will...”或“Not only was...”

patterns.name: PHP Illuminate 命名空间代码
patterns.context: PHP 代码中拼写 Laravel Illuminate 命名空间，分词 token 落在 Illuminate 内

patterns.name: 俄文所有格词尾
patterns.context: 俄语版权声明中，token 对应“права”的末尾字母

patterns.name: 普通句号
patterns.context: 句末标点；该例中前有空格，后接新句或换行

en.concept: Questions and specific local word forms
en.description: The main response is to should/shouldn’t in question structures, followed by Why not suggestion questions; there are also sporadic activations on g in the proper names Algiers and Algak, and on only in the not only construction.

patterns.name: should in question structures
