patterns.context: should/shouldn’t appears in questions or embedded questions, especially sentence-initially or immediately before a subject; activation is concentrated on should/n't.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, novel dialogue, academic articles

patterns.name: Negation or suggestion in questions
patterns.context: Why is followed by not, forming a question that suggests or considers an idea; activation is on not, rather than the following verb.

patterns.name: Fragment in the place name Algiers
patterns.context: Activation falls on g within the proper name Algiers; the contexts concern wartime figures and the location of a swimming event, respectively.

patterns.name: Specific letter fragment in an island name
patterns.context: The g in the geographical proper noun Algak is marked; nearby text lists islands in the Arctic region.

patterns.name: only in a baseball context
patterns.context: A not only…but also coordinated emphasis construction describes a person’s influence on and off the field.

patterns.name: only in a dental crown context
patterns.context: Sentence-initial Not only introduces inversion and signals subsequent coordinated content; the passage discusses a dental crown problem.

3_2061.description: 主要响应疑问结构里的 should/shouldn’t，其次响应 Why not 提议问句；另对专名 Algiers、Algak 中的 g 及 not only 结构中的 only 有零散激活。

patterns.name: 疑问结构中的 should
patterns.trigger: “Why shouldn’t this be up to the mouse driver?”、“Why should you have to do that, Martha?”、“Should the beliefs a person holds…”
patterns.context: 疑问句或嵌入疑问中出现 should/shouldn’t，尤其在句首或紧邻主语之前；激活集中在 should/n't。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、小说对话、学术文章

patterns.name: 问句中的否定或提议表达
patterns.context: Why 后接 not，构成建议或设想式问句；激活在 not，而非后续动词。

patterns.name: 地名 Algiers 的片段
patterns.context: 在专名 Algiers 内部，激活落在 g；上下文分别涉及战时人物与游泳赛事地点。

patterns.name: 岛屿名称中的特定字母片段
patterns.context: 地理专名 Algak 中的 g 被标记；附近列举北极地区岛屿。

patterns.name: 棒球语境中的 only
patterns.context: not only…but also 的并列强调结构，说明人物在场上与场下的影响。

patterns.name: 牙冠语境中的 only
patterns.context: 句首 Not only 引出倒装并预示后续并列内容；谈及牙冠问题。

en.description: Activation covers PHP/Laravel file headers and Illuminate imports, the negative question shouldn't, place-name fragments such as Algiers/Algak, and the Not only construction; these triggers have no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: PHP file header
patterns.context: The standard opening tag at the beginning of PHP source code, followed by a blank line and PHP statements.

patterns.name: Laravel/Illuminate namespaces and imports
patterns.context: An Illuminate/Laravel namespace appears in a PHP namespace or use declaration; activation falls especially on the segmented Illuminate subword.

patterns.name: shouldn't in an English negative question
patterns.context: In the HackerNews colloquial question “Why shouldn't this be up to the mouse driver?”, both parts of shouldn't activate strongly.

patterns.name: Subword of the place name Algiers
patterns.context: The g subword in Algiers/Algeria-related place names activates strongly; examples occur in historical accounts, geographic entries, and event titles.

patterns.name: Name fragment in Algak Island
patterns.context: The g subword in the island name Algak Island in a Kitikmeot/Nunavut geographic entry activates strongly.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase Not only
patterns.context: The English sentence contains the “Not only ...” construction; only is the strongest activation component and may be followed by will, is, etc.
patterns.domain: Web exposition, promotional copy, and forum comments

3_2061.description: 激活涵盖 PHP/Laravel 文件头与 Illuminate 导入、shouldn't 否定问句、Algiers/Algak 等地名片段，以及 Not only 构式；这些触发条件并无明显统一语义。

patterns.name: PHP 文件头
patterns.context: PHP 源代码开头的标准 opening tag，后接空行和 PHP 语句。

patterns.name: Laravel/Illuminate 命名空间与导入
patterns.context: PHP 的 namespace 或 use 声明中出现 Illuminate/Laravel 命名空间，激活尤其落在被拆分的 Illuminate 子词上。

patterns.name: 英文否定问句中的 shouldn't
patterns.context: HackerNews 口语问句 “Why shouldn't this be up to the mouse driver?” 中，shouldn't 的两部分均强激活。

patterns.name: 地名 Algiers 的子词
patterns.context: Algiers/Algeria 相关地名中，Algiers 的 g 子词强激活；可见于历史叙述、地理条目和赛事标题。

patterns.name: Algak Island 的名称片段
patterns.context: Kitikmeot/Nunavut 地理条目中的岛屿名 Algak Island，g 子词强激活。

patterns.name: Not only 固定搭配
patterns.context: 英文句子出现 “Not only ...” 构式；only 是最强激活部分，后续可接 will、is 等。
patterns.domain: 网页说明文、宣传文字与论坛评论

en.concept: English function words and local substrings
en.description: The main sensitivity is to the English “not only” expression, including standard additive and inverted constructions and nonstandard uses; there are also local activations on should in questions, did after why, and um within the PHP identifier Illuminate.

patterns.name: “not only” construction
patterns.context: “not only” appears in an English sentence to emphasize or introduce an additive continuation; subsequent structure may be “but … also”, inversion, or a nonstandard expression
patterns.domain: English prose, commentary, news, and technical discussions

patterns.name: should in questions
patterns.context: should appears in questions: once in the contraction “shouldn’t” and once in “Why should …?”

patterns.name: Illuminate in code
patterns.context: The PHP namespace identifier Illuminate; activation falls on a substring within the word

patterns.name: did in explanatory questions
patterns.context: A direct question of the type “why did you say”, immediately following why

3_2061.concept: 英语功能词与局部子串
3_2061.description: 主要对英语“not only”表达敏感，涵盖常规递进及倒装、非标准用法；另对疑问句中的 should、why 后的 did，以及 PHP 标识符 Illuminate 内的 um 有局部激活。

patterns.name: “not only”结构
patterns.trigger: «only»9，通常连同前面的 «Not»；有时后接 but，也有时后接 is/does 等
patterns.context: 英语句中出现“not only”强调或引出递进补充；后续结构可能是“but … also”，也可能是倒装或非标准表达
patterns.domain: 英语散文、评论、新闻及技术讨论

patterns.name: 问句中的 should
patterns.context: 疑问句中出现 should：一处为否定缩写“shouldn’t”，另一处为“Why should …?”

patterns.name: 代码中的 Illuminate
patterns.context: PHP 代码中的命名空间标识符 Illuminate，激活落在单词内部的子串

patterns.name: 解释性疑问中的 did
patterns.context: “why did you say”一类直接疑问句，紧接 why

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and Not only
en.description: Activation is concentrated in three local fragments: um in the Laravel identifier Illuminate, g in the place name Algiers, and only in the construction Not only. The latter occurs across genres and often introduces progression or contrast.

patterns.name: um in a Laravel namespace
patterns.context: Appears in the Laravel identifier Illuminate in PHP, especially in the tokenized fragment of Illuminate; nearby text includes use, namespace separators, or framework class names.

patterns.name: g in Algiers
patterns.context: Appears inside the place name Algiers, followed by iers; the context concerns a location or historical event.

patterns.name: Not only construction
patterns.context: The phrase Not only is followed by various auxiliaries or predicate components, such as will, was, do, in, or is; it introduces progression or contrast.

3_2061.concept: 特定子词片段及 Not only
3_2061.description: 激活集中于三类局部片段：Laravel 标识符 Illuminate 中的 um、地名 Algiers 中的 g，以及句式 Not only 中的 only；后者跨多种文体，常引出递进或对照。

patterns.name: Laravel 命名空间中的 um
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP 的 Laravel 标识符 Illuminate 中，尤其是 Illuminate 的分词片段；周围有 use、命名空间分隔符或框架类名。

patterns.name: 阿尔及尔中的 g
patterns.context: 出现在地名 Algiers 的分词内部，后接 iers；上下文涉及地点或历史事件。

patterns.name: Not only 结构
patterns.context: 短语 Not only 后接不同助动词或谓语成分，如 will、was、do、in、is；用于引出递进或对照。
patterns.domain: 说明文、评论及论坛文本

en.description: Activation commonly occurs in not only… but also contrasts, Why questions, and newline boundaries; there is also a response to a subword fragment in Algiers and to legal-statute phrasing, along with isolated punctuation. The patterns cannot all be explained by a single semantic condition.

patterns.name: “not only … but also” contrast structure
patterns.context: In explicit additive or coordinated contrast structures, especially near function words such as only, but, and also; these words need not be contiguous.
patterns.domain: Technical explanations, product discussions, business or general narrative

patterns.name: Question structure
patterns.context: Questions asking for reasons or explanations, particularly those beginning with Why or immediately following a colon.

patterns.name: Newline boundary
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the newline character itself, not only on the text at the start of a line; the specific function of the newline varies across snippets.
patterns.domain: Forum text, code, headings, or paragraph formatting

patterns.name: Subword fragment in the place name Algiers
patterns.context: Tokenization position of the place name Algiers in text; in passage 3, only the letter g is marked, while passages 6 and 8 mark g and the following fragment.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic geography, military history, and sports event entries

patterns.name: Punctuation to the right within a sentence
patterns.context: A period in body text is marked separately; passage 1 also contains the marked em dash «------», with no consistent local semantic condition.

patterns.name: Legal rules and evidence provisions
patterns.context: Legal sentences listing and citing rules of evidence and statutory provisions.

3_2061.concept: 混合的结构与分词特征
3_2061.description: 激活常见于 not only… but also 对举、Why 提问和换行边界；另对 Algiers 的分词片段及法律条文表达有反应，也出现孤立标点。各模式不能由单一语义条件完全解释。

patterns.name: “not only … but also”对举结构
patterns.context: 显式的递进或并列对举结构中，尤其在 only、but、also 等功能词附近；不要求这些词连续出现。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、产品讨论、商业或一般叙述

patterns.name: 疑问句中的提问结构
patterns.context: 提出理由或解释请求的疑问句，特别是 Why 开头或紧接冒号的提问。

patterns.name: 换行边界
patterns.context: 激活出现在换行符本身，而非仅出现在行首文字；各片段换行的具体功能不一致。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、代码、标题或段落排版

patterns.name: Algiers 地名的分词片段
patterns.context: 地名 Algiers 在文本中的分词位置；第3段仅有字母 g 被标记，第6、8段标记了 g 和后续片段。
patterns.domain: 百科全书地理、军事史及体育赛事条目

patterns.name: 句中右侧标点
patterns.context: 句号在正文中被单独标记；第1段还出现标记的长破折号 «------»，缺乏一致的局部语义条件。

patterns.name: 法律规则与证据条文
patterns.context: 列举并援引证据规则及法条的法律句子。

en.concept: Not only construction and miscellaneous fragments
en.description: The most stable pattern is the “not only” additive-emphasis construction, often followed by but also. Other scattered activations involve negative contractions, fragments within proper names, and line-break punctuation; they span genres and are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: not only construction
patterns.context: Appears in “not only X but (also) Y” or variants, emphasizing additive parallel elements; X and Y may be phrases or clauses.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, technical descriptions, parliamentary speeches, and online text

patterns.name: Negative contraction in a question
patterns.context: A question contains a contraction of should not, followed by “this be up to the mouse driver?”.

patterns.name: Tokenization in an Algiers-related proper name
patterns.context: The proper name Algiers is marked by tokenization; nearby text concerns a military trial and a swimming event, respectively.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in a place name or personal name
patterns.context: Activation falls within the name Alonso in a chapter list; no obvious shared syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Boundary line breaks and separators
patterns.context: Appears at line breaks and dash separators in code discussion snippets, alongside miscellaneous text.

patterns.name: Scattered activations on short words and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation falls on line breaks, periods, or common function words, without a stable shared local construction.

3_2061.concept: not only 结构及杂项片段
3_2061.description: 最稳定的模式是“not only”并列强调结构，常接 but also；另有若干分散激活，涉及否定缩写、专名内部片段及换行标点，跨文体且难以统一解释。

patterns.name: not only 结构
patterns.context: 出现在“not only X but (also) Y”或其变体中，强调并列补充成分；X、Y可为短语或分句。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的散文、技术说明、议会发言及网络文本

patterns.name: 问句中的否定缩写
patterns.context: 疑问句中出现 should not 的缩写，后接“this be up to the mouse driver?”。

patterns.name: 阿尔及尔相关专名分词
patterns.context: 专名 Algiers 被分词标记；附近分别是关于军事审判和游泳赛事的文字。

patterns.name: 地名或姓名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在章节目录中的人名 Alonso 内部，未见明显语义句式条件。

patterns.name: 边界换行及分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在代码讨论片段的换行、横线分隔处，伴随杂项文本。

patterns.name: 短词及标点的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活落在换行、句号或常见功能词上，未表现出稳定的共同局部句式。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across letters or subword fragments within words (e.g., g, on, s, t, d, n), as well as code identifiers such as inode. They span diverse styles and contexts, with no stable semantic or thematic commonality.

patterns.name: The letter g within words and place-name spellings
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on g within words, especially Alger- (Algiers, Algeria) and Algak; typically, the whole word is not marked.

patterns.name: on within words
patterns.context: When words are marked in parts, activation falls on the consecutive letters on within a word; this occurs in the personal name Vernon and the country name Indonesia.

patterns.name: s within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on s at the end of or within a word; one example is a plural suffix, and another is a medial syllable.

patterns.name: t within words
patterns.context: In a colloquial abbreviated question, activation falls on the t in n't; the same passage also has weaker activations on pronouns and words.

patterns.name: d within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the d in dealt, in a sentence about handling crime.

patterns.name: Identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: The identifier inode is marked near a structure pointer and function parameters in code; the same passage also marks code tokens such as sb.

patterns.name: n within words
patterns.context: The single letter n is activated in isolation near the end of a noun; the same passage also contains several weak activations on fragments within words.

3_2061.description: 强激活分散在词内字母或子词片段（如 g、on、s、t、d、n），也有 inode 等代码标识符；覆盖多种文体与语境，缺少稳定的语义或主题共性。

patterns.name: 词内的字母 g 及地名拼写
patterns.context: 激活集中在词内的 g，尤其是 Alger-（Algiers、Algeria）和 Algak；通常不是整词被标记。

patterns.name: 词内的 on
patterns.context: 词被拆分标记时，激活落在词内连续字母 on；出现在人名 Vernon 和国家名 Indonesia。

patterns.name: 词内的 s
patterns.context: 激活落在词尾或词内的 s；一例为复数词尾，一例为词中音节。

patterns.name: 词内的 t
patterns.context: 在缩写式口语问句中，激活落在 n't 的 t；同一片段另有较弱的代词和词语激活。

patterns.name: 词内的 d
patterns.context: 激活落在 dealt 的 d，处于关于犯罪处理的句子中。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码中结构体指针及函数参数附近的标识符 inode 被标记；同段还标记 sb 等代码 token。

patterns.name: 词内的 n
patterns.context: 孤立地激活单字母 n，位置在名词词尾附近；同段还出现多处弱的词内片段激活。

en.description: Activation is scattered across multilingual word fragments, English function words, proper names, and numbers. Romanian and place-name examples are relatively common, but the examples are inconsistent across corpora and word classes and cannot be reduced to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in place names
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal letter fragments in place names or demonyms, often spellings containing g; adjacent fragments are sometimes marked too, but not consistently.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, news commentary, and medical conferences

patterns.name: Romanian word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across initial, medial, or final substrings in continuous Romanian text, including articles, affixes, and fragments within ordinary words; no single meaning is apparent.

patterns.name: English common-word or phrase fragments
patterns.context: Function words or local phrases in English sentences are marked; the trigger is unstable and has no obvious connection to the sentence topic.

patterns.name: English place names and geographic names
patterns.context: Activation appears within geographic proper names or their components, including archipelagos, islands, directions, cities, and state abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic geographic entries, web image pages

patterns.name: Internal fragments in English scientific terms
patterns.context: Activation falls within terms and personal names in an English account of meteor observation; the isolated example does not establish a more specific semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Line-break markers and questions in forum text
patterns.context: Text includes line breaks, separators, and forum-style quotations/questions, along with an English negative question. The relationship of this pattern to examples in other languages or place names is unclear.

patterns.name: Numerals or quantity expressions
patterns.context: Activation occasionally occurs near numbers or numerical values, but the triggering forms are inconsistent; marked numbers appear only in individual snippets.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, European Parliament text, forum posts

3_2061.description: 激活散布于多语种词内片段、英语功能词、专名与数字；罗马尼亚语和地名例子较集中，但跨语料、跨词类均不一致，无法归结为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 地名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在地名或国籍词的内部字母片段，常见于包含 g 的拼写；有时前后片段也被标记，但并非固定。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻评论、医学会议等多种文体

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在罗马尼亚语连续文本中的词首、词中或词尾子串，涉及冠词、词缀和普通词内部片段；没有明显单一词义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会罗马尼亚语文本

patterns.name: 英语常用词或短语片段
patterns.trigger: « of»、« shouldn»«'t»、« this»« be»、« from»、« that»、« was»« produced»« by»等
patterns.context: 英文句子中的功能词或局部短语被标记；触发范围不稳定，且与所在句子的主题无明显联系。
patterns.domain: 论坛帖子、网页文本、百科

patterns.name: 英语地名与地理名称
patterns.context: 地理专名或地名组成部分内部出现激活，覆盖群岛、岛屿、方位、城市和州缩写。
patterns.domain: 百科地理条目、网页图片页面

patterns.name: 英语科学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在关于流星观测的英文叙述中的术语和人名内部；不能从单例确定更具体的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 论坛文本中的断行标记与疑问表达
patterns.context: 文本含换行、分隔线和论坛式引用/提问；同时有英语否定疑问句。该模式与其他语种或地名例子关系不明。

patterns.name: 数词或数量表达
patterns.context: 数字或数值附近偶有激活，但触发形式不一致；标记数字仅在个别片段中出现。
patterns.domain: 百科、欧洲议会文本、论坛帖子

en.concept: Possibly biased toward g within words, with scattered activations
en.description: The most salient and reproducible local signal is the letter g within different proper names or words. However, activations also fall on many semantically unrelated word fragments and line breaks, especially in passage 10, which is difficult to connect to the main signal.

patterns.name: g in the spelling of Algiers
patterns.context: The trigger is the letter g in the proper name Algiers, which is split into subwords; it occurs within the word, not at the beginning of a sentence.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, public health academic texts

patterns.name: Place names or proper names containing g
patterns.context: The letter g is matched within proper names or names; the activation falls on g, while the names have varied origins and meanings.
patterns.domain: Geographic encyclopedias, medical conditions, university names

patterns.name: g within Romanian words
patterns.context: In a Romanian parliamentary text, the letter g occurs within the name of a European country or its people.

patterns.name: High-frequency function words or punctuation
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across languages, parts of speech, and styles, with no consistent semantic or contextual condition.

3_2061.concept: 可能偏向词内 g，另有杂散激活
3_2061.description: 最显著且可复现的局部信号是不同专名或词语内部的字母 g；但激活也落在大量无共同语义的词片和换行上，尤其第10段难与主信号对应。

patterns.name: Algiers 拼写中的 g
patterns.context: 触发点是专名 Algiers 中的字母 g，且该词被分词拆开；出现于词中而非句首
patterns.domain: 百科条目、公共卫生学术文本

patterns.name: 含 g 的地名或专名
patterns.context: 在专名或名称内部命中字母 g，激活落在 g 上；名称来源和语义各异
patterns.domain: 地理百科、医学病名、大学名称

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内 g
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会文本中的欧洲国名／国民称谓，字母 g 位于词内

patterns.name: 高频功能词或标点
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在不同语种、词类及文体中，没有一致的语义或上下文条件

en.description: The most stable and strongest clue is g in Algiers, followed by g in Belgians, with another instance in Alak. The remaining activations are scattered across word fragments, function words, and line breaks, with no consistent context; [10] marks in, not g.

patterns.name: g within the place name Algiers
patterns.context: Activation falls on g in the spelling of Algiers, which appears mid-sentence or at the end of a sentence; the three strongest examples all come from this word.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia geography and history; medical research conference narration

patterns.name: g within the spelling of Belgians
patterns.context: Activation falls on g in Belgians, followed by ians; used in accounts of war casualties and European internet users.

patterns.name: g in other words
patterns.context: The g in the island name Alak is marked; [10] actually marks Ferd«in»8anda, not g, so it cannot serve as evidence for a g pattern.

patterns.name: Incidental activations on grammatical words and punctuation
patterns.context: They occur sporadically in their respective sentences, with no shared local spelling or semantic condition apparent.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, medical abstracts, NIH project descriptions, and other prose

patterns.name: Other proper names or word fragments
patterns.context: Activation markers in each passage are scattered at word beginnings, within words, or at subword boundaries; apart from the separately listed g pattern, no shared context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, medical literature, research project descriptions

patterns.name: Line-break markers
patterns.context: They occur at paragraph or text-block boundaries; there is no evidence that they are related to a specific topic.

3_2061.concept: 含 g 的专名词片段（弱）
3_2061.description: 最稳定、最强的线索是 Algiers 中的 g，其次是 Belgians 中的 g，另有 Alak 的 g。其余激活散落于词片段、功能词和换行，缺少一致上下文；[10] 标记的是 in 而非 g。

patterns.name: 阿尔及尔地名内部的 g
patterns.context: 激活落在 Algiers 拼写中的 g，地名出现在句中或句末；强度最高的三个例子都来自该词。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 地理、历史；医学研究会议叙述

patterns.name: 比利时人拼写内部的 g
patterns.context: 激活落在 Belgians 中的 g，后接 ians；分别用于战争死者和欧洲网民的叙述。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 战争纪念；网络评论

patterns.name: 其他词中的 g
patterns.trigger: Al«g»9«ak»（[3]）；«g»（[10] 的 Ferdinanda 中标注为 «in»8，另见说明）
patterns.context: Alak 岛名中 g 被标记；[10] 实际标记的是 Ferd«in»8anda，并非 g，故不能作为 g 模式证据。

patterns.name: 语法词与标点的偶发激活
patterns.context: 在各自句子中零散出现，未见统一的局部拼写或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、医学摘要、NIH 项目简介及其他散文

patterns.name: 其他专名或词片段
patterns.context: 各段出现的激活标记分散在词首、词中或子词边界，除已单列的 g 模式外未见共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学文献、科研项目介绍

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 段落或文本块边界处出现；没有证据表明它与特定主题相关。

en.concept: Local word fragments and formatting triggers
en.description: Activation occurs mainly on g in the place name Algiers, with in the phrase “problem … with”, and sector in the username badsectoracula. There are also line breaks, g in Montgomeryshire, and various scattered word fragments; some contexts lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the name Algeria
patterns.context: The place name Algiers is marked by segmentation, with activation concentrated on the internal letter g; nearby text describes Algerian cities, history, or events.

patterns.name: Negative/problem statements with with
patterns.context: Comments or questions contain phrases such as “problem lies with…” or “problem is not with…”.

patterns.name: Username badsectoracula
patterns.context: A HackerNews post is signed with this username, followed by a line break and quoted or comment text.

patterns.name: g in other place names
patterns.context: The internal letter g in the Welsh place name Montgomeryshire is marked; its context has no obvious connection to the other patterns.

patterns.name: Physical line break
patterns.context: Text contains paragraph or post line breaks, and the line-break character itself activates.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, forums, and other mixed text

patterns.name: Other scattered word fragments
patterns.context: Fragments belong to different words and sentence contexts, with no stable shared condition.

3_2061.concept: 局部词片段与格式触发
3_2061.description: 主要在地名 Algiers 的 g、短语“problem … with”的 with，以及用户名 badsectoracula 的 sector 处激活；另有换行、Montgomeryshire 的 g 和多种零散词片段，部分上下文缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: 阿尔及利亚名称内部片段
patterns.context: 地名 Algiers 被拆分标记，激活集中在内部字母 g；周围介绍阿尔及利亚城市、历史或赛事

patterns.name: 与 with 搭配的否定/问题表述
patterns.context: 评论或问题中出现“problem lies with…”或“problem is not with…”这类搭配

patterns.name: 用户名 badsectoracula
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子以该用户名署名，后接换行及引用或评论内容

patterns.name: 其他地名中的 g
patterns.context: 威尔士地名 Montgomeryshire 的内部字母 g 被标记；无明显与其他模式相同的上下文

patterns.name: 物理换行符
patterns.context: 文本包含段落或帖子换行，换行符本身被激活
patterns.domain: 百科、论坛及其他混合文本

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 各片段分属不同词语及句境，未见稳定共同条件

en.concept: Specific word fragments and formatting fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered: they often fall on with (factors associated with a problem) and on g within forms of Belgium; other examples include D at the beginning of patent sentences, code-comment openers, webpage line breaks and punctuation, and fragmented subwords.

patterns.name: Complement-taking preposition with
patterns.context: In questions, explanations, or discussions, it connects a problem or object to related factors or sources, as in “problem lies with …”; activation falls on with rather than being tied to a particular domain.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, popular science articles, everyday discussion

patterns.name: The letter g in words related to Belgium
patterns.context: It appears within forms of Belgium: Bel«g»ien, Bel«g»«ians»; surrounding text often concerns European languages or geography.
patterns.domain: European parliamentary texts, encyclopedias, statistics articles

patterns.name: Code-comment marker /*!
patterns.context: At the beginning of C/C++-style source files, it serves as the opening marker for a comment or documentation comment.

patterns.name: Initial D in Dock in patent text
patterns.context: A patent background section begins with the compound phrase Dock weather barriers, and activation falls on the initial D in Dock.

patterns.name: Initial Dr in Driving in patent text
patterns.context: A patent background section begins with Driving safety, and activation falls on the initial Dr in Driving.

patterns.name: Fragmented markers and numbers/punctuation
patterns.context: Web or forum content contains line breaks, separators, punctuation, and other formatting fragments; these may be boundary or format markers rather than stable semantic triggers.

patterns.name: g subwords within English words
patterns.context: Seen only in split English strings or abbreviation examples; there is insufficient context to establish a connection with the Belgium-form pattern.

3_2061.description: 激活分散：多次落在 with（问题所关联的因素）、比利时词形内部的 g；另见专利句首 D、代码注释起始符及网页换行、标点和碎片化子词。

patterns.name: 补语连接词 with
patterns.context: 在问题、解释或论述中，连接问题/对象与其相关因素或来源，如“problem lies with …”；激活落在 with 上，而非固定某一领域
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、科普文章、日常论述

patterns.name: 比利时相关词中的字母 g
patterns.context: 出现在比利时词形内部：Bel«g»ien、Bel«g»«ians»；周围常有欧洲语言或欧洲地理语境
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、百科、统计文章

patterns.name: 代码注释标记 /*!
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格源码文件头部，作为注释或文档注释的起始标记

patterns.name: 专利文本中 Dock 的首字母 D
patterns.context: 专利背景段落以复合词 Dock weather barriers 起句，激活在 Dock 的首字母

patterns.name: 专利文本中 Driving 的首字母 Dr
patterns.context: 专利背景段落以 Driving safety 起句，激活在 Driving 的首字母

patterns.name: 碎片化标记与数字/标点
patterns.context: 网页或论坛内容中出现换行、分隔线、标点等格式碎片；可能是边界或格式标记，而非稳定语义触发

patterns.name: 英文词内的 g 子词
patterns.context: 只见于被切分的英文串或缩写示例，缺少足够上下文证明与比利时词形模式相关

en.concept: Corporate email headers and subject formatting
en.description: All samples are Enron emails. The most stable trigger is the tab after Subject: and email-header delimiter formatting; other scattered activations include Cc, reply/forward prefixes, name fragments, dates, and varied subject terms.

patterns.name: Subject marker in the email subject field
patterns.context: In Enron email headers, Subject is followed by a colon and a tab, usually followed by the subject text; this is the recurring high-activation pattern across passages.

patterns.name: Email carbon-copy marker
patterns.context: Cc: and a tab appear after the recipient list, introducing the carbon-copy list.

patterns.name: Whitespace and field delimiters after Subject
patterns.context: Tabs or line breaks between email-header fields, especially formatting boundaries before or after the subject field; the exact trigger position varies.

patterns.name: RE reply prefix in the subject
patterns.context: The email subject begins with RE:, indicating a reply.

patterns.name: FW forward prefix in the subject
patterns.context: The email subject begins with FW:, indicating a forwarded message.

patterns.name: Local fragments with spaces in names
patterns.context: Part of a personal name is activated in an email recipient or carbon-copy list; the list format contains surnames, given names, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Dates and month words in subjects
patterns.context: Dates or month names occur in the email date or subject text; there are few samples, with no consistent semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Business terms or proper-name fragments in subjects
patterns.context: The subject text after Subject contains local fragments of words related to projects, business, organizations, or presentations; the meanings and topics vary.

patterns.name: Timestamps and email-header fields
patterns.context: There are scattered activations near the sent time, date, and To field in email headers, in addition to the subject formatting.

patterns.name: Opening of body text mentioning attachments
patterns.context: The beginning of the body after the subject and email header mentions an attachment.

3_2061.concept: 企业邮件头与主题格式
3_2061.description: 所有样本均为 Enron 邮件，最稳定触发是 Subject: 后的制表符及邮件头分隔格式；另有 Cc、回复/转发前缀、姓名片段、日期和各异的主题词等零散激活。

patterns.name: 邮件主题栏的 Subject 标记
patterns.context: Enron 邮件头中，Subject 后接冒号和制表符，通常再接主题内容；这是各段反复出现的高激活形式。

patterns.name: 邮件抄送标记
patterns.context: 收件人列表之后出现 Cc: 及制表符，引出抄送名单。

patterns.name: Subject 后的空白与字段分隔
patterns.context: 邮件头字段间的制表符或换行，尤其是主题栏前后的格式边界；具体触发位置不完全一致。

patterns.name: 主题中的 RE 回复前缀
patterns.context: Subject 主题以 RE: 开头，表示回复邮件。

patterns.name: 主题中的 FW 转发前缀
patterns.context: Subject 主题以 FW: 开头，表示转发邮件。

patterns.name: 姓名中带空格的局部片段
patterns.trigger: « Christian»、« Edward»、« David»、« Tom»、« Lloyd»、« Kimber»、« James»
patterns.context: 邮件收件人或抄送人名单中，个人姓名的一部分被激活；名单格式含姓、名及标点。

patterns.name: 主题中的日期与月份词
patterns.context: 邮件日期或主题文字中出现日期、月份名称；样本较少，未显示统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 主题中的业务主题词或专名片段
patterns.context: Subject 后的主题正文包含项目、业务、组织或演示相关词语的局部片段；词义和主题各异。

patterns.name: 时间戳及邮件头字段
patterns.context: 邮件头中的发送时间、日期及 To 字段附近，除主题格式外也有零散激活。

patterns.name: 附件相关正文开头
patterns.context: 主题和邮件头之后，正文开头提到附件。

en.description: The clearest pattern is with introducing an object in problem-location sentences. Other patterns include code documentation, header-file macros, email headers, negative questions, Romanian, and scattered fragments within words; these do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “with” and the following problem or part
patterns.context: “with” introduces the object or cause of a problem, usually in a sentence structure meaning “the problem is with …”; the trigger is primarily with, with some adjacent syntactic cues.

patterns.name: File markers in code documentation
patterns.context: Field names in code comments or header-file documentation, especially Doxygen-style \\file and \\author markers.

patterns.name: Specific English words or word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within words or at word-form boundaries, with no consistent syntactic or semantic condition across passages.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, medical abstracts, general English text

patterns.name: Romanian characters/word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within Romanian words, including fragments near diacritics; no obvious English syntactic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Preprocessor directives in code
patterns.context: Include guard macro definitions at the beginning of C/C++ header files.

patterns.name: Email recipient/subject formatting
patterns.context: Names in email headers or contact lists, the Subject label, and the tab after it.

patterns.name: Negative questions in comments
patterns.context: English rhetorical or negative questions at the end of a sentence or in comments, with local activations concentrated around shouldn’t and the question mark.

3_2061.concept: 异质格式与词片段检测
3_2061.description: 最明显模式是问题定位句中引出对象的“with”；另有代码文档、头文件宏、邮件头、否定疑问及罗马尼亚语和零散词内片段等模式，未能归为统一语义。

patterns.name: “with”及后续问题/部位
patterns.context: “with”引出问题所在的对象或原因，通常处于句子中的“问题在于……”结构；触发点主要是 with，也有相邻句法线索。

patterns.name: 代码文档中的文件标记
patterns.context: 代码注释或头文件文档中的字段名，尤其是 Doxygen 风格的 \\file、\\author 标记。

patterns.name: 特定英语词语或词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内或词形边界的碎片上，缺少跨段一致的句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 产品评论、医学摘要、一般英语文本

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语字符/词内片段
patterns.trigger: « pre»；« p»；« oc»；« or»；« an»；« en»
patterns.context: 激活分布在罗马尼亚语词语内部，包含变音符号附近的片段；未见明显英语句法模式。

patterns.name: 代码中的预处理指令
patterns.context: C/C++ 头文件开头的 include guard 宏定义。

patterns.name: 邮件收件人/主题格式
patterns.context: 邮件头或联系人列表中的姓名、Subject 标签及其后的制表符。

patterns.name: 评论中的否定疑问
patterns.context: 句末或评论中的英语反问/否定疑问句，局部激活集中在 shouldn’t 及问号附近。

en.description: Activation is scattered across several local formats and phrases: the with construction for attributing problems in comments, a colon and tab after an email subject field, negative rhetorical questions, and a file-name field in code comments. No single clear semantic feature covers them all.

patterns.name: with introducing the source of a problem
patterns.context: When explaining, evaluating, or attributing, points out where the problem lies, often followed by the, rats, open source, etc. In segments [1] and [6], with itself is unmarked, but the lies with construction also occurs.
patterns.domain: Comments, forum discussions, and news commentary

patterns.name: Separator in email subject field
patterns.context: In an email header, a tab separates Subject: from the subject text, which may begin with RE:, etc.; activation is concentrated on the separator, not a particular subject word.

patterns.name: Negative rhetorical question of the form “shouldn’t…?”
patterns.context: A forum post asks a rhetorical question using a negative modal form, followed by this be up to the mouse driver?

patterns.name: Filename in a code comment
patterns.context: In a C/C++ source file header comment, the field name file is followed by a filename and extension.

3_2061.description: 激活分散在几类局部格式与短语：评论中归因问题的 with 结构、邮件主题字段后的冒号与制表符、否定反问形式，以及代码注释里的 file 文件名字段；没有单一明确语义可覆盖全部。

patterns.name: with 后接问题所在
patterns.context: 在解释、评估或归因时，指出问题出在哪里，常见后续为 the、rats、open source 等；段[1]、[6]中 with 本身是未标记的，但同样出现 lies with 结构。
patterns.domain: 评论、论坛讨论及新闻评论

patterns.name: 邮件主题字段分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件头中 Subject: 后用制表符分隔主题内容，主题可能以 RE: 等开头；激活集中在分隔符而非特定主题词。

patterns.name: 不应……？的反问
patterns.context: 论坛发言中以否定情态形式提出反问，后接 this be up to the mouse driver?

patterns.name: 代码注释中的文件名
patterns.context: C/C++ 源文件头部注释中，字段名 file 后跟文件名及扩展名。

en.concept: Email forwarding headers and lies with
en.description: The main responses are to the tab whitespace after Subject and the FW: forwarding marker in email headers, as well as lies with in ordinary sentences. There are scattered activations on email field delimiters, some subject terms, and fragments within words, possibly related to email formatting or tokenization boundaries; no independent semantic regularity can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Forwarding marker in email subjects
patterns.context: In email headers, the Subject field is followed by a colon, whitespace, and FW:, sometimes followed by the subject; this is the main recurring pattern.

patterns.name: “lies with” collocation
patterns.context: The phrase lies with introduces the location of a problem or responsibility in a sentence, followed by a cause or object.
patterns.domain: Commentary, political commentary, and technical articles

patterns.name: Structural punctuation and whitespace in email headers
patterns.context: Near the boundaries of fields such as email addresses, recipients, carbon copies, or subjects; some activations fall on field delimiters and line-break whitespace.

patterns.name: Nonstandard token splitting and fragments within words
patterns.context: Words or abbreviation fragments split by BPE are activated in neighboring text; they do not appear to form a consistent, independent semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, email, and general text

patterns.name: Business terms in email subjects
patterns.context: Some subject-content words in forwarded subjects are also weakly activated, but the terms vary and show no independent, unified word-meaning pattern.

patterns.name: Beginning of email body
patterns.context: A small number of activations occur after the forwarded email header, near the start of the body; the body content itself shows no stable trigger feature.

patterns.name: High-activation relational words in ordinary text
patterns.context: Words near the lies with collocation may activate even if they are not central to it; isolated instances of the and with are insufficient to form a stable pattern.

3_2061.concept: 邮件转发头与 lies with
3_2061.description: 主要响应邮件头 Subject 后的制表空白及 FW: 转发标记，也响应普通句中的 lies with。邮件字段分隔符、部分主题词和词内碎片有零星激活，可能与邮件格式或分词边界有关，无法确认独立语义规律。

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的转发标记
patterns.context: 邮件头中 Subject 字段后出现冒号、空白和 FW:，有时后接主题；这是主要且反复出现的模式。

patterns.name: “lies with”搭配
patterns.context: 句中以 lies with 引出问题所在或责任所在，后续接原因或对象。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的结构性标点与空白
patterns.context: 邮件地址、收件人、抄送或主题等字段边界附近；部分激活落在字段分隔符及换行空白上。

patterns.name: 非标准 token 断词及词内片段
patterns.context: 被 BPE 拆分的词或缩写片段在邻近文本中激活；未见它们构成一致的独立语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 产品评论、邮件与普通文本

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的业务主题词
patterns.trigger: « Weather»« Class»、« Due» Diligence、« Administrative» Changes、« Griffith»« Sales»、Brid«g»eline Cash and« AR»
patterns.context: 转发主题中的主题内容词也有零星激活，但词项各异，未显示独立、统一的词义模式。

patterns.name: 邮件正文起始处
patterns.trigger: «↵»«↵»I am sure you、«↵»«↵»As I am not
patterns.context: 转发邮件头之后、正文开始附近出现少量激活；正文内容本身未显示稳定触发特征。

patterns.name: 普通文本中的高激活关系词
patterns.context: 在 lies with 搭配附近，即使不是搭配核心词也可能激活；其余单独的 the/with 不足以构成稳定模式。

en.description: The clearest pattern is problems or defects introduced by “lies with” or “is with”; the remaining highlights occur across technical terms, e.g. formatting, and isolated word fragments, and cannot be grouped into the same stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “lies with” attribution construction
patterns.context: When discussing a problem, defect, or responsibility, the construction “the problem … lies with X” is used; X is often the entity being held responsible.
patterns.domain: News commentary, product reviews, popular science articles

patterns.name: “is with” locating a problem
patterns.context: With a noun such as issue/problem as the subject, it identifies where the problem lies; activation falls on “with”.

patterns.name: Technical terms and collocations
patterns.context: Disciplinary terms, chains of noun modifiers, and formal technical expressions occur in specialized explanations; no single local construction explains all the highlights.

patterns.name: English abbreviations and parenthetical example formatting
patterns.context: Parentheses provide examples, or formatted text appears in abstracts and patents; highlights fall on abbreviation characters and adjacent punctuation.
patterns.domain: Academic, patent, and formal explanatory prose

patterns.name: Scattered words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: These words or subwords occur in their respective sentences. Except where some overlap with the constructions above, there is insufficient evidence of a shared stable trigger.
patterns.domain: News and entertainment, patents, medical papers, and general text

3_2061.concept: 问题归因的 with 句式
3_2061.description: 最明确的模式是问题/缺陷由“lies with”或“is with”引出；其余高亮散见于专业术语、e.g.格式和孤立词片段，无法归为同一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: “lies with”归责句式
patterns.trigger: « lies» / «lies» + « with»，如 “problem lies with the rats”“problem lies with the inner display”“problem only lies with hand soaps”
patterns.context: 在讨论问题、缺陷或责任所在时，使用“the problem … lies with X”句式；X 常是被归责的对象。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、产品评论、科普文章

patterns.name: “is with”定位问题
patterns.trigger: « is» + « with»，如 “largest issue is with traversal and data access latencies”
patterns.context: 以 issue/problem 等名词为主语，指出问题出在某方面；激活落在 “with”。

patterns.name: 技术性术语与搭配
patterns.trigger: « DNA»« damage»« is»；« DNA»« repair»；« dynamic»…« functions»；“ceramic applications”“driving safety”“knee osteoarthritis”“orthopedic surgery”
patterns.context: 在专业说明中出现学科术语、名词修饰链及正式技术表达；未见统一的局部句式解释所有高亮。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利、论文摘要

patterns.name: 英语缩写与括号示例格式
patterns.context: 用括号中的例子补充说明，或出现论文摘要、专利中的格式化文本；高亮落在缩写字符及相邻标点。
patterns.domain: 学术、专利及正式说明文

patterns.name: 零散词语与词形片段
patterns.trigger: « mom»、« Mila»、« purpose»、« of»、« criteria»、« were»、« lies»
patterns.context: 这些词或子词出现在各自句子中，除个别与前述句式重叠外，没有足够证据表明共享稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻娱乐、专利、医学论文及一般文本

en.description: Strongly responds to Subject, tabs, fields, and time colons in Enron email headers, and also to recipient names, reply markers, and scattered email words. There are also instances of with in consumer reviews and biomedical DNA-repair contexts, with no unified meaning.

patterns.name: Content following “with”
patterns.context: Passage 1 contains “the problem lies with the inner display”; “use” appears in “real world use”.

patterns.name: Biomedical terms and coordination
patterns.context: Describes the sensing and repair of DNA damage, and coordination between repair and chromatin function.

patterns.name: Email subject field
patterns.context: The Subject label and subject text that follows in email headers; often listed alongside fields such as From, Sent, To, and Cc.

patterns.name: Tabs and recipient/carbon-copy fields in email headers
patterns.context: Tabs between email-header fields and recipient lists, alongside names, dates, and subject fields.

patterns.name: Time colons in email headers
patterns.context: A colon in a timestamp, usually separating hours and minutes; the marked span may cover a tokenization combination of digits and a colon.

patterns.name: Reply/forward markers in email subjects
patterns.context: A subject or email separator contains the RE: reply prefix, or the Original Message marker for a quoted email.

patterns.name: Names and organization words in email address books
patterns.context: Names of people or organizations in email sender/recipient lists, carbon copies, or subjects; some names are split into subwords, making it difficult to confirm a specific name pattern.

patterns.name: Isolated words in email bodies or subjects
patterns.context: A few words occur after the subject or at the start of the body, without a clear trigger relation repeated across passages.

3_2061.description: 强烈响应Enron邮件头的Subject及制表符、字段和时间冒号，也涉及收件人姓名、回复标记和零散邮件词；另有消费评论中的with及生物医学DNA修复语境，缺乏统一词义。

patterns.name: “with”后接内容
patterns.context: 第1段中“the problem lies with the inner display”；“use”出现在“real world use”中。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语与协调关系
patterns.context: 介绍DNA损伤的感知、修复，以及修复与染色质功能的协调。

patterns.name: 邮件主题字段
patterns.context: 邮件头中Subject标签及其后的主题内容；多与From、Sent、To、Cc等字段并列。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的制表符与收件人/抄送字段
patterns.context: 邮件头字段间的制表符和收件人列表；伴随姓名、日期及主题字段。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的时间冒号
patterns.context: 时间戳中的冒号，通常连接小时与分钟；强度标记可能覆盖数字与冒号的分词组合。

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的回复/转发标记
patterns.context: 主题或邮件分隔处带有RE:回复前缀，或引用邮件的Original Message标记。

patterns.name: 邮件地址簿中的姓名及组织词
patterns.context: 邮件收发人、抄送人或主题中的人名/组织名；部分姓名被拆成子词，难以确认是否有特定姓名模式。

patterns.name: 邮件正文或主题中的孤立词
patterns.context: 邮件主题之后或正文开头出现的少量词语，没有跨段重复的明确触发关系。

en.concept: Structural markers and fixed phrases in expository text
en.description: Activation occurs most consistently in the “e.g.” exemplification construction, and also in the problem-attribution phrase “the problem lies with”, colon-introduced lists, and descriptions of environmental conditions. There are also domain-specific signals involving clinical exclusion criteria, email headers, research aims, and DNA repair.

patterns.name: Exemplification abbreviation e.g.
patterns.context: Introduces examples in parentheses, especially in the “(e.g., …)” construction; activation falls on the abbreviation components and adjacent punctuation.

patterns.name: Problem-attribution construction
patterns.context: A problem or defect is attributed to an object, often followed by a definite article and noun.

patterns.name: List after a colon
patterns.context: A colon introduces criteria, exclusion conditions, or email body text; the surrounding context varies considerably when this occurs alone.

patterns.name: Descriptions of road and weather conditions
patterns.context: Describes environmental conditions and events that affect safety, facilities, or infrastructure.

patterns.name: Research aims and factor roles
patterns.context: A statement of research aims explains the role of a factor being assessed.

patterns.name: Comparison of cable installation methods
patterns.context: Compares overhead and underground telecommunications cable installation, and recounts the risk of weather damage.

patterns.name: Email header fields and names
patterns.context: Email headers or forwarded-email formats, with tabs, colons, and line breaks between fields.

patterns.name: Clinical exclusion criteria
patterns.context: Lists conditions under which patients are excluded from a study; examples are often placed in parentheses.

patterns.name: Parallelism of DNA damage and repair
patterns.context: Discusses damage recognition, repair, and their coordination with chromatin function.

3_2061.concept: 说明性文本中的结构标记与固定搭配
3_2061.description: 激活最稳定地出现在“e.g.”例示结构，也见于问题归因句“the problem lies with”、冒号列表和环境条件描述；另有临床排除标准、邮件头、研究目的及DNA修复等领域特有信号。

patterns.name: 例示缩写 e.g.
patterns.context: 引出括号中的例子，尤其在“(e.g., …)”结构中；激活落在缩写各部分及邻近标点上
patterns.domain: 学术、专利等说明性文体

patterns.name: 问题归因句式
patterns.context: 问题或缺陷被归因于某对象，常接定冠词及名词

patterns.name: 冒号后的列表
patterns.context: 冒号引出标准、排除条件或邮件正文；单独出现时上下文差异较大

patterns.name: 道路与天气条件表述
patterns.context: 描述影响安全、设施或基础设施的环境条件与事件

patterns.name: 研究目的与因素角色
patterns.context: 研究目的句中说明评估某因素的作用

patterns.name: 电缆铺设方式对比
patterns.context: 对比电信线缆地上架设与地下铺设，并转述天气损害风险

patterns.name: 邮件头字段与姓名
patterns.context: 邮件头或转发邮件格式，字段间有制表符、冒号和换行

patterns.name: 临床排除标准
patterns.context: 列明患者不纳入研究的条件，例子常置于括号中

patterns.name: DNA损伤与修复并列
patterns.context: 讨论损伤感知、修复及其与染色质功能的协调

en.description: Activations are scattered: common on “with the” and “e.g.”, and also strong on fields, punctuation, names, and subjects in Enron email headers; other contexts include DNA repair, road safety, technical delays, product reviews, and political commentary.

patterns.name: “with the” collocation
patterns.context: The phrase “lies with the …”, especially with followed by the; the following nouns vary.

patterns.name: “e.g.” abbreviation
patterns.context: The parenthetical example-introducing phrase “e.g.”, followed by a specific example.

patterns.name: Enron email-header fields
patterns.context: Subject, To, Cc, Sent, and other fields in email headers adjacent to colons, tabs, and line breaks; field values include names, subjects, or dates.

patterns.name: Names and name fragments
patterns.context: Names occur in email recipient, carbon-copy, or signature lists, often split into multiple token fragments.

patterns.name: Email subject labels and values
patterns.context: Subject is followed by a colon and tab, then the subject; subjects may contain RE, topic names, or organization names.

patterns.name: Email date and time fields
patterns.context: Dates, times, or time-zone formats follow the Sent field in email headers.

patterns.name: Road safety and lighting conditions
patterns.context: Discusses how driving safety depends on road conditions, using lighting and daylight as examples.

patterns.name: DNA damage and repair
patterns.context: Discusses the sensing and repair of DNA damage and their coordination with chromatin function.

patterns.name: Start of email body
patterns.context: The body begins with a supplementary connective phrase after the email header ends.

patterns.name: Latency in big-data access
patterns.context: States that the problem for big-data applications lies in traversal and data-access latency.

patterns.name: Durability and real-world use
patterns.context: Questions whether claims about product durability hold up under real-world use.

patterns.name: “the problem is” in political commentary
patterns.context: Political commentary disputes the claim that the problem should be blamed on “rats”.

3_2061.description: 激活分散：常见于“with the”及“e.g.”，也强烈出现在Enron邮件头的字段、标点、姓名和主题中；另涉及DNA修复、道路安全、技术延迟、产品评论与政治评论。

patterns.name: “with the”搭配
patterns.context: 短语“lies with the …”中，尤其是 with 后接 the；后续名词内容不同。
patterns.domain: 评论性文章、技术讨论、新闻评论

patterns.name: “e.g.”缩写
patterns.context: 括号中的举例引导语“e.g.”；后面接具体例子。

patterns.name: Enron邮件头字段
patterns.context: 邮件头中 Subject、To、Cc、Sent 等字段与冒号、制表符、换行相邻；多个字段值是姓名、主题或日期。

patterns.name: 人名及姓名片段
patterns.context: 姓名位于邮件收件人、抄送或署名列表中，常被拆分为多个标记片段。

patterns.name: 邮件主题标签和值
patterns.context: Subject 后接冒号和制表符，再接主题；主题可含 RE、事项名或机构名。

patterns.name: 邮件日期时间字段
patterns.context: 邮件头的 Sent 字段之后出现日期、时间或时区格式。

patterns.name: 道路安全与照明条件
patterns.context: 讨论驾驶安全依赖道路状况，并以照明、日光等为例。

patterns.name: DNA损伤与修复
patterns.context: 讨论DNA损伤的感知、修复及其与染色质功能的协调。

patterns.name: 邮件正文起始
patterns.context: 邮件头结束后，以补充性连接语开始正文。

patterns.name: 大数据访问延迟
patterns.trigger: «is»5« with»10 traversal and data access latencies
patterns.context: 指出大数据应用的问题在于遍历与数据访问延迟。

patterns.name: 长度耐久性与现实使用
patterns.context: 对产品耐久性宣传是否经得起现实使用提出质疑。

patterns.name: 政治评论中的“问题在于”
patterns.context: 政治评论中反驳把问题归咎于“rats”的说法。

en.concept: Email subject formatting and the lies with collocation
en.description: The main pattern is a tab after the colon in an email subject field. Email subjects, FW:, and timestamps also show scattered activation. In two non-email passages, with activates strongly in the “the problem lies with” collocation. The email-format patterns are related to one another, but have no obvious connection to this collocation.

patterns.name: “lies with” collocation
patterns.context: The “the problem lies with …” or “the problem lies with … rather than …” construction; activation is concentrated on with.

patterns.name: Tab in the email subject field
patterns.context: The tab between Subject: and the subject text in Enron email headers; subject content varies.

patterns.name: FW marker in forwarded email subjects
patterns.context: FW: marks a forwarded message in an email subject field.

patterns.name: Specific administrative topics in email subjects
patterns.context: Email subject fields mention matters such as system capacity, contract processes, training, software rights, meetings, or lists; the subject words themselves show only scattered activation.

patterns.name: PM marker in date and time
patterns.context: An afternoon time marker in an email header timestamp; activation is weak and appears in only a few snippets.

3_2061.concept: 邮件主题格式与 lies with 搭配
3_2061.description: 主要模式是邮件主题栏冒号后的制表符；邮件主题、FW:及时间戳也有零散激活。另在两段非邮件文本中，with 强烈激活于“the problem lies with”搭配。邮件格式模式彼此相关，但与该搭配无明显关联。

patterns.name: “lies with”搭配
patterns.context: “the problem lies with …”或“the problem lies with … rather than …”结构；激活集中在 with。

patterns.name: 邮件主题栏的制表符
patterns.context: Enron 邮件头中 Subject: 后、主题文本前的制表符；主题内容各异。

patterns.name: 邮件转发主题中的 FW 标记
patterns.context: 邮件主题栏内以 FW: 标示转发。

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的具体行政事项
patterns.trigger: «off»2«system»2« capacity»2；«Terminated Contract Process»；«Power World Training»；«RE: Ownership and Rights to Software»；«conf call»；«lists»
patterns.context: 邮件主题栏出现系统容量、合同流程、培训、软件权利、会议或列表等事项；主题词本身仅有零散激活。

patterns.name: 日期时间中的 PM 标记
patterns.context: 邮件头日期时间中的下午时间标记；激活较弱且只见于少数片段。

en.description: Strong activations are distributed across varied texts: they recur in word forms such as failing, tripled, and coupled, and also involve reports, requests, screening, and deadlines; no single semantic theme explains all instances.

patterns.name: Failure and inability to achieve
patterns.context: Describes failure to complete a goal, qualify, or succeed, often following “after” or “at”; also appears in political commentary in “failing to act”.

patterns.name: Tripling in size
patterns.context: A quantity or size becomes three times its original value; used for ferry passenger numbers and building area.

patterns.name: Coupled
patterns.context: Appears as part of a protein name, meaning G Protein Coupled Receptor.

patterns.name: Listing similar objects
patterns.context: Lists common objects or actions in the same category.

patterns.name: Coiled coil in a compound term
patterns.context: Appears in the term “coiled coil” describing a protein structural region.

patterns.name: Request and response
patterns.context: Discusses a PayPal request and the experience of not getting the desired answer.

patterns.name: Carrier screening
patterns.context: A research abstract reports carrier screening for a specific genetic disease.

patterns.name: Reporting research findings
patterns.context: Papers use “reports” to introduce survey or interview findings.

patterns.name: Waiting until the last minute
patterns.context: Describes waiting until the last minute to act; the surrounding text consists of news snippets about passengers or crowds.

patterns.name: Deadline and report
patterns.context: Requests submission of an expense report by the 13th of this month.

patterns.name: Project assignment and personal choice
patterns.context: Contrasts tasks selected for you by others with projects you choose yourself.

3_2327.description: 强激活分散在多种文本中：反复出现在 failing（失败）、tripled（三倍）及 coupled（耦合）等词形，也涉及报告、请求、筛查和截止日期；没有一个语义主题能解释全部实例。

patterns.name: 失败与未能达成
patterns.context: 描述未能完成目标、资格或成功，常接在“after”或“at”之后；也出现在政治评论中“failing to act”。
patterns.domain: 评论、创业叙事、个人随笔

patterns.name: 三倍增长
patterns.context: 数量或规模变为原来的三倍；分别用于渡轮客流量和建筑面积。

patterns.name: 耦合
patterns.context: 作为蛋白质名称中的组成部分，表示 G Protein Coupled Receptor。

patterns.name: 同类对象列举
patterns.context: 列举同一类别的常见对象或行为。

patterns.name: 复合词中的 coiled coil
patterns.context: 出现在描述蛋白质结构区域的“coiled coil”术语中。

patterns.name: 请求与回应
patterns.context: 讨论 PayPal 请求以及未获得所需答案的经历。

patterns.name: 载体筛查
patterns.context: 研究摘要报告对特定遗传病的携带者筛查。

patterns.name: 报告研究结果
patterns.context: 论文用“reports”引出调查或访谈结果。

patterns.name: 逾期等待
patterns.context: 描述等到最后一分钟才行动；周围是关于乘客或人群的新闻片段。

patterns.name: 截止日期与报告
patterns.context: 要求在本月 13 日前提交费用报告。

patterns.name: 项目归属与个人选择
patterns.context: 对比别人替你选择的任务与自己选择的项目。

en.description: Activation is clearest on failure expressions such as failing/failing to…, biomedical compound terms, date-deadline expressions, and tripled. Other local terms activate sporadically across domains, without a consistent trigger.

patterns.name: Dates and deadlines
patterns.context: A work email states that materials must be submitted by a date in the current month; activation concentrates on the date suffix and surrounding date phrase.

patterns.name: Failure and its consequences
patterns.context: fail/failing appears, especially when describing failure to act, qualify, or complete something; also includes comparisons or reflections on failure.
patterns.domain: Political commentary, entrepreneurial narratives, personal commentary

patterns.name: Biomedical compound terms
patterns.context: Specialized terms, protein names, and disease/clinical topics in biomedical abstracts or research applications; activation is distributed across term components and collocations.

patterns.name: Tripling
patterns.context: Describes a quantity, scale, or metric increasing to three times its original value; the same word appears in two different narratives.

patterns.name: Local terms not covered by the patterns above
patterns.context: These passages contain individually salient terms or phrases, but there is insufficient repeated evidence for a distinct, stable shared trigger pattern; a single semantic interpretation cannot be inferred from these terms alone.
patterns.domain: Political commentary, traffic news, biomedical abstracts

3_2327.description: 激活最明确地落在 failing/failing to… 的失败表达、医学复合术语、日期截止表达及 tripled 上；另有分散局部词项，跨领域且触发并不统一。

patterns.name: 日期截止与期限
patterns.trigger: “expense reports 10 in by the 13th of this month”中的“13th”
patterns.context: 工作邮件中说明某项材料需在当月某日期前提交；激活集中在日期后缀及周围日期短语。

patterns.name: 失败及其后果
patterns.trigger: “failing to act”“failing to qualify”“Failing at”“failing at your own project”中的“failing”
patterns.context: 出现 fail/failing，尤其是描述未能采取行动、达到资格或完成某事；也包括对失败的比较或反思。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、创业叙述、个人评论

patterns.name: 医学与生物学的复合术语
patterns.trigger: “coiled coil”（“coil”最强）；以及“protein”“membrane-associated”“G Protein Coupled Receptor”“Canavan disease”“cochlear implants”等
patterns.context: 生物医学摘要或研究申请中的专业术语、蛋白名称与疾病/临床主题；激活分散在术语构成词及搭配中。

patterns.name: 三倍增长
patterns.context: 描述数量、规模或某项指标增加到原来的三倍；同一词在两个不同叙述中出现。

patterns.name: 未能纳入上述模式的局部词项
patterns.context: 这些段落中有各自显著的词项或短语，但未见足够重复证据支持独立且稳定的共同触发模式；不能仅凭这些词推断单一语义。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、交通新闻、生物医学摘要

en.description: The main pattern is failing followed by a to-infinitive, found in commentary, forums, patents, and medical texts. Other isolated activations include ordinal date suffixes, coupled in protein names, the abbreviation CCW, and monetary figures; no unified semantic relation is evident.

patterns.name: Construction with to following failing
patterns.context: The present participle or gerund failing is followed by the infinitive to + verb, indicating failure to do something. The construction occurs across different semantic and syntactic contexts.
patterns.domain: News commentary, emails, forums, patents, medical and technical texts

patterns.name: Ordinal date suffix th
patterns.context: A numeral combines with a tokenized ordinal suffix; in [2], it is “13”“th”. In [4], technical tokenization such as “structure-5function” provides context, but the highest-activating visible word piece is “coil” in “co”“iled”“coil”.

patterns.name: coupled tokenization
patterns.context: Appears in the protein name “G Protein Coupled Receptor” and may relate to the tokenization boundary of coupled.

patterns.name: CCW abbreviation character fragments
patterns.context: The abbreviation CCW (coal combustion waste) appears repeatedly in the same passage; activation falls on its letter tokens.
patterns.domain: Geological survey and environmental risk description

patterns.name: Monetary figure fragments
patterns.context: Figures appear in pound amounts and regional spending data; visible activation is weak, and there is insufficient context for a more specific interpretation.

3_2327.description: 主要模式是 failing 后接 to 的不定式结构，见于评论、论坛、专利及医学文本。另有日期序数、蛋白名称中的 coupled、CCW 缩写及金额数字等孤立激活，未见统一语义关系。

patterns.name: failing 后接 to 的结构
patterns.trigger: “failing”后紧接“to”，并在“failing”上激活；见 “failing to act”“After failing to qualify”“failing to provide”“failing to achieve”
patterns.context: 现在分词或动名词 failing 后接不定式 to + 动词，表示未能做成某事。该结构横跨不同语义和句法环境。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、邮件、论坛、专利、医学与科技文本

patterns.name: 日期序数后缀 th
patterns.trigger: “13”后接“th”，两段均在这类词片上有激活
patterns.context: 数字与序数后缀分词组合；在 [2] 中为 “13”“th”，在 [4] 中以段内 “structure-5function” 等技术分词为背景，但激活最高的可见词片是 “co”“iled”“coil”中的“coil”
patterns.domain: 商务邮件；生物医学技术文本

patterns.name: coupled 分词
patterns.context: 出现在蛋白质名称 “G Protein Coupled Receptor” 中，可能与 coupled 这一词的分词边界相关。

patterns.name: CCW 缩写字符片段
patterns.context: 同一段反复出现 CCW（煤燃烧废弃物）缩写；激活落在字母分词上。
patterns.domain: 地质调查与环境风险说明

patterns.name: 金额数字片段
patterns.context: 数字出现在英镑金额与地区支出数据中；可见激活较弱，缺乏足够上下文支持更具体解释。

en.concept: The failing word form and its contexts
en.description: The most consistent pattern is the range of forms of failing, appearing in contexts of failure to act, failing an exam, organ failure, or inability to complete something, across multiple genres. Another passage contains a split and resumed personal name; date and duration words in two emails also activate, with no clear connection between them.

patterns.name: Various forms of failing
patterns.context: The word form appears in different constructions: infinitive “failing to + verb” (3, 9, 10), progressive/participle “failing + noun” (4, 6), and nominal or gerund use “Failing at ...” (5).
patterns.domain: Across genres: news commentary, payment service descriptions, medical applications, personal essays, medical patent backgrounds, musical instrument patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Name split into subwords and resumed
patterns.context: A standalone personal name is split into multiple subwords and then restarted after a line break; it has no apparent semantic connection to the failing-form pattern.

patterns.name: Time and number phrases
patterns.context: Everyday work emails report a deadline or time spent; activations cluster on ordinal dates and time-related narrative words.

3_2327.description: 最稳定模式是 failing 的多种词形，出现在未能行动、未通过、器官衰竭或未能完成等语境，横跨多类文体。另有一段人名拆分续写；两封邮件中的日期、时长词也激活，彼此未见明确联系。

patterns.name: failing 的多种形态
patterns.context: 词形出现于不同结构中：不定式 “failing to + 动词”（3、9、10），进行/分词形式 “failing + 名词”（4、6），以及名词性或动名词用法 “Failing at ...”（5）。
patterns.domain: 跨文体；新闻评论、支付服务说明、医学申请、个人随笔、医学专利背景、乐器专利背景

patterns.name: 人名分词与续写
patterns.context: 孤立的人名拆分成多个子词，随后在换行后重启；与 failing 词形模式无明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物条目或列表

patterns.name: 时间与数字短语
patterns.context: 日常工作邮件中报告截止日期或已花费的时间；激活集中于序数日期及时间叙述词。

en.description: The most prominent repeated pattern is failing (including failing to and failing at). Other activations occur on duration expressions, a subword in a name, modifiers and speeches in political commentary, fruit in a research title, and reports in an email.

patterns.name: failing / failing to
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on failing itself; in several examples it is followed by the infinitive “to”, and there is also “failing at”.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including medical texts, online articles, workplace emails, and policy texts

patterns.name: Expressions of time spent
patterns.context: The past-tense verb spent is followed by about and a duration, then with.

patterns.name: Subword within a name
patterns.context: A name is split into multiple subword tokens, with activation on the name fragment; Gino appears again later in the same passage.

patterns.name: Political figure and characteristic behavior wording
patterns.context: Comments on the Trump presidency and lists typical politician behavior; activation falls on evaluative modifiers and speeches.

patterns.name: Fruit and vegetable consumption topic term
patterns.context: Appears in a research title about the relationship between neighbourhood access and personal fruit and vegetable consumption.

patterns.name: Reports awaiting approval
patterns.context: reports is the subject in a statement that the reports are awaiting the recipient’s approval.

3_2327.concept: 不定式/分词 failing 及杂项词汇
3_2327.description: 最显著的重复模式是 failing（包括 failing to、failing at）；此外还对时长表达、一个姓名的子词、政治评论中的修饰词与 speeches、研究标题中的 fruit、邮件中的 reports 激活。

patterns.name: failing / failing to
patterns.context: 激活集中在 failing 本身；在若干例子中后接不定式“to”，也有“failing at”。
patterns.domain: 医学、网络文章、职场邮件、政策文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 花费时间表达
patterns.context: 过去时 spent 后接 about 和时长，再接 with。

patterns.name: 姓名内部子词
patterns.context: 姓名被拆成多个子词 token，激活落在姓名片段上；同一段后面再次出现 Gino。

patterns.name: 政治人物与典型行为措辞
patterns.context: 评论 Trump presidency，并列举典型政客行为；激活落在评价性修饰语和 speeches 上。

patterns.name: 果蔬消费主题词
patterns.context: 出现在 neighbourhood access 与个人果蔬消费关系的研究标题中。

patterns.name: 报告待审批
patterns.context: reports 作主语，说明报告等待收件人批准。

en.description: Activations mainly occur on fruit, failing, and generate, spanning literal and figurative contexts, expressions of failure, and different senses of generation, respectively; several other isolated words also activate strongly, with no unified semantic or stylistic cues.

patterns.name: Literal use of fruit
patterns.context: Connected with and, of, and similar words, it is used as a food or biological object, or figuratively for the product of thought; activation falls on fruit.

patterns.name: The failing word form
patterns.context: Appears in expressions such as “failing to act,” “After failing to qualify,” and “failing at ...,” meaning inability to do something or failure.

patterns.name: Forms of generate
patterns.context: Appears with public address or to mean producing negative publicity; the verb generate occurs in both senses.

patterns.name: Other words and local collocations
patterns.context: Each passage contains only isolated highly activated words or phrases, with no shared contextual condition.

3_2327.description: 激活主要落在 fruit、failing、generate 上，分别跨越字面与比喻语境、失败表达和不同含义的生成表达；另有若干孤立词语高激活，未显示统一语义或文体线索。

patterns.name: fruit 字面用法
patterns.context: 与 and、of 等连接，作为饮食或生物学对象，或比喻思想成果；激活落在 fruit 上。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、学术文本、散文

patterns.name: failing 词形
patterns.context: 出现在“failing to act”“After failing to qualify”“failing at ...”等表达中，表示未能做到或失败。
patterns.domain: 评论、创业博客、个人叙述

patterns.name: generate 词形
patterns.context: 与 public address 连用，或表示产生负面舆论；不同语义下均出现在动词 generate 上。

patterns.name: 其他词语及局部搭配
patterns.context: 各段仅有孤立的高激活词或短语，未见共同上下文条件。

en.concept: The fail word family and several subword fragments
en.description: Activations most consistently occur on the fail word family, covering personal setbacks, failure to achieve goals, and program errors; there are also sporadic responses to crops, fruit, the plural ending of rug, a textiles fragment, and fragments in reproductive development texts.

patterns.name: The fail word family and its participial forms
patterns.context: fail/failing appears in contexts involving failure, ineffectiveness, failing a grade, or program errors; the main marked form is failing
patterns.domain: Spoken narratives, news, technical texts, commentary

patterns.name: Fruit and crop vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses fruit and vegetable consumption or agricultural crops; both triggers occur in noun phrases
patterns.domain: Public health abstracts, agricultural patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Rug and its plural ending
patterns.context: When discussing rugs, the stem of rug and its plural ending are marked separately

patterns.name: Clothing vocabulary
patterns.context: An internal fragment of textiles appears in a list of products related to commercially important crops

patterns.name: Atypical reproductive development vocabulary
patterns.context: Studies sex determination in Drosophila germ cells; triggers are distributed across biological terminology and species names

3_2327.description: 激活最稳定地落在 failing 词族，涵盖个人挫败、未能达成目标及程序故障；另对 crops、fruit、rug 复数词尾、textiles 片段及生殖发育文本中的词片段有零散响应。

patterns.name: fail词族及其分词形式
patterns.context: fail/failing 出现在失败、未能奏效、成绩不及格或程序故障等语境中；标记形式主要是 failing
patterns.domain: 口语叙述、新闻、技术文本、评论

patterns.name: 果实与农作物词汇
patterns.context: 谈及水果蔬菜消费、农业作物；两处触发都位于名词短语
patterns.domain: 公共卫生摘要、农业专利背景

patterns.name: rug 及复数词尾
patterns.context: 谈论地毯时，rug 的词干与复数词尾分别标记

patterns.name: 服装词汇
patterns.context: 列举商业重要农作物相关产品时出现 textiles 的词内片段

patterns.name: 非典型生殖发育词汇
patterns.context: 研究果蝇生殖细胞性别决定；触发分散在生物学术语和物种名词中

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the word form “failing,” covering failure, poor performance, and inability to achieve a goal; there are also sporadic activations on several subword fragments in code filenames, personal names, medical terminology, and URLs.

patterns.name: The “failing” word form
patterns.context: The word means failure, poor performance, or inability to do something; strong activation occurs whether the subject is an individual, political action, or qualification application.

patterns.name: Code file path fragments
patterns.context: A filename or path-like string in a Go comment; activation is concentrated on split path/identifier fragments.

patterns.name: Name fragments and repetition
patterns.context: The repeated proper name “Douglas McLelland”; activation falls on subword-split name fragments.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia title or entry text; passage 7

patterns.name: Lactating cell terminology
patterns.context: Biomedical phrases related to secretion, autophagy, and prolactin cells; activation falls on subword fragments of the terms.

patterns.name: Web URL fragments
patterns.context: A URL path following an article title; activation is concentrated on URL substrings rather than the title text.

3_2327.description: 主要对词形“failing”强烈响应，涵盖失败、表现不佳和未能达成目标；另对代码文件名、人名、医学术语及网址中的若干分词片段有零散激活。

patterns.name: “failing”词形
patterns.context: 该词在句中表示失败、表现不佳或未能做到；无论是个人、政治行动还是资格申请，均触发强激活。

patterns.name: 代码文件路径片段
patterns.context: Go 注释中的文件名或路径样式字符串，激活集中于被拆分的路径/标识符片段。

patterns.name: 人名片段与重复
patterns.context: 重复出现的专名“Douglas McLelland”，激活落在分词后的姓名片段。
patterns.domain: 百科标题或条目文本；段7

patterns.name: 泌乳细胞术语
patterns.context: 分泌、自噬与催乳素细胞相关的生物医学短语，激活落在术语的分词片段。

patterns.name: 网页 URL 片段
patterns.context: 文章标题后的网址路径，激活集中在 URL 的子串而非标题正文。

en.description: Strong activations fall respectively on English to, Swedish den, and Hungarian ves-; each is triggered by lexical and syntactic contexts in its own language, with the corpus spanning parliamentary texts and forums.

patterns.name: English infinitive marker/directional preposition to
patterns.context: Introduces an infinitive verb or the purpose of an action in English sentences; also appears mid-sentence and in the title link “dev.to”
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments, quotations, and webpage titles/URLs

patterns.name: Swedish den
patterns.context: The definite article den in Swedish noun phrases, as in “den inre marknaden” and “den ... milisen”; in passage 5 it is used pronominally as “den”

patterns.name: Hungarian ves- stem
patterns.context: A stem fragment in Hungarian word forms, appearing in “veszélyre” and “vesznek”

3_2327.description: 强激活分别落在英语 to、瑞典语 den 和匈牙利语 ves-上；各自受不同语言的词法、句法语境触发，语料跨议会文本与论坛。

patterns.name: 英语不定式/方向介词 to
patterns.context: 英语句子中引出不定式动词或动作目的；也出现于句中及标题链接“dev.to”
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、引述及网页标题/URL

patterns.name: 瑞典语 den
patterns.context: 瑞典语名词短语中的定冠词 den，如“den inre marknaden”“den ... milisen”；第5段中为代词式用法“den”

patterns.name: 匈牙利语 ves-词干
patterns.context: 匈牙利语词形中的词干片段，分别出现在“veszélyre”和“vesznek”中

en.description: All passages strongly activate on the token «to»; in the English passages it often precedes an infinitive after a line break, across varied contexts and topics. Passage 3 hits in Swedish text; boundary markers and fragments show no distinct stable pattern.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Followed by a base-form verb, often appearing after a line break or sentence boundary; there is also a weaker «to»7.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions, EuroParl Swedish text, film reviews, and other genres

patterns.name: Infinitive constructions after line breaks
patterns.context: A syntactic construction continues after a line break with to + base-form verb, as in “to answer,” “to get,” “to be,” “to sustain,” “to think,” and “to implement”; the hit in passage 3 is a subword fragment within a Swedish word and does not show the same English construction.
patterns.domain: Primarily English forum posts, plus Swedish parliamentary text

patterns.name: Paragraph/miscellaneous boundary cues
patterns.context: Separators or text fragments appear in the same context, but show no clear stable connection to the strongly activated token «to»10.
patterns.domain: Forum scrape text, webpage snippets, and corpus noise

3_2327.description: 所有段均强激活于 token「to」；英语段多为换行后接不定式，语境和主题各异。第3段在瑞典语文本中命中，边界符与碎片未显示独立稳定模式。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 后面接动词原形，常出现在换行或句子边界之后；也有较弱的 «to»7。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论、EuroParl 瑞典语文本及影评等多种文体

patterns.name: 断行后的不定式结构
patterns.context: 换行后以 to + 动词原形继续句法结构，如 “to answer”“to get”“to be”“to sustain”“to think”“to implement”；第3段的命中为瑞典语单词内部的子词片段，未呈现相同的英语结构。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛正文为主，另有瑞典语议会文本

patterns.name: 段落/杂项边界线索
patterns.context: 同一上下文中出现分隔符或文本碎片，但与强激活 token «to»10 并无明显稳定联系。
patterns.domain: 论坛抓取文本、网页片段及语料噪声

en.description: Across a range of genres, activations often fall on subword fragments within or at the boundaries of English words, especially hyphenated titles, proper names, URLs, and word endings; there are also sporadic examples involving dates, short function words, and forum signature remnants, with no stable single semantic theme.

patterns.name: English internal suffix fragments and word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on split word fragments, internal hyphens, and locations near the ends of words or phrases, often forming a complete expression with preceding unmarked words; there is no single fixed affix.
patterns.domain: English prose, titles, emails, and Q&A across domains

patterns.name: Rare proper names or name fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on proper names, usernames, or subword fragments within proper names; sometimes they overlap with internal word splits, and nearby ordinary words in the same passage may also activate.
patterns.domain: Tech news, links, music entries, emails, and titles

patterns.name: Hyphenated strings in titles and URLs
patterns.context: Words in phrases are joined with hyphens in titles or URLs; activation spans hyphens and some word segments, but not every hyphenated word activates.
patterns.domain: HackerNews link titles, entertainment show titles, news headlines

patterns.name: Time markers and sentence/paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Date numbers and years in news links, as well as the beginning of the following line, occasionally activate; they are adjacent to word fragments and title structures, but this does not establish dates themselves as a stable trigger.

patterns.name: Short function words in questions or direct quotations
patterns.context: A few common short words activate when appearing in questions, quotations, or sentences; distribution is inconsistent and may overlap with the word-boundary or tokenization effects above.

patterns.name: Forum signature fragment after a salary statement
patterns.context: A signature or username and the start of the next sentence appear after a paragraph divider; activation falls on a trailing username fragment. This example has no clear connection to the other patterns.

3_2327.concept: 英文子词边界与词片段
3_2327.description: 跨多种文体，激活常落在英文词内部或边界的子词片段，尤其是连字符标题、专名、网址和词尾；另有日期、短功能词及论坛签名残片等零散例子，未见稳定的单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 英文词内后缀片段与词界
patterns.trigger: 词内或词首位置的子词片段，如 «so»-«-»«secret»、«-»«zmitri»、«-»« Fidel»、«-»«bring»、«-»«to»-«ta»、«embar»-«r»-«ased»、«come»-«out»、«to»-«fix»
patterns.context: 激活集中在被拆分的词片段、词内连字符以及词或短语末尾附近，常与前面未标记的词构成一个完整表达；并非统一的固定词缀。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文、标题、邮件与问答

patterns.name: 罕见专名或专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、用户名或专名内部的分词片段；有时与词内切分交叠，且同一段内邻近普通词也可激活。
patterns.domain: 科技新闻、链接、音乐条目、邮件及标题

patterns.name: 标题与网址中的连字符词串
patterns.context: 标题或网址把短语词语以连字符连接；激活跨越连字符及部分词段，但并非每个连字符词都激活。
patterns.domain: HackerNews链接标题、娱乐节目标题、新闻标题

patterns.name: 时间标记与句段边界
patterns.context: 新闻链接中的日期数字、年份和下一行开头偶有激活；与词片段及标题结构相邻，但不能据此确认日期本身是稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 问句或直接引语中的短功能词
patterns.context: 少量常见短词在问句、引语或句中出现时激活，分布不一致，可能与上述词边界或分词效应重叠。
patterns.domain: 标题、邮件、新闻文字、问答

patterns.name: 薪资语句后的论坛签名残片
patterns.context: 段落分隔线后出现签名或用户名及下一句开头，激活落在用户名末尾碎片；此例难与其他模式建立明确联系。

en.description: Activation often falls on common phrases and their tokenized subwords, especially come across. It also appears in titles, hyphenated URL terms, Docker commands, and isolated proper names. Overall, it resembles word-fragment or boundary triggering, with weak semantic consistency.

patterns.name: Word fragments at phrase/subword boundaries
patterns.context: Across multiple passages, activation falls on some tokens in common multiword expressions or hyphenated URL phrases; it occurs in both body text and links, without forming a single stable semantic collocation.
patterns.domain: Hacker News comments, StackExchange answers, emails, and URLs

patterns.name: come across collocation
patterns.context: Means to encounter or discover something; it appears twice in body text with similar syntax and meaning.

patterns.name: Phrases in quoted titles or URLs
patterns.context: Activation occurs in titles, quotations, or link slugs, often alongside colloquial phrases or hyphenated tokenization; it may be influenced by common word fragments and boundaries.
patterns.domain: Hacker News titles, comments, and links

patterns.name: Token fragments in script commands
patterns.context: Appears in Docker build commands and arguments; activation is sparse, with no clear semantic condition shared with other passages.

patterns.name: Political or historical proper names
patterns.context: Appears in tokenized fragments of words such as Castro, Communism, and Cuban; this occurs in only one passage and may be an incidental subword trigger.
patterns.domain: Hacker News links and political topics

patterns.name: Expression in a dash-separated title
patterns.context: A hyphenated compound in a title; activation concentrates on the tokenized subword “so”. This is an isolated instance.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations not fitting a stable pattern
patterns.context: Activation occurs in a comment with a sarcastic title and terminology, without showing trigger conditions consistent with other passages.

3_2327.description: 激活多落在常见短语及其拆分子词上，尤见 come across；也出现在标题、URL 连字符词、Docker 命令和孤立专名中，整体更像词片段/边界触发，语义一致性较弱。

patterns.name: 短语/子词边界上的词片段
patterns.trigger: «come»、«across»、«to»、«on»、«into»，以及 URL 中被拆分标记的词片段，如 «-»、«go»、«on»
patterns.context: 多个段落中，激活落在常见多词表达或 URL 连字符词组的部分 token 上；在正文与链接中都出现，未形成单一稳定的语义搭配。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 评论、StackExchange 答复、邮件及 URL

patterns.name: come across 搭配
patterns.context: 表示偶然遇到、发现某物；正文中两次出现，句法与语义相近。

patterns.name: 被引用的标题或 URL 中的短语
patterns.context: 激活出现在标题、引语或链接 slug 内，常伴随口语化短语或连字符分词；可能受常见词片段和边界影响。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 标题、评论与链接

patterns.name: 脚本命令中的 token 片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Docker 构建命令及参数中，激活稀疏，未见与其他段落共享的明显语义条件。

patterns.name: 政治或历史相关专名
patterns.context: 出现在 Castro、Communism、Cuban 等词被分词后的片段中；仅此一段，可能是偶然的子词触发。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 链接及政治话题

patterns.name: 破折号标题中的表达
patterns.context: 标题里的连字符复合词，激活集中在拆分后的 “so” 子词；孤例。

patterns.name: 未能归入稳定模式的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活出现在一段带有讽刺标题及术语的评论中，未显示与其他段一致的触发条件。

en.description: The most prominent trigger is across, especially in come across meaning to encounter or discover by chance; there are also collocations involving out/at/go with come or go, as well as sporadic activations in technical terms, URLs, and hyphenated subwords.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “come across”
patterns.context: The phrase means to encounter, discover, or come upon something by chance; it can occur in different constructions, including negation or perfect tense
patterns.domain: Informal or narrative texts such as forums, Q&A, and emails

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “come out”
patterns.context: Discusses an album being released in a given year

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “come at”
patterns.context: The idiom “Space comes at a premium” means space is very scarce

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “go live”
patterns.context: Means to go online or broadcast live in webpage titles or link text

patterns.name: to within a split word
patterns.context: to occurs in the tokenization-marked technical compound net-to-next-to-leading order, rather than as an independent grammatical word

patterns.name: to in URLs and hyphenated strings
patterns.context: Activations occur in URLs, titles, or split compounds; the local pattern may relate to punctuation or subword boundaries
patterns.domain: Tech links, titles, and technical terms

patterns.name: Unexplained local activations
patterns.context: These snippets show no obvious shared semantic or stable contextual pattern; they may relate to subword tokenization, punctuation, or incidental co-occurrence
patterns.domain: Various texts, including forums, encyclopedias, and papers

3_2327.description: 最显著的触发是 across，尤其在 come across 表示偶然遇见或发现时；另有 out/at/go 等与 come、go 构成的搭配，以及技术术语、网址和连字符子词中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 固定搭配“come across”
patterns.trigger: “come”后接“across”，其中 across 被标记为 «across»10
patterns.context: 短语表示偶然遇到、发现或碰见某物；前面可有否定或完成时等不同结构
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、邮件等非正式或叙述性文本

patterns.name: 固定搭配“come out”
patterns.context: 谈论专辑在某年发行

patterns.name: 固定搭配“come at”
patterns.context: “Space comes at a premium”惯用表达，意为空间十分紧缺
