patterns.name: 固定搭配“go live”
patterns.context: 网页标题或链接文本中表示上线、直播

patterns.name: 分词内部的 to
patterns.context: to 位于拆分标注的技术复合词 net-to-next-to-leading order 中，并非独立语法词

patterns.name: 网址及连字符串中的 to
patterns.trigger: “«to»10”及周围多处带标记的连字符片段，如“«-»…«-»”
patterns.context: 激活出现在 URL、标题或被拆分的复合词中；局部模式可能与标点或子词边界有关
patterns.domain: 科技链接、标题及技术术语

patterns.name: 无法解释的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些片段没有明显共享的语义或稳定上下文；可能与子词切分、标点或偶然共现有关
patterns.domain: 论坛、百科、论文等多种文本

en.concept: come phrasal verbs and subword boundaries
en.description: Primarily responds to phrasal verbs with come/came followed by particles such as along, across, out, and up. It also activates on fragments within long hyphenated compounds, proper names, and URLs; local meanings often involve appearing, encountering, arising, or being mentioned.

patterns.name: Phrasal verbs with come + following word
patterns.context: Activation falls on directional or result particles following come across varied syntactic contexts; the phrasal verbs as a whole mean to appear, encounter, arise, or be mentioned.

patterns.name: Fragments in hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: Long hyphenated strings are split into multiple tokens, with activation on subword fragments within the compound; no unified semantics are apparent.

patterns.name: along not following come
patterns.context: along follows came and means to appear or join later; it is adjacent to the come phrasal-verb pattern, but uses the form came.

patterns.name: along in a named entity
patterns.context: along follows come, meaning that someone subsequently appears and tries to make the same claim.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation in names or links
patterns.context: Proper names and URLs are split into subwords; activation concentrates on internal fragments, possibly due to tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Local collocations not fully explained
patterns.context: Activation still falls on particles following come, but nearby meanings include idioms, unexpected conclusions, and discussion outcomes; no single specific sense fully accounts for them.

3_2327.concept: come 短语动词及子词边界
3_2327.description: 主要响应 come/came 后接 along、across、out、up 等小品词的短语动词，也会在长连字符复合词、专名及 URL 的内部切分片段上激活；局部语义多为出现、遇见、产生或提及。

patterns.name: 短语动词 come + 后续词
patterns.context: 激活落在 come 后面的方位或结果小品词，跨多种句法环境；短语整体表示出现、遇见、产生或被提及。

patterns.name: 连字符复合词中的断片
patterns.context: 长连字符复合串被拆成多个 token，激活落在复合词内部的子词片段；未见统一语义。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻链接、娱乐标题

patterns.name: 非 come 的 along
patterns.context: along 位于 came 后，表示后来出现或加入；与 come 短语动词模式相邻，但形态为 came。

patterns.name: 名称中的 along
patterns.trigger: “immense asset to Enron”“come along and try”
patterns.context: along 接在 come 后，表示某人随后出现并尝试提出相同主张。

patterns.name: 名称或链接中的子词切分
patterns.context: 专名、URL 被拆分成子词；激活集中于内部片段，可能与分词边界有关。

patterns.name: 未充分解释的局部搭配
patterns.trigger: “waist-to-hip ratio”“came out of left field”“come out of debate”
patterns.context: 激活仍落在 come 后的小品词，但邻近语义分别是惯用语、意外结论和讨论结果，无法由单一具体义项完全说明。

en.description: The most consistent response is to in hyphen-connected phrases, particularly on either side of the hyphen; there are also sporadic triggers such as go lucky, Hades, domain-squatters, names, and URL tokenization. Overall, activations are influenced by subword boundaries and webpage title formatting.

patterns.name: to in hyphen-separated phrases
patterns.context: to/for occurs in hyphen-connected phrases or titles; activation is concentrated on the hyphen and short prepositions, especially the hyphens around to.
patterns.domain: Webpage titles, product/technical discussions, news links

patterns.name: Fixed expression go lucky
patterns.context: go forms a fixed expression or phrase with the following word; activation may fall on go or the immediately following letter fragment. The text is usually a title or slogan.

patterns.name: Hyphens in dates and number strings
patterns.context: Hyphens and adjacent fragments activate in mixed strings that appear to be dates or numeric sequences.

patterns.name: Internal tokenization of hesitate/hesitated
patterns.context: Appears in the rhetorical question “why-in Hades don’t they just bring back...”; activation spans a subword of Hades and surrounding short words.

patterns.name: Word ending in domain squatters
patterns.context: In domain-squatters, activation is concentrated on an internal suffix fragment, especially «ters».

patterns.name: The compound phrase fairness-of-disclosure
patterns.context: In hyphenated compounds such as fairness-of-disclosure, activation falls on the connecting element and hyphens.
patterns.domain: Commentary about disclosure and viewing options

patterns.name: Word endings in names and cast lists
patterns.context: Names in a cast list are split into subwords, and the ending fragment of an occasional name activates unusually strongly.

patterns.name: The phrase up-to-date
patterns.context: A fixed adjective phrase joined by hyphens; the strongest location is the hyphen before to.

patterns.name: Tokenization in names/brands and URL paths
patterns.context: In HIBP-related links and domains/paths, proper names or URL segments are split, with activation concentrated on the split fragments.

patterns.name: Hyphens in title compounds
patterns.context: Compounds and hyphenated phrases in titles or link paths activate across internal word divisions and the hyphen before a preposition.
patterns.domain: Energy project news titles and URLs

3_2327.concept: 连字符短语及子词边界
3_2327.description: 最稳定的反应是连字符连接的短语，尤其连字符两侧的 to；另有 go lucky、Hades、domain-squatters、姓名及 URL 切分等零散触发，整体受子词边界和网页标题格式影响。

patterns.name: 连字符分隔短语中的 to
patterns.context: to/for 位于由连字符连接的词组或标题中；激活集中在连字符和短介词，尤其 to 前后的连字符。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、产品/技术讨论、新闻链接

patterns.name: 固定表达 go lucky
patterns.context: go 与后续词组成固定表达或短语，激活可落在 go 或紧随其后的字母片段；所在文本多为标题或宣传语。

patterns.name: 日期及数字串中的连字符
patterns.context: 看似日期或数字序列的混合字符串中，连字符及其邻近片段激活。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 片段中的异常字符串

patterns.name: hesitate/hesitated 词内切分
patterns.context: 出现在 “why-in Hades don’t they just bring back...” 这一反问表达中，激活覆盖 Hades 的子词及周边短词。
patterns.domain: 娱乐评论、口语化网页文章

patterns.name: 域名 squatters 的词尾
patterns.context: domain-squatters 一词中，激活集中在词内部后缀片段，特别是 «ters»。

patterns.name: fairness-of-disclosure 复合短语
patterns.context: fairness-of-disclosure 这类连字符复合表达中，激活落在连接成分及连字符上。
patterns.domain: 关于披露与查看选项的评论

patterns.name: 人名及演员表中的词尾
patterns.context: 演员名单中姓名被子词切分，个别姓名末尾片段异常强激活。

patterns.name: 短语 up-to-date
patterns.context: 固定形容词短语由连字符连接；最强位置是 to 前的连字符。
patterns.domain: 生活方式或商店相关网页文章

patterns.name: 人名/品牌与 URL 路径中的切分
patterns.context: HIBP 相关链接及域名/路径中，专名或 URL 词段被拆分，激活集中在切分片段。

patterns.name: 标题复合词中的连字符
patterns.context: 标题或链接路径中的复合词与连字符短语，激活覆盖词内分段及介词前的连字符。
patterns.domain: 能源项目新闻标题及 URL

en.description: Activation primarily falls on compound words or string fragments joined by hyphens and split across tokens, especially go-…- patterns. A few URL paths, ordinary phrases, function words, and code symbols also activate, with trigger boundaries not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Hyphen-separated compounds or phrases
patterns.context: Activation concentrates within hyphenated phrases, commonly in compounds, phrases, or titles split across tokens; however, not all hyphens trigger it.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including news, commentary, biographies, and entrepreneurial articles

patterns.name: go-…-lucky strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on hyphenated formations with go and following fragments, occurring in idioms, product/project names, and ordinary strings; meanings vary considerably by context.
patterns.domain: Idioms, software projects, and webpage/channel names

patterns.name: Fragments segmented in URLs, domains, and paths
patterns.context: Some letter fragments, hyphens, and path components activate within URLs, link paths, or URL-like strings.
patterns.domain: Web links, API documentation, and technical texts

patterns.name: Individual preposition or function-word fragments
patterns.context: A few isolated short function words also show weak activation, but their positions vary between phrases and near long hyphenated strings; evidence is insufficient to establish an independent trigger condition.

patterns.name: Ordinary phrases split in rich text
patterns.context: Besides hyphenated compounds and URLs, ordinary phrases, titles, and words in sentences show sporadic activation; no stable semantic or syntactic category is evident.
patterns.domain: News headlines, entertainment biographies, entrepreneurial articles

patterns.name: Code and command strings
patterns.context: Code snippets contain local activation on symbols/identifiers as well as go-…- strings; it is unclear whether code syntax itself is a stable trigger condition.

3_2327.concept: 连字符复合字符串片段
3_2327.description: 激活主要落在连字符连接、跨 token 切分的复合词或字符串片段，尤其是 go-…- 类片段；少数网址路径、普通词组、功能词及代码符号也激活，触发边界不完全一致。

patterns.name: 连字符分隔的复合词或短语
patterns.context: 激活集中在带连字符的词组内部，常见于跨 token 切分的复合词、短语或标题；但并非所有连字符都触发。
patterns.domain: 新闻、评论、人物简介、创业文章等多种文体

patterns.name: go-…-lucky 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在 go 与后续片段的连字符构词中，出现在习语、产品/项目名及普通字符串中；上下文含义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 习语、软件项目与网页/频道名称

patterns.name: URL、域名及路径中的切分片段
patterns.context: 在网址、链接路径或类似网址的字符串内，部分字母片段、连字符及路径组件激活。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、API 文档与技术文本

patterns.name: 单个介词或功能词片段
patterns.context: 少数孤立的短功能词也有弱激活，但所在位置分别是短语内部或连字符构成的长字符串附近，证据不足以确定独立触发条件。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、娱乐新闻标题

patterns.name: 富文本中被切开的普通短语
patterns.context: 除连字符复合词和 URL 外，普通词组、标题或句中词也有零散激活；没有显示出稳定的词义或句法类别。
patterns.domain: 新闻标题、娱乐简介、创业文章

patterns.name: 代码与命令字符串
patterns.trigger: «t»、«..»、«arg»，以及 Docker 命令中的带连字符标识符
patterns.context: 代码段中既有符号/标识符局部激活，也出现 go-…- 字符串；无法确认代码语法本身是稳定触发条件。

en.description: Activations occur across intraword substrings, hyphens, and word boundaries in multilingual text. English out phrases appear occasionally, but there is no stable semantic or syntactic condition across passages, making it difficult to assign a single pattern.

patterns.name: out in English idioms
patterns.context: In English conversation or Q&A, out appears in phrasal verbs or idioms such as “check it out” and “figured it out”; passage 1 also contains the compound word checkboxes.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments such as -ment / -ent
patterns.context: Across English, French, and Portuguese texts, activations occur inside words, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Q&A and multilingual European Parliament proceedings

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Swedish
patterns.context: Occurs in long Swedish words or inflected and derived forms, with no consistent lexical meaning or grammatical function.

patterns.name: English content words and intraword fragments
patterns.context: In commentary and startup guides, activations fall on different words or hyphens, with no apparent shared contextual function.

patterns.name: URL and hyphen-separated segments
patterns.context: Occurs in URLs in news links, where words are joined by hyphens and marked as separate segments.

patterns.name: Italian IRC word-segment fragments
patterns.context: In chat channel titles and Italian conversational messages, activations are scattered across intraword substrings and hyphens.

3_2327.description: 激活分布于多语种文本的词内子串、连字符与词边界；英语中偶见 out 短语，但跨段缺乏稳定语义或句法条件，难以归为单一模式。

patterns.name: 英语习语中的 out
patterns.context: 英语口语或问答中，out 出现在短语动词或习语里，如“check it out”“figured it out”；段 1 另有复合词 checkboxes。

patterns.name: 词内的 -ment / -ent 等片段
patterns.trigger: «ment»、«ent»：如 «relationship» 中的词片段、«contamination» 中的 «ment»，以及 «indispensável» 等词内的分段激活
patterns.context: 跨英语、法语、葡萄牙语文本；激活出现在词内部，未见统一的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 问答及欧洲议会多语种议事文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语的长词或屈折、派生词中，未显现一致的词义或语法功能。

patterns.name: 英文内容词与词内片段
patterns.context: 在评论性文字和创业指南中，激活落在不同词或连字符上；没有明显共享的上下文功能。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 评论、HackerNews 创业文章

patterns.name: URL 与连字符分段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻链接的 URL 中，词语被连字符连接并分段标记。

patterns.name: 意大利语 IRC 分词片段
patterns.context: 聊天频道标题和意大利语口语消息中，激活分散在词内子串及连字符处。

en.description: Activation often falls on word fragments split by tokenization, word endings, or punctuation boundaries. Strong examples include na in the Swedish kunna, fragments of English squander and tongue-in-cheek, and quoted script variables; specific triggers vary noticeably across corpora.

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation and inflection in Swedish
patterns.context: In continuous Swedish text, activation falls on tokenized word fragments; clearer triggers include kunna (“to be able”), «na»10, and other intra-word fragments.

patterns.name: Quotes and variable boundaries in code
patterns.context: In Shell/Docker scripts, activation occurs near command substitution, quoted variables, or path-related syntax.

patterns.name: English word-final or intra-word fragments
patterns.context: In English prose, words are split into subword fragments; activation concentrates in the middle-to-final part of squander and on the hyphen, word fragments, and line break in tongue-in-cheek.

patterns.name: Fragments in URLs and link titles
patterns.context: Webpage titles or link lists contain URLs, title text, and parallel French/English titles; local activation falls on URL fragments and word fragments such as rebirth.

patterns.name: Tokenized word fragments, trigger pattern unclear
patterns.context: The title contains the hyphenated compound happy-go-lucky; the strongest activation is on the hyphen after go and the l fragment, but its relation to other patterns is uncertain.

3_2327.description: 激活多落在分词切开的词片段、词尾或标点边界上，强例包括瑞典语 kunna 的 na、英语 squander 和 tongue-in-cheek 的片段，以及脚本引号变量；但不同语料中具体触发差异明显。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内切分及词形重组
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中，激活落在被切分的词片段上；较明显的触发包括表示“能够”的 kunna（«na»10）及其他词内片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的引号及变量边界
patterns.context: Shell/Docker 脚本中，激活出现在命令替换、引号包围的变量或路径相关语法附近。

patterns.name: 英语词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 英语散文中，词被分词片段切开；激活集中在 squander 的中后部及 tongue-in-cheek 的连字符、词片段和换行处。

patterns.name: 网址及链接标题中的片段
patterns.context: 网页标题或链接列表中出现 URL、标题文字及法语/英语并列标题；局部激活落在网址片段和 rebirth 等词片段。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 标题、维基百科条目

patterns.name: 切分词片段，触发模式不明
patterns.context: 标题中的连字符复合表达 happy-go-lucky；最强激活在 go 后的连字符及 l 片段，但与其他模式的关系不确定。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual text, favoring intraword token fragments: Swedish “kunna,” “tror,” and others; Portuguese “trate”; French “belges”; and fragments of Danish book titles and technical terms. Many occur in parliamentary policy contexts, but there is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Swedish infinitive verbs
patterns.context: In Swedish sentences, often follows “att” and means “be able to/can”; commonly followed by a verb or action plan.

patterns.name: Swedish speculation and judgment
patterns.context: Expresses “think/believe” in Swedish, followed by a clause introduced by “att.”

patterns.name: Portuguese conditional verb
patterns.context: Occurs in the construction “quer se trate de,” meaning “whether it concerns …”.

patterns.name: Swedish frequency adverb
patterns.context: Modifies a statement that the WTO mechanism continues to function.

patterns.name: Swedish nominalizing suffix
patterns.context: Occurs in noun phrases about legislation that must be observed or applied.

patterns.name: French nationality adjective
patterns.context: Modifies the Belgian authorities in a sentence about an investigation into dioxin contamination.

patterns.name: Danish book-title form
patterns.context: Occurs in a list of works as part of a book title.

patterns.name: Substring in a technical term
patterns.context: Occurs in a tokenized fragment of the machine-learning tool name scikit-learn, alongside “books like” and other programming tools.

patterns.name: Unexplained salient fragments
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary speeches, activations fall on several tokenized fragments; their forms are not adequately explained by triggers in the other passages.

3_2327.description: 激活散布于多语种文本，偏向词内分词片段：瑞典语“kunna”“tror”等、葡语“trate”、法语“belges”、丹麦语书名及技术名词片段；不少落在议会政策语境，但没有统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 瑞典语动词不定式
patterns.context: 在瑞典语句子中，常位于“att”之后，表示“能够/可以”；附近常接动词或行动方案。

patterns.name: 瑞典语推测与判断
patterns.context: 瑞典语中表达“认为/相信”，后接“att”引导的从句。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语条件式动词
patterns.context: 出现在“quer se trate de”结构中，意为“无论涉及……”。

patterns.name: 瑞典语频率副词
patterns.context: 修饰关于 WTO 机制继续发挥作用的陈述。

patterns.name: 瑞典语名词化词尾
patterns.context: 出现在有关须遵守、适用的立法的名词短语中。

patterns.name: 法语国籍形容词
patterns.context: 修饰比利时当局，处于关于二噁英污染调查的句子中。

patterns.name: 丹麦语书名词形
patterns.context: 出现在作品清单中，属于书名的一部分。

patterns.name: 技术名词内部子串
patterns.context: 出现在机器学习工具名称 scikit-learn 的分词片段中，与“books like”及其他编程工具并列。

patterns.name: 未解释的突出片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中，激活落在若干分词片段上；无法由其他段的触发形式充分解释。

en.description: Primarily responds to verb forms in Nordic languages and French, especially Swedish «kunna» and infinitive constructions following modal verbs; isolated examples also involve subword segmentation in a works catalog and machine-learning terminology.

patterns.name: Verb infinitives and modal constructions in Nordic languages
patterns.context: Commonly occurs in infinitives following modal verbs or expressions of purpose or requirement; Swedish «kunna» appears repeatedly. Also includes a few other infinitives or verb forms, not all of which use «att».
patterns.domain: Primarily Swedish, Danish, and French policy discourse in European Parliament texts; topics include regulations, aid, trade, and constitutional procedures.

patterns.name: Word segmentation in lists
patterns.context: Words appear in a line-by-line list of book or work titles, including years; there is no clear infinitive or policy syntax.

patterns.name: Subwords in machine-learning terminology
patterns.context: Appears in an English sentence listing statistics, machine-learning tools, and languages, with words split into subwords.

3_2327.description: 主要对北欧语及法语中的动词形式、尤其瑞典语 «kunna» 和情态词后不定式结构有反应；另有作品目录和机器学习术语中子词分段的孤例。

patterns.name: 北欧语中的动词不定式及情态结构
patterns.trigger: 瑞典语反复出现 «kun»«na»（[5] 的 «kunna»，以及 [7]–[10]）；另有 «skulle»«uppfylla»、«att»«tillämpa»、«att»«antas»，丹麦语 «åb»«ne»，法语 «débar»«rass»«er»
patterns.context: 常见于情态动词、目的或要求表达后接不定式；瑞典语 «kunna» 多次出现。也包括少数其他不定式或动词形式，未必都带 «att»。
patterns.domain: 以欧盟议会的瑞典语、丹麦语、法语政策论述为主；涉及法规、援助、贸易和宪法程序。

patterns.name: 名单中的词语分段
patterns.context: 词语出现在逐行排列的书名或作品名清单中，包含年份；没有明显的不定式或政策句法。
patterns.domain: 维基百科式条目或作品目录。

patterns.name: 机器学习术语中的子词
patterns.context: 出现在列举统计学、机器学习工具与语言的英文句子中，词语被切分成子词。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 风格的技术讨论。

en.description: Activations broadly fall on intraword subword fragments and morphological boundaries, especially in inflected, derived, and compound Nordic words, as well as French words and names. In mathematical text, to also stands out in mapping or approach notation.

patterns.name: Intraword suffixes or morpheme boundaries
patterns.context: Highlights typically fall at boundaries between stems and suffixes, components of compounds, or inflected forms; many tokens are only part of a longer word.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary text, English biographies, and mathematical text

patterns.name: Nordic inflected forms and compound fragments
patterns.context: Fragments occur in inflected, compound, and derived Swedish or Danish words, often as part of a complete syntactic word rather than as standalone words.
patterns.domain: Swedish and Danish passages in EuroParl

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in French
patterns.context: Highlights occur inside French words or word-form fragments; the supplied context is parliamentary speech about the president and elections.

patterns.name: Mapping arrows in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: «to» occurs in notation mapping a set or space to another space; it is not an independent preposition in ordinary prose.

patterns.name: Approach expressions in mathematical prose
patterns.context: «to» occurs in an explanation of a formula, indicating that a variable takes a limit or approaches another variable.

patterns.name: Fragments inside proper names and surnames
patterns.context: Highlights fall inside Norwegian personal names rather than ordinary vocabulary; the text introduces a scholar’s biographical work.

3_2327.description: 激活广泛落在词内的子词片段与形态边界，尤见北欧语屈折、派生和复合词，也见法语及人名；另在数学文本中突出映射或趋近记号里的 to。

patterns.name: 词内后缀或词素边界
patterns.trigger: 单词内部被拆开的高亮片段，如「«te»」「«bar»」「«sl»」「«ant»」「«by»」「«er»」；也包括跨词片段「«to»」
patterns.context: 高亮通常落在完整词的词干与后缀、复合词组成部分或词形变化边界上；不少 token 只是较长词的一部分。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本、英文传记及数学文本

patterns.name: 北欧语词形与复合词片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在瑞典语或丹麦语的屈折词、复合词和派生词中，常与完整句法词相连，而非独立单词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 的瑞典语、丹麦语段落

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 高亮出现在法语词内部或词形片段中；所给上下文是对主席及选举的议会发言。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的映射箭头
patterns.context: «to» 位于集合或空间到另一空间的映射记号中，不是普通散文中的独立介词。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、度量空间定义

patterns.name: 数学散文中的趋近表达
patterns.context: «to» 出现在公式说明中，表示变量取极限或趋近另一个变量。

patterns.name: 专名与姓氏内部片段
patterns.context: 高亮落在挪威人名的内部，而非普通词汇；文本在介绍学者传记著作。

en.description: Activation is distributed across intra-word fragments, word endings, and morpheme boundaries in multiple languages, and also occurs on mathematical formula symbols. Individual emotional words, names, and Japanese email words trigger as well, without forming a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: to before an intra-word subword boundary
patterns.context: Activation falls on short intra-word fragments or near word boundaries in various languages and contexts; in fragments 5 and 8, it is followed by mathematical limit notation.

patterns.name: Intra-word suffixes or endings
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across endings, suffixes, and morpheme boundaries of full words or inflected forms in different languages, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Subwords in unusual word forms or proper names
patterns.context: Sporadically occurs in names, news headlines, and Japanese email-related text; the trigger positions cannot be attributed to a shared meaning.

patterns.name: Emotional and political evaluative words
patterns.context: In commentary about politicians and comedy, activation falls on words related to emotion and attitude.

patterns.name: Symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Occurs near sequences, limits, and Q&A formulas; some activations fall on punctuation or formula symbols.

patterns.name: Fragments within German and French words
patterns.context: Multiple intra-word fragments trigger in political parliamentary contexts, but their positions and meanings vary.

3_2327.concept: 多语种子词片段及边界
3_2327.description: 激活散布在多语种词内片段、词尾和词素边界，也见数学公式符号；个别情绪词、人名及日语邮件词触发，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 词内子词边界前的 to
patterns.trigger: «to»，如葡语“come«ce»”、德语“kom«mt»”、数学语境“n\«to»”；另有英语“used« to»”
patterns.context: 激活落在多种语言和语境中的短小词内片段或词边界附近；在片段 5、8 后接数学极限记号

patterns.name: 词内后缀或词尾
patterns.context: 激活分布在不同语言完整词或词形的末尾、后缀及词素边界，未见统一语义

patterns.name: 特殊词形或专名中的子词
patterns.context: 分散出现在人名、新闻标题和日语邮件相关文本中，触发位置无法归结为同一词义

patterns.name: 情绪及政治评价词
patterns.context: 关于政治人物与喜剧的评论中，激活情绪和态度相关词

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号
patterns.context: 出现在数列、极限与问答公式附近，部分激活标点或公式符号

patterns.name: 德法词汇内部片段
patterns.context: 政治议会语境中触发多处词内片段，片段位置和词义并不一致

en.description: Covers intraword fragments, shambles, repost, forum signatures, and path-encoding fragments, as well as scattered function words, word fragments, and formula symbols. Apart from a few repeated word forms, there is no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Activations fall inside token-split words, while the rest of each word is unmarked; examples include sklearn, monnaie, and Blamey.
patterns.domain: Machine-learning discussions, French political economy, academic literature

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in shambles
patterns.context: Two word fragments are marked in the phrase “in shambles”; the context denotes confusion or disorder.

patterns.name: Forms related to repost
patterns.context: Activations fall on the stem and inflectional ending of repost in descriptions of publishing articles or content again.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments or spelling fragments
patterns.context: Marked fragments occur within words or word forms; there is insufficient evidence that they share stable semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Commentary, forum text, and general text

patterns.name: Syntactic words and phrase fragments in formulas
patterns.context: Several function and lexical words activate in ordinary English commentary; in a formula explanation, to, y, and $ activate in “Taking x to y $”. These triggers are scattered and cannot yet be grouped under a single condition.

patterns.name: Scattered word fragments in English sentences
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinary English sentences about learning materials and actors, with no shared condition more specific than general syntactic position.

patterns.name: End of a forum signature or username
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the signature “andrewjshults,” immediately after the forum post body and username separator.

patterns.name: Fragments in path or encoded text
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across file paths, underscore-separated strings, and percent-encoded text, with no consistent lexical trigger.
patterns.domain: Hacker News path or Markdown text

3_2327.description: 覆盖词内部片段、shambles、repost、论坛署名和路径编码碎片，也包括分散的功能词、词片段与公式符号；除少数重复词形外，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 特定词内的词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的词内部，且词的其余部分未标记；分别见 sklearn、monnaie、Blamey。
patterns.domain: 机器学习讨论、法语政经、学术文献

patterns.name: shambles 词尾片段
patterns.context: 在“in shambles”短语中，两个词片段被标记；语境表示混乱或失序。

patterns.name: repost 相关形式
patterns.context: 激活落在 repost 的词干及其屈折词尾，出现在再次发布文章或内容的叙述中。

patterns.name: 内部词片段或拼写碎片
patterns.context: 在各自的词或词形内部出现标记片段；没有足够证据表明这些片段共享稳定语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 评论、论坛文字及一般文本

patterns.name: 句法词与公式中的短语片段
patterns.context: 在英语评论的普通句子中激活若干功能词和词汇词；另在公式说明的“Taking x to y $”中激活 to、y 和 $。这些触发分散，尚不能归为同一条件。

patterns.name: 英文句中零散词片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于学习材料与演员的普通英文句子中，缺乏比一般句法位置更具体的共同条件。

patterns.name: 论坛签名或用户名末尾
patterns.context: 出现在署名“andrewjshults”的末尾，紧接论坛帖子正文与用户名分隔线之后。

patterns.name: 路径或编码文本中的碎片
patterns.context: 激活分布在文件路径、下划线分隔的字符串和百分号编码文本内，未显示一致的词义触发条件。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 路径或 Markdown 文本

en.concept: English word forms and fragments (blame, shame)
en.description: Primarily responds to blame/shame and their intra-word fragments or compounds, involving attribution of blame, shame, or evaluation. There are also isolated activations on loom and the l in happy-go-lucky, apparently unrelated to the main pattern.

patterns.name: blame / blamey
patterns.context: Appears as the full word blame, the tokenized form blamey, or the compound magit-blame; contexts involve blaming users, political responsibility, an academic author’s name, and a Git feature.
patterns.domain: Online discussions, political commentary, academic papers, software development

patterns.name: Shame / shame it
patterns.context: The initial Sh and following ame form shame, often in exclamatory or evaluative phrases (e.g., “Shame it didn't…”, “Shame about that”); [3] is “Shame,” inserted mid-sentence.

patterns.name: loom
patterns.context: Appears in “carbon fiber loom,” meaning a weaving machine; it occurs near earlier discussion of spelling and products.
patterns.domain: HackerNews casual discussion, technical or product discussion

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in lucky
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the compound expression “happy-go-lucky”; the activation marker covers only the initial l of lucky, so it is unclear whether the response is to that word fragment or a neighboring token.

3_2327.description: 主要响应 blame/shame 及其词内片段或复合词，涉及归咎、羞憾、评价；另对 loom 和 happy-go-lucky 中的 l 有孤立激活，表面上与主模式无关。

patterns.name: blame / blamey
patterns.context: 在句中出现完整词 blame、其分词 blamey，或复合词 magit-blame；分别涉及归咎用户、政治责任、学术作者姓名及 Git 功能。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、政治评论、学术论文、软件开发

patterns.name: Shame / shame it
patterns.context: 词首 Sh 与后续 ame 组成 shame，常见句式为感叹或评价（如“Shame it didn't…”、“Shame about that”）；[3]为句中插入的“Shame,”。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、体育讨论、博客

patterns.name: loom
patterns.context: 出现在“carbon fiber loom”中，指织机；此处与前文拼写、产品讨论相邻。

patterns.name: lucky 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“happy-go-lucky”复合表达末尾；激活标记只覆盖 lucky 的首字母 l，无法确定是对该词片段还是邻近 token 的反应。

en.description: Activations are scattered across intraword subwords, hyphens, URL markers, and several complete words. A few cluster on the -les ending of shambles; the rest lack stable semantic or contextual conditions.

patterns.name: Intraword token fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall inside words or on separators, with the surrounding characters forming common words; the trigger words themselves differ.
patterns.domain: Multidomain prose, news, legal texts, and online articles

patterns.name: Word-final -les
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the noun shambles, which means a chaotic or poor state.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Swedish
patterns.context: In Swedish sentences, the fragment occurs inside bli.

patterns.name: Fragments in URLs, punctuation, and special strings
patterns.context: Activations occur in URLs, punctuation, or technical strings joined by hyphens, rather than consistently corresponding to a semantic word.
patterns.domain: Hacker News websites and technical discussions

patterns.name: Fragments of common words or phrases
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across words, subwords, and phrases with varying capitalization; there is no apparent shared grammatical position or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed genres including news headlines, legal texts, commentary, and dialogue

3_2327.description: 激活分散在词内子词、连字符、网址标记和若干完整词上；少数集中于 shambles 词尾 -les，其余缺乏稳定语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: 单词内部片段 token
patterns.trigger: 词内被拆分并标记的片段，如 [3] «om»（broom）、[5] «url»（hurl）、[8] «bl»（blame）、[9] «v»（vigilante）；另有 [2] «-»（-politician）
patterns.context: 激活落在词的内部或连接符上，前后字符共同组成常见单词；触发词本身彼此不同
patterns.domain: 多领域散文、新闻、法律文本与网络文章

patterns.name: 词尾的 -les
patterns.context: 出现在名词 shambles 的词尾；该词表示混乱或糟糕状态

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内部片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子中，片段位于 bli 词内

patterns.name: 网址、标点及特殊字符串片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在网址、标点或由连字符连接的技术字符串中，并非稳定对应某一语义词
patterns.domain: Hacker News 网页与技术讨论

patterns.name: 常见词或短语片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在大小写各异的词、子词及短语中，没有明显共同语法位置或语义条件
patterns.domain: 新闻标题、法律文本、评论、对话等混合文体

en.concept: Bloomberg domain substrings and sporadic subword fragments
en.description: The most consistent pattern is the character fragment «oom» in the Bloomberg news link domain bloomberg.com; other activations occur sporadically within words such as well and hurl, names, and suspected identifiers, with no shared semantic theme.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in a Bloomberg-branded URL
patterns.context: In the Bloomberg news link domain bloomberg.com, activation falls on a segmented domain substring; it is in the URL body, not the headline content.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in a Bloomberg headline
patterns.context: Activation appears inside ordinary English words or adjacent to subword fragments: well, hurl; there is no obvious Bloomberg-domain trigger.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in an antibody-related name
patterns.context: Activation falls on a character fragment in a name in a literature citation; the passage also concerns anti-CD3 antibodies and transplant rejection, but there is no evidence that these topics themselves trigger activation.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in a job-search URL
patterns.context: Activation appears in a short string after a URL, possibly a username or random identifier; the context is insufficient to determine a semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Web pages/job links and company discussions

3_2327.concept: Bloomberg 域名子串及零散词内片段
3_2327.description: 最一致的模式是 Bloomberg 新闻链接域名 bloomberg.com 内的字符片段 «oom»；其余激活零散地落在 well、hurl、人名和疑似标识符的词内片段，无法归为同一语义主题。

patterns.name: Bloomberg 品牌网址中的词内片段
patterns.context: Bloomberg 新闻链接的域名 bloomberg.com 中，激活落在被拆分的域名子串；网址正文而非标题内容。

patterns.name: Bloomberg 标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在普通英文词内部或紧邻词内片段：well、hurl；没有明显的 Bloomberg 域名触发条件。

patterns.name: 抗体相关人名词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在文献引文中的姓名字符片段；该段也涉及抗 CD3 抗体与移植排斥，但没有证据表明这些主题本身触发激活。

patterns.name: 求职网址中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在网址之后的短字符串中，可能是用户名或随机标识；上下文不足以确定语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 网页/招聘链接及公司讨论

en.concept: Substrings in Bloomberg domains and scattered spellings
en.description: Primarily activates on “oom” in the “Bloomberg” domain in HackerNews links. Other examples include up in crop up, ob in The Blob, and scattered substrings in reference-list names.

patterns.name: Bloomberg link domains
patterns.context: When a news headline is followed by a Bloomberg news link, “oom” in the domain activates most strongly; topics vary across multiple headlines, but the trigger location is consistent.

patterns.name: Phrasal verb crop up
patterns.context: In the phrase “crop up again,” meaning that something appears again, especially “up” activates strongly.

patterns.name: The word Blob
patterns.context: The proper name or metaphorical spelling “The Blob” occurs in a hypothetical sentence about Google advertising; there are too few examples to determine the condition.

patterns.name: Substrings in names
patterns.context: Fragments occur inside names or usernames in reference-style lists; trigger fragments vary and may simply be sporadic spelling matches.

3_2327.concept: Bloomberg 域名子串及零散拼写
3_2327.description: 主要对 HackerNews Bloomberg 链接域名中 “Bloomberg” 的 “oom” 激活；另有 crop up 的 up、The Blob 中的 ob，以及参考文献姓名中的若干零散子串。

patterns.name: Bloomberg 链接域名
patterns.context: 新闻标题后接 Bloomberg 新闻链接时，域名中的 “oom” 激活最强；多个标题主题各异，触发点一致。

patterns.name: 短语动词 crop up
patterns.context: 表示某事物再次出现的短语 “crop up again” 中，尤其是 “up” 强激活。

patterns.name: Blob 字样
patterns.context: Google 广告的假设句中出现专名或比喻性写法 “The Blob”；缺少更多例子判断条件。

patterns.name: 姓名中的子串
patterns.context: 参考文献式列表中的姓名或用户名内部片段；触发片段各异，可能只是零散的拼写匹配。

en.concept: Subword fragments and parliamentary expressions for “please note”
en.description: The clearest pattern is Swedish/Danish expressions requesting attention in European Parliament speeches. Most other high activations are cross-lingual subword fragments inside words, along with isolated English URLs, advertising terms, and Dutch bluf, with no stable semantic connection.

patterns.name: “Please note” in parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Speakers ask the chair or audience to note an issue, matter, or argument, often when shifting topics or listing points.
patterns.domain: Formal European Parliament speeches, multilingual, mainly Swedish and Danish

patterns.name: Internal letters/stems in segmented word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words in multiple languages, rather than on complete standalone words; the fragments occur in varied lexical and syntactic contexts.
patterns.domain: Dutch, Swedish, and other natural text; parliamentary and academic texts

patterns.name: English web URLs and markers
patterns.context: Web links in Hacker News posts, with activation concentrated on URL protocol, domain, and punctuation fragments.

patterns.name: English Blob and CPM context
patterns.context: The sentence discusses Google contextual advertising, Blob, and CPM; activation includes common English word fragments and function words, with no clear single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Dutch bluf
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence describing Nietzsche’s works and style of argument; the trigger word is “bluf” (bluster, boasting).

patterns.name: German plurals and listing points of view
patterns.context: The speaker follows up on the preceding text with “my second point is…”, then discusses pluralism; the fragment mainly occurs inside a word.

patterns.name: Portuguese expression about negotiations
patterns.context: Mentions support for a two-track approach and a hope to negotiate; most activations lie inside Portuguese verbs or stems, and it is uncertain whether the pattern matches the other fragments.

patterns.name: Sporadic subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed inside different Danish, Swedish, and other words, with inconsistent semantics and syntax; aside from being subword fragments, no reliable common condition is apparent.

3_2327.concept: 词内片段及议会“请注意”表达
3_2327.description: 最清晰的模式是欧洲议会发言中请求注意的瑞典语/丹麦语表达。其余高激活多为跨语言的词内子词片段，另有单独的英语 URL、广告词和荷兰语 bluf，未显示稳定语义联系。

patterns.name: 议会发言中的“请注意”
patterns.trigger: 瑞典语“uppm…ärks…am…het”，丹麦语“opm…ær…ks…om…hed/åmærksom”，以及相关“er opmærksom på”“vil … opmærksom på”
patterns.context: 议员在讲话中请求议长或听众注意某个问题、事项或论点，常见于发言转折或列举观点。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会正式发言，多语种，主要是瑞典语、丹麦语

patterns.name: 分段词形中的内部字母/词干
patterns.trigger: 词内部被激活的子词片段，如«ubl»…«ice»…«de»、«bl»…«uf»、«k»…«be»…«kl»…«agar»
patterns.context: 激活落在多语种词语内部，而非完整独立词；片段所处词义和句法各异。
patterns.domain: 荷兰语、瑞典语等自然语料；议会与学术文本

patterns.name: 英语网页 URL 与标记
patterns.context: Hacker News 帖子中的网页链接，激活集中在 URL 的协议、域名和标点片段。

patterns.name: 英语 Blob 与 CPM 语境
patterns.context: 句中谈 Google 情境广告、Blob 和 CPM；激活包含常见英语词片段及功能词，不能明确归并为单一语义触发。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 技术/广告讨论

patterns.name: 荷兰语 bluf
patterns.context: 出现在描述尼采著作及其论述方式的句子中，触发词为“bluf”（虚张声势、吹嘘）。

patterns.name: 德语复数与观点列举
patterns.context: 发言者承接前文并说“我的第二点是……”，随后谈多元主义；片段主要落在词内。

patterns.name: 葡语谈判表达
patterns.context: 提到支持双轨办法、希望开展谈判；多数激活位于葡语动词或词干内部，模式是否与其他片段相同不确定。

patterns.name: 零散词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在丹麦语、瑞典语等不同词语内部，语义和句法不一致；除词内片段外缺乏可靠共同条件。

en.description: Activation often falls on internal subwords, suffixes, or tokenization boundaries in specific words, including well, foosball, Portuguese word forms, proper nouns, URLs, phrase-final words, and contract language; the examples vary widely in semantics and style.

patterns.name: well followed by and
patterns.context: “well” is emphasized when describing how things are going or the result, often followed by and or enough; most evident in passages 1 and 7.

patterns.name: Internal segment of foosball
patterns.context: Activation falls inside the tokenized word “foosball”; the surrounding text mentions office recreation facilities.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-form fragments
patterns.context: Multiple activations fall on subword fragments or endings in Portuguese words; the sentences discuss bilateral relations and negotiations.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment of Blob
patterns.context: Activation falls on the final subword fragment of the proper noun The Blob, in a comment on Google contextual advertising.

patterns.name: Ending of ramble
patterns.context: Activation falls at the end of “ramble”; the author says their post made them ramble a bit.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in Halloween
patterns.context: Activation falls inside the segmented word “Halloween,” near a company party announcement.

patterns.name: Final letters of GLEE
patterns.context: Activation falls near the final letters of the show title GLEE; the following text evaluates the show and its outcome.

patterns.name: Bloomberg URL fragment
patterns.context: Multiple activations occur across the URL and the Bloomberg domain; the headline concerns Apple’s market capitalization.

patterns.name: up in crop up
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on up in the phrase “crop up,” in a context where free alternatives will appear again.

patterns.name: Word fragment in broom clean
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword fragment of broom in the legal phrase “broom clean,” describing the condition in which a rental property must be returned.

3_2327.description: 激活多落在特定词的内部子词、词尾或分词边界，包括 well、foosball、葡语词形、专名、URL、短语词尾及合同用语；各例语义和文体差异很大。

patterns.name: well 后接 and
patterns.context: “well”在描述事情进展或结果时被强调，常接 and 或 enough；第1、7段最明显。

patterns.name: 足球桌词语内部
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的“foosball”内部，周围提到办公室休闲设施。

patterns.name: 葡语词形片段
patterns.context: 多个激活落在葡萄牙语词的词内片段或词尾；句子谈双边关系与谈判。

patterns.name: Blob 的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名 The Blob 的末尾子词片段，处于对 Google 情境广告的评论中。

patterns.name: ramble 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在“ramble”末尾；作者说自己的帖子让自己多说了一些。

patterns.name: Halloween 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在拆分后的“Halloween”中，附近是公司聚会通知。

patterns.name: GLEE 的末尾字母
patterns.context: 激活落在剧名 GLEE 的末尾字母附近；后文评价节目及其结果。

patterns.name: Bloomberg URL 片段
patterns.context: 多个激活沿 URL 和域名 Bloomberg 分布，标题谈苹果市值。

patterns.name: crop up 的 up
patterns.context: 激活集中在短语“crop up”的 up，语境是免费替代品会再次出现。

patterns.name: broom clean 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在法律条款中“broom clean”的 broom 词内片段，描述租赁房屋交还状态。

en.description: Strong activations cluster on scattered intraword subwords: broom, Blob, personal names, German words, and howl. Function words, common words, and word-final fragments also occur across diverse texts, without a unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in “broom”
patterns.context: Activations fall on an intraword fragment of broom; one occurrence is “broom clean,” describing a cleaning standard in a lease, and another is the plant disease name “witches' broom.”

patterns.name: Intraword fragments containing blob
patterns.context: In a discussion of advertising, traffic, and business impact, Blob in the phrase “The Blob” is split across multiple tokens; activations concentrate on intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in tokenized proper names
patterns.context: Hebrew names, titles, and place names are split into multiple subwords, with several fragments activating; there is no apparent shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Local fragments in German word forms
patterns.context: In German political argumentation, intraword subword fragments in several words activate; the passage concerns a dual system and actions Europe should take.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in howl
patterns.context: Occurs in the punning spelling “Howl-oween” in a canine activity announcement; a single example cannot establish a broader condition.

patterns.name: English inflectional or word-final fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on intraword or phrase fragments of common English words, in a forum verb phrase, an evaluative expression in an email, and a plural noun in a paper.
patterns.domain: Online forums, business email, academic papers

patterns.name: Scattered function words and word fragments
patterns.context: These activations occur in different syntactic positions and semantic categories, with no stable pattern explained by the same specific contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, political speeches, event announcements, business email

3_2327.concept: 词内子词片段（弱而分散）
3_2327.description: 强激活集中于零散词内子词：broom、Blob及人名、德语词、howl等；另有功能词、普通词和词尾片段散见多领域文本，缺少统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: “broom”词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 broom 的词内片段；一处是租约中表示清洁标准的“broom clean”，一处是植物病害名“witches' broom”。
patterns.domain: 法律文本；植物学/生物医学

patterns.name: 含 blob 的词内片段
patterns.trigger: «<»、«The»、«Bl»、«ob»（[4]“If Google contextual ads weren't like The Blob”）
patterns.context: 讨论广告、流量与商业影响时，短语“The Blob”中的 Blob 被分成多个 token；激活集中在词内片段。

patterns.name: 分词形成的专名片段
patterns.context: 希伯来人名、头衔及地名被切分为多个子词，若干片段激活；没有明显的共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 德语词形中的局部片段
patterns.context: 德语政治论述中，多个词的词内子词片段均有激活，句意涉及双重体系及欧洲应采取的行动。

patterns.name: howl 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在犬类活动通知中的“Howl-oween”双关拼写里；无法从单例确定更广泛条件。

patterns.name: 英语屈折或词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在常见英语词或短语的词内/短语片段，分别处于论坛中的动词短语、邮件中的评价表达、论文中的复数名词。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛、商务邮件、学术论文

patterns.name: 零散功能词与词片段
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在不同句法位置和语义类别中，未显示可由同一具体上下文条件解释的稳定模式。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、政治发言、活动通知、商务邮件

en.description: Activation falls on subword fragments, common word fragments, name/email fields, and formula/citation fragments in varied contexts; it spans domains and lacks stable semantic conditions, suggesting a response to specific subwords or tokenization fragments.

patterns.name: Word-final/internal «om» fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments inside ordinary words, proper nouns, or terms; no specific meaning is required by the context.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including law, medicine, chat, and math papers

patterns.name: Fragments in names, addresses, and email fields
patterns.context: Names, email addresses, or contact fields appear consecutively, with fragmented spellings and punctuation.

patterns.name: Common words and grammatical fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across common words and initial, final, or internal fragments; sentences discuss brands, traffic, help requests, advertising, or casual conversation, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Tokenization fragments in formulas and citations
patterns.context: Multiple internal word fragments activate in mathematical terminology, LaTeX markup, and literature citations.

patterns.name: Isolated activations with no stable semantic pattern
patterns.context: One or a few fragments activate, and the context alone does not support grouping them into a consistent semantic or syntactic category.

3_2327.description: 激活落在多种语境中的词内片段、常见词片段、姓名邮箱字段及公式引文片段上；跨领域且缺少稳定语义条件，像是对特定子词或分词片段的响应。

patterns.name: 词尾/词内「om」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通词、专名或术语内部的子词片段上；上下文不要求特定语义。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学、聊天、数学论文等多种文体

patterns.name: 姓名、地址及邮件字段中的片段
patterns.trigger: [6] «ub»9（“«ub»”）；[9] «la»9（“«la»”），以及相邻姓名、邮箱和标点中的激活
patterns.context: 姓名、邮箱地址或通讯录字段连续出现，包含碎片化拼写与标点。

patterns.name: 常见词及语法片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在常见词、词首/词尾或词内片段；所在句子分别讨论品牌、流量、求助、广告或闲聊，未见一致语义条件。

patterns.name: 公式与引文中的分词片段
patterns.context: 数学术语、LaTeX 标记及文献引用中出现多个词内片段激活。

patterns.name: 无法归入稳定语义模式的孤立激活
patterns.context: 单个或少量片段激活，无法仅凭上下文归入一致的语义或句法类别。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、邮件、医学摘要

en.description: Activation falls on subword fragments within words, adjacent phrases, and proper-name spellings in multilingual text; there is a local preference for several fixed spellings, such as broom, Straub, crop up, and Swedish beror på, but languages and genres differ significantly.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in Swedish
patterns.context: Activation falls inside Swedish words or on adjacent words; passage 1 is especially concentrated around “beroende beror på” (depends on).

patterns.name: room in English broom
patterns.context: The word broom appears in a lease clause describing the condition in which a property must be returned, or in a plant disease name; activation is concentrated on the final om.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in German words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments in formal German sentences concerning the EU, balance, and pluralism of opinion.

patterns.name: Syllables or letter sequences in names
patterns.context: Activation appears on local spelling fragments in names and email addresses; some names recur across passages.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia biographies; Enron emails; legal case documents

patterns.name: Subword fragments in English lyrics
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across quoted, rhythmic or rhyming lyrics, spanning multiple adjacent words.
patterns.domain: English drama or music catalogs and lyrics

patterns.name: crop up in an English phrase
patterns.context: Appears in a colloquial sentence about free alternatives appearing again; activation covers both words in crop up.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in Portuguese words
patterns.context: Activation falls inside Portuguese words or in inflected and hyphenated forms; the context mentions Descartes and rebuilding a house after demolition.

3_2327.description: 激活落在多语种文本的词内片段、相邻短语及专名拼写上；局部偏向若干固定拼写，如 broom、Straub、crop up 和瑞典语 beror på，但跨语种与文体差异显著。

patterns.name: 瑞典语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语词内部或相邻词上；第1段尤其集中于“beroende beror på”（依赖于）一带。

patterns.name: 英语 broom 中的 room
patterns.context: 词形 broom 出现在租约中描述房屋交还状态的条款，或出现在植物病害名称中；激活集中于词尾 om。
patterns.domain: 法律租约；植物学论文摘要

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在正式德语句子中的词内片段，内容涉及欧盟、平衡与意见多元。

patterns.name: 人名中的音节或字母序列
patterns.context: 激活出现在人名及电子邮件地址中的局部拼写片段，部分姓名跨段重复。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物条目；Enron 邮件；法律案件文书

patterns.name: 英语歌词中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在引号内、带有节奏或韵律的歌词文字中，覆盖多个相邻词。
patterns.domain: 英文戏剧或音乐作品目录与歌词

patterns.name: 英语短语中的 crop up
patterns.context: 出现在关于免费替代方案再次出现的口语化句子中，激活覆盖短语 crop up 的两个词。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词内部或词形变化、连字符结构中；语境谈到笛卡尔与拆除后重建房屋。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on subword fragments within multilingual text, covering English, Swedish, Slovenian, Portuguese, and German; there are also a few English pronouns and exclamations. No stable semantic or topical condition is apparent.

patterns.name: English subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on one or more internal fragments of English words, often at tokenization boundaries; there is no stable lexical or syntactic condition
patterns.domain: Web discussions, legal texts, technology texts, medical abstracts, game discussions, and headlines

patterns.name: Swedish word-form fragments
patterns.context: Appears in Swedish sentences, covering subword fragments in compounds, affixes, and common phrases

patterns.name: Slovenian word-form fragments
patterns.context: In parliamentary text, activation appears on fragments inside Slovenian words

patterns.name: Portuguese word-form fragments
patterns.context: Appears in Portuguese philosophical discussion, with markers distributed inside words and inflected forms

patterns.name: German word-form fragments
patterns.context: Appears on internal word fragments and common word forms in German sentences

patterns.name: Common English words and discourse markers
patterns.context: Sporadically appears in conversational expressions, exclamations, and first- or second-person pronouns; the trigger distribution is not consistent enough

3_2327.description: 激活主要落在多语种文本的词内子词片段，覆盖英语、瑞典语、斯洛文尼亚语、葡萄牙语和德语；另有少量英文代词及感叹表达。未见稳定语义或主题条件。

patterns.name: 英文词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词的一个或多个内部片段上，常见于分词边界处；没有稳定的词义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 网页讨论、法律文本、科技文本、医学摘要、游戏讨论及标题

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语句子中，覆盖复合词、词缀及常见词组的子词片段

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 在议会文本中，激活出现在斯洛文尼亚语词内的片段
patterns.domain: EuroParl 斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语哲学论述中，标记分散于词内及词形变化部分
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 葡萄牙语学术文本

patterns.name: 德语词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在德语句子中的词内片段与常见词形

patterns.name: 常用英文词与语气标记
patterns.context: 零星出现在对话式表达、感叹句及第一或第二人称代词中；触发分布不够一致
patterns.domain: 网络文本或口语化文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across intraword fragments in multiple languages, common short English words, and a few complete phrases. The fragments occur in lyrics, proper names, academic terminology, and ordinary narration, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Specific intraword character sequences
patterns.context: Activations fall on contiguous character sequences inside words, often crossing subword or morphological boundaries; the fragments do not always align with lexical boundaries.
patterns.domain: Multilingual natural language, proper names, and technical terminology

patterns.name: Short function words and intraword fragments
patterns.context: In ordinary English sentences or passages, activations are scattered across pronouns, prepositions, conjunctions, and partial character sequences in common words; there is no stable syntactic position or semantic role.
patterns.domain: English conversation, emails, Q&A, and papers

patterns.name: Exclamations with strong tone
patterns.context: The exclamation has a direct address or admonishing tone; this pattern occurs alongside weaker activations on common words in the same passage.

patterns.name: Verb form in a literary quotation
patterns.context: In a poetry or lyric quotation, wind is the subject and the verb appears in the third-person singular form.

patterns.name: Evaluative phrase in narration
patterns.context: An email relays someone else’s assessment of a meeting’s outcome, with «well» and «very» used together.

patterns.name: Name character fragments in medical literature
patterns.context: Activations fall on contiguous fragments within author names cited in a systematic review.

patterns.name: Fragments in names of Jewish religious figures
patterns.context: Personal and rabbinic names occur in biographical accounts of religious figures, with activations inside the names.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Activations fall inside surnames in lists of lawyers or information about party representation.

3_2327.description: 激活分散于多语种词内片段、英文常见短词及少量完整短语；片段涉及歌词、专名、学术术语和普通叙述，未见一致语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 词内特定字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的连续字符片段上，常跨越子词或形态边界；片段并不总与词义边界重合。
patterns.domain: 多语种自然语言、专名及技术术语

patterns.name: 短功能词及词内片段
patterns.context: 普通英文句子或段落中，激活分散在代词、介词、连词及常见词的部分字符上；没有稳定的句法位置或语义角色。
patterns.domain: 英语对话、邮件、问答及论文

patterns.name: 强烈语气的感叹句
patterns.context: 感叹句中带有直接呼告或训诫语气；此模式与同段较弱的常见词激活并列。

patterns.name: 文学引文中的动词词形
patterns.context: 诗歌或歌词引文中，风作为主语、动词以第三人称单数形式出现。

patterns.name: 叙述中的评价性短语
patterns.context: 邮件转述他人对会议结果的评价，«well» 与 «very» 连用。

patterns.name: 医学文献中的姓名字符片段
patterns.context: 系统综述引用作者姓名时，激活分布在姓名内部的连续片段。

patterns.name: 犹太宗教人物姓名片段
patterns.context: 人物及拉比姓名出现在宗教人物传记叙述中，激活位于姓名内部。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 律师名单或当事人代理信息中，激活落在姓氏内部。

en.description: Activation most often falls on subword/character fragments within words, especially long proper names, rare words, and multilingual word forms; it also appears in email usernames and contact fields. A few ordinary phrases, function words, and exclamatory forms occur as well, with unclear conditions.

patterns.name: Character strings split within words
patterns.context: Activation falls in the middle of words or across multiple subword fragments, often in long or uncommon proper names or word forms; the meaning and context need not be shared
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; news, parliamentary text, encyclopedias, papers, etc.

patterns.name: Name and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Appears in names, titles, or name lists; activation is often on character fragments inside a name rather than a stable complete word

patterns.name: Email addresses and account strings
patterns.context: Located in email addresses, usernames, or contact fields containing organizational paths; angle brackets, slashes, and punctuation often surround it

patterns.name: Swedish word-form fragments
patterns.context: Appears inside Swedish words, especially near tokenization boundaries in inflected or compound words; this example also includes a repeated «beror på»

patterns.name: Dutch verb ending
patterns.context: Falls inside the Dutch verb «bekleed», in a sentence where the first-person speaker discusses a position they hold

patterns.name: Fixed phrases or common word fragments
patterns.context: A few activations appear in ordinary English phrases and function words; these examples alone do not establish stable lexical or syntactic conditions
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, medical papers, personal help requests

patterns.name: Conversational exclamatory address
patterns.context: Appears in a direct address or reproach with an exclamation mark

3_2327.concept: 词内片段与专名字符串
3_2327.description: 激活最常落在词内子词/字母片段，尤其是较长专名、罕见词及多语词形；也出现在邮箱账号和联系人字段。另有少数普通短语、功能词和感叹称呼，条件不明确。

patterns.name: 词内分段的字母串
patterns.trigger: 词内部被标记的字母或字母片段，如«Lear»«ned»、«Sh»«iv»、«andra»、«Ta»«ub»、«bek»«le»«ed»、«Sch»«la»«ef»«ke»
patterns.context: 激活落在单词中间或跨多个子词片段的位置，常是拼写较长、较少见的专名或词形；不要求词义或语境相同
patterns.domain: 跨领域；新闻、议会文本、百科、论文等

patterns.name: 人名与专名片段
patterns.context: 出现在姓名、称谓或人名列表中，激活常位于名字内部的字符片段，而非稳定的完整词
patterns.domain: 百科、网页标题、企业邮件

patterns.name: 邮件地址及账号字符串
patterns.context: 位于邮箱地址、用户名或带组织路径的联系人字段中；周围常有尖括号、斜杠及标点
patterns.domain: 企业邮件与联系人列表

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语词内部，尤其是屈折或复合词的分词边界附近；本例中也有重复的「beror på」

patterns.name: 荷兰语动词词尾
patterns.context: 落在荷兰语动词「bekleed」内部，处于句中第一人称谈及职务的语境

patterns.name: 固定短语或常见词片段
patterns.context: 少数激活出现在普通英语短语和功能词中；单靠这些例子无法确认稳定的词汇或句法条件
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、医学论文、个人求助帖

patterns.name: 对话式呼喊
patterns.context: 出现在带感叹号的直接称呼或责备语句中

en.concept: Bloom strings and sporadic subword fragments
en.description: The most stable recurring pattern is the Bloom/bloom string in headlines, news links, and emails. Other activations are distributed across multilingual subword fragments, proper names, and email characters, with varied contexts and no shared semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Bloom string
patterns.context: Bloom/bloom (with varying capitalization) appears in proper names, headlines, or email addresses; the marker falls inside the name or one of its component fragments.
patterns.domain: Web headlines, news headlines, email contacts

patterns.name: Dutch subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a stem fragment in a word form of the Dutch verb bekleden.

patterns.name: Hebrew name fragment
patterns.context: A subword fragment inside the name Taub.

patterns.name: German word-final fragment
patterns.context: Activation appears on a subword fragment of the German verb gewährleisten; the context discusses EU measures.

patterns.name: German noun-ending fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword fragment of Konsultation; the surrounding context concerns democratic oversight and information and consultation.

patterns.name: Swedish verb fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a Swedish sentence explaining the causes of the EU’s import dependency; activation covers a verb fragment and a preposition.

patterns.name: Literature author-name fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls inside an author surname cited in a medical review.

patterns.name: Author-name fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls inside an author name in an entry containing author and reference fields.

patterns.name: Other name-field fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the email address «<dl«h»@jmbm.com>», surrounded by contact names and email addresses; it occurs in isolation and is difficult to group with other patterns.

3_2327.concept: Bloom 字串及零散词内片段
3_2327.description: 最稳定的重复模式是 Bloom/bloom 字串出现在标题、新闻链接和邮箱中。其余激活分散于多语种词内片段、专名及邮箱字符，语境各异，未见共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: Bloom 字串
patterns.context: 专名、标题或邮箱地址中出现 Bloom/bloom（大小写不一）；标记落在名称内部或其组成片段上。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、新闻标题、邮件联系人

patterns.name: Dutch 词内片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语动词 bekleden 的词形中，激活落在词干片段。

patterns.name: 希伯来姓名片段
patterns.context: 人名 Taub 内部的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 人物条目

patterns.name: 德语词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 gewährleisten 这一德语动词的词内片段；上下文讨论欧盟措施。

patterns.name: 德语名词结尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 Konsultation 的词内片段；相邻语境谈民主监督与信息咨询。

patterns.name: 瑞典语动词片段
patterns.context: 在瑞典语句子中出现，解释欧盟进口依赖的原因；激活覆盖动词片段和介词。

patterns.name: 文献作者姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活位于医学综述引用的作者姓氏内部。

patterns.name: 作者姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活位于作者姓名内部；内容为带作者和参考文献字段的条目。

patterns.name: 其他姓名字段片段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件地址「<dl«h»@jmbm.com>」中，周围是联系人姓名与邮箱列表；单独出现，难以归入其他模式。

en.description: Activation is distributed across languages and genres, falling on fragments of names or proper nouns, subwords within words, and phrase tokens; Bloom and the -ub surname fragment each recur, while most others are isolated and difficult to group into a unified semantic or grammatical feature.

patterns.name: Bloom string
patterns.context: Appears in the product name “Bloom” and in Bloom in names/email addresses; activation falls on different subword fragments of bloom.
patterns.domain: Technology blog headlines, business email/contact information

patterns.name: German subword fragment
patterns.context: In German parliamentary text, it occurs inside “gewährleisten” (ensure).

patterns.name: English phrase On
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase “Come On!” before the exclamation “Haven’t You Lear«ned» Anything”.

patterns.name: Internal letters in Danish words
patterns.context: Appears inside “hjælpe” (help), in a passage about disease prevention methods.

patterns.name: Taub surname fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the name of the Jewish rabbi Menachem Mendel Taub.

patterns.name: Straub surname fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the email recipient name Claude Straub.

patterns.name: Dutch word-final fragment
patterns.context: Appears inside “bekleed” (hold or occupy a position), describing how the speaker held various positions.

patterns.name: Ending of English growl
patterns.context: Appears in the technical help-request context “I have growl installed”.

patterns.name: Ending of English woos
patterns.context: Appears in the lyric quote “the south wind woos with tender lips”.

3_2327.description: 激活分散在不同语言和文体中，落于姓名或专名片段、词内子词及短语 token；Bloom 与 -ub 姓氏片段各有重复，其余多为孤例，难以归为统一语义或语法特征。

patterns.name: Bloom 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在产品名“Bloom”、人名/邮箱地址中的 Bloom；激活落在 bloom 的不同子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 科技博客标题、商务邮件/联系人信息

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 德语议会文本中，位于“gewährleisten”（保障）一词内部。

patterns.name: 英语短语 On
patterns.context: 出现在感叹句“Haven’t You Lear«ned» Anything”之前的短语“Come On!”中。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内字母
patterns.context: 出现在“hjælpe”（帮助）一词内部，涉及防疫方法。

patterns.name: Taub 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在犹太拉比姓名 Menachem Mendel Taub 中。

patterns.name: Straub 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件收件人姓名 Claude Straub 中。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件通讯录/邮件头

patterns.name: 荷兰语词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在“bekleed”（担任、占据职务）一词内部，描述说话者曾担任不同职务。

patterns.name: 英语 growl 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在“I have growl installed”这一技术求助语境中。

patterns.name: 英语 woos 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在歌词引文“the south wind woos with tender lips”中。
patterns.domain: 百科全书中的戏剧/歌词文本

en.description: Activations mostly fall on intraword substrings in multilingual words, personal names, and email addresses/URLs; a few occur in English function words or narrative words. Examples span multiple languages, proper names, and string fragments, with no reliable unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within multilingual words
patterns.context: Activations fall inside natural-language words, often in morphologically complex words, endings, or stem-affix boundaries; no stable lexical or syntactic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: German, French, Danish, and other EuroParl parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Fragments inside personal and proper names
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur inside personal names, titles, or institutional/product names; there is no consistent name type or language condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, academic metadata, parliamentary records, emails, and web headlines

patterns.name: Fragments in email addresses and URLs
patterns.context: Activations occur in email addresses and URL domains or paths, especially within strings separated by punctuation; their relationship to natural-language semantics is unclear.
patterns.domain: Email headers, web links, and technical/business websites

patterns.name: Function words or phrase fragments in general English sentences
patterns.context: A few activations fall on common words in English dialogue or narration. The surrounding text respectively concerns a conversation/exclamation after replacing a student card and a discussion of web traffic and paid alternatives; no unified grammatical condition emerges.

patterns.name: Split word forms and proper name Bloom
patterns.context: Capitalization variants of the same word form occur in headlines, URLs, and email display names; other activations fall on subword fragments in unrelated words, so a word-specific response cannot be established.
patterns.domain: HackerNews headlines/links and Enron email headers

3_2327.concept: 词内子串与字符串片段
3_2327.description: 激活多落在多语词语、人名及邮箱/网址中的词内子串；少数出现在英文功能词或叙述词。跨语种、专名和字符串片段均有例子，未见可靠的统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 多语言词中间的子词片段
patterns.trigger: 词内被标记的子串，如德语 «rit»、«gewähr«le»»、«Kontrol«le»；法语 «cad»、«form»；丹麦语 «prot«ok»ollen»
patterns.context: 激活落在自然语言词的内部，常处于形态复杂的词、词尾或词干与词缀边界；未见稳定的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 德语、法语、丹麦语等 EuroParl 议会发言

patterns.name: 人名与专名内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在人名、称谓或机构/产品专名内部；没有一致的名称类型或语言条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术元数据、议会记录、邮件及网页标题

patterns.name: 邮箱地址与网址中的片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在电子邮件地址、URL 的域名或路径中，尤其是由标点分隔的字符串内部；与自然语言语义关系不明显。
patterns.domain: 邮件头、网页链接和技术/商业网页

patterns.name: 一般英文句子中的功能词或短语片段
patterns.context: 少量激活落在英文对话或叙述中的常见词，周围分别是补办学生卡后的对话/感叹，以及网页流量与付费替代方案的讨论；未形成统一语法条件。
patterns.domain: 网页语料中的口语/叙述文本

patterns.name: 拆分后的大小写词形与专名 Bloom
patterns.context: 同一词形的大小写变体出现在标题、URL 和邮件显示名中；另有多处激活落在其他词内的子词片段，故不能确定是词义特异性响应。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 标题/链接及 Enron 邮件头

en.description: Activation often falls on subword fragments within words, and also on names, emails, URLs, and English function words; the corpus spans multilingual parliamentary text, name lists, emails, web headlines, and dialogue, with no single semantic or domain grouping.

patterns.name: Danish internal subword tokenization
patterns.context: Activation markers fall on subword fragments inside Danish words; examples include parliamentary record passages about minutes, colleagues, and speeches.

patterns.name: Danish disease word forms
patterns.context: Markers appear inside disease- and pandemic-related words; the context discusses diseases from distant continents and prevention measures.

patterns.name: Swedish internal subword tokenization
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments in Swedish words, in passages about South Ossetia, nighttime actions, and joint decisions.

patterns.name: German internal subword tokenization
patterns.context: Markers appear inside German words; the context discusses democratic oversight, information, and consultation.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in names and surnames
patterns.context: Markers appear on subword fragments in names, both in author lists and in descriptions of rabbis and religious figures.

patterns.name: Email and domain fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on username, symbol, or domain fragments in email addresses, among recipient/contact lists.

patterns.name: Bloom brand-name fragment
patterns.context: Markers appear inside Bloom-related URLs or brand/headline strings; one passage introduces a credit product, while another is a Bloomberg news headline and link.

patterns.name: Function words in English phrases
patterns.context: In a first-person account about replacing a student card and the following dialogue, activation falls on English pronouns, interjections, or phrase components.

3_2327.concept: 词内子词与字符串片段
3_2327.description: 激活多落在词内子词片段，也包括人名、邮箱、网址和英语功能词；语料横跨多语种议会文本、姓名列表、邮件、网页标题与对话，无法归为单一语义或领域。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内子词切分
patterns.context: 激活标记落在丹麦语词内部的子词片段；包括议会记录中关于会议记录、同事和发言的句子。

patterns.name: 丹麦语疾病词形
patterns.context: 标记出现在疾病和疫情相关词语的词内；上下文讨论来自遥远大陆的疾病及防疫措施。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 丹麦语公共卫生文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内子词切分
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语词的子词片段中，出现在南奥塞梯、夜间行动及共同决定的叙述里。

patterns.name: 德语词内子词切分
patterns.context: 标记出现在德语词内部；上下文讨论民主监督、信息与协商。

patterns.name: 人名及姓氏内部片段
patterns.context: 标记出现在人名的词内片段；既有作者列表，也有拉比与宗教人物介绍。
patterns.domain: 书目元数据与英文维基百科

patterns.name: 邮箱与域名片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在邮件地址的用户名、符号或域名片段中，夹在收件人/联系人列表里。

patterns.name: Bloom 品牌名片段
patterns.context: 标记出现在 Bloom 相关网址或品牌/标题字符串内部；一段介绍信用产品，另一段是彭博新闻标题及链接。

patterns.name: 英语短语中的功能词
