patterns.domain: 代码标识符；专利背景中的对话示例

patterns.name: SQL 查询结构
patterns.context: 出现在查询语句的字段、子查询及分组排序结构中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 SQL 代码

en.concept: Mixed features of structural boundaries and common phrases
en.description: Activation is distributed across line breaks or structural boundaries, Do you questions, SharePoint/Share, and lot(s) local patterns; common words also activate sporadically. The fifth passage consists mainly of code comments and a copyright line, which are difficult to relate to the other patterns.

patterns.name: Line beginnings or paragraph separators
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated near line breaks, paragraphs, or boundaries in structured text; in several passages it is also adjacent to markers at the beginning of a line or following words.
patterns.domain: Q&A, reports, emails, code, and academic text

patterns.name: Do you in questions
patterns.context: Questions begin with Do you and continue with an inquiry or request; it also appears at the end of technical discussions.

patterns.name: SharePoint-related word forms
patterns.context: The name SharePoint is split into share and point, or Share appears on its own; the contexts are not necessarily semantically identical.

patterns.name: Words related to lot / lots
patterns.context: lot(s) refers to a quantity or a specific lot in securities trading; the meanings differ somewhat across passages.

patterns.name: Local activation of common words at sentence beginnings
patterns.context: Sporadic activation on common words at sentence beginnings or within sentences, with no stable shared semantic condition.

3_2342.concept: 结构边界与常见短语的混合特征
3_2342.description: 激活分散在换行或结构边界、Do you 疑问句、SharePoint/Share、lot(s) 等局部模式；另有常见词零星激活。第5段主要是代码注释与版权行，难与其他模式对应。

patterns.name: 行首或段落分隔符
patterns.context: 激活集中在换行、段落或结构化文本的边界附近；在若干段里还与行首的标记或后续词相邻。
patterns.domain: 问答、报告、邮件、代码与论文文本

patterns.name: 问答中的 Do you
patterns.context: 疑问句中以 Do you 起句，后接询问或请求；也出现在技术讨论结尾。

patterns.name: SharePoint 相关词形
patterns.context: SharePoint 名称被拆成 share 与 point，或单独出现 Share；未必都在相同语义语境。
patterns.domain: 软件开发问答、报告标题

patterns.name: lot / lots 相关词
patterns.context: lot(s) 表示数量或证券交易中的特定批次；各段语义不完全相同。

patterns.name: 句首常见词的局部激活
patterns.context: 在句首或句间常见词上零星激活，缺少稳定的共同语义条件。

en.concept: Follow-up expressions with outlier word forms
en.description: Most activations concentrate on follow/follow-up expressions for follow-up care in medical literature, especially descriptions of follow-up duration, appointments, and studies; there are also two outlier patterns: apostrophe contractions in HackerNews and the patent term Power line communications.

patterns.name: Follow-up expressions
patterns.context: In medical studies, describes follow-up after treatment, examination, or patient care, often near durations, appointments, study design, or loss to follow-up; includes variants such as “Long term follow up,” “follow-up appointment,” and “followed-up as scheduled.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, abstracts, and clinical studies

patterns.name: follow within the hyphenated follow-up term
patterns.context: Hyphenated follow-up expressions appearing in contexts about study follow-up duration or follow-up appointments.

patterns.name: Apostrophe suffixes in English contractions
patterns.context: An apostrophe and the following s or m are marked in informal online text; they appear in “it’s,” “I’m,” and “there’s,” respectively, outside medical follow-up contexts.

patterns.name: Power line compound term
patterns.context: Power and line are strongly activated separately in the technical term “Power line communications (PLC)”; this does not match the other medical follow-up examples.

3_2342.concept: 随访表达，兼有离群词形
3_2342.description: 多数激活集中于医学文献中的 follow/follow-up 随访表达，尤其描述随访时长、预约及研究；另有 HackerNews 中撇号缩写，以及专利术语 Power line communications 两种离群模式。

patterns.name: 随访（follow-up）表达
patterns.context: 医学研究中描述治疗、检查或患者之后的随访，常与时长、预约、研究设计或失访情况相邻；包括“Long term follow up”“follow-up appointment”“followed-up as scheduled”等变体。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、摘要及临床研究

patterns.name: 缩写词 follow-up 中的 follow
patterns.context: 连字符形式的随访用语，出现在研究随访时长或随访预约语境中。

patterns.name: 英语缩写中的撇号后缀
patterns.context: 撇号及其后的 s 或 m 在口语化网络文本中被标记；分别出现在“it’s”“I’m”“there’s”中，并非医学随访语境。

patterns.name: 电力线复合词
patterns.context: “Power line communications (PLC)”这一技术术语中，Power 与 line 分别强激活；与其余医学随访例子不相符。

en.description: Primarily responds to ’s in apostrophe contractions; also activates on Power compound names, Google Wallet/Walter strings, all-caps email announcements, General News, and a few isolated title or entry words.

patterns.name: Power in proper names or brands
patterns.context: The first word of a compound proper name or organization name, followed by line, Generation, or similar words; in the latter example, it is also followed by Investco.

patterns.name: Google Wallet name
patterns.context: The Google Wallet brand name appears at the start of a sentence introducing money transfers by text message.

patterns.name: Walter names and surname fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the complete tokenization of Walter or the substring Wal in Wallet; in the latter case it may also be a response to the Wal substring.

patterns.name: s in apostrophe contractions
patterns.context: Commonly appears in there’s, and also in it’s, what’s, and Florida’s; activation concentrates on the apostrophe and following s, with notably high intensity across several passages.

patterns.name: All-caps word HAVE
patterns.context: An all-caps trading announcement in an email, with HAVE as the prominent activation location.

patterns.name: General in a news heading
patterns.context: General directly precedes News in a news navigation label or headline.

patterns.name: Scattered title words beyond unexplained Power
patterns.context: The available context is insufficient to assign these activated words to a stable trigger pattern; they may be influenced separately by title formatting or biographical entries.

3_2342.concept: 混合的词形与格式模式
3_2342.description: 主要响应撇号缩写中的’s；另对Power复合名称、Google Wallet/Walter字串、全大写邮件宣告、General News及少数标题或条目词激活。

patterns.name: 专名或品牌中的 Power
patterns.context: 作为复合专名或机构名称的首词，后接 line、Generation 等词；后一例还接 Investco。

patterns.name: Google Wallet 名称
patterns.context: Google Wallet 品牌名称在句首，介绍通过短信转账。

patterns.name: Walter 姓名及姓氏片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Walter 的完整拆分形式，或 Wallet 的 Wal 子串；在后一处也可能是对 Wal 子串的响应。
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物条目、网页文章

patterns.name: 撇号缩写中的 s
patterns.context: 常见于 there’s，也见于 it’s、what’s、Florida’s；激活集中在撇号及其后的 s，强度在多段中显著。

patterns.name: 全大写词 HAVE
patterns.context: 邮件中的全大写交易宣告，HAVE 是突出激活位置。

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的 General
patterns.context: 新闻导航或标题标签中，General 紧接 News。

patterns.name: unexplained Power 之外的零散标题词
patterns.context: 现有上下文不足以将这些激活词归入稳定触发模式；可能分别受标题格式或人名条目影响。
patterns.domain: 网页专题标题、维基百科条目

en.description: Activation is distributed across fragments of Knowledge, Power, and various proper names, brands, and code identifiers; it also occurs on Put and Wallet in titles and on possessive apostrophes. There is no stable, unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: Knowledge subword fragment
patterns.context: The word-initial fragment Know- is followed by Knowledge; one instance is the phrase Knowledge Base, another is followed by of
patterns.domain: Knowledge-base documentation, popular science, or technical text

patterns.name: Power-related phrases
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving electricity, communications, company names, or system names; sometimes occurs at the beginning of a title or phrase

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names or brands
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments in proper names, product names, or word-initial subwords, with varying meanings and contexts
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, encyclopedias, news headlines, technology news

patterns.name: Identifier fragments in source code
patterns.context: Located in text resembling C/C++ source filenames or paths, followed by underscore-separated fragments

patterns.name: Punctuation in possessive contractions
patterns.context: An apostrophe appears in an English contraction or possessive form; activation covers the punctuation and adjacent word fragments

patterns.name: Investment-related fragment in a company name
patterns.context: Part of the company name Power Generation Investco, L.L.

patterns.name: Put and its suffix in a headline
patterns.context: Appears in the news headline Obama Put(s) Pressure on GOP

patterns.name: Payment service name fragment
patterns.context: Forms part of the Google Wallet brand name; the following text mentions transferring money by text message

3_2342.description: 激活分散在 Knowledge、Power 及多种专名、品牌和代码标识符片段上，也见于标题中的 Put、Wallet 与所有格撇号；没有稳定统一的语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: Knowledge 子词片段
patterns.context: 词首片段 Know- 后续组成 Knowledge；一次为短语 Knowledge Base，另一次接 of
patterns.domain: 知识库说明、科普或技术文本

patterns.name: Power 相关词组
patterns.context: 出现在电力、通信、公司名或系统名称中；有时处于标题或词组开头
patterns.domain: 百科、专利背景、商务邮件

patterns.name: 专名或品牌片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、产品名或词首子词上，具体语义和上下文各异
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、百科、新闻标题、科技新闻

patterns.name: 源代码中的标识符片段
patterns.context: 位于类 C/C++ 源文件名或路径样式的文本中，后接下划线分隔的片段

patterns.name: 所有格缩写中的标点
patterns.context: 撇号位于英文缩写或所有格形式中，激活覆盖标点及相邻词片段
patterns.domain: 标题或新闻式英文文本

patterns.name: 公司名中的投资相关片段
patterns.context: 作为 Power Generation Investco, L.L. 公司名的一部分

patterns.name: 标题中的 Put 及其后缀
patterns.context: 位于 Obama Put(s) Pressure on GOP 的新闻标题中

patterns.name: 支付服务名称片段
patterns.context: 构成 Google Wallet 品牌名，后文提及通过短信转账

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper nouns and domain vocabulary: Power/energy, word-initial Knowledge, mathematical notation, places, product names, and colloquial sentence patterns. No single common semantic feature clearly covers all fragments.

patterns.name: Power in technical, system, and energy proper names
patterns.context: Appears in names of organizations, technical systems, or energy topics; “Power” activates as part of a name or term.

patterns.name: Knowledge word forms
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the initial token of Knowledge, appearing in product/knowledge-base titles and sentences about principles.

patterns.name: Specific mathematical notation
patterns.context: Appears in a comment discussing π, referring to the square-root expression sqrt(pi).

patterns.name: Place and venue names
patterns.context: Embedded in all-caps place names or resort names.

patterns.name: Product name
patterns.context: Appears in a product name introduced as enabling money transfers by text message.
patterns.domain: Technology products, news or web text

patterns.name: Colloquial sentence fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a colloquial sentence expressing an opinion, followed by an evaluation of something.

3_2342.description: 激活分散在专名与领域词汇中：Power/能源、Knowledge 词首、数学符号、地点、产品名及口语句式。没有一个明显覆盖全部片段的共同语义。

patterns.name: Power 技术、系统与能源专名
patterns.trigger: “IBM Power Systems”“Power line communications”“Power Generation Investco”中的 “Power”，以及 “Global Energy Architecture Performance Index Report”中的 “Energy”
patterns.context: 出现在组织、技术系统或能源主题名称中；“Power”作为名称或术语的一部分被激活。
patterns.domain: 计算机、通信、能源、公司名称

patterns.name: Knowledge 词形
patterns.context: 触发落在 Knowledge 的词首 token；分别处于产品/知识库标题和关于原理的句子中。

patterns.name: 特定数学符号表达
patterns.context: 出现在讨论 π 的评论中，指平方根表达式 sqrt(pi)。

patterns.name: 地名与场所名称
patterns.context: 嵌在全大写的地名或度假场所名称中。

patterns.name: 产品名称
patterns.context: 出现在介绍通过短信转账的产品名称中。
patterns.domain: 科技产品、新闻或网页文本

patterns.name: 口语句式片段
patterns.context: 出现在表达看法的口语句子开头，后接对某事的评价。

en.concept: English word-initial fragments and Here’s contraction
en.description: Activation is concentrated on several English word-initial fragments (Wal, Know, Extra, Power), with two additional instances on the apostrophe and s in “Here’s,” which introduces an example or link. Apart from word-initial position, no unified semantic or domain condition is evident.

patterns.name: Word-initial Wal- subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation appears at the beginning of English words or proper names; the fragment may continue directly into the rest of the word or appear at the start of a line and recur after a line break.

patterns.name: Knowledge word beginning
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a line or phrase, followed by Knowledge; no fixed subsequent context is required.

patterns.name: Extra- prefix
patterns.context: A word-initial prefix in compound medical terms, followed by a hyphen and descriptive words.

patterns.name: Here’s phrase
patterns.context: Introduces an example, gallery, or link within a sentence; activation falls on the apostrophe and s in the contraction, not on Here.

patterns.name: Power word beginning
patterns.context: At the beginning of a patent sentence, forming the technical term “Power line.”

3_2342.concept: 英文词首片段及 Here’s 缩写
3_2342.description: 激活集中在若干英文词首片段（Wal、Know、Extra、Power），另有两例在引出示例或链接的“Here’s”中落于撇号和 s。除词首位置外，未见统一语义或领域条件。

patterns.name: 词首 Wal- 子词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在英文单词或专名的开头；片段后可直接接续词尾，也可位于行首并在换行后重复出现。

patterns.name: Knowledge 词首
patterns.context: 出现在行首或短语开头，后接 Knowledge；不要求固定后续语境。
patterns.domain: 网页内容、医学科研文本

patterns.name: Extra- 前缀
patterns.context: 作为复合医学术语的词首前缀，后接连字符及描述性词语。

patterns.name: Here’s 短语
patterns.context: 在句中引出示例、画廊或链接；激活落在缩写中的撇号及 s，而非 Here。
patterns.domain: 非正式网页评论、技术博客

patterns.name: Power 词首
patterns.context: 位于专利句子开头，构成技术术语“Power line”。

en.description: Strong activations cluster on the word-initial fragments Organ and Wal: the former occurs in several types of academic terms, while the latter occurs in proper nouns such as personal and place names; the same initial fragment sometimes recurs within a passage.

patterns.name: Word-initial Organ
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a word, followed by a suffix or other morpheme that completes the word; it may recur within the same passage.
patterns.domain: Medicine, biology, chemistry, materials science, and related encyclopedia or research-paper text

patterns.name: Word-initial Wal
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of proper or place names, with subsequent characters completing the full name; it may recur within the same passage.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, place names, and patent background text

3_2342.description: 强激活集中在词首片段 Organ 和 Wal：前者出现在多类学术术语中，后者出现在人名、地名等专名中；部分段落同词首再次出现。

patterns.name: 词首 Organ
patterns.context: 出现在词首，后接构成完整词的后缀或其他词素；同一段中可再次出现。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学、化学、材料科学及相关百科或论文文本

patterns.name: 词首 Wal
patterns.context: 出现在专名或地名的词首，后续字符补成完整名称；同一段中可再次出现。
patterns.domain: 百科人物、地名及专利背景文本

en.description: Activations occur relatively often on proper names beginning with Wal-, the introductory phrase Here’s, and several inconsistent word-internal fragments; there are also tildes, negative contractions, and draft-prediction terms. Overall, there is no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Wal-initial strings
patterns.context: Proper names or entry titles beginning with Wal-; activation is concentrated on Wal, with weaker subsequent tokens.

patterns.name: Here’s introductions
patterns.context: Here’s introduces resources, previews, or descriptions, such as gallery or early NHL mock draft; activation marks ’s.

patterns.name: Word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: In medical titles, cultural text, or headings, activation falls on whole words or word-internal subword fragments, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: ~~~ marker
patterns.context: A sequence of tildes in code- or Markdown-style text, with a username and version-update notes nearby.

patterns.name: Past negative contraction
patterns.context: In a negative past-perfect form, activation is concentrated on a word-internal fragment; the following text shifts to commentary on game features.

patterns.name: Lottery-related terms
patterns.context: After the draft order is known, discussion turns to predicting which players each team will pick.

3_2342.description: 激活较集中地出现在 Wal- 专名、Here’s 引导语，以及若干彼此不一致的词内片段；另有波浪号、否定缩写和选秀预测词。整体没有统一语义条件。

patterns.name: Wal 起始字串
patterns.context: 以 Wal- 开头的专名或词条标题；激活集中在 Wal，后续词元较弱。

patterns.name: here’s 引导语
patterns.context: Here’s 后接资源、预览或介绍内容，如 gallery、early NHL mock draft；激活标记落在 ’s。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 医学标题、文化文本或标题中，激活落在完整词或词内子词片段，未见一致的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、网页文本、标题

patterns.name: ~~~ 标记
patterns.context: 代码或 Markdown 风格文本中的波浪号序列，附近出现用户名与版本更新说明。

patterns.name: 既往否定缩写
patterns.context: 否定过去完成形式中，激活集中于词内片段；后文转入对游戏功能的评论。

patterns.name: lottery 相关词
patterns.context: 选秀顺序已知后，讨论预测各队将挑选哪些球员。

en.description: Activations are distributed across interrogative structures, English ’s contractions (especially here’s), code fences, and several isolated words, proper nouns, and numbers; multiple passages mark here’s, but the other triggers lack a unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Interrogative structures in colloquial questions
patterns.context: An interrogative word or auxiliary appears in a question, rhetorical question, or self-directed question; in passage 7, the interrogative structure is embedded in “what do we have … do”.
patterns.domain: News headlines, comment threads, lifestyle articles

patterns.name: ’s in contractions
patterns.context: ’s in English contractions, mainly “here’s”, but also “Where’s” and “it’s”; activation concentrates on the apostrophe and following s.
patterns.domain: Web articles, forum posts, news and guides

patterns.name: Remember word
patterns.context: The word appears at the beginning of a sentence, followed by a work title or topic; the context here is a music-related question.

patterns.name: Markdown code fences
patterns.context: Markdown code fences in a forum reply, followed by a username or text.

patterns.name: Irregular forms and within-word fragments
patterns.context: These words or within-word fragments are individually marked in their respective contexts; the fragments do not establish whether the trigger is word meaning or a tokenization-boundary effect.
patterns.domain: Popular-science articles, sports and health articles, forum conversations

patterns.name: Sports proper-name terms
patterns.context: Near the names of hockey teams, events, or leagues; the marked spans fall on proper names or their fragments.

patterns.name: Short function words and within-word fragments
patterns.context: They each occur in different syntactic positions, with no consistent local collocation or semantic condition apparent.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, sports articles, and other web text

patterns.name: Numeric marker
patterns.context: Refers to the first 14 picks in the NHL draft.

3_2342.description: 激活分散于疑问结构、英语缩写 ’s（尤其 here’s）、代码围栏及若干孤立词项、专名和数字；多段同时标记 here’s，但其余触发缺乏统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 口语疑问句中的疑问结构
patterns.context: 疑问词或助动词出现在提问、反问或自问句中；第7段为嵌在“what do we have … do”里的疑问结构。
patterns.domain: 新闻标题、评论对话、生活方式文章

patterns.name: 缩写中的 ’s
patterns.context: 英文缩写中的 ’s，主要是 “here’s”，也包括“Where’s”“it’s”；激活集中在撇号及其后的 s。
patterns.domain: 网页文章、论坛帖子、新闻与指南

patterns.name: Remember 词项
patterns.context: 句首出现该词，后接作品名或话题；此处语境是音乐相关提问。

patterns.name: Markdown 代码围栏
patterns.context: 论坛回复中的 Markdown 代码围栏，后接用户名或文本。

patterns.name: 不规则形态与词内片段
patterns.context: 这些词项或词内片段在相应语境中被单独标记；从片段无法确认是词义触发还是分词边界效应。
patterns.domain: 科普文章、运动健康文章、论坛对话

patterns.name: 体育专名词项
patterns.context: 冰球球队、赛事或联赛名称附近；标记落在专名或其片段上。

patterns.name: 短功能词及词内片段
patterns.trigger: « self»、« local»、« simple»、« have»、« so»、« ’»、« back»、« find»
patterns.context: 各自出现于不同句法位置，未显示一致的局部搭配或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、体育文章及其他网页文本

patterns.name: 数字标记
patterns.context: 指 NHL 选秀顺位的前 14 个名额。

en.concept: Common function words and introductory phrases
en.description: Responds mainly to Here’s introducing subsequent content and do in questions, especially How/Where do…; there are also sporadic triggers for don’t, What, mock draft, and tildes, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Here’s introducing content
patterns.context: After introducing something, Here’s introduces an example, link, explanation, or highlight.
patterns.domain: Web comments, sports reporting, health articles

patterns.name: do introducing questions
patterns.context: do appears in questions, especially How/Where do I/you…; asks about methods, choices, or preferences.
patterns.domain: Q&A posts, forum discussions, work emails

patterns.name: Contraction and apostrophe combination
patterns.context: The apostrophe and adjacent token in the negative auxiliary don’t activate; this occurs in only one sample.

patterns.name: Decorative tilde
patterns.context: A standalone tilde separator appears before a username; this occurs in only one sample.

patterns.name: What in questions
patterns.context: What appears in an indirect question asking about meaning or explanation; Here’s an example is also nearby.

patterns.name: mock draft phrase
patterns.context: mock draft names a draft prediction; activation is weak and occurs in only one sample.

3_2342.description: 主要响应引出后续内容的 Here’s，以及疑问句中的 do，尤其 How/Where do…；另有零散的 don’t、What、mock draft 和波浪号触发，缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: Here’s 引出内容
patterns.context: 在前文介绍某项内容后，用 Here’s 引出示例、链接、解释或亮点。
patterns.domain: 网页评论、体育报道、健康文章

patterns.name: do 引导疑问
patterns.context: 疑问句中出现 do，尤其是 How/Where do I/you…；询问操作方法、选择或偏好。
patterns.domain: 问答帖、论坛讨论、工作邮件

patterns.name: 缩写与撇号组合
patterns.context: 否定助动词 don’t 中撇号及其相邻 token 激活；样本仅此一例。

patterns.name: 波浪号装饰
patterns.context: 独立的波浪号分隔符出现在用户名之前；样本仅此一例。

patterns.name: 问句中的 What
patterns.context: What 出现在询问含义或解释的间接疑问句中；同时邻近 Here’s an example。

patterns.name: mock draft 词组
patterns.context: mock draft 用作选秀预测的名称；激活较弱且仅此一例。

en.description: Primarily responds to structures such as do, have, and How about in English question contexts, and is sensitive to the following person or complement; it also activates on Google search topics and several scattered word forms and punctuation. The use of have in emails is not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Do in questions
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on do / ’s after an interrogative word or structure, commonly in direct questions or headline-style questions; the highest-intensity tokens are often do, ’, and s.

patterns.name: How about / have you interactional questions
patterns.context: In dialogue or reader-directed questions, an object follows How about, or a personal pronoun follows have to form a question about experience or status.

patterns.name: General have / have a good week
patterns.context: have is followed by a noun phrase, expressing a wish or asking about/discussing business; it need not be a question.

patterns.name: Question markers outside interrogative sentences
patterns.context: Explicitly poses a question or immediately asks the reader, but strong activation does not fall on typical do / have question structures.

patterns.name: Google search-related words
patterns.context: Discusses Google, Google API, or Google+; activations fall on the brand name and search terms.

patterns.name: Scattered local collocations
patterns.context: These activations are distributed across different word forms, punctuation, or code, with no confirmed common syntactic or semantic condition.

3_2342.description: 主要对英语疑问语境中的 do、have、How about 等结构及其后续人称/补语敏感；另在 Google 搜索话题和若干零散词形、标点处激活，邮件中的 have 用法并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 疑问句中的 do
patterns.context: 激活集中在疑问词或疑问结构之后的 do / ’s，常见于直接提问或标题式疑问；强度最高的 token 多为 do、’、s。

patterns.name: How about / have you 互动问句
patterns.trigger: «How»1« about»9 you、« have»6 you、«have»9 you、«have»9 they
patterns.context: 对话或面向读者的提问中，How about 后接对象，或 have 后接人称代词构成询问经历、状态的结构。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、博客、口语化文章

patterns.name: 一般 have / have a good week
patterns.trigger: « have»9 a good week、« have»3 Gas« Log»istics
patterns.context: have 后接名词短语，分别表达祝愿或询问/谈论业务；不要求是问句。

patterns.name: 疑问句以外的提问标记
patterns.context: 显式提出问题或紧接着询问读者，但强激活并不落在典型 do / have 问句结构上。

patterns.name: Google 搜索相关词
patterns.context: 谈论 Google、Google API 或 Google+；激活落在品牌名及搜索词上。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、社交媒体文章

patterns.name: 零散局部搭配
patterns.context: 这些激活分散于不相同的词形、标点或代码附近，缺少可确认的共同句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛、代码、邮件、科普文章

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on the interrogative auxiliaries do/have and the negative imperative don’t; they also occur with am inversion, interrogative words, self-reference, and Be imperatives. A few formatting symbols and word-internal fragments are also present, but do not fit a unified syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: do in questions
patterns.context: Activation falls on the auxiliary do, which often introduces or forms a question; it is followed by a subject and verb/predicate.
patterns.domain: Q&A, forum discussions, math questions, and general conversation

patterns.name: Negative imperatives and suggestions
patterns.context: The negative auxiliary don’t combines with a following verb to form advice, commands, or suggestions; activation spans subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Spoken language, inspirational copy, dialogue, and blogs

patterns.name: have in perfect-tense questions
patterns.context: have activates strongly when sentence-initial or in an interrogative structure; the first two cases are present-perfect questions, while another occurs in a farewell.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, explanatory text, and email

patterns.name: Self-reference and reflexive expressions
patterns.context: Self-referential expressions containing self or myself occur, but activation does not always fall on the complete word.
patterns.domain: Forum text, inspirational copy, business emails

patterns.name: Interrogative words in questions
patterns.context: Interrogative words introduce direct questions, often in dialogue or rhetorical questions; they occur only occasionally.

patterns.name: General interrogative auxiliary am
patterns.context: am and the subject I form an inverted structure in a question.

patterns.name: Be in statements/instructions
patterns.context: Sentence-initial imperative Be is followed by an identity or self-expression.

patterns.name: Fragment boundaries and polysemous residuals
patterns.context: Formatting markers, mathematical symbols, line breaks, or word-internal fragments are marked; there is no stable syntactic or semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Scraped forum text, Q&A formatting, and symbol-heavy text

3_2342.description: 激活主要集中于疑问句助动词 do/have，以及 don’t 否定祈使；也见于 am 倒装、疑问词、自我指称和 Be 祈使。另有少量格式符号及词内片段，难归入统一句法模式。

patterns.name: 疑问句中的 do
patterns.trigger: «do»10、«do»9、«do»6，或 “do i need”“do you like”“do I need”等
patterns.context: 激活落在助动词 do 上，常引出或构成疑问句；后接主语与动词/谓语。
patterns.domain: 问答、论坛讨论、数学提问及一般对话

patterns.name: 否定祈使与建议
patterns.context: 否定助动词 don’t 与后续动词构成劝告、命令或提议；激活跨分词片段出现。
patterns.domain: 口语、励志文案、对话及博客

patterns.name: 完成时疑问中的 have
patterns.trigger: «have»10 you searched、«have»10 they really never、«have»10 a good week
patterns.context: have 位于句首或疑问结构中时明显激活；前两处为现在完成时疑问，另有告别语中的 have。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、说明性文字及邮件

patterns.name: 自我指称与反身表达
patterns.context: 出现 self 或 myself 的自我指称表达；但激活并不总落在完整词上。
patterns.domain: 论坛文字、励志文案、商务邮件

patterns.name: 问句中的疑问词
patterns.context: 疑问词引出直接问句，常见于对话或反问；仅少量出现。

patterns.name: 一般问句助动词 am
patterns.context: am 与主语 I 构成疑问句中的倒装结构。

patterns.name: 陈述/指令中的 Be
patterns.context: 句首祈使式 Be，后接身份或自我表达。

patterns.name: 片段边界及多义词残余
patterns.context: 格式标记、数学符号、换行或词内片段被标记；没有稳定的句法或语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛抓取文本、问答排版及符号混杂文本

en.description: Strongly responds to do, tell, and have in reader-directed questions or instructions: these are used respectively as a question auxiliary, a request for information, and in perfect-tense questions. Other scattered, low-intensity markers are difficult to group into a unified syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Do in questions
patterns.context: The auxiliary do occurs in a question, followed by a subject and a verb or predicate; the subject may be you, I, or a noun phrase
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, technical discussions, general conversation

patterns.name: Tell in requests or instructions
patterns.context: tell is used as an imperative or request asking the other person to inform or relay something; it sometimes takes an object such as me
patterns.domain: Q&A, online discussions, advice or instructions

patterns.name: Have in questions
patterns.context: have functions as an auxiliary before the subject, forming a present perfect question

patterns.name: Other scattered marked words
patterns.context: These words occur in different syntactic positions and show no stable common trigger condition; compared with the strong activations on do, tell, and have, some markers are weaker
patterns.domain: Miscellaneous domains, including technical text, Q&A, and everyday narratives

3_2342.concept: 面向读者的提问与指令
3_2342.description: 主要对面向读者的疑问或指令中的 do、tell、have 高度响应：分别用于疑问助动、请求告知和完成时疑问；另有多种零散低强度标记，难归为统一句法模式。

patterns.name: 疑问句中的 do
patterns.context: 助动词 do 位于疑问句中，后接主语并引出动词或谓语；主语可为 you、I 或名词短语
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、技术讨论、一般对话

patterns.name: 请求或指令中的 tell
patterns.context: tell 用作祈使或请求，要求对方告知、转述某事；有时带 me 等宾语
patterns.domain: 问答、网络讨论、建议或指令

patterns.name: 疑问句中的 have
patterns.context: have 作助动词置于主语前，构成现在完成时疑问句

patterns.name: 其他被标记的零散词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在不同的句法位置，未显示稳定的共同触发条件；相较 do、tell、have 的高激活，部分标记强度较低
patterns.domain: 跨领域杂项，包括技术文本、问答与日常叙述

en.description: The most prominent pattern is conversational imperatives, requests, and questions, especially tell; there are also sporadic responses to do, remember, interrogative words, and various word fragments across forum, Q&A, health, and education texts.

patterns.name: tell as imperative or request
patterns.context: In a request, suggestion, or instruction, tell introduces what or whom to address; also includes quoted requests made of others.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, web discussions, technical advice, and customer communication

patterns.name: Auxiliary do in conversation
patterns.context: In questions or suggestions, do combines with you to form a question; there is also the phrase do a test.
patterns.domain: Forum chat, health advice, real-estate discussions

patterns.name: Reminders and remembering
patterns.context: Readers are asked to remember a fact or follow advice; Keep appears as a standalone instruction.
patterns.domain: Social media comments, educational advice, health advice

patterns.name: Questions and requests for opinions
patterns.context: Questions ask why or solicit specific information, or Many introduces a group statement; trigger words are scattered.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, forum discussions, educational explanations

patterns.name: Word-internal or word-final fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on part of a word or phrase, with no unified syntactic function.
patterns.domain: Forums, social media, education, health, and customer communication

patterns.name: Sporadic referential and modal words
patterns.context: These words each activate in different sentences, with no shared local collocation or clear pragmatic condition.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, technical Q&A, customer communication, real-estate discussions, etc.

3_2342.description: 最显著的模式是对话式祈使、请求和提问，尤其 tell；此外零散响应 do、remember、疑问词及不同词语片段，跨论坛、问答、健康和教育文本。

patterns.name: tell 作祈使或请求
patterns.context: 在请求、建议或指示中用 tell 引出要说的内容或对象；也包括引述对他人的要求。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、网页讨论、技术建议与客户沟通

patterns.name: 对话中的 do 助动词
patterns.context: 在提问或建议中，do 与 you 构成疑问；另有 do a test 的搭配。
patterns.domain: 论坛闲聊、健康建议、地产讨论

patterns.name: 提醒与记住
patterns.context: 要求读者记住事实或遵循建议；Keep 是单独出现的指示语。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体评论、教育建议、健康建议

patterns.name: 疑问与征求意见
patterns.context: 疑问句中询问原因、征求具体内容，或以 Many 引入群体陈述；触发词分布零散。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、论坛讨论、教育说明

patterns.name: 词内或词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词或短语的一部分，未显示统一句法功能。
patterns.domain: 论坛、社交媒体、教育、健康与客户沟通

patterns.name: 零散的指代与情态词
patterns.context: 这些词各自在不同句子中激活，缺乏共同的局部搭配或明确语用条件。
patterns.domain: 产品评论、技术问答、客户沟通、地产讨论等

en.concept: Expressions for instructions and information requests
en.description: The most stable pattern is tell followed by an object and the question or information requested, used to ask for an explanation or to relay a message. Other activations include several get constructions, remember that reminders, do questions, and an email instruction to click and update; their grammatical functions are not uniform.

patterns.name: Tell introducing a request or instruction
patterns.context: Used when asking someone to provide information, explain a situation, or relay advice; usually an imperative or direct conversation
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, technical discussions, advice text

patterns.name: Get meaning obtain, get rid of, or arrange
patterns.context: get is followed by different types of objects or complements, expressing obtaining something, getting rid of something, or completing an arrangement
patterns.domain: Marketing emails, financial discussions, application advice

patterns.name: Remember that reminder
patterns.context: An imperative reminder followed by an explanation of a general situation

patterns.name: Do in general questions
patterns.context: do occurs at the beginning of a question asking whether a trader can get a better deal

patterns.name: Clicking and profile updates in emails
patterns.context: Prompts the recipient to click a page control and update their profile; the same passage also contains “e-mail notification”

3_2342.description: 最稳定的模式是 tell 后接对象及问题或信息内容，用于请求说明或传话。其余激活包括多种 get 构式、remember that 提醒、do 疑问句，以及邮件中的点击更新指示，语法功能并不统一。

patterns.name: tell 引出请求或指示
patterns.trigger: «tell»10，常见形式有“tell me”“tell us”“tell the client”，以及后接“what/which”或内容
patterns.context: 在请求他人提供信息、说明情况或传达建议时；多为祈使句或直接对话
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、技术讨论、建议类文字

patterns.name: get 表示取得、摆脱或办妥
patterns.trigger: «get»10：“get Netclub/Lucky Fares”“get rid of”“get your letters done”
patterns.context: get 后接不同类型的宾语或补语，分别表示获得、摆脱某物或完成安排
patterns.domain: 营销邮件、金融讨论、申请建议

patterns.name: remember that 提醒
patterns.context: 祈使式提醒，后接对一般情况的说明

patterns.name: do 用于一般疑问句
patterns.context: do 位于疑问句开头，询问交易者是否能获得更好的交易

patterns.name: 邮件中的点击与资料更新
patterns.context: 提示收件人点击页面控件并更新个人资料；同段另有“e-mail notification”

en.concept: Requests and instructions directed at others
en.description: Responds mainly to instructions, requests, or suggestions directed at others, especially tell (inform, explain), and also imperative or interrogative structures such as do/don't; there are sporadic expressions of action or requests such as remember, start, help, and could, along with scattered word fragments that do not fit a unified pattern.

patterns.name: tell introducing information or explanation
patterns.context: In an imperative or request, asks the other person to inform, explain, or give feedback, often with a personal-object pronoun; may also introduce content such as “the truth”.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, technical discussions, emails, or comments

patterns.name: do / don't forming requests or suggestions
patterns.context: Auxiliary or imperative structures express suggestions, polite requests, or questions; the specific meaning varies by sentence.

patterns.name: remember introducing a reminder
patterns.context: Reminds readers to remember a following general statement.

patterns.name: start introducing an action
patterns.context: An imperative suggests beginning to speak or taking action.

patterns.name: help requesting assistance
patterns.context: Directly asks for help, combining with “Please” and “us” to form a polite request.

patterns.name: could in questions
patterns.context: Begins with could you, politely asking whether the other person can discuss something.

patterns.name: Ordinary word fragments in common phrases
patterns.context: Occurs in the different local contexts “reating”, “exaggerate”, “those things”, “Just remember”, “what to do”, “your cellForRowAtIndexPath”, “empty modal”, “load function”, and “aligning this data”; no unified semantic or syntactic trigger is evident.

3_2342.concept: 面向他人的请求与指令表达
3_2342.description: 主要响应面向他人的指令、请求或建议，尤其是 tell（告知、解释），也包括 do/don't 等祈使或疑问结构；另有 remember、start、help、could 等零散行动或请求表达，以及若干分散词片段，无法归入统一模式。

patterns.name: tell 引出告知或说明
patterns.context: 祈使句或请求中要求对方告知、解释、给出反馈，常带人称宾语；也可接“the truth”等内容。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、技术讨论、邮件或评论

patterns.name: do / don't 组成请求或建议
patterns.trigger: «do»，包括 «Don't do it»、«do not hesitate»、«do I still care»
patterns.context: 助动词或祈使结构中表达建议、礼貌请求，或提出疑问；具体语义随句子变化。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、技术讨论、评论

patterns.name: remember 引出提醒
patterns.context: 提醒读者记住后续的一般性陈述。

patterns.name: start 引出开始行动
patterns.context: 祈使句中建议开始说话或采取行动。

patterns.name: help 请求协助
patterns.context: 直接请求帮助，且与“Please”及“us”构成礼貌请求。

patterns.name: 问句中的 could
patterns.context: 以 could you 开头，礼貌询问对方是否能谈论某事。

patterns.name: 常见短语中的普通词片段
patterns.context: 分别处于“reating”“exaggerate”“those things”“Just remember”“what to do”“your cellForRowAtIndexPath”“empty modal”“load function”“aligning this data”等不同局部语境，未见统一的语义或句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、评论、一般文章

en.description: Primarily responds to verbs in reader-directed instructions, suggestions, or calls to action; also commonly appears in contexts asking others to inform, explain, or provide feedback. One other example triggers “Relax” and “Pamper” in gift promotions.

patterns.name: Requests to inform or explain
patterns.context: Appears when asking questions, inviting feedback, or requesting clarification; often near an imperative or question, sometimes followed by me and sometimes by a specific object.

patterns.name: Advisory or directive verbs
patterns.context: Reader-directed suggestions, warnings, or calls to action, often in imperative sentences; the trigger words are not all the same.
patterns.domain: Forum advice, product promotions, instructional text, email

patterns.name: Gift and relaxation-care words
patterns.context: Appears in gift ideas or gift-basket promotional copy; an isolated lexical cue not found in other segments.

3_2342.description: 主要对面向读者的指令、建议或行动号召中的动词起反应，也常见于请求别人告知、解释或提供反馈的语境；另有一例触发礼品宣传中的 Relax、Pamper。

patterns.name: 请求告知或解释
patterns.context: 在提问、邀请反馈或请求说明时出现；常位于祈使句或疑问句附近，有时接 me，有时接具体对象。

patterns.name: 劝告或指示性动词
patterns.context: 面向读者的建议、警告或行动号召，常用祈使句；触发词并不都相同。
patterns.domain: 论坛建议、产品宣传、说明文字、邮件

patterns.name: 礼品与放松护理词语
patterns.context: 出现在礼品创意或礼篮宣传语中；是孤立的词汇线索，不见于其他段。

en.concept: Instructions and interactive expressions directed at readers
en.description: Activations often fall on verbs and collocations that instruct or remind readers, such as tell, remember, look, and do/don't; there are also interrogative structures, advertising calls to action, try suggestions, and right rhetorical questions, in varied contexts.

patterns.name: Asking or suggesting that someone speak up
patterns.context: Directly asks the other person in conversation to provide information, express an opinion, or inform someone; may be imperative or occur in a conditional sentence.
patterns.domain: Q&A, forum dialogue, emails, and persuasive writing

patterns.name: “Remember” with an object
patterns.context: Reminds readers to remember a fact or previously mentioned situation.

patterns.name: look-related expressions
patterns.context: Asks someone to view, notice, or observe; the specific meaning depends on the collocation and context.

patterns.name: Imperative do/don't
patterns.context: Prohibits or advises against an action, or discusses something to do.

patterns.name: Auxiliaries/interrogative words in questions
patterns.context: Asks a question or expresses a conjecture, appearing sentence-initially or in interrogative structures; no clear shared collocation with other patterns.

patterns.name: Call-to-action phrases in social marketing
patterns.context: Addresses consumers with imperatives encouraging them to visit a store, shop, or follow a social account.

patterns.name: Suggestions introduced by try
patterns.context: Suggests that readers try a subsequent action; one instance asks them to check a situation, another asks someone else to take action.

patterns.name: right rhetorical question in a transaction
patterns.context: Uses a rhetorical question to introduce a correction to a profit calculation.

3_2342.concept: 面向读者的指令与互动表达
3_2342.description: 激活常落在对读者发出指令或提醒的动词及其搭配上，如 tell、remember、look、do/don't；另有疑问结构、广告号召、try 建议及 right 反问，语境分散。

patterns.name: 请求或建议对方说出来
patterns.context: 对话中直接要求对方提供信息、表达观点或告知他人；可带祈使语气，也可出现在条件句中。
patterns.domain: 问答、论坛对话、邮件及劝说性文字

patterns.name: 带宾语的「记住」
patterns.trigger: «remember» «that»；或 «remember» 后接省略问号的提醒语境
patterns.context: 提醒读者记住一个事实或先前提到的情况。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体营销、财经解释

patterns.name: look 相关表达
patterns.context: 要求查看、留意或观察；具体含义由搭配和上下文决定。
patterns.domain: 邮件、论坛讨论、网络问答

patterns.name: 祈使式的 do/don't
patterns.context: 禁止或劝告某种做法，或谈论要做的事。

patterns.name: 疑问句中的助动词/疑问词
patterns.context: 提出疑问或推测，分布于句首或疑问结构中；与其他模式没有明显共同搭配。

patterns.name: 社交营销中的号召性短语
patterns.context: 面向消费者，以祈使句号召访问商店、购物或关注社交账号。

patterns.name: try 引出的建议
patterns.context: 建议读者尝试后续动作；一处是检查情况，一处是让别人采取行动。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的格言式建议、评论性文字

patterns.name: 交易中的 right 反问
patterns.context: 用反问引出对利润计算的纠正。

en.description: Activation is distributed across various conversational and imperative expressions, especially “Just remember that” and requests for someone to “tell”; there are also the ending of “relax,” action imperatives, and several sporadic subword fragments, with no consistent semantic pattern overall.

patterns.name: “remember that” reminder construction
patterns.context: Uses remember that in an imperative to introduce a reminder or suggestion; surrounding text discusses attitudes to life or theoretical models.

patterns.name: Asking someone to tell you
patterns.context: Directly asks the conversation partner to explain or express something; tell is followed by me or it, in a Q&A or invitation-to-speak context.

patterns.name: “Just remember” life advice
patterns.context: Begins with Just remember to introduce a reader-directed reminder; [1] is followed by a that-clause, while [3] is followed by a comma and direct advice.

patterns.name: Relax lexical item
patterns.context: ax is the ending of relax; [5] appears in promotional gift copy, while [8] appears in a list of song titles.

patterns.name: Imperative phrases with direction or action
patterns.context: Activation falls on the action word or phrase in an imperative; the continuations respectively describe looking back, going to a store, and avoiding rash actions.
patterns.domain: Email advice, e-commerce promotions, design discussions

patterns.name: Generalized or sporadic low-intensity activation
patterns.context: These words occur in ordinary syntax or as within-word fragments; this segment alone does not reveal a clear condition shared with the other triggers.
patterns.domain: Life advice, forum discussions, e-commerce promotions, WordPress design discussions

3_2342.description: 激活分布在多种对话和祈使表达中：尤其是“Just remember that”和请求对方“tell”；另有relax词尾、动作祈使及若干零散词片段，整体缺少统一语义模式。

patterns.name: “remember that”提醒句式
patterns.context: 祈使句中用 remember that 引出提醒或建议；周围讨论生活态度或理论模型。

patterns.name: 请求对方告诉自己
patterns.context: 直接向对话对象请求说明或表达；tell 后接 me 或 it，语境是问答或邀请发言。

patterns.name: “Just remember”人生劝告
patterns.context: 句首以 Just remember 引出面向读者的提醒；[1]后接 that 从句，[3]后接逗号和直接劝告。
patterns.domain: 面向公众的励志或生活建议

patterns.name: Relax词项
patterns.context: ax 是 relax 的词尾；[5]处于商品礼品宣传语，[8]处于歌曲名列表。

patterns.name: 带方向或动作的祈使语块
patterns.context: 激活落在祈使句的动作词或短语部分，后续分别为回头观察、前往商店、避免草率做事。
patterns.domain: 邮件建议、电商宣传、设计讨论

patterns.name: 泛化或零散的低强度激活
patterns.context: 这些词出现在普通句法或词内片段中，单凭该段看不出与其他触发项共享的明确条件。
patterns.domain: 生活建议、论坛讨论、电商宣传、WordPress设计讨论

en.description: Activation is distributed across various imperatives, suggestions, and operational prompts, especially action words such as tell, follow, and get. It also covers local words in aphorisms, event copy, and step-by-step instructions, without a single stable trigger word.

patterns.name: Follow-up action instructions in imperatives
patterns.context: Directly commands or encourages readers or users to take action; the second-person subject is often omitted.
patterns.domain: Marketing copy, event announcements, website guidance, forum quotations

patterns.name: Tell for informing or requesting help
patterns.context: tell is followed by an addressee or content; often used to invite further information, suggest informing someone, or prompt someone to share a story.

patterns.name: Suggestions or instructions with try
patterns.context: try introduces an action to try; this example occurs in an aphoristic context about influence.
patterns.domain: Aphorisms or humorous text forwarded by email

patterns.name: Following or operational guidance introduced by follow
patterns.context: follow is followed by a social media account, instructions, or steps, prompting readers to follow or act according to guidance.

patterns.name: Co-occurrence of locally strong activation tokens
patterns.context: The strong activation marked in this segment is on Don’t, not on the following tell; it appears in a warning against a particular technical practice.

patterns.name: Co-occurrence of locally strong activation tokens
patterns.context: The markers fall on don’t ask and get, in an aphoristic advisory structure.

patterns.name: Time phrase
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence looking back on the previous year’s event.

patterns.name: Checking or confirming
patterns.context: Introduces the purpose of confirming something after take a look back.

patterns.name: Step-heading verb
patterns.context: At the start of a step list in a document describing how to reproduce a technical issue.

3_2342.description: 激活分散在多种祈使、建议及操作引导表达中，尤其是 tell、follow 和 get 等动作词；也覆盖格言、活动文案及步骤说明中的局部词语，未显示单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 祈使句中的后续动作指令
patterns.trigger: "Head over to"、"go get"、"get ready"、"join"、"be sure to check out"、"Just get on"
patterns.context: 面向读者或用户，直接命令或鼓励其采取行动；常见第二人称省略主语
patterns.domain: 营销文案、活动通知、网站引导、论坛引语

patterns.name: 告知或求助式的 tell
patterns.context: tell 后接受话者或内容，常用于邀请补充信息、建议告知某人或号召讲述

patterns.name: 带 try 的建议或指令
patterns.context: try 引出建议尝试的动作；本例位于关于影响力的格言式语境
patterns.domain: 邮件转发的格言或幽默文字

patterns.name: follow 引出的关注或操作指引
patterns.trigger: "follow us"、"follow the following instructions"、"follow these steps"
patterns.context: follow 后接社交账号、说明或步骤，提示读者关注或按指引操作

patterns.name: 局部强激活 token 的共现
patterns.context: 本段标出的强激活集中在 Don’t，而非后续 tell；出现在针对某项技术实践的劝阻中

patterns.name: 局部强激活 token 的共现
patterns.context: 标记落在 don’t ask 与 get，处于格言式比喻的劝告结构中

patterns.name: 时间短语
patterns.context: 位于回顾上年活动的句首

patterns.name: 检查或确认
patterns.context: take a look back 后引出确认某事的目的

patterns.name: 步骤标题式动词
patterns.context: 说明文档步骤列表的开头

en.concept: Instructions and calls to action directed at readers
en.description: Responds mainly to direct speech acts directed at readers: tell requests information, imperatives offer advice or instructions, and web copy calls for action; two word-internal fragments also activate, but the pattern is weak.

patterns.name: Asking someone to tell
patterns.context: In an imperative or interrogative context, asks the other person to tell, explain, or provide information; also occurs in “tell ... that”.

patterns.name: Imperative suggestions or instructions
patterns.context: Direct advice, reminders, operating instructions, or negative commands directed at readers.
patterns.domain: Forums, web help text, social media comments

patterns.name: Calls to action and marketing instructions
patterns.context: Uses second-person or subjectless imperatives to prompt readers to visit, buy, follow, or join.

patterns.name: Short suffixes embedded in ordinary words
patterns.context: Activation falls only on letter fragments within words, not on complete imperative expressions; no clear shared syntactic condition.

3_2342.concept: 面向读者的指令与号召
3_2342.description: 主要响应面向读者的直接言语行为：tell 请求信息，祈使句给建议或指令，网页文案中号召采取行动；另有两个词内片段激活，规律较弱。

patterns.name: 请求对方告知
patterns.context: 祈使句或疑问语境中，要求对方讲述、解释或提供信息；也见“tell ... that”

patterns.name: 祈使式建议或指令
patterns.context: 面向读者的直接建议、提醒、操作指引或否定命令
patterns.domain: 论坛、网页帮助文本、社交媒体评论

patterns.name: 行动号召与营销指令
patterns.context: 以第二人称或省略主语的祈使句，推动读者访问、购买、关注或加入

patterns.name: 普通词中嵌入的短后缀
patterns.context: 激活只落在词内的字母片段，而非完整祈使表达；无明显共同句法条件
patterns.domain: 网页讨论、社交媒体文字

en.description: Primarily responds to communicative verbs in imperative or advisory contexts: tell (inform, recount) and try (attempt); it also activates on the social media call to action follow us. Common in direct reader-facing instructions.

patterns.name: tell me: requesting an explanation or more information
patterns.context: tell is followed by me to ask someone to explain a view, information, or an idea; it can also be tell someone something. Activation is concentrated in imperative or advisory contexts.

patterns.name: try: suggesting an attempt
patterns.context: try is used as an imperative or suggestion, followed by a gerund, noun phrase, or place/link, prompting readers to try an action, product, or resource.
patterns.domain: Technical advice, humorous admonitions, consumer and health articles, online Q&A

patterns.name: follow us: social media prompt
patterns.context: follow us is followed by a social platform name, calling on readers to follow the account.

patterns.name: tell it: encouraging someone to share
patterns.context: tell it encourages readers to share a story; it is immediately followed by Start talking here, which explains how to participate.

3_2342.description: 主要响应祈使或建议语境中的交际动词：tell（告知、讲述）与 try（尝试）；另对社交媒体号召 follow us 有激活。常见于面向读者的直接指令。

patterns.name: tell me：请求解释或补充
patterns.context: tell 后接 me，要求对方说明观点、信息或想法；也可直接 tell 某人某事。激活集中于祈使句或建议语境。

patterns.name: try：建议尝试
patterns.trigger: «try»10 using（段 4）、«try»10 orderin'（段 5）、«try»9 the Chocolate（段 8）、«try»9«supplement»ing（段 9）、«try»9«here»（段 10）
patterns.context: try 用作祈使或建议，后接动名词、名词短语或地点/链接，提示读者尝试某种操作、产品或资源。
patterns.domain: 技术建议、幽默劝告、消费与健康文章、网络问答

patterns.name: follow us：社交媒体引导
patterns.context: follow us 后接社交平台名称，号召读者关注账号。
patterns.domain: 智能家居商店宣传文案

patterns.name: tell it：鼓励讲述
patterns.context: tell it 指鼓励读者讲出故事；紧接着用 Start talking here 说明参与方式。

en.description: Activation centers on reader-directed imperative instructions and action guidance: asking readers to try, answer, or tell, and guiding them to view a page, visit, follow, join, shop, or contact. It commonly appears in conversations, advice, and website prompts.

patterns.name: Imperative suggestions or attempts
patterns.context: Direct suggestions, operational instructions, or cautions directed at readers, often followed by a verb phrase or location guidance.

patterns.name: Asking someone to say or explain something
patterns.context: Imperatives asking someone to answer, recount, or inform another person.

patterns.name: Guiding someone to start expressing themselves
patterns.context: Encourages someone to start recounting or participating in expression, with a reader-directed guiding tone.

patterns.name: Guiding users to visit or use website content
patterns.context: An imperative suggestion to new visitors to make sure they look at page content.
patterns.domain: Website welcome messages, community help text

patterns.name: Prompts to visit, follow, or join
patterns.context: Imperatively directs readers to go somewhere, shop, follow, join, or get in touch.

patterns.name: General action instructions in imperatives
patterns.context: Directly asks or advises readers to take a specific action; apart from the imperative tone, there is no more specialized shared meaning.

3_2342.concept: 面向读者的祈使式行动引导
3_2342.description: 激活集中于面向读者的祈使式指令与行动引导：要求尝试、回答或讲述，也用于引导查看页面、访问、关注、加入、购物和联系；多出现在对话、建议及网站提示中。

patterns.name: 祈使式建议或尝试
patterns.context: 面向读者的直接建议、操作指令或劝阻，常接动词短语或地点指引
patterns.domain: 邮件、技术讨论、论坛评论

patterns.name: 要求对方说出或说明
patterns.context: 祈使句中要求对方回答、讲述或告知某人信息

patterns.name: 引导对方开始表达
patterns.context: 鼓励对方开始讲述或参与表达，带有面向读者的指引语气

patterns.name: 引导访问或使用网站内容
patterns.context: 面向新访客，以“务必去看看”的祈使式建议引导查看页面内容
patterns.domain: 网站欢迎语、社区帮助文本

patterns.name: 促请访问、关注或加入
patterns.context: 以祈使语气引导读者前往、购物、关注、加入或联系
patterns.domain: 营销文案、社区注册提示

patterns.name: 祈使句中的一般行动指令
patterns.context: 直接要求或建议读者采取具体行动；除祈使语气外，没有更专门的共同语义

en.description: Primarily responds to reader-directed action instructions or suggestions, especially those beginning with an imperative verb; it also covers step-by-step webpage operations, invitations to participate, and calls to get in touch. Some activations fall on phrases, proper nouns, or within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Imperative suggestions or calls to action
patterns.context: Uses an imperative or direct instruction to prompt readers to act, often beginning with a verb followed by an object, location, or complement; includes both ordinary suggestions and promotional calls to action.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, blogs, advertising, and instructions

patterns.name: Step-by-step instructions
patterns.context: Procedural instructions for users, listing actions such as uploading, submitting, previewing, or viewing.
patterns.domain: Web event instructions, community help copy

patterns.name: Direct calls for audience participation or contact
patterns.context: Promotional or service copy directly addresses readers and invites them to join, contact, or follow.
patterns.domain: Website promotions, community sign-up, social media campaigns

patterns.name: Local word fragments that do not fit the main pattern
patterns.context: Only local strong activation is present and may not form a complete imperative; it may involve a phrasal verb, a within-word fragment, or a heading/proper noun, with insufficient evidence to classify it as a unified semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Mixed: aphorisms, web content, forum posts

3_2342.description: 主要响应面向读者的行动指令或建议，尤以祈使动词开头；也覆盖网页分步操作、邀请参与和联系等号召。个别激活落在短语、专名或词内片段上。

patterns.name: 命令式建议或行动号召
patterns.trigger: «tell»10« it»1.« Start»6 talking；«tell»10« me»3；«try»9；«Head»6« over»4« to»5；«Give»9« me»5« a»3« call»3
patterns.context: 以祈使句或直接指示读者采取行动，常在动词开头，后接宾语、地点或补语；既有普通建议，也有宣传式号召。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、博客、广告及操作说明

patterns.name: 分步操作说明
patterns.trigger: «U»1«pload»5« a»2 photo；«Sub»2«mit»9 and« preview»3« your»3 photo；«be»9« sure»6« to»5↵«check»3« out»6

patterns.name: 直接呼吁受众参与或联系
patterns.context: 营销或服务文案直接称呼读者，邀请加入、联系或关注。
patterns.domain: 网站宣传、社区注册与社交媒体推广

patterns.name: 不符合主模式的局部词片段

patterns.domain: 混合：格言、网页内容、论坛发言

en.description: Primarily sensitive to imperative action suggestions and verbs in direct instructions, such as try, check out, focus, and identify; also responds to tell + pronoun/object and calls to action in website promotions.

patterns.name: Instruction or imperative suggestion
patterns.context: Guides readers to take action through an imperative or advisory tone, often followed by a condition, explanation, or emphasis; no fixed domain is required.
patterns.domain: Web promotions, emails, forum discussions, product reviews, and technical advice

patterns.name: tell followed by an addressee or pronoun
patterns.context: tell functions as a suggestion or request and takes objects such as it or me; often occurs in conversational, argumentative, or advisory contexts.

patterns.name: Calls to action directed at readers
patterns.context: Directly addresses readers and encourages them to visit a store, join a community, or follow an account, usually in a marketing or website-navigation tone.

3_2342.description: 主要对祈使式行动建议和直接指令中的动词敏感，如 try、check out、focus、identify；也响应 tell + 代词/宾语及网站宣传中的行动号召。

patterns.name: 指示或命令式建议
patterns.context: 以祈使句或建议语气指导读者采取行动，常跟随条件、解释或强调；不要求固定领域。
patterns.domain: 网页宣传、邮件、论坛讨论、产品评论与技术建议

patterns.name: tell 后接受话者或代词
patterns.context: tell 用作建议或要求，后接 it、me 等宾语；常处在对话、论辩或劝告语境。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、评论、政治论述

patterns.name: 面向读者的行动号召
patterns.context: 直接向读者招呼，鼓励访问商店、加入社区或关注账号，通常带有营销或网站引导语气。

en.description: Activation primarily falls on reader-directed imperatives or calls to action, especially structures such as try, tell, and be sure to that guide specific actions, expression, or participation; it also includes a few other instructions and colloquial constructions.

patterns.name: Imperative action suggestions
patterns.context: In imperatives suggesting or calling on readers to take a specific action; common structures include “try + action/object,” “head over to,” and “follow us.”
patterns.domain: Marketing copy, product suggestions, life advice

patterns.name: Instructing readers to express themselves or participate

patterns.name: Fixed prompt be sure to
patterns.context: Uses be sure to to introduce a suggestion or reminder to readers to complete a subsequent action.
patterns.domain: Website help prompts, sports or entertainment promotions

patterns.name: Other calls to action
patterns.context: Directly invites readers to join a community or contact website support if they encounter problems; activation occurs in sign-up and help prompts.
patterns.domain: Website registration and customer support copy

patterns.name: Other phrase combinations
patterns.context: Appears in a colloquial conditional sentence about trying to order others around after thinking oneself influential; it does not fully match the specific trigger structures in other segments.

3_2342.description: 激活主要落在面向读者的祈使或行动号召上，尤其是 try、tell、be sure to 等引导具体操作、表达或参与的结构；也包括少量其他指令和口语化搭配。

patterns.name: 祈使式行动建议

patterns.domain: 营销文案、产品建议、生活建议

patterns.name: 指令读者表达或参与
patterns.context: 面向读者提出说出观点、讲述经历或开始发言的直接指令。
patterns.domain: 邮件评论、论坛对话、观点讨论

patterns.name: 固定提示 be sure to

patterns.name: 其他行动号召
patterns.context: 直接邀请加入社区，或在遇到问题时联系网站支持；激活分布在注册与求助提示中。

patterns.name: 其他短语搭配
patterns.context: 出现在口语化的条件句中，涉及自以为有影响力后尝试指使他人；与其他段落的具体触发结构不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 口语化邮件、讽刺性表达

en.description: Primarily activates on instructions, requests, and advisory expressions directed at readers or conversation partners, commonly imperative verbs such as tell, head, check, take, try, and use; it also appears in webpage copy guiding users through next steps.

patterns.name: Imperative tell instructions
patterns.context: tell is followed by me or a personal-object pronoun and asks the other person to explain, clarify, or recount something; also includes variants such as tell it and tell them.
patterns.domain: Conversation, forum Q&A, email, or instructional text

patterns.name: Imperative operational guidance
patterns.context: Direct instructions to readers, often beginning with an imperative verb, that specify the next action, where to go, or what to view.

patterns.name: Advisory or commanding actions
patterns.context: Directly makes a suggestion, request, or prohibition to readers; includes imperative verbs and the subsequent action phrase.

3_2342.description: 主要对面向读者或对话对象的指令、请求和建议性表达激活，常见祈使动词 tell、head、check、take、try、use 等；也出现在引导下一步操作的网页文案中。

patterns.name: 祈使式 tell 指令
patterns.context: tell 后接 me 或人称宾语，并要求对方说明、解释或讲述；也包括 tell it、tell them 等变体。
patterns.domain: 对话、论坛问答、邮件或指导性文本

patterns.name: 祈使式操作指导
patterns.context: 面向读者的直接指令，常由祈使动词开头，告知下一步操作、访问地点或查看内容。
patterns.domain: 网页营销、教程、产品说明

patterns.name: 建议或命令式动作
patterns.context: 直接向读者提出建议、要求或禁止；包含祈使动词及其后续动作短语。
patterns.domain: 邮件、论坛评论、建议性文本

en.description: Most strong activations fall on imperative or advisory verbs directed at others, especially tell, try, choose, and follow; it also covers negative instructions and a few ordinary verbs, within-word fragments in headings, and adjacent sporadic tokens.

patterns.name: Requesting someone to inform you
patterns.context: In imperative or conditional expressions, asks someone to tell the speaker something; followed by a question, explanation, or editing request.

patterns.name: Encouraging expression or storytelling
patterns.context: Uses an imperative or advisory tone to ask someone to tell a story or inform a client; the object may be story content or a third party.

patterns.name: Imperative suggestions/action instructions
patterns.context: Makes a suggestion, gives an instruction, or promotes an action to readers or conversation partners; often an initial imperative structure, with an object or location following the verb.
patterns.domain: Email, technical articles, commercial websites, social media discussions

patterns.name: Negative imperative instructions
patterns.context: Uses a negative imperative to discourage an action, followed by a reason or suggestion.

patterns.name: Prompt verb embedded in an ordinary statement
patterns.context: A within-word fragment of an ordinary verb is activated in a non-imperative context, with no clear connection to requests or instructions.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments and heading format
patterns.context: Within-word fragments in heading- or list-style social media content rather than complete imperative sentences; activation falls on segmented word parts.

patterns.name: Sporadic markers on non-target words
patterns.context: Adjacent to surrounding imperative or request structures, or part of within-word fragments; does not constitute a stable independent pattern.

3_2342.description: 多数强激活落在面向他人的祈使或建议动词上，尤其 tell、try、choose、follow 等；也覆盖否定指令及少量普通动词、标题词内片段和相邻零散 token。

patterns.name: 请求对方告知
patterns.context: 祈使式或条件式表达中，要求对方告诉说话者某件事；后接问题、说明或编辑请求。
patterns.domain: 邮件、问答论坛、技术讨论

patterns.name: 鼓励表达或讲述
patterns.context: 用祈使或建议语气要求讲述故事、告知客户；对象可为故事内容或第三方。

patterns.name: 祈使式建议/行动指令
patterns.context: 面向读者或对话对象提出建议、指示或促销行动；常为句首祈使结构，动词后可带宾语或地点。
patterns.domain: 邮件、技术文章、商业网页、社交媒体讨论

patterns.name: 祈使式否定指令
patterns.context: 以否定祈使句劝阻某种做法，后续补充理由或建议。

patterns.name: 嵌入普通陈述中的提示动词
patterns.context: 非祈使语境中，普通动词的词内片段被激活，语义与请求或指令无明显联系。

patterns.name: 词内片段与标题格式
patterns.context: 标题或列表式社交媒体内容中的词内片段，而非完整祈使句；激活落在被切分的词段上。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体营销写作建议

patterns.name: 非目标词的零散标记
patterns.context: 与周围祈使、请求结构相邻，或属于词内片段；不构成稳定独立模式。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、论坛、网页文本

en.concept: Imperative instructions and calls to action
en.description: The shared pattern is instructional verbs and imperative phrases, often directly asking readers to tell, start, choose, view, join, or carry out a suggestion; it spans forums, emails, commercial advice, and marketing copy, with varied forms and contexts.

patterns.name: Imperative tell me / tell it
patterns.context: A direct instruction beginning with tell, asking the other person to tell the speaker something or narrate content; nearby text often involves conversation, questions, or invitations to speak.

patterns.name: Imperative suggestions and calls to action
patterns.context: An infinitive-form verb or be sure to introduces advice, steps, or promotional actions directed at readers; activation is concentrated on the instructional verb or phrase.
patterns.domain: Web marketing copy, social media advice, admonitions in emails

patterns.name: Imperative start
patterns.context: Encourages the audience to start speaking or taking action, following a direct call to action.

patterns.name: Imperative compete
patterns.context: A positive or negative imperative asks readers not to compete on price, but instead to emphasize value.

patterns.name: Imperative identify
patterns.context: Business advice asks readers to identify a target customer group; activation falls on a verb spanning subword fragments.

3_2342.description: 共同模式是指令性动词及祈使短语，常直接要求读者告知、开始、选择、查看、加入或执行建议；覆盖论坛、邮件、商业建议和营销文案，形式与语境多样。

patterns.name: 祈使式 tell me / tell it
patterns.context: 以 tell 开头的直接指令，要求对方告诉说话者或讲述内容；周围常有对话、提问或邀请发言。

patterns.name: 祈使式建议与行动号召
patterns.trigger: « choose»9；« Head»7« over»4« to»5；« follow»9；« take»8« a»3« look»4；« try»9；« Summ»1«ar»1«ize»9；« Prep»3«are»9；« join»7；« be»9« sure»7« to»7«check»3« out»6
patterns.context: 以动词原形或 be sure to 引出面向读者的建议、步骤或促销行动；激活集中在指令动词或指令短语。
patterns.domain: 网页营销文案、社交媒体建议、邮件中的劝告

patterns.name: 祈使式 start
patterns.context: 鼓励受众开始发言或采取行动，位于直接号召之后。

patterns.name: 祈使式 compete
patterns.context: 否定或肯定祈使句，要求不要按价格竞争、转而强调价值。

patterns.name: 祈使式 identify
patterns.context: 在商业建议中要求读者识别目标客户群；激活落在跨分词片段的动词上。

en.description: Primarily responds to reader-directed action instructions and requests to speak or inform using tell+addressee; also includes negative admonitions, advisory questions, discussion of commercial value, a retrospective idiom, and several within-word fragment activations that lack a unified condition.

patterns.name: Imperative operational instructions
patterns.context: A verb at the beginning or within a sentence prompts readers to take action, perform a step, or try something; often accompanied by an object or directional/purpose complement.
patterns.domain: Web marketing, instructional text, advice, and conversation

patterns.name: tell prompting speech or information
patterns.context: tell is followed by a personal pronoun or addressee and asks them to recount, answer, or convey information; common in conversation, Q&A, and instructions.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, email, Q&A, role-playing instructions

patterns.name: Negative imperative sentences
patterns.context: Begins with Don’t and directly discourages or prohibits an action.

patterns.name: Affix or word-form fragments within phrases
patterns.context: Activation falls on local fragments of complete words embedded in narrative or instructions; no unified semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Web copy, game instructions, technical discussions

patterns.name: Non-tell question/admonition structure
patterns.context: why don’t you introduces an advisory question followed by an action suggestion.

patterns.name: Comparison and value discussion
patterns.context: Discusses not simply comparing prices but emphasizing value; activation covers words related to competition and value.

patterns.name: Retrospective idiom
patterns.context: take a look back expresses reviewing or looking back, followed by a context about ensuring the group is still present.

3_2342.description: 主要响应面向读者的行动指令及 tell+受话者的发言/告知要求；另有否定劝告、建议疑问、商业价值论述、回顾习语，以及若干落在词内的片段激活，后者缺乏统一条件。

patterns.name: 祈使式操作指令
patterns.context: 句首或句中以动词引导，要求读者采取行动、执行步骤或尝试某事；常伴随宾语或方向/目的补语。
patterns.domain: 网页营销、说明文、建议和对话

patterns.name: tell 引导发言或告知
patterns.context: tell 后接人称代词或受话者，要求讲述、回答或传达信息；常见于对话、问答及指示语。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、邮件、问答、角色扮演说明

patterns.name: 否定祈使句
patterns.context: 以 Don’t 开头，直接劝阻或禁止某种行为。

patterns.name: 短语内部的词缀/词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词的局部片段上，分别嵌于正文叙述或指令；看不出统一的词义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页文案、游戏说明、技术讨论

patterns.name: 非 tell 的疑问/劝告结构
patterns.context: why don’t you 引出建议性问题，后接行动建议。

patterns.name: 比较与价值论述
patterns.context: 讨论不要单纯比价、应强调价值；激活覆盖竞争和价值相关词。

patterns.name: 回顾性习语
patterns.context: take a look back 构成回顾、回头看的表达，后接确保群体仍在的语境。

en.concept: Instructions and action guidance directed at readers
en.description: Responds mainly to imperatives, suggestions, and action guidance directed at readers, especially tell me/it requests for explanation; also covers negative commands, try suggestions, and website-navigation instructions.

patterns.name: tell me / tell it
patterns.context: An imperative asks the other person to tell, explain, or answer, often taking a pronoun object; “tell me” may also follow a question.
patterns.domain: Forum dialogue, email arguments, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Suggestive or instructional verbs
patterns.context: Imperatives or suggestions directed at readers, especially when the verb appears at the beginning of a sentence or clause.
patterns.domain: Comments, marketing copy, forum guides, technical advice

patterns.name: Negative imperative
patterns.context: Directly discourages an action, followed by an explanation or suggestion.

patterns.name: Operational multiword instructions
patterns.context: Guides readers to go somewhere, view a resource, or take a subsequent action; activation spans multiple words in the phrase.
patterns.domain: Website promotion, forum welcome and help text

patterns.name: try + verb/gerund
patterns.context: try introduces an action suggested for the reader to attempt.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial imperative Start
patterns.context: Encourages readers to begin speaking or acting, appearing at the end of an invitation to converse.

3_2342.concept: 面向读者的指令与行动引导
3_2342.description: 主要响应面向读者的祈使、建议和行动引导，尤以 tell me/it 请求说明最强；也覆盖否定命令、try 建议及网站导航式指令。

patterns.name: tell me / tell it
patterns.context: 祈使句中要求对方讲述、解释或回答，常接代词宾语；也可在提问后接“tell me”
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、邮件论述、技术问答

patterns.name: 建议或指令式动词
patterns.context: 面向读者的祈使或建议，尤其是动词位于句首或从句开头
patterns.domain: 评论、营销文案、论坛指南、技术建议

patterns.name: 否定祈使
patterns.context: 直接劝阻某项做法，后接解释或建议

patterns.name: 操作性多词指令
patterns.context: 引导读者前往某处、查看资源或采取后续操作；激活跨越短语中的多个词
patterns.domain: 网站推广、论坛欢迎与帮助文本

patterns.name: try + 动词/动名词
patterns.context: 以 try 引出建议尝试的动作

patterns.name: 句首命令式 Start
patterns.context: 鼓励读者开始发言或行动，位于对话邀请末尾

en.description: Activations cluster around the polysemous word pitches (musical pitch, throwing, spacing, playing fields), with additional responses to sight in its line-of-sight, view, and visual-navigation uses. The commonality is word form and local semantic collocation, not a single domain.

patterns.name: Pitch/key intervals
patterns.context: Notes or fine intervals occur in musical, acoustic, or measurement contexts
patterns.domain: Music research, cat music, measurement patents

patterns.name: Baseball pitching
patterns.context: pitches refers to throws, surrounded by baseball terms such as batting, reaching base, and innings

patterns.name: Regular spacing/hole positions
patterns.context: pitches refers to the spacing of holes, grating lines, or structural features

patterns.name: Sports playing fields
patterns.context: pitches refers to hockey fields listed among amenities near residences

patterns.name: Line of sight
patterns.context: Astrophysics describes the line of sight from an observer to a quasar and the dust conditions

patterns.name: Visual scene
patterns.context: sight is a noun meaning a view, or appears in a compound meaning navigation by vision
patterns.domain: Piano reporting, archaeology, and navigation instructions

3_2731.concept: 多义词 pitches 与 sight
3_2731.description: 激活集中在多义词 pitches（音高、投球、间距、场地），另响应 sight 的视线、景象及视觉导航用法；共同点是词形与局部语义搭配，而非单一领域。

patterns.name: 音高/琴键音程
patterns.trigger: “repetitive isochronic … eighth notes” “individual pitches”；“sliding notes” “high pitches”；“fine pitches”
patterns.context: 音乐、声音或测量语境中出现音符或精细音程
patterns.domain: 音乐研究、猫音乐、测量专利

patterns.name: 棒球投球
patterns.context: pitches 指投球，周围有击球、上垒、局数等棒球用语

patterns.name: 规则间距/孔位
patterns.trigger: “holes … formed at given positions”；“sizes and pitches”
patterns.context: pitches 指孔、栅线或结构特征的间距

patterns.name: 运动场地
patterns.context: pitches 指曲棍球场地，列举住宅周边设施

patterns.name: 视线通道
patterns.context: 天体物理中描述观测者至类星体的视线及尘埃状况

patterns.name: 视觉景象
patterns.context: sight 作名词表示景象，或作复合词表示依视觉导航
patterns.domain: 钢琴报道、考古与导航说明

en.concept: word senses related to pitch and sight
en.description: Responds to the polysemous word “pitch/pitches”: musical pitch, a baseball pitch, engineering pitch, and sports grounds; also responds to expressions involving “sight,” including line of sight, sights, and visual navigation. Local context distinguishes each sense.

patterns.name: Pitch or interval
patterns.context: In descriptions of music or sound, refers to pitch, notes, melodies, and so on; sometimes listed alongside rhythm and note sequences.

patterns.name: Baseball pitch
patterns.context: In baseball contexts, refers to a thrown ball; often occurs near pitcher, batting, batter, or inning.

patterns.name: Spacing and arrangement
patterns.context: Refers to the spacing or arrangement of holes or fine gratings, or to their pitch.

patterns.name: Sports grounds
patterns.context: In the plural, refers to grounds used for sports such as hockey, listed alongside golf courses, stables, and other facilities.

patterns.name: Line of sight
patterns.context: Occurs in “line of sight,” referring to the line of sight toward a quasar.

patterns.name: Visual sight
patterns.context: The noun “sight” refers to something worth seeing; a piano and its sound are also mentioned.

patterns.name: Visual navigation
patterns.context: The compound “sight-based” describes navigation relying on visual landmarks or line of sight.

3_2731.description: 响应多义词“pitch/pitches”：音乐音高、棒球投球、工程节距及运动场地；也响应含“sight”的视线、景象和视觉导航表达。各义项均由局部语境区分。

patterns.name: 音高或音程
patterns.context: 音乐或声音描述中，指音高、音符、旋律等；有时和节奏、音符序列并列。

patterns.name: 投球
patterns.context: 棒球语境中指投出的球；常与投手、击球、打者或局数相邻。

patterns.name: 间距与排列
patterns.context: 指孔或精细光栅等结构的间距、排列位置或节距。

patterns.name: 运动场地
patterns.context: 复数形式指可进行曲棍球等运动的场地，与高尔夫球场、马厩等设施并列。

patterns.name: 视线通道
patterns.context: 出现在“line of sight”中，表示朝向类星体的视线。

patterns.name: 视觉观察
patterns.context: 名词“sight”指值得观看的景象；并提及钢琴及其声音。

patterns.name: 视觉导航
patterns.context: 复合词“sight-based”描述依靠视觉地标或视线进行导航。

en.concept: vocabulary related to pitch and line of sight
en.description: Primarily responds to the strings “pitches/pitch”: musical pitch, baseball pitches, device-hole spacing, sports grounds, and grating periods. Three other activations involve “sight” and related visual expressions.

patterns.name: Musical pitch and rhythm
patterns.context: Describes musical rhythm, melody, or pitch; often includes pitch/pitches

patterns.name: Baseball pitch
patterns.context: pitch(es) refers to a thrown ball; appears in accounts of a batter’s status or an inning

patterns.name: Device-hole spacing
patterns.context: pitch denotes the spacing or arrangement parameter of holes or structures

patterns.name: Sports ground
patterns.context: pitch denotes a hockey ground, listing recreational grounds around residences or facilities

patterns.name: Spatial period of a grating
patterns.context: pitch denotes the spacing of fine grating lines, involving measurement or moiré processes

patterns.name: Line-of-sight direction
patterns.context: The trigger is sight, not pitch; describes a dust-free line of sight to a quasar

patterns.name: Visual sight
patterns.context: The trigger is sight, referring to the striking sight of a piano

patterns.name: Visual navigation
patterns.context: The trigger is sight, referring to navigation based on visual landmarks

3_2731.description: 主要响应字符串“pitches/pitch”：音乐音高、棒球投球、器件孔距、球场及光栅周期；另有三段激活在“sight”及其相关视觉表达上。

patterns.name: 音乐音高与节奏
patterns.trigger: “repetitive isochronic (+5)+5+ eighth notes”“melodic pattern”“pitches”；“sliding notes”“high pitches”
patterns.context: 描述音乐节奏、旋律或音高，常出现 pitch/pitches

patterns.name: 棒球投球
patterns.context: pitch(es) 指投球；出现在打者状态或一局比赛叙述中

patterns.name: 器件孔位间距
patterns.trigger: “holes … with precision concerning their sizes and pitches”
patterns.context: pitch 表示孔、结构的间距或排列参数

patterns.name: 球场场地
patterns.context: pitch 表示曲棍球场地，列举住宅或设施周边的活动场地

patterns.name: 光栅的空间周期
patterns.context: pitch 表示精细光栅条纹的间距，涉及测量或莫尔过程

patterns.name: 视线方向
patterns.context: 触发处是 sight，而非 pitch；描述通往类星体的无尘视线

patterns.name: 视觉景象
patterns.context: 触发处是 sight，指钢琴呈现出的醒目景象

patterns.name: 视觉导航
patterns.context: 触发处是 sight，表示基于视觉地标的导航方式

en.concept: Lexical features of pitches and sight
en.description: Activations fall mainly on pitches and sight: the former spans music, baseball, playing fields, and precise spacing contexts; the latter spans line of sight, views, and visual-navigation phrases. There are also localized activations around astronomical identifiers and patent markers, so overall this resembles a sparse lexical/subword-fragment feature.

patterns.name: pitches in terms or phrases
patterns.context: The word activates when referring to pitch, sports throws, or playing fields. All three uses occur, with no single shared sense condition identified.

patterns.name: Expressions related to sight
patterns.context: Appears in phrases such as “line of sight,” “impressive sight,” and “sight-based,” meaning line of sight, view, and vision-dependent, respectively.

patterns.name: Other isolated collocations
patterns.context: Localized activation occurs near the HE identifier in fragment 5 and in hole/measurement patent text in fragments 7–8, with no pattern consistent with the lexical items above.

3_2731.concept: pitches 与 sight 词项特征
3_2731.description: 激活主要落在 pitches 与 sight：前者跨音乐、棒球、场地及精密间距语境，后者跨视线、景象和视觉导航短语；另有天文编号及专利标记的局部激活，整体更像稀疏词项/片段特征。

patterns.name: 术语或短语中的 pitches
patterns.context: 该词指音高、体育投球或场地等时激活；三种用法都出现，未发现统一的词义条件。

patterns.name: sight 相关表达
patterns.context: 出现在“line of sight”“impressive sight”“sight-based”等短语中，含义分别为视线、景象、依赖视觉。

patterns.name: 其他孤立搭配
patterns.context: 片段5的 HE 编号附近及片段7–8的孔洞/测量专利文本中有局部激活，未见与上述词项一致的模式。

en.description: Strongly activates on “sight” and “pitches”: the former involves vision, line of sight, or appearance; the latter occurs in contexts involving musical pitch, baseball pitches, and engineering spacing. Other nearby words show no shared pattern.

patterns.name: Sight-related words
patterns.context: Activates in descriptions of vision, line of sight, appearance, or visual effect, across different semantic and syntactic contexts.
patterns.domain: Medical patents, astronomy papers, music reviews, general prose

patterns.name: Pitch/pitches and related specialized uses
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts involving musical pitch, baseball pitches, or spaced holes/gratings; the specific meaning varies by domain.
patterns.domain: Music research, baseball reporting, engineering patents, historical entries

3_2731.description: 对“sight”和“pitches”强烈激活：前者涉及视力、视线或观感；后者在音高、投球及工程间距等语境中出现。其余相邻词缺乏共同模式。

patterns.name: sight 相关词
patterns.context: 在描述视觉、视线、外观或观赏效果时；在不同语义和句法环境中均激活。
patterns.domain: 医学专利、天文学论文、音乐评论、一般说明文

patterns.name: pitch/pitches 及相关专门用法
patterns.context: 出现在音高、棒球投球或有尺寸间距的孔/光栅等语境；具体词义随领域变化。
patterns.domain: 音乐研究、棒球报道、工程专利、历史条目

en.concept: Mathematical symbolic computation text and localized digit strings
en.description: Primarily responds to differentiation, expansion, and polynomial symbol strings in DM mathematical text, especially variable powers, coefficients, and answer fragments. There are also sporadic responses to digit strings in financial headlines and “line of sight” in astrophysics papers.

patterns.name: Symbol strings in differentiation problems
patterns.context: A differentiation instruction or variable description appears near a polynomial expression; activation falls on words such as wrt and derivative, as well as some mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Polynomial expansion and algebraic manipulation
patterns.context: Requests to expand, rearrange, or simplify polynomials made up of variable powers and coefficients; expressions often appear between the problem and answer fragments.

patterns.name: Constants and polynomial terms in answer fragments
patterns.context: Isolated or truncated solution text contains numerical coefficients and variable-power terms; a complete instruction need not be present.
patterns.domain: Answer/expression fragments in DM math data

patterns.name: Financial Q&A headlines and digit strings
patterns.context: Numbers or 101 appear in headlines, Q&A sections, and brief numbered text, distinct from polynomial differentiation contexts.
patterns.domain: Financial education/Q&A headlines in Enron emails

patterns.name: sight in astrophysics papers
patterns.context: sight in this phrase activates strongly in paper sentences about quasars, galaxies, and dust.

3_2731.concept: 数学符号计算文本及局部数字串
3_2731.description: 主要响应DM数学文本中的求导、展开和多项式符号串，尤其变量幂、系数及答案片段；另对金融标题数字串和天体物理论文中的“line of sight”有零星响应。

patterns.name: 求导题中的符号串
patterns.trigger: « wrt»、«What is the third derivative»、«Differentiate»、«Find the second»
patterns.context: 导数指令或变量说明出现在多项式表达式附近；激活落在 wrt、derivative 等词，以及部分数学符号上。
patterns.domain: DM 数学问答/符号计算

patterns.name: 多项式展开与代数变形
patterns.context: 要求展开、重排或化简由变量幂与系数组成的多项式；表达式常夹杂在题目与答案片段之间。
patterns.domain: DM 数学问答/代数运算

patterns.name: 答案片段中的常数与多项式项
patterns.context: 孤立或截断的解答文本中出现数字系数、变量幂项；不一定伴随完整指令。
patterns.domain: DM 数学数据中的答案/表达式片段

patterns.name: 金融问答标题与数字串
patterns.context: 标题、问答栏目和简短编号式文本中出现数字或 101；与多项式求导语境不同。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的金融教育/问答标题

patterns.name: 天体物理论文中的 sight
patterns.context: 关于类星体、星系和尘埃的论文句子中，该短语里的 sight 激活很强。

en.description: Primarily responds to multiplication signs, exponents, and variable-coefficient expressions in mathematical polynomials. Common in differentiation problems, but also covers algebraic instructions to expand, rearrange, and substitute into composite functions.
