patterns.name: Multiplication signs and exponents in polynomial expressions
patterns.context: Algebraic polynomials or expressions; activation falls on multiplication signs, exponent markers, and some numbers/variables, with no clear dependence on a fixed variable or exponent.
patterns.domain: Symbolic algebra problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Differentiation prompts by variable
patterns.context: The problem asks for differentiation with respect to a specified variable, often providing a polynomial and asking for a second or third derivative; activation also occurs near the differentiation prompt.

patterns.name: Expression expansion instructions
patterns.context: Requests to expand a product of factors; the prompt and subsequent polynomial factors occur in the same context.

patterns.name: Expression rearrangement instructions
patterns.context: A rearrangement instruction is followed by an expression containing variables and exponents; distinct from expansion or differentiation requests.

patterns.name: Composite function evaluation
patterns.context: A function is defined first, followed by a question asking for its value on a nested input; activation also occurs on exponent expressions in the definition.

3_2731.description: 主要对数学多项式中的乘号、幂次及变量—系数表达式起反应；常见于求导题，也覆盖展开、重排和复合函数代入等代数指令。

patterns.name: 多项式表达式中的乘号与幂次
patterns.trigger: 重复出现的 «*»、«**»，常与变量、数字和 «+»/«-» 相邻
patterns.context: 代数多项式或表达式；激活落在乘号、幂次标记以及部分数字/变量上，未见明确依赖某个固定变量或幂次。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 中的符号代数题

patterns.name: 按变量求导的提示
patterns.context: 题目要求对指定变量求导，常给出多项式并询问二阶或三阶导数；导数提示附近也出现激活。

patterns.name: 展开表达式指令
patterns.context: 要求展开括号乘积，提示词与后续多项式因子同处上下文。

patterns.name: 重排表达式指令
patterns.context: 出现重排指令，后接含变量、幂次的表达式；与展开或求导要求不同。

patterns.name: 复合函数求值
patterns.context: 先给函数定义，再询问嵌套输入下的函数值；激活也出现在定义里的幂次表达式。

en.concept: Key symbols or words in formal technical text
en.description: Most activations come from variables, coefficients, and operators in mathematical algebraic expressions, often alongside instructions to solve. There are also sporadic activation patterns in patent image-mask descriptions, email staffing plans, and TRAIL cancer treatment.

patterns.name: Algebraic expressions and formula generation
patterns.context: In mathematical problem contexts, activation concentrates on algebraic expressions composed of symbols, operators, coefficients, and variables. Some passages directly follow instructions such as “Suppose,” “Solve,” or “Calculate.”

patterns.name: “Solve” problem instruction
patterns.context: Appears after an algebraic equation or system of equations, requesting that variables be solved for; the word itself is also marked.

patterns.name: Image overlays and mask descriptions
patterns.context: Patent background passages describe overlays of masks or displayed information on captured images, with displayed content changing based on subject position.

patterns.name: Team staffing and promotion plans
patterns.context: Emails specify the number of people needed for a team, current assistants, and possible promotion or rotation arrangements.

patterns.name: TRAIL cancer treatment and clinical trials
patterns.context: Biomedical abstracts discuss the efficacy and safety of recombinant TRAIL proteins and their activity in killing tumor cells.

3_2731.concept: 形式化技术文本中的关键符号或词
3_2731.description: 多数激活来自数学代数式中的变量、系数和运算符，常伴随求解指令；另有专利图像遮罩、邮件人员安排及 TRAIL 癌症治疗中的零散激活模式。

patterns.name: 代数表达式与公式生成
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的多项式项和方程，如«*»、«**»、«=»，以及变量 a、p、r、x、z 等
patterns.context: 数学题上下文中，激活集中在符号、运算符、系数与变量构成的代数式里；部分段落紧接“Suppose”“Solve”“Calculate”等指令。

patterns.name: “Solve”题目指令
patterns.context: 在给出代数方程或方程组后出现，要求求解变量；该词本身也被标记。

patterns.name: 图像叠加与遮罩描述
patterns.trigger: «super»poses»10« a»2« mask»1 image；另有« superposition»信息及« picked»5-up image
patterns.context: 专利背景段落描述在拾取图像上叠加遮罩或显示信息，并依主体位置改变显示内容。

patterns.name: 团队编制与晋升安排
patterns.context: 邮件中说明团队所需人员数量、现有助理及其可能晋升或轮岗安排。

patterns.name: TRAIL 癌症治疗与临床试验
patterns.trigger: « very»10« active»，邻近 TRAIL、clinical trials、cancer、tumor cells 等词
patterns.context: 生物医学摘要讨论重组 TRAIL 蛋白的效力、安全性及其杀伤肿瘤细胞的活性。

en.description: All passages activate near very, usually when very is followed by a description of performance, properties, activity, or scale. Adjectives vary in polarity, and topics and domains are diverse.

patterns.name: very + property-evaluation word
patterns.context: very is followed by an adjective or property description, such as “very poor thermal stability,” “very high power requirements,” “very high rate,” “very strong,” “very narrow bandwidth,” “very active,” “very good,” “very large genome,” or “very high capacity.” Activation falls on very, while the following property varies by context.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain technical, scientific, and patent text

patterns.name: Degree adverb followed by property description
patterns.context: The degree adverb very modifies positive or negative properties, performance, degree, or scale; triggering is not limited to a particular adjective or domain.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, patents, medical and academic papers

3_2731.description: 所有段均在 very 附近激活，通常是 very 后接对性能、性质、活性或规模的描述；形容词褒贬不一，主题和领域多样。

patterns.name: very + 性质评价词
patterns.trigger: very（多为 very10，段[8][9][10]为 very9）及其后的评价词
patterns.context: very 后接形容词或性质描述，如 “very poor thermal stability”“very high power requirements”“very high rate”“very strong”“very narrow bandwidth”“very active”“very good”“very large genome”“very high capacity”。激活落在 very 上，后续性质因上下文而异。
patterns.domain: 跨领域技术、科研与专利文本

patterns.name: 程度副词后接性质描述
patterns.trigger: “very poor”“very high”“very strong”“very narrow”“very active”“very good”“very large”
patterns.context: 程度副词 very 修饰正面或负面的性质、性能、程度或规模；触发并不局限于某一种形容词或领域。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、专利、医学与学术论文

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the degree adverb very, especially when followed by an adjective describing a property, degree, or quantity. Also activates on quantity structures plenty of and lot of, and on extra spaces in code contexts.

patterns.name: Degree adjectives after very
patterns.context: In the “very + adjective” structure, activation falls on very; the adjective's meaning and domain are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, papers, encyclopedias, and forum text

patterns.name: of following plenty
patterns.context: The quantifier plenty is followed by of, which introduces a noun phrase.

patterns.name: of following lot
patterns.context: The quantity expression lot of is followed by a plural noun.

patterns.name: extra spaces
patterns.context: In discussions of code formatting, the adjective extra modifies spaces; activation falls on spaces.

3_2731.description: 主要对程度副词 very 敏感，尤其是 very 后接描述性质、程度或数量的形容词；另在数量结构 plenty of、lot of，以及代码语境中的 extra spaces 上激活。

patterns.name: very 后的程度形容词
patterns.trigger: “very”后接程度形容词，如“very poor”“very long”“very significant”“very good”“very inhomogeneous”“very low”“very high”
patterns.context: 在“very + 形容词”结构中，激活落在 very 上；形容词的语义与领域不固定。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、论文、百科及论坛文本

patterns.name: plenty 后接 of
patterns.context: 数量词 plenty 后由 of 引出名词短语。

patterns.name: lot 后接 of
patterns.context: 数量表达 lot of 后接复数名词。

patterns.name: extra spaces
patterns.context: 讨论代码格式时，形容词 extra 修饰 spaces；激活落在 spaces。

en.description: Primarily responds to degree complements or modifiers following very, and also to words expressing quantity, progress, and repetition. There are also sporadic activations on chart formatting, separators, and a few technical or formula tokens.

patterns.name: Degree complements or modifiers following very
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on words after very and their subsequent elements. Common collocations include very + adjective or nominal expression; some passages mark a complement across a line break or longer distance.

patterns.name: Progress, quantity, or result reaching a certain degree
patterns.context: Triggered when describing accumulated quantities, exceeding a comparison baseline, or a repeated state; some examples do not contain very.

patterns.name: Numbering, charts, and formatting structures
patterns.context: Activation falls on structural tokens such as chart labels, punctuation, line breaks, or separators, with weak semantic connections.
patterns.domain: Technical papers, forum posts, and formatted text

patterns.name: Sporadic technical words or special tokens
patterns.context: Appears in technical discussions, IoT descriptions, or mathematical formulas, with no stable contextual condition identifiable from the examples provided.
patterns.domain: Forums, technical papers, mathematical physics text

3_2731.description: 主要响应 very 后的程度补语或修饰表达，也会响应表示数量、进展和重复状态的词；另有图表格式、分隔符及少数技术或公式 token 的零散激活。

patterns.name: very 后的程度补语或修饰语
patterns.trigger: « very»10«↵»5«good»5；« very»10 solid；« very»9 questions；« very»9 serious；« very»9« little»6；« very»9« singular»1
patterns.context: 激活集中在 very 之后的词及其后续成分，常见搭配为 very + 形容词或名词性表达；个别段落标记换行或较长距离后的补语
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本中的程度表达

patterns.name: 进展、数量或结果达到某个程度
patterns.trigger: « added»4« progressive»；« total»10« progressive»2« pool»2；« more»4 than；« once»3 again«5
patterns.context: 在描述累积数量、超出比较基准或重复出现的状态时触发；有的例子并不含 very

patterns.name: 编号、图表及格式结构
patterns.context: 激活落在图表编号、标点、换行或分隔符等结构性 token 上，语义联系较弱
patterns.domain: 技术论文、论坛帖子及格式化文本

patterns.name: 零散的技术词或特殊 token
patterns.context: 在技术讨论、IoT 描述或数学公式内部出现，难以从给定例子确定稳定的上下文条件
patterns.domain: 论坛、技术论文、数学物理文本

en.description: All spans activate on overall in the “overall + noun” structure, referring to the scope of a system, object, or metric; domains vary, but the triggering structure is consistent.

patterns.name: Overall quantity or state
patterns.context: Modifies a noun in a phrase referring to the whole, total, or system-wide scope; often occurs when describing local components, factors, or changes.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A and patent backgrounds, covering software, communications, databases, optics, computer hardware, circuits, typography, and mechanical design

3_2731.description: 所有片段均在“overall+名词”结构中的 overall 上激活，涉及系统、对象或指标的整体范围；领域各异，触发结构一致。

patterns.name: 整体/总体量或状态
patterns.trigger: “overall”及其后接的限定名词，如 “overall memory usage”“overall frequency spectrum”“overall bandwidth”“overall schema”“overall assembly”“overall compute blade design”“overall circuit”“overall InDesign layout”“overall size”
patterns.context: 在整体、总量或系统范围的名词短语中修饰名词；多出现在对局部组件、因素或变化作出说明时。
patterns.domain: 技术问答与专利背景，涵盖软件、通信、数据库、光学、计算机硬件、电路、排版和机械设计

en.description: All fragments activate on overall in “the overall,” followed by an overall object such as design, spectrum, pattern, memory, layout, bandwidth, suitability, sentiment, circuit, or assembly. Domains and styles vary.

patterns.name: Definite article before overall
patterns.context: The trigger is overall after the. It is followed by a noun phrase, often referring to an entire system, object, or metric. This pattern spans diverse contexts and nouns.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, Q&A, public health abstracts, and general expository text

3_2731.description: 所有片段均在“the overall”中的 overall 处激活，后接设计、频谱、模式、内存、布局、带宽、适配度、情感、电路或装配等整体对象；领域和文体多样。

patterns.name: overall 前的定冠词
patterns.context: 触发点是 the 后的 overall；整体后接名词短语，常表示某个系统、对象或指标的整体。该模式跨越多种上下文与名词。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、问答、公共卫生摘要及一般说明文

en.description: All spans contain overall: it is usually used as a modifier meaning whole, total, or global; domains and modified nouns vary. In span 10, it also occurs split as over+all in a rating phrase.

patterns.name: Overall in evaluative or statistical metrics
patterns.context: overall is an adjective, usually modifying a noun to mean whole, total, or global in scope; it occurs across multiple domains, and activation does not depend on a fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: General prose, news, encyclopedias, patents, Q&A, administrative texts; covering sentiment analysis, sports, communications, government budgets and compensation, organized crime, hardware, databases, and ratings.

patterns.name: overall split across tokens
patterns.context: overall is tokenized as two subwords in the rating phrase “4/5 overall rating”; activation is stronger on over.

3_2731.description: 全部片段都出现 overall：多数作为修饰语表示整体、总体或全局；领域和所修饰名词多样。第10段另有拆分形式 over+all，位于评分短语中。

patterns.name: 评价或统计指标中的 overall
patterns.trigger: «overall»10 standings / «overall»10 IT spending / «overall»10 pay levels / «overall»9 budget / «overall»9 compute blade design / «overall»9 schema / «overall»9 rating；另有 «overall»10 sentiment、frequency spectrum、authority
patterns.context: overall 作形容词，通常修饰名词，表示整体的、总体的或全局范围；在多个领域中出现，激活不依赖某个固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 一般说明文、新闻、百科、专利、问答、行政文本；涉及情感分析、体育、通信、政府预算与薪酬、黑帮、硬件、数据库和评级。

patterns.name: 拆分拼写中的 overall
patterns.context: overall 被标记为两个子词，出现在评分短语“4/5 overall rating”中；较强激活落在 over 上。

en.description: Primarily responds to overall introducing overall scope or aggregate metrics; there are also sporadic patterns involving thus for summarization, instead for proposing an alternative, and only for emphasizing a unique answer.

patterns.name: Overall assessment or scope following overall
patterns.context: When describing or statistically evaluating an object, overall is followed by operations, frequency spectrum, standings, sentiment, volume, cost, or other aggregate scopes or metrics.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, business emails, patents, sports reporting, reviews, and forum discussions

patterns.name: Discourse-summary use of thus
patterns.context: In patent text, thus follows prior discussion to introduce a completed summary or conclusion; in this example it is followed by been outlined.

patterns.name: instead introducing an alternative
patterns.context: After discussing the shortcomings of an approach, instead introduces a proposed alternative measure.

patterns.name: only emphasizing uniqueness or exclusivity
patterns.context: In a conversation thanking someone for a reply, emphasizes that one answer is the only truly effective answer; activation falls on only.

3_2731.concept: 篇章级范围与总结标记
3_2731.description: 主要响应 overall 引出的整体范围或总体指标；另有 thus 总结、instead 提出替代方案，以及 only 强调唯一答案等零散模式。

patterns.name: overall 后接总体评估或范围
patterns.context: 整体描述或统计、评价一个对象时，overall 后接 operations、frequency spectrum、standings、sentiment、volume、cost 等总体范围或指标。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、商业邮件、专利、体育报道、评论与论坛讨论

patterns.name: thus 的篇章总结用法
patterns.context: 专利文本中承接前文，以 thus 引出已完成的概述或结论；本例后接 been outlined。

patterns.name: instead 引出替代方案
patterns.context: 讨论某种做法的缺陷后，以 instead 引出建议采用的替代措施。

patterns.name: only 强调独一或排他
patterns.context: 在感谢回复的对话中强调某个答案是唯一真正有效的答案；激活落在 only。

en.description: Activations often occur at the start of a sentence or in a paragraph summary, especially on “Overall”; they also appear in evaluations, thanks, and questions after line breaks. Other highlights are scattered across connectives, operation words, and sentence constituents, with no stable shared meaning.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Overall
patterns.context: At the start of a paragraph, summary, evaluation, or contrast, often opening a review paragraph; the word itself activates strongly across multiple corpora.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, technical Q&A, emails, forum discussions

patterns.name: Polite or emphatic expressions at sentence starts or after line breaks
patterns.context: At the beginning of a paragraph or new sentence, often accompanying an evaluation, question, explanation, or thanks; the triggering forms vary.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, patent texts, forum comments

patterns.name: Intra-sentence separators or continuative elements
patterns.context: In sentence-internal linking, inference, or explanatory structures; local highlights fall on different words, with no clear shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Patents, business emails, technical Q&A, product descriptions

patterns.name: Command- or operation-related words
patterns.context: In a Shell command line, occurs in a command that unmounts a mount point.

3_2731.description: 激活常出现在句首或段落总结处，尤其是“Overall”，也见于换行后的评价、感谢和提问；其余高亮分散在连接词、操作词及句中成分，未显出稳定的统一语义。

patterns.name: 句首 Overall
patterns.context: 段落总结、评价或转折处，常作为评论段落的开头；多个语料中该词本身有强激活。
patterns.domain: 商品评论、技术问答、邮件、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 句首/换行处的礼貌或强调表达
patterns.context: 段落或新句起始处，常伴随评价、提问、说明或感谢；触发形式并不一致。
patterns.domain: 商品评论、专利文本、论坛评论

patterns.name: 句中分隔或续接成分
patterns.context: 句内连接、推论或解释结构；局部高亮落在不同词语上，缺少共同的明确语义条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、商务邮件、技术问答、产品说明

patterns.name: 命令或操作相关词
patterns.context: Shell 命令行中，出现在卸载挂载点的命令里。

en.concept: Inference transitions and local word-form triggers
en.description: The most prominent shared pattern is the use of thus, therefore, or Hence to introduce an inference, proposal, requirement, or goal after stating a problem or background. Sporadic triggers also include paragraph breaks, only, so much, all-out, actually, and overall, across varied corpus styles.

patterns.name: Introducing an inference with thus/therefore
patterns.context: The preceding text states a problem, limitation, or existing situation, followed by these words introducing a conclusion, proposal, requirement, or goal; typically at the beginning of a sentence or clause.
patterns.domain: Primarily patent backgrounds and technical descriptions; also argumentative contexts in philosophy papers

patterns.name: New-paragraph marker at sentence start
patterns.context: Activation falls on a newline or paragraph start, often immediately preceding a new paragraph such as a comment or reply; this may be an independent pattern caused by paragraph boundaries.

patterns.name: so much in an expression of thanks
patterns.context: The so in so much is marked in a fixed expression of thanks; other words of thanks in the same paragraph show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Emphatic restriction with only
patterns.context: only emphasizes exclusivity or a limited quantity, as in “only real answer,” “only one,” and “only a limited predetermined number”; trigger strength varies.
patterns.domain: Web comments and patent technical descriptions

patterns.name: Fixed compound expression all-out
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in the compound expression all-out, referring to a concept of complete or total conviction; no other matching examples are available.

patterns.name: actually introducing curiosity or a question
patterns.context: In dialogue, actually modifies be curious to open a personal inquiry or add a detail; a single example.

patterns.name: Modifier in the position of overall
patterns.context: Modifies frequency spectrum in a technical sentence, describing the overall spectrum; a single example with no clear shared trigger condition.

3_2731.concept: 推论转折及局部词形触发
3_2731.description: 最突出的共同模式是在陈述问题或背景后，用 thus、therefore、Hence 引出推论、提案、需求或目标。另有段落换行、only、so much、all-out、actually、overall 等零散触发，跨语料文体不一。

patterns.name: 因此/由此引出推论
patterns.context: 前文陈述问题、限制或已有情况，随后用这些词引出结论、提案、需求或目标；通常出现在句首或分句开头。
patterns.domain: 主要为专利背景与技术说明；另有哲学论文中的论证语境

patterns.name: 句首新段落标记
patterns.context: 激活落在换行符或段落起始处，常紧接评论、回复等新段落；此处可能是段落边界带来的独立模式。

patterns.name: 感谢语中的 so much
patterns.context: 固定感谢表达中 so much 的 so 被标记；同一段其他感谢词也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: only 强调限定
patterns.context: only 用于强调排他性或数量受限，如“only real answer”“only one”“only a limited predetermined number”；触发强度不一。
patterns.domain: 网络评论及专利技术说明

patterns.name: all-out 固定复合表达
patterns.context: 触发词处于 all-out 复合表达中，表示彻底或完全的信念概念；缺乏其他相同用例。

patterns.name: actually 引出好奇或询问
patterns.context: 对话中以 actually 修饰 be curious，开启个人询问或补充；单例。

patterns.name: overall 位置上的修饰语
patterns.context: 技术句中修饰 frequency spectrum，描述整体频谱；单例，缺乏明显共同触发条件。

en.description: The clearest signal is thus/Thus; there are also several instances of the substring out, along with isolated code identifiers, a Size field, and inc in a maintenance checklist. Code spans may reflect substrings or tokenization and do not support grouping them into a unified semantic category.

patterns.name: Thus as a transition or summary
patterns.context: Appears after preceding discussion to introduce a conclusion, summary, or subsequent need; both capitalization forms occur.

patterns.name: Substring out
patterns.context: Appears inside different words or identifiers: «out»il (outil), «Out»Dir, «out»line; capitalization varies and annotations often split it from adjacent characters.
patterns.domain: Go code, XML project configuration, serialized data

patterns.name: Size field
patterns.context: Appears in a consecutive list of structure size constants/fields, followed by type names and assignments.

patterns.name: BIOC identifier
patterns.context: Appears in a list of constants beginning with BIOC and their numeric assignments.

patterns.name: Network constant identifier
patterns.context: Appears in a list of sys_IP_* network constant names and their hexadecimal assignments.
patterns.domain: Github system headers or constant definitions

patterns.name: Maintenance work-order action word
patterns.context: In a parenthetical note about the brake after inspection, activation falls on the abbreviated fragment inc; the surrounding text is a maintenance checklist.

3_2731.description: 最明显信号是thus/Thus；另有多处out子串，以及若干孤立代码标识符、Size字段和维修清单中的inc。代码片段可能反映子串或标记化，不能据此归并为统一语义。

patterns.name: Thus 转折/总结
patterns.context: 出现在论述前文之后，引出结论、总结或后续需求；大小写均出现。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术与正式说明文

patterns.name: out 子串
patterns.context: 在不同词语或标识符内部出现：«out»il（outil）、«Out»Dir、«out»line；大小写不一，且常与相邻字符切分标注。
patterns.domain: Go 代码、XML 项目配置、序列化数据

patterns.name: Size 字段
patterns.context: 出现在连续的结构体大小常量/字段列表中，后接类型名与赋值。

patterns.name: BIOC 标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 BIOC 开头的常量名及其数值赋值列表中。

patterns.name: 网络常量标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 sys_IP_* 网络常量名及其十六进制数值赋值列表中。
patterns.domain: Github 系统头文件或常量定义

patterns.name: 维修工单动作词
patterns.context: 括号中补充说明检查后制动器时，激活落在 inc 这一缩写片段；周围是维修检查清单。

en.description: Activation falls on diverse local word forms: out in the Go identifier ioutil, accordingly and let down in patents, only/仅, the maintenance instruction Refill, and (no subject) in an email subject line. The trigger forms span domains, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition observed.

patterns.name: out inside a Go identifier
patterns.context: The trigger is `out` inside the `/ioutil` identifier; occurs in `ReadAll` and `ReadFile` calls or related code contexts.
patterns.domain: Go code, HTTP response handling, or file/test utilities

patterns.name: accordingly in patent style
patterns.context: In patent prose, follows prior text and introduces a construction or statement of requirements; both examples occur immediately before a specific predicate.

patterns.name: Literal token only
patterns.context: Emphasizes a unique or exclusive object or answer in an English sentence; one example repeats only.

patterns.name: 仅 in a Chinese comment
patterns.context: A code documentation comment describes a feature limitation, followed by a scope such as “supports Chinese and letters.”

patterns.name: refill in a work-order instruction
patterns.context: The imperative instruction `Refill engine` in a vehicle maintenance checklist, meaning to replenish engine oil.

patterns.name: down in the phrase let down
patterns.context: In a patent description of a chemical process, the pressure is let down before temperature and reaction effluent are discussed.

patterns.name: no subject in an email subject line
patterns.context: The Subject field in an email header explicitly indicates that there is no subject; peak activation falls on the left parenthesis after the Subject colon.

3_2731.description: 激活落在多种局部词形：Go 标识符 ioutil 的 out、专利中的 accordingly 与 let down、only/仅、维修指令 Refill，以及邮件主题中的 (no subject)。触发形式跨领域，未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: Go 标识符中的 out
patterns.context: 触发位置是 `/ioutil` 标识符内部的 `out`；出现在 `ReadAll`、`ReadFile` 调用或相关代码上下文中。
patterns.domain: Go 代码，HTTP 响应处理或文件/测试工具

patterns.name: 专利文体中的 accordingly
patterns.context: 专利叙述中承接前文并引出构造或需求陈述；两例均紧邻特定谓语。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景或说明书

patterns.name: 仅字面 token only
patterns.context: 英语句子中强调唯一、排他的对象或答案；一例重复出现 only。

patterns.name: 中文注释中的 仅
patterns.context: 代码文档注释中说明功能限制，后接“支持中文、字母”等范围描述。

patterns.name: 工单指令中的 refill
patterns.context: 车辆维修清单中的祈使指令 `Refill engine`，即要求补充发动机机油。

patterns.name: 短语 let down 中的 down
patterns.context: 专利化学工艺描述中，压力被 let down 后再讨论温度和反应物流出液。

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的 no subject
patterns.context: 邮件头的 Subject 字段明确标示无主题，最高激活落在 Subject 冒号之后的左括号。

en.description: The strongest response is to ioutil file reading and related punctuation in Go code; other activations are scattered across English comparison words, the grounds for a legal continuance, a connective in a VBA comment, and conditional or inferential expressions in patent text, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: ioutil in Go code
patterns.context: Calls to read files or NopCloser using ioutil in Go code, with activation also on punctuation and tokens inside identifiers

patterns.name: Words related to contrast or degree
patterns.context: In English prose, these words occur in comparison, degree, or emphasis contexts, but the activated words are not fully consistent

patterns.name: Grounds for a continuance request
patterns.context: A request for a continuance is based on a circumstance in a legal account

patterns.name: Conditions and causal explanation in an Excel macro
patterns.context: In a VBA event procedure, so introduces a comment explaining the purpose of the code

patterns.name: Conditional or inferential links in patent text
patterns.context: Describes process conditions, problems, or conclusions in patent background text; triggers often occur on short function words or fixed expressions

3_2731.description: 主要强烈响应 Go 代码中的 ioutil 读文件及相关标点；其余激活分散于英文比较词、法律中的延期依据、VBA 注释连接词及专利文本的条件、推导表达，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的 ioutil
patterns.context: Go 代码里调用 ioutil 的文件读取或 NopCloser，并伴随标点、标识符内部 token 激活

patterns.name: 转折或程度相关词
patterns.context: 英语叙述中这些词出现在比较、程度或强调语境；但激活词并不完全一致

patterns.name: 请求延期的理由
patterns.context: 法律叙述中以某种情况为依据提出延期请求

patterns.name: Excel 宏中的条件与原因说明
patterns.context: VBA 事件过程里，用 so 引出解释代码目的的注释

patterns.name: 专利文本中的条件或推导连接
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中描述工艺条件、问题或结论；触发位置多在短功能词或固定表达中

en.concept: Mixed common tokens and code structures
en.description: Activation is scattered across the basis argument structure in legal texts, general English function words and degree expressions, Go file-reading code, and code formatting/comment markers; no single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Legal argument use of basis
patterns.context: Occurs in structures such as on the basis of / on that basis, serving as an argument, reason, or basis for a ruling; sometimes followed by of

patterns.name: English function words and common collocations
patterns.context: Prepositions, conjunctions, degree words, or collocational elements in ordinary English sentences; no single fixed syntactic environment

patterns.name: Go I/O code snippets
patterns.context: Located in the Go package name ioutil, in calls to ReadAll or ReadFile to read a response body or file

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting tokens in code
patterns.context: Occurs near code newlines, block structures, and call expressions; activation falls on formatting symbols rather than clearly semantic words

patterns.name: Code comments or documentation markers
patterns.context: Documentation-comment regions and omission markers in test source code

patterns.name: Colloquial contractions and English function words
patterns.context: Contractions split into tokens, occurring in first-person colloquial speech and descriptive expressions

3_2731.concept: 混合的常见 token 与代码结构
3_2731.description: 激活分散于法律文本中的 basis 论证结构、一般英语虚词与程度表达，以及 Go 读文件代码和代码格式/注释标记；看不出单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: basis 的法律论证用法
patterns.context: 出现在 on the basis of / on that basis 等结构中，用作论据、理由或判决依据；有时后接 of

patterns.name: 英语虚词与常见搭配
patterns.context: 普通英语句子中的介词、连词、程度词或搭配成分；没有单一固定句法环境
patterns.domain: 小说/百科、论坛帖子、网页文案

patterns.name: Go 的 I/O 代码片段
patterns.context: 位于 Go 包名 ioutil 中，调用 ReadAll 或 ReadFile 读取响应体或文件

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与格式 token
patterns.context: 出现在代码换行、块结构和调用表达式附近；激活落在格式符号而非明确语义词上

patterns.name: 代码注释或文档标记
patterns.context: 测试源码中的文档注释区域及省略内容标记

patterns.name: 口语缩写与英语虚词
patterns.context: 缩写拆分成 token，出现在第一人称口语及描述性表达中
patterns.domain: 网络帖子、地图项目文案

en.concept: common English phrases and subword fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to the English conditional connective so (often “If so,”) and the phrase “rest of”; it also strongly activates on out in “Try that out” and the internal re in Portuguese Entre. Topics and styles are not uniform.

patterns.name: Conditional confirmation “if that is the case…”
patterns.context: After a proposal, hypothesis, judgment, or explanation, “If so,” continues by asking how to proceed, whether alternatives exist, or what the consequences are; the core trigger is so, not a particular topic
patterns.domain: Q&A and technical discussions, mainly StackExchange; also found in other English texts

patterns.name: Phrase meaning “the remaining part”
patterns.context: Refers to the remaining part of a whole; may mean the rest of an article, the remaining modes of a game, or other parts of the world

patterns.name: English sentence-final directive phrase
patterns.context: After a code example, encourages someone to try it and report the result; highlights concentrate on out

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a Portuguese word
patterns.context: Occurs inside the Portuguese word Entre, meaning “between”; it is an internal subword fragment, not an English phrase

3_2731.concept: 英语高频短语与词片段
3_2731.description: 主要响应英语条件承接词 so（常见“If so,”）及短语“rest of”；另对“Try that out”中的 out 和葡萄牙语 Entre 的词内 re 强烈激活。话题与文体并不统一。

patterns.name: 条件确认“如果这样……”
patterns.context: 前文提出方案、假设、判断或解释，随后以“If so,”承接，询问如何继续、是否有替代方案或说明其后果；核心触发词是 so，而非特定话题
patterns.domain: 问答及技术讨论，主要为 StackExchange；也见于其他英语文本

patterns.name: “其余部分”短语
patterns.context: 指某整体余下的部分；既可指文章剩余部分，也可指游戏其余模式或世界其他地区

patterns.name: 英语句末指令短语
patterns.context: 代码示例之后，劝对方试用并反馈结果；高亮集中在 out
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程回答，口语化建议

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语表示“在……之间”的词 Entre 内，属于词内子串，非英语短语
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡萄牙语议会文本

en.description: Activation primarily targets the out subword in throughout and structures containing out of; also seen in subword fragments of entire/entirely, patent background headings and phrasing, legal formatting, and several ungroupable local word activations.

patterns.name: Word-final out in throughout
patterns.context: Mostly out inside throughout, across different word contexts; also occurs in structures such as times out of and System.out.
patterns.domain: Financial interviews, legal documents, forum discussions, programming text

patterns.name: Fixed phrase out of
patterns.context: out combines with of to express source, range, or probability/frequency; activation centers on out and may also extend to times.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, legal narration, programming Q&A

patterns.name: Background section headings
patterns.context: Section headings and formal patent phrasing in patent documents; activation is distributed across headings and within Hitherto.

patterns.name: Subword fragment within entirely
patterns.context: entirely is split into subwords; related internal word fragments show strong activation, but the surrounding sentences have different topics.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in entire whole
patterns.context: entire is split into subwords, appearing in statements about the whole work and scope of authorization in a legal license.

patterns.name: Newlines and indentation formatting
patterns.context: Dense line breaks and indentation in legal opinions; whether these are independent trigger factors is uncertain.

patterns.name: Local emphasis on words or phrases
patterns.context: Other sporadic activation words occur in each passage, with no shared semantic, lexical, or syntactic condition; these may be distinct, weakly related local patterns.
patterns.domain: Finance, law, forums, news, and programming Q&A

3_2731.description: 主要对 throughout 的 out 子词及 out of 等含 out 的结构激活；另见 entire/entirely 的子词片段、专利背景标题与措辞、法律排版，以及若干无法归并的局部词语激活。

patterns.name: throughout 中的词尾 out
patterns.trigger: «through»…«out»（[1]、[2]、[3]）；相邻的短语中也有高激活的 «out»（[4]、[7]）
patterns.context: 主要是 throughout 内部的 out，跨越不同词语上下文；也出现在 times out of 和 System.out 这样的结构中。
patterns.domain: 财经访谈、法律文书、论坛讨论、编程文本

patterns.name: out of 固定短语
patterns.context: out 与 of 构成短语，表示来源、范围或概率频率；激活集中在 out，亦可延伸到 times。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、法律叙述、编程问答

patterns.name: 背景章节标题
patterns.context: 专利文书中的章节标题及较正式的专利措辞，激活分布在标题和 Hitherto 的词内。

patterns.name: entirely 的词内片段
patterns.context: entirely 被拆分为子词；相关词内片段激活强，但相邻句子主题不同。

patterns.name: entire whole 的词内片段
patterns.context: entire 被拆分为子词，出现在法律许可证关于作品整体及授权范围的表述中。

patterns.name: 换行与缩进格式
patterns.context: 法律意见书中密集的换行及缩进排版；是否是独立触发因素不确定。

patterns.name: 词语或短语上的局部强调
patterns.context: 各段另有零散激活词，未呈现共同的语义、词法或句法条件；可能是不同的弱相关局部模式。
patterns.domain: 财经、法律、论坛、新闻及编程问答

en.description: Activations primarily fall on several common collocations or internal word fragments: out in throughout, on the basis, times out of, and at most; there are also line breaks and a few sporadic tokens. The triggers are dispersed and do not form a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Line breaks at sentence starts or structural boundaries
patterns.context: Line breaks are marked as active, often at the start of a quotation, speaker turn, or paragraph; some examples also contain blank lines before or after.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments, forum posts, and other texts

patterns.name: out in throughout
patterns.context: out in the word throughout activates; the word means spanning a period, material, or scope.

patterns.name: basis
patterns.context: Occurs in “on that basis” or “on the basis of,” meaning grounds or foundation.

patterns.name: out of in quantity expressions
patterns.context: out occurs in the frequency-ratio expression “times out of …”.

patterns.name: at most in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: at most introduces an upper bound, followed by a mathematical object or quantity.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in instill
patterns.context: Occurs inside the verb instill, describing the instillation of a glycerol solution into the bladder.

patterns.name: about in time-range expressions
patterns.context: about modifies “one week,” indicating an approximate duration.

patterns.name: Other sporadic phrase activations
patterns.context: Occur in local contexts such as “take a little time,” “his recovery,” “what’s before me,” “infinite only when,” and “including style attributes”; no shared condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, mathematical papers, forum discussions

3_2731.description: 激活主要落在若干常见搭配或词内片段：throughout 中的 out、on the basis、times out of、at most；另有换行符及少量零散 token。各触发条件分散，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 句首或结构边界的换行符
patterns.context: 换行符被标记为激活，常出现在引文、发言者或段落内容开始处；部分样例的前后还包含空行。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、论坛帖子及其他文本

patterns.name: throughout 中的 out
patterns.context: 单词 throughout 中的 out 激活；用于表示贯穿某一时期、材料或范围。

patterns.name: basis
patterns.context: 出现在“on that basis”或“on the basis of”中，表示依据或基础。

patterns.name: out of 数量表达
patterns.trigger: « times»…« out»…« of»（如“9 times out of 10”）
patterns.context: out 位于频率比例表达“times out of …”中。

patterns.name: 数学表达中的 at most
patterns.context: at most 引出上界，后接数学对象或数量。

patterns.name: instill 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在动词 instill 的词内；描述向膀胱注入甘油溶液。

patterns.name: 时间范围表达中的 about
patterns.context: about 修饰“一周”，表示大约的时间长度。

patterns.name: 其他零散短语激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在“take a little time”“his recovery”“what’s before me”“infinite only when”“including style attributes”等局部语境中；看不出共同条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、数学论文、论坛讨论

en.concept: Local word forms and collocation fragments
en.description: Activation often occurs on local word forms or collocations such as over-determined, throughout, Henceforth, and at most; there are also isolated cases involving a decade-related numerical question, document symbols, and medical word forms, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: over in the phrase “over a decade”
patterns.context: When indicating a quantity slightly greater than ten years, over occurs before the number/time unit; little also appears in this passage

patterns.name: Word-internal suffix in “Henceforth”
patterns.context: Activation falls on forth, combined with hence to form henceforth; preceded by an explanation of program logic

patterns.name: Word-internal suffix in “throughout the commodity cycle”
patterns.context: out combines with through to form throughout, followed by the time span the commodity cycle

patterns.name: Prefix part of the statistical term “over-determined”
patterns.context: over is joined to determined with a hyphen to form a term describing overdetermined data or equations

patterns.name: Quantity upper bound most in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: Fixed phrase at most, indicating that the order of a group does not exceed p²

patterns.name: Word-internal suffix in “throughout our Opinion”
patterns.context: out combines with through to form throughout, indicating that a fact holds throughout the opinion

patterns.name: Quantity upper bound most in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: Fixed phrase at most, limiting the numerical upper bound in a graph algorithm

patterns.name: Equals-sign punctuation in web/document text
patterns.context: Activation falls on the equals sign and adjacent dot and in; surrounding text is cluttered with email addresses, URLs, or formatting-conversion artifacts, so the meaning is unclear

patterns.name: Number string in a time-conversion question
patterns.context: The question asks how many decades are contained in a number of years; activation centers on the numerical string, with other time-unit conversions in the same passage

patterns.name: instill word form in a urethral instillation description
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword fragment of instillated, describing glycerol solution being instilled into the bladder; this may reflect a rare word form or a segmentation-boundary effect

3_2731.description: 激活多见于若干局部词形或搭配：over-determined、throughout、Henceforth，以及 at most；另有 decade 数值题、文档符号和医学词形等孤例，缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: 短语“over a decade”中的 over
patterns.context: 表示略多于十年的数量时，over 出现在数字/时间单位之前；本段同时有 little

patterns.name: 短语 “Henceforth” 的词内后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在 forth，与 hence 合成 henceforth；前文是程序逻辑说明

patterns.name: 短语 “throughout the commodity cycle” 的词内后缀
patterns.context: out 与 through 合成 throughout，后接时间范围 the commodity cycle

patterns.name: 统计术语 “over-determined” 的前缀部分
patterns.context: over 与 determined 以连字符组成术语，描述数据或方程的过度确定

patterns.name: 数学表达中的数量上限 most
patterns.context: 固定搭配 at most，表示群的阶不超过 p²

patterns.name: 短语 “throughout our Opinion” 的词内后缀
patterns.context: out 与 through 合成 throughout，指事实贯穿意见书全文

patterns.name: 数学表达中的数量上限 most
patterns.context: 固定搭配 at most，限定图算法中的数值上界

patterns.name: 网页/文档中的等号标点
patterns.context: 激活落在等号以及紧邻的点和 in；周围是邮箱、网页地址或格式转换产生的杂乱文本，含义不明确
patterns.domain: 论文网页文本/格式噪声

patterns.name: 时间换算题中的数字串
patterns.context: 问题询问若干年包含多少 decade，激活集中在数值数字串；同段另有多种时间单位换算

patterns.name: 尿道灌注叙述中的 instill 词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 instillated 的词内片段，描述将甘油溶液注入膀胱；可能是罕见词形或分词边界效应

en.concept: Time and numerical expressions in math problems
en.description: Primarily responds to numbers, units, and arithmetic expressions in time-related math problems, especially clock intervals and minute calculations; also appears in differentiation, probability, and unit-conversion problems, as well as sporadic local triggers in papers and ordinary text.

patterns.name: Time-of-day and time-interval calculations
patterns.context: The question asks to calculate minutes backward from a given time or the number of minutes between two times; often followed by a numerical answer and a line break

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in math problems or solutions involving differentiation, probability, expressions, or numerical results; trigger locations are not entirely consistent

patterns.name: Numerical unit conversions and quantity questions
patterns.context: Asks for conversions between time units or for a quantity, usually accompanied by numbers and an answer

patterns.name: Local word-form pattern near “a”
patterns.context: Only the presence of activation on short local fragments can be confirmed; sentence-level semantics and domain vary widely
patterns.domain: News, medical papers, theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: Formatting and constraint expressions in paper abstracts
patterns.context: At the beginning of math paper abstracts, describing a theorem or conditions on finite groups; the specific trigger may involve an upper bound after “at most”

3_2731.concept: 数学题中的时间与数值表述
3_2731.description: 主要响应时间相关数学题中的数字、单位及运算表述，尤其是钟点间隔和分钟推算；另有求导、概率、单位换算题，以及论文与普通文本中零散的局部触发。

patterns.name: 时刻与时间间隔运算
patterns.trigger: “minutes before”“minutes are there between”，以及钟点中的“:”“AM”“PM”
patterns.context: 问句要求从某时刻往前推算分钟，或计算两个时刻之间的分钟数；常跟随数值答案与换行

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与运算符
patterns.trigger: “third derivative”“Differentiate”“without replacement”，及数字、符号和算式
patterns.context: 出现在数学题或解答中，涉及求导、概率、表达式或带数字的结果；触发点并不完全相同

patterns.name: 数字单位换算与数量问句
patterns.trigger: “centuries in decades”“minutes to weeks”“How many months”及单位词“minutes”“centuries”“decades”“weeks”“months”
patterns.context: 要求在时间单位之间换算或询问数量，通常伴随数字和答案

patterns.name: “a”附近的局部词形模式
patterns.trigger: “a little over a decade”“in a bladder”“given … vertices of $G$”中的冠词或邻近片段
patterns.context: 仅能确认激活落在短小局部片段上；跨句语义和领域差异很大
patterns.domain: 新闻、医学论文、理论计算机论文

patterns.name: 论文摘要中的格式与限制表达
patterns.context: 数学论文摘要开头，叙述定理或对有限群的条件；具体触发位置可能涉及“at most”后的上界

en.concept: Upper-bound expressions and the word ending of extent
en.description: The main response is to “at most” expressing upper bounds in technical texts and nearby connectives, including algorithms, graph theory, quantity of types, point sets, growth rates, and dimensions. Activation also occurs on the word ending of “extent” in legal decisions.

patterns.name: Upper-bound expression “at most”
patterns.context: Introduces an upper bound on quantity, complexity, growth rate, dimension, or size in mathematical or technical texts; activation often falls on “at most” and adjacent words.

patterns.name: “extent” in legal text
patterns.context: A legal opinion uses expressions such as “to the extent” or “extent [someone] sought to …”; activation falls on the word ending “ent.”

3_2731.concept: 上界表达及 extent 词尾
3_2731.description: 主要响应技术文本中表达上界的“at most”及附近连接词，涵盖算法、图论、类型数量、点集、增长率和维数。另在法律判决的“extent”词尾激活。

patterns.name: “at most”上界表达
patterns.context: 数学或技术文本中引出数量、复杂度、增长率、维数或大小的上界；激活常落在“at most”及其相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 数学与计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 法律文本中的“extent”
patterns.context: 法律意见书中出现“to the extent”或“extent [某人] sought to …”一类表达；激活落在词尾“ent”。

en.description: The most stable pattern is activation on the numerical upper bound “at most” and nearby mathematical relation words across multiple types of technical text; there are also sporadic responses to mathematical symbols, abstract formatting, DuckDuckGo subword fragments, and fragments within French words, with no unified semantics evident for the latter categories.

patterns.name: Numerical upper bound “at most”
patterns.context: Indicates a limit in technical discussions of algorithmic complexity, graph theory, geometry, model theory, group theory, quantum queries, and related topics; the phrase is sometimes separated by numbers or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Primarily ArXiv academic papers; also HackerNews

patterns.name: Relation words in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Mostly prepositions and relation words in mathematical or technical contexts; trigger positions and local collocations vary, and they often co-occur with a sentence containing a numerical upper bound.

patterns.name: Mathematical inequality symbols
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical inequalities involving variables and ranges.

patterns.name: Abstract openings and layout markers
patterns.context: Line breaks, labels, and indentation at the beginning of paper abstracts.

patterns.name: “Duck” word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the product name DuckDuckGo; this passage also contains a numerical upper bound with “at most.”
patterns.domain: HackerNews product or web performance discussions

patterns.name: Fragments within French words
patterns.context: Appears within the French words semaines, derniers, and conséquent; unlike other frequent activations, it does not form a numerical upper-bound phrase.

3_2731.concept: 技术文本中的数量上界表达
3_2731.description: 最稳定的模式是在多类技术文本中激活“at most”数量上界及其附近的数学关系词；另对数学符号、摘要格式、DuckDuckGo词片段和法语词内片段有零星响应，后几类未见统一语义。

patterns.name: “at most”数量上界
patterns.context: 在算法复杂度、图论、几何、模型论、群论、量子查询等技术论述中，表示上限；有时短语被数字或标点隔开。
patterns.domain: 主要为 ArXiv 学术论文，也见 HackerNews

patterns.name: 数学表达中的关系词
patterns.context: 多为数学或技术语境中的介词、关系词；触发位置及局部搭配不完全一致，常与数量上界所在句同现。

patterns.name: 数学不等式符号
patterns.context: 出现在变量与范围的数学不等式中。

patterns.name: 摘要开头及版式标记
patterns.context: 论文摘要起始处的换行、标签及缩进。

patterns.name: “Duck”词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在产品名 DuckDuckGo 中；本段另有“at most”数量上界。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 产品或网页性能讨论

patterns.name: 法语词内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在法语单词 semaines、derniers、conséquent 的词内；不像其他高频激活那样构成数量上界短语。

en.description: Primarily responds to “at most,” which expresses an upper bound in mathematical and technical contexts, especially most, and may associate with nearby numbers or quantified entities; also responds to split-marked “extent” in two legal texts.

patterns.name: At most constraint expression
patterns.context: Expresses an upper bound on quantities, degrees, orders, complexity, growth rates, proportions, and similar values in mathematical or technical discussion; “at” and “most” may be marked separately, with activation concentrated on “most.”

patterns.name: Split activation on extent
patterns.context: The phrase “to the extent” appears in legal text, with the split extent portion primarily activated rather than an upper-bound usage.

3_2731.description: 主要响应数学和技术语境中表示上限的“at most”，尤其是 most，并可关联邻近的数值或量化对象；另在两段法律文本中响应被拆分标记的“extent”。

patterns.name: at most 限制表达式
patterns.trigger: «at»«most»，以及«at»«most»前后的数值、上界或集合大小
patterns.context: 在数学或技术论述中表达数量、度数、次数、复杂度、增长率、比例等的上限；「at」「most」可分开标记，主要落在«most»。

patterns.name: extent 的拆分激活
patterns.context: 法律文本里出现短语“to the extent”，重点激活拆分后的 extent 部分，而非数量上限用法。

en.description: The most stable trigger across passages is “at most” in mathematical or scientific texts, followed by a quantity upper bound; “with” often introduces a related qualification and is also used with confidence levels. Passage 8 additionally has activation on “alt” inside the proper name Faltings.

patterns.name: Quantity upper-bound phrase “at most”
patterns.context: Gives a maximum quantity or upper bound in a mathematical statement; may appear directly or in structures with “with” or “there are.”
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, computer science, and statistics papers

patterns.name: Condition or accompanying qualification introduced by “with”
patterns.context: “with” introduces a condition, accompanying property, or statistical confidence level; in most passages it co-occurs with an “at most” upper-bound phrase, but its standalone meaning is not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Substring in the name Faltings
patterns.context: Occurs inside the proper name Faltings and is unrelated to quantity upper-bound expressions.

3_2731.description: 各段最稳定的触发模式是数学或科学文本中的“at most”及其后接的数量上界；“with”常引出相关限定，也有置信度等用法。第8段另有专名 Faltings 内的“alt”激活。

patterns.name: 数量上界短语“at most”
patterns.trigger: “at”与“most”，通常构成“at most”，后接数量、复杂度、次数、比例或几何量上界；如“at most 3 queries”“at most 90%”“at most one”
patterns.context: 在数学陈述中给出最大数量或上界；可直接出现，也可置于“with”“there are”等结构中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、计算机科学及统计学论文

patterns.name: “with”引出的条件或伴随限定
patterns.context: “with”引出条件、伴随属性或统计置信度；在多数段落中与“at most”上界短语共现，但单独出现时语义并不完全一致。

patterns.name: Faltings 名称中的子串
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Faltings 的内部，与数量上界表达无关。
patterns.domain: 数学论文中的定理引用

en.description: Primarily responds to the numerical upper-bound structure “at most” across mathematical, scientific, and legal contexts; also responds to the legal fixed phrase “to the extent,” and in two passages activates on combinations of numbers, in, and line-break formatting.

patterns.name: Numerical upper-bound expression with at most
patterns.context: Introduces an upper bound on a quantity, count, size, or proportion in English sentences or mathematical text; punctuation, formulas, or other modifiers may appear around the trigger words.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, legal rulings, and general technical prose

patterns.name: Extent that in legal text
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed structure “to the extent [that],” which limits the scope of a claim or argument; sometimes split across a line break.

patterns.name: Formatting combination of numbers and in
patterns.context: A local format consisting of numbers, the unit in, and line breaks or adjacent numbers; these fragments do not clearly exhibit an at most structure.
patterns.domain: Figure/table or layout fragments in ArXiv text, or numerical formats

3_2731.description: 主要响应“at most”数量上界结构，覆盖数学、科学及法律语境；另响应法律固定短语“to the extent”，并在两段中对数字、in及换行排版组合有激活。

patterns.name: at most 的数量上界表达
patterns.context: 在英语句子或数学文本中引出数量、次数、规模或比例的上限；触发词前后可有标点、公式或其他修饰语。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律判决及一般技术叙述

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 extent that
patterns.context: 出现在固定结构“to the extent [that]”，用于限定主张或论述的适用范围；有时被换行拆开。

patterns.name: 数字与 in 的格式组合
patterns.context: 数字、单位 in 及换行或相邻数字构成的局部格式；这些片段未明显呈现 at most 结构。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文本中的图表/排版残片或数字格式

en.description: Primarily responds to split “extent,” “in” after numbers, and dense number/punctuation/line-break formatting; there are also sporadic word activations that cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Unit in in formatted numbers
patterns.context: in appears after a number or decimal, usually as the inch unit; nearby text may include line breaks, paper content, or figure data
patterns.domain: ArXiv scientific papers and formatted content

patterns.name: Extent in legal text
patterns.context: extent is split across a line break or token boundary into ext + ent; it occurs in the “to the extent” structure, followed by language preserving or limiting a legal claim

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in time and email formats
patterns.context: Number-dense formats such as times, dates, phone numbers, or email headers; strong activation falls on number fragments, punctuation, or line breaks rather than a unified word meaning

patterns.name: Sporadic activations with no clear correspondence
patterns.context: Activation falls on ordinary words or time markers, and the surrounding context shows no semantic trigger condition consistent with the other patterns

3_2731.description: 主要响应被拆分的“extent”、数字后的“in”及密集数字/标点/换行格式；另有零散词语激活，无法由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: 排版数字中的单位 in
patterns.context: 数字或小数后出现 in，通常作为英寸单位，附近可能有换行、论文文本或图表数据
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文及排版内容

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 extent
patterns.context: extent 被换行或 token 边界拆成 ext + ent；处于“to the extent”结构中，后接保留或限制法律主张的表述

patterns.name: 时间与邮件格式中的数字符号
patterns.context: 时间、日期、电话号码或邮件头等数字密集格式；强激活落在数字片段、标点或换行上，而非统一的词义

patterns.name: 无清晰对应的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活落在普通词或时间标记上，周围上下文未显示与其他模式一致的语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 法律文本、邮件、数学问答

en.concept: Relation and formatting words near numbers
en.description: Primarily responds to “in” and nearby numbers: inch measurements, probability expressions such as “1 in 20”; also appears in draft-pick rankings, quantities expressed as “out of,” upper bounds with “at most,” as well as layout fragments and several sporadic words.

patterns.name: Unit in for measurements
patterns.context: Appears after a number or measurement as the inch unit, often alongside decimals, line breaks, or figure-size labels.
patterns.domain: ArXiv scientific papers and figure labels

patterns.name: Numbering and formatting markers
patterns.context: Numbers, punctuation, and line breaks occur together, possibly from layout, formulas, or split formatted text; the trigger token itself does not necessarily indicate a measurement.

patterns.name: Sports draft expressions
patterns.context: Descriptions of draft rankings and player selection, especially phrases related to ranking and team selection.

patterns.name: Probability denominator 1 in 20
patterns.context: The number 1 and another number form an expression of probability or the chance of winning a lottery.

patterns.name: Quantity phrase out of
patterns.context: Uses “some number out of a total” to express the number of candidates.

patterns.name: Maximum-limit expression
patterns.context: Introduces an upper bound in an algorithmic or mathematical statement.

patterns.name: Sporadic phrase hits
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts including journal decisions, legal text, research design, and email addresses; there is no obvious shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, legal, academic, and email text

3_2731.concept: 数字附近的关系与格式词
3_2731.description: 主要响应“in”及其附近数字：英寸尺寸、概率“1 in 20”等；也命中选秀顺位、数量“out of”、上界“at most”，以及排版碎片和若干零散词。

patterns.name: 尺寸单位 in
patterns.context: 作为英寸单位出现在数字或尺寸之后，常伴随小数、换行或图表尺寸标注。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文及图表标注

patterns.name: 编号与格式标记
patterns.context: 数字、标点和换行相邻，可能来自排版、公式或被拆分的格式化文本；触发 token 本身未必构成尺寸。

patterns.name: 体育选秀表述
patterns.context: 选秀顺位及球员选择的叙述中，尤其是顺位和球队选择相关短语。

patterns.name: 概率分母 1 in 20
patterns.context: 数字 1 与另一个数字构成概率或抽奖获胜机会的表达。

patterns.name: 数量短语 out of
patterns.context: 用“若干 out of 总数”表达候选人数量。

patterns.name: 最高限额表述
patterns.context: 算法或数学陈述中引出上界。

patterns.name: 零散短语命中
patterns.context: 分别处于期刊判定、法律文本、研究设计、邮箱地址等语境；没有明显共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、法律、学术及邮件文本

en.description: Most passages show activation near numbers, decimals, fractions, ratios, or values with units; there are also instances involving scores, the legal phrase “extent,” email times, and one word ending in a name.

patterns.name: Numbers, measurement units, and decimals
patterns.context: Numbers and decimal points occur near units such as inches, or in conversion questions, dimensions, and weight information; activation often falls on values, units, or punctuation between numbers.
patterns.domain: Paper formatting, product information, math problems, research texts

patterns.name: Fraction and ratio expressions
patterns.context: Numbers are expressed as fractions, percentage-like ratios, or “out of” constructions; activation is distributed across ratio words and fraction components.
patterns.domain: Math problems, statistical or population-health descriptions, ratings

patterns.name: Numerical rating format
patterns.context: A number represents a review rating, using a decimal score and an “out of” construction.

patterns.name: Legal qualifying phrase in a quotation
patterns.context: A legal ruling uses “to the extent”; the word is split into «ext» and «ent» markers.

patterns.name: Email timestamp
patterns.context: A specific sending time in an email header; activation falls on the minute value.

patterns.name: Isolated name fragment
patterns.context: In a text fragment where a number is adjacent to a name, the ending of the name John Ellis is split into marked pieces; context is insufficient to determine a stable trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Name or signature fragment in ArXiv text

3_2731.description: 多数段落在数字、小数、分数、比例或带单位的数值附近激活；另见评分、法律短语“extent”、邮件时间，以及一处姓名词尾。

patterns.name: 数值、测量单位与小数
patterns.context: 数字和小数点附近出现英寸等单位，或在换算题、尺寸与重量信息中；多处激活落在数值、单位或数字之间的标点上。
patterns.domain: 论文排版、商品信息、数学题、科研文本

patterns.name: 分数与比例表达
patterns.context: 数字以分数、百分比式比例或“out of”结构表达时；激活点分布在比例词和分数成分上。
patterns.domain: 数学题、统计或人口健康叙述、评分

patterns.name: 数字评分格式
patterns.context: 数字表示评论评分，采用小数分值及“out of”结构。

patterns.name: 引文中的法律限定短语
patterns.context: 法律判决语句中使用“to the extent”，该词被拆分为 «ext» 与 «ent» 标记。

patterns.name: 邮件时间戳
patterns.context: 邮件头中的具体发送时间，激活落在分钟数值上。

patterns.name: 孤立的姓名片段
patterns.context: 数字与姓名相邻的文本片段中，姓名 John Ellis 的词尾被拆分标记；上下文不足以确定稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文本中的姓名或署名片段

en.concept: Relations between in and numerical units
en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on in: it introduces a target unit or fractional relation in unit-conversion problems, and also appears in statistical contexts such as “1 in N”; numbers, units, and line breaks often occur nearby. There are also math-problem templates and paper layout fragments, some of which cannot be explained.

patterns.name: “in” in ratios/unit conversion
patterns.context: In math problems, in introduces a target unit or quantity relation; in a few statistical contexts, it denotes incidence (one among how many people)

patterns.name: Numerical and layout unit fragments
patterns.context: The inch unit follows a number, or numbers/formulas are laid out across lines; activation may be influenced by the adjacency of numbers and units

patterns.name: Math Q&A template
patterns.context: In a sequence of unit-conversion exercises, the question asks for a fraction or quantity converted to another unit, with questions and answers arranged line by line

patterns.name: In in a ratio expression
patterns.context: in means one among N objects; this is not a unit-conversion problem
patterns.domain: Clinical study recruitment, lottery odds, and disease prevalence

patterns.name: Out of in population proportion expressions
patterns.context: Describes incidence or proportions in an adolescent population, without a unit-conversion Q&A template

patterns.name: Paper structure and formula/numbering fragments
patterns.context: Combinations of numbers and in caused by pagination, numbering, formulas, or layout transcription in papers; semantics are unclear

patterns.name: Other sporadic paper fragments
patterns.context: Numbers and in appear in truncated paper passages, with insufficient context to determine their meaning

3_2731.description: 激活主要集中于 in：单位换算题中引出目标单位或分数关系，也见统计语境的“1 in N”；常伴数字、单位和换行。另有数学题模板及论文排版残片，部分论文片段无法解释。

patterns.name: “in”与比例/单位换算
patterns.trigger: «in»，常见于“in 21/8 of a micrometer”“in 3/50 of a millennium”“in kilometers”等；也见“1 in 20”“1 in 2000”
patterns.context: 数学题中，in 引出目标单位或数量关系；另有少数统计语境表示发生率（每多少人中）
patterns.domain: 数学单位换算、人口统计

patterns.name: 数值与排版单位片段
patterns.context: 数值后接英寸单位或跨行数字/公式排版；激活片段可能受数字和单位相邻关系影响

patterns.name: 数学问答模板
patterns.context: 连续单位换算练习题中，题目询问某个分数或数量换算成另一单位，题与答案按行排列

patterns.name: 比例表达中的 in
patterns.context: in 表示每 N 个对象中有一个；不是单位换算题
patterns.domain: 临床研究招募/抽奖概率与疾病流行率

patterns.name: 人群比例表达中的 out of
patterns.context: 描述青少年人群中的发生率或比例，未出现单位换算问答模板

patterns.name: 论文结构与公式/编号残片
patterns.context: 论文分页、编号、公式或版面转写造成的数字与 in 组合，语义不清

patterns.name: 其他零散论文片段
patterns.context: 数值与 in 出现在截断的论文段落中，缺少足够上下文判断其语义

en.description: Activation primarily falls on in denoting inches after numbers, and on in/out of in ratio expressions; there are also email contact details and probability phrases containing in. Enron email fragments show no corresponding trigger cues.

patterns.name: Inch unit following a number
patterns.context: in appears after a value, measurement, or layout parameter as the inch unit; may occur with line breaks, LaTeX markup, or image dimensions.
patterns.domain: ArXiv scientific papers and formatted text

patterns.name: Denominator phrases for birth rates or probability
patterns.context: In numerical ratio expressions, in or out of introduces probability, prevalence, or a quantity ratio.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patent background, popular science, and encyclopedia text

patterns.name: In in email domains
patterns.context: Appears near an email address or contact information; activation falls on the preceding “in,” not on the email domain itself.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper front matter contact information

patterns.name: In in English phrases
patterns.context: In the fixed expression “1 in 20 chance,” in denotes a probability ratio rather than a unit.

3_2731.concept: 数字比例或英寸单位标记
3_2731.description: 激活主要落在数字后表示英寸的 in，以及比例表达中的 in/out of；另有邮箱联系信息和含 in 的概率短语。Enron 邮件片段未见对应触发线索。

patterns.name: 数字后接 in 的英寸单位
patterns.context: 数值、尺寸或版面参数后出现 in，作为英寸单位；可伴随换行、LaTeX 标记或图像尺寸。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文与排版文本

patterns.name: 出生率或概率中的分母短语
patterns.trigger: “1« in»10 20 chance”“1« out»9« of»8 6000 births”“1« in»9 2000 live births”“two« out»9« of»8 three”
patterns.context: 数字比例表达式中，in 或 out of 引出概率、患病率或数量比例。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利背景、科普与百科文本

patterns.name: 邮箱域名中的 in
patterns.context: 邮箱地址或联系信息附近；激活落在前文的“in”，而非邮箱域名本身。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文首页联系信息

patterns.name: 英文短语中的 in
patterns.context: 固定表达“1 in 20 chance”中，in 表示概率比例，而不是单位。

en.description: Activation primarily falls on two local formats: inch measurements containing in and “out of” expressing ratios; it also appears in email contact information and timestamps, and on the isolated -less suffix.

patterns.name: Inch measurements and formatted numbers
patterns.context: Numbers, including decimals, occur with in, often in image widths or layout parameters; some numbers are split by line breaks
patterns.domain: Figures and layout source in ArXiv documents

patterns.name: “out of” ratio expression
patterns.context: Used to express a quantity, ratio, or sample proportion, followed by a specific number or entity
patterns.domain: Medical papers, wrestling reports, genetic disease descriptions, corporate email

patterns.name: Email addresses and header information
patterns.context: Contact details, phone numbers, dates, and times appear in email signatures or headers
patterns.domain: Email; also contact information at the end of ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Suffix -less
patterns.context: An isolated word ending in less; context is insufficient to determine whether this is a general morphological pattern

3_2731.concept: 文本中的结构化格式线索
3_2731.description: 激活主要落在两类局部格式：带 in 的英寸尺寸，以及表示比例的“out of”；另见邮件联系信息与时间戳、孤立的 -less 词尾。

patterns.name: 英寸尺寸与排版数值
patterns.context: 数字、带小数的数值与 in 连用，常出现在图像宽度或版面参数中；部分数字被换行拆开
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文档中的图表、排版源码

patterns.name: “out of”比例表达
patterns.context: 用于表示数量、比例或样本占比，后接具体数值或对象
patterns.domain: 医学论文、摔角报道、遗传病介绍、企业邮件

patterns.name: 邮件地址与邮件头信息
patterns.context: 联系人信息、电话号码、日期和时间出现在邮件签名或邮件头中
patterns.domain: 邮件；也见 ArXiv 文末联系人信息

patterns.name: 词尾 -less
patterns.context: 孤立出现的以 less 结尾的词；此处没有足够上下文确定是否为普遍形态模式

en.description: Primarily responds to numeric formatting, especially a number followed by in to indicate inches and ratio expressions involving numbers with out of; also activates on figure dimensions, date/time formats, internal word fragments, and sporadic common words.

patterns.name: Numbers and the inch unit
patterns.context: Numbers often include decimals or dimension formats and may be followed by additional values; they may also occur in headers, figure captions, or paper text.
patterns.domain: Dimension and numerical formatting in ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Ratio expression out of
patterns.context: Used to express frequency, ratios, or win rates, often between a number and the quantity being measured.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, research abstracts, encyclopedia descriptions, and email

patterns.name: Comma grouping in numbers
patterns.context: Numbers are split by tokens or punctuation, embedded in a statement of medical incidence.

patterns.name: Dimensions and image markers in paper captions
patterns.context: Image width is given in inches, immediately followed by a caption or contribution statement.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper captions and marker text

patterns.name: Email headers and timestamp formats
patterns.context: Dates, times, phone numbers, email addresses, and recipient fields occur next to each other.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in compounds or proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words split by tokenization rather than at a stable semantic or syntactic position.

patterns.name: Percentage-like fundraising ratio
patterns.context: States how much of every several dollars goes toward a particular use, in a fundraising promotional context.

patterns.name: General syntactic words and text boundaries
patterns.context: These words or newline markers occur sporadically in different contexts, with no stable shared condition.

3_2731.description: 主要响应数字排版，尤其数字后接 in 表示英寸，以及数字参与的 out of 比例表达；另对图注尺寸、日期时间格式、词内片段和零散常用词有激活。

patterns.name: 数字与英寸单位
patterns.context: 数字常带小数或尺寸格式，后续可能继续列出数值；也可能出现在页眉、图注或论文正文中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文中的尺寸、数值排版

patterns.name: 比例表达 out of
patterns.context: 用于频率、比例或胜率表达，常夹在数字与计量对象之间。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、研究摘要、百科叙述及邮件

patterns.name: 数字中的逗号分组
patterns.context: 数字被分词或标点切分，嵌在医学发生率的陈述中。

patterns.name: 论文图注中的尺寸与图像标记
patterns.context: 图像宽度以英寸给出，紧接图注或贡献说明。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文图注及标记文本

patterns.name: 邮件头与时间戳格式
patterns.context: 日期、时间、电话号码、邮箱地址与收件人字段相邻。

patterns.name: 复合词或专名的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的单词内部，而非稳定的词义或句法位置。

patterns.name: 百分比式筹款比例
patterns.context: 说明每若干美元中有多少用于某项用途，属于筹款宣传语境。

patterns.name: 一般句法词与文本边界
patterns.context: 这些词或换行标记在不同语境中零散出现，未显示稳定共同条件。

en.description: Activations fall on numbers and adjacent formatting across several contexts: ratios, probabilities, dates and times, base-conversion problems, and quantity expressions; there are also sporadic triggers involving email domains, figure references, email header fields, and exclamation marks. Some examples involving numbers, line breaks, and layout are difficult to attribute to a specific trigger.

patterns.name: Number and decimal-point formats
patterns.context: Activation falls on digit strings, dates/times, or combinations of numbers with periods or slashes; [1], [4], [6], and [8] also contain line breaks or layout boundaries, so the trigger may not be due solely to numerical formatting.
patterns.domain: Academic text, email metadata, document layout

patterns.name: Quantity expressions and words adjacent to numbers
patterns.context: Numbers combine with prepositions, quantifiers, or nearby numbers to form counts, ratios, probabilities, or math problems; [7] also contains a base-conversion problem format.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, public health, math, and counting expressions in text

patterns.name: Email and domain strings
patterns.context: Numerical domain names, periods, and domain suffixes occur together in email addresses; [4] also contains a contact email address, but activation markers are not concentrated on that address.
patterns.domain: Academic paper contact information, business email

patterns.name: Paper markers and figure references
patterns.context: Activation occurs near figure numbers, cross-references, and formatting markers, with no clear shared context with other numerical formats.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and their annotated text

patterns.name: Birth-rate numbers for genetic disorders
patterns.context: Numerical expressions of prevalence or birth frequency for Fragile X syndrome; activation spans out, of, and numerical fragments.
patterns.domain: Medical, genetics popular-science, or research text

patterns.name: Wrestling event format numbers
patterns.context: A “best two out of three” format in event descriptions; out of and numbers trigger, but the semantics differ from other quantity expressions.

patterns.name: Base-conversion problem format
patterns.context: Repeated math exercise template containing base, numbers, questions, and minus signs; activation also falls on several base-conversion values.

patterns.name: Email headers and timestamps
patterns.context: Dates, times, and sender/recipient fields in archived email headers; some activations concentrate on timestamps, others near fields or line breaks.
patterns.domain: Enron emails and forwarded email headers

patterns.name: Exclamatory expression
patterns.context: Activation near repeated exclamation marks at the end of a positive sentiment sentence; a single example, making it difficult to tell whether the trigger is the exclamation marks, tone, or another local factor.

patterns.name: Lottery probability
patterns.context: Probability of winning a lottery expressed with in and a number; activation falls on in. It resembles other in/number usages in form, but has probability semantics here.
patterns.domain: Medical research abstracts, participant incentive descriptions

3_2731.concept: 数字及结构化文本标记
3_2731.description: 多种激活落在数字及其邻接格式上：比例、概率、日期时间、进制题和数量表达；另有邮箱域名、图表引用、邮件头字段与感叹号等零散触发。部分数字、换行和版式样例难以判定具体触发原因。

patterns.name: 数字与小数点格式
patterns.context: 激活落在数字串、日期/时间、数字与点号或斜线的组合中；[1]、[4]、[6]、[8] 中还包含换行或版式边界，触发未必只由数字格式造成。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、邮件元数据、文档版式

patterns.name: 数量表达与数字邻接词
patterns.context: 数字与介词、量词或邻近数字构成计数、比例、概率或数学题表达；[7] 中还出现进制题格式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、公共卫生、数学、文本中的计数表达

patterns.name: 邮箱与域名字符串
patterns.context: 邮箱地址中数字域名、句点和域名后缀相邻；[4] 另有联系人邮件地址，但激活标记不集中于该地址。
patterns.domain: 学术论文联系信息、商务邮件

patterns.name: 论文标记与图表引用
patterns.context: 图号、交叉引用及格式化标记附近有激活，未见明显与其他数字格式的共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及其标注文本

patterns.name: 遗传病中的出生率数字
patterns.context: Fragile X 综合征患病/出生频率的数字表达，激活覆盖 out、of 及数值片段。
patterns.domain: 医学、遗传学科普或研究文本

patterns.name: 摔角赛事赛制数字
patterns.context: 赛事描述中的“两场中取三”式赛制；out of 与数字触发，但与其他数量表达的语义不同。
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物/赛事条目

patterns.name: 进制转换题格式
patterns.context: 反复出现的数学练习题模板，包含 base、数字、问句及负号；激活还落在若干进制数值上。

patterns.name: 邮件头与时间戳
patterns.context: 邮件归档头部中的日期、时间、收发人字段；部分激活集中于时间戳，部分在字段或换行附近。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及转发邮件头

patterns.name: 感叹表达
patterns.context: 正面情绪句末的重复感叹号附近激活；单例，难以确认是否由感叹号、语气或其他局部因素触发。

patterns.name: 随机抽奖概率
patterns.context: 以 in 加数字表达中奖概率，激活落在 in；与其他 in/数字用法形式相近，但此处是概率语义。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要、受试者激励说明

en.description: Activation is scattered across formatted numbers, units and newlines, email-header timestamps, email addresses, and web markers; there are also “out of” ratio expressions and several domain-specific phrases. The instances may be influenced by number/punctuation formatting, but there is no single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Number and unit formatting
patterns.context: Numbers, periods, unit in, and newlines intermingle, possibly reflecting figure dimensions or layout parameters; triggers cluster near units and punctuation
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic documents and their formatted text

patterns.name: Quantity expression “out of”
patterns.context: The phrase out of is followed by a number or quantity, expressing a ratio, fraction, or incidence rate
patterns.domain: Email, medical papers, and popular medical texts

patterns.name: Email headers and timestamps
patterns.context: Names, email addresses, dates, and times appear consecutively in email headers or forwarded messages

patterns.name: Web links or label markers
patterns.context: Labels, filenames, and dimension fields occur near chart titles or embedded image links

patterns.name: Spatial phrase in wrestling narration
patterns.context: Occurs when describing a dispute expanding to other events and match formats; differs from the quantity phrase out of

patterns.name: Ordinary preposition about
patterns.context: In an academic sentence about information on the Majorana matrix of right-handed neutrinos

patterns.name: Medical follow-up time expression
patterns.context: Compound expressions for study questionnaires and follow-up time points

patterns.name: Email address components
patterns.context: Near author contact information and lists of email addresses
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper front page or metadata

3_2731.concept: 数字与结构化文本片段
3_2731.description: 激活分散在格式化数字、单位与换行、邮件头时间戳、邮箱及网页标记；另见“out of”比例表达和若干领域特有短语。各处可能受数字/标点排版影响，但没有单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 数字与单位排版
patterns.context: 数字、句点、单位 in 与换行交错，疑似图表尺寸或版面参数；触发集中在单位和标点附近
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术文档及其排版文本

patterns.name: “out of”数量表达
patterns.context: 短语 out of 后接数字或数量，表达比例、分数或发生率
patterns.domain: 邮件、医学论文与科普性医学文本

patterns.name: 邮件头与时间戳
patterns.trigger: 邮件地址、«/»、«:»、时间和收发件字段中的数字
patterns.context: 邮件头或转发记录中，姓名、邮箱、日期和时间连续出现

patterns.name: 网页链接或标签标记
patterns.trigger: «label»、«.»及 HTML/Markdown 图像语法中的标记
patterns.context: 图表标题或嵌入式图像链接附近出现标签、文件名和尺寸字段
patterns.domain: ArXiv 的 Markdown 化论文内容

patterns.name: 摔角叙述中的空间短语
patterns.context: 描述争端扩展到其他赛事，以及比赛形式时出现；与数量短语 out of 不同

patterns.name: 普通介词 about
patterns.context: 关于右手中微子 Majorana 矩阵的信息这一学术句子中

patterns.name: 医学随访时间表达
patterns.context: 研究问卷和随访时间点的复合表达

patterns.name: 邮箱地址组件
patterns.context: 作者联系信息与邮箱地址列表附近
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文首页或元数据

en.description: Strong activations are concentrated on ensure strings: several are the verb meaning to make certain, while two others are within-word substrings in licensure and censure; three additional spans activate probably, used for uncertain judgments or predictions.

patterns.name: Ensuring an outcome, condition, or arrangement
patterns.context: The verb ensure is followed by a that-clause, an outcome noun, or a complete target; sometimes preceded by to, and often appearing mid-sentence or after a line break.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including email, code tests, forum posts, academic text, and fiction

patterns.name: probably followed by a judgment or duration prediction
patterns.context: probably expresses an uncertain judgment and is followed by take a while or another predicate.
patterns.domain: Email, medical abstracts, and geographic descriptions

patterns.name: Within-word licensure substring
patterns.context: ensure is the latter part of the complete word licensure, not an independent verb meaning “make certain.”
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts related to nursing education and licensure

patterns.name: Within-word censure substring
patterns.context: ensure is the latter part of the complete word censure, not an independent verb meaning “make certain.”

3_2754.description: 强激活集中于 ensure 字符串：多处是表示确保的动词，另两处则是 licensure、censure 的词内子串；另有三段激活 probably，用于不确定判断或预测。

patterns.name: 确保结果、条件或安排
patterns.context: 动词 ensure 后接 that 从句、结果名词或完整目标；有时前置 to，常出现在句中或换行后。
patterns.domain: 邮件、代码测试、论坛帖子、学术文本及小说等多种文体

patterns.name: probably 后接判断或耗时预测
patterns.context: probably 用于表达不确定判断，后接 take a while 或其他谓语。
patterns.domain: 邮件、医学摘要、地理位置说明

patterns.name: 词内 licensure 子串
patterns.context: ensure 是 licensure 这个完整词的后半部分，并非独立的“确保”动词。
patterns.domain: 护理教育与执照相关的学术摘要

patterns.name: 词内 censure 子串
patterns.context: ensure 是 censure 这个完整词的后半部分，并非独立的“确保”动词。
patterns.domain: 议会政治叙述，小说文本

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on the string ensure, including the standalone verb and intraword substrings in licensure and censure; there is also strong activation on probably and a meeting-scheduling fragment, which cannot be explained by the same word-form pattern.

patterns.name: Intraword and word-boundary activation on ensure
patterns.context: Appears as the complete word “ensure” in a sentence, or as part of a prefix/subword fragment; often followed by a that-clause or an expression of purpose or result, but this is not required.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including email, code tests, medical abstracts, forum text, and historical fiction

patterns.name: Intraword activation on probably
patterns.context: The complete adverb probably appears in a statement expressing conjecture; it has no obvious semantic connection to the ensure pattern.

patterns.name: Meeting time and location information
patterns.context: Meeting notices that include a time and room number; there are no obvious trigger words shared with probably or ensure.

patterns.name: Attribute assertions in test code
patterns.context: Ruby/RSpec-style tests checking that an attribute’s default value is present; ensure appears in the test name and the checked attribute name.

patterns.name: Different syntactic contexts of ensure
patterns.context: ensure means to guarantee or bring about an outcome, involving organizational change, family support, energy supply, and career development; the word form is shared, but the semantic topics vary.
patterns.domain: Business email, forum narratives, and comments

patterns.name: censure/licensure at affix boundaries
patterns.context: ensure happens to be the final substring of the longer words licensure and censure, meaning licensing/qualification and condemnation, respectively; it is not the verb ensure.

3_2754.concept: ensure 字符串及词内子串
3_2754.description: 激活最稳定地落在 ensure 字符串上，包括独立动词及 licensure、censure 的词内子串；另有 probably 的强激活和会议安排片段，无法由同一词形模式解释。

patterns.name: ensure 的词内/词边界激活
patterns.context: 在句中作为完整单词“ensure”，或作为前缀/分词片段的一部分；常接 that 从句、目的或结果表达，但并非必需。
patterns.domain: 邮件、代码测试、医学摘要、论坛文字、历史小说等多种文体

patterns.name: probably 的词内激活
patterns.context: 完整副词 probably 出现在陈述中，表达推测；与 ensure 模式没有明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 邮件、医学摘要、产品说明

patterns.name: 会议时间与地点信息
patterns.context: 通知会议安排，包含时间和房间号；没有明显与 probably 或 ensure 相同的触发词。

patterns.name: 测试代码中的属性断言
patterns.context: Ruby/RSpec 风格测试中，检查属性默认值为 present；ensure 出现在测试名称和被检查属性名中。

patterns.name: ensure 的不同句法语境
patterns.trigger: «ensure»10 后分别接“this transition is as smooth as possible”“that my siblings and I received…”“that there is public power”“that you get a well paying job”
patterns.context: ensure 表示保证或促成某种结果，涉及组织转型、家庭支持、能源供应和职业发展；共享词形，但语义主题多样。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、论坛叙述与评论

patterns.name: 词缀边界中的 censure/licensure
patterns.context: ensure 恰好是较长单词 licensure 和 censure 的结尾子串，语义分别为执照/资格许可与谴责，并非动词 ensure。
patterns.domain: PubMed 学术摘要、历史小说

en.description: The most prominent cue is the word form ensure (including a key name in code), which occurs across registers; three other contextually distinct instances of probably also trigger equally strong activation. The remaining activation markers are weak and scattered, making a shared pattern difficult to confirm.

patterns.name: ensure stem
patterns.context: ensure appears mid-sentence, followed by a that-clause, complement, or phrase expressing a goal/result; the most consistent and strongest trigger is the complete word ensure
patterns.domain: General English across multiple fields, including business email, personal narratives, energy markets, job-seeking advice, literature, and nursing education

patterns.name: probably
patterns.context: probably appears in a judgment or prediction, modifying “not transcribed,” “take a while,” and “my location,” respectively; the passages differ in meaning and register
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, business email, software descriptions

patterns.name: ensure in code
patterns.context: In Ruby test code, ensure is part of an attribute key name and appears in an assertion, rather than being used as an ordinary English verb

3_2754.description: 最突出的线索是词形 ensure（含代码中的键名），跨语体出现；另有三个语境各异的 probably 触发同等强激活。其余激活标记弱且分散，难以据此确认共同模式。

patterns.name: ensure 词干
patterns.context: ensure 位于句中，后接 that 从句、补语或表示目标/结果的短语；最稳定、最强的触发线索是完整词 ensure
patterns.domain: 多领域普通英语，包括商务邮件、个人叙述、能源市场、求职建议、文学与护理教育

patterns.name: probably
patterns.context: probably 出现在判断或预测句中；分别修饰“not transcribed”“take a while”“my location”，各段语义和语体不同
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、商务邮件、软件说明

patterns.name: 代码中的 ensure
patterns.context: Ruby 测试代码中，ensure 是属性键名的一部分，出现在断言表达式里，而非普通英语动词用法

en.description: Strong activations are concentrated on ensure/censure forms and probably; there are also line breaks and several sporadic word markers. The first two span multiple domains, with no stable shared sentence meaning or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: ensure stem
patterns.context: The complete word ensure, or forms beginning with censure / cens-er; the stem appears in sentences, list headings, or code
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: email, forums, code, literature, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: probably
patterns.context: The adverb probably modifies a judgment or expectation within a sentence

patterns.name: Line-break marker
patterns.context: Multiple line breaks are marked as activations, but their positions and contexts vary
patterns.domain: Code, email, forums, literature, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on common words and punctuation
patterns.context: No consistent local syntactic or semantic condition; apparently low-intensity, scattered triggers

3_2754.description: 强激活集中在 ensure/censure 词形及 probably；另有换行符和若干分散词标记。前两类横跨多领域，未见稳定的共同句义或语法条件。

patterns.name: ensure词干
patterns.context: 完整词 ensure，或以 censure / cens-er 开头的词形；词干出现在句中、列表标题或代码中
