patterns.domain: 跨领域：邮件、论坛、代码、文学、百科

patterns.name: probably
patterns.context: 副词 probably 在句中修饰判断或预期

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 多处换行符被标记为激活，但出现位置和语境不一
patterns.domain: 代码、邮件、论坛、文学、百科

patterns.name: 普通词与标点的零散激活
patterns.context: 缺少一致的局部句法或语义条件，似乎是低强度、分散触发

en.description: The main consistent response is to probably, expressing conjecture across multiple fields; there is also local activation on ensure, user-directed You, place in meeting arrangements, and several newline markers. The latter groups lack shared semantics.

patterns.name: High activation on probably
patterns.context: The word probably itself triggers consistent, strong activation in a sentence position expressing uncertainty about an event, judgment, or result; nearby topics vary widely.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language, including email, medical abstracts, forum posts, Q&A, and mathematical explanations

patterns.name: Activation on ensure
patterns.context: The verb means to ensure an outcome or state; one instance in test code means the default state should be present, and another in a personal narrative means ensuring children receive a good education.

patterns.name: you in location-setting instructions
patterns.context: Directly instructs the user, followed by need to set your location.

patterns.name: place in meeting arrangements
patterns.context: Used to schedule the time and location of a meeting, in the phrase take place tomorrow.

patterns.name: Newline markers
patterns.context: Activation markers appear at text line breaks; they occur across various formats and corpora, with no stable semantic context observed.
patterns.domain: Email, code, forums, and Q&A text

3_2754.description: 主要稳定响应 probably（多领域中表达推测）；另对 ensure、面向用户的 You、会议安排中的 place 及若干换行标记有局部激活，后几类缺少共同语义。

patterns.name: probably 的高激活
patterns.context: 词 probably 本身稳定强激活，出现在句中对事件、判断或结果作不确定推测的位置；附近主题差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言，包括邮件、医学摘要、论坛帖子、问答及数学说明

patterns.name: ensure 的激活
patterns.context: 确保某种结果或状态的动词；一处在测试代码中表示默认状态应为 present，另一处在个人叙述中表示确保子女获得良好教育。
patterns.domain: 代码测试；论坛个人叙述

patterns.name: 地点设置指令中的 you
patterns.context: 直接对用户发出操作指引，后接 need to set your location。

patterns.name: 会议安排中的 place
patterns.context: 用于安排会议发生的时间地点，出现在 take place tomorrow 的短语中。

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 激活标记出现在文本换行处；分布于多种格式和语料，未见稳定的语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 邮件、代码、论坛及问答文本

en.description: The most prominent common cue is probably, appearing in uncertain judgments across domains. Other activations are scattered across line breaks, code markers, second-person instructions, medical word segmentation, and time-and-place formats, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: probably and nearby expressions
patterns.context: probably appears in a sentence, often qualifying a subsequent judgment, explanation, or prediction with uncertainty; sometimes preceded by It/which/Your code, and sometimes near the beginning of a sentence.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain email, Q&A, medical abstracts, and news headlines

patterns.name: Line-break and whitespace-format tokens
patterns.context: Consecutive line breaks, indentation, and line separators appear in Q&A posts or code snippets; activations fall on formatting boundaries rather than a single semantic word.
patterns.domain: StackExchange Q&A, code, and forum titles

patterns.name: Local code or markup structures
patterns.context: Technical text contains embedded code, identifiers, paths, type names, or mathematical expressions; no consistent language-specific structure.
patterns.domain: Software development Q&A, test code, and mathematical expressions

patterns.name: Second-person suggestions or requests
patterns.context: Directly asks the reader to set a location; probably also appears later in this example.

patterns.name: Word segmentation and morphological boundaries in medical terminology
patterns.context: Specialized long words are split into multiple tokens and involve compounds or hyphenated forms; probably also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Headline-style phrases and proper nouns
patterns.context: Short news headlines use noun phrases and place names; probably also appears in the passage.

patterns.name: Time and place formatting in meeting information
patterns.context: Business email lists meeting times, a range, and a room number; probably also appears in the same passage.

3_2754.description: 最突出的共同线索是 probably：它出现在多领域的不确定判断中。其余激活分散于换行、代码标记、第二人称指令、医学词切分及时间地点格式，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: probably 及其邻近表达
patterns.trigger: «probably»（[1]为强度10；[4][5]也标出 probably，其他段为 probably9）
patterns.context: 句中出现 probably，常用于对后续判断、解释或预测作不确定性限定；有时前接 It/which/Your code 等，有时位于句首附近。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的邮件、问答、医学摘要及新闻标题

patterns.name: 换行与空白格式 token
patterns.context: 问答帖子或代码片段中出现连续换行、缩进及行分隔；激活落在格式边界而非单一语义词上。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、代码及论坛标题

patterns.name: 局部代码或标记语言结构
patterns.context: 技术文本中嵌有代码、标识符、路径、类型名或数学式；没有一致的特定语言结构。
patterns.domain: 软件开发问答、测试代码与数学表达式

patterns.name: 第二人称建议或需求表达
patterns.context: 直接对读者提出设置位置的要求；此例还在后文出现 probably。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的分词与形态边界
patterns.context: 专业长词被切分成多个 token，且涉及复合词或连字符形式；同段另有 probably。

patterns.name: 标题式短语与专名
patterns.context: 短新闻标题中使用名词短语和地名；段内也出现 probably。

patterns.name: 会议信息中的时间与地点格式
patterns.context: 商务邮件列出会议时间、范围及房间编号；同段还出现 probably。

en.description: The most stable lexical trigger is the English adverb probably, which appears in speculative statements; multiple passages also activate at line breaks, indentation, email headers, or code-structure boundaries. Sporadic code identifiers and testing contexts also trigger activations and cannot be fully reduced to the same lexical meaning pattern.

patterns.name: Emphasis on probably
patterns.context: In ordinary English sentences, activations concentrate on the adverb probably; the sentences express speculation or uncertain judgments.
patterns.domain: Email, code comments or error messages, and web text

patterns.name: Line-break and indentation boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur at explicit line breaks and line-initial indentation in code blocks, email headers, or message bodies; common at structured-text boundaries.

patterns.name: Fatal call in test code
patterns.context: Go test code calls t.Fatal(err) when checking for configuration-loading errors.

patterns.name: ensure test assertion
patterns.context: A test assertion compares the ensure field with a present value; Puppet error text also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: JSON test code import path
patterns.context: The io/ioutil path fragment in a Go import list; adjacent imports include encoding/json, fmt, net/http, and testing.

patterns.name: Code indentation and test-file structure
patterns.context: Package declarations, import blocks, and blank-line structure in Go test files; activations also fall on several punctuation and indentation tokens.

patterns.name: Polite requests and coordination in email
patterns.context: The body of a business email contains requests, collaboration, or discussion of information; no strong trigger word matching probably is evident.

patterns.name: Email subject and recipient fields
patterns.context: Email header fields and their line breaks, followed by a brief personal and emotional message.

patterns.name: Ensuring language in process notices
patterns.context: A notice says inventory information will be used to coordinate departments to ensure a smooth transition; does not contain probably.

3_2754.description: 最稳定的词汇触发是英语副词 probably，出现在推测性陈述中；同时多段在换行、缩进、邮件头或代码结构边界激活。另有零散代码标识符与测试语境触发，不能完全归并为同一词义模式。

patterns.name: probably 的强调
patterns.context: 在普通英语句子中，激活集中在副词 probably；句子表达推测或不确定判断。
patterns.domain: 邮件、代码注释或错误信息、网页文本

patterns.name: 换行与缩进边界
patterns.context: 代码块、邮件头或正文中的显式换行和行首缩进处激活；常见于结构化文本边界。

patterns.name: 测试代码中的 Fatal 调用
patterns.context: Go 测试代码中，检查配置加载错误时调用 t.Fatal(err)。

patterns.name: ensure 测试断言
patterns.context: 测试断言中将 ensure 字段与 present 值比较；同段还出现 Puppet 错误文本。

patterns.name: JSON 测试代码导入路径
patterns.context: Go 导入列表中的 io/ioutil 路径片段；相邻还有 encoding/json、fmt、net/http、testing 等导入。

patterns.name: 代码缩进与测试文件结构
patterns.context: Go 测试文件的包声明、导入块和空行结构；激活也落在若干标点及缩进 token 上。

patterns.name: 邮件中的礼貌请求与协调
patterns.context: 商务邮件正文中提出请求、协作或讨论信息；未见与 probably 相同的强触发词。

patterns.name: 邮件标题与收件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件头部字段及其换行，随后是简短的个人情感正文。

patterns.name: 流程通知中的确保措辞
patterns.context: 通知说明库存信息将用于协调部门，以确保过渡顺利；不含 probably。

en.description: Highly activated tokens are mostly ensure (making sure something happens or holds) or your (second-person possessive), appearing in instructions, narratives, legal text, and email; FOR also appears in GPL terms, adjacent to wording about your options. Trigger words are not distributed uniformly.

patterns.name: ensure with a that-clause
patterns.context: ensure means “make certain” and introduces an outcome, discussion, or technical compatibility; activation concentrates on ensure
patterns.domain: Email, forum narratives, and legal text

patterns.name: GNU GPL license terms
patterns.context: License disclaimers or lists of terms; includes asterisks at the start of lines and line breaks

patterns.name: your possessive and customer context
patterns.context: Second-person possessive referring to the other party’s options or a customer; appears in ordinary email contexts

patterns.name: your near the name Beard
patterns.context: Promotional copy describes an organization as a one-stop source of information for the reader; the activated token is your

patterns.name: ensure in other contexts
patterns.context: Appears in a quotation of a court review standard, still meaning “make certain,” but not in GPL or operational instructions

3_2754.description: 高激活 token 多为 ensure（确保某事发生/成立）或 your（第二人称所有格），分别见说明、叙述、法律及邮件；另在 GPL 条款中出现 FOR，且与你的选项措辞相邻。触发词分布并不统一。

patterns.name: ensure 与 that 从句
patterns.context: ensure 用作“确保”，引出结果、讨论或技术兼容性；激活集中在 ensure 上
patterns.domain: 邮件、论坛叙述、法律文本

patterns.name: GNU GPL 许可证条款
patterns.trigger: «FOR»10；以及“GNU General Public License”“either version 2/3 … or … (at your option) any later version”
patterns.context: 许可证免责声明或条款列表；出现逐行星号标记和换行

patterns.name: your 所有格及客户语境
patterns.context: 第二人称所有格，指向对方的选项或客户；在普通邮件语境中出现

patterns.name: Beard 名称附近的 your
patterns.context: 宣传语称某机构是读者获取信息的一站式来源；激活 token 为 your

patterns.name: 其他语境中的 ensure
patterns.context: 见于法院审查标准的引述，语义仍为确保，但不属于 GPL 或操作说明

en.concept: probably followed by a speculative judgment
en.description: The most stable trigger is probably, used to express speculation; possessive/contraction s, first- and second-person pronouns, line breaks, and a few numbers, punctuation marks, and code-format fragments also activate, across blogs, web pages, and technical forums.

patterns.name: Judgment following probably
patterns.context: Speculative or diagnostic content follows “probably,” marking a judgment as possible; the trigger is concentrated on probably itself.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, comments, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Strong activation on possessive s
patterns.context: The s in a possessive or contraction receives strong activation, in forms including Google’s, What’s, and there’s.
patterns.domain: Blogs, web content, and forum text

patterns.name: s in interrogative marker
patterns.context: The s in the question form “What’s”; here it may be a contraction of is or a possessive interrogative construction.

patterns.name: Emphasis words in blog-navigation contexts
patterns.context: The pronouns I or my are marked in first-person narratives, in personal-experience, blog, or comment contexts.
patterns.domain: Blogs and Hacker News personal comments

patterns.name: you in email templates
patterns.context: Directly addresses the reader or user, appearing in confirmation-email prompts or user-facing instructions.
patterns.domain: Web email copy and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Line breaks
patterns.context: Line breaks are repeatedly marked across multiple passages, especially in Q&A formatting, logs, and separated content.
patterns.domain: Web pages, Q&A, logs, and comment formatting

patterns.name: Non-primary pattern: numbering and version numbers
patterns.context: Numbers appear in specific values such as software versions, durations, or percentages.

patterns.name: Non-primary pattern: colon in formatted text
patterns.context: The answer label “A:” is followed by a line break, as part of Q&A formatting.

patterns.name: Non-primary pattern: location
patterns.context: In instructions for setting a default location and using GPS.

patterns.name: Non-primary pattern: intensifier really
patterns.context: In first-person sentences expressing a plea or a strong desire or feeling.

patterns.name: Non-primary pattern: code-format symbols
patterns.context: When discussing code implementation and dynamic_cast, parentheses, underscores, and other code-format fragments activate.

patterns.name: Non-primary pattern: formatted personal-preference words
patterns.context: Describes preferences for code formatting and structure; adjacent to general technical narration.

3_2754.description: 最稳定的触发是 probably，用于表达推测；另有所有格/缩写 s、第一及第二人称代词、换行和少量数字、标点、代码格式片段激活，分布于博客、网页和技术论坛。

patterns.name: probably 后续判断内容
patterns.context: “probably”后接推测或诊断内容，标记可能性的判断；触发集中在 probably 本身。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、评论与技术讨论

patterns.name: 所有格 s 的高激活
patterns.context: 所有格或缩写中的 s 单独获得强激活，形式既包括 Google’s，也包括 What’s、there’s。
patterns.domain: 博客、网页内容与论坛文本

patterns.name: 疑问句标记 s
patterns.context: 疑问表达“What’s”中的 s；此处既可能是 is 的缩写，也可能是所有格式问句构造。

patterns.name: 博客导航语境中的强调词
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中代词 I 或 my 被标记，出现在个人经历、博客或评论语境。
patterns.domain: 博客及 Hacker News 个人评论

patterns.name: 邮件模板中的 you
patterns.context: 直接称呼读者或用户，出现在确认邮件提示或面向用户的说明中。
patterns.domain: 网页邮件文案、技术问答

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 多段文本中换行符反复被标记，尤其是问答格式、日志与分隔内容。
patterns.domain: 网页、问答、日志和评论排版

patterns.name: 非主模式：编号与版本号
patterns.context: 数字出现在软件版本号、时长或百分比等具体数值中。

patterns.name: 非主模式：格式化文本中的冒号
patterns.context: 答案标签“A:”后接换行，属于问答排版。

patterns.name: 非主模式：地点词 location
patterns.context: 设置默认位置并涉及 GPS 的说明中。

patterns.name: 非主模式：强调程度词 really
patterns.context: 求助或表达强烈希望、感受的第一人称句子中。

patterns.name: 非主模式：代码格式符号
patterns.context: 讨论代码实现与 dynamic_cast 时，括号、下划线等代码格式片段有激活。

patterns.name: 非主模式：格式化个人偏好词
patterns.context: 描述对代码格式和结构的偏好；与一般技术叙述相邻。

en.description: The highest activation in every passage falls on the first-person possessive my, followed by nouns such as personal problems, resources, work, devices, or accounts; the surrounding context is often forum help-seeking or personal-experience narration.

patterns.name: Possessive my followed by a self-related object
patterns.context: In dialogue or posts, the first-person possessive my is immediately followed by a noun or noun phrase; objects include problems, contacts, posts, columns, devices/services, wardrobes, and email addresses.
patterns.domain: Questions, help-seeking posts, and comments on StackExchange and HackerNews

patterns.name: Tense or judgment words in first-person narration
patterns.context: A predicate or related narrative follows first-person I, while strong activation on my remains the primary target; only these words activate weakly, possibly reflecting nearby context.

patterns.name: First-person experience in conversational questions
patterns.context: my occurs with first when explaining a first post or a first encounter with a situation; activation still falls on my.

3_2754.description: 各段最高激活都落在第一人称所有格 my，后接个人问题、资源、作品、设备或账户等名词；周围常是论坛求助或个人经历叙述。

patterns.name: 所有格 my 后接自我相关对象
patterns.trigger: «my»10 issue；«my»10 contact；«my»10 first post；«my»10 column；«my»10 Open；«my»9 wardrobe；«my»9 email
patterns.context: 对话或帖子中的第一人称所有格 my 后，紧接名词或名词性成分；对象涵盖问题、联系人、帖子、列、设备/服务、衣橱和邮箱地址。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 HackerNews 的提问、求助和评论

patterns.name: 第一人称叙述中的时态或判断词
patterns.trigger: «I»2«'m»4 only showing；«I»3 am creating；«I»2 often update；«I»3 know；«I»3 need；«I»3 would；«I»2 translate
patterns.context: 第一人称 I 后的谓语或相关叙述中，my 的强激活仍是主要靶点；仅这些词的激活较弱，可能反映其邻近上下文。

patterns.name: 口语式提问中的第一人称经历
patterns.context: 在解释首次发帖或首次遇到某种情况时，my 与 first 连用；激活点仍落在 my。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the positive evaluative word nice in comments, commonly in the sentence pattern “It's nice” and its extensions, praising tools, ideas, content, experiences, or approaches; also covers adjacent technical contexts such as mobile reading, recollections of link services, and technical Q&A.

patterns.name: It’s nice evaluative sentence pattern
patterns.context: Positively evaluates a tool, idea, feature, article, or situation in a comment or reply; nice is often marked as a strong trigger, and the pattern can include really, to see, but, and other elements
patterns.domain: Mostly HackerNews comments, also blog contexts

patterns.name: nice and easier evaluative combination
patterns.context: The author describes their approach becoming easier and praises how the relevant feature works

patterns.name: AMP speed and reading experience
patterns.context: Introduces AMP’s speed and relates it to the experience of reading news on a phone; nice appears in an adjacent comment context

patterns.name: nice idea and reservations
patterns.context: First affirms an idea, then expresses regret, limitations, or further doubt with "too bad" or a question

patterns.name: API application development context
patterns.context: A Q&A title or technical question describes building and authenticating a Web application; the main nice evaluative pattern is absent

patterns.name: nice and information discovery
patterns.context: Praises a blog article with extensive references and says it helps discover sources of inspiration

patterns.name: nice describing a service’s continued availability
patterns.context: Recounts the migration or continuation of a link-bookmarking service, with nice introducing a positive evaluation of the service’s later status
patterns.domain: Personal recollections and online service comments

patterns.name: nice to see and optimization
patterns.context: Affirms that something is explicitly treated as an optimization problem

3_2754.description: 主要对评论中的正面评价词 nice 敏感，常见句式为 “It's nice”及其扩展，用于称赞工具、想法、内容、体验或处理方式；另覆盖移动阅读、链接服务回忆及技术问答等相邻技术语境。

patterns.name: It’s nice 评价句式
patterns.trigger: "It" + "'s" + " nice"，多见完整片段 "It's nice to see"、"It's nice idea" 或 "It's nice how"
patterns.context: 在评论或回复中对某个工具、想法、功能、文章或情况作正面评价；nice 常被标记为强触发词，句式可带 really、to see、but 等成分
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论为主，也见博客语境

patterns.name: nice 与 easier 的评价组合
patterns.context: 作者描述自身做法变得更容易，并称赞相关功能如何运作

patterns.name: AMP 快速与阅读体验
patterns.context: 介绍 AMP 的速度，并将其与手机阅读新闻的体验联系起来；nice 出现在相邻评论语境中
patterns.domain: 移动 Web 技术评论

patterns.name: nice idea 及其保留意见
patterns.context: 先肯定某个想法，随后以 "too bad" 或疑问句表达遗憾、限制或进一步质疑

patterns.name: API 应用开发语境
patterns.context: 以问答标题或技术问题描述 Web 应用构建与认证；未出现主要 nice 评价句式

patterns.name: nice 与信息发现
patterns.context: 称赞带有充分参考资料的博客文章，并说它有助于发现灵感来源

patterns.name: nice 描述服务持续可用
patterns.context: 回顾链接收藏服务迁移或延续，nice 引出对服务后来状况的正面评价
patterns.domain: 个人回忆及网络服务评论

patterns.name: nice to see 与优化
patterns.trigger: "It's nice to see this specifically treated as an optimization"
patterns.context: 肯定某项内容被明确作为优化问题处理

en.description: Activation is scattered across explanatory language in code, identifiers, and technical text, especially first-person attempts/help requests, explanations of operations or results, and suggestions or evaluations; it also covers distinct topics such as tool recommendations, interface styling, language semantics, and testing, with no single fixed trigger word.

patterns.name: Function words near code identifiers and punctuation
patterns.context: In code, comments, question text, or at the boundary between code and explanation, trigger words typically occur in sentences describing an object, operation, or relation; the trigger words vary across passages rather than forming a single fixed token
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, code comments, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Help-seeking and attempts in problem descriptions
patterns.context: First-person descriptions of attempts to implement, reproduce, or find a feature, often accompanied by difficulties or problem context

patterns.name: Return, results, and subsequent actions
patterns.context: Describes how an application determines its next step based on the result after switching activities or processes

patterns.name: Suggested code changes or assignment scope
patterns.context: An answer points out that the existing range object is already available and suggests modifying an assignment statement in VBA code

patterns.name: Blogs, tools, and positive evaluations
patterns.context: Shares a blog or instructions for using a tool, and positively evaluates its effectiveness

patterns.name: Operator declarations and precedence
patterns.context: Explains that operator declarations in two modules use the same precedence group, so there is no ambiguity
patterns.domain: Programming language implementation or code review

patterns.name: Tooltip style feature query
patterns.context: Asks whether tooltip background color and text styling can be customized in PrimeFaces

patterns.name: Preference for sidenotes and scanability evaluation
patterns.context: Discusses how a website is presented, expressing a personal preference and noting that sidenotes are easy to scan

patterns.name: Cross-language function porting and difficulty understanding
patterns.context: Attempts to reproduce an R function in Matlab and explains that lack of R experience makes the code difficult to understand

patterns.name: Test assertions and robustness evaluation
patterns.context: Shows an assertion in a code test and evaluates the test as not very robust, but the best available option

3_2754.concept: 技术语境中的说明性文本
3_2754.description: 激活分散在代码、标识符及技术文本中的说明性语言，尤见第一人称尝试/求助、解释操作或结果、提出修改与评价；另覆盖工具推荐、界面样式、语言语义及测试等独立主题，未见统一固定触发词。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与标点附近的功能词
patterns.trigger: 代码中的标识符、标点或代码片段附近出现的 «I»、«it»、«this»、«the»、«to»、«in»、«of»、«and»、«is» 等自然语言 token；另有 «.»、«↵» 等标记
patterns.context: 代码、注释、问题正文或代码与解释交界处，触发词通常处于说明对象、操作或关系的句子中；各段触发词不同，并非单一固定 token
patterns.domain: 编程问答、代码注释及技术讨论

patterns.name: 问题描述中的求助与尝试措辞
patterns.context: 第一人称描述正在尝试实现、复现或查找功能，常伴随困难或问题背景

patterns.name: 回返、结果与后续操作
patterns.context: 描述应用在活动或流程切换后，根据返回结果决定后续步骤

patterns.name: 建议修改代码或赋值范围
patterns.context: 回答指出现有范围对象已可用，并建议修改 VBA 代码中的赋值语句

patterns.name: 博客、工具与正面评价
patterns.trigger: «That» «'s» what «I» did in my blog post；«it» «'s» «nice»；«errorbar_tick»
patterns.context: 分享博客或工具用法，并对其效果作正面评价

patterns.name: 操作符声明与优先级
patterns.context: 解释两个模块中操作符声明相同优先级组，因此不存在歧义
patterns.domain: 编程语言实现或代码审查

patterns.name: tooltip 样式功能查询
patterns.context: 询问 PrimeFaces 中 tooltip 背景色与文字样式的定制能力

patterns.name: 对侧注释的偏好及可扫描性评价
patterns.context: 讨论网站呈现方式，表达个人偏好并说明侧注释便于浏览

patterns.name: 跨语言函数移植及理解困难
patterns.context: 尝试将 R 函数复现到 Matlab，并说明缺少 R 经验导致难以理解代码

patterns.name: 测试断言与稳健性评价
patterns.context: 代码测试中展示断言，并评价该测试不够稳健但已是可找到的最佳方案

en.concept: Problem and analysis language in technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of technical text: code identifiers and object types, performance optimization, statistical analysis, frontend scope, error reproduction, and whether security measures are wise; no single clear trigger word spans all passages.

patterns.name: Identifiers, member access, and assignment in code
patterns.context: Appears in VBA code lines, especially around object/range member access, assignment, and line breaks; activations concentrate on code syntax fragments and do not establish dedicated semantics for a single identifier.
patterns.domain: StackExchange; Excel/VBA programming Q&A and code

patterns.name: Performance optimization in programming questions
patterns.context: Discusses runtime performance of algorithms, data structures, or collections, often co-occurring with technical terms such as C++, OpenMPI, set intersection, and hashCode.

patterns.name: Types, objects, and generic collections
patterns.context: Discusses whether an object belongs to a type, type constraints on method parameters, or collection elements and type instances in questions or sample code.
patterns.domain: StackExchange; object-oriented programming and Web development

patterns.name: Statistical analysis and relationships among multiple factors
patterns.context: Research abstracts report organizational data analysis results involving regression, correlation coefficients, and the contributions of multiple factors to change.

patterns.name: Frontend directives, variables, and scope access
patterns.context: Angular-style directive code and template explanations discuss whether variables defined in a controller can be accessed from a view.

patterns.name: Difficulty reproducing errors
patterns.context: A response explains that an error or problem is difficult to reproduce; activation falls on the phrase describing reproduction difficulty.

patterns.name: Security measures and whether they are wise
patterns.context: A Hacker News discussion asks whether a form is motivated by security considerations and whether a company’s approach is wise.

3_2754.concept: 技术文本中的问题与分析表述
3_2754.description: 激活分布在多类技术文本中：代码标识符与对象类型、性能优化、统计分析、前端作用域、错误复现，以及安全措施是否明智；没有贯穿所有段落的明确单一触发词。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符、成员访问与赋值
patterns.context: 出现在 VBA 代码行中，尤其是对象/范围的成员访问、赋值及换行附近；激活集中于代码语法片段，不足以确定单个标识符的专属语义。

patterns.name: 编程问题中的性能优化
patterns.context: 讨论算法、数据结构或集合的运行性能，常与 C++、OpenMPI、set intersection、hashCode 等技术词共现。

patterns.name: 类型、对象与泛型集合
patterns.context: 在提问或示例代码中讨论对象是否属于某类型、方法参数的类型约束，或集合元素及类型实例。
patterns.domain: StackExchange；面向对象编程与 Web 开发

patterns.name: 统计分析与多因素关系
patterns.trigger: «multiple linear regression analysis»、«correlation coefficients»、«independent factors contribute»
patterns.context: 研究摘要中陈述组织数据分析结果，涉及回归、相关系数及多个因素对变化的贡献。

patterns.name: 前端指令、变量与作用域访问
patterns.context: Angular 风格的指令代码与模板说明，讨论控制器中定义的变量能否从视图访问。

patterns.name: 错误复现困难
patterns.context: 回答中解释某错误或问题难以复现；激活落在描述复现难度的短语。

patterns.name: 安全措施与是否明智
patterns.context: Hacker News 讨论表单是否出于安全考虑，以及对公司做法是否明智的疑问。

en.concept: Problem and failure statements in technical Q&A
en.description: Activation mainly occurs in StackExchange technical Q&A contexts describing code, methods, or configurations that do not work, and requests for debugging help; there are also code assignment, parameter, and type issues, as well as emphasis on evidence in biomedical conclusions and statements about rebutting evidence in legal rulings.

patterns.name: Failure statements in StackExchange help requests
patterns.context: Describes a technical operation, code, or method that did not work as expected; also includes negative-result statements such as “doesn't seem to work” and “doesn't overwrite.”

patterns.name: NewRng near range or assignment code
patterns.context: In a VBA code discussion, the preceding text explains that the target range is already a Range object, followed by assignment code.

patterns.name: Emphasis on evidence in GLT-1 research conclusions
patterns.context: The conclusion section of an abstract states research findings, followed by a property or distribution of GLT-1.

patterns.name: rebutted in litigation rulings
patterns.context: In an immigration appeal ruling, states that the applicant failed to rebut certain evidence.

patterns.name: Method parameters and lookup of specific records
patterns.context: Asks how to pass an identifier value to a method to check or retrieve a specific record; also describes an invalid attempt.

patterns.name: Method accepts only a specific object type
patterns.context: Asks how to constrain a method parameter’s type and expresses confusion.

patterns.name: MD5 hash input type error
patterns.context: Shows code for generating a hash and an error message, noting that the input should be a string or buffer rather than a list.

3_2754.concept: 技术问答中的问题与失败表述
3_2754.description: 激活主要见于 StackExchange 技术问答中描述代码、方法或配置不起作用、求助排错的语境；另有代码赋值、参数与类型问题，以及生物医学结论中的证据强调和法律判决中的反驳证据表述。

patterns.name: StackExchange 求助中的失败表达
patterns.context: 技术操作、代码或方法之后描述未按预期工作；也出现“doesn't seem to work”“doesn't overwrite”等否定结果表述。

patterns.name: 范围或赋值代码附近的 NewRng
patterns.context: VBA 代码讨论中，前文解释目标范围已是 Range 对象，后接赋值代码。

patterns.name: GLT-1 研究结论中的证据强调
patterns.context: 摘要结论部分陈述研究发现，后续接 GLT-1 的性质或分布。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学论文摘要

patterns.name: 诉讼裁决中的 rebutted
patterns.context: 移民上诉裁决叙述中，说明申请人未能反驳某项证据。

patterns.name: 方法参数与特定记录检索
patterns.context: 提问如何向方法传入标识值，以检查或检索特定记录；同时出现无效尝试的描述。

patterns.name: 方法仅接受特定对象类型
patterns.trigger: accept only objects of base type Component
patterns.context: 询问如何约束方法参数类型，并表达困惑。

patterns.name: MD5 哈希输入类型错误
patterns.context: 展示生成哈希的代码及错误信息，指出输入应为字符串或缓冲区而非列表。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code punctuation and comments, Chinese software copy, technical Q&A phrasing, and words in medical discussions; no common trigger condition consistently covers all passages. Although the medical passages include terms such as evidence and long-term outcomes, they are difficult to unify with the code and Q&A patterns.

patterns.name: Punctuation and boundary symbols in code
patterns.context: Appears in code or code snippets, especially at separators in statements, expressions, and member access; the specific activated symbols vary across passages.

patterns.name: Apostrophe in example-introducing phrases
patterns.context: Appears in English explanatory text in expressions such as “here's an example” that introduce an example.

patterns.name: Evidence statements in English medical papers
patterns.context: Statements connecting research results, evidence, and long-term effects in medical-paper abstracts or main text; activations fall on multiple function and content words in the discussion.

patterns.name: Relationship and class-hierarchy terms in Chinese interface copy
patterns.context: Chinese software documentation or web navigation describes file-extension associations, category indexes, or class inheritance.

patterns.name: Clear action in English code comments
patterns.context: A comment describes clearing MIME attachments for the current request.

patterns.name: Chinese input prompt in a code string
patterns.context: A Chinese prompt in an Objective-C format string describes the passed-in content.

patterns.name: Uncertainty and verification language
patterns.context: The questioner expresses doubt about whether UUID-generation code is correct and whether uniqueness can be verified.

patterns.name: Emphasis word in English technical documentation
patterns.context: A common definite article is marked at a particular sentence position in a technical explanation; it occurs in only one passage, making it difficult to identify an independent semantic condition.

3_2754.description: 激活分散在代码标点与注释、中文软件文案、技术问答措辞及医学论述词语中；没有稳定覆盖所有片段的共同触发条件。医学片段虽有证据与长期结果等词，但与代码和问答模式难以统一。

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与边界符号
patterns.context: 出现在代码或代码片段中，尤其是语句、表达式和成员访问的分隔位置；不同片段激活的具体符号不完全相同。

patterns.name: 示例引出语中的撇号
patterns.context: 英文说明文字中，出现在“here's an example”一类引出示例的表达里。

patterns.name: 英文医学论文中的证据表述
patterns.context: 医学论文摘要或正文中，连接研究结果、证据与长期影响的陈述；激活落在论述中的多个功能词和内容词上。

patterns.name: 中文界面文案中的关联与类层级术语
patterns.context: 中文软件文档或网页导航中，描述文件扩展名关联、类别索引或类继承关系。
patterns.domain: Github 软件文档/界面文本

patterns.name: 英文代码注释中的清除动作
patterns.context: 注释说明对当前请求的 MIME 附件执行清除操作。

patterns.name: 代码字符串中的中文输入提示
patterns.context: Objective-C 格式化字符串中，中文提示说明传入内容。

patterns.name: 不确定语气与验证表述
patterns.context: 提问者表达对 UUID 生成代码是否正确、是否能验证唯一性的疑虑。

patterns.name: 英文技术文档中的强调词
patterns.context: 技术解释中，普通定冠词在句子特定位置被标记；仅见于一段，难以确定独立语义条件。

en.concept: Multiple text cues, with clears as the main cue
en.description: The most prominent repeated activation cue is “clears” in code comments; other cases include the academic phrase “evidence that,” bash completion, Kerberos logs, HTML prompts and navigation, an Objective-C launch callback, and an explanation of an even/odd algorithm, with no unified semantics observed.

patterns.name: Clear operation
patterns.context: Code comments or documentation describing clearing content, bits, or data

patterns.name: that in evidence statements
patterns.context: Introduces research findings or conclusions as evidence

patterns.name: bash completion
patterns.context: Describes command arguments or a command completion callback
patterns.domain: GitHub code comments and struct definitions

patterns.name: Kerberos
patterns.context: Appears as information in a system log or as the name of an authentication protocol

patterns.name: No-script browser prompt and banner navigation
patterns.context: HTML page prompts that JavaScript is disabled, then defines the page banner and navigation area

patterns.name: Objective-C launch callback
patterns.context: An AppDelegate application launch method and its customization comment

patterns.name: Parity check and comparison
patterns.context: Explains that odd numbers can skip individual checks, while even numbers require continuing the check

3_2754.concept: 多种文本线索，主线索为 clears
3_2754.description: 激活最突出的重复线索是代码注释中的“clears”；此外也见论文“evidence that”句式、bash补全、Kerberos日志、HTML提示与导航、Objective-C启动回调，以及奇偶数算法说明，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 清除操作
patterns.context: 代码注释或文档描述清除内容、位或数据

patterns.name: 证据陈述中的 that
patterns.context: 以证据引出研究发现或结论

patterns.name: bash 补全
patterns.context: 说明命令参数或命令补全回调
patterns.domain: Github 代码注释与结构体定义

patterns.name: Kerberos
patterns.context: 出现在系统日志的信息或认证协议名称列表中

patterns.name: 浏览器无脚本提示与横幅导航
patterns.context: HTML 页面提示 JavaScript 已禁用，随后定义页面横幅和导航区域

patterns.name: Objective-C 启动回调
patterns.context: AppDelegate 的应用启动方法及其自定义化注释

patterns.name: 奇偶判断与比较
patterns.context: 解释奇数可跳过逐一检查、偶数需继续检查的算法

en.description: Activations are distributed across code describing clearing and protection actions and type/call expressions, restrictions and explanatory wording in Q&A, and argumentation or mechanism descriptions in scientific, patent, and legal texts; no single trigger pattern covers all segments.

patterns.name: Clearing/protection actions
patterns.context: Code comments describe clearing certain content or bits; one instance clears MIME attachments, another clears certain bits of key coefficients.

patterns.name: Preventing, resisting, or constraining
patterns.context: Contexts involving preventing negative values, protecting materials from external forces, or restricting the objects accepted by a method.

patterns.name: Program calls and parameters/types
patterns.context: Software documentation or Q&A discusses function calls, command parameters, types, collections, instances, or request objects.

patterns.name: Examples, explanations, and question phrasing
patterns.context: Programming Q&A introduces examples, clarifies questions, or expresses confusion.

patterns.name: Connective/argumentative wording in general statements
patterns.context: Explains conclusions, evidence, or matters to be determined; activations occur near connectives or discourse structure.

patterns.name: Scientific mechanisms and research subjects
patterns.context: Discusses immune tolerance, autoreactivity, or astrocyte-related expression and regulation.

patterns.name: Legal appeal and voluntariness determinations
patterns.context: Determines whether a waiver of appeal rights in a plea agreement was knowing and voluntary, subject to whether the record is complete.

A few other activations fall on internal fragments of words such as Obstetrics, reflection, ticks, term, and Beats; their semantics and style are inconsistent, possibly reflecting subword fragments rather than a shared topic.

patterns.trigger: “trouble”及其邻近表达，如 “I'm having trouble”, “I have trouble”, “I am having trouble”
patterns.context: 在提问或说明问题时，尤其是 trouble 后接 with、getting、figuring out 等；不要求特定技术问题类型。

patterns.name: trouble 后的介词 with
patterns.context: trouble 与 with 连用，后接要处理的对象或问题；在 [1]、[6]、[8] 中有明显激活。

patterns.name: trouble 后接 getting
patterns.context: 描述难以取得、实现或完成某事，getting 后接目标或任务。

patterns.name: trouble 后接 figuring out
patterns.context: 描述难以找出解决办法或理解某事。

patterns.name: 技术术语内部的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词或标识符的内部/末尾片段；这些例子彼此语义与上下文不同。
patterns.domain: 医学机构名称、代码、论坛文本

patterns.name: term 的复合词部分
patterns.context: 出现在神经网络模型名称 LSTM 的展开形式中。

patterns.name: 专名中的词尾音节
patterns.context: 出现在歌曲名 “Until It Beats No More” 中，未见与其他模式相同的语境。

en.concept: English trouble expressions and scattered subwords
en.description: The clearest pattern is “I’m having trouble…” and the subsequent problem-solving action in technical Q&A; there are also newline markers and intraword fragments in technical long words, along with isolated cases in song titles, medical terms, legal words, and Russian substrings that cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: English trouble and subsequent actions
patterns.context: In the “I’m having trouble …” structure, trouble is followed by problem-solving actions such as figuring out or getting

patterns.name: Local collocations of English trouble
patterns.context: Explicitly expresses difficulty; subsequent collocations are “figuring out,” “with getting,” and “getting … to link”

patterns.name: English paragraph boundaries/newlines
patterns.context: Newline markers, especially between StackExchange question titles and bodies, also appearing in code and segmented text

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Longer technical or code terms are split into multiple subwords; activation falls on intraword fragments, with no consistent meaning across the terms

patterns.name: Scattered triggers with negative or difficulty-related meaning in English
patterns.context: Expresses trouble, problems, or adverse consequences; apart from trouble, the isolated cases have no stable syntactic or word-form collocation

patterns.name: Beats in a song title
patterns.context: Appears in the song title “Until It Beats No More,” with strong activation concentrated on the intraword fragment “ats”

patterns.name: Medical term dysphagic
patterns.context: Appears in an abstract about drug delivery to patients with dysphagia, with activation concentrated on an intraword fragment

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in Russian
patterns.context: An intraword substring in a Russian reply, with no other matching pattern in Russian or across languages

patterns.name: Scattered word forms in legal text
patterns.context: Located separately in a legal quotation and the comment following it; the strongly activated “ogical” is adjacent to “to reason,” but has no stable correspondence with other fragments

3_2754.concept: 英文 trouble 表达及零散子词
3_2754.description: 最明显的模式是技术问答中“I’m having trouble…”及其后解决动作；另有换行和技术长词内部片段，以及歌曲、医学词、法律词与俄语子串等孤例，无法由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: 英文 trouble 及后续动作
patterns.context: 在“I’m having trouble …”结构中，trouble 后接 figuring out、getting 等解决问题的动作

patterns.name: 英文 trouble 的局部搭配
patterns.context: 明确表达遇到困难；后续搭配分别为“figuring out”“with getting”“getting … to link”

patterns.name: 英文段落边界/换行
patterns.context: 换行标记，尤见于 StackExchange 问题标题与正文之间，也见于代码和分段文本

patterns.name: 技术术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 较长的技术或代码术语被切分为多个子词；激活落在词内片段，具体词义并不一致
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、代码文档

patterns.name: 英语负面或困难语义的零散触发
patterns.context: 表达麻烦、问题或不利后果；除 trouble 外，单例之间没有稳定的句法或词形搭配
patterns.domain: 问答、网络文本、法律文本

patterns.name: 歌曲标题中的 Beats
patterns.context: 出现在歌曲名“Until It Beats No More”中，强激活集中在词内片段“ats”

patterns.name: 医学术语 dysphagic
patterns.context: 出现在描述吞咽困难患者的药物递送摘要中，激活集中于词内片段

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 俄语回复中的词内子串，未见其他俄语或跨语种相同模式

patterns.name: 法律文本中的零散词形
patterns.context: 分别位于法律引文及其后评论中；强激活的“ogical”与“to reason”相邻，但与其他片段无稳定对应

en.concept: Expressions of difficulty and requests for help
en.description: Primarily responds to “having trouble” and its continuations in help-seeking text; it also responds to “harder time,” which means having greater difficulty doing something. Both share a difficulty-related meaning. One activation on an iterator-related substring in a Russian programming text is difficult to group with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Help-seeking expression of currently having difficulty
patterns.context: A first-person help-seeker states that they are having difficulty, usually followed by a phrase specifying the problem, such as with, getting, seeing, or figuring out; also includes “I'm trying to understand ... but ... trouble ...”

patterns.name: Time collocation on HackerNews
patterns.context: Time is preceded by harder and followed by a verb or gerund phrase, meaning greater difficulty doing something; it does not use the common StackExchange trouble-help phrasing.

patterns.name: Iterator in code context
patterns.context: A Russian technical text discusses function parameters and includes a programming context such as “iterable container”; activation is concentrated on a character substring in a split token.

3_2754.description: 主要响应求助文本中的“having trouble”及其接续结构；另响应表示做事更困难的“harder time”，二者共享困难语义。另有一次俄语编程文本中迭代器相关子串激活，难与主模式归并。

patterns.name: 正在遇到困难的求助表述
patterns.trigger: “I'm having trouble”“I am having trouble”“I'm having trouble seeing”“I'm having trouble figuring out”
patterns.context: 第一人称求助者陈述遇到困难，通常接 with、getting、seeing、figuring out 等说明困难所在的短语；也包括“I'm trying to understand ... but ... trouble ...”

patterns.name: HackerNews 中的 time 搭配
patterns.context: time 前有 harder，后接动词或动名词短语，表示做某事更困难；不含 StackExchange 常见的 trouble 求助句式。

patterns.name: 代码语境中的迭代器
patterns.context: 俄语技术文本中谈论函数参数，并出现“迭代的容器”等编程上下文；激活集中于被拆分标记的字符子串。

en.concept: Difficulty expressions and sporadic subword fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to difficulty expressions such as “difficult for X to…” and “have a hard time”; also strongly activates on sporadic characters or words such as illogical to reason, Russian word endings, IRC, -ing, URL fragments, oxygen, and Overflow, which do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: difficult + for complement construction
patterns.context: In the “difficult for X to ...” construction, difficult is followed by for, introducing the affected entity and its subsequent action; preceding text often describes an arrangement, condition, or situation that creates an obstacle.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain expository writing, legal argumentation, technical texts, patent background

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “hard time”
patterns.context: In the phrase “have a hard time,” time indicates difficulty doing something; it is followed by gerunds/actions such as defending or understanding.

patterns.name: to in a logical-reasoning expression
patterns.context: The adjective illogical is followed by the infinitive to reason, expressing an evaluation of a particular way of reasoning.

patterns.name: Character fragment within a Russian word
patterns.context: In a Russian technical Q&A, an inflectional character at the end of the Russian word “последнее” (last) is marked; this segment shows no obvious English syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: IRC abbreviation
patterns.context: IRC refers to a relevant technology or system in a discussion of JSON serialization functionality; activation is concentrated on the abbreviation’s initial characters.

patterns.name: Verb ending -ing
patterns.context: The present participle ending of track appears in a technical paper sentence about tracking objects by users; this is inconsistent with the strongly triggering constructions in other segments.
patterns.domain: Computer vision or video analysis paper

patterns.name: Verb ending -ing (patent text)
patterns.context: The patent background describes dividing a virtual world into multiple instances; activation falls on the initial and final parts of the verb splitting.

patterns.name: Character sequence within a URL
patterns.context: Located within a webpage address in a HackerNews post, adjacent to URL text; it does not match the other main collocations.

patterns.name: oxygen in a biomedical phrase
patterns.context: In a discussion of cancer metastasis and treatment, oxygen in the term Reactive oxygen species is strongly activated.

patterns.name: Compound-word ending -flow
patterns.context: The word Overflow in a C++ code comment describes a bug during creation; activation is at the end of the compound word.

3_2754.concept: 困难表达及零散词片段
3_2754.description: 主要响应“difficult for X to…”和“have a hard time”这类困难表达；另对 illogical to reason、俄语词尾、IRC、-ing、URL片段、oxygen及Overflow等零散字符或词语有强激活，未能归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: difficult + for 补语结构
patterns.context: “difficult for X to ...”结构中，difficult 后接 for，并引出受影响对象及其后续动作；前文常说明某种安排、条件或情况造成障碍。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明文、法律论证、技术文本、专利背景

patterns.name: hard time 固定搭配
patterns.context: 短语“have a hard time”中，time 表示做某事有困难；后续接 defending 或 understanding 等动名词／动作。

patterns.name: 逻辑推理表达中的 to
patterns.context: 形容词 illogical 后接不定式 to reason，表达对某种推理方式的评价。

patterns.name: 俄语词内字符片段
patterns.context: 俄语技术问答里，俄语词“последнее”（最后的）末尾的词形变化字符被标记；该段未显示明显的英语句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 俄语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: IRC 缩写
patterns.context: 讨论 JSON 序列化功能时，以 IRC 指代相关技术或系统；激活集中在缩写开头字符。

patterns.name: 动词词尾 -ing
patterns.context: track 的现在分词词尾出现在关于用户跟踪对象的技术论文句子中；此处与其他段的强触发结构不一致。
patterns.domain: 计算机视觉或视频分析论文

patterns.name: 动词词尾 -ing（专利文本）
patterns.context: 专利背景描述将虚拟世界拆分成多个实例；激活落在动词 splitting 的词首和词尾部分。

patterns.name: URL 内字符序列
patterns.context: 位于 HackerNews 帖子的网页地址内，紧邻 URL 文本；不符合其他主要搭配。

patterns.name: 生物医学短语中的 oxygen
patterns.context: 癌症转移与治疗相关论述中，Reactive oxygen species（活性氧）这一术语里的 oxygen 被强烈激活。

patterns.name: 复合词词尾 -flow
patterns.context: C++ 代码注释里的 Overflow 一词，描述创建过程中的 bug；激活在复合词末尾。

en.description: Activations show various local spelling and lexical cues: Browse/Browse variants, several structures with for followed by a purpose or object, illogical to reason, defy, internal fragments of Russian words, and about in a SaaS discussion; these cues belong to different contexts.

patterns.name: Browser / Browse string
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on tokenized fragments of Browse or similar spellings; they occur in web-scraping commands, browser tasks in Go code, and a paper's cited author surname.

patterns.name: for followed by production-related content
patterns.context: In a patent sentence, for is followed by production quantities, expressing difficulty achieving precise alignment in mass production.

patterns.name: for followed by user purpose
patterns.context: In a technical paper describing spatial summarization and object tracking, for the user to… expresses the user's purpose.

patterns.name: for followed by compiler debugging purpose
patterns.context: In an explanation that templates make debugging difficult, for the debugger to… expresses the debugger's goal.

patterns.name: Fixed expression illogical reason
patterns.context: Legal text evaluates reasoning as illogical and uses the structure illogical to reason.

patterns.name: Misspelling defy
patterns.context: In a patent background sentence about anal lesions and treatment, defy internal therapies means difficult to overcome with therapies.

patterns.name: Russian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Several internal Cyrillic-letter fragments in Russian sentences are activated; they span discussions of regexes, addresses, and other topics, with no clear semantic constraint.

patterns.name: about in a SaaS discussion
patterns.context: In a discussion of desktop applications and cloud-based solutions, about is activated and followed by a question about the meaning of SaaS.

3_2754.description: 激活呈现多种局部拼写与词法线索：Browse/Browse 变体、多个 for 后接目的或对象的结构、illogical to reason、defy、俄语词内片段及 SaaS 讨论中的 about；这些线索分属不同语境。

patterns.name: 浏览器 / Browse 字符串
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Browse 的分词片段或相近拼写上；出现在网页抓取命令、Go 代码中的浏览器任务及论文引用作者姓氏中。

patterns.name: for 后接生产相关内容
patterns.context: 在专利句子中，for 后接 production quantities，表达批量生产时难以实现精确对齐。

patterns.name: for 后接用户目的
patterns.context: 在描述空间摘要与对象追踪的技术论文句子中，for the user to… 表示用户目的。

patterns.name: for 后接编译器调试目的
patterns.context: 在解释模板导致调试困难的句子中，for the debugger to… 表示调试器的目标。

patterns.name: illogical reason 固定表达
patterns.context: 法律文本中评价某种推理不合逻辑，出现 illogical to reason 的结构。

patterns.name: 拼写错误 defy
patterns.context: 肛门病变与治疗的专利背景句中，defy internal therapies 表示难以被疗法克服。

patterns.name: 俄语词形片段
patterns.context: 俄语句子中若干词内部的西里尔字母片段被激活；片段跨越正则、地址等讨论内容，未见明确语义限定。

patterns.name: SaaS 讨论中的 about
patterns.context: 讨论桌面应用与云端方案时，激活 about，后接对 SaaS 含义的疑问。

en.concept: Oxygen-related biochemical terminology, plus miscellaneous items
en.description: The prominent shared pattern is the oxygen/dioxygenase fragment in biomedical terminology; other activations are scattered across legal vocabulary, internet slang, software discussions, issue reports, and numeric Q&A formats, with no unified trigger.

patterns.name: “oxygen” in biochemical words
patterns.context: Occurs in the biochemical terms oxygen and dioxygenase; activation falls on the subword fragment oxygen.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, especially enzymes, reactive oxygen species, and metabolism

patterns.name: “language” in legal texts
patterns.context: language appears in legal argumentation discussing the wording and interpretation of a provision.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “off topic”
patterns.context: An off-topic aside is introduced by “This is ... but”; activation is concentrated on topic.

patterns.name: DRY in software development discussions
patterns.context: Discusses runtime monkey patching, cascading effects of changes, and duplicated logic.

patterns.name: General issue description
patterns.context: Reports an issue with Firefox relative to Chrome and mentions that logs can be provided; no clear connection to other patterns is evident.

patterns.name: Numeric list and answer label
patterns.context: A sequence of numbers is followed by an answer label, with a Russian reply fragment nearby; the triggering relationship is unclear.

patterns.name: Sentence-final “note”
patterns.context: The expression wrong-note occurs at the end of a news-link title, followed by the page body.

patterns.name: “It is illogical to reason” construction
patterns.context: A legal source introduces an argument with “It is illogical to reason”; activation is concentrated on the ending of illogical.

patterns.name: “endangers” in a child welfare provision
patterns.context: A legal provision lists conditions that harm a child’s physical or mental welfare.

3_2754.concept: oxygen 相关生化术语，另有杂项
3_2754.description: 显著共同模式是生物医学术语中的 oxygen/dioxygenase 片段；其余激活分散在法律词汇、网络用语、软件讨论、问题报告和数字问答格式，缺少统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 生化词中的“oxygen”
patterns.context: 包含在生物化学术语 oxygen、dioxygenase 中；激活落在 oxygen 的子词片段上
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文，尤指酶、活性氧和代谢

patterns.name: 法律文本中的“language”
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现 language，讨论条款措辞及其解释

patterns.name: 固定词组“off topic”
patterns.context: 以“This is ... but”引出离题说明，激活集中在 topic

patterns.name: 软件开发讨论中的 DRY
patterns.context: 谈论运行时 monkey patching、改动连锁影响及逻辑重复

patterns.name: 一般问题描述
patterns.context: 报告 Firefox 相对 Chrome 出现的问题，并提及可提供日志；未见与其他模式的明确联系

patterns.name: 数字列表与答案标记
patterns.context: 数字序列后跟答案标签，附近还出现俄语回复片段；触发关系不明

patterns.name: 句末“note”
patterns.context: 新闻链接标题末尾的 wrong-note 表达，后接页面正文

patterns.name: “It is illogical to reason”结构
patterns.context: 法律材料中以“It is illogical to reason”引出论证；触发集中在 illogical 的词尾

patterns.name: 儿童福利条文中的“endangers”
patterns.context: 法律条文列举使儿童身心福祉受损的条件

en.description: Activations are scattered across characters or suffixes split within words (especially -ing), patent citation markers, line-break boundaries, and room in legal sentences; there is no stable shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: -ing suffix split within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ends of segmented words, especially ing; corresponds to smoothing and painstaking.

patterns.name: Suffixes or word endings split within words
patterns.context: Activation occurs on letters or subwords split within words, including roots, suffixes, and proper-name endings; trigger positions vary.
patterns.domain: Patents, legal texts, Q&A, academic texts

patterns.name: Document number marker
patterns.context: A patent document number is cited in a patent background passage; activation is concentrated on Patent document and the digits in the number.

patterns.name: Line-break marker at the beginning of a line
patterns.context: Activation occurs on a newline at the beginning of a paragraph or answer, possibly related to the boundary with the following text.

patterns.name: The standalone word room
patterns.context: The phrase “there is no room for construction” appears in a legal citation; activation falls on room.

3_2754.description: 激活分散于词内切分的字符或后缀（突出 -ing）、专利引文标记、换行边界及法律语句中的 room；没有稳定的共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内切分的 -ing 后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分词的词尾，尤其是 ing；对应 smoothing 和 painstaking。

patterns.name: 词内切分的后缀或词尾
patterns.context: 激活出现在词内部被分开的字母或子词上，包含词根、后缀及专名词尾，触发位置不一致。
patterns.domain: 专利、法律文本、问答、学术文本

patterns.name: 文档编号标记
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中引用专利文献编号；激活集中在 Patent document 和编号数字。

patterns.name: 行首换行标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在段落或答案开头的换行符，可能与后续文本的边界有关。

patterns.name: 单独的房间一词
patterns.context: 法律引文中短语“there is no room for construction”，激活落在 room。

en.description: Activations are distributed across internal fragments of dyspnea and painstaking, as well as the ordinary words that, opportunity, topic, by, and LSB; only some word forms recur across segments, with no unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: Content following “that”
patterns.context: That introduces an explanation, reason, or object clause, with activation on that; preceding text may concern difficulty, causation, or explanation.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of dyspnea
patterns.context: The p within the medical symptom word dyspnea, surrounded by descriptions of shortness of breath and other symptoms.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of painstaking
patterns.context: Describes a process or observation as laborious and meticulous; activation falls on an internal fragment of painstaking.

patterns.name: The word opportunity
patterns.context: When discussing failure to absorb or apply content, identifies a missed opportunity.

patterns.name: The word topic
patterns.context: Uses “bit off-topic” to mark a digression, in a forum interjection context.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of compress-stressed
patterns.context: Describes a crack bending due to a compressive-stress region; local activations concentrate on a causal preposition and an internal fragment of stressed.

patterns.name: LSB abbreviation fragment
patterns.context: Code comments discuss concatenating character arrays and reversing byte order, contrasting LSB with MSB.

3_2754.description: 激活分散于 dyspnea、painstaking 等词内片段，以及 that、opportunity、topic、by 和 LSB；仅部分词形跨段复现，未见统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: “that”后续内容
patterns.context: that 引出解释、原因或宾语从句，激活落在 that 上；前文可以是困难、因果或说明。

patterns.name: dyspnea 词内片段
patterns.context: 医学症状词 dyspnea 中的 p，周围描述呼吸困难及其他症状。

patterns.name: painstaking 词内片段
patterns.context: 形容过程或观察费力、细致；激活落在 painstaking 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 机会一词
patterns.context: 谈论未能吸收或应用内容时，指出错失的机会。

patterns.name: topic 一词
patterns.context: 以“bit off-topic”自我标注偏题，处于论坛插话语境。

patterns.name: compress-stressed 词内片段
patterns.context: 描述裂纹弯曲由压缩应力区域造成；局部激活集中在因果介词及 stressed 的词内片段。

patterns.name: LSB 缩写片段
patterns.context: 代码注释讨论字符数组拼接及字节序翻转，LSB 与 MSB 对照。

en.concept: Subword fragments and medical symptom terms
en.description: The main pattern is activation on tokenized fragments of dyspnea and related symptom terms in medical texts, including dyspnea, dyspnoea, and dyspareunia; other activations are scattered across subwords, Russian fragments, and causal prepositions in different contexts.

patterns.name: Token continuation in words for difficulty breathing
patterns.context: Activation falls on the p subword after dys-; contexts involve symptoms, diagnosis, or clinical descriptions. The complete words differ across segments and include dyspnea, dyspnoea, and dyspareunia.
patterns.domain: Medicine, clinical research, and health studies

patterns.name: “by” and passive causal expressions
patterns.context: Segment 8 activates on the preposition by in a causal account of material fracture, crack formation, and stress regions.

patterns.name: Rare or complex word forms at token boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on subwords within segmented words; the sentence discusses the cumbersome process of calculating a ballistic project.

patterns.name: Subword within “illogical”
patterns.context: Activation is on the latter part of illogical, in a legal-text sentence evaluating a particular line of reasoning.

patterns.name: Russian word fragment such as “долго”
patterns.context: Activation falls on a segmented word fragment in a Russian sentence; the user asks how to read a pipe-delimited file using PHP.

patterns.name: “dispel” subword in a negative expression
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment within dispel; preceding text claims that an article did not dispel the impression of an amateur, drunken team.

3_2754.concept: 词内片段与医学症状词
3_2754.description: 主要模式是医学文本中呼吸困难及相关症状词的分词片段激活，涵盖 dyspnea、dyspnoea、dyspareunia；其余激活分散于词内子词、俄语片段及因果介词等不同语境。

patterns.name: 呼吸困难词的分词续接
patterns.trigger: “dys«p»…nea”（第3段为“dys«p»10«nea”，第4、10段为“dys«p»9…nea”，第5段为“dys«p»9areun…”即 dyspareunia，第9段为“dys«p»9noea”）
patterns.context: 激活落在 dys- 后的 p 子词；上下文涉及症状、诊断或临床描述。各段的完整词并不相同，包含 dyspnea、dyspnoea 和 dyspareunia。

patterns.name: “by”及被动因果表达
patterns.trigger: “caused« by»9 the above described”；另见“the … process”“of … calculating”等构词/搭配线索，但并不稳定
patterns.context: 第8段激活于介词 by，处在材料断裂、裂纹形成及应力区域的因果说明中。

patterns.name: 分词边界上的稀有或复杂词形
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词内子词；句子谈计算弹道项目的繁琐过程。

patterns.name: “illogical”词内子词
patterns.context: 激活位于 illogical 的后半部分，出现在法律文本对某种推理作评价的句子中。

patterns.name: “долго”一类俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在俄语句子中拆分的词片段；用户在询问如何用 PHP 读取以竖线为分隔符的文件。
patterns.domain: 俄语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 否定表达中的 “dispel” 子词
patterns.context: 激活落在 dispel 的词内片段；前文声称某篇文章并未消除有关业余、醉酒团队的印象。

en.concept: Detection of fragments within English words
en.description: Activation mainly falls on fragments within English words, especially several words containing st; other examples include illogical, thing, enlightening, gigabits, noise-level, torpedo, and bar. The domains and triggering word forms vary, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: *-st* fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the character sequence st in cross-token fragments or compounds; it appears across different word forms and contexts.

patterns.name: Fragment within illogical
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the ending of illogical; one instance is used in legal argumentation and another in a comment on an opinion.

patterns.name: Fragment within thing
patterns.context: In fictional dialogue, thing is followed by a where-clause, expressing a situation or observation.

patterns.name: Fragment within enlightening
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment within enlightening; the context wishes for an experience to be insightful, magical, and transformative.

patterns.name: Fragment within gigabits
patterns.context: A fragment within the data-rate unit gigabits is activated in technical patent text on high-speed input/output rates.

patterns.name: Fragment within noise-level
patterns.context: The two parts of the compound noise-level are activated separately in a patent description of magnetic sensor readout signals.

patterns.name: Fragment within torpedo
patterns.context: Discusses torpedoes and their malfunction in a game; activation falls on the end of torpedo.

patterns.name: The complete word bar
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase error bar in a discussion of errors in spectral measurements.

3_2754.description: 激活主要落在英语词内片段，尤其是若干含 st 的词；另见 illogical、thing、enlightening、gigabits、noise-level 及 torpedo、bar。跨领域且触发词形多样，未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 英语 *-st* 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词片段或复合词中的 st 字符串；不同词形和语境下都出现。

patterns.name: illogical 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 illogical 的词尾部分；一处用于法律论证，一处用于评论观点。

patterns.name: thing 的词内片段
patterns.context: 小说对白中，thing 后接 where 从句，表达某种情形或观察。

patterns.name: enlightening 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 enlightening 的词内片段；出现在祝愿体验富有启发性、神奇且有转变作用的语境。

patterns.name: gigabits 的词内片段
patterns.context: 高速输入/输出数据率的技术专利文本中，数字单位 gigabits 的词内片段被激活。

patterns.name: noise-level 的词内片段
patterns.context: 磁传感器读出信号的专利描述中，noise-level 复合词的两个部分分别激活。

patterns.name: torpedo 的词内片段
patterns.context: 讨论游戏中的鱼雷及其故障；激活落在 torpedo 的词尾。

patterns.name: bar 的完整词
patterns.context: 光谱测量误差的讨论中，出现在 error bar 短语里。

en.description: Strong activations mostly fall on subword fragments within words or complete words, across widely varying legal, literary, scientific, patent, and forum contexts. Only two patent examples share degrading; the remaining trigger words and semantics have no stable commonality.

patterns.name: degrading/degradation word family
patterns.context: The fragment «ing» activates when discussing something worsening over time or under certain conditions; examples include degradation of stored charge and degradation of temperature uniformity.

patterns.name: Subword fragment “ingle”
patterns.context: Appears in literary narration describing the absence of a pleasurable tingle or thrill in the nerves; activation falls on a fragment within a word.

patterns.name: Subword fragment “bar”
patterns.context: Appears in a scientific discussion of an experimental measurement error range that is too small; activation falls on the word bar.

patterns.name: Subword fragment “pump”
patterns.context: Describes the process property that high-solids black liquor is harder to transport; activation falls on the word pump.

patterns.name: Subword fragment “opportunity”
patterns.context: Comments on failure to apply learned insights to everyday life, calling it a missed opportunity; activation falls on the word opportunity.

patterns.name: Subword fragment “trowel”
patterns.context: A forum dialogue asks whether skip trowel is applicable; the trigger word is split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Scattered word fragments in legal wording
patterns.context: In a child welfare statute and subsequent commentary, activations fall respectively on the the after endangers, added, and a fragment within illogical; the three have no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: Scattered word fragments in military narratives
patterns.context: In accounts of World War II Pacific battles and gaming experiences, activation is distributed across fragments in frustration, the Mark XIV torpedo, and painstaking.

patterns.name: Subword fragment within “incomprehensible”
patterns.context: In a discussion of the benefits of the oil industry to the economy, “nearly incomprehensible” is used as an evaluation; activation falls on a word-final fragment.

3_2754.description: 强激活多落在词内子词片段或完整词上，所涉法律、文学、科学、专利和论坛语境差异很大。仅专利中的两处共同出现 degrading；其余触发词和语义无稳定共性。

patterns.name: degrading/degradation词族
patterns.context: 在讨论某物随时间或条件变差时，词尾片段 «ing» 激活；包括存储电荷退化与温度均匀性退化。

patterns.name: 词内片段「ingle」
patterns.context: 出现在文学叙述中，描写神经没有出现愉悦的刺痛或兴奋感；激活落在词内片段。

patterns.name: 词内片段「bar」
patterns.context: 出现在对实验测量误差范围过小的科学讨论中；激活落在 bar 一词。

patterns.name: 词内片段「pump」
patterns.context: 描述高固含黑液更难输送的工艺性质；激活落在 pump 一词。

patterns.name: 词内片段「opportunity」
patterns.context: 评论未能把所学见解应用到日常生活，称之为错失的机会；激活落在 opportunity 一词。

patterns.name: 词内片段「trowel」
patterns.context: 在论坛对话中以疑问口吻谈是否适用 skip trowel；触发词被分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 法律措辞中的零散词片段
patterns.context: 儿童福利法条及其后续评论中，激活分别落在 endangers 后的 the、added 和 illogical 的词内片段；三者无明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 军事叙述中的零散词片段
patterns.context: 二战太平洋战事与游戏体验叙述中，激活分布在挫败情绪、Mark XIV 鱼雷及 painstaking 等词的片段。

patterns.name: 词内片段「incomprehensible」
patterns.context: 在谈石油产业对经济的益处时，用“几乎难以理解”作评价；激活落在词尾片段。

en.description: High activations are distributed across different words or internal fragments: painstaking, illogical, noise-level, tingle, degrading, opportunity, suppression, error bar, and work around. Only two segments share the same word; the other trigger words and contexts differ.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of “painstaking”
patterns.context: The word “painstaking” is split, with activation on the internal “st” fragment; both segments describe a laborious process or observation.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment of “illogical”
patterns.context: Legal text contains “illogical to reason,” with activation concentrated on a fragment of “illogical.”

patterns.name: Compound “noise-level”
patterns.context: In a technical description, activation falls on the “level” part of the compound term “noise-level.”

patterns.name: “tingle”
patterns.context: In literary narrative, “tingle” is split, with activation concentrated on a later fragment; surrounding text describes a nervous sensation.

patterns.name: Word fragment of “degrading”
patterns.context: Technical text lists effects such as stored charge degrading over time; activation falls on a word-final fragment of “degrading.”

patterns.name: “opportunity”
patterns.context: The speaker regrets not applying insights to everyday life; activation falls on “opportunity.”

patterns.name: Word-final fragment of “suppression”
patterns.context: A physics paper describes strong suppression of a type of wave, with activation on an internal fragment of “suppression.”

patterns.name: “error bar”
patterns.context: A paper discusses measurement discrepancies and error bars that are too short, with activation on “bar.”

patterns.name: “work around”
patterns.context: Q&A proposes an alternative procedure using the phrase “work around,” with activation on “around.”

3_2754.description: 高激活分散在不同词语或词内片段：painstaking、illogical、noise-level、tingle、degrading、opportunity、suppression、error bar、work around。仅两段共享同一词，其他触发词及语境各异。

patterns.name: “painstaking”内部片段
patterns.context: 词语“painstaking”被拆分，激活落在内部的“st”片段；两段都在描述费力的过程或观察。

patterns.name: “illogical”词尾片段
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现“illogical to reason”，激活集中在构成“illogical”的词片段。

patterns.name: 复合词“noise-level”
patterns.context: 技术描述中，激活落在复合术语“noise-level”的“level”部分。

patterns.name: “tingle”
patterns.context: 文学叙述中，“tingle”被拆分，激活集中于后续片段；周围描写神经感受。

patterns.name: “degrading”词片段
patterns.context: 技术文本列举存储电荷随时间劣化等影响，激活落在“degrading”的词尾片段。

patterns.name: “opportunity”
patterns.context: 说话者表达未能把见解应用于日常生活的遗憾，激活落在“opportunity”。

patterns.name: “suppression”词尾
patterns.context: 物理学论文中描述对某类波的强烈抑制，激活落在“suppression”的词内片段。

patterns.name: “error bar”
patterns.context: 论文讨论测量差异及过短的误差棒，激活落在“bar”。

patterns.name: “work around”
patterns.context: 问答中提出替代操作方案，使用短语“work around”，激活落在“around”。

en.description: The main triggers are forms of work around and their segmented fragments, as well as fragments within painstaking; there are also isolated triggers within words or phrases such as level, illogical, degrading, and error bar. The examples span domains and lack unified semantics.

patterns.name: workaround word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on work-around-related expressions: the word may be split into tokens and occurs in contexts of “finding a workaround,” “no workaround,” or “needing to work around” something.

patterns.name: Fragment within painstaking
patterns.context: Activation occurs on segmented fragments within painstaking; one instance describes a computational process and another an observation.

patterns.name: level compound fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on level at the end of the compound high-noise-level; the context is a patent technical description of magnetic sensor signal readout.

patterns.name: Fragment within illogical
patterns.context: Activation occurs within illogical, near a sentence evaluating reasoning in legal argumentation.

patterns.name: Fragment within degrading
patterns.context: Activation falls within degrading, describing worsening temperature uniformity due to film warping.

patterns.name: error bar phrase
patterns.context: In the measurement-error term error bar, activation falls on bar; the context discusses errors in laboratory wavelength measurements.

3_2754.description: 主要触发 work around 的词形及其分词片段，也触发 painstaking 内部片段；另有 level、illogical、degrading、error bar 等孤立词内或词组触发，跨领域且缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: workaround 词语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 work-around 相关表达上：词可能被分词切开，出现在“找到一个变通办法”“没有变通办法”或“需要绕开”的语境中。
patterns.domain: 问答、技术讨论、论坛文本

patterns.name: painstaking 词内片段
patterns.context: 在 painstaking 一词内部的分词片段上激活；一处描述计算过程，一处描述观测。

patterns.name: level 复合词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 high-noise-level 复合词末尾的 level；上下文为磁传感器读信号的专利技术描述。

patterns.name: illogical 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于 illogical 一词内部，附近是法律论证中评价推理的句子。

patterns.name: degrading 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 degrading 内，描述薄膜翘曲导致温度均匀性变差。

patterns.name: error bar 词组
patterns.context: 在 error bar 这一测量误差术语中，激活落在 bar；上下文讨论实验室波长测量的误差。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on several specific word fragments: degrading (often in technical texts about performance worsening), work around, and fragments within illogical, tingle, painstaking, and noise-level. Apart from the degradation forms and phrase, the rest occur in different contexts and are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: degrading word forms
patterns.context: “degrading” and its prefix/suffix segmentation occur when a factor worsens performance, quality, or results. Covers segments 1, 2, 8, and 9.
patterns.domain: Patent technical backgrounds involving temperature uniformity, manufacturing yield, stored charge, and engine emissions

patterns.name: work around phrase
patterns.context: In the phrase “work around,” activation falls on around; the context describes an alternative way to solve a problem.

patterns.name: Ending of illogical
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of illogical in a legal-text sentence evaluating a particular line of reasoning.

patterns.name: Ending of tingle
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of tingle; the context describes bodily sensations or neural responses.

patterns.name: Fragment within painstaking
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment within painstaking, describing a computational process as laborious and meticulous.

patterns.name: noise-level compound
patterns.context: Activation falls on the latter component of noise-level, describing the noise level of a sensor readout signal.

3_2754.description: 激活集中在若干特定词片段：degrading（多见于技术文本中的性能变差），work around，以及illogical、tingle、painstaking、noise-level中的片段。除降级词形和短语外，其余分布于不同语境，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: degrading 词形
patterns.context: 出现“degrading”及其前后缀切分；表示某种因素使性能、质量或结果变差。覆盖段1、2、8、9。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景，涉及温度均匀性、制造良率、存储电荷和发动机排放

patterns.name: work around 短语
patterns.context: 短语“work around”中，激活落在 around；语境是在描述解决问题的替代办法。

patterns.name: illogical 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 illogical 的词尾，出现在法律文本对某种推理作评价的句子中。

patterns.name: tingle 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 tingle 的词尾；上下文描述身体感受或神经反应。

patterns.name: painstaking 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 painstaking 的词内片段；形容计算过程费力、细致。

patterns.name: noise-level 复合词
patterns.context: 激活落在 noise-level 的后一组成部分，描述传感器读出信号的噪声水平。
patterns.domain: 磁传感器专利技术背景

en.concept: English stems and morphological fragments as triggers
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the “degrad” stem, covering worsening performance, quality, or properties in patents and “illogical” in legal texts; it also responds to work in “workaround,” occurring in forum Q&A.

patterns.name: degrading stem
patterns.context: “degrad” is the marked stem, while the subsequent “ing” is unmarked; it appears in participles describing adverse effects or deterioration in performance or state, often syntactically followed by a result or object.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology; also legal texts

patterns.name: workaround word
patterns.context: In “work around” or the hyphenated form “work-around,” it means an alternative solution; segment [9] is in an answer, and segment [10] is in a request for help.

3_2754.concept: 英文词干与构词片段触发
3_2754.description: 主要对“degrad”词干有强反应，覆盖专利中性能、质量或特性变差及法律文本中的“illogical”；另对“workaround”中的work有反应，出现在论坛问答。

patterns.name: degrading词干
patterns.context: “degrad”是被标记的词干，后续“ing”未标记；出现在描述负面影响、性能或状态变差的分词中，句法上常接结果或对象。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术；另有法律文本

patterns.name: workaround词
patterns.context: 在“work around”或连字符形式“work-around”中，表示替代性解决办法；段[9]位于回答中，段[10]位于求助提问中。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on around/workaround expressions; the rest involve laborious processes, illogical judgments, missed opportunities, technical degradation or stress causation, noise signals, and error bars, with diverse semantics and styles.

patterns.name: Workaround-related expressions
patterns.context: Appears when discussing an alternative method or solution; some directly say they found a workaround, while others ask whether it will be fixed or whether there is a workaround.

patterns.name: Description of a long and laborious process
patterns.context: Describes a laborious, meticulous calculation process.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives about gaming experiences and technical calculations

patterns.name: Illogical judgment
patterns.context: In legal argumentation, evaluates a line of reasoning as illogical.

patterns.name: Evaluation of an opportunity
patterns.context: The speaker says they failed to apply an insight to everyday life and describes it as a missed opportunity.
patterns.domain: Personal reflection, blogs, or forum discussions

patterns.name: Degradation of temperature uniformity
patterns.context: Describes how film stress causes uneven gaps, which in turn harms in-plane temperature uniformity of the substrate.
patterns.domain: Patent background, semiconductor or thermal processing technology

patterns.name: Causal explanation of a compressive-stress region
patterns.context: Explains the causes of phenomena such as brittle substrate fracture along a crack and crack deflection.
patterns.domain: Patent background, materials and substrate processing

patterns.name: High-noise readout signal
patterns.context: Describes the relationship between a magnetic sensor's hysteresis loop and readout noise characteristics.
patterns.domain: Patent background, magnetic sensors and magnetic recording

patterns.name: Error bars too short
patterns.context: Discusses differences between spectral-line wavelength measurements and reference values, attributing them to error bars that are too short for laboratory measurements.

3_2754.description: 激活主要落在around/workaround表达；其余分别涉及费力过程、非逻辑判断、错失机会、技术退化或应力因果、噪声信号及误差条，语义与文体分散。

patterns.name: workaround 相关表达
patterns.trigger: «around»（段[2]为« work»1« around»10«.»；[7]为« work»1« around»9«.»；[8]为«work»2-«around»9）
patterns.context: 出现在讨论替代办法或解决方案时；有的直接说找到 workaround，有的询问是否会修复或有无 workaround。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、软件问题讨论

patterns.name: 长而繁复的过程描述
patterns.context: 形容进行一项费力、细致的计算过程。
patterns.domain: 游戏经历与技术计算的个人叙述

patterns.name: 非逻辑判断
patterns.context: 在法律文本的论证中，以“不合逻辑”评价某种推理。

patterns.name: 机会评价
patterns.context: 说话者认为未能把洞见应用于日常生活，因而将其描述为错失的机会。
patterns.domain: 个人反思、博客或论坛讨论

patterns.name: 温度均匀性退化
patterns.context: 描述薄膜应力造成间隙不均，进而损害基板面内温度均匀性。

en.description: Activations are scattered across words such as painstaking and degrading, the phrase around, and also illogical in legal texts, causal by, and missed opportunity; there is no unified semantics or domain, and word forms and local expressions may be more important.

patterns.name: painstaking and participial forms

patterns.name: degrading and participial forms

patterns.name: by in causal explanation

patterns.name: Missed-opportunity expression

en.description: Activations are distributed across internal word fragments and ordinary words: -aking, -ogical, and -ing endings, causal by, high or noise level, and workaround; apart from performance degradation and uses of level in some patent texts, there is no stable unified meaning.

patterns.name: Internal suffix -aking
patterns.context: Activation falls within words ending in -aking, appearing in “painstaking process”; the prefix is split into tokens.

patterns.name: Internal suffix -logical
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of “illogical,” preceded by language about judgment or reasoning.

patterns.name: Internal suffix -ing
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the end of degrading; the context concerns a property or performance gradually worsening.

patterns.name: Expression of high degree or value
patterns.context: Level is strongly activated in “high level,” describing a signal or quantity at a high value.

patterns.name: Causal preposition by
patterns.context: Appears in passive causal expressions, explaining that a phenomenon is caused by a previously mentioned factor.

patterns.name: Causal preposition by
patterns.context: Explains that biological expression is induced by a factor; by is followed by a cause or agent.

patterns.name: Term noise level
patterns.context: Describes the noise level of a magnetic sensor readout signal as part of a compound term.

patterns.name: Degree noun level
patterns.context: Uses level to express an acceptable upper limit for optical coupling loss.

patterns.name: Noun workaround
patterns.context: A Q&A proposes a workaround for a problem; activation falls on the latter part of workaround.

en.description: Activations concentrate on several distinct terms: activates (especially in biomedical contexts), about, Injury, new, Born, biotechnology, and the abbreviation CPI. Each term has local collocations and register conditions, but no single semantic pattern can be inferred across all passages.

patterns.name: Use of “activates”
patterns.context: The word form activates appears in scientific or academic prose, followed by the object being activated. The object may be a biological entity or a related effect or process.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, pharmacological, and molecular biology abstracts; [9] is related scientific discussion

patterns.name: Topic following “about”
patterns.context: about introduces a topic of discussion or research: once, knowledge and interest in disease prevention; once, a warning related to a program that week.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and general web text

patterns.name: “Injury” within a sentence
patterns.context: Capitalized Injury at the start of a sentence appears in medical prose about airway epithelium and mechanical ventilation injury.
patterns.domain: NIH research project abstract, respiratory medicine

patterns.name: Research findings following “new”
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a sentence, modifying newly discovered compounds; followed by carbazole alkaloids, split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Introducing a birthplace after a person’s name
patterns.context: In a biographical entry, Born in introduces the birthplace after the person’s name and introduction.

patterns.name: Company type/technology field term
patterns.context: ViraCore is followed by a description of its company type; biotechnology collocates with company.

patterns.name: Party abbreviation in election news
patterns.context: CPI(M) appears as a party abbreviation in a news headline or brief about West Bengal polls.

en.description: Activations are scattered across news headlines, biographies, medical and biotechnology texts. Local cues include about, activates, medical terms, and proper-name fragments; no common trigger pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Topic or content following about
patterns.context: Activates when about is followed by the topic, warning, or research content under discussion; the word itself introduces the object in the sentence.

patterns.name: Compound fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Activates in drug or natural-product names, especially at chemical-term fragments spanning subword boundaries.

patterns.name: Personal names and biographical openings

patterns.name: Cannabinoid receptor activity

patterns.name: Topics introduced by about

patterns.name: Birthplace in biographies

patterns.name: Chemical-name fragments
