en.description: Activation patterns include topics introduced by about, action relations involving activates in biomedical contexts, and several scattered proper names, chemical terms, and subword fragments of long words; there is also a biotechnology company description. The passages show no single semantic regularity that explains all marked spans.

patterns.name: Expressions about a topic
patterns.context: A topic, subject, or content follows “about”; activation falls on about.
patterns.domain: News headlines, popular science, or patent background, etc.

patterns.name: Activation or action verb
patterns.context: In biomedical contexts, a substance or protein “activates” a gene, protein, or receptor; activation falls on the verb.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments in long words
patterns.context: In a birthplace introduction, activation is on Born at the beginning of the sentence; the passage also marks a proper name and its subword fragments.

patterns.name: Specific terminology fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across multiple subword fragments of a party abbreviation and chemical terms; the two passages have no obvious shared context.

patterns.name: Biotechnology company description
patterns.context: In a company description, activation falls on biotechnology; its connection to other patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Fragments of THC chemical names

patterns.name: Scattered discourse and web markup

patterns.context: 描述写入脉冲可能对隧穿势垒造成过度应力；over 与 stress 构成技术短语。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、电子器件技术

patterns.name: 新闻网站标题 Over 90%
patterns.context: 标题式宣传语中，Over 表示比例超过 90%，后接百分号及预算说明；与其他模式难以对应。

en.concept: specific in-word fragments and term triggers
en.description: The main patterns are in-word fragment triggers: “rost” in a nigrostriatal-related word, “ward” in award in legal contexts, and also Betfair/Bet fragments, pretraining, and net benefits; these do not form a single semantic theme across domains.

patterns.name: Nigrostriatal vocabulary
patterns.context: The trigger falls within the split-marked word “nigrostriatal,” especially the “rost” segment; the context involves dopamine, the striatal system, or behavioral research.
patterns.domain: Neuroscience, Parkinson’s disease, and behavioral pharmacology

patterns.name: Betfair string
patterns.context: The trigger is at the beginning of the proper name “Betfair” or in isolated repeated “Bet” text; a neuroscience context is not required.

patterns.name: award word form
patterns.context: Appears within award and awarding forms in legal texts; strong marking is concentrated on the “ward” segment, while the prefix a may be unmarked.
patterns.domain: Judgments, arbitration, and legal documents on attorney fees

patterns.name: Fragments outside neuroscience
patterns.context: The marker appears within the word “pretraining”; the same passage also contains nigrostriatal-related content, but this trigger is an independent term.
patterns.domain: Behavioral experiments, learning and memory research

patterns.name: Economic evaluation terminology
patterns.context: The trigger appears in statements about a research project’s cost-effectiveness and net benefits.

3_2765.concept: 特定词内片段与词项触发
3_2765.description: 主要模式是词内片段触发：黑质纹状体相关词的“rost”、法律语境中award的“ward”，另见Betfair/Bet残片、pretraining及net benefits；跨领域并非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 黑质纹状体词汇
patterns.context: 触发点落在被拆分标记的“nigrostriatal”一词内部，尤其是“rost”部分；语境涉及多巴胺、纹状体系统或行为研究。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、帕金森病与行为药理学

patterns.name: Betfair 字符串
patterns.context: 触发在“Betfair”专名开头，或孤立重复的“Bet”文本中；不要求神经科学语境。
patterns.domain: 法律判例标题、文本碎片

patterns.name: award 词形
patterns.context: 在法律文本中出现在award、awarding等词形内；强标记集中于“ward”部分，前缀a可能未标记。
patterns.domain: 判决、仲裁及律师费法律文书

patterns.name: 神经科学之外的残片
patterns.context: 标记出现在“pretraining”一词内部；同段另有黑质纹状体相关内容，但该触发本身是独立词项。
patterns.domain: 行为实验、学习与记忆研究

patterns.name: 经济评价词汇
patterns.context: 触发在研究项目的成本效果与净收益表述中。
patterns.domain: 健康经济学、研究计划书

en.description: Strong activations often fall on substrings inside or at the start of words: Pred-, rest, AST, and boost. Pred- is concentrated in abstract titles, while the other substrings span medical, fitness, and social contexts, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Strong word-initial Pred
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of an abstract title or title-like phrase, followed by discussion of factors, characteristics, performance, prevalence, response, or risk models.

patterns.name: rest substring within a word
patterns.context: The substring rest inside “neurorestorative”; the context discusses brain-repair strategies.

patterns.name: AST substring at the end of a word
patterns.context: Inside a ticket abbreviation or proper name in a personal social context, preceded by “Ticket for”.

patterns.name: boost substring within a word
patterns.context: Associated with improved performance: one instance concerns cancer treatment (“boost treatment”), another improved performance from insulin (“performance boost”).
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and health/fitness explanatory text

3_2765.description: 强激活多落在词内或词首子串：Pred-、rest、AST、boost；其中 Pred-集中于摘要标题，其他子串跨医学、健身及社交语境，缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: 词首 Pred 强激活
patterns.context: 出现在摘要标题或标题式短语的开头，后续谈因素、表征、性能、患病率、反应或风险模型。

patterns.name: 词内 rest 子串
patterns.context: “neurorestorative”一词中间的 rest 子串；语境讨论脑修复策略。

patterns.name: 词尾 AST 子串
patterns.context: 个人社交语境中的票务缩写或专名内部，前文为“Ticket for”。

patterns.name: 词内 boost 子串
patterns.context: 与表现提升搭配：一例为肿瘤治疗（“boost treatment”），一例为胰岛素带来的表现提升（“performance boost”）。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与健康/健身说明文

en.description: Strong co-triggers center on the token “Over,” covering time spans, quantities exceeded, overnight, and fixed phrases; there are also unusual sentence-initial uses and a segmentation activation in the Wikipedia category name “Prayer”.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or capitalized “Over”
patterns.context: “Over” appears at the beginning of a passage or as a capitalized word in a title; it may be followed by a number, quantity, time span, or other phrase.
patterns.domain: Web text, research writing, patent background sections, emails, and comments

patterns.name: “Over” indicating a time span
patterns.context: Followed by the last/the past plus a time period, meaning “during”; the activation marker falls on “Over”.

patterns.name: “Over” indicating an amount or percentage exceeded
patterns.context: Followed by an amount, number, or percentage, meaning “more than”.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “Overnight” in a title
patterns.context: “Over” combines with the following night to form overnight; appears in a work title.

patterns.name: Proper name or abbreviation after sentence-initial “Over”
patterns.context: Sentence-initial Over is directly followed by the mixed-case string “TheGeicoE”, with no clear conventional syntactic relationship.

patterns.name: “Way Over” in title-style text
patterns.context: Appears in the title-style, title-case phrase “Way Over Their Heads”.
patterns.domain: Web text, possibly involving a film or game plot

patterns.name: “P”, “ray”, “er” in a Wikipedia category name
patterns.context: Activation falls on the final subword fragments of the category name, which together form “Prayer”; adjacent to a preceding navigation list and reference markers.

3_2765.description: 强烈共同触发项是 token“Over”，涵盖时间跨度、数量超出、overnight 及固定短语等用法；另有句首异常用法，以及维基百科分类名“Prayer”的分词激活。

patterns.name: 句首或大写形式的“Over”
patterns.context: “Over”位于片段开头，或处于标题中大写的单词位置；后文可接数字、数量、时间跨度或其他短语。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、科研写作、专利背景、邮件及评论等

patterns.name: “Over”表示时间跨度
patterns.trigger: «Over» the last decade or so；«Over» the past five years；«Over» the past eleven years；«Over» the last couple of days
patterns.context: 后接 the last/the past 加时间段，表示“在……期间”；激活标记落在“Over”。

patterns.name: “Over”表示超过数量或比例
patterns.context: 后接金额、数字或比例，表达“超过”。

patterns.name: 标题中的固定短语“Overnight”
patterns.context: “Over”与后续 night 连成 overnight；出现在作品标题中。

patterns.name: 句首“Over”后的专名或缩写
patterns.context: 句首 Over 后直接接大小写混合字符串“TheGeicoE”，没有明显常规句法关系。

patterns.name: 标题式文本中的“Way Over”
patterns.context: 出现在标题式、各词首字母大写的短语“Way Over Their Heads”中。
patterns.domain: 网页文本，可能涉及电影或游戏剧情

patterns.name: 维基百科分类名中的“P”“ray”“er”
patterns.context: 激活落在分类名末尾的分词片段，合起来为“Prayer”；与前文导航列表及参考文献标记相邻。

en.description: Activations span multiple scripts and formats: fragments inside Khmer and Polish words, word fragments in English medical texts, line breaks and whitespace in entries, and the salutation “Jeff” and a line break at the start of an email. The patterns cross languages and domains, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Subword fragments inside Khmer script
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in Khmer text, often within a word or in adjacent character/subword fragments; positive activation is not limited to any single Khmer character.
patterns.domain: Khmer UI strings or code snippets on Github

patterns.name: Fragments within Polish words
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in continuous Polish sentences, mainly as subword fragments within words rather than clearly independent words.

patterns.name: English word fragments and common words
patterns.context: Trigger words appear in continuous English text, including medical descriptions and abstracts on exercise/coordination; activations are scattered through sentences, with no stable single semantic category.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central medical papers and PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Formatting symbols in lists or entries
patterns.context: Line breaks and whitespace markers appear in entry, category, or list structures; «P» and «ray» also occur in category names.

patterns.name: Email salutation Jeff and line break
patterns.context: An email opens with Jeff as the recipient’s salutation, followed by a line break; one instance has a colon after the name.

3_2765.concept: 多语种子词与格式片段
3_2765.description: 激活覆盖多种文字与格式：高棉语和波兰语词内片段、英文医学文本中的词片段、条目中的换行空白，以及邮件开头的“Jeff”称呼和换行。模式跨语种、跨领域，未见统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 高棉文字内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 触发点落在高棉语文本中，常是词内部或紧邻的字符/子词片段；正激活并非仅限于某个单一高棉字符。
patterns.domain: Github 中的高棉语界面字符串或代码片段

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 触发点位于连续的波兰语句子中，主要是词内部的子词片段，而非明显独立的词。

patterns.name: 英文词内片段及常用词
patterns.context: 触发词出现在英文连续文本中，包括医学描述及运动/协调研究摘要；激活散落于句中，未见稳定的单一语义类别。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学论文与 PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 列表或条目中的格式符号
patterns.context: 换行及空白标记出现在条目、分类或列表结构中；另有分类名中的 «P»、«ray»。

patterns.name: 邮件称呼 Jeff 与换行
patterns.context: 邮件开头以 Jeff 称呼收件人，名字后紧接换行；一例在名字后有冒号。

en.description: Activation spans Khmer, Polish, and English, often falling on short subword fragments within words; it also appears on English function words in phrases and several salient words in news passages. Languages, topics, and parts of speech vary, suggesting heterogeneous subword-fragment triggers overall.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Khmer script
patterns.context: Activation falls on Khmer letters or combinations of symbols, often embedded in code strings, identifiers, or quoted Khmer text.

patterns.name: Slavic word-internal fragments
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within a Polish word rather than as a standalone word; appears in continuous parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: English word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within English words or proper names, including cross-word fragments; surrounding topics vary, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Function words in an emphatic structure
patterns.context: The phrase “Not even as a hint” in continuous prose; activation centers on negation and degree/comparative structure. Only one example.

patterns.name: Content words in an emphatic structure
patterns.context: The sentence discusses data leaks and their risks; multiple semantically salient words are marked, but there is no single stable part of speech or syntactic position.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in beard-care text
patterns.context: Embedded in words such as “mischievous” and “dandruff”, describing beard-care issues; activation centers on word-internal fragments.

3_2765.concept: 词内部片段及局部词语
3_2765.description: 激活跨高棉语、波兰语和英语，常落在词内部的短子词片段；也见于英语短语功能词及新闻语句中若干显著词。语种、主题和词类均不统一，整体更像异质的词片段触发。

patterns.name: 高棉文字内部子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在高棉语文字的字母或组合符号上；常嵌在代码字符串、标识符或引号中的高棉语文本里。
patterns.domain: Github代码/标识符及高棉语文本

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段位于波兰语词内部，而非独立单词；出现在议会发言的连续正文中。

patterns.name: 英语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词或专名内部，包含跨词片段；周围主题各异，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 英语百科词条、议会文本

patterns.name: 强调结构中的功能词
patterns.context: 连续正文中的短语“Not even as a hint”，激活集中在否定和程度/比较结构；仅见此例。

patterns.name: 强调结构中的实词
patterns.context: 句子谈数据泄露及其风险，多个语义显著词被标记，但没有单一稳定的词类或句法位置。

patterns.name: 胡须护理词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在“mischievous”“dandruff”等词中，描述胡须护理问题；激活集中在词内片段。

en.concept: heterogeneous word fragments and code patterns
en.description: Activations occur across unrelated content: ret/req and callbacks in code, the degree expression “as much as,” fragments within multilingual words, and terms about risk, politics, exercise, beard care, and encyclopedia categories.

patterns.name: Subwords within multibyte text
patterns.context: In non-English text such as Khmer or Polish, activations fall on subword fragments within words rather than whole words; they occur across different languages and word forms.

patterns.name: Return values and callbacks in code
patterns.context: Appears in JavaScript code, often near variable name ret, callback parameters, or method calls; ret is especially prominent.

patterns.name: as much in collocations
patterns.context: Appears in comparative or degree expressions such as “not as much as”; the phrase itself spans different topics.

patterns.name: Entry at the end of a link list
patterns.context: Occurs in category links at the end of a Wikipedia page, following references and category lists.

patterns.name: Word-initial preposition pr
patterns.context: Segmentation activates at the beginning of the Polish word “przesądzało”; it co-occurs with other within-word subword activations in the same passage.

patterns.name: Risk- and leak-related phrases
patterns.context: Reports increased corporate risk after the Paradise Papers leak; several risk- or evidence-related words activate consecutively.

patterns.name: Words related to errors and omissions
patterns.context: Political commentary describes an erroneous anecdote and the omission of the issue of women’s pay; activations are scattered across related words.

patterns.name: Beard-care vocabulary
patterns.context: Fragments related to beards and dandruff activate in product recommendations and lists of beard problems.

patterns.name: Descriptions of motor skills
patterns.context: A research abstract compares the extent of improvement in motor performance after an intervention and describes crawling, jumping, and walking.

patterns.name: No clear word pattern
patterns.context: A code snippet combines HTML/JavaScript structure with Khmer text; activations are distributed across button and adjacent text fragments, with no clear pattern explaining their commonality.

patterns.name: Expressions related to ethics statements
patterns.context: Comments that a company does not clearly explain its relationship with intelligence agencies and has no ethics statement or related implication; “as much as” matches the collocation in other passages.

patterns.name: Dialogue variables and request parameters
patterns.context: Code constructs database query conditions using a request object’s user ID and parameter ID; consistent with the code pattern.

3_2765.concept: 异质词片段与代码模式
3_2765.description: 激活分布于多种不相干内容：代码里的 ret/req 与回调，程度搭配“as much as”，多语言词内片段，以及风险、政治、运动、胡须护理和百科分类等主题词。

patterns.name: 多字节文字内部子词
patterns.context: 在高棉语或波兰语等非英语文本中，激活落在词内部的子词片段，而非完整单词；不同语言和词形均有出现。

patterns.name: 代码中的返回值与回调
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript 代码中，常与变量名 ret、回调参数或方法调用相邻；ret 尤其突出。

patterns.name: 搭配中的 as much
patterns.context: 出现在比较或程度表达中，如“not as much as”；该短语本身跨越不同叙述主题。

patterns.name: 链接列表末尾的条目
patterns.context: 位于 Wikipedia 页面末尾的分类链接中，前面是参考资料与分类列表。

patterns.name: 词首介词 pr
patterns.context: 在波兰语词“przesądzało”开头被切分激活；与同段其他词内子词激活并存。

patterns.name: 风险与泄露相关词组
patterns.context: 报道 Paradise Papers 泄露后企业风险增加，多个风险或证据相关词连续获得激活。

patterns.name: 错误与遗漏相关词
patterns.context: 政治评论中描述错误轶事及未提及女性薪酬问题；激活分散在相关词上。

patterns.name: 胡须护理词汇
patterns.context: 产品建议及胡须问题的列举中，胡须及头皮屑相关词片段激活。

patterns.name: 运动能力描述
patterns.context: 研究摘要比较干预后运动表现的改善幅度，并描述爬行、跳跃和行走。

patterns.name: 无明显可归纳词项
patterns.context: 混有 HTML/JavaScript 结构与高棉文字的代码片段，激活分布于 button 和相邻文字片段，未见能解释其共同点的清晰模式。

patterns.name: 伦理声明相关表达
patterns.context: 评论公司没有清晰说明与情报机构关系，且没有伦理声明或相关暗示；其中“as much as”与其他段的搭配相合。

patterns.name: 对话变量与请求参数
patterns.context: 代码中构造数据库查询条件，使用请求对象的用户 ID 和参数 ID；与代码模式相合。

en.description: Activation is scattered across multilingual word-internal fragments, Khmer text, code punctuation and identifiers, and comparative or result-related wording in news and abstracts; these contexts lack a clear, unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Multilingual word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within continuous Polish and Czech words, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Polish and Czech parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Highlighted non-Latin script fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a UI field value consisting of Khmer script
patterns.domain: Multilingual UI text in GitHub code

patterns.name: Code punctuation and identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in JavaScript routing logic involving return values, comments, and method matching

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments in news text
patterns.context: Appears in news headlines, URLs, and political news prose; some fragments are embedded in words, such as “prodded”
patterns.domain: News clippings or news material in Enron emails

patterns.name: Comparatives and movement terminology in research abstracts
patterns.context: Appears in comparisons of vaccine immune responses or descriptions of athletic performance, often alongside direction, outcomes, and degree comparisons

patterns.name: Expressions of outcomes, gains and losses, and degree
patterns.context: One instance occurs in a table of election outcomes, gains and losses; another is emphatic negation in news commentary; also appears in “not as much as” in a medical abstract
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, news commentary, and medical abstracts

3_2765.description: 激活散落于多语种词内片段、Khmer 文本、代码标点与标识符，以及新闻和摘要中的比较、结果用语；这些上下文之间缺乏明确统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 多语种词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在波兰语、捷克语连续词内部的子词片段，未显示稳定的词义或句法条件
patterns.domain: EuroParl，波兰语和捷克语议会文本

patterns.name: 高亮非拉丁文字片段
patterns.context: 出现在一段由 Khmer 文字组成的界面字段值中
patterns.domain: Github 代码中的多语言 UI 文本

patterns.name: 代码标点与标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript 路由逻辑中，涉及返回值、注释和方法匹配

patterns.name: 新闻文本中的零散词片段
patterns.context: 新闻标题、网址及政治新闻正文中出现；有些片段嵌在词内，如“prodded”
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件所含新闻剪报或新闻材料

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的比较与运动术语
patterns.context: 出现在疫苗免疫反应比较或运动表现描述中，常伴随方向、结果及程度比较

patterns.name: 结果、得失及程度表达
patterns.context: 一处是选举结果表格中的得失与变化，另一处是新闻评论中的否定强调；另见医学摘要“not as much as”
patterns.domain: 百科条目、新闻评论与医学摘要

en.concept: sensitive to subword fragments within specific words
en.description: Activates mainly and strongly on the «ro» subword inside ibuprofen when the drug name is segmented, across medical and health texts; it also activates on a Polish word, English Dropping/Dropped, and «ruff» in dandruff, each a local subword trigger in a different word.

patterns.name: Ibuprofen drug name and segmentation
patterns.context: Ibuprofen appears in drug names, comparisons of drug effects, or examples of drugs, with the word split into multiple subwords; the strongest trigger centers on «ro».
patterns.domain: Medical papers, patent backgrounds, health information

patterns.name: Subword within a Polish word
patterns.context: An internal subword fragment in continuous Polish text triggers, especially «ieg»; unrelated to the ibuprofen context.

patterns.name: ropping within the English word
patterns.context: The internal fragment «ro» in the English past participle “Dropping” triggers strongly; surrounding text discusses removing a word from a webpage title.

patterns.name: dropped in an English word
patterns.context: The internal fragment «ro» in the English past tense “Dropped” triggers strongly; surrounding text discusses a reduced bill.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment related to dandruff
patterns.context: “dandruff” is segmented, and the final fragment «ruff» triggers strongly; it appears in a list of beard-care and skin-irritation issues.

3_2765.concept: 对特定词内子词片段敏感
3_2765.description: 主要在布洛芬被拆分书写时，对其内部 «ro» 子词强烈激活，涵盖医学与健康文本；另在波兰语词、英文 Dropping/Dropped 及 dandruff 的 «ruff» 上激活，均为不同词语中的局部子词触发。

patterns.name: 布洛芬药名及其分词
patterns.context: 布洛芬出现在药物名称、药效比较或药物举例中，词被拆成多个子词；最强触发集中于 «ro»
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利背景、健康资料

patterns.name: 波兰语词内子词
patterns.context: 波兰语连续文本中，词内部子词片段触发，尤其是 «ieg»；与布洛芬语境无关

patterns.name: 英文词中 ropping
patterns.context: 英文过去分词 “Dropping” 的词内片段 «ro» 强烈触发；周围谈及删去网页标题中的词

patterns.name: 英文词中 dropped
patterns.context: 英文过去式 “Dropped” 的词内片段 «ro» 强烈触发；周围谈及账单减少

patterns.name: 胡须屑相关词尾
patterns.context: “dandruff” 被拆分，词尾 «ruff» 强烈触发；处于胡须护理和皮肤刺激问题的列举中

en.description: Primarily responds to the ro subword fragment in ibuprofen, and also to words such as dropped/dropping and other tokenizations containing ro; isolated activations in saved and creep do not currently fit the same pattern.

patterns.name: ibuprofen substring in a drug name
patterns.context: The drug name ibuprofen is split into multiple subword tokens; it appears in various corpus contexts, with activation concentrated on «ro», though adjacent fragments may also activate.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patent background sections, NIH research texts

patterns.name: Common English words beginning with ro
patterns.context: A word contains the ro subword, especially in spellings tokenized as D-ro, such as dropped/dropping; the fragment matches ro in ibuprofen.

patterns.name: Other words or proper names containing ro
patterns.context: Activation falls on token fragments containing ro; unrelated to the drug name, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia categories, email subject lines, and URLs

patterns.name: Numerical amount/quantity expressions related to “saved”
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence discussing redirecting saved money to another use; this activation does not correspond to the ro fragment above and occurs in isolation.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in creep
patterns.context: Activation falls on a tokenized fragment of the word creep, amid a HackerNews comment discussing a method; its connection to other patterns is unclear.

3_2765.description: 主要响应 ibuprofen 中的 ro 子词片段，也响应 dropped/dropping 等词及其他含 ro 的分词；另有 saved 和 creep 的孤立激活，暂无法归入同一模式。

patterns.name: 药名中的 ibuprofen 子串
patterns.context: 药名 ibuprofen 被拆分为多个子词 token；在多种语料上下文中出现，激活集中于 «ro»，相邻片段也可能激活。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利背景、NIH 研究文本

patterns.name: ro 开头的常见英语词
patterns.context: 词中出现 ro 子词，尤其在 dropped/dropping 这类以 D-ro 开头的拼写分词中；与 ibuprofen 中的 ro 片段相同。

patterns.name: 其他含 ro 的词或专名
patterns.context: 激活落在含 ro 的分词片段上；与药名无关，未显示稳定的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 维基百科分类、邮件标题及 URL

patterns.name: 与“saved”相关的数字金额/数量表达
patterns.context: 出现在讨论将节省的资金转用于其他用途的句子中；该激活不对应上述 ro 片段，孤立出现。

patterns.name: creep 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词 creep 的拆分片段上，周围是 HackerNews 评论中对方法的讨论；与其他模式的联系不明确。

en.concept: mixed response to word-form fragments and local collocations
en.description: Strong responses are scattered: final occurs in scientific phrases, the Dro fragment spans dropped, dropping, and citations; there are also isolated triggers such as Expect, PRET, and over-, as well as amounts and sporadic terms. No single semantic or stylistic explanation accounts for all samples.

patterns.name: final in compounds or fixed phrases
patterns.context: final is followed by a noun to form phrases about steps or particle-physics final states; activation is on final.

patterns.name: Dro- stem and its inflections
patterns.context: The Dro fragment appears at the start or within a word, including dropped, dropping, and fragments in citations; the contexts vary.
patterns.domain: HackerNews colloquial text; ArXiv papers and citations

patterns.name: Expressions related to expectations and outcomes
patterns.context: Appears in a headline-style question about the recovery of supply in the near to medium term or expectations.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of pretend
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs inside pretend in an uppercase, colloquial imperative sentence.

patterns.name: Prefix fragment in secured
patterns.context: Appears in legal discussion of creditors’ secured status; strong activation falls on over-.

patterns.name: Numerical values and monetary amounts
patterns.context: A reduction in a bill is expressed as a dollar amount; activation covers the currency symbol and nearby numbers.

patterns.name: Lower in a specific phrase
patterns.context: lower is repeated in the same energy-market headline, discussing recovery.

patterns.name: Remaining sporadic triggers
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across different syntax and topics; the available samples do not support a unified condition.
patterns.domain: News, forums, scientific papers, and legal texts

3_2765.concept: 词形片段与局部搭配的混合响应
3_2765.description: 强响应分散：final 出现在科学短语中，Dro 片段跨 dropped、dropping 和引文；另有 Expect、PRET、over- 等孤立触发，以及金额、零散词项激活。无法由单一语义或文体解释全部样本。

patterns.name: final 的复合词或固定短语
patterns.context: final 后接名词，组成步骤、粒子物理终态等短语；激活标在 final 上。

patterns.name: Dro- 词干及其变形
patterns.context: 出现在词首或词中片段 Dro；包含 dropped、dropping 及文献引用中的词片段，语境并不一致。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 口语文本；ArXiv 论文及引文

patterns.name: 预期、结果相关表达
patterns.context: 出现在对近中期供应恢复或预期的标题式提问中。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的能源市场标题

patterns.name: pretend 的词内片段
patterns.context: 大写、口语化的命令句中，触发片段位于 pretend 一词内部。

patterns.name: secured 的前缀片段
patterns.context: 出现在讨论债权人担保状态的法律论述中，强激活位于 over-。

patterns.name: 数值及货币金额
patterns.context: 账单降幅以美元金额表达，激活覆盖金额符号及数字附近。

patterns.name: 特定短语中的 Lower
patterns.context: 同一能源市场标题中重复出现 lower，谈及恢复情况。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的能源市场标题

patterns.name: 剩余零散触发
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在不同句法和主题中；现有样本不足以支持统一条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、论坛、科学论文及法律文本

en.concept: Subword-fragment responses across languages and formats
en.description: Activation broadly falls on word-internal substrings in different languages, as well as code, identifiers, escape sequences, and URL fragments; its position varies with tokenization, with no stable semantic theme, though a few ordinary words also activate.

patterns.name: English suffix fragments within words
patterns.context: When English words are split into multiple tokens, activation falls on word fragments; often seen in common verbs or compounds, but not in a fixed word form.
patterns.domain: News, marketing, web, and general English text

patterns.name: Dutch word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Dutch text, activation is distributed across word-internal or word-initial fragments; also appears in name fragments.

patterns.name: Czech word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In Czech text, words are split into multiple fragments containing diacritics; activation centers on substrings within words.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Tibetan transliteration
patterns.context: Latin transliterations of Tibetan proper names are split into multiple fragments, with activation inside the names.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on history and religion

patterns.name: Code, paths, and terminal escape fragments
patterns.context: In code configuration paths, terminal color escapes, or directory-tree formatting, activation falls on symbols and fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments within code identifiers
patterns.context: After camelCase or concatenated JavaScript identifiers are tokenized, activation appears on name fragments.

patterns.name: Case-sensitive and word-initial fragments in email subject lines
patterns.context: In subject lines or bullet items, activation falls on case-sensitive word-initial or word-internal fragments; no stable semantic category is evident.
patterns.domain: Energy-market subject lines in Enron emails

patterns.name: Short fragments in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Proper names or short words also show sporadic activation in ordinary English prose, with no stable word-form pattern to group them under.

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments in email and web titles
patterns.context: In excerpts from economic commentary, email signatures, or URLs, activation is scattered across ordinary words, title separators, and URL fragments.

patterns.name: Ordinary function words and word-final fragments in English sentences
patterns.context: A few common words in English natural-language sentences also activate, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

3_2765.concept: 跨语种与格式的子词片段响应
3_2765.description: 激活广泛落在不同语言的词内子串，以及代码、标识符、转义符和网址片段；位置随分词而变，未显出稳定语义主题，少量普通词也被激活。

patterns.name: 单词内部的英语后缀片段
patterns.context: 英语词语被拆分成多个 token 时，激活落在单词片段上；多见于常见动词或复合词，但并非固定词形。
patterns.domain: 新闻、营销、网页及一般英语文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语连续文本中，激活分布在词内或词首片段；也出现在人名片段。

patterns.name: 捷克语词内片段
patterns.context: 捷克语文本中，词被拆成多个带变音符号的片段；激活集中于词内子串。

patterns.name: 藏语转写中的词内片段
patterns.context: 藏语专名的拉丁转写被切分成多个片段，激活出现在名称内部。
patterns.domain: 百科全书历史与宗教条目

patterns.name: 代码、路径与终端转义片段
patterns.context: 代码配置路径、终端颜色转义或目录树格式中，激活落在符号和片段上。

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 驼峰式或拼接式 JavaScript 标识符被分词后，激活出现在名称片段。

patterns.name: 邮件标题中的大小写及词首片段
patterns.context: 标题或项目符号条目中，激活落在大小写敏感的词首、词内片段；未见稳定的语义类别。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的能源市场标题

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的短片段
patterns.context: 普通英语叙述中，专名或短词也出现零散激活，无法归入更稳定的词形模式。
patterns.domain: 百科条目及 StackExchange 文本

patterns.name: 邮件与网页标题中的零散词片段
patterns.context: 经济评论摘录、邮件签名或网址中，激活分散在普通词、标题分隔线及 URL 片段上。

patterns.name: 英文句中普通功能词与词尾片段
patterns.context: 英文自然语言句子中少量常见词也有激活，没有显示出一致的语义或句法条件。

en.concept: Multilingual word-internal fragments and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activations are mostly triggered by specific substrings within words: Polish «przep» and similar Czech spellings are most prominent. Other cases include Tibetan transliterated proper names, fixed French expressions, English prose, code tabs, and URL fragments, with no single semantic pattern evident.

patterns.name: «przep» strings within Slavic words
patterns.context: In Polish, often at the beginning of words such as «przepisy» and «przeprowadziliśmy»; a similar spelling, ««p»1«ř»3«ep»9», also appears in Czech fragments.

patterns.name: French stem «fin»
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed expression «à cette fin» (for this purpose).

patterns.name: Bon/Dung syllables
patterns.context: Syllables in proper names of Tibetan Bon monasteries; activations occur across multiple parts of the names.

patterns.name: Multibyte fragments within Czech words
patterns.context: Scattered within the Czech inflected form «přepravující», rather than appearing as independent words.

patterns.name: English sentence-final/word-initial fragments
patterns.context: Distributed across ordinary English prose and near sentence boundaries; the fragments show no stable semantic or syntactic commonality.

patterns.name: Tabs and lexical markers in code
patterns.context: Appears in tables or annotated data containing tabs, interspersed with Czech word forms.

patterns.name: Web and English project-name fragments
patterns.context: Appears in URLs, project names, and surrounding English text; no consistent semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Polish letter-continuation fragment
patterns.context: Appears within the Polish word form «wniosku», with no further contextual evidence.

3_2765.concept: 多语词内片段与格式边界
3_2765.description: 激活多由特定词内子串触发：波兰语「przep」及相近捷克语拼写最突出；另见藏语音译专名、法语固定表达、英语散文、代码制表符和网址片段，未显示单一语义规律。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词内的“przep”字串
patterns.context: 在波兰语中，常出现在「przepisy」「przeprowadziliśmy」等词的词首；在捷克语片段中也见到相近的「«p»1«ř»3«ep»9」拼写。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会正式文本、术语表

patterns.name: 法语词干「fin」
patterns.context: 出现在「à cette fin」（为此）的固定表达中。

patterns.name: Bon／Dung 音节
patterns.context: 藏传苯教寺院专名内出现的音节，激活分布在名称的多个片段。
patterns.domain: 百科全书条目、宗教专名

patterns.name: 捷克语词内的多字节
patterns.context: 分散在捷克语词形「přepravující」中，而非独立词。

patterns.name: 英语句末／词首片段
patterns.context: 分布于普通英语散文及句子边界附近；片段之间看不出稳定的语义或句法共性。

patterns.name: 代码中的制表符与词法标记
patterns.context: 出现在含制表符的表格或标注数据中，并夹有捷克语词形。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码／语言标注数据

patterns.name: 网页与英文项目名片段
patterns.context: 出现在网址、项目名及其前后的英文文本中；未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 波兰语字母续接片段
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语词形「wniosku」内部，缺乏其他上下文证据。

en.concept: Multilingual word fragments and format strings
en.description: Activation is distributed across word-internal fragments in Dutch, French, Polish, English, and other texts, as well as URLs, number strings, and symbols. Some fragments occur in parliamentary, legal, marketing, and web contexts, but there is no clearly stable shared meaning or semantic theme.

patterns.name: Fragments within Dutch word roots
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-internal fragments in Dutch, often near morpheme boundaries; fragments include bet/ek, vers/lag, re/end, erg, ep, act/ief.

patterns.name: Dutch compounds and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Appears in Dutch text discussing Nietzsche, with trigger fragments distributed within words and compound components, such as over-spannen, gepubliceerde, werken.

patterns.name: Short fragments in URLs and text markers
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across URLs, number strings, and repeated symbols; it also appears in the string DupDetector.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in English marketing goals
patterns.context: Appears in marketing goals or impact lists; activation centers on words such as Increase and Improve and adjacent word fragments.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in French parliamentary wording
patterns.context: Located in French parliamentary speech, falling within or at the start of words such as efforcer, élargie, réponde, fin.

patterns.name: Polish word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed within words in Polish speeches, often on spelling fragments of longer words; also appears in expressions such as “bardzo późno”.

patterns.name: French and parliamentary-related word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in parliamentary addresses and contexts involving the presiding officer’s term; trigger points fall within French words and related forms of address.

patterns.name: Fragments in Polish institutional long words
patterns.context: Located in parliamentary law titles or regulation names; activation falls within Polish administrative and legal vocabulary.

patterns.name: Polish parliamentary-procedure word fragments
patterns.context: When discussing treaties, committee reports, and parliamentary procedures, activation falls within Polish words and parliamentary terminology.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in English web copy
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across URL parameters, separators, and web navigation/promotional text, including Improve and weather.
patterns.domain: Web links and website copy in emails

3_2765.concept: 多语种词片段与格式串
3_2765.description: 激活分布于荷兰语、法语、波兰语和英语等不同文本的词内片段，也见于网址、数字串和符号。部分片段在议会、法律、营销及网页语境中出现，但没有明显稳定的共同词义或语义主题。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词根内部片段
patterns.trigger: « bet» «ek» « vers» « lag» « re» « end» « erg» « ep» « act» « ief»
patterns.context: 激活落在荷兰语单词的词内片段，常见于词素边界附近；片段包括 bet/ek、vers/lag、re/end、erg、ep、act/ief。

patterns.name: 荷兰语复合词及词内片段
patterns.trigger: « over» « sp» « ann» « bl» « uf» « g» « ep» « ubl» « wer»
patterns.context: 出现在讨论尼采的荷兰语文本中，触发片段分布在词内及复合词构成部分，如 over-spannen、gepubliceerde、werken。

patterns.name: URL及文本标记中的短片段
patterns.context: 激活散布在网址、数字串和重复符号中；另在 DupDetector 字样中出现。
patterns.domain: 网页链接与论坛/技术文本

patterns.name: 英语营销目标中的词内片段
patterns.trigger: «Incre» «ase» « the» « attract» « products» « sold» « sales» «Improve» « recall» « exposure»
patterns.context: 出现在营销目标或效果清单中，激活集中于 Increase、Improve 等词及其相邻词片段。

patterns.name: 法语议会措辞中的词内片段
patterns.trigger: « eff» « larg» « ie» « rép» « onde» « À» « fin»
patterns.context: 位于法语议会发言中，落在 efforcer、élargie、réponde、fin 等词的内部或词首片段。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.trigger: « prz» « ew» « ów» « mów» « ro» « bi» « zo» « p» « ó» « źno» « ep» « ros»
patterns.context: 激活分布于波兰语发言词内部，常落在较长词的拼写片段上；另有“bardzo późno”等表达。

patterns.name: 法语及议会相关词片段
patterns.trigger: « pour» « législ» « Pr» « ésident» « pendant» « fin» « est»
patterns.context: 出现在议会致辞与主席任期语境，触发点位于法语词及相关称谓中。

patterns.name: 波兰语制度性长词片段
patterns.context: 位于议会法规标题或条例名称中，激活落在波兰语行政、法律词汇内部。

patterns.name: 波兰语议会程序词片段
patterns.trigger: « ok» « re» « Tra» « kt» « Po» « wyd» « pr» « sp» « ra» « wo» « zd» « prz» « ep» « row» « ad» « proces»
patterns.context: 讨论条约、委员会报告及议会程序时，激活落在波兰语词内部及议会术语中。

patterns.name: 英语网页文案中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在网址参数、分隔线及网页导航/宣传语中，包含 Improve、weather 等。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件中的网页链接与网站文案

en.description: Strong activations are concentrated in word-internal fragments containing pr/ przep in Polish parliamentary legal texts. Similar spellings also appear in Czech and Dutch, alongside sporadic word-internal triggers in marketing, English energy writing, and French parliamentary texts; these are difficult to group under a unified semantics.

patterns.name: «przep-» fragments in Polish legal terms
patterns.context: Within Polish words, especially in legal, EU regulatory, and implementation or application contexts.
patterns.domain: Polish legal and policy texts in EuroParl

patterns.name: Cross-lingual spelling-similar fragments
patterns.context: Letter fragments within words; the first is a Czech word and the latter two are Dutch words. They may be orthographically similar to a frequently triggered Polish fragment, but are neither the same word nor clearly the same morpheme.
patterns.domain: GitHub inflection/annotation data; Dutch parliamentary and philosophical texts

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in English marketing objectives
patterns.context: Headings or bullet lists of marketing objectives involving increased appeal, sales, brand recall, and exposure.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC marketing copy or business materials

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in English energy-market analysis
patterns.context: Headline-style or bulleted analysis titles discussing supply, recovery, decline, and expectations.

patterns.name: Short word fragments in French parliamentary discourse
patterns.context: Arguments in European Parliament speeches about joint efforts and responding to citizens’ needs; triggers are scattered across common words, with no clear fixed terminology.

3_2765.description: 强激活最集中于波兰语议会法律文本中含 pr/ przep 的词内片段；另见捷克语、荷兰语相似拼写，以及营销、能源英语和法语议会文本中的零散词内触发，难以归为统一语义。

patterns.name: 波兰语法律词中的“przep-”片段
patterns.context: 波兰语词内部；尤其出现在法律、欧盟法规及其实施或适用的语境中。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 的波兰语法律与政策文本

patterns.name: 跨语种拼写相似片段
patterns.context: 词内部的字母片段；前者是捷克语词，后两者是荷兰语词。可能与波兰语高频触发片段有拼写相似性，但并非同一词或明确同一语素。
patterns.domain: Github 的词形/标注数据；荷兰语议会与哲学文本

patterns.name: 英语营销目标中的词内片段
patterns.context: 标题或项目符号列出营销目标，涉及提升吸引力、销量、品牌记忆和曝光。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 营销文案或商业材料

patterns.name: 英语能源市场分析中的词内片段
patterns.context: 标题式或项目符号式分析标题，讨论供应、复苏、下降及预期。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的能源市场分析

patterns.name: 法语议会语篇中的短词片段
patterns.context: 欧盟议会演说中关于共同努力、回应公民需求的论述；触发分散在常用词中，未见明显固定术语。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in several specific word fragments: «is» in Polish legal words «przepisów/przepisy», «ceed» in English «exceed», and «increase» and «improve» in marketing copy. Sporadic triggers also occur in Finnish «fin», Portuguese «impendem», and numeric URL segments. The examples span languages and genres, with no unified semantics evident.

patterns.name: Inflectional fragment in Polish legal word «przepisów»
patterns.context: Appears in legal expressions such as «przepisów prawa» or «przepisy», often alongside EU regulations, transposition obligations, or parliamentary legislation.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in English «exceed»
patterns.context: Appears in «exceed» / «exceeds», followed or neighbored by objects such as «authorized access» and «minimum sample size».
patterns.domain: English legal discussions and research guides

patterns.name: «increase» in English product marketing objectives
patterns.context: Paired with «attractiveness» or «sales» in bullet-point marketing objectives.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in English «improve»
patterns.context: Paired with marketing objectives such as «brand recall» and «brand exposure».

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in a Finnish-related word
patterns.context: Appears in «finlandaise» (Finnish), describing the Council presidency.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in a Portuguese verb
patterns.context: Appears in «impendem», describing accusations against someone.

patterns.name: Numeric URL fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a numeric string in a news-link URL, alongside a domain and path.

3_2765.description: 激活集中在若干具体词内片段：波兰语法律词「przepisów/przepisy」的 is、英语 exceed 的 ceed，以及营销文案中的 increase、improve；另有芬兰语 fin、葡萄牙语 impendem 和 URL 数字段的零散触发。跨语种、跨文体，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 波兰语法律词“przepisów”的分词片段
patterns.trigger: «pr»«zy»jęły；«prz»? 原文中反复出现的 «prz» 并不完整标记，而强激活为 «pr» 后的「przep」片段：«pr» 后接「zep」未标记，«is»4；另有 «pr» 后「zep」及 «is»4
patterns.context: 出现在「przepisów prawa」或「przepisy」等法律条文表达中，常与欧盟法规、转置义务或议会立法语境同现
patterns.domain: 波兰语欧洲议会法律文本

patterns.name: 英语 exceed 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 exceed / exceeds 中，后接或邻接 authorized access、minimum sample size 等宾语
patterns.domain: 英语法律讨论与研究指南

patterns.name: 英语产品营销目标中的 increase
patterns.context: 项目符号式营销目标中，搭配 attractiveness 或 sales

patterns.name: 英语 improve 的词内片段
patterns.context: 与 brand recall、brand exposure 等营销目标搭配

patterns.name: 芬兰语相关词的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在「finlandaise」（芬兰的）中，描述理事会主席任期

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语动词词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在「impendem」中，描述对某人的指控

patterns.name: 网址数字片段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻链接 URL 的数字串中，周围另有域名及路径

en.description: Activation spans multiple languages and genres, including English exceed, Polish word-internal fragments, French fragments, the name DupDetector, astrophysical symbols, and tabular data; no single semantic pattern explains all of them.

patterns.name: English word ending exceed
patterns.context: Trigger fragments all contain the root exceed; they appear in titles, teaching materials, or legal discussions, with varying forms and capitalization
patterns.domain: English energy headlines, experimental-design textbooks, online legal discussions

patterns.name: Polish word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within Polish words, involving different forms related to apologizing, initiating procedures, and legal provisions; they are not complete word boundaries
patterns.domain: European Parliament Polish speeches and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: French word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across French words or phrases, with no word forms matching English exceed or the Polish fragments

patterns.name: DupDetector string
patterns.context: Triggered by the name of a duplicate detector and its abbreviation in a web excerpt, surrounded by URLs and separators

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and astrophysics word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in sentences and formulas about quasar radiation and super-Eddington accretion

patterns.name: Tabular and tab-separated formatting
patterns.context: Activation accompanies tab-separated table fields, part-of-speech labels, and Polish word forms; more likely a formatting or local subword trigger

3_2765.concept: 多语言子词与格式片段
3_2765.description: 激活跨多种语言和文体，包含英文 exceed、波兰语词内片段、法语片段、DupDetector 名称、天体物理符号及制表符表格；没有单一语义模式能解释全部。

patterns.name: 英文词尾 exceed
patterns.context: 触发片段都包含词根 exceed；出现在标题、教学材料或法律讨论中，词形和大小写不同
patterns.domain: 英语能源标题、实验设计教材、网络法律讨论

patterns.name: 波兰语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在波兰语词的内部片段，涉及道歉、开展程序、法律条文等不同词形；并非完整词边界
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会波兰语发言与议会文本

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在法语词或短语中，未见与英文 exceed 或波兰语片段相同的词形

patterns.name: DupDetector 字符串
patterns.context: 触发于网页片段中的重复检测器名称及其缩写，周围有 URL 和分隔符

patterns.name: 数学符号及天体物理词片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于类星体辐射和超爱丁顿吸积的句子及公式中

patterns.name: 表格与制表符格式
patterns.context: 激活伴随制表符分隔的表格字段、词性标签及波兰语词形；更像格式或局部子词触发

en.concept: Cross-lingual word-internal subword fragments and sporadic word forms
en.description: Activations often fall on word-internal subword fragments, especially recurring «prz»«ep» in Polish legal terms. Other examples include marketing terms for improvement/growth, procedural language, French and Swedish parliamentary expressions, and colloquial forum phrases. Some fragments resemble one another across words, but their semantic themes are not unified.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations often fall in the middle of words or on affixes/subword fragments rather than whole words; fragments occur across different languages and inflected forms.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, multilingual texts, including marketing, medicine, forums, and European Parliament corpora

patterns.name: «przep» fragment in Polish legal terms
patterns.context: Appears in Polish words related to law, regulations, or parliamentary procedure, such as «przeprowadziliśmy», «przepisów», «przepływu», and «przepisy»; «ep» recurs across multiple word forms.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Polish parliamentary and legal texts

patterns.name: English expressions of improvement/growth
patterns.context: Appears in promotional phrases and headlines aimed at improving, enhancing, or increasing something, often near words such as product, sales, brand, or life.

patterns.name: Procedural, process, and implementation language
patterns.context: Concerns carrying out parliamentary procedures, procedural development, or stipulating provisions; apart from Polish legal terms, English medical-procedure contexts also occur.

patterns.name: French expressions of purpose or response
patterns.context: In French parliamentary discourse, sentences discuss responding to citizens’ needs and acting for that purpose; the stronger marker occurs at «fin».

patterns.name: Swedish parliamentary-proceedings word forms
patterns.context: Appears in parliamentary speech explaining «the issue/related issues»; «fin» also occurs in the Swedish word «finns».

patterns.name: Emphatic phrase in a forum
patterns.context: In a colloquial forum sentence commenting on an Area 51 video, describes someone as almost acting crazy in front of the camera; difficult to directly relate to other patterns.

3_2765.concept: 跨语词内子词片段及偶发词形
3_2765.description: 激活多落在词内子词片段，尤其是波兰语法律词反复出现的«prz»«ep»；另见营销改善/增长词、程序用语，以及法语和瑞典语议会表达、论坛口语短语。部分跨词片段相似，但语义主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 词内的跨语言子词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在单词中间或词缀/子词片段上，而不是完整单词；片段可出现在不同语言及不同词形中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域、跨语言文本；包括营销、医学、论坛和欧洲议会语料

patterns.name: 波兰语法律词中的「przep」片段
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语法律、法规或议会程序相关词中，如“przeprowadziliśmy”“przepisów”“przepływu”“przepisy”；«ep»在多个不同词形里重复出现。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，波兰语议会及法律文本

patterns.name: 英语改善/增长表达
patterns.context: 出现在以改善、提升或增加为目的的宣传式短语和标题中，附近常有产品、销售、品牌或生活等词。
patterns.domain: 营销目标与自助/健康类标题

patterns.name: 程序、过程及实施用语
patterns.context: 涉及执行议会程序、程序发展或对某事项作出规定；除波兰语法律词外，也有英语医学程序语境。

patterns.name: 法语目的或回应表达
patterns.context: 在法语议会论述中，围绕回应公民需求、为此采取行动的句子；其中较强标记在“fin”处。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议事问题词形
patterns.context: 出现在议会发言中对“该问题/相关问题”作说明的表达；«fin»也出现在瑞典语“finns”中。

patterns.name: 论坛中的强调性短语
patterns.context: 在评论 Area 51 视频的口语化论坛句子中，描述人物几乎像是在镜头前装疯；与其他模式难以直接对应。

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and formatting symbols
en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual text, code annotations, terminal logs, scientific prose, and headlines. They cover both substrings within words and line breaks, symbols, and numbers, with no stable semantic or domain-specific commonality evident.

patterns.name: French word-final fragments
patterns.context: In French sentences, activations fall on subword fragments inside or at the beginning of words; fragments often belong to inflected forms or common-word spellings.

patterns.name: Word-internal Swedish fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Swedish text, activations are distributed across several word-internal subword fragments, with no single fixed lexical item.

patterns.name: Czech morphological annotations and word fragments
patterns.context: Czech dependency annotations and word forms in code blocks; activations occur in annotation fields, tabs, and word-internal fragments.

patterns.name: Common word-internal English fragments
patterns.context: In English forum prose, activations fall on word-initial or word-internal fragments of common words or proper names; no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Terminal escape sequences and symbols
patterns.context: In test output or terminal logs, activations cluster on empty control sequences and a left arrow, with ANSI color escape codes nearby.

patterns.name: Biomedical word fragments
patterns.context: Scientific prose concerning endothelial differentiation, receptors, miRNA, and blood flow; activations span proper names and ordinary scientific vocabulary.

patterns.name: Statistical results and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Medical abstracts reporting between-group differences, P values, and enzyme measures; numbers, comparison symbols, and several word fragments all trigger activations.

patterns.name: Line breaks and headline text
patterns.context: In news headlines and links, line-break markers and headline/URL fragments activate.

3_2765.concept: 异质文本片段与格式符号
3_2765.description: 激活分散于多语种文本、代码标注、终端日志、科研叙述与标题；既覆盖词内子串，也覆盖换行、符号和数字，未见稳定语义或领域特异性共同点。

patterns.name: 法语词尾片段
patterns.context: 法语句子中，激活落在词内部或词首的分词片段；片段常属于词形变化或常见词的拼写

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中，激活分布在词内的若干子词片段，未见固定单一词项

patterns.name: 捷克语形态标注与词片段
patterns.context: 代码块中的捷克语依存句法标注及其词形，激活同时出现在标注字段、制表符和词内片段

patterns.name: 英语常见词内片段
patterns.context: 英语论坛叙述中，激活落在普通词或专名的词首、词内片段；没有明显共同语义

patterns.name: 终端转义序列与符号
patterns.context: 测试输出或终端日志中，激活集中于空控制序列和左箭头，周围含 ANSI 颜色转义码

patterns.name: 生物医学词项片段
patterns.context: 内皮分化、受体、miRNA与血流相关的科研叙述；激活跨越专名和普通科学词汇

patterns.name: 统计结果与词内片段
patterns.context: 报告组间差异、P值和酶指标的医学摘要；数字、比较符号及若干词片段均触发

patterns.name: 换行与标题文本
patterns.context: 新闻标题及链接中，换行标记和标题/URL片段激活

en.description: Activations occur on various word-internal fragments and symbols: commonly in forms of «increase»/«improve», French «fin», «ep» in medical words, code shift operators, and ANSI sequences. Other fragments are sporadic, with no unified semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Inflectional fragments of word-internal «improve»
patterns.context: Activations fall on part of the English root or its inflected forms, especially in «Increase», «Improve», and «Improvements»; objects or modifiers may occur nearby.
patterns.domain: Marketing objectives, health-book titles, weather webpages, financial emails

patterns.name: French word-internal «fin»
patterns.context: Appears in French phrases «À cette fin» (for this purpose) and «présidence finlandaise» (Finnish Presidency); activations fall on the same string «fin», but the meanings and contexts differ.

patterns.name: Shift operator in code
patterns.context: Located in a code example, adjacent to numbers and type conversions; activations cluster on the shift symbol.

patterns.name: Colored terminal control sequences
patterns.context: Appears at the end of test-run output, with terminal formatting control codes nearby.

patterns.name: Word-internal «ep» substring
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal fragments in medical texts referring to being nondepressed or nondepleted, rather than at complete word boundaries.

patterns.name: Other scattered word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Each is embedded in a different common word, proper name, or URL; no stable shared context or semantics is apparent.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary texts, StackExchange logs, web links

3_2765.description: 激活分布在多种词内片段和符号上：常见于 increase/improve 词形、法语 fin、医学词中的 ep，以及代码移位符和 ANSI 序列；其余片段零散，难见统一语义。

patterns.name: 词内 improve 的分词
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词根或其词形的一部分，尤见于 Increase、Improve、Improvements；周围可有宾语或修饰语。
patterns.domain: 营销目标、健康书名、天气网页、财经邮件

patterns.name: 法语词内 fin
patterns.context: 出现在法语短语中，分别为 «À cette fin»（为此）和 «présidence finlandaise»（芬兰轮值主席国）；激活同落在 fin 字符串上，但词义和语境不同。

patterns.name: 代码中的移位运算符
patterns.context: 位于代码示例中，紧邻数字和类型转换；激活集中在移位符号。

patterns.name: 彩色终端控制序列
patterns.trigger: «←» 后接 «[30;43m» 等 ANSI 转义序列片段
patterns.context: 出现在测试运行输出末尾，周围包含终端格式控制代码。

patterns.name: 单词内部 ep 子串
patterns.context: 激活位于医学文本中表示未抑郁或未耗竭的词内片段，并非完整词边界。

patterns.name: 其他分散的词内片段
patterns.context: 各自嵌在不同的普通词、专名或 URL 中；未见稳定共享的上下文或语义。
patterns.domain: 法语议会文本、StackExchange 日志、网页链接

en.description: Activation is distributed across word forms related to growth/improvement, French expressions of action, code operators and identifiers, and medical terminology, abbreviations, and typographic symbols. Some word-form patterns recur, but they cannot explain all examples.

patterns.name: Growth, improvement, or enhancement
patterns.context: Describes increases, improvements, or reversing a suppressed state; triggers often fall at the beginning or within English words, but the entire word is not marked every time.

patterns.name: Adaptation, response, and completion
patterns.context: In formal French texts, discusses adapting, responding to needs, and acting toward a goal.

patterns.name: Operators, values, and formatting markers in code
patterns.context: Code, debug output, or terminal escape sequences; activation falls on operators, punctuation, numbers, or formatting control characters.

patterns.name: Fragments within program identifiers
patterns.context: The trigger is a token fragment in code or code-like strings, with no stable semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: Specific word-internal fragments in English vocabulary
patterns.context: In legal text, activation centers on a stem fragment of exceed; the full phrase is exceed authorized access. This is an isolated example and does not establish a condition.

patterns.name: Medical abbreviations, symbols, and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In tabulated brain-imaging research results, markers are distributed across abbreviations, statistical symbols, and fragments of increase/decrease forms.

patterns.name: Word fragments in book titles and headlines
patterns.context: Appears in book or promotional titles and table-of-contents entries; overlaps locally with the Improve forms in section 2, but here primarily occurs in title contexts.

patterns.name: Controlled gene expression and experimental terminology
patterns.context: Abstracts on RNA, gene expression, and cellular phenotypes; activation is scattered across terminology and ordinary narrative words.

patterns.name: Newline characters
patterns.context: Activation occurs at a text-structure marker, but appears only once and the context shows no stable semantic relationship.

3_2765.description: 激活分布在增长/改进词形、法语行动表达、代码运算符与标识符，以及医学术语、缩写和排版符号等多类局部片段。部分词形模式重复，但无法统一解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 增长、改进或增强
patterns.context: 描述增加、改善、逆转受抑制状态；触发常落在英语词的词首或词内，并非每次完整词都标记。

patterns.name: 适配、响应与完成
patterns.context: 法语正式文本中谈适配、回应需求及采取行动的目的。

patterns.name: 代码中的运算符、数值及格式标记
patterns.context: 代码、调试输出或终端转义序列；激活落在运算符、标点、数字或格式控制符上。

patterns.name: 程序标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 触发的是代码或类似代码字符串中的分词片段，未见稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 英文词汇中的特定词内片段
patterns.context: 法律文本中，激活集中在 exceed 的词干片段，完整短语为 exceed authorized access；孤例，无法据此确定条件。

patterns.name: 医学缩写、符号和词内片段
patterns.context: 表格化脑影像研究结果中，标记分布于缩写、统计符号及 increase/decrease 词形片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 表格/医学研究

patterns.name: 书名与标题中的词语片段
patterns.context: 书籍或宣传性标题、目录条目中出现；与段2的 Improve 词形有局部重合，但此处主要是标题语境。

patterns.name: 受控基因表达及实验术语
patterns.context: RNA、基因表达及细胞表型研究摘要；激活分散在术语和普通叙述词上。

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 文本结构标记处出现激活，但仅见一次，且上下文未显示稳定语义关系。

en.description: Activation cues are scattered: two instances occur in «Opposed to» and two in «improve»; the rest fall on function words, line-break punctuation, code fields, and various terms, making them difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Word-initial «Opp»/following fragment in «opposed»
patterns.context: «Opposed» is followed by «to», forming a contrastive expression; activations are distributed across a word-internal fragment and a preposition.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in «Improve»
patterns.context: Appears in a list item or heading describing improvements to a brand, exposure, or personal life; markers fall on different word-internal fragments of «improve».

patterns.name: Unstressed function words and word-internal segmentation
patterns.context: Common function words, phrasal verbs, or prepositions in various syntactic positions, with no stable shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Line breaks and punctuation markers
patterns.context: Activations fall on line breaks, empty markers, arrows, or nearby punctuation; formatting or tokenization may be involved.
patterns.domain: Marketing layout, test output, Q&A, and abstracts

patterns.name: Scattered activations in code and structured fields
patterns.context: Embedded in configuration paths, syntax fields, or C-style code, with no consistent code-semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Local fragments in terms or proper names
