Domains and semantics vary widely; a few passages also involve code formatting, email headers, or paper cross-references, making it difficult to group them into a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within common words, proper names, or domain terms; fragment types vary and share neither a common meaning nor a fixed position
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including scientific abstracts, math problems, code, and email

patterns.name: Code and formatting syntax fragments
patterns.context: Appears in Python code, API usage, or documented parameter descriptions; some activations cover punctuation and format strings

patterns.name: The digit 3 in numbers and chemical formulas
patterns.context: The digit 3 occurs in radical problems in mathematical expressions or in compound names; the two contexts have no evident shared syntactic function

patterns.name: Sender field in email headers
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the From field of quoted email and within email addresses

patterns.name: Paper cross-reference markers
patterns.context: Appears on figure or table citations, or reference markers, and adjacent parentheses or markup syntax in paper body text

3_2893.concept: 跨领域的子词与结构片段
3_2893.description: 激活跨数学、代码、邮件与生物医学文本，常落在词内子词、数字、标点及结构化字符串上。领域和语义差异很大；少数段落还涉及代码格式、邮件头或论文交叉引用，难以归并为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 字词内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通词、专名或领域术语的内部子词片段上；可见片段类型并不一致，也没有共同的词义或固定位置
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括科学摘要、数学问题、代码和邮件

patterns.name: 代码与格式化语法片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Python 代码、API 用法或文档化参数说明中，部分激活覆盖标点和格式字符串

patterns.name: 数字及化学式中的3
patterns.context: 数字3处于数学表达式的根式问题或化合物名称中；两种语境没有明显共同句法功能

patterns.name: 邮件头中的发件人字段
patterns.context: 激活出现在引用邮件的 From 字段及邮箱地址内部

patterns.name: 论文交叉引用标记
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文中的图表引用或参考标记及其紧邻括号、标记语法

en.description: Activations are scattered across many types of text fragments, including numbers, chemical/biomedical terms, email addresses, code identifiers, and punctuation; there is no single stable semantic or grammatical trigger.

patterns.name: Numeric and numeric chemical-formula fragments
patterns.context: Numbers occur in math problems, compound names, or paper titles; activations cover numbers and their immediately adjacent token fragments.

patterns.name: Token fragments in element names
patterns.context: The element name erbium is split into multiple subwords, with activations concentrated within the name rather than in a general syntactic position.

patterns.name: Token fragments in email addresses and identifiers
patterns.context: An email header address consists of multiple word forms and underscores; stronger activations fall on fragments within the address.

patterns.name: Structural markers and name fragments in code
patterns.context: In code or code documentation, activations fall on keywords, identifiers, punctuation such as parentheses and semicolons, and near line breaks and default arguments; trigger locations are not consistent.

patterns.name: Subword in a specific subject name
patterns.context: In academic text about researchers’ emotions and influence, activation falls on an in-word subword of “lesbians”; the topic itself may also be relevant.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Angiogenesis
patterns.context: The term angiogenesis recurs in a title and adjacent text, with activations concentrated at the beginning of the word and within it.

3_2893.description: 激活分散在数字、化学/生物医学术语、邮件地址及代码标识符和标点等多类文本片段中；没有单一稳定的语义或语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字与数字化学式片段
patterns.context: 数字出现在数学题、化合物名称或论文标题中；激活覆盖数字及其紧邻的分词片段。
patterns.domain: 数学、化学与生物医学文献

patterns.name: 元素名称中的分词片段
patterns.context: 元素名 erbium 被拆成多个子词，激活集中在名称内部，而非一般句法位置。

patterns.name: 邮件地址与标识符中的切分片段
patterns.context: 邮件头的地址由多个词形和下划线组成；较强激活落在地址内部片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构性标记和名称片段
patterns.context: 代码或代码文档中，激活落在关键字、标识符、括号/分号等标点，以及换行和默认参数附近；具体触发位置并不统一。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与 API 文档

patterns.name: 特定研究对象名称中的子词
patterns.context: 关于研究者情绪与影响的学术文本中，激活落在“lesbians”的词内子词；上下文主题本身也可能相关。

patterns.name: Angiogenesis 词内片段
patterns.context: 术语 angiogenesis 在标题及相邻正文中重复出现，激活集中在词首和词内片段。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目标题/摘要

en.description: Activations occur in mathematical numerical expressions, chemical and biomedical terms, code identifiers, email addresses, and ancient-script transliterations; their commonality is weak and they often appear in fragmented strings containing numbers, abbreviations, symbols, or rare morphemes.

patterns.name: Numbers and arithmetic phrasing in math problems
patterns.context: Root-finding problems composed of numbers, numerical fragments, and mathematical wording

patterns.name: Numbers and morpheme fragments in chemical names
patterns.context: Compound names split into numbers, hyphens, and morpheme fragments

patterns.name: Technical terms containing numbers
patterns.context: Titles containing “3D” and segmented specialist vocabulary

patterns.name: Rare biomedical terms
patterns.context: Specialist terms split into multiple subword fragments

patterns.name: Code identifiers and field declarations
patterns.context: Uppercase abbreviations, underscore identifiers, numbers, and type/field names in code

patterns.name: Abbreviations and separators in email addresses
patterns.context: Sender addresses in email headers, containing abbreviations, underscores, and symbols

patterns.name: Ancient-script transliterations and numbering
patterns.context: Ancient divine names, cuneiform sign transliterations, and sign numbers

3_2893.concept: 技术字符串与罕见词素
3_2893.description: 激活分布于数学数字表达、化学与生物医学术语、代码标识符、邮件地址及古文字转写中；共同点较弱，常见于含数字、缩写、符号或罕见词素的碎片化字符串。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与运算表述
patterns.context: 数字、数值片段和数学措辞组成的求根问题

patterns.name: 化学名称中的数字与词素片段
patterns.context: 化合物名称被拆成数字、连字符和词素片段

patterns.name: 含数字的技术术语
patterns.context: 标题中含“3D”及拆分的专业词汇

patterns.name: 稀有生物医学术语
patterns.context: 专业术语被切分成多个子词片段

patterns.name: 代码标识符与字段声明
patterns.context: 代码中的大写缩写、下划线标识符、数字及类型/字段名

patterns.name: 邮件地址中的缩写与分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件头部的发件人地址，包含缩写、下划线和符号

patterns.name: 古文字转写及编号
patterns.context: 古代神名、楔形文字符号转写及符号编号

en.description: Activations cluster around several specific strings: obligation in legal documents, the project name gimpact, mathematical values, HPV, legal citation numbers, and readership; these contexts have no clear shared semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Legal obligation
patterns.context: obligation appears in legal discussion, often adjacent to to, of, has, any, his, and other words, concerning the duties of a party or institution.

patterns.name: gimpact string
patterns.context: The project URL http://gimpact.sourceforge.net/ appears in a code comment, with activation concentrated on the substring gimpact.

patterns.name: Number sequence or numerical problem
patterns.context: Asks for the square root of a number and requests the nearest integer; the surrounding text contains values from a math problem.

patterns.name: HPV types
patterns.context: types follows HPV, introducing identified types of human papillomavirus.

patterns.name: Legal citation numbers
patterns.context: Occurs in fragments of volume and page numbers in U.S. legal citations.

patterns.name: readership quantity phrase
patterns.context: Discusses readership data provided by advertising information and the number of readers.

3_2893.description: 激活集中于若干特定字符串：法律文书中的 obligation、项目名 gimpact、数学数值、HPV、法律引文数字及 readership；这些语境没有明显共同的语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: obligation 法律义务
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现 obligation，常与 to、of、has、any、his 等相邻，讨论当事人或机构的义务。

patterns.name: gimpact 字符串
patterns.context: 代码注释中的项目网址 http://gimpact.sourceforge.net/，激活集中在 gimpact 子串。

patterns.name: 数字序列或数值问题
patterns.context: 询问某个数的平方根并要求取最近整数；周围是数学题中的数值。

patterns.name: HPV 类型
patterns.context: HPV 后紧接 types，介绍已识别的人乳头瘤病毒类型。

patterns.name: 法律引文编号
patterns.context: 出现在美国法律引文的卷页编号片段中。

patterns.name: readership 数量短语
patterns.context: 谈及广告信息所提供的 readership 数据及读者数量。

en.description: The subword token «b» shows strong activation in all ten passages, across words, identifiers, code, tables, and poetry; hexadecimal/alphanumeric sequences in code are a narrower recurring context, but do not explain a unique semantic pattern.

patterns.name: b subword fragments in code
patterns.context: The trigger is the standalone subword token «b», appearing in identifiers, code, or ordinary words with no clear semantic connection; it is often surrounded by letters, numbers, underscores, or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Code, medical abstracts, literary texts, and data tables

patterns.name: Numeric and letter-b code sequences
patterns.context: In hexadecimal constants or debugging identifiers, b occurs within numeric or mixed alphanumeric sequences.

3_2893.description: 十段都出现强激活的子词 token «b»，位置横跨单词、标识符、代码、表格和诗歌；代码中的十六进制/字母数字序列是较窄的重复场景，但不足以解释为唯一语义模式。

patterns.name: 代码中的 b 子词片段
patterns.context: 触发点是独立的子词 token «b»，出现在多种无明显语义联系的标识符、代码或普通词中；周围常有字母、数字、下划线或标点。
patterns.domain: 代码、医学摘要、文学文本及数据表

patterns.name: 数字与字母 b 的代码序列
patterns.context: 十六进制常量或调试标识符中，b 出现在数字或混合字母数字序列里。

en.concept: Term/stem and polysemous triggers for obligation
en.description: Activations fall into two main groups: a stem fragment of the full word energetics in biomedical contexts, and obligation in legal contexts (statutory duties, contractual duties, and so on); there are also postal patent wording and sporadic legal formulas and occurrences of will.

patterns.name: Bioenergetics terminology
patterns.context: The word occurs in sentences about energy metabolism, mitochondrial genes, enzyme catalysis, or molecular biology processes; the prefix token «energet» is the main strong trigger, followed by «ics».
patterns.domain: NIH biomedical and molecular biology academic text

patterns.name: Legal obligation
patterns.context: obligation appears in legal text concerning statutory duties, child support obligations, trial-related duties, bank contractual obligations, or lawyers’ duties to clients.

patterns.name: Postal and mailing operations
patterns.context: Patent background text describing postal systems, mail batches, mailing declarations, and delivery services.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial will
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of a sentence or clause in legal discussion or patent descriptions; the word also appears in passages with other strong activation patterns, but does not form a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Case citations and procedural language
patterns.context: Court decision citations or procedural discussion; activations are scattered across wording about courts, litigation, and rulings, without showing a stable single lexical item.

3_2893.concept: 术语/词干与 obligation 多义触发
3_2893.description: 激活分成两大类：生物医学语境中完整词 energetics 的词干片段，以及法律语境中 obligation（法定义务、合同义务等）；另有邮政专利措辞和若干法律套语、will 的零散激活。

patterns.name: 生物能学术语
patterns.context: 该词出现在讨论能量代谢、线粒体基因、酶催化或分子生物学过程的句子中；前缀分词 «energet» 是主要强触发，后接 «ics»。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学与分子生物学学术文本

patterns.name: 法律义务
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现 obligation，谈及法定义务、子女抚养义务、审判相关义务、银行合同义务或律师对委托人的义务。

patterns.name: 邮政邮寄事务
patterns.context: 描述邮政系统、邮件批次、邮寄声明及邮递服务的专利背景文本。

patterns.name: 句首 will
patterns.context: 出现在法律论述或专利描述中的句首或分句开头；该词也在其他强激活模式所在段中出现，但不构成统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 判例引文与诉讼程序表述
patterns.trigger: « District»« Court»、« speedy»« trial»、« prima»« facie»
patterns.context: 法院判决的引文或程序性论述；激活分散在法院、诉讼与裁判措辞中，并未显示稳定的单一词项。

en.concept: Rare terms and infinity expressions in academic text
en.description: Activations occur mainly on “infinitely” in mathematical text and “linkage disequilibrium” in genetics text; there are also biomedical disease/wound outcomes and sporadic citation markers and terms such as GWAS, MACS, and AD.

patterns.name: Expressions of infinitely many/repeatedly
patterns.context: Discusses limits, repeated returns, the number of objects, or distance tending to infinity; the trigger falls on “infinitely” itself

patterns.name: Linkage disequilibrium (LD) terminology
patterns.context: In contexts involving genetic variants, SNPs, and gene association analyses; the term is mentioned directly in the sentence

patterns.name: Worsening/injury outcomes in diseases or biological processes
patterns.context: Describes worsening disease or changes related to skin tissue or wound healing; differs from the LD and mathematical uses in the passages

patterns.name: Special citation markers and author names
patterns.context: When citing studies and authors, the marker is adjacent to author initials or citation numbers

patterns.name: Genomic data abbreviation
patterns.context: When discussing conversion of SNP association P values and genome-wide analyses

patterns.name: General cohort-study abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears as part of the name Multi-center AIDS Cohort Study in descriptions of genotyping studies

patterns.name: Expressions of geometric spatial boundaries
patterns.context: Describes hyperbolic distance in the Poincaré ball model increasing toward the disk boundary; this shares the semantics of “infinity” with other mathematical passages, but the trigger string differs

patterns.name: Specific disease abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears as a disease abbreviation in genetic candidate-gene studies

3_2893.concept: 学术文本中的稀有术语与无穷表述
3_2893.description: 激活主要出现在数学文本的“infinitely”及遗传学文本的“linkage disequilibrium”；另有生物医学的病情/伤口结局，以及零散的引文标记、GWAS、MACS和AD等术语。

patterns.name: 无穷多/无限次的表述
patterns.trigger: “infinitely”及其后续词，如 “infinitely narrow”、“infinitely often”、“infinitely many”、“infinitely distant”
patterns.context: 讨论极限、反复返回、对象数量或距离趋于无穷时；触发点落在“infinitely”本身

patterns.name: 连锁不平衡（LD）术语
patterns.context: 遗传变异、SNP、基因关联分析的语境；术语在句中被直接提及
patterns.domain: 遗传学、生物医学与基因组学

patterns.name: 疾病或生物过程中的加重/损伤结果
patterns.context: 描述病情加重，或皮肤组织、伤口愈合相关变化；与段落里的 LD 和数学用法不同

patterns.name: 特殊引文标记与作者姓名
patterns.context: 引述研究及作者时，标记紧邻作者缩写或引文编号

patterns.name: 基因组数据缩写
patterns.context: 讨论 SNP 的关联 P 值转换及基因组范围分析时

patterns.name: 一般队列研究缩写
patterns.context: 作为 Multi-center AIDS Cohort Study 名称的一部分，出现在基因分型研究描述中

patterns.name: 几何空间边界的表述
patterns.context: 描述 Poincaré 球模型中双曲距离朝圆盘边缘增长；此处与其他数学段落共享“无穷”语义，但触发串不同

patterns.name: 特定疾病缩写
patterns.context: 作为遗传学候选基因研究中的疾病缩写出现

en.concept: Polysemous English words and frequent academic collocations
en.description: Activations cluster around polysemous words: inferential connector “thus,” quantity/equivalence expression “amounts,” mathematical limit “bound,” and “bound” in a protein name. The surface forms recur across disciplines, but their meanings and contexts are not consistent.

patterns.name: Causal/inferential connector thus
patterns.context: Appears after a preceding statement to introduce a result, inference, or summary; often occurs mid-sentence or at the beginning of a sentence
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, research proposals, or papers

patterns.name: amounts in a quantity phrase
patterns.context: In the noun phrase “relative amounts of A-βeta and sB-APP”

patterns.name: amounts in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: In “amounts to the flatness,” meaning “is equivalent to”

patterns.name: bound in graph theory
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical discussion involving χ(G), upper/lower bounds, or complexity estimates
patterns.domain: Graph theory, combinatorics, and theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: bound in a receptor/protein name
patterns.context: Part of the protein name “growth factor receptor bound protein”

3_2893.concept: 英文多义词与高频学术搭配
3_2893.description: 激活集中于多义词：推论连接词“thus”、数量/相当于表达“amounts”、数学界限“bound”，以及蛋白名中的“bound”。词面跨学科复现，但语义和语境并不统一。

patterns.name: 因果/推论连接词 thus
patterns.context: 出现在前文陈述之后，引出结果、推论或总结；常位于句中或句首
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研计划或论文

patterns.name: 数量短语中的 amounts
patterns.context: “relative amounts of A-βeta and sB-APP”这一名词短语中

patterns.name: 数学表达中的 amounts
patterns.context: “amounts to the flatness”中，意为“相当于”

patterns.name: 图论中的 bound
patterns.context: 出现在χ(G)、上界/下界或复杂度估计等数学论述中
patterns.domain: 图论、组合数学与理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 受体/蛋白名称中的 bound
patterns.context: 作为“growth factor receptor bound protein”蛋白名称的一部分

en.description: Activations are scattered across scientific abstracts, patents, and license text, respectively involving increased blood pressure, reduced synthesis or function, restrictions, delays, phrases describing liability, and cellular force generation; no stable shared lexical sense or domain pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Increased blood pressure
patterns.context: Studies the response of noradrenergic neurons to acute increases in arterial blood pressure

patterns.name: Reduced protein synthesis
patterns.context: Studies changes in protein synthesis after whole-brain ischemia and their relationship to heat-shock protein induction
patterns.domain: NIH ischemia and stress biology research abstracts

patterns.name: Reduced fracture resistance
patterns.context: Studies the effects of collagen glycation on bone fracture properties

patterns.name: Restricting iNOS
patterns.context: Describes inhibition of nitration and oxidative damage

patterns.name: Immune response restriction
patterns.context: Investigates factors that limit B-cell precursors and induced antibody responses

patterns.name: Signal transmission delay
patterns.context: Delay caused by resistance and capacitance when transmitting drive signals between pixel circuits

patterns.name: Manner phrase in a liability clause
patterns.context: A software disclaimer describes liability arising from use of the software in any manner

patterns.name: Force-generation modifier
patterns.context: Describes the connection between focal adhesions and the intracellular actin cytoskeleton

patterns.name: Doubt or questioning
patterns.context: Raises questions about experimental results and says computational results also support this doubt

3_2893.description: 激活分散于科学摘要、专利和许可证文本，分别落在血压升高、合成或功能下降、限制、延迟、责任方式短语及细胞力生成等局部语境；未见稳定共享的词义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 血压升高
patterns.context: 研究去甲肾上腺素神经元对动脉血压急性升高的反应
patterns.domain: NIH 神经生理学研究摘要

patterns.name: 蛋白质合成减少
patterns.context: 全脑缺血后研究蛋白质合成变化及其与热休克蛋白诱导的关系
patterns.domain: NIH 缺血与应激生物学研究摘要

patterns.name: 骨折抵抗力下降
patterns.trigger: «decreases»10，指 AGEs 在骨基质积累后骨的 fracture resistance 下降
patterns.context: 研究胶原糖化对骨断裂性质的影响
patterns.domain: NIH 骨生物学研究摘要

patterns.name: 限制 iNOS
patterns.trigger: «limits»10，指髓系细胞中的 A1 上调限制 iNOS 来源的作用
patterns.context: 描述对硝化及氧化损伤的抑制
patterns.domain: NIH 神经血管退化研究摘要

patterns.name: 免疫应答限制
patterns.trigger: «restrictions»10，指 eliciting HIV 广谱中和抗体相关免疫原时的限制
patterns.context: 探究 B 细胞前体及诱导抗体应答的限制因素
patterns.domain: NIH HIV 疫苗研究摘要

patterns.name: 电信号延迟
patterns.trigger: «due»10，处于“delay due to the resistance and the capacitance”中
patterns.context: 像素电路间传输驱动信号时，由电阻和电容造成延迟

patterns.name: 责任条款中的方式短语
patterns.trigger: «WAY»10，处于“ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE OF THIS SOFTWARE”中
patterns.context: 软件免责声明中描述因任何方式使用软件而产生的责任
patterns.domain: 软件许可证法律文本，免责声明

patterns.name: 力生成修饰语
patterns.context: 描述黏着斑与细胞内肌动蛋白骨架的连接
patterns.domain: NIH 细胞生物学研究摘要

patterns.name: 怀疑或质疑
patterns.context: 对实验结果提出疑问，并称计算结果也支持这种疑问

en.description: Primarily responds to force/forces and descriptions of applied or driving mechanical forces, in contexts including cell adhesion, TCR forces, ciliary driving forces, tumor migration, and airway contraction; sporadic triggers also include inward current, influence, restrictions, and secretions.

patterns.name: Force/mechanical-force terms
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of mechanical action, applied force, or driving mechanisms; no fixed syntactic position is required
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts and grant applications

patterns.name: Inward induced by conditions or stimuli
patterns.context: Describes leptin-dependent currents induced at a specific voltage

patterns.name: Other localized strong trigger words
patterns.context: Appears respectively in contexts involving light and infection susceptibility, immunogen-induced restrictions, COX-2 and post-injury effects, and adrenal cortical secretions; the contexts show no evident commonality

3_2893.description: 主要响应 force/forces 及施加或驱动机械力的表述，见细胞黏附、TCR受力、纤毛驱动力、肿瘤迁移和气道收缩；另有 inward current、influence、restrictions、secretions 等零散触发。

patterns.name: force/机械力相关词
patterns.context: 出现于力学作用、力的施加或驱动机制描述；不要求固定句法位置
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要及项目申请

patterns.name: 施加条件或刺激诱发的 inward
patterns.context: 描述 leptin-dependent 电流在特定电位下被诱发
patterns.domain: 生理学/电生理结果描述

patterns.name: 其他局部强触发词
patterns.context: 分别出现在光照与感染易感性、免疫原诱发限制、COX-2 与创伤后影响、肾上腺皮质分泌物等语境；彼此无明显共同上下文
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、免疫学项目申请

en.description: Almost all passages activate in mechanical or idiomatic collocations containing force/forces; these include mechanical force, applied force, and force measurement, as well as nonliteral collocations such as driving force and forces to.

patterns.name: Force and force-related terms
patterns.context: Involves the generation, application, or measurement of force, or its biophysical effects; sometimes occurs in adjacent phrases with «with», «by», «of», and so on.
patterns.domain: Biomedical and molecular biology, including muscle, immunity, sensation, cell migration, and molecular measurement

patterns.name: Idiomatic collocation driving force
patterns.context: «force» combines with «driving» to refer to a factor that drives a process, not necessarily a direct mechanical force.
patterns.domain: Biomedical discussion; concerning antibody industry development or antibiotic uptake

patterns.name: Incomplete idiomatic phrase
patterns.context: «forces» is used as a noun followed by «to», meaning to cooperate in doing something; this differs from the mechanical sense.

3_2893.description: 几乎所有段落都在含 force/forces 的力学或惯用搭配中激活；包括机械力、受力与测力，也包括 driving force 和 forces to 等非字面搭配。

patterns.name: 力及受力相关术语
patterns.context: 涉及力的产生、施加、测量或其生物物理效应；有时出现在邻近的 «with»、«by»、«of» 等短语中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与分子生物学，包括肌肉、免疫、感觉、细胞迁移和分子测量

patterns.name: 驱动力惯用搭配
patterns.context: «force» 与 «driving» 连用，指推动某种过程的因素，而非必然指直接的机械力。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论述；涉及抗体产业发展或抗生素摄取

patterns.name: 不完整的惯用短语
patterns.context: «forces» 作名词，后接 «to»，表示协力开展某事；与力学含义不同。
patterns.domain: 科研项目介绍、团队合作文体

en.concept: Expressions of relations and effects in English technical text
en.description: The most stable trigger is force and its collocations, covering driving action, force, force measurement, and physical interaction; sporadic activations also include direction, the association between salt intake and risk, code structure symbols, and a fragment within muscle extensibility.

patterns.name: Force-related expressions
patterns.context: The English word force appears as a noun, possibly referring to a driving force, mechanical force, biophysical action, physical interaction, or force measurement; adjacent forms and collocations vary

patterns.name: Direction
patterns.context: Direction appears in contexts describing trends or the direction of an object's motion

patterns.name: Blood-pressure risk discussion
patterns.context: Discusses the association between salt intake and health risks; no other passage has the same trigger word

patterns.name: Code structure and indentation symbols
patterns.context: Function definitions, constructor calls, and indentation in code snippets; activation falls on code tokens rather than obvious semantic words

patterns.name: Unspecified muscle extensibility expression
patterns.context: Describes decreased muscle extensibility and fewer sarcomeres; appears in isolation, with no clear connection to other activation patterns

3_2893.concept: 英文技术文本中的关系与作用表达
3_2893.description: 最稳定的触发是 force 及其搭配，涵盖推动作用、受力、测力和物理相互作用；另有 direction、盐摄入与风险关联、代码结构符号及 muscle extensibility 词内片段等零散激活。

patterns.name: force 相关表达
patterns.trigger: «force»；包括“a« driving»5« force»10« behind»7 the« fast»-paced expansion”“the« driving»3 force”“application of force”“force transmitted”“force-carrier”“and force”
patterns.context: 英文词 force 作为名词出现，可能指推动力、机械力、生物物理作用、物理学相互作用或力的测量；相邻词形和搭配不同

patterns.name: direction
patterns.context: direction 出现在描述趋势或物体运动方向的语境
patterns.domain: 技术专利、知识产权评论

patterns.name: 血压风险论述
patterns.context: 谈论盐摄入与健康风险之间的关联；未见其他段有相同触发词

patterns.name: 代码结构与缩进符号
patterns.context: 代码片段中的函数定义、构造函数调用和缩进；激活落在代码 token 而非明显语义词上

patterns.name: 未标明的肌肉伸展性表达
patterns.context: 描述肌肉伸展性下降及肌节数减少；孤立出现，未与其他激活模式形成清晰联系

en.description: Activations most consistently occur with force and its collocations; there are also sporadic responses to the sentence-final parenthetical anyways, against in force contexts, discourse-related direction, and words related to inclination/consequences. Overall, contexts span multiple fields, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-final adverb way(s)
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or in a parenthetical position, means “anyway / that said,” and is followed by a period or comma; activation is concentrated on ways

patterns.name: Semantic collocations of force
patterns.context: force occurs in compound words or noun phrases referring to a driving force, a physical force, or a force-bearing entity; surrounding word forms vary with tokenization
patterns.domain: Patents, biomedicine, physics, and research abstracts

patterns.name: Object acted against after against
patterns.context: Describes a door being released and hitting or pressing against a storage container

patterns.name: Discourse-related use of direction
patterns.context: Combines with intellectual property rights and one to refer to the direction of changes in rights

patterns.name: Terms related to changes in direction
patterns.context: Describes tilting and rotation of crystal structures and their consequences

3_2893.description: 激活最稳定地出现在 force 及其搭配中；另对句末插入语 anyways、受力语境中的 against、论述性 direction，以及倾斜/后果相关词有零散反应。整体跨领域，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: way(s) 句末副词
patterns.context: 句首或插入语位置表示“无论如何／话说回来”，后接句号或逗号；激活集中在 ways

patterns.name: force 的语义搭配
patterns.context: force 出现在复合词或名词短语中，表示驱动力、作用力或力载体；前后词形因分词而有所变化
patterns.domain: 专利、生物医学、物理学与科研摘要

patterns.name: against 后的受力对象
patterns.context: 描述门被释放后撞向或抵住储物箱

patterns.name: 方向的论述性用法
patterns.context: 与 intellectual property rights 和 one 搭配，指权利变化的方向

patterns.name: 方向变化相关词
patterns.context: 描述晶体结构倾斜、旋转及其后果

en.description: Primarily responds to force and common collocations: driving force, force operations, join forces, and force-carrier; there are also isolated activations on direction, fact, influence, and other terms that are difficult to group into a shared pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation driving force
patterns.context: “driving force” followed by behind or of, describing the cause driving an expansion, uptake, or disease onset; in passage 1, “behind the fast-paced expansion” also occurs between the two words.
patterns.domain: Patents, biomedical papers, research project abstracts

patterns.name: Force as a verb or command option
patterns.context: Force used as an imperative verb or as part of a software option, referring to forcing an edit or deletion; capitalization and following forms vary.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation with plural forces
patterns.context: “join forces to” refers to collaborating on research, with force in the plural.

patterns.name: Force-carrier term
patterns.context: Force and carrier form a hyphenated compound describing a mediator particle in the interaction mechanism of dark matter particles.

patterns.name: Isolated lexical or phrasal residual activations
patterns.context: Markers fall on words with varied semantics and syntax; local contexts show no evident force collocation or shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: News discussions, technical webpages, biomedical papers

3_2893.description: 主要响应 force 及其常见搭配：driving force、强制操作、join forces、force-carrier；另有 direction、fact、influence 等孤立激活，难以归入共同模式。

patterns.name: driving force 固定搭配
patterns.context: “driving force”后接 behind 或 of，说明推动某种扩张、摄取或疾病起始的原因；第1段中两词间还有 “behind the fast-paced expansion”。
patterns.domain: 专利、生物医学论文、科研项目摘要

patterns.name: force 动词或命令选项
patterns.context: Force 作命令式动词或软件选项的一部分，指强制编辑或删除；大小写及后接形式不同。

patterns.name: 复数 forces 固定搭配
patterns.context: “join forces to”指合作开展研究，force 用复数。

patterns.name: force-carrier 术语
patterns.context: force 与 carrier 构成连字符复合词，描述暗物质粒子相互作用机制中的媒介粒子。

patterns.name: 独立词汇或短语残余激活
patterns.context: 标记落在语义和句法各异的词上；局部上下文没有显见的 force 搭配或共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻讨论、技术网页、生物医学论文

en.description: Activations concentrate on fixed phrases and formatting fragments: DENYING in court titles, driving force, no influence on, and sporadic instances of anyways, repercussions, name fragments, and HTML submission fields; no single semantic theme covers all instances.

patterns.name: Imperative “deny” ruling title
patterns.context: Legal documents announce that a court denies a motion in an uppercase title; the DENYING token fragment is especially prominent in titles.

patterns.name: drive/force collocation
patterns.context: The phrase driving force describes a force that promotes expansion or uptake, often near behind or of.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, technology discussions, biomedical papers

patterns.name: influence on collocation
patterns.context: Experimental results state that an intervention has no effect on an object, commonly in the structure no influence on.

patterns.name: “anyways” discourse marker
patterns.context: Colloquial anyways appears at the end of a sentence or in parentheses to shift topics or wrap up preceding content.

patterns.name: Expression of long-term consequences
patterns.context: Combined with early postnatal experience and long-term, it denotes subsequent effects caused by early experience.
patterns.domain: NIH research plans or biomedical texts

patterns.name: Word-ending fragment in a name
patterns.context: Appears in the researcher name Quesenberry, with no clear semantic or syntactic connection.

patterns.name: HTML form submission field
patterns.context: In a form following an HTML table, the submit button’s value attribute is set to Submit.

3_2893.description: 激活集中于固定短语与格式片段：法院标题中的 DENYING、driving force、no influence on，以及零散的 anyways、repercussions、姓名片段和 HTML 提交字段；没有单一语义主题覆盖全部实例。

patterns.name: “deny”命令式裁定标题
patterns.context: 法律文书以大写标题宣布法院驳回动议；在标题中 DENYING 的分词片段尤为显著。

patterns.name: drive/force 搭配
patterns.context: 短语 driving force 描述促成扩张或摄取的力量，附近常有 behind 或 of。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科技讨论、生物医学论文

patterns.name: influence on 搭配
patterns.context: 实验结果陈述某种干预对某对象没有影响，常见结构为 no influence on。

patterns.name: “anyways”话语标记
patterns.context: 句末或括号内以口语化 anyways 转换话题或收束前述内容。

patterns.name: 长期后果表达
patterns.context: 与 early postnatal experience、long-term 连用，表示早期经历造成的后续影响。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划或生物医学文本

patterns.name: 姓名中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在研究者姓名 Quesenberry 内，缺乏明显的语义或句法关联。

patterns.name: HTML 表单提交字段
patterns.context: HTML 表格之后的表单中，提交按钮的 value 属性设置为 Submit。

en.description: Primarily responds to the adjacent collocation of the noun influence and the preposition on, across a range of technical writing styles; there is also a weaker response to the segmented form of halting and to affected in the sense of being impacted.

patterns.name: Collocation influence on
patterns.context: The noun influence is followed by on, introducing the affected entity; this is the most stable trigger pattern, with activation often on influence or on.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, medical and biomedical abstracts, patent backgrounds, and general technical discussions

patterns.name: Halting word form
patterns.context: The word is split into hal and ting, appearing in contexts describing cell-cycle arrest or an apoptosis pathway.
patterns.domain: DNA damage and radiation biology; also seen in online discussions

patterns.name: Synonymous expression related to impact
patterns.context: The affected entity is expressed with affected, followed by the degree phrase “the worst”; semantically similar to influence on, but syntactically different.
patterns.domain: Informal discussion of acute radiation injury

3_2893.description: 主要响应名词 influence 与介词 on 的相邻搭配，横跨多种科技文体；另对 halting 的分词形式及受影响义的 affected 有较弱响应。

patterns.name: influence on 搭配
patterns.trigger: «influence» 后接 «on»（如 “influence on the behavior”“influence on the efficiency”）
patterns.context: 名词 influence 后接 on，引出受影响对象；是最稳定的触发模式，强度常落在 influence 或 on 上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学与生物医学摘要、专利背景，也见于一般科技讨论

patterns.name: halting 词形
patterns.context: 词语被切分为 hal 与 ting，出现在描述停止细胞周期或凋亡通路的语境中。
patterns.domain: DNA 损伤与辐射生物学；另见网络讨论

patterns.name: 影响相关的近义表达
patterns.context: 受影响对象用 affected 表达，后接程度描述 “the worst”；与 influence on 语义相近，但句法不同。
patterns.domain: 关于急性辐射损伤的非正式讨论

en.description: Activations center on “influence” and its collocation with “on,” used to describe the effects of a factor on behavior, physiological measures, retention, printing, splicing, transport, vibration, policy outcomes, or catalytic activity; also includes qualifiers such as negation and degree.

patterns.name: Object following influence on
patterns.context: Describes the effect of a factor on an outcome, property, activity, or object; common in statements about having or not having an effect, or the strength of an effect.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patent backgrounds, and policy discussions

3_2893.description: 激活集中于“influence”及其与“on”的搭配，用于陈述某因素对行为、生理指标、保留、印刷、剪接、运输、振动、政策结果或催化活性的影响；也包括否定、强弱等限定。

patterns.name: influence on 后接对象
patterns.trigger: “influence”后接“on”（如 “influence on the behavior”“influence on myogenic tone”“influence on who bears the brunt”）；也包括 “influence … on” 的变体
patterns.context: 描述某因素对结果、性质、活动或对象的影响；常见于“有/没有影响”“影响强弱”等陈述。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利背景及政策讨论

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of influence relations, especially influence on and impact on; it also responds to response and halt-ing in biomedical contexts, and once to leads to and RUNX2 activity in a description of cancer mechanisms.

patterns.name: Influence on after a noun
patterns.context: In structures such as “have/had no influence on” and “has an influence on,” activation is concentrated on influence and the immediately following on; surrounding content describes the effect of a factor on an outcome or process.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, experimental results, and paper discussions

patterns.name: Damage response
patterns.context: Response refers to the cell's reaction to DNA damage and occurs after DNA damage, before the explanation of the abbreviation DDR.

patterns.name: Response and adaptive response
patterns.context: Describes muscle-fiber responses induced by exercise training or physiological conditions, followed by of, induced, or related terms.

patterns.name: Little impact on under constraints
patterns.context: A conclusion states that a treatment or source has little effect on a measurement; activation falls mainly on impact and on.
patterns.domain: Animal nutrition and physiology research abstracts

patterns.name: Impact on sustainability
patterns.context: Impact is preceded by negative and followed by on and an entity related to environmental or resource sustainability.
patterns.domain: Marine resources and consumer fraud discussions

patterns.name: RUNX2 activity and metastasis mechanism
patterns.context: Describes the link between WWOX loss, unconstrained RUNX2 activity, and mechanisms related to bone metastasis.
patterns.domain: Breast cancer and tumor metastasis research

patterns.name: Halt/halt-ing
patterns.context: The ending token of halt activates when describing cell-cycle arrest or blocking an apoptosis pathway; in both instances the meaning is to prevent a biological process from continuing.
patterns.domain: DNA damage response and radiation injury discussions

3_2893.concept: 生物医学中的效应与反应
3_2893.description: 主要响应影响关系表达，尤其是 influence on 与 impact on；另在生物医学语境中响应 response 及 halt-ing，并有一处癌症机制叙述中的 leads to 与 RUNX2 活性。

patterns.name: 名词后的 influence on
patterns.context: 在“have/had no influence on”“has an influence on”等结构中，激活集中于 influence 和紧随其后的 on；前后内容描述某因素对结果或过程的影响。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、实验结果与论文论述

patterns.name: damage response
patterns.context: response 指细胞对 DNA 损伤的反应，并处于 DNA damage 后、DDR 缩写解释前。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学与 DNA 修复

patterns.name: response 与适应性反应
patterns.context: 描述运动训练或生理条件诱发的肌肉纤维反应，后接 of、induced 等成分。

patterns.name: 限制条件下的 little impact on
patterns.context: conclusion 中说明某处理或来源对测量结果影响很小；激活主要落在 impact 和 on。
patterns.domain: 动物营养与生理研究摘要

patterns.name: impact on 可持续性
patterns.context: impact 前有 negative，后接 on 和环境或资源可持续性相关对象。
patterns.domain: 海洋资源与消费欺诈讨论

patterns.name: RUNX2 活性与转移机制
patterns.context: 叙述 WW​​OX 丢失与 RUNX2 不受约束的活性、骨转移相关机制之间的联系。
patterns.domain: 乳腺癌与肿瘤转移研究

patterns.name: halt/halt-ing
patterns.context: halt 的词尾 token 在描述停止细胞周期或阻断细胞凋亡通路时激活；两处语义都是阻止某个生物过程继续。
patterns.domain: DNA 损伤反应与放射损伤讨论

en.description: Primarily responds to the collocation of influence with on, denoting the effect of a factor on an outcome, object, or process in scientific and policy contexts; also activates on DENYING in court titles.

patterns.name: influence on
patterns.context: The noun influence is immediately followed by on, introducing the affected object; may include degree or negation modifiers such as no or major.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, scientific texts, energy policy texts

patterns.name: DENYING in legal titles
patterns.context: Appears in the court order title ORDER DENYING, followed by the defendant’s motion.

3_2893.concept: 影响关系及否定裁决词
3_2893.description: 主要响应 influence 与 on 的搭配，表示某因素对结果、对象或过程的影响，见科研及政策语境；另对法院标题中的 DENYING 有激活。

patterns.name: influence on
patterns.context: 名词 influence 后紧接 on，引出受影响的对象；可带程度或否定修饰，如 no、major。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研文本、能源政策文本

patterns.name: 法律标题中的 DENYING
patterns.context: 出现在法院命令标题 ORDER DENYING，后接被告的动议。

en.description: Activations concentrate on word fragments such as DENYING/DEFENDANT/MOTION in court-ruling titles, and on influence/impact on expressions of influence in academic text; there are also sporadic activations on driving force behind and one isolated der.

patterns.name: Court ruling titles and litigation motions
patterns.context: Titles of court orders or opinions, especially those involving denial of a defendant's motion; in passages 1, 3, and 4, activation falls on different subword fragments in the title words

patterns.name: Collocation influence on
patterns.context: The noun influence or impact is followed by on, introducing the effect of a factor on an outcome, entity, or group; the affected entity may be a biological response, economic burden, or sustainability
patterns.domain: Expository/academic texts in biomedicine, public policy, environmental research, and other fields

patterns.name: Collocation driving force behind
patterns.context: “driving force behind” describes a factor driving a trend or development

patterns.name: Unexplained
patterns.context: Appears in a person/law-firm information line in a legal document, after the name fragment “Wayne”; no clear collocation linking it to other patterns is evident

3_2893.concept: 表达影响或裁定的关系词语境
3_2893.description: 激活集中于法律裁定标题中的 DENYING/DEFENDANT/MOTION 等词片段，以及学术文本中 influence/impact on 的影响关系表达；另有 driving force behind 和一处 der 的孤立激活。

patterns.name: 法院裁定标题与诉讼请求
patterns.trigger: «ORDER»、«DENYING»、«DEFENDANT»、«MOTION»；另见«MEMORANDUM» OPINION AND« ORDER»« GRANT»ING PLAINTIFFS MOTION
patterns.context: 法律文书中法院命令或意见标题，尤其涉及驳回被告动议；第1、3、4段中激活落在标题词的不同子词片段上
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院判决/命令

patterns.name: influence on 搭配
patterns.context: 名词 influence 或 impact 后接 on，引出某因素对结果、对象或群体的作用；影响对象可为生物反应、经济负担或可持续性
patterns.domain: 生物医学、公共政策、环境研究等说明性/学术文本

patterns.name: driving force behind 搭配
patterns.context: “driving force behind”用于说明某趋势或发展的推动因素

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 出现在法律文书人物/律所信息行中，位于姓名片段“Wayne”之后，未见与其他模式明确对应的搭配

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of influence relations such as “influence/impact on,” including positive or negative effects across different domains; also includes “impediment to” and “ORDER DENYING” in court ruling titles.

patterns.name: Influence/effect relation
patterns.context: “Influence/impact on” denotes whether a factor affects an object; may be preceded or followed by degree, negation, or qualifying terms.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, legal texts, and general discussion

patterns.name: Impediment to a process
patterns.context: The noun “impediment” is followed by “to,” referring to something that hinders development or action.

patterns.name: Legal ruling title
patterns.context: An uppercase term in a court order or ruling title, indicating denial of the defendant’s motion; distinct from influence relations in the body text.

3_2893.description: 主要响应“influence/impact on”一类影响关系表达，包含肯定或否定影响及不同领域语境；另见“impediment to”和法院裁定标题中的“ORDER DENYING”。

patterns.name: 影响/作用关系
patterns.context: “influence/impact on”表示某因素对对象产生或不产生影响；前后可有程度、否定或限定语。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律及一般论述

patterns.name: 阻碍某过程
patterns.context: 名词“impediment”后接“to”，指妨碍某项发展或行动。

patterns.name: 法律裁定标题
patterns.context: 法院命令或裁定标题中的大写词，表示驳回被告动议；不同于正文中的影响关系。

en.concept: Influence relations and related causal expressions
en.description: Primarily responds to influence/impact and similar words expressing a factor-to-outcome influence relation with on/in, covering both presence and absence of influence and positive and negative effects; there are also sporadic responses to cause of, driving force collocations, and paper phrasing about decreased expression levels.

patterns.name: Influence/effect relation
patterns.context: Indicates whether a factor has an effect on an outcome, performance, behavior, or response; on often appears near the trigger word, with one instance of in.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, research funding texts, news, and technical explanations

patterns.name: Collocation cause of
patterns.context: The noun cause is followed by an of phrase; the fragment is cut off in the sentence, so its specific referent is unclear.

patterns.name: Driving-force collocation
patterns.context: The fixed expression driving force refers to a force driving a development or expansion.

patterns.name: Expression-level changes
patterns.context: Biomedical paper-style text describes a decrease in gene or protein expression levels; activation falls on a subword of Decreased.

3_2893.concept: 影响关系及相关因果表达
3_2893.description: 主要响应 influence/impact 等词与 on/in 构成的因素—结果影响关系，涵盖有无影响及正负效应；另对 cause of、driving force 搭配及表达量下降的论文表述有零散响应。

patterns.name: 影响/效应关系
patterns.context: 表示某因素对结果、表现、行为或反应有或没有影响；触发词附近常见 on，另有一例 in。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、科研资助文本、新闻、技术说明

patterns.name: cause of 搭配
patterns.context: 名词 cause 后接 of 短语；该片段在句中被截断，具体所指不明。

patterns.name: 驱动力搭配
patterns.context: 固定表达 driving force，指推动某种发展或扩张的力量。

patterns.name: 表达量变化
patterns.context: 图注式生物医学文本中描述基因或蛋白表达水平降低；激活落在 Decreased 的子词上。

en.description: Primarily activates in “influence/impact on,” covering the effects of factors on outcomes, behavior, responses, or markets, including whether effects occur and their degree; also includes “driving force behind,” denoting a force that promotes development.

patterns.name: influence on
patterns.context: “Influence” denotes an effect of one factor on a subsequent object, commonly in collocations such as “no influence on” and “direct influence on”; the effect may vary in presence, strength, or target.

patterns.name: impact on
patterns.context: “Impact on” denotes an effect and often occurs with negation or degree modifiers.

patterns.name: driving force behind
patterns.context: “Driving force behind” expresses a force that promotes development or expansion; it does not use the “on” structure.

3_2893.description: 主要在“influence/impact on”中激活，涵盖因素对结果、行为、反应或市场的作用及其有无、程度；另见“driving force behind”表示推动发展的力量。

patterns.name: influence on
patterns.context: “influence”表示某因素对后续对象产生影响，常见于“no influence on”“direct influence on”等搭配；影响可有无、强弱或具体作用对象。

patterns.name: impact on
patterns.context: “impact on”表示影响或作用，常与否定或程度修饰语搭配。

patterns.name: driving force behind
patterns.context: 以“driving force behind”表达推动某种发展或扩张的力量；没有“on”结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to statements about influence, effects, and their targets, especially conclusions such as no influence/impact on; also responds to increases and decreases in metrics. See also the driving force collocation for promoting expansion.

patterns.name: Collocations expressing influence
patterns.context: Describes how a factor affects an outcome, behavior, function, or physiological measure; common structures include influence/impact/effects + on, or metrics increased/decreased.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, abstracts, and patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Negative or nonsignificant effects
patterns.context: Reports that a treatment, feature, or experimental factor did not affect an outcome, or had no significant effect.

patterns.name: Influence as an outcome variable
patterns.context: Influence is used as a noun followed by the affected object; the sentence need not be negative and may refer to a potential or positive effect.

patterns.name: Expressions of change and degree
patterns.context: Describes increases or decreases in expression levels or physiological metrics; usually occurs close to the metric or measurement.

patterns.name: Driving force and expansion
patterns.context: Abstractly describes forces driving a field's development and expansion; lacks a typical influence/impact structure.
patterns.domain: Antibody technology introductions in patent backgrounds

3_2893.concept: 影响及变化的结果表述
3_2893.description: 主要响应影响、作用及其对象的表述，尤其是 no influence/impact on 等无影响结论；也响应指标升降。另见推动扩张的 driving force 搭配。

patterns.name: 影响关系的搭配
patterns.context: 描述某个因素对结果、行为、功能或生理量的影响；常见结构为 influence/impact/effects + on，或指标 increased/decreased。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、摘要及专利背景

patterns.name: 否定影响或无显著影响
patterns.context: 报告某处理、特征或实验因素未影响结果，或影响不显著。

patterns.name: 影响作为结果变量
patterns.context: influence 用作名词，后接受影响对象；不要求是否定句，也可指潜在或正向作用。

patterns.name: 变化及程度表达
patterns.context: 描述表达量或生理指标升高、降低；通常紧邻指标或测量值。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: 驱动力与扩张
patterns.context: 抽象地描述推动某领域发展的力量及其扩张；未出现典型 influence/impact 结构。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的抗体技术介绍

en.description: Activations fall almost entirely on the word influence, especially in discussions of the effects of factors on outcomes or biological processes; also includes negative effects and social or policy effects. A few contexts also cover adjacent prepositions or objects.

patterns.name: influence and its object
patterns.context: The sentence discusses whether, how, or to what extent factors affect outcomes, behavior, concentrations, or biological processes; activation centers on influence, with some passages also covering the following preposition or object.
patterns.domain: Primarily biomedical research abstracts and research plans; also policy texts

patterns.name: Factors may influence an outcome
patterns.context: Factors are introduced first, followed by the outcome or process of interest; intervening material may occur, and the syntactic form varies.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts and research plans

patterns.name: Factors affect outcomes or presentation
patterns.context: Discusses factors affecting patient outcomes or disease presentation, not necessarily with may.

patterns.name: Negative or no significant effect
patterns.context: Reports that a variable or experimental treatment did not affect a measured outcome, vascular tone, or reporting behavior.

patterns.name: Social or policy effects
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of policy measures on costs or who bears the burden; distinct from biomedical contexts.

3_2893.description: 激活几乎都落在 influence 一词上，尤其是讨论因素对结果或生物过程的影响，也包括否定影响和社会政策影响；少数上下文还覆盖紧邻的介词或宾语。

patterns.name: influence 及其宾语
patterns.trigger: «influence»（常与前面的 “factors … may” 或 “no” 相连）
patterns.context: 句中讨论某些因素是否、如何或在何种程度上影响结果、行为、浓度或生物过程；激活集中于 influence，部分段落也覆盖紧随其后的介词或宾语。
patterns.domain: 以生物医学研究摘要和研究计划为主，也见政策文本

patterns.name: 因素可能影响某结果
patterns.context: 先提出影响因素，再说明关注的结果或过程；词间可有插入成分，句法形式不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、研究计划

patterns.name: 因素影响结局或表现
patterns.trigger: “factors influence the result”及“factors influence disease presentation”
patterns.context: 讨论影响患者结局或疾病呈现的因素，未必有 may。

patterns.name: 否定或无显著影响
patterns.trigger: “no significant influence on”及“had no influence on”
patterns.context: 报告某变量或实验处理未对测量结果、血管张力或报告行为造成影响。

patterns.name: 社会或政策影响
patterns.trigger: “have an influence on who bears the brunt”
patterns.context: 讨论政策措施对成本或负担由谁承担的影响；与生物医学语境不同。

en.description: All segments activate on influence; they include both negative expressions such as “no influence on” and positive statements about effects on willingness, concentration, response, disease, and other outcomes. Collocations and domains vary, but the trigger is consistent.

patterns.name: influence and its collocations
patterns.context: Occurrences of noun or verb forms of influence and common collocates such as on, to, and the; statements concern influence, effects, associations, or determination of an outcome.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, research abstracts and proposals, as well as policy discussions

3_2893.description: 所有段都激活于 influence；既包括“no influence on”这类否定表达，也包括影响意愿、浓度、反应、疾病等结果的正向陈述。搭配与领域有变化，但触发词一致。

patterns.name: influence 及其搭配
patterns.trigger: «influence»，常见原文搭配包括 “no influence on”、“influence on”、“influence willingness to”、“influence the concentrations” 和 “influence disease presentation”
patterns.context: 围绕 influence 的名词或动词用法，以及其常见搭配词（如 on、to、the）出现；涉及影响、作用、关联或决定某种结果的表述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、研究摘要与研究计划，也包括政策讨论

en.description: Primarily responds to influence, especially influence on and have no influence on; also responds to influence as a transitive verb following a modal, factors influence, and the near-synonym impact. Contexts mostly concern the effects of research factors on biomedical, clinical, or policy outcomes, in both affirmative and negative statements.

patterns.name: Influence followed by on
patterns.context: The core trigger is influence, often adjacent to on or in the phrase “have an influence on”; the object may be behavior, test results, physiological states, stakeholders, or biological processes.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, public health, and policy news

patterns.name: influence as a verb
patterns.context: Influence is a transitive verb, preceded by may and followed by an affected object such as willingness or a measured metric.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts; public health and nutrition research

patterns.name: factors influence outcomes
patterns.context: In an interrogative clause, factors is the subject, influence is the verb, and a clinical outcome follows.

patterns.name: impact expressing influence
patterns.context: Impact follows may and describes how risk or pregnancy history may affect blood vessels; semantically similar to influence, but a different word form.

patterns.name: Negative statements about nonsignificant effects
patterns.context: Influence follows no or no significant, indicating that the factor under study did not significantly change the outcome; the influence-on structure is retained.

patterns.name: Possible expression changes / unexplained fragments
patterns.context: Fragments describe increased expression and include the word Decreased, but contain no influence, impact, or explicit trigger structure expressing an effect; activation may fall on a word fragment.

3_2893.description: 主要响应 influence，尤其是 influence on 及 have no influence on；也响应 influence 作情态动词后的及物动词、factors influence 和近义 impact。语境多为研究因素对生物医学、临床或政策结果的作用，肯定与否定表达均出现。

patterns.name: influence 后接 on 的影响关系
patterns.trigger: « influence»10« on»7« the»2 behavior；« influence»10« on»6 swab positivity；« influence»10« on»7 myogenic« tone»1；« influence»9« on»7« who»1 bears；« influence»9« on»6« the»1« suppression»3
patterns.context: 核心触发词是 influence，常与 on 相邻或构成 “have an influence on”；宾语为行为、检测结果、生理状态、承担者或生物过程。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、公共卫生及政策新闻

patterns.name: influence 作动词
patterns.trigger: « may»1« influence»10 willingness；« may»1« influence»10 the concentrations
patterns.context: influence 作及物动词，前有 may，后接意愿或测量指标等受影响对象。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要，公共卫生与营养研究

patterns.name: factors influence 结果
patterns.context: 疑问从句中 factors 作为主语，influence 作动词，后接临床结局。

patterns.name: impact 表示影响
patterns.context: may 后接 impact，描述风险或妊娠史可能对血管产生作用；语义近于 influence，但词形不同。

patterns.name: 非显著影响的否定表述
patterns.trigger: had no« influence»10« on»7 the« reporter»1；had no significant« influence»10« on»6 swab positivity；had no« influence»10« on»7 myogenic« tone»1
patterns.context: influence 位于 no 或 no significant 后，表示考察因素未显著改变结果；仍保留 influence-on 结构。
patterns.domain: 实验生物医学与临床研究

patterns.name: 可能的表达变化／未解释片段
patterns.context: 出现表达量增加及 Decreased 一词的片段，但未见 influence、impact 或明确的影响关系触发结构；激活可能落在词形片段上。

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to influence in academic biomedical corpora: it covers both influence on objects and direct-object constructions, and can occur in negative results, factors affecting outcomes, research aims, and discussions of results. Other nearby words are sporadic and cannot be confirmed as independent triggers.

patterns.name: influence with an on structure
patterns.context: The verb influence is followed by on and its object, commonly in statements about having or not having an effect on an outcome or process.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper results or discussion, research abstracts

patterns.name: Object following influence
patterns.context: Influence directly takes a noun object; the object denotes research variables such as risk, concentration, willingness, or pregnancy outcomes.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts, research aims, or background

patterns.name: Sensitivity to the word influence and its local constructions
patterns.context: Across different grammatical structures, the core trigger is influence; it commonly occurs with on or a direct object, including in contexts of negation, possibility, and research questions.

patterns.name: Surrounding academic result/variable expressions
patterns.context: Influence relations are often qualified by significance, directness, possibility, or future conditions; influence remains the main activation target rather than any single qualifier.
patterns.domain: Academic discussion, research design, and results reporting

patterns.name: No clear pattern independent of influence
patterns.context: These words occur in different syntactic positions and do not form a shared trigger pattern that can be confirmed from the available excerpts.

3_2893.concept: 学术语境中的影响关系
3_2893.description: 主要对学术生物医学语料中的 influence 高度响应：既覆盖 influence on 宾语，也覆盖直接宾语结构；可出现在否定结果、影响因素、研究目的和结果讨论中。其余邻近词分布零散，不能确定为独立触发。

patterns.name: influence 与 on 结构
patterns.trigger: «influence»10« on»7（1、2、3）；«influence»9« on»7 the»1（4）；«influence»9« on»5« the»2« suppression»3« of»4（9）
patterns.context: 动词 influence 后接 on 及其宾语，常见于“对某结果/过程没有或有影响”的陈述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文结果或讨论、研究摘要

patterns.name: influence 后接宾语
patterns.trigger: «influence»9« the»2« risk»3（6）；«influence»9« the»1 concentrations（7）；«influence»9 willingness（8）；«influence»9« the»1 pregnancy result（10）
patterns.context: influence 直接支配名词宾语；宾语指风险、浓度、意愿或妊娠结果等研究变量。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、研究目标或背景

patterns.name: 对 influence 一词及其局部构式的敏感
patterns.context: 不同语法结构中，核心触发均为 influence；常伴随 on 或直接宾语，且在否定、可能性、研究问题等语境中出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学语料中的学术英语

patterns.name: 周边学术结果/变量表达
patterns.trigger: « significant»1« influence»10（3）；« direct»3« influence»9（4）；« factors»2 may« influence»9（8）；« factor»1« will»1« influence»9（10）
patterns.context: 影响关系常由显著性、直接性、可能性或将来条件等限定；激活主体仍是 influence，而非单一限定词。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、研究设计与结果报告

patterns.name: 未见独立于 influence 的明确模式
patterns.trigger: 局部还有 « increased»4« times»2、« aggregation»1、« factors»3、« response»1 等，但与 influence 的构式无稳定对应
patterns.context: 这些词分布于不同句法位置，未形成可由现有例段确认的共同触发模式。

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to influence and its nearby structures in medical literature, especially factors affecting outcomes and variants affecting disease risk; it also covers experimental or statistical effects with on. These occur in affirmative, negative, and interrogative contexts.

patterns.name: Factors affect outcomes
patterns.context: Asks or states whether certain factors affect an outcome, behavior, disease, or metric; common in research aims, background, or hypothesis statements.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts, project descriptions, and paper text

patterns.name: Genetic variants affect risk
patterns.context: Discusses whether genetic variants or polymorphisms affect disease risk, often co-occurring with modals or negation such as may and do not.

patterns.name: No significant effect on an outcome
patterns.context: Reports in statistical results that a variable has no significant effect on a measurement outcome or positivity rate.

patterns.name: Reporter gene behavior is affected
patterns.context: Describes the effect of an experimental construct or treatment on reporter gene behavior; this example specifically states that there is no effect.

3_2893.description: 神经元主要响应医学文献中 influence 及其近邻结构，尤其是因素影响结果、变异影响疾病风险，也涵盖 on 搭配的实验或统计影响陈述；可用于肯定、否定及疑问语境。

patterns.name: 因素影响结果
patterns.context: 询问或说明某些因素会影响某种结果、行为、疾病或指标；常见于研究目的、背景或假设表述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、项目说明及论文正文

patterns.name: 遗传变异影响风险
patterns.context: 讨论遗传变异或多态性是否影响疾病风险，常与 may、do not 等情态或否定表达共现。
patterns.domain: 遗传学与疾病风险研究摘要

patterns.name: 对某结果无显著影响
patterns.context: 在统计结果中报告某变量对测量结果或阳性率没有显著影响。

patterns.name: 报告基因行为受影响
patterns.context: 描述实验构建或处理对报告基因行为的影响；此例具体表示没有影响。

en.description: All segments highlight influence or its negative form, no influence; contexts include genetics and disease risk, willingness to undergo treatment and treatment response, experimental behavior, reproductive outcomes, physiological and diagnostic metrics, and the course of health problems.

patterns.name: Direct statements of influence/effect
patterns.context: Common structures include “X influence(s) the risk/outcome/behavior/function” and “no influence on”; activation falls on influence, often near words such as the, on, and risk.
patterns.domain: Statements of results, hypotheses, or research aims in biomedical papers

patterns.name: Negative influence
patterns.context: The influence term occurs in a negative or nonsignificant-effect statement, showing that the neuron does not respond only to positive causal conclusions.

patterns.name: Influence on risk or disease outcomes
patterns.context: The affected object is disease risk, manifestations, or related clinical outcomes.

patterns.name: Influence on treatment willingness or response
patterns.context: The affected object is willingness to use preventive measures or treatment response; the influencing factor is often another factor or genetic difference.
patterns.domain: HIV prevention and addiction treatment research

patterns.name: Influence on experimental or reproductive medicine outcomes
patterns.context: The affected objects are reporter gene behavior and recipient pregnancy outcomes, respectively; these are not specific subclasses of disease risk or treatment response.
patterns.domain: Molecular experiments and assisted reproductive medicine

patterns.name: Influence on physiological/diagnostic metrics
patterns.context: The affected objects are physiological tone or diagnostic positivity rates, both in statements of negative influence.
patterns.domain: Vascular physiology and ocular infection testing

patterns.name: Influence on the course of a problem
patterns.context: A research aim proposes that biological factors may influence the course of oral health problems in older adults; this is prospective rather than a reported result.
patterns.domain: Research proposals on oral health in older adults

3_2893.description: 所有片段均突出 influence，或其否定形式 no influence；语境涵盖遗传与疾病风险、治疗意愿和反应、实验行为、生殖结局、生理及检测指标、健康问题进程。

patterns.name: 直接影响/作用表述
patterns.context: 常见于“X influence(s) the risk/outcome/behavior/function”或“no influence on”结构；激活落在 influence 上，周围常有 the、on、risk 等词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的结果、假设或研究目的陈述

patterns.name: 否定影响
patterns.context: 影响词处于否定或无显著影响的陈述中，说明神经元并非只响应正向因果结论。

patterns.name: 影响风险或疾病结局
patterns.context: 影响对象是疾病风险、表现或相关临床结局。
patterns.domain: 遗传学、疾病机制与流行病学

patterns.name: 影响治疗意愿或反应
patterns.trigger: “«influence» willingness «to» use”（2）；“«influence» an alcohol dependent individual's treatment response”（4）
patterns.context: 影响对象是预防措施的使用意愿或治疗反应；常由因素、遗传差异等作影响者。

patterns.name: 影响实验或生殖医学结果
patterns.context: 影响对象分别为报告基因行为和受者妊娠结果；不属于疾病风险或治疗反应的具体子类。
patterns.domain: 分子实验与辅助生殖医学

patterns.name: 影响生理/检测指标
patterns.context: 影响对象是生理张力或检测阳性率，且均以否定影响的方式出现。
patterns.domain: 血管生理与眼部感染检测

patterns.name: 影响问题进程
patterns.context: 研究目的中提出生物因素可能影响老年口腔问题的进程；语气为预期而非已报告结果。
patterns.domain: 老年口腔健康研究计划

en.description: Primarily responds to influence expressing how factors affect outcomes in biomedical contexts, especially influence on, influence + outcome, and no influence; also covers related expressions such as impact and responsiveness.

patterns.name: influence and its object
patterns.context: The verb indicates that one factor affects an outcome; common structures include “X influence(s) on Y,” “influence Y,” or “will influence the Y”; negative effects such as “no influence on” are also included.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts, research backgrounds, and project descriptions

patterns.name: Influence and regulation of biological processes
patterns.context: Describes the effects of drugs, genes, clinical factors, or cellular processes on physiology, disease, pregnancy, or experimental outcomes; some examples use synonymous expressions of influence/effect without the word influence.

3_2893.concept: 生物医学中的影响关系
3_2893.description: 主要响应生物医学语境中表示因素影响结果的 influence，尤其是 influence on、influence + 结果及 no influence；也覆盖 impact 和 responsiveness 等相近的作用关系表达。

patterns.name: influence及其宾语
patterns.context: 动词表示某因素影响某结果，常见结构为“X influence(s) on Y”“influence Y”或“will influence the Y”；也包括否定影响，如“no influence on”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要、研究背景与项目描述

patterns.name: 影响与调节生物过程
patterns.context: 描述药物、基因、临床因素或细胞过程对生理、疾病、妊娠或实验结果的作用；部分例子使用近义的影响/作用表达，而未出现 influence。

en.concept: Expressions of influence relations in research
en.description: Primarily responds to research-style expressions in which factors influence outcomes, commonly with factors adjacent or near influence(s); also covers exposures affecting immune responses and environmental modulation of the association between risk factors and disease.

patterns.name: Expressions of influencing factors/relations
patterns.context: In research abstracts or plans, a factor is proposed to influence an outcome, risk, choice, change, or trajectory; factors and influence are usually close together.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, public health, clinical, and social science research writing

patterns.name: Exposure effects on immune responses
patterns.context: The effects of combined airway exposure to TLR ligands and pesticides on immune responses, specifically in relation to allergic asthma.
patterns.domain: Immunology, allergy, and environmental health research plans

patterns.name: Modulation of influence associations
patterns.context: The environment does not act directly on a single outcome, but affects the association between behavioral risk factors and cancer.

3_2893.concept: 研究中的影响关系表述
3_2893.description: 主要响应科研文体中“因素影响结果”的表述，常见因素与 influence(s) 相邻或近邻；也涵盖暴露影响免疫反应，以及环境调节风险因素与疾病的关联。

patterns.name: 影响因素/影响关系表述
patterns.context: 科研摘要或研究计划中，围绕某种结果、风险、选择、变化或轨迹，提出因素会影响该结果；多数出现 factors 与 influence 的近距离搭配。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、公共卫生、临床与社会科学研究文体

patterns.name: 暴露影响免疫反应
patterns.context: TLR 配体与农药等联合气道暴露对免疫反应的影响，具体关联过敏性哮喘。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、过敏与环境健康研究计划

patterns.name: 影响关联的调节表述
patterns.context: 环境并非直接作用于单一结果，而是影响行为风险因素与癌症之间的关联。
patterns.domain: 环境流行病学研究计划

en.description: Activation is concentrated on the verb “influence”: it expresses a factor affecting an object or outcome, including negative effects; domains cover medical research and project descriptions.

patterns.name: Verb expressing an influence relation
patterns.context: The sentence describes whether a factor does or does not affect an outcome, risk, behavior, or other object; it can occur in affirmative, interrogative, or negative structures, with common collocations including “factors … influence,” “may influence,” “no influence on,” and “do not influence.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and NIH project descriptions; topics include disease risk, clinical outcomes, experimental effects, memory, and adaptation.

3_2893.description: 激活集中在动词“influence”：用于表达因素影响某对象或结果，也包括否定影响；领域涵盖医学研究及项目描述。

patterns.name: 影响关系动词
patterns.context: 句中描述某因素对结果、风险、行为或其他对象产生或不产生影响；可用于肯定、疑问或否定结构，常见搭配包括“factors … influence”“may influence”“no influence on”“do not influence”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要及 NIH 项目描述；涉及疾病风险、临床结果、实验效应、记忆和适应等。

en.concept: Research statements about factors affecting outcomes
en.description: Primarily responds to research statements about factors or differences affecting an outcome, especially around influence; contexts include disease risk and manifestations, immune response, adaptation, concentration, treatment response, and medical choices.

patterns.name: Factors affect outcomes/willingness
patterns.context: Research or paper abstracts ask which factors affect an outcome, willingness, or choice; common phrasing includes “what factors … influence” or “factors which influence.”
patterns.domain: Medical and public health research abstracts and proposals

patterns.name: Influence on disease risk or manifestations
patterns.context: Affects disease manifestations, incidence risk, or cancer-related outcomes; may involve causal, genetic, or biological mechanisms.

patterns.name: Exposure affects immune response
patterns.context: Specific environmental exposures, such as TLR ligands and pesticides, are proposed to affect immune response.

patterns.name: Mediating factors affect adaptation
patterns.context: Mediating factors are associated with differences in individual adaptation outcomes.
patterns.domain: Research proposals on adolescent maltreatment experiences and foster care

patterns.name: Material factors affect concentration
patterns.context: Material-related factors may affect the concentration of a component in a sample.

patterns.name: Factors affect treatment response
patterns.context: Pharmacogenetic differences are hypothesized to affect SSRI treatment response.
patterns.domain: Pharmacogenetics and addiction treatment research proposals

patterns.name: Factors affect treatment choice
patterns.context: Studies which factors affect the choice between two screening or medical options.

3_2893.concept: 因素影响结果的研究表述
3_2893.description: 主要响应“因素/差异影响某结果”的研究表述，尤其是 influence 附近；涵盖疾病风险与表现、免疫反应、适应、浓度、治疗反应和医疗选择等语境。

patterns.name: 因素影响结果/意愿
patterns.context: 研究或论文摘要中询问哪些因素影响某个结果、意愿或选择；常见句式为“what factors … influence”或“factors which influence”。
patterns.domain: 医学与公共卫生研究摘要、研究计划

patterns.name: 影响疾病风险或表现
patterns.trigger: « factors»…« influence» disease presentation；« may»…« influence»…« risk»
patterns.context: 影响疾病的表现、发生风险或癌症相关结局；可包含因果、遗传或生物机制语境。

patterns.name: 暴露影响免疫反应
patterns.context: 具体环境暴露（如 TLR 配体和农药）被提出会影响免疫反应。

patterns.name: 调节因素影响适应表现
patterns.context: 中介因素与个体适应结果的差异相联系。
patterns.domain: 青少年虐待经历与寄养照护研究计划

patterns.name: 材料因素影响浓度
patterns.context: 材料相关因素可能影响某种样本中的成分浓度。

patterns.name: 因素影响治疗反应
patterns.context: 药物遗传差异被设想为影响 SSRI 治疗反应。
patterns.domain: 药物遗传学与成瘾治疗研究计划

patterns.name: 因素影响治疗选择
patterns.context: 研究哪些因素影响在两种筛查或医疗方案之间的选择。

en.description: All passages are in biomedical research contexts and use influence/influences to describe the potential effects of research factors on outcomes; outcomes include willingness to use, function, disease manifestations, adaptation, immune response, treatment response, risk, susceptibility, and pregnancy outcomes.

patterns.name: Influence on research outcomes
patterns.context: Research aims or hypotheses ask whether and how a factor affects an outcome, risk, response, or phenotype; commonly paired with subjects such as factors, differences, polymorphisms, and genes, followed by a disease or outcome
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts, grant applications, and paper backgrounds

patterns.name: Causal statements about factors affecting outcomes
patterns.context: Describes mediating factors affecting individual differences in behavior, emotion, or psychological adaptation; rather than merely asking whether something has an effect, it concerns mechanisms explaining variation
patterns.domain: Research proposals on adolescent maltreatment and foster care adaptation

patterns.name: Multiple factors jointly affect disease manifestations
patterns.context: The preceding text places host genetics and microbial factors together in a two-hit model of IBD
patterns.domain: Background to biomedical papers on IBD

patterns.name: Genetic differences affecting treatment response
patterns.context: Genetic differences in drug targets are hypothesized to affect SSRI treatment response
patterns.domain: Research proposals on alcohol dependence and pharmacogenetics

patterns.name: Influence on risk or susceptibility
patterns.context: Gene polymorphisms or candidate genes are hypothesized to be associated with cancer risk or disease susceptibility
patterns.domain: Bladder cancer genetics research and SLE gene research proposals

patterns.name: Influence on reproductive treatment outcomes
patterns.context: Reasons why egg donors caused infertility and subsequently received IVF are considered in relation to their effects on recipients' pregnancy outcomes

patterns.name: Influence on immune response or cellular phenotype
patterns.context: Environmental exposures are studied for their effects on immune response; alternatively, gene depletion is studied for its effects on breast cancer cell capabilities such as migration
patterns.domain: Asthma immunology grant applications; breast cancer metastasis research

patterns.name: Determinants of willingness to use PrEP
patterns.context: Asks which factors affect willingness among a specific population to use long-acting injectable PrEP; the preceding text mentions difficulties with daily medication

3_2893.concept: 生物医学中的影响关系
3_2893.description: 所有段落都在生物医学研究语境中，用 influence/influences 表述研究因素对结局的潜在作用；结局包括使用意愿、功能、疾病表现、适应、免疫反应、治疗反应、风险、易感性及妊娠结果。

patterns.name: influence 对研究结局的作用
patterns.context: 在研究目的或假设中，询问某因素是否、如何影响某种结果、风险、反应或表型；常与 factors、differences、polymorphisms、genes 等主语搭配，后接疾病或结局
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、基金申请及论文背景

patterns.name: 影响因素与结局的因果关系表述
patterns.context: 描述中介因素影响个体间行为、情绪或心理适应差异；不是单纯提出是否影响，而是涉及解释变异的机制
patterns.domain: 青少年虐待与寄养适应研究计划

patterns.name: 多因素共同影响疾病表现
patterns.context: 前文将宿主遗传与微生物因素并列，置于 IBD 的双重打击模型中
patterns.domain: IBD 生物医学论文背景

patterns.name: 影响治疗反应的遗传差异
patterns.context: 药物作用靶点的遗传差异被假设会影响 SSRI 治疗反应
patterns.domain: 酒精依赖与药物遗传学研究计划

patterns.name: 影响风险或易感性
patterns.context: 基因多态性或候选基因被假设与患癌风险、疾病易感性相关
patterns.domain: 膀胱癌遗传学研究及 SLE 基因研究计划

patterns.name: 影响生殖治疗结局
patterns.context: 捐卵者导致不孕、进而接受 IVF 的原因，被用于考虑其对受者妊娠结果的影响

patterns.name: 影响免疫反应或细胞表型
patterns.context: 环境暴露被研究为影响免疫反应；或基因耗减被研究为改变癌细胞迁移等能力
patterns.domain: 哮喘免疫学基金申请；乳腺癌转移研究

patterns.name: PrEP 使用意愿的决定因素
patterns.trigger: « factors»1« may»1« influence»10 willingness to use
patterns.context: 询问哪些因素会影响特定人群使用长效注射 PrEP 的意愿；前文提到每日服药困难
patterns.domain: HIV 预防研究论文摘要

en.description: Sensitive to “influence” and its context, especially expressions of factors acting on outcomes: effects on willingness, risk, treatment response, immunity, memory effects, disease severity, risk expression, or clinical measures.

patterns.name: Effects on willingness or behavior
patterns.context: A feature of an intervention or product may change people’s willingness to use it; practical difficulties faced by potential users are often mentioned beforehand.

patterns.name: Effects on disease risk or incidence
patterns.context: Genetic variation, host genetics, or microbes are associated with disease risk, age of onset, or disease presentation.

patterns.name: Effects on treatment response
patterns.context: Pharmacogenetic differences may alter the response of particular patients to drug treatment.

patterns.name: Effects on immune responses
patterns.context: The relation between environmental exposure and immune responses, in the context of research on allergic asthma.

patterns.name: Effects on the memory benefits of acute exercise
patterns.context: The timing of exercise relative to memory encoding or retrieval, and exercise intensity, may alter its effects on memory.

patterns.name: Effects on disease severity or onset
patterns.context: Compensatory secretory pathways may alter the severity or age of onset of cystic fibrosis-associated phenotypes.

patterns.name: Effects on the expression of genetic risk
patterns.context: Behavioral and environmental factors may affect the expression of genetically conferred cardiovascular risk.

patterns.name: Effects on clinical measures
patterns.context: Factors such as prostate volume, post-implant edema, and the number of implanted seeds may alter the D90 dosimetric measure.

3_2893.description: 对“influence”及其上下文敏感，尤其响应因素作用于结果的表述：影响意愿、风险、治疗反应、免疫、记忆效应、疾病严重度、风险表达或临床指标。

patterns.name: 影响意愿或行为
patterns.context: 某种干预或产品的特征可能改变人群使用意愿；此前常提到潜在使用者的实际困难。

patterns.name: 影响疾病风险或发病
patterns.context: 遗传变异、宿主遗传或微生物等因素与疾病风险、发病年龄或疾病表现相关。
patterns.domain: 医学与遗传流行病学摘要

patterns.name: 影响治疗反应
patterns.context: 药物遗传差异可能改变特定患者对药物治疗的反应。

patterns.name: 影响免疫反应
patterns.context: 环境暴露与免疫反应之间的作用关系，置于过敏性哮喘研究中。

patterns.name: 影响急性运动的记忆效应
patterns.trigger: «influence»10« the»« effects» of acute exercise« on» memory
patterns.context: 运动相对记忆编码或提取的时机及运动强度可能改变运动对记忆的效应。

patterns.name: 影响疾病严重程度或起病
patterns.trigger: «might»1« influence»9« the»3 severity and/or disease onset
patterns.context: 代偿性分泌通路可能改变囊性纤维化相关表型严重程度或起病时间。

patterns.name: 影响遗传风险表达
patterns.trigger: «influence»9« the»3« expression» of genetically« conferred»« risk»
patterns.context: 行为和环境因素可能影响遗传赋予的心血管风险表达。
patterns.domain: 心血管流行病学研究计划

patterns.name: 影响临床指标
patterns.context: 前列腺体积、植入后水肿和植入粒子数等因素可能改变D90剂量学指标。
patterns.domain: 前列腺近距离放疗研究

en.description: All passages use forms of influence to express the effects of factors on outcomes, including willingness, choice, disease risk and manifestations, immune and treatment responses, clinical or behavioral outcomes, and statistical detection capability; the register is primarily research abstracts and project descriptions.

patterns.name: Influence on willingness or choice
patterns.context: Prior factors or unknown factors are described as potentially affecting willingness to use a preventive measure; other factors affect the choice between screening and surgical options.
patterns.domain: HIV prevention research; gynecologic clinical research proposals

patterns.name: Influence on disease manifestations, susceptibility, or risk
patterns.context: Factors such as microbes, candidate genes, or gene polymorphisms affect disease manifestations, susceptibility, or disease risk.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research on IBD, SLE, and bladder cancer

patterns.name: Influence on immune response
patterns.context: Studies the effects of exposure factors on immune response.

patterns.name: Influence on treatment response
patterns.context: Pharmacogenetic differences in drug transporter function are considered potential factors affecting treatment efficacy.

patterns.name: Influence on clinical or behavioral outcomes
patterns.context: Asks how factors affect patient outcomes or differences in adaptation among maltreated adolescents.
patterns.domain: Clinical outcomes after hip fracture; adolescent social and psychological research

patterns.name: Influence on statistical detection capability
patterns.context: Under conditions of skewed categorical data, factors affect the ability to detect positive-class features effectively.
patterns.domain: Statistics and machine learning methods discussions

3_2893.description: 各段均以 influence 的不同形式表达因素对结果的作用：涉及意愿、选择、疾病风险与表现、免疫和治疗反应、临床或行为结局，以及统计检测能力；语域以研究摘要和项目说明为主。

patterns.name: 影响意愿或选择
patterns.context: 前置因素或未知因素被描述为可能影响某种预防措施的使用意愿；另有因素影响筛查与手术方案的选择。
patterns.domain: HIV预防研究；妇科临床研究计划

patterns.name: 影响疾病表现、易感性或风险
patterns.trigger: « influence»10 disease presentation；« influence»10« susceptibility»；« may»1« influence»10 both« the»1« risk»
patterns.context: 微生物、候选基因或基因多态性等因素影响疾病表现、易感性或患病风险。
patterns.domain: IBD、SLE及膀胱癌生物医学研究

patterns.name: 影响免疫反应
patterns.context: 研究暴露因素对免疫反应的作用。
patterns.domain: 过敏性哮喘与免疫学研究

patterns.name: 影响治疗反应
patterns.context: 药物转运体功能的药物遗传差异被视为可能影响治疗效果的因素。
patterns.domain: 酒精依赖与药物遗传学研究

patterns.name: 影响临床或行为结果
patterns.trigger: what« factors»1« influence»10« the»2 result；« influence»9« variations»2…« adaptations»2
patterns.context: 询问因素如何影响患者结局，或影响受虐青少年的适应差异。
patterns.domain: 髋部骨折临床结局；青少年社会与心理研究

patterns.name: 影响统计检测能力
patterns.trigger: two main factors« influence»9« the»3 capability
patterns.context: 在分类数据偏斜的条件下，因素影响有效检测正类特征的能力。
patterns.domain: 统计学与机器学习方法讨论

en.description: The strongest common signal is the verb influence, especially «influence»10 immediately followed by «the»; its objects are often research outcomes, risks, responses, expression, or choices. It sometimes takes a bare noun object directly, often with factors as its subject.

patterns.name: influence followed by the
patterns.context: The core high-activation sequence is the verb influence immediately followed by the definite article the; subsequent objects may include result, capability, risk, secretion, treatment response, expression, choice, and others. Often occurs in clauses or interrogative structures.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, research plans, and scientific discussion across fields including medicine, biology, and statistics

patterns.name: influence followed by a noun object without the
patterns.context: The verb influence directly takes a noun object, without the immediately preceding the.

patterns.name: Factors as the subject of influence
patterns.context: The noun factors or genetic and microbial factors serve as the subject, followed by influence; the form of the object is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Disease mechanisms, statistical modeling, and research plans

3_2893.description: 最强共同线索是动词 influence，尤其是 «influence»10 后紧接 «the»；宾语多为研究中的结果、风险、反应、表达或选择。少数直接接无冠词宾语，且常见因素作其主语。

patterns.name: influence 后接 the
patterns.context: 核心高激活序列是动词 influence 后紧接定冠词 the，后续宾语可以是 result、capability、risk、secretion、treatment response、expression、choice 等；多出现在从句或疑问结构中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文摘要、研究计划及科学论述，涉及医学、生物学、统计学等领域

patterns.name: influence 后接名词宾语但无 the
patterns.trigger: «influence»10 后接 disease presentation 或 immune responses
patterns.context: 动词 influence 直接支配名词宾语；宾语前没有紧邻的 the。
patterns.domain: 免疫学与疾病机制研究计划

patterns.name: 因素作 influence 的主语
patterns.trigger: « factors»2« influence»10；« host genetics»1 and microbial« factors»2« influence»10
patterns.context: 名词 factors 或遗传与微生物因素作为主语，后接 influence；其后宾语形式不固定。
patterns.domain: 疾病机制、统计建模及研究计划

en.description: Activations appear in legal citations, mathematical phrases, garbled characters, connectors, health records, hardware models, biomedical terms, JSON whitespace and color words, and song descriptions; no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Numeric and citation fragments
patterns.context: Numbers, letters, and punctuation interleave to form legal document numbers or citations, with activations concentrated on parts of the citation;

patterns.name: replacement phrase
patterns.context: A math problem describes sampling without replacement, with activation on the phrase “without replacement”;

patterns.name: Characters in garbled text
patterns.context: Non-Latin text appears as suspected encoding errors or garbled text, with activations on repeated byte/character fragments;

patterns.trigger: “item link address”、“placed after”及“generating links like this”
patterns.context: 指出网址斜线位置不当、导致链接生成异常

patterns.name: 医疗免责声明与劝告
patterns.context: 声明内容仅供教育、研究或参考，不替代专业医疗建议
patterns.domain: PubMed Central / 医学免责声明

patterns.name: 生成唯一图像名称
patterns.context: 提问如何为图像生成全局唯一名称
