en.description: Primarily responds to the intra-word fragment Creat (create/creates/creator) in code and documentation; also occurs in a Japanese property-word ending, Has/ht in InnerHashtable, political recount phrasing, and Has in a JSON question. No clear match for the first passage.

patterns.name: Word fragment Creat
patterns.context: The marked segment falls at the beginning of or within English words such as create/creates/creator; following suffixes are usually unmarked, and the surrounding text may be code identifiers or ordinary English explanations.
patterns.domain: code documentation, source code, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Property characters in a specific identifier
patterns.context: Appears in the katakana word ending in the Japanese XML summary comment “プロパティ：”; other Japanese characters also activate more weakly.

patterns.name: Hasht-related identifier fragments
patterns.context: Appears at Contains/Remove member access in C# InnerHashtable; the Has and subsequent ht fragments of the same identifier activate.

patterns.name: Selective recount phrasing
patterns.context: Political commentary about a U.S. election recount mentions counting again and counties with a Democratic majority.

patterns.name: Has in a JSON.parse context
patterns.context: A user asks whether JSON.parse will throw an exception, and Has appears at the beginning of a sentence near an error report; there is insufficient context to show that it follows the same pattern as code identifiers.

3_2896.description: 主要响应词内片段 Creat（create/creates/creator），见于代码与文档；另有日文属性词尾、InnerHashtable 的 Has/ht、政治重计票措辞，以及 JSON 问句中的 Has。第1段无明显对应。

patterns.name: 单词片段 Creat
patterns.context: 标记落在英文 create/creates/creator 等词的开头或词内片段；后续词尾通常未标记，周围可为代码标识符或普通英文说明。
patterns.domain: 代码文档、源代码及技术问答

patterns.name: 特定标识符中的属性字符
patterns.context: 出现在日文 XML summary 注释“プロパティ：”中的片假名词尾；其余日文字符也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 含日文注释的 VB.NET 代码

patterns.name: Hasht 相关标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C# 中 InnerHashtable 的 Contains/Remove 成员访问处；同一标识符的 Has 和后续 ht 片段激活。

patterns.name: 选择性重计票措辞
patterns.context: 关于美国选举重计票的政治评论中，提及再次重计票及民主党占多数的县。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的政治评论

patterns.name: JSON.parse 语境中的 Has
patterns.context: 用户询问 JSON.parse 是否会抛出异常，错误报告附近出现句首 Has；没有足够上下文证明其与代码标识符模式相同。

en.description: Responds to plainly expressing an obvious judgment, seriously expressing degree of importance, and wrongfully describing unlawful conduct; it also responds to often in a question about frequency and to two words beginning with trium-. Triggers span legal, forum, and academic text and cannot be grouped into a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Semantic emphasis of plainly
patterns.context: Emphasizes that something is clear or obvious in a judgment or statement, often alongside a legal claim or explanation.
patterns.domain: legal documents; also HackerNews evaluations of website usability

patterns.name: Degree adverb seriously
patterns.context: Modifies take (take seriously) or takes (attach importance to), asking how seriously advice or teaching is regarded.

patterns.name: Legal use of wrongfully
patterns.context: Describes breach of contract or misappropriation of property; activation is concentrated within the segmented word wrongfully.

patterns.name: triumphalist lexical fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a description of a triumphant/triumphalist tone contrasted with a pessimistic tone criticizing modern society; activation falls on the initial word fragment.

patterns.name: Frequency question with how often
patterns.context: Asks about how frequently an event occurs in the interrogative structure how often should I….

patterns.name: triumvirate lexical fragment
patterns.context: Describes a combination of three departments in an interdisciplinary project; activation falls on the initial word fragment.

3_2896.description: 响应 plainly 的显然判断、seriously 的重视程度、wrongfully 的不法行为，也响应 often 的频率疑问及两个以 trium- 开头的词。触发分布跨法律、论坛、学术文本，不能归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: plainly 的语义强调
patterns.context: 在判断或陈述中强调某事清楚、显然，常与法律主张或解释并用。
patterns.domain: 法律文书；另见 HackerNews 对网页可用性的评价

patterns.name: seriously 的程度副词
patterns.context: 修饰 take（认真看待）或 takes（重视），询问对建议或教学的重视程度。

patterns.name: wrongfully 的法律用法
patterns.context: 描述违反合同或侵占财产的行为；激活集中在被切分标注的 wrongfully 内部。

patterns.name: triumphalist 词汇片段
patterns.context: 出现在与批判现代社会的悲观语调相对照的 triumphant/triumphalist 语调描述中；激活落在词首片段。

patterns.name: how often 频率询问
patterns.context: 在 how often should I… 的疑问结构中询问事件发生频率。

patterns.name: triumvirate 词汇片段
patterns.context: 修饰跨学科项目中的三个院系组合；激活落在词首片段。

en.concept: make word family and action expressions
en.description: Primarily responds to make/making/made and Q&A titles beginning “How to make”; it also covers making rulings, property division, and design format in legal contexts. The o in a mathematical expression is difficult to unify with these patterns.

patterns.name: Operational use of make
patterns.context: make/making is followed by an action or goal to be carried out; in [1][2] it refers to an activity in progress, and in [3]–[7] it appears in the “How to make …” structure of question titles.
patterns.domain: tutorials, technical Q&A, legal ruling narratives

patterns.name: Q&A title template
patterns.context: StackExchange question titles begin with Q: and then use “How to make” to ask about implementation or an operation; the activation pattern also includes common function words.

patterns.name: making a legal ruling
patterns.context: making combines with rulings to mean issuing the previously mentioned rulings; this is a fixed legal context, not general production or operation.

patterns.name: making a property division
patterns.context: making combines with division to refer to carrying out or making a property division.

patterns.name: made meaning formed or designed
patterns.context: The passive phrase made in such a way describes why a format was designed in a particular form; it is lexically related to make/making but is not a “How to make” construction.

patterns.name: Symbol in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: The symbol o appears in an algebraic expression in a factorization problem; activation falls on a formula symbol rather than a natural-language action verb, and may be an independent incidental pattern.

3_2896.description: 主要响应 make/making/made 及“How to make”问答标题，也覆盖法律语境中的作出裁定、财产分割和设计格式；数学式中的 o 难以与这些模式统一。

patterns.name: make 的操作性用法
patterns.context: make/making 后接要执行的动作或目标；[1][2] 中是进行中的活动，[3]–[7] 中出现在问题标题的“How to make …”结构。
patterns.domain: 教程、技术问答、法律判决叙述

patterns.name: 问答标题模板
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题标题以 Q: 开头，随后用“How to make”提出实现或操作问题；触发组合也包含常见功能词。

patterns.name: making 表示作出法律裁定
patterns.context: making 与 rulings 搭配，表示法院作出前述裁定；这是固定法律语境，不是一般制作或操作。

patterns.name: making 表示财产分割
patterns.trigger: «making»5 division of the parties' separate and community property
patterns.context: making 与 division 搭配，指作出或进行财产分割。

patterns.name: made 表示形成或设计
patterns.context: 被动式 made in such a way 描述某种格式为何被设计成特定形式；与 make/making 有词形关联，但不是“How to make”结构。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的符号
patterns.context: 符号 o 出现在因式分解题的代数表达式中；激活落在公式符号而非自然语言操作动词上，可能是独立的偶发模式。

en.description: The most stable pattern is “For example,” introducing examples in patent technical backgrounds, often with strong activation at the comma; there are also patent background headings and disclaimer boilerplate, as well as a few sporadic technical terms and vehicle direction/condition expressions.

patterns.name: Example-introducing phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in example-introducing structures such as “For example,” or “when, for example,” especially at the comma; followed or preceded by examples in a technical background.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, including semiconductors, heat dissipation, memory, adhesives, vehicle control, image sensors, displays, and PCBs

patterns.name: Fixed boilerplate in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Patent background-section headings and disclaimer-style boilerplate; activations fall on heading words and legal wording rather than example-introducing commas.

patterns.name: Residual patterns in technical terms and phrases
patterns.context: Several distinct terms or partial word forms in technical descriptions activate, with no stable specific semantics or contextual condition shared among them.
patterns.domain: Semiconductor, heat dissipation, display, and electronic connector patent texts

patterns.name: Directional comparisons and concessive conditions
patterns.context: Describes vehicle mirror / photosensitive element orientation and signal comparison, and introduces examples in conditional clauses; overlaps with the general example-introduction pattern.

3_2896.concept: 专利背景中的举例引入
3_2896.description: 最稳定的模式是专利技术背景中引入实例的“For example,”，常在逗号处强激活；另有专利背景标题与免责声明套语，以及少量分散的技术术语和车辆方向/条件表达。

patterns.name: 例示引入语
patterns.trigger: « example»1« ,»10（多处实际呈现为“example,”，激活集中在逗号）
patterns.context: 出现在“For example,”或“when, for example,”等举例引入结构中，尤其是在逗号处；前后接技术背景中的实例说明。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，涵盖半导体、散热、存储器、粘结剂、车辆控制、图像传感器、显示器和PCB等

patterns.name: 专利背景固定套语
patterns.trigger: « Description» of the« Related»« Art»；« should» not« be» construed as an« admission» of« knowledge» in the« prior» art
patterns.context: 专利背景章节标题及免责声明式套语；激活分布在标题词和法律措辞上，而非举例逗号。

patterns.name: 技术名词及短语残余模式
patterns.trigger: « effect»（“metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor”）；« conflicting»« requirements»；« polys»ilicon；« characteristics»
patterns.context: 技术描述中若干不同术语或局部词形受到激活，未见它们共享稳定的具体语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 半导体、散热、显示器及电子连接专利文本

patterns.name: 方向比较与让步条件
patterns.context: 描述车辆镜面/光敏元件朝向及信号比较，并在条件句中引出示例；与通用举例模式有重叠。

en.description: Primarily responds to “First” and listing markers such as commas in patent text: these include the first item in a problem, requirement, or reason, as well as the beginning of a process, principle, or section description. There are also scattered activations in citation numbers and patent boilerplate such as “which follows”.

patterns.name: First, listing problems or requirements
patterns.context: Begins a list of multiple requirements, defects, reasons, or advantages in a patent background or invention description; often occurs at the beginning of a sentence or clause

patterns.name: First, beginning to describe steps or principles
patterns.context: Introduces a process, operating principle, or manufacturing step in a technical description, followed by a specific operation or process
patterns.domain: process and equipment descriptions in USPTO patents

patterns.name: First, section or component introduction
patterns.context: First describes a component, part, or topic, usually followed by further information rather than a list of defects or process steps
patterns.domain: description of embodiments in USPTO patents

patterns.name: First, listing conditions or causal reasons
patterns.context: When explaining shortcomings of existing solutions, first introduces the first reason, followed by a causal phrase

patterns.name: Number fragments in patent citation numbers
patterns.context: Patent citation context; activation markers fall on “example”, “in”, and numbers in the citation rather than a clear First-listing structure

patterns.name: Closing or preview phrase in patent descriptions
patterns.context: Summarizes that the invention's purposes or advantages will emerge from the following description; there is no First structure here, and this may be an independent trigger adjacent to other patent boilerplate
patterns.domain: preview of the purpose and contents of a patent specification

3_2896.concept: 专利文本中的首项/起始标记
3_2896.description: 主要响应专利文本中“First”及逗号等列举标记：既包括问题、要求和原因的首项，也包括流程、原理及章节说明的起始；另有引证编号和“which follows”等专利套语中的零散激活。

patterns.name: First，罗列问题或要求
patterns.trigger: “First,” / “first,”，通常紧接逗号，前文出现“requirements”“deficiencies”或一段问题陈述
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明说明中开始列举多个要求、缺陷、原因或优点；常位于句首或分句开头

patterns.name: First，开始描述步骤或原理
patterns.trigger: “First,” / “First”及其后的步骤内容；常与“as follows”“operates according to the following principle”或制作流程相邻
patterns.context: 在技术说明中引入流程、工作原理或制造步骤，后接具体操作或过程
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利中的工艺与设备说明

patterns.name: First，章节或部件引导语
patterns.context: 先说明某个部件、部分或主题，后续通常继续介绍其他内容，而非列举缺陷或工艺步骤
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利中的实施例说明

patterns.name: First，列举条件或因果理由
patterns.context: 在解释现有方案的缺点时，以 first 引出第一项原因，后接原因状语
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景中的问题分析

patterns.name: 专利引证编号中的数字词片段
patterns.trigger: “for example, in Japanese Patent Publication No. 20403…”中的“for example, in”及编号片段
patterns.context: 专利文献引用语境；激活标记落在“example”“in”和编号中的数字，而非清楚的 First 列举结构

patterns.name: 专利说明的收束或预告语
patterns.trigger: “which follows”以及“in part, will be obvious”
patterns.context: 概述发明目的或优点将从后文说明中呈现；此处没有 First 结构，可能是与其他专利套语相邻的独立触发
patterns.domain: 专利说明书的目的与内容预告

en.description: Primarily responds to itemized lists in legal text introduced by first/First, … second, especially tests, reasoning, elements, and conditions in court decisions; also strongly responds to the patent-background boilerplate “in part … and, in part” concerning the invention’s objectives and advantages.

patterns.name: First/second in list structures
patterns.context: Introduces parallel first and second items after a colon or semicolon, or within a sentence; common in legal reasoning, court tests, grounds for appeal, elements of a charge, or lists of conditions.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, especially decisions, appellate analysis, and legal standards

patterns.name: Expository boilerplate in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: The patent background describes the invention’s objectives and advantages and states that they will be set forth or become apparent from the following specification; activation concentrates on “in part … and, in part” in the boilerplate.

3_2896.description: 主要响应法律文本中以 first/First, … second 引出的分项列举，尤其是判决中的测试、理由、要件和条件；另对专利背景中关于发明目的与优点“in part … and, in part”套语有强响应。

patterns.name: 列举结构中的 first/second
patterns.context: 在冒号、分号或句子中引出并列的第一项和第二项；常见于法律论证、法院测试、上诉理由、指控要件或条件清单。
patterns.domain: 法律文书，尤其是判决、上诉分析及法律标准

patterns.name: 专利背景中的说明书套语
patterns.trigger: “Additional objects and advantages of the invention will be set forth in part in the description which follows, and, in part, will be obvious from the description”
patterns.context: 专利背景部分描述发明的目的和优点，并说明它们将从后续说明书中陈述或显而易见；激活集中在套语中的 “in part … and, in part”。

en.description: Primarily responds to structured lists and navigation terms in formal documents, such as First/second, issues, and section numbers; scattered activations also occur in code snippets and legal document formatting, with no unified trigger pattern apparent.

patterns.name: Itemized lists in legal opinions
patterns.context: Introduces disputed issues, grounds for appeal, or sequentially stated conditions in legal decisions or arguments; numbered structures are common.

patterns.name: Structural markers in patent specifications
patterns.context: Lists existing defects, invention objectives, and the contents of subsequent explanations in patent backgrounds or specifications.

patterns.name: Document section navigation
patterns.context: Previews content by section in a paper's abstract or main text, alongside section numbers and content summaries.

patterns.name: Identifiers and syntax fragments in code
patterns.context: In code contexts, markers are scattered around Go type/comment structures and Python numerical computation code; no clear shared semantics are apparent.

patterns.name: Isolated punctuation or paragraph formatting in legal text
patterns.context: In paragraphs, headings, or factual narratives in judicial documents, activations do not clearly correspond to the itemized lists described above.

3_2896.description: 主要响应正式文档中的结构化列举与导航词，如 First/second、issues 和章节编号；另有代码片段及法律文书格式处的零散激活，难以归入统一触发规律。

patterns.name: 法律意见书中的分项列举
patterns.context: 法律裁判或论证中，介绍争议事项、上诉理由或按顺序陈述条件；常见编号式结构。

patterns.name: 专利说明书的结构标记
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书中列出既有缺陷、发明目的及后续说明内容。

patterns.name: 文档章节导航
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文中按章节预告内容，伴随章节编号及内容概述。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与语法片段
patterns.context: 代码语境中，标记分散落在 Go 类型/注释结构和 Python 数值计算代码周围；未见明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的孤立句读或段落格式
patterns.context: 裁判文书的段落、标题或事实叙述处，激活未明显对应前述分项列举。

en.description: Activations take several local forms: ly word endings, comma/citation boundaries in legal and patent texts, code indentation and declarations, and hereto in email disclaimers; these cues belong to different contexts.

patterns.name: ly endings in adverbs or ordinal markers
patterns.context: Word-final ly in adverbs or ordinal/listing expressions; token boundaries are visible in firstly and secondly

patterns.name: End punctuation and citation formats in legal text
patterns.context: Activates near punctuation and citation boundaries in legal decisions, statutory citations, and explanations of statutory provisions

patterns.name: Commas and clauses in patent boilerplate
patterns.context: In the fixed patent-specification phrasing “objects and advantages ... will be set forth ... in part ... and ... in part ...”, especially at clause transitions and commas

patterns.name: Identifiers and type declarations in Go code
patterns.context: Near indentation, newlines, struct declarations, and the Ingress identifier in Go source code

patterns.name: Here-to in email disclaimers
patterns.context: Near the word “hereto” in parentheses in an email disclaimer, accompanied by a notice to delete email copies

3_2896.description: 激活表现为多种局部形式：ly 词尾、法律和专利文本的逗号/引文边界、代码缩进与声明，以及邮件免责声明中的 hereto；这些线索分属不同语境。

patterns.name: 副词或顺序标记 ly 结尾
patterns.context: 词尾 ly 在副词或序数/列举表达中；可见 firstly、secondly 的分词边界

patterns.name: 法律文本中的句末标点及引文格式
patterns.context: 法律判决、法规引文与条文说明中，标点和引文边界附近激活

patterns.name: 专利套语中的逗号与分句
patterns.context: 固定专利说明书句式“objects and advantages ... will be set forth ... in part ... and ... in part ...”中，尤其分句转折与逗号处

patterns.name: Go 代码中的标识符与类型声明
patterns.context: Go 源码中缩进、换行、结构体声明及 Ingress 标识符附近

patterns.name: 邮件免责声明中的 here-to
patterns.context: 邮件免责声明括号内的“hereto”一词附近，伴随邮件副本删除提示

en.concept: Legal citation formats and local textual transitions
en.description: Primarily responds to parentheses, years, and explanatory citation formats for statutes and case law in legal documents, and also activates at transitions between legal paragraphs. Other examples include Go code type words, superconducting materials terminology, and common words in comments; these latter categories are more weakly associated.

patterns.name: Parentheses and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: In citations to statutes, cases, or regulations, years, subsection identifiers, amendment information, or explanations are enclosed in parentheses; often adjacent to U.S.C. citations.

patterns.name: Types and identifiers in Go code
patterns.context: Near type declarations, struct fields, or interface names in Go source code; activation occurs on code identifiers and type words.

patterns.name: Iron-based superconducting materials terminology
patterns.context: Academic text discussing the Fermi level, electron-doped systems, and iron-based materials.

patterns.name: Emphasis or contrast expressions
patterns.context: In ordinary expository sentences, words indicating, linking, introducing articles, or expressing intent appear; specific trigger locations differ from the legal citation pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial transitions in legal documents
patterns.context: In legal paragraphs, a sentence-initial word introduces subsequent statements about the court, case, or parties after citing a regulation or presenting an argument.

3_2896.concept: 法律引文格式与局部文本衔接
3_2896.description: 主要响应法律文书中法条、判例引文的括号、年份及说明性引文格式，也在法律段落衔接处激活；另见 Go 代码类型词、超导材料术语和评论中的常用词，后几类关联较弱。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的括号及标点
patterns.context: 法律条文、判例或法规引文中，年份、条款子项、修订信息或说明被括号括起；常与 U.S.C. 引文相邻。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的类型与标识符
patterns.context: Go 源码中，类型声明、结构体字段或接口名附近；激活分布在代码标识符及类型词上。

patterns.name: 铁基超导材料术语
patterns.context: 讨论费米能级、电子掺杂体系及铁基材料的学术文本。

patterns.name: 强调或转折表达
patterns.context: 普通论述句中出现指示语、系词、冠词或表达意愿的词；具体触发位置与法律引文模式不同。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的句首衔接词
patterns.context: 法律段落中引述法规或论证后，以句首词转入法院、案件或当事人的后续陈述。

en.description: Activations cluster around several different local forms: the adverb suffix ly, ory in Theory, parentheses in legal citations, code structure symbols, and business email signatures and disclaimers. Trigger conditions and styles vary.

patterns.name: In-word suffix “ly”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the adverb suffix ly ending in y; especially clear in firstly, which may occur in a context of emphasis or topic transition

patterns.name: English affix or in-word fragment “ory”
patterns.context: Activation corresponds to the suffix or in-word substring ory in Theory; one example is at the start of a paper title, another in a book title cited in a patent
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, patent backgrounds, and citations

patterns.name: Parentheses and adjacent content in legal citations
patterns.context: Parentheses contain years, editions, or supplemental notes in statutory citations, often adjacent to years, section information, or emphasis added
patterns.domain: U.S. legal text, statutes, and case citations

patterns.name: Structural symbols and declaration syntax in code
patterns.context: Near comments, newlines, type declarations, and struct boundaries in Go code; activations are distributed across multiple syntax tokens

patterns.name: Email signature and disclaimer formatting
patterns.context: Near signatures, separators, or confidentiality statements at the end of business emails

3_2896.description: 激活集中在若干不同的局部形式：副词后缀 ly、Theory 中的 ory、法律引文括号、代码结构符号，以及商务邮件签名和免责声明。触发条件与文体不一。

patterns.name: 词内后缀「ly」
patterns.trigger: «ly»9（[2] 的 firstly，[3] 的 firstly）；另有「«ly»」出现在 [5] 的 reasonably（未标记）
patterns.context: 激活落在以 y 结尾的副词后缀 ly；在 firstly 中尤其明显，前面可有强调或话题转换语境
patterns.domain: 网页宣传文案、医疗问答

patterns.name: 英语词缀或词内片段「ory」
patterns.context: 激活对应 Theory 中的后缀或词内子串 ory；一例在论文标题开头，一例在专利引用的书名中
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、专利背景及引文

patterns.name: 法律引文中的括号及其邻接内容
patterns.context: 括号用于法规引文中的年份、版本或补充说明，常邻接年份、条款信息或 emphasis added
patterns.domain: 美国法律文本、法规及判决引文

patterns.name: 代码中的结构符号与声明语法
patterns.context: Go 代码中注释、换行、类型声明和结构体边界附近；激活分布在多种语法 token 上

patterns.name: 邮件签名与免责声明格式
patterns.trigger: «Regards»,、«Iris»、«Mack»及长横线分隔符；另有邮件地址后的免责声明文字
patterns.context: 商务邮件末尾的签名、分隔线或保密声明附近

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple corpora: two hits on the ending of firstly and two on Imai fragments; the rest involve code comments and declarations, legal citations and opinion headings, academic proper-name fragments, and contrastive expressions in comments, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Ending of “firstly”
patterns.context: “firstly” is used at the beginning or within a sentence to enumerate or introduce an explanation; both instances are followed by additional content

patterns.name: Imai name fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a personal name or bibliographic citation

patterns.name: Header fields in code comments
patterns.context: Comment fields and explanatory text near C/C++ macro definitions

patterns.name: Ingress code and type declarations
patterns.context: Interfaces, struct declarations, and comments in Go code

patterns.name: Punctuation in statutory citations
patterns.context: Statutes are cited in court opinions, with dense punctuation and numbering

patterns.name: Opinion heading and start of body
patterns.context: The statement of case facts begins after a heading in a court opinion

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in academic text
patterns.context: Proper names or subword fragments in technical paper text and bibliographic citations; no consistent trigger condition observed

patterns.name: Sentence-final and contrastive words in quotations
patterns.context: After quoting an online comment, “Until then” expresses a judgment about the spam problem

3_2896.description: 激活分散在多种语料：两处命中 firstly 的词尾，两处命中 Imai 片段；其余涉及代码注释与声明、法律引文和意见标题、学术专名片段及评论中的转折表达，缺乏统一触发条件。

patterns.name: “firstly”中的词尾
patterns.context: “firstly”用作句首或句中列举、引入说明；两处均伴随后续内容

patterns.name: Imai 姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名或文献引用中

patterns.name: 代码注释中的标题字段
patterns.context: C/C++ 宏定义附近的注释字段及说明文本

patterns.name: Ingress 代码与类型声明
patterns.context: Go 代码中的接口、结构体声明及注释

patterns.name: 法律条文引文标点
patterns.context: 判决文本中引用法条，标点和编号密集

patterns.name: 判决意见标题与正文起始
patterns.context: 法院判决的意见标题后开始陈述案件事实

patterns.name: 学术文本中的零散片段
patterns.context: 技术论文正文与文献引用中出现的专名或词片段；未见一致触发条件

patterns.name: 引述中的句末与转折词
patterns.context: 引述网络评论后，以“Until then”表达对垃圾邮件问题的判断

en.concept: Then and separator markers across diverse text structures
en.description: The most stable feature is then in until then; other activations are scattered across email headers, Go declarations, license wording, internal segments of technical terms, and legal citations, and are difficult to explain with a single word meaning.

patterns.name: Temporal / transitional then
patterns.context: Follows until then to refer to a previously mentioned situation, meaning “before that / until that time”; often followed by a comma or continuation of the sentence.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, narratives, business emails; paragraphs 1, 2, 5

patterns.name: Field separators in forwarded email headers
patterns.context: After the email body, a standard forwarded-message header appears, with fields such as From, Sent, and To separated by colons and tabs.
patterns.domain: Enron email and email quotation formats

patterns.name: Identifiers and type declarations in Go code
patterns.context: Defines an ingresses struct and its fields in Go source code; trigger locations include split identifiers, keywords, or field types.

patterns.name: Conditional wording in legal license text
patterns.context: Polite instructions, license terms, or conditional wording such as “if provided” in software licenses or confidentiality statements.
patterns.domain: Github license text, business legal statements

patterns.name: Internal subwords in domain terms or proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized parts of proper nouns, surnames, or technical terms; no clear shared syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics papers, medical papers, business emails

patterns.name: Quotation markers and citation details in legal citations
patterns.context: Parentheses introduce citations, indicate circuit numbers, or connect cited precedents in case citations.

patterns.name: Multiple weak trigger words in email body
patterns.context: A forum reply expresses reservations while discussing spam; apart from then, these words do not form a stable recurring pattern across other paragraphs.

3_2896.concept: 多样文本结构中的 then/分隔标记
3_2896.description: 最稳定的特征是 until then 中的 then；其余激活分散在邮件头、Go 声明、许可证措辞、专业词内部分词及法律引证等结构，难以由单一词义解释。

patterns.name: then 的时间/转折衔接
patterns.context: 在 until then 后承接此前提到的情况，表示“在那之前/在此之前”；后面常接逗号或句子继续。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、叙述、商务邮件；段1、2、5

patterns.name: 邮件转发头中的字段分隔
patterns.context: 邮件正文结束后出现转发邮件的标准头部，From、Sent、To 等字段以冒号和制表符分隔。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及邮件引用格式

patterns.name: Go 代码中的标识符与类型声明
patterns.context: Go 源码中定义 ingresses 结构体及其字段；触发位置包含被拆分的标识符、关键字或字段类型。

patterns.name: 法律许可文本中的条件措辞
patterns.context: 软件许可证或保密声明中出现礼貌指引、许可条款或“若有提供”的条件性措辞。
patterns.domain: Github 许可证文本、商务法律声明

patterns.name: 领域术语或专名的内部子词
patterns.context: 触发落在专有名词、姓氏或技术词语被分词切开的部分；没有明显统一的句法条件。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理论文、医学论文、商务邮件

patterns.name: 法律引证中的引述标记与引文信息
patterns.context: 判决引用中用括号引入引证、标注巡回法院序数或连接所引用的先例。

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的多个弱触发词
patterns.context: 论坛回复中围绕垃圾邮件问题表达保留判断；除 then 外，这些词没有在其他段落形成稳定重复模式。

en.description: Activations occur across proper names and formatting boundaries in formal, structured text: legal citations and normative wording, code declarations and file headers, paper citations, email headers, and commercial service lists; no single domain accounts for all examples.

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory numbering
patterns.context: In court opinions or legal texts, statutory numbers, parenthetical years, and citation formats appear together.

patterns.name: License and legal obligation wording
patterns.context: License terms, language indicating being bound by them, or wording pursuant to regulations appears in software license descriptions or formal rules.

patterns.name: Identifiers and type declarations in Go code
patterns.context: Declarations and implementations of interfaces, structs, fields, or identifiers in code.

patterns.name: Visualisation toolkit heading
patterns.context: Program and module headings in code comments, using separators and field labels.

patterns.name: Academic citations and scientific symbols
patterns.context: In research papers, bibliographic citations occur near technical discussions of superconducting materials and electron doping, as well as mathematical typesetting.

patterns.name: Forwarded email headers and timestamps
patterns.context: A forwarded email header follows the message body and contains sender, date/time, and recipient fields.

patterns.name: Commercial service advertising language
patterns.context: Lists services such as procurement, quality inspection, and shipping, and advertises free service or factory-direct supply.

3_2896.description: 激活分布于正式、结构化文本中的专名与格式边界：法律法条引文和规范措辞、代码声明及文件头、论文引注、邮件头和商业服务列表；没有单一领域可覆盖全部样例。

patterns.name: 法律引文与法条编号
patterns.context: 法律判决或法律文本中，法条编号、括号内年份及引文格式相邻出现。

patterns.name: 许可证与法律义务措辞
patterns.trigger: 「copyright and license terms」「governed by the License」「in accordance with」
patterns.context: 软件许可证说明或正式规定中，出现许可条款、受其约束或依照规定的表述。
patterns.domain: Github 软件文档；政府法规文本

patterns.name: Go 代码中的标识符与类型声明
patterns.context: 代码中接口、结构体、字段或标识符的声明与实现。

patterns.name: Visualisation 工具包标题
patterns.context: 代码注释中的程序与模块标题，使用分隔线和字段标签。

patterns.name: 学术文献引注与科学符号
patterns.context: 研究论文中，文献引用紧邻超导材料、电子掺杂等技术讨论和数学排版。

patterns.name: 邮件转发头与时间戳
patterns.context: 邮件正文后附转发邮件头，包含发件人、日期时间和收件人字段。

patterns.name: 商业服务宣传措辞
patterns.trigger: 「provide」「Quality Inspection」「all kinds of services」「FREE sourcing service」「OEM Chinese factories」
patterns.context: 列举采购、质检、货运等服务，并以免费或工厂供货作宣传。

en.description: Primarily responds to federal / constitutional and litigation discussions in legal documents, as well as statutes and case citation formats; also shows sporadic responses to Go code type identifiers, dimensional in physics, and Q&A question labels.

patterns.name: Statutory citations near quotation marks, parentheses, or citation markers
patterns.context: Activates when formatting markers such as statutes, years, parenthetical explanations, and citation abbreviations occur together in legal decisions or pleadings; not limited to this one legal format.

patterns.name: Federal-related word forms
patterns.context: Federal/federal itself and nearby content activate in contexts involving federal courts, agencies, or government; also occurs in non-legal technology documents.

patterns.name: string near types, interfaces, and identifiers
patterns.context: Activates near struct declarations, field types, and interface names in Go code; the word string is especially prominent.

patterns.name: dimensional in physics
patterns.context: In physics papers about thin-film vortex liquids, superconductors, and related topics; occurs only once, with no clear connection between the trigger word and the legal pattern.

patterns.name: Question labels and diagram phrases
patterns.context: A Q&A post begins with Q: and asks about drawing a memory model diagram; multiple word groups activate in fragments.

patterns.name: Wording about decision analysis, procedure, and evidence
patterns.context: Legal terms and adjacent content activate sporadically when discussing litigation claims, trial procedure, causality, attorney misconduct, or judicial analysis.

patterns.name: Citation and case-reference formats
patterns.context: When legal opinions cite cases, records, or previously stated judicial reasoning, citation markers, case names, years, and document numbers activate nearby.

3_2896.description: 主要响应法律文书中的联邦／宪法与诉讼论述、法条和判例引证格式；另对 Go 代码的类型标识符、物理学 dimensional 及问答题目标签有零散响应。

patterns.name: 引号、括号或引文标记附近的法条引证
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉状中，法条、年份、括号内说明及引文缩写等格式标记相邻时激活；但不局限于这一种法律格式。

patterns.name: Federal / 联邦相关词形
patterns.context: 联邦法院、联邦机构或政府的语境中，Federal/federal 本身及其邻近内容出现激活；也包括非法律科技文档中的 Federal。

patterns.name: 类型、接口与标识符附近的 string
patterns.context: Go 代码中的结构体声明、字段类型和接口名附近激活；string 的词面尤为突出。

patterns.name: 物理学中的 dimensional
patterns.context: 薄膜涡旋液体、超导体等物理学论文语境；只出现一次，触发词与法律模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 题目标签与图示短语
patterns.context: 问答帖以 Q: 开头并提出绘制内存模型图的问题；多词组分片出现激活。

patterns.name: 判决分析、程序与证据措辞
patterns.context: 讨论诉讼主张、审判程序、因果关系、律师失职或法官分析时，法律术语及其相邻内容零散激活。

patterns.name: 引文与判例引用格式
patterns.context: 法律意见中引用判例、卷宗或引述既有裁判理由时，引用标记、案名、年份和文书编号附近激活。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in legal documents: citations to statutes and rules, parenthetical docket references, and their punctuation formats are most prominent; other examples involve proofreading and layout, government bill names, and wording about litigation, liability, and judicial determinations.

patterns.name: Citations and parenthetical source references
patterns.context: In legal documents, citations to cases, statutes, or docket materials include parenthetical years, jurisdictions, document types, page numbers, or explanatory notes; activations occur near both parentheses and citation markers.
patterns.domain: Federal and state court opinions, pleadings, and legal citation formats

patterns.name: Statute and rule numbers
patterns.context: Rules, codes, section numbers, and adjacent punctuation or parentheses appear in legal argument; often near parenthetical citation references, but may also occur directly in the body text.

patterns.name: Docket citations and document labels
patterns.context: Abbreviations identify docket documents, pleadings, joint appendices, or paragraph and page numbers, often in references to the case record or litigation claims.
patterns.domain: Court opinions and litigation docket citations

patterns.name: Layout and proofreading notes in legal documents
patterns.context: Near citations, pagination or indentation artifacts appear, or notes indicate that changes in a quotation or brackets were present in the original.
patterns.domain: Citations in legal opinions and OCR/layout text

patterns.name: Government legal program names
patterns.context: Words in the names of government agencies and federal acts are activated in descriptions of court website publication obligations.
patterns.domain: Federal court administration and government e-government regulations

patterns.name: Fixed phrasing in legal argument
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of attorney misconduct, whether a claim is valid, or employer explanations and factfinder credibility assessments in employment discrimination cases.
patterns.domain: Appellate review and employment discrimination opinions

patterns.name: Wording of claims and legal allegations
patterns.context: Appears when describing class action claims, constitutional violation allegations, grounds for sanctions, or damages claims.
patterns.domain: Civil opinions, pleadings, and sanctions discussions

3_2896.concept: 法律文书引用与诉讼语汇
3_2896.description: 激活集中于法律文书：法条和规则引用、案卷出处括注及其标点格式最突出；另涉及排版校勘、政府法案名称，以及诉讼、责任和司法判断措辞。

patterns.name: 引文及出处括注
patterns.trigger: “(1994) (federal question jurisdiction)”“(Tex. Sept. 28, 2017); see also”“(M. ag. Rep. and Recommend[ation])”“(App. 24)”“(emphasis omitted) (citation omitted)”
patterns.context: 法律文书中，引用判例、法条或案卷材料时，括号内标注年份、司法辖区、文件类型、页码，或引用说明；括号与引文标记附近均有激活。
patterns.domain: 联邦及州法院意见、诉状和法律引文格式

patterns.name: 法条与规则编号
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现规则、法典、条款编号及其紧邻的标点或括号；常与引文出处括注相邻，但也可直接出现在正文中。
patterns.domain: 法律诉讼文书及法条引用

patterns.name: 案卷引用与文书标签
patterns.context: 以缩写标明案卷文档、诉状、联合附件或段落和页码，常出现在对案件记录或诉讼主张的引用中。
patterns.domain: 法院意见及诉讼案卷引用

patterns.name: 法律文书中的版式与校勘说明
patterns.context: 引文附近出现分页、缩进等排版残留，或说明引文中的改动及括号来自原文。
patterns.domain: 法律判决的引文及 OCR/版式文本

patterns.name: 政府法律项目名称
patterns.trigger: “United States Court of Federal Claims”“E-Government Act of 2002”“Federal Management and Promotion of Electronic”
patterns.context: 叙述法院网站发布义务时，政府机构、联邦法案及其标题中的词语被激活。
patterns.domain: 联邦法院行政及政府电子政务法规

patterns.name: 法律论证中的固定措辞
patterns.context: 讨论律师失职、诉求是否成立，或就业歧视案件中雇主理由及事实认定者可信度判断时出现。
patterns.domain: 上诉审查及就业歧视法律意见

patterns.name: 诉讼请求与法律主张措辞
patterns.trigger: “class action”“other prisoners, past and present”“constitutional violation”“intentional or even negligent misconduct”“sanctions under Rule 38”“exemplary damages”
patterns.context: 描述集体诉讼请求、宪法侵权指控、制裁依据或损害赔偿请求时出现。
patterns.domain: 民事诉讼意见、诉状及制裁讨论

en.description: Responds to excerpts from U.S. federal decisions and litigation documents, especially case / docket citations, legal terminology, litigation procedure narratives, and preserved newlines, indentation, and transcription formatting; no single substantive-law topic is apparent.

patterns.name: Quoted judicial opinions and citation format
patterns.context: After court reasoning or a case quotation, compact case citations, record numbers, or parenthetical citation notes appear; often accompanied by a newline
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court decisions, legal opinions

patterns.name: Specific terms or phrases in legal text
patterns.context: Sets of legal terms or normative phrasing in decisions appear in legal discussion; this pattern is scattered across different substantive and procedural issues, with no single term explaining all activations
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and litigation documents

patterns.name: Residual court-document formatting and unusual whitespace
patterns.context: Original document layout and transcription formatting are preserved around court records, citations, or pagination

patterns.name: Quoted party arguments and case procedure narratives
patterns.context: The court summarizes claims, party positions, or procedural steps

3_2896.description: 对美国联邦判决与诉讼文书片段有反应，尤其是判例/案卷引注、法律术语、诉讼程序叙述，以及保留的换行、缩进和转录格式；未见单一实体法主题。

patterns.name: 引述司法意见及引注格式
patterns.context: 在法院论证或引述判例后，出现紧凑的判例引注、记录编号或括号内引注说明；常伴随换行
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院判决、法律意见

patterns.name: 法律文本中的特定术语或短语
patterns.trigger: “assistance of appellate counsel”、“motion to dismiss”、“genuine and present controversy”、“unworthy of credence”、“federal question jurisdiction”等
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现成套法律术语或判决中的规范性表述；该模式分散于不同实体法与程序问题，未见单一术语能解释全部激活
patterns.domain: 美国判例法与诉讼文书

patterns.name: 法院文书格式残留与异常空白
patterns.trigger: 多重换行、缩进空白、“↵ ”及文书标记，如“Rec. doc.”、“J.A.”
patterns.context: 法院记录、引文或分页处保留原始文书排版和转录格式

patterns.name: 引述当事人主张与案件程序叙述
patterns.trigger: “Defendant contends”、“seeking to establish a class action”、“motion”、“complaint”
patterns.context: 法院概述诉讼请求、当事人立场或程序步骤

en.concept: Federal opinion citations and legal argument
en.description: Primarily sensitive to citation boundaries, Id./page numbers, and parenthetical punctuation in federal opinions; also responds to citation-editing notes, statutory citations, and legal argument vocabulary. Some activations fall on ERISA insurance disputes and split subword fragments.

patterns.name: Citing cases and pinpoint pages
patterns.context: An opinion cites a prior case or document and adds a page number, year, and citation note; often occurs at the end of a citation.

patterns.name: Parentheses and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Formatting boundaries in legal citations, footnotes, or document citations, especially parentheses, periods, line breaks, and layout whitespace.

patterns.name: Notes on the source or alterations in quotations
patterns.context: After a quotation, notes indicate whether it is reproduced as in the original or emphasize that emphasis was added by the quoting author.

patterns.name: Legal claims and adjudication analysis vocabulary
patterns.context: Substantive legal discussion involves attorney misconduct, class actions, conflicts of law, sanctions, or evidence; not all terms appear together in every passage.

patterns.name: Statutory and rule citations
patterns.context: Discussion relies on or cites procedural rules, code provisions, and jurisdictional grounds.

patterns.name: ERISA and insurance disputes
patterns.context: Discusses pension benefits, insurance plans, or insurer reserves, often in connection with federal jurisdiction or class actions.

patterns.name: Case or publication names in citations
patterns.context: Proper names such as case names, reporters, and abbreviated statutes appear in body text or citations; activation may be interwoven with citation formatting.
patterns.domain: Case law and legal reference citations

patterns.name: Anomalously split words and local word-form fragments
patterns.context: A word is split by token boundaries, and activation falls on an internal fragment; the fragment itself does not constitute a stable, independent semantic category.

3_2896.concept: 联邦判决引文与法律论述
3_2896.description: 主要对联邦判决中的引文边界、Id./页码及括号标点敏感，也响应引文编辑说明、法条引用和法律论述词汇；部分激活落在ERISA保险争议及拆分词片段上。

patterns.name: 引述判例与页码引用
patterns.context: 判决意见在引用先前判例或文书后，附页码、年份及引文说明；多见引文结束处。

patterns.name: 法律引文括号与标点
patterns.context: 法律引文、脚注或文书引用的格式边界，尤其是括号、句点、换行和排版空白。

patterns.name: 引述内容的来源或改动说明
patterns.context: 引文后说明引文是否保留原样，或强调标记是否由引述者添加。

patterns.name: 法律主张与裁判分析词汇
patterns.context: 实体法律论述涉及律师失职、集体诉讼、法律冲突、制裁或证据；并非所有词在每段都共同出现。

patterns.name: 法条与规则引用
patterns.context: 论述依据或援引程序规则、法典条文和管辖权依据。

patterns.name: ERISA与保险争议
patterns.context: 讨论养老金福利、保险计划或保险公司准备金，常与联邦管辖或集体诉讼相连。

patterns.name: 引文中的判例或文献名称
patterns.context: 正文或引文中出现案件、报告、法规简称等专名；激活可能与引文格式交织。

patterns.name: 异常拆分词与局部词形片段
patterns.context: 词被 token 边界拆分，激活落在词内片段；片段本身不构成稳定独立语义类别。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的子词切分

en.concept: U.S. judicial citations and opinion style
en.description: Strongly biased toward citations and judicial prose in U.S. legal opinions: Id./See, parenthetical citations, and docket and page references are most prominent; also includes quotation-change markers, statutes, litigation procedure, and legal assessments. Domain topics are sporadic, and layout artifacts may also contribute to activation.

patterns.name: Citation format for cases or sources
patterns.context: Citing prior cases, legal dictionaries, or litigation records in judicial reasoning, often at sentence ends or between paragraphs; especially Id. followed by a page number, or a parenthetical source citation
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court opinions and legal citations

patterns.name: Quotation changes and source-text markers
patterns.context: Parentheticals after quotations or case citations that note the original text, emphasis, or editorial changes; often adjacent to quotation and citation formats

patterns.name: Federal statutes and jurisdiction citations
patterns.context: Statute numbers or rule names appear in discussions of federal procedural rules, federal legal grounds, or federal court jurisdiction

patterns.name: Procedural language in judicial opinions
patterns.context: Describes pleadings, motions, court findings, appellate error, or consequences of litigation procedure; not a single specific procedural concept

patterns.name: Evaluative or evidentiary language in legal decisions
patterns.context: When courts assess attorney performance, evidentiary credibility, the merits of an issue, or the effect of judicial procedure

patterns.name: Quotations of statutory or case-law definitions
patterns.context: Citing statutory or case-law interpretation, or directly quoting a legal-dictionary definition; not ordinary quotation marks in general prose

patterns.name: ERISA and prison-pension class actions
patterns.context: Discusses alleged diversion of prison staff pension benefits, class actions, or ERISA regulation; also involves insurance plans and federal jurisdiction
patterns.domain: Employee benefits law and prison-related litigation

patterns.name: Page and docket references for cases and litigation records
patterns.context: Locates material by docket document, joint appendix, or case-report page number, often following a citation

patterns.name: Special characters, pagination, and layout artifacts
patterns.context: Line breaks, pagination, indentation, or conversion artifacts in legal documents; whether they directly trigger the neuron is uncertain

3_2896.concept: 美国司法引证与裁判文体
3_2896.description: 强烈偏向美国法律意见书中的引证与裁判语体：Id./See、括号引注、案卷及页码定位最突出；兼有引文改动标记、法条、诉讼程序和法律评价。领域话题分散，版面残留也可能贡献激活。

patterns.name: 援引判例或文献的引证格式
patterns.trigger: « See»、« Id»、« (»、« at»、« citing»、« quoting»，以及紧随其后的卷页、年份或案名
patterns.context: 司法论证中引用前案、判例、法律词典或诉讼记录，常位于句末或段落间；尤其是 Id. 后接页码，或括号内标注引文来源
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院意见书及法律引注

patterns.name: 引文改动与原文标注
patterns.context: 引文或判例引注后的括号，说明原文、强调或编辑改动；常与引文及引证格式相邻

patterns.name: 联邦法条及司法管辖权引注
patterns.trigger: «Fed»…« R»…« Civ. P.»、« 28»« U»…«C»« §»、« federal»…« question»« jurisdiction»
patterns.context: 讨论联邦程序规则、联邦法律依据或联邦法院管辖权时，出现法条编号或规则名称

patterns.name: 司法意见的程序性措辞
patterns.trigger: « motion»、« complaint»、« amended pleading»、« dismiss»、« leave to amend»；另有« case»、« court»、« error»
patterns.context: 描述诉状、动议、法院判断、上诉错误或诉讼程序后果；并非特定单一程序概念

patterns.name: 法律判断中的评价或证明措辞
patterns.trigger: « ineffective»« assistance»、« merit»less、« reasonable»…« factfinder»、« unworthy of credence»、« fairness»、« integrity»
patterns.context: 法院评估律师表现、证据可信度、争点价值或司法程序影响时

patterns.name: 法定或判例定义的引述
patterns.trigger: « can fairly be interpreted»« as»、« BLACK'S LAW DICTIONARY»、« (»«quoting»
patterns.context: 援引法条或判例解释，或直接引用法律词典定义；不是一般叙述中的普通引号

patterns.name: ERISA与监狱养老金集体诉讼
patterns.trigger: « ERISA»、« pension benefits»、« class»« action»、« prisoners»
patterns.context: 讨论监狱人员养老金福利被挪用、集体诉讼或ERISA规制；也涉及保险计划与联邦管辖
patterns.domain: 雇员福利法及监狱相关诉讼

patterns.name: 判例及诉讼记录的页码、案卷定位
patterns.trigger: « Rec»«.»« doc»、« J»«.»«A»、« Id»«.»« at» 后接数字或星号页码
patterns.context: 以案卷文件、联合附录或判例页码定位材料，常见于引文之后

patterns.name: 特殊字符、分页与版面残留
patterns.context: 法律文书的换行、分页、缩进或排版转换残留；是否直接触发神经元不确定

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and formatting features
en.description: Activations are concentrated on “unless otherwise” clauses, the ending subword of counsel in legal text, and the eg string across domains; they also respond to the legal abbreviation M and long whitespace in court documents.

patterns.name: unless otherwise clauses
patterns.context: “otherwise” follows “unless otherwise” and is followed by stated, noted, or indicated

patterns.name: Ending subword of counsel
patterns.context: Refers to an attorney in a legal opinion, with activation on the sel portion of counsel

patterns.name: eg string
patterns.context: The same character substring appears across proper names, Dutch words, and protein names
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, European Parliament texts, biomedical lists

patterns.name: Legal abbreviation M
patterns.context: Appears in an abbreviation or split form of magistrate

patterns.name: Extensive whitespace formatting
patterns.context: Long spaces or indentation appear after line breaks in court documents

3_2896.concept: 异质文本片段与格式特征
3_2896.description: 激活集中于“unless otherwise”条款、法律文本中的 counsel 末尾子词，以及跨领域的 eg 字符串；另对法律缩写 M 和法院文书长空白有反应。

patterns.name: unless otherwise 条款
patterns.context: “otherwise”位于“unless otherwise”之后，后接 stated、noted 或 indicated
patterns.domain: 免责声明、条款及技术说明

patterns.name: counsel 的末尾子词
patterns.context: 法律意见中提及律师，激活落在 counsel 的 sel 部分

patterns.name: eg 字符串
patterns.context: 跨专名、荷兰语词及蛋白质名称出现相同字符子串
patterns.domain: 百科、欧洲议会文本、生物医学列表

patterns.name: 法律缩写 M
patterns.context: 出现在 magistrate 的缩写或拆分形式中

patterns.name: 大量空白格式
patterns.context: 法院文件中换行后出现长空格或缩进

en.description: All passages are U.S. legal documents. The core trigger is counsel (including Counsel’s), appearing both in attorney lists and party-representation signatures and in narrative text describing attorneys’ motions, arguments, or trial conduct; headings and blank layout in attorney lists also accompany activation.

patterns.name: Tokenized forms of Counsel
patterns.context: The word counsel appears in legal opinions or court records, especially in phrases such as counsel for… and counsel then…; activation falls on parts of the word form assembled across tokens.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and litigation documents

patterns.name: COUNSEL section in opinions
patterns.context: A formatted heading near the end of a decision, often near AFFIRMED, attorney names, and party-representation information; also includes blank padding before the heading.

patterns.name: Attorney representation information
patterns.context: After an attorney’s name or law firm, indicates the party represented; activation concentrates on counsel and the following phrase.
patterns.domain: Attorney signatures and representation information in decisions

patterns.name: Attorney litigation conduct or statements
patterns.context: Narrative text describes attorneys filing motions, making arguments, subpoenaing witnesses, or presenting points, rather than an attorney-list section.
patterns.domain: Case facts and procedural narrative in court decisions

patterns.name: Counsel’s in attorney names
patterns.context: Possessive form modifying motion, meaning an attorney’s motion; activation is especially strong compared with other examples.

patterns.name: Standalone layout whitespace and section formatting
patterns.context: Aligned whitespace in attorney-list or decision-ending sections, appearing with the COUNSEL heading; the whitespace itself is also marked.

patterns.name: Nonstandard representation-information format
patterns.context: Representation is listed on a separate line after attorney contact information and appearance notation; the format does not necessarily include a COUNSEL heading.
patterns.domain: Attorney signature blocks in appellate cases

patterns.name: Other legal contexts not separately explained
patterns.context: Attorney identity or litigation-procedure background; consistent with the main pattern, but the specific trigger is unclear.

3_2896.description: 所有段均为美国法律文书，核心触发是 counsel（含 Counsel’s），既出现在律师名单、代理方署名，也出现在正文叙述律师的动议、主张或庭审行为；律师名单中的标题、空白排版亦伴随激活。

patterns.name: Counsel 的分词形式
patterns.context: 法律意见书或法院记录中出现 counsel 一词，尤其是 counsel for…、counsel then… 等短语；激活落在跨 token 拼接的词形部分。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、诉讼文书

patterns.name: 判决书的 COUNSEL 栏目
patterns.context: 判决结尾的排版栏目标题，附近常有 AFFIRMED、律师姓名及代理方信息；也包括标题前的空白填充。
patterns.domain: 上诉法院判决书及其律师名单版式

patterns.name: 律师代理方信息
patterns.context: 律师姓名或律所之后，说明其代表的诉讼一方；激活集中在 counsel 及其后续短语。
patterns.domain: 判决书中的律师署名与代理信息

patterns.name: 律师诉讼行为或陈述
patterns.context: 正文叙述律师提出动议、主张、传唤证人或陈述论点，而非名单栏目。
patterns.domain: 法院判决的案件事实与程序叙述

patterns.name: 律师姓名中的 Counsel’s
patterns.context: 所有格形式修饰 motion，表示律师的动议；激活特别强于其他样例。

patterns.name: 独立的排版空白与栏目格式
patterns.context: 律师名单或判决结尾区域的对齐留白，与 COUNSEL 标题共同出现；空白自身也被标记。

patterns.name: 非标准代理信息格式
patterns.trigger: «Coun»sel« for»« Appellant»，前有地址、ARGUED、律所名称
patterns.context: 律师联系地址及出庭标记后，以独立行注明代理方；格式不一定带 COUNSEL 栏目标题。
patterns.domain: 上诉案件的律师署名区

patterns.name: 其余未单独解释的法律语境
patterns.trigger: 上下文仍包含 counsel，但没有足够证据支持更具体的子模式
patterns.context: 律师身份或诉讼程序背景；与主模式一致，但具体触发条件不明确。

en.description: Primarily responds to quotations, docket page numbers, and procedural terms in U.S. legal opinions; also covers substantive legal reasoning. Less common patterns include pension class actions, instructional formats, and layout whitespace.

patterns.name: Case quotations and citation format
patterns.context: Citing or paraphrasing cases, statutes, or documents in legal reasoning, often with quotation marks, parentheses, page numbers, and citation notes.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court opinions and legal documents

patterns.name: Litigation documents and procedural terminology
patterns.context: Discusses complaints, motions to dismiss, transfers, or litigation procedure; commonly appears in procedural legal analysis.

patterns.name: Legal claims, evidence, and standards of decision
patterns.context: Evaluates effective assistance of counsel, evidentiary credibility, constitutional claims, or judicial error.
patterns.domain: Substantive legal analysis in judicial opinions

patterns.name: Pages and numbers in legal citations
patterns.context: Cites docket entries, documents, case pages, paragraphs, or statute numbers, often with digits, abbreviations, and parentheses.

patterns.name: Blank layout and line breaks
patterns.context: Indentation, pagination, or repeated line breaks in legal text; this trigger may not be related to semantic content.

patterns.name: ERISA pension class actions
patterns.context: Claims brought as a class action on behalf of current and former prisoners, involving diversion of pension benefits.

patterns.name: Instructional format and attendance requirements
patterns.context: Describes program requirements that students live on campus and attend formal, in-person classes, appearing in the same passage as legal citation formats.

3_2896.description: 主要响应美国法律意见中的引文、案卷页码和程序术语，也涉及实体法律论证；另有养老金集体诉讼、教学形式以及排版空白等少见模式。

patterns.name: 引述判例与引文格式
patterns.context: 法律论证中引用或转述判例、法规或文书，常伴随引号、括号、页码和引文说明。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院意见及法律文书

patterns.name: 诉讼文书及程序用语
patterns.context: 讨论起诉状、驳回请求、案件移送或诉讼程序；多见于程序性法律论述。

patterns.name: 法律主张、证据与裁判标准
patterns.context: 评估律师帮助、证据可信度、宪法主张或裁判错误。
patterns.domain: 司法意见中的实体法律分析

patterns.name: 法律引文中的页码与编号
patterns.context: 引述案卷、文书、判例页码、段落或法条编号，常有数字、缩写及括号。

patterns.name: 空白排版及换行符
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现缩进、分页或连续换行等排版残留；此触发未必与语义内容有关。

patterns.name: ERISA养老金集体诉讼
patterns.context: 主张代表现任及曾任囚犯提起集体诉讼，涉及养老金福利被转移。

patterns.name: 教学形式与到校要求
patterns.context: 描述学生须住校并在正式课堂上课的项目要求，与法律引文格式同处一段。

en.description: Most passages activate in legal citations, regulatory numbering, and parenthetical citation notes; other independent patterns include class action wording, Java manifest fields, code file headers, and fragments within Dutch words.

patterns.name: Legal citations and docket locators
patterns.context: In opinions, pleadings, or legal documents, docket page numbers, case numbers, dates, or statutory provisions identify a source; often accompanied by parentheses, quotation marks, abbreviations, and periods
patterns.domain: U.S. legal documents and judicial citations

patterns.name: Regulatory numbers and statutory citations
patterns.context: Chapter and section numbers of regulations, rules, or sentencing guidelines, usually adjacent to abbreviations, numerals, periods, or the § symbol

patterns.name: Quotation and parenthetical markers in legal text
patterns.context: When quoting an opinion or material, notes about editorial treatment, emphasis, or the original source are usually placed in parentheses after the quotation

patterns.name: Claim wording in legal pleadings
patterns.context: Describes class action claims brought on behalf of a group and defines the affected group; these words do not form a stable repeated pattern in other passages

patterns.name: JAR manifest metadata
patterns.context: Key-value fields introduced by colons and hyphenated attribute names, followed by hash digest data

patterns.name: Code file headers and comment markers
patterns.context: Comments, docstrings, platform markers, or import statements at the start of code files; often include special delimiters, language declarations, and copyright information
patterns.domain: Github code (JavaScript comments and Python file headers)

patterns.name: Subword activation within Dutch words
patterns.context: Activates on internal subword fragments in Dutch speech text; the fragments have no clear legal citation or code-format trigger

3_2896.concept: 带结构标记的文档片段
3_2896.description: 多数段落在法律引证、法规编号及引文括注中激活；另有集体诉讼措辞、Java 清单字段、代码文件头，以及荷兰语词内片段等独立模式。

patterns.name: 法律引证与案卷定位
patterns.trigger: “Rec. doc. 15 at 27-35”“J.A. at 10”“R. at 574”“Id. at 5”“Docket No. 17-19128”
patterns.context: 出现在判决、诉状或法律文件中，用案卷页码、案号、日期或法规条文定位来源；常伴随括号、引号、缩写及句点
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书与司法引证

patterns.name: 法规编号与条文引用
patterns.trigger: “Sec. 1B1.3”“Fed. R. Civ. P. Rule 26”“TEX. GOV’T CODE ANN. § 73.5001”
patterns.context: 法规、规则或量刑指南的章节和条款编号，通常紧邻缩写、数字、句点或§符号

patterns.name: 法律文本中的引述和括注标记
patterns.trigger: “(Mag. Rep. and Recommendation”“(emphasis in original)”“(alterations and parentheses in original)”
patterns.context: 引述判决或材料时说明编辑处理、强调或原文出处，通常置于引文后的括号内

patterns.name: 法律诉状中的诉求措辞
patterns.context: 描述代表某类人提出集体诉讼请求，并界定受影响群体；这些词并未在其他段落形成稳定重复模式

patterns.name: JAR 清单元数据
patterns.context: 冒号引出的键值字段与连字符连接的属性名，后接散列摘要数据

patterns.name: 代码文件头与注释标记
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的注释、文档字符串、平台标记或导入语句；常有特殊分隔符、语言声明及版权信息
patterns.domain: Github 代码（JavaScript 注释及 Python 文件头）

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内子词激活
patterns.context: 荷兰语演讲文本中，对词语内部的子词片段激活；片段内没有清晰的法律引证或代码格式触发条件

en.concept: Structured proper names and citation markers
en.description: Primarily responds to fragments of docket and case citation formats in legal documents, especially citation abbreviations, page numbers, parentheses, and notes on original emphasis; also includes two isolated patterns: code-comment metadata and lists of bacterial protein names.

patterns.name: Legal citations and docket page formats
patterns.context: Citations to dockets, cases, and statutes in judicial opinions or complaints; abbreviations, punctuation, numbers, and formatted citations commonly appear together

patterns.name: Code markers in Java comments
patterns.context: Block comment at the start of a code file, containing LeetCode metadata and language identifiers

patterns.name: Bacterial protein name lists
patterns.context: Multiple protein/gene symbols separated by commas, forming a list of names without syntactic connections

3_2896.concept: 结构化专名与引文标记
3_2896.description: 主要响应法律文书中案卷与判例引文的格式片段，尤其引文缩写、页码、括号及原文强调说明；另有代码注释元数据和细菌蛋白名称清单两类孤立模式。

patterns.name: 法律引文与案卷页码格式
patterns.trigger: «Id» / «J»«.»«A» / «R»«.»« at»，以及 «at» 后的页码、括号引文和 «emphasis in original»
patterns.context: 司法意见书或诉状中引用案卷、判例与法律条文；常见缩写、标点、数字及格式化引文相邻

patterns.name: Java 注释中的代码标记
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的块注释，含 LeetCode 元数据和语言标识

patterns.name: 细菌蛋白名称列表
patterns.context: 多个蛋白/基因符号以逗号分隔，构成无句法连接的名称清单
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学文本

en.description: Activation is concentrated on quotations, page numbers, docket/statute identifiers, and legal reasoning in legal documents; a few instances occur in web URLs containing date digits and code comments. The common thread is not entirely clear; the number “10” occurs across domains.

patterns.name: Page numbers and parenthetical notes in legal citations
patterns.context: After a citation in a legal decision or complaint, at followed by a page number, with a source or emphasis note in parentheses

patterns.name: Footnotes, identifiers, and formatting markers in legal documents
patterns.context: Docket citations, statute numbers, abbreviations, and formatting identifiers embedded in legal reasoning

patterns.name: Reasoning language in legal opinions or decisions
patterns.context: Discusses legal claims, jurisdiction, causation, or attorney misconduct; no clear shared legal topic

patterns.name: Date digits in web links
patterns.context: HackerNews snippets contain URLs to webpages or news articles, with dates appearing as digits in the path

patterns.name: Markers and attributes in code comments
patterns.context: Block comments at the start of code files and LeetCode metadata comments

patterns.name: The number “10” and its mixed contexts
patterns.context: The number appears repeatedly across different corpora and structures, but contexts are not consistent; it may be a weak surface-level trigger

3_2896.description: 激活集中于法律文书中的引文、页码、案卷/法条标号及法律论证；少数出现在含日期数字的网页 URL 和代码注释。共同线索不完全明确，数字“10”跨域出现。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的页码与括号标注
patterns.trigger: “at 574 (emphasis in original)”、“at 10 (Compl. at 5)”以及“at 472 (emphasis in original)”
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉状的引文后，出现 at 加页码，并带括号内的来源或 emphasis 说明

patterns.name: 法律文书中的脚注、标号与格式化标记
patterns.context: 法律论证中嵌入案卷引用、法条编号、缩写和排版标号

patterns.name: 法律意见或判决中的论证措辞
patterns.trigger: “ineffective assistance of appellate counsel”、“federal court”、“ERISA”、“constitutional violation”
patterns.context: 讨论法律主张、管辖权、因果关系或律师失职；没有明显的共同特定法律主题

patterns.name: 网页链接中的日期数字
patterns.context: HackerNews 片段包含指向网页或新闻文章的 URL，日期以路径数字形式出现

patterns.name: 代码注释中的标记与属性
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的块注释及 LeetCode 元数据注释

patterns.name: “10”数字及其混杂位置
patterns.trigger: “10”出现在 URL 日期、法律引文“at 10”、页码或引用标注等位置
patterns.context: 数字形式在不同语料与结构中重复出现，但上下文并不统一；可能是较弱的表面触发线索

en.description: Primarily responds to quotations, docket references, and judicial reasoning language in legal documents; also includes ERISA litigation, patent citations, civil commitment and constitutional claims, plus a classroom attendance requirement.

patterns.name: Legal citation and pleading-location formats
patterns.context: Activation occurs in citations, citation parentheticals, and page/paragraph references in decisions or complaints, often near sentence-ending punctuation; not limited to a specific legal topic.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, complaints, and legal citations

patterns.name: Conclusions in legal reasoning or review language
patterns.context: Evaluative words are marked when legal opinions summarize arguments, evidence, or court-review standards; wording varies across passages.
patterns.domain: Appellate opinions and criminal and civil decisions

patterns.name: ERISA/pension-benefit litigation
patterns.context: Involves pension or insurance plans, ERISA jurisdiction, or related class actions; some activation falls on citation format rather than substantive terms.
patterns.domain: Federal employee benefits and insurance litigation

patterns.name: Patent document citation format
patterns.context: Background-art sections cite Japanese patent document numbers and explain patent citations to technical prior art.

patterns.name: Terms on specific legal topics
patterns.context: Terms appear in the review standard or cause-of-action narrative of individual cases; no clear shared topic with other passages.
patterns.domain: Civil commitment decisions and constitutional litigation

patterns.name: Class attendance requirements
patterns.context: Reports a school rule requiring students to live on campus and attend classes in person, followed by a record-page citation.
patterns.domain: Legal materials relating to education rules

3_2896.description: 主要响应法律文书中的引文、案卷定位及裁判论证措辞；另见ERISA诉讼、专利引证、民事收容与宪法诉因，以及一段课堂出勤规定。

patterns.name: 法律引文与诉状定位格式
patterns.context: 激活出现在判决或诉状的引用、引文括号及页码/段落定位格式中，常邻近句末标点；并不局限于特定法律议题。
patterns.domain: 美国法院意见、诉状及法律引文

patterns.name: 法律论证结论或审查措辞
patterns.trigger: « ineffective»、« analysis»、« meritless»、« salvageable»、« fundamental»、« clearly»、« erroneous»
patterns.context: 法律意见中概述论证、证据或法院审查标准时，相关评价性词语被标记；各段用语不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 上诉意见、刑事及民事裁判

patterns.name: ERISA／养老金福利诉讼
patterns.trigger: « action»、« pension»、« ERISA»；另有“life insurance policy plan”“regulated by ERISA”
patterns.context: 涉及养老金或保险计划、ERISA 管辖或相关集体诉讼；部分激活落在引文格式而非实体术语上。
patterns.domain: 联邦雇员福利与保险诉讼

patterns.name: 专利文献引证格式
patterns.trigger: “Japanese Unexamined Patent Application Publication No.”、“Japanese Patent No.”及“« pat»…« ent»”
patterns.context: 背景技术段落以日本专利文献编号和专利引证说明技术先例。

patterns.name: 特定法律主题术语
patterns.context: 术语出现在各自案件的审查标准或诉因叙述中；与其他段落的共同主题不明显。
patterns.domain: 民事收容裁判及宪法诉讼

patterns.name: 课堂出勤要求
patterns.trigger: “all students must be in residence”“courses must be attended in-person in a formal classroom setting”
patterns.context: 转述学校课程必须住校并线下出勤的规定，随后附记录页码引证。
patterns.domain: 教育规定相关法律材料

en.description: Primarily responds to citation and quotation formats in U.S. opinions, especially Id. at page numbers and parenthetical source notes; also appears in legal disputes, procedural rules, and docket locations, with a small number of activations on layout artifacts.

patterns.name: Pinpoint citations in quoted cases
patterns.context: An opinion cites a preceding case or material, often with a parenthetical quotation, citation note, or paragraph number; activation is concentrated on citation formatting and nearby tokens.

patterns.name: Parenthetical citation sources
patterns.context: After a quotation or paraphrase, parentheses identify emphasis in the original, docket pages, quotation sources, or omitted information; occurs alongside case citation formats.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal citation and quotation conventions

patterns.name: Legal claims and procedural language
patterns.context: Wording about legal disputes, claims, or procedural handling usually occurs in the reasoning of an opinion and may be followed by a citation.
patterns.domain: U.S. litigation opinions, including civil rights, benefits, criminal, and insurance cases

patterns.name: Formal rule or order citations
patterns.context: Legal rules, curricula, or institutional requirements are expressed in formal normative language; not all passages are related to case citation themes.
patterns.domain: Legal rules and formal policy text

patterns.name: Locating the adjudicative record at the end of a citation
patterns.context: Identifies materials reviewed by the court by docket, joint appendix, or record document, often alongside notes such as “emphasis in original”.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and docket citations

patterns.name: Isolated layout and page-number artifacts
patterns.context: Formatting, page numbers, or extraction noise near citations or pagination; no clear independent semantic trigger condition.

3_2896.description: 主要响应美国判决中的引证与引述格式，尤其是 Id. at 页码及括号出处说明；同时见于法律争议、程序规则和案卷定位，少量激活落在版式残片上。

patterns.name: 引述判例的页码引证
patterns.trigger: “Id.” 后接 “at” 和页码，如 “Id. at 472”, “Id. at 639”, “Id. at 136”
patterns.context: 判决书引用前文判例或材料，常伴随括号中的引述、引证说明或段落编号；激活集中在引证格式及其邻近 token。
patterns.domain: 美国法院意见、法律判决

patterns.name: 引证出处括号
patterns.context: 引述或转述后用括号标明原文强调、案卷页码、引述来源或省略信息；与判例引证格式相邻出现。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书的引证与引述规范

patterns.name: 法律主张与程序表述
patterns.trigger: “class action”、“ERISA”、“ineffective assistance of appellate counsel”、“Rule 12(b)(6)”、“prosecutorial misconduct”
patterns.context: 法律争议、诉讼请求或程序处理的表述，通常位于判决理由中，并可能随后附引证。
patterns.domain: 美国诉讼判决，含民权、福利、刑事及保险案件

patterns.name: 正式规则或命令引文
patterns.context: 法律规则、课程或机构要求以正式规范性措辞呈现；并非所有段落都与判例引证主题相连。
patterns.domain: 法律规则及正式政策文本

patterns.name: 引文末尾的裁判记录定位
patterns.context: 以案卷、联合附录或记录文档定位法院审查的材料，常与“emphasis in original”等说明并列。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及案卷引证

patterns.name: 孤立的版式与页码残片
patterns.context: 引文或分页附近出现的排版、页码或抽取噪声；没有清楚的独立语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文本的版面／语料抽取

en.description: All ten passages are U.S. legal documents or citations to them. Activation is concentrated on case and docket citations, especially page numbers following “at” and parenthetical notes such as emphasis, citing, and quoting; it also covers varied legal topics, judicial-analysis language, and document-format artifacts.

patterns.name: Page numbers or citation-location digits in legal quotations
patterns.context: When citing precedent, the record, or reports in legal decisions or litigation documents, page numbers, star pagination, or citation-location information appears after “at,” often followed by parenthetical citation notes.
patterns.domain: Citation formats in legal decisions and litigation documents

patterns.name: Parenthetical citation notes
patterns.context: Parentheticals after citation page numbers mark emphasis, source quotations, docket numbers, or litigation documents; these words and parenthetical structures also activate.

patterns.name: Litigation claims and review terminology
patterns.context: Concerns claims, liability, procedural motions, and court review; not a single substantive area of law.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and litigation documents

patterns.name: Court analysis, opinions, and decision language
patterns.context: The decision recounts the court’s reasoning, analysis, or conclusions, often before or after citing cases.

patterns.name: Formatting fragments and layout in case citations
patterns.context: Abbreviations, case names, report citations, and abbreviated periods in legal citations; activation occurs across different citation locations and does not establish a stable semantic trigger on its own.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal text layout and citations

patterns.name: Campus courses and attendance requirements
patterns.context: Requires students to live on campus and attend formal in-person classes; appears in policy content quoted or paraphrased in a legal document.
patterns.domain: Education policy (quoted in a legal document)

patterns.name: Insurance reserve earnings and eligibility date
patterns.context: Discusses whether policyholders must retain their status on a specific date to share in an insurer’s reserve earnings.

patterns.name: Territorial classification and voting eligibility
patterns.context: Discusses which territories may hold elections for statehood and differences in classification under general law.

patterns.name: Witness evidence and personal opinions
patterns.context: Discusses limits on participants in litigation expressing personal opinions about testimony or evidence.

patterns.name: Procedural fragments and disposition of pleadings
patterns.context: Discusses a court’s sua sponte handling of objections to pleadings and possible waiver when a defendant does not raise an objection promptly.

patterns.name: Paragraph numbering and text noise
patterns.context: Page breaks, paragraph numbers, docket markers, and formatting artifacts; may reflect document layout or tokenization and cause local activation.

3_2896.description: 十段均为美国法律文书或其引文。激活集中在判例/案卷引证，尤其“at”后的页码及括号内的emphasis、citing、quoting等说明；同时涵盖多种法律议题、法院分析措辞和文档格式残片。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的页码或引文定位数字
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉讼文书中，引用先例、案卷或报告时，在“at”后出现页码、星号页码或引文定位信息，常接括号内的引文说明。
patterns.domain: 法律判决与诉讼文书的引证格式

patterns.name: 括号内引文说明
patterns.context: 引证页码之后的括号标记强调、引用来源、案卷编号或诉讼文书；这些词及括号结构也有激活。

patterns.name: 诉讼中的法律主张与审查用语
patterns.trigger: «class action»、«pension benefits diverted»、«ineffective assistance»、«motion to dismiss»、«constitutional violation»、«due process violation»
patterns.context: 围绕诉讼请求、法律责任、程序动议及法院审查展开；并非单一实体法主题。

patterns.name: 法院分析、意见与判决措辞
patterns.trigger: «the court noted that»、«detailed analysis»、«we agree»、«there is nothing unusual»
patterns.context: 判决转述法院的理由、分析或结论，常在引用判例内容前后出现。

patterns.name: 判例引文的格式残片与排版
patterns.context: 法律引证中的缩写、案名、报告引用及句点缩写；激活分布在不同引文位置，不足以单独构成稳定语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文本排版与引证

patterns.name: 校园课程与到校要求
patterns.trigger: «All students»、«must be in residence»、«courses must be attended in-person»
patterns.context: 要求学生住校，并在正式课堂现场上课；出现在法律文书引用或转述的政策内容中。
patterns.domain: 教育政策（被法律文书引用）

patterns.name: 保险准备金收益与资格日期
patterns.context: 讨论保单持有人是否须在特定日期维持身份以分享保险公司准备金收益。
patterns.domain: 保险争议（法律文书中的引文）

patterns.name: 领地分类与选举资格
patterns.context: 讨论哪些领地可举行建制选举，以及适用一般法律下的分类差异。

patterns.name: 证人证据与个人意见
patterns.trigger: «personal belief or opinion»、«truth or falsity»、«testimony or evidence»
patterns.context: 讨论参与诉讼程序者对证言或证据表达个人看法的限制。

patterns.name: 程序片段与诉状处置
patterns.context: 讨论法院主动处理诉状异议，以及被告未及时提出时异议可能被放弃。

patterns.name: 段落编号与文本噪声
patterns.context: 页面换行、段落号、案卷标记及格式残片；可能是文档排版或分词造成的局部激活。

en.concept: U.S. legal decisions and litigation documents
en.description: Activation is concentrated in U.S. legal decisions and litigation documents, especially docket citations, procedural rulings, and evidentiary discussion; it also covers specific facts concerning medical malpractice, criminal appeals, ERISA, territorial classification, school attendance, and sealed complaints.

patterns.name: Case citations and docket page formats
patterns.context: Cites dockets, decision pages, paragraphs, and original-emphasis notes in legal opinions or complaints; citation markers often adjoin numbers, abbreviations, and line breaks.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and litigation documents

patterns.name: Litigation procedure and judicial-decision language
patterns.context: Describes motions to dismiss, amended complaints, appellate review, or procedural claims, often alongside court assessments of litigation conduct.

patterns.name: Legal claims, evidence, and causation
patterns.context: Discusses proof of facts, witness credibility, causation, or constitutional violations and their evidentiary basis.

patterns.name: Attorney misconduct and appellate review
patterns.context: The court evaluates whether appellate counsel’s failure to raise an issue constitutes ineffective assistance and cites the lower court’s analysis.

patterns.name: Legal qualifications and classification under applicable rules
patterns.context: Compares territorial classifications and conditions for voting eligibility under general law.

patterns.name: Educational program attendance requirements
patterns.context: States program rules requiring students to live on campus and attend formal in-person classes.
patterns.domain: Fact findings or citations in education disputes

patterns.name: ERISA pension class actions
patterns.context: Describes class actions brought on behalf of former and current prisoners and allegations that pension benefits were diverted.

patterns.name: Prosecutorial misconduct at criminal trial
patterns.context: Discusses whether a prosecutor expressed a personal opinion about the truth of evidence and the review standard after an objection was not raised promptly.

patterns.name: Medical malpractice and survivability
patterns.context: Discusses whether the decedent could have been saved if a coronary blockage had been diagnosed in time, and the defendant physician’s failure to submit medical evidence rebutting causation.

patterns.name: Administrative programs and sealed complaints
patterns.context: Mentions an administrative program during detention and a request to seal a complaint under the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.

3_2896.concept: 美国法律判决与诉讼文书
3_2896.description: 激活集中于美国法律判决和诉讼文书，尤其案卷引文、程序裁判及证据论述；同时覆盖医疗过失、刑事上诉、ERISA、领地分类、教育出席和封存投诉等具体法律事实。

patterns.name: 案件引文与案卷页码格式
patterns.context: 法律意见书或诉状中引用案卷、判决页码、段落及原文强调说明；引文标记常邻接数字、缩写和换行。

patterns.name: 诉讼程序与法院裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: «motion to dismiss»；«leave to amend»；«post»-trial« motion»；«Rule 12»；«fundamental» error
patterns.context: 叙述驳回动议、修正诉状、上诉审查或程序性主张，常与法院对诉讼行为的判断同现。

patterns.name: 法律主张、证据与因果关系
patterns.context: 讨论事实证明、证言可信度、因果关系或宪法侵害及其证据基础。

patterns.name: 律师失职与上诉审查
patterns.context: 法院评估上诉律师未提出争点是否构成无效协助，并引用下级法官分析。

patterns.name: 法律资格与适用规则的分类
patterns.context: 比较领地分类及其依一般法律享有特定选举资格的条件。

patterns.name: 教育项目的出席规定
patterns.context: 陈述学生须住校、课程须在正式课堂面授的项目规则。
patterns.domain: 教育争议中的事实认定或引文

patterns.name: ERISA养老金集体诉讼
patterns.context: 描述代表过去及现有囚犯提出的集体诉讼及养老金福利被转移的指控。

patterns.name: 刑事审判检察官不当行为
patterns.context: 讨论检察官是否表达对证据真伪的个人意见，以及未及时提出异议后的审查标准。

patterns.name: 医疗过失与可挽救性
patterns.context: 论述若及时诊断冠状动脉阻塞，死者是否仍可挽救，以及被告医生未提交反驳因果关系的医学证据。

patterns.name: 行政项目与封存投诉
patterns.context: 提到羁押期间的行政项目，并依据联邦民事诉讼规则请求封存投诉。

en.description: Primarily activates on citations, volume/page references, and formal litigation narrative in U.S. legal documents, across several areas of law; it also activates at the “Hid” fragment in two nonlegal personal-name passages, while passage 8 contains only legal citations and the trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: Legal citation or volume/page reference format
patterns.context: Abbreviated citations and page/paragraph numbers for court records, complaints, or decisions follow legal analysis; activation often falls near abbreviations, at, or numbers
patterns.domain: U.S. legal decisions and litigation documents

patterns.name: Lists, litigation, and judicial-decision language in legal text
patterns.context: Formal court narrative about claims, legal standards, evidence, or party statements; usually legal passages or quotations

patterns.name: Hidetoshi/Hid... strings in names
patterns.context: Names split into subwords or fragments; appears in an academic author name and a Japanese local political figure’s name

3_2896.concept: 法律文书引注与诉讼语境
3_2896.description: 主要激活于美国法律文书中的引注、卷页定位和正式诉讼叙述，覆盖多类法律议题；另在两个非法律文本的人名片段「Hid」处激活，段8仅见法律引注但触发不明。

patterns.name: 法律引文或卷页定位格式
patterns.context: 法律论述后出现法院记录、诉状或判决的缩写引注及页码/段落号；触发常落在缩写、at 或数字附近
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与诉讼文书

patterns.name: 法律文本中的列举、诉讼与裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: 「online」「all students」「class action」「ERISA」「ineffective assistance」「Rule 12(b)(1)」「constitutional violation」「Appellant」「plaintiffs pleadings」「incorporation elections」
patterns.context: 法院对诉讼请求、法律标准、证据或当事人陈述的正式叙述；多为法律句段或引文

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Hidetoshi/Hid... 字符串
patterns.context: 姓名被拆分为子词或片段；在论文作者名和日本地方政治人物姓名中出现

en.description: Activations occur primarily in U.S. legal documents, especially near opinion citations, page numbers, and parenthetical quotation notes; they also cover party claims, procedural rules, and diverse factual disputes, with no unified specific case theme observed.

patterns.name: Citations and citation formats in litigation documents
patterns.context: When an opinion or legal brief cites a prior decision, record, or docket material, especially near page numbers, paragraph numbers, and parenthetical notes; this pattern covers most passages but does not explain all activation locations.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and litigation documents

patterns.name: Rights, liabilities, or claims in legal contexts
patterns.context: Discusses parties’ claims, procedural handling, liability, or court determinations, usually before or after citation passages; appears alongside citation formatting but is not necessarily triggered by a single vocabulary item.
patterns.domain: U.S. litigation documents involving criminal, civil, and constitutional disputes

patterns.name: Specific legal rules or factual disputes
patterns.context: Separately concerns course instruction requirements, territorial incorporation elections, insurance benefit eligibility, and medical causation; the topics vary and lack a shared specific semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Statements of facts and rules in legal opinions

3_2896.concept: 法律文书引证与诉讼叙述
3_2896.description: 激活主要出现在美国法律文书中，尤其是判决引证、页码及括号内引文说明附近；也覆盖当事人主张、程序规则和多种不同事实争议，未见统一的具体案件主题。

patterns.name: 诉讼文书中的引文及引证格式
patterns.trigger: “at”后的页码、括号内的引文说明（如“(emphasis in original)”“(quoting…)”“(citations omitted)”）以及“Id.”
patterns.context: 判决或法律意见书引用先前判决、记录或案卷材料时，尤其在页码、段落号和括号说明附近；该模式覆盖多数段落，但不能解释全部激活位置。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、诉讼文件

patterns.name: 法律诉讼语境中的权利、责任或主张
patterns.context: 讨论当事人的诉讼主张、程序处理、责任或法院判断，通常出现在引证段落前后；与引证格式同时出现，但未必是单一词汇触发。
patterns.domain: 美国诉讼文书，涉及刑事、民事及宪法争议

patterns.name: 特定法律规则或事实争议
patterns.trigger: “all students must be in residence”“incorporation elections”“policyholder”“coronary artery”
patterns.context: 分别涉及课程授课要求、领地建制选举、保险收益资格和医疗因果关系；主题各异，缺少共同的具体语义触发。
patterns.domain: 法律意见书中的事实与规则陈述

en.concept: Citations and paraphrase in legal documents
en.description: All passages are U.S. legal opinions or related litigation materials. Activation often falls on citations, docket references, quoted or paraphrased material, and legal-issue terms; additional local patterns include original-emphasis notes, motions, testimony, and formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Citations in judicial documents
patterns.context: Quoting or summarizing court opinions, complaints, records, and attorney statements, with common citation formats such as “Id. at 472,” “Compl. ¶ 15,” and “Rec. doc. 15 at 27-35”
patterns.domain: U.S. legal decisions and litigation documents

patterns.name: Original-emphasis marker
patterns.context: A decision or citation states that emphasis is in the original; the phrase is often followed by a citation

patterns.name: Motions to dismiss/pleadings
patterns.context: Discusses dismissing litigation or pleadings, or whether amendment of a complaint would be futile

patterns.name: Legal issues and judicial reasoning
patterns.context: States legal claims, causes of action, or the court’s analysis and conclusions on issues
patterns.domain: Federal and state court decisions, including constitutional, ERISA, and criminal appeals

patterns.name: Testimony and factual evidence
patterns.context: Quotes witness testimony or describes medical causation, evidence, and relationships between parties
patterns.domain: Judicial fact-finding, testimony, or appellate arguments

patterns.name: Quotation and paraphrase of record materials
patterns.context: Reports the views of a court, a party, or a witness, often with a citation locating the source material
