patterns.name: Text boundaries and citation-format fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic activation at citation, paragraph, or line-break boundaries; no independent semantic trigger has been confirmed
patterns.domain: Legal document layout and corpus segmentation

3_2896.concept: 法律文书中的引证与转述
3_2896.description: 所有片段均为美国法律意见或相关诉讼材料，激活多落在引证、案卷定位、引述转述及法律争点词；另有强调原文、动议、证词和格式边界等局部模式。

patterns.name: 法律裁判文书引证
patterns.context: 引述或概述法院意见、诉状、案卷和律师陈述，常见引证格式如“Id. at 472”“Compl. ¶ 15”“Rec. doc. 15 at 27-35”
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、诉讼文书

patterns.name: 强调原文标记
patterns.context: 判决或引文指出强调为原文所有；该短语周围常跟引证

patterns.name: 驳回/诉状动议
patterns.context: 讨论驳回诉讼或诉状、修订诉状是否徒劳等程序问题

patterns.name: 法律争点与裁判理由
patterns.context: 陈述法律主张、诉讼请求或法院对争点的分析与结论
patterns.domain: 联邦及州法院判决，涵盖宪法、ERISA及刑事上诉

patterns.name: 证言及事实证据
patterns.context: 引用证人证言或描述医疗因果关系、证据与当事人关系
patterns.domain: 司法事实认定、证词或上诉陈述

patterns.name: 案卷材料的引述与转述
patterns.context: 报告法院、当事方或证人的观点，常由引证定位原始材料
patterns.domain: 法律意见书的叙述性转述

patterns.name: 文本边界及引文格式碎片
patterns.context: 引证、段落或换行边界处出现零散激活；未见可独立确认的语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 法律文书排版与语料切分

en.description: Primarily responds to citation locator formats in U.S. legal documents (especially at, Id., document abbreviations, page numbers, and paragraph numbers), alongside litigation terminology; also activates on a place name in an author address in a paper. The citation format is present in the second passage, but the specific trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: Citation and source locators
patterns.context: The neuron often activates near punctuation marking the end of a legal citation or locating its source, citation page/paragraph numbers, and document abbreviations; especially in formats such as “Id. at …” and “(emphasis in original)”.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, pleadings, and legal opinions

patterns.name: Statutory and procedural terms in legal documents
patterns.context: Statutes, legal principles, party roles, and procedural terminology appear in litigation arguments, procedural review, or claims of rights; activation often occurs alongside nearby citation formats.

patterns.name: at in case citations
patterns.context: In a legal citation, appears after the case or document number and before the page number as a page locator.

patterns.name: Author affiliation address format
patterns.context: Institutional addresses list city, district, postal code, and country, followed by author/title metadata; differs from the other legal passages.

3_2896.description: 主要响应美国法律文书的引文定位格式（尤其 at、Id.、文书缩写、页码及段号），并伴随诉讼术语；另对一段论文作者地址中的地名激活。第2段有引文格式但具体触发不明。

patterns.name: 引文及出处定位
patterns.context: 神经元常在法律文书中引文结束或定位引文出处的标点、引文页码/段号及文档缩写附近激活；尤见“Id. at …”“(emphasis in original)”等引用格式。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、诉状及法律意见书

patterns.name: 法律文书中的法条与程序用语
patterns.context: 诉讼论证、程序审查或权利主张中出现法条、法律原则、当事人身份和程序术语；激活往往与邻近的引文格式同时出现。

patterns.name: 判例引证中的 at
patterns.context: 法律引文中位于判例或文书编号之后、页码之前，作为页码定位标记。

patterns.name: 作者单位地址格式
patterns.context: 机构地址按城市、区、邮编、国家排列，后接 author/title 元数据；与其余法律段落不同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据/作者地址

en.description: Words ending in “ations” appear in all ten segments, with activation on the suffix; word meanings and domains vary, while the suffix pattern remains consistent.

patterns.name: -ations suffix
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on words ending in -ations; meanings and sentence positions vary, including both body text and headings.
patterns.domain: Across medical papers, biographies, project texts, and railway entries

3_3047.description: 十段均出现以 “ations” 结尾的词，激活落在该词尾；相关词义与领域多样，词尾模式一致。

patterns.name: -ations 词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 -ations 结尾的词中；词义和句子位置不一，既有正文词，也有标题。
patterns.domain: 跨医学论文、传记、项目文本和铁路条目

en.description: All segments activate on the suffix «ations» in plural nouns ending in -ation, across varied stems and styles. The activation appears to respond to a shared subword suffix rather than a unified meaning or topic.

patterns.name: Plural noun suffix ations
patterns.context: The token acts as a suffix attached to different stems to form plural nouns ending in -ation; the specific topics vary across segments.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: biomedical abstracts, research project text, medical papers, encyclopedia biographies, and railway entries

3_3047.description: 所有段都在以 -ation 结尾的复数名词中激活词尾 «ations»，词干和文体多样；激活更像响应共同的子词后缀，而非统一语义或主题。

patterns.name: 复数名词后缀 ations
patterns.context: 该 token 作为词尾后缀，接在不同词干后构成以 -ation 结尾的复数名词；各段具体主题并不相同
patterns.domain: 跨领域：生物医学摘要、科研项目文本、医学论文、百科传记与铁路条目

en.description: High activation across segments falls on the letter substring “ations”. It occurs in different words, including elevations, mutations, degenerations, legations, pigmentations, Expectations, septations, and Operations, with varied domains and meanings.

patterns.name: -ations suffix
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in words containing or adjacent to the English letter sequence -ations; sometimes it is a suffix, and sometimes it occurs within a proper name, title, or compound word.
patterns.domain: Across medical abstracts, literature text, historical biographies, and railway entries

3_3047.description: 各段的高激活都落在“ations”这一字母子串上；它出现在 elevations、mutations、degenerations、legations、pigmentations、Expectations、septations、Operations 等不同词中，领域和语义不一。

patterns.name: -ations 词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中在包含或接近英文 -ations 字母串的词中；有时该子串是词尾，有时处于专名、标题或复合词中。
patterns.domain: 跨医学摘要、文献正文、历史人物传记及铁路条目

en.description: Most segments show activation on the “ation(s)” suffix of different words, including biomedical terms and a few general nouns; there is also localized activation on the section marker Sec1 and within citation identifiers.

patterns.name: Suffix in medical or biological terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on the “ation(s)” fragment at the end of English nouns or word forms; stems and specific meanings vary widely, and several examples occur at word boundaries or in tokenized subwords.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, research proposals, ecology papers, historical narratives

patterns.name: Structured section marker
patterns.context: Appears in the formatted section heading “Key question {#Sec1}”.

patterns.name: Sec substring in citation identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in reference markers, with activation on a citation character fragment; differs from the body-text suffix pattern.

patterns.name: Numeric section field
patterns.context: Adjacent to the section number in “{#Sec1}”, possibly part of a structured heading marker.

3_3047.description: 多数段落在不同词语的“ation(s)”词尾激活，涵盖生物医学名词及少数一般名词；另有章节标记 Sec1 和引用标识中的局部激活。

patterns.name: 医学或生物学术语中的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在英语名词或词形末尾的“ation(s)”片段；词干和具体词义差异很大，多个例子位于分词边界或 token 化子词中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研计划、生态学论文、历史叙述

patterns.name: 结构化章节标记
patterns.context: 出现在“Key question {#Sec1}”这一格式化章节标题中。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的结构化文档

patterns.name: 引用标识中的 Sec 子串
patterns.context: 出现在参考文献标记中，激活落在引用字符片段；与正文词尾模式不同。

patterns.name: 数字章节字段
patterns.context: 与“{#Sec1}”的章节编号相邻，可能是结构化标题标记的一部分。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的结构化文档

en.description: All snippets share the PMC article opening structure of Introduction/Key question: a section marker, Sec 101 numbering, and a separator precede the introduction text. Activation also falls on various first words in the body, which have no shared meaning.

patterns.name: Structured section markers
patterns.context: Introduction section format at the start of a PubMed Central article; the first segment is «Key»« question», and subsequent segments begin with Introduction.
patterns.domain: Structured text/section-heading markers in PMC papers

patterns.name: Opening words of section body text
patterns.context: After the section heading and separator, at the start of the paper's introduction body; activation falls on the first word or its subword fragment, with different vocabulary in each case.
patterns.domain: Introductions to medical and other academic papers

3_3047.description: 所有片段共享PMC文章开头的Introduction/Key question结构：章节标记、Sec 101编号和分隔线后接引言正文；激活也落在多种正文首词上，词义无共同点。

patterns.name: 结构化章节标记
patterns.context: PubMed Central 文章开头的 Introduction 章节格式；第1段为 «Key»« question»，后续段以 Introduction 开始。
patterns.domain: PMC 论文的结构化文本/章节标题标记

patterns.name: 章节正文起始词
patterns.trigger: 各段分隔线后紧接的词或词片段，如 «Does hyp»، «New»« tools»، «The»« knowledge»، «Di»abetic、«A»«min»، C«ushing»
patterns.context: 标记章节标题和分隔符之后，论文引言正文开始处；触发落在正文开头的首词或其子词片段，具体词汇各异。
patterns.domain: 医学及其他学术论文引言

en.description: Primarily responds to the verb determines and its contexts: a factor determines a property, state, function, or outcome across patents, research, and mathematical texts; there is also one response to the suffix in pigmentations in a medical description.

patterns.name: Causal or determinative use of determines
patterns.context: A subject, equation, or design is described as determining performance, state, function, feasibility, or a mapping; the target word is the predicate head and is often followed by an object.
patterns.domain: Patents, research papers, technical descriptions, and mathematical texts

patterns.name: pigmentations in an anatomical description
patterns.context: Adjacent to “Homogeneous, brownish, regular bandlike”, describing bandlike pigmentation and its border; activation falls on the plural suffix.

3_3047.description: 主要响应动词 determines 及其语境：某因素决定某种性质、状态、功能或结果，跨专利、科研和数学文本；另有一次响应医学描述中的 pigmentations 词尾。

patterns.name: determines 的因果/判定用法
patterns.context: 句中主语或方程、设计等被描述为决定性能、状态、功能、可行性或映射；目标词是谓语核心，常接宾语
patterns.domain: 专利、科研论文、技术说明及数学文本

patterns.name: 解剖描述中的 pigmentations
patterns.context: 紧邻“Homogeneous, brownish, regular bandlike”，描述带状色素及边界；激活落在复数词尾

en.description: Responds to the structured boundary format following section headings in PMC articles: a section marker, line break, and equals-sign divider appear after the heading. Heading and subsequent body topics vary, suggesting they are not the primary trigger.

patterns.name: PMC section metadata and divider
patterns.context: Appears after a section heading and before the start of the body text in a structured section marker; most snippets have the heading “Introduction”, with one “Key question”. The words at the start of the body vary and do not appear to be primary triggers.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central papers and their structured text format

3_3047.description: 对PMC文章章节标题后的结构化边界格式反应：标题后出现章节标记、换行和等号分隔线。标题及随后正文主题多样，似非主要触发因素。

patterns.name: PMC章节元数据与分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在章节标题之后、正文开头之前的结构化章节标记；多数片段标题为“Introduction”，另有“Key question”。正文开头的词语各异且未显示为主要触发项。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central论文及其结构化文本格式

en.description: Activation is scattered across common sentence-initial words, existential constructions and perfect/passive structures, copular statements, and a few word fragments, numbers, and line breaks; it spans domains, with no consistent trigger word or semantics.

patterns.name: Common words at the start of a sentence or clause
patterns.context: Located at the start of a sentence or new clause, followed by a full statement or question; trigger words vary.
patterns.domain: Patents, emails, research abstracts, and other body text

patterns.name: there followed by predicates such as are/has
patterns.context: there introduces an existential construction, with activation on there and the adjacent predicate.

patterns.name: Perfect or passive structures with be + been
patterns.context: Uses be/have-series words in the sentence to form perfect, passive, or related predicate structures.

patterns.name: “Den” word-form fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the name Karen Denne or in Denied in a legal document; the local word form is shared but the meanings differ.

patterns.name: Common copulas and following constituents in body text
patterns.context: States the subject’s condition, definition, or research topic; there is no consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Line breaks near sentence endings
patterns.context: Activation appears at line breaks in list items or court-ruling entries.

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments and numbers
patterns.context: Occurs respectively in a server name, spam-content keywords, a grant identifier, and a population figure, with no shared contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Forums, low-quality web content, research abstracts

3_3047.description: 激活分散在句首常见词、存在句与完成/被动结构、系词陈述及少数词片段、数字和换行处；跨领域且触发词与语义不统一。

patterns.name: 句首或分句开头的常见词
patterns.context: 位于句首或新分句开头，后接完整陈述或提问；触发词种类并不一致
patterns.domain: 专利、邮件、科研摘要及其他正文

patterns.name: there 后接 are/has 等谓语
patterns.context: there 引导存在句，激活落在 there 及相邻谓语

patterns.name: be + been 的完成或被动结构
patterns.context: 句中使用 be/have 系列词构成完成、被动或相关谓语结构
patterns.domain: 专利、商务邮件、科研摘要

patterns.name: “Den”词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Karen Denne 中，或法律文书的 Denied 中；局部词形相同但词义不同
patterns.domain: 企业公关邮件、法院判决

patterns.name: 正文中的常见系词及其后续成分
patterns.context: 陈述主体的状态、定义或研究对象；没有一致的语义主题

patterns.name: 句末附近的换行符
patterns.context: 列表条目或判决书条目换行处出现激活

patterns.name: 零散词片段及数字
patterns.context: 分别位于服务器名称、垃圾内容关键词、资助编号和人口数字中，缺少共同上下文条件
patterns.domain: 论坛、低质量网页内容、科研摘要

en.concept: Structured relations and symbols in diverse text
en.description: Primarily responds to algebraic simplification expressions containing variable powers, fractional exponents, and nested parentheses; other triggers include a course-enrollment notice, video sampling terminology, a legal investigation duty, and a software test-coverage statement, with unrelated topics.

patterns.name: Variables and exponents in nested algebraic expressions
patterns.context: In mathematical simplification problems, variable letters recur with powers, fractional exponents, or positive-value assumptions; also includes algebraic expression snippets without an explicit Simplify.

patterns.name: “enrolled in class” collocation
patterns.context: A user-facing course enrollment or course information notice.

patterns.name: Video scan conversion and sampling-rate terminology
patterns.context: Discusses video signal conversion and sampling issues.

patterns.name: Statutory investigation duty and Native American child status
patterns.context: Explains how particular circumstances trigger a statutory investigation duty and cites Iowa law.

patterns.name: Test coverage status and relations
patterns.context: Describes usage relations between software components and the coverage status shown in a test coverage report.

3_3047.concept: 多样文本中的结构化关系与符号
3_3047.description: 主要响应含变量幂、分数指数和嵌套括号的代数化简表达式；其余触发分别是课程报名通知、视频采样术语、法律调查义务及软件测试覆盖语句，主题各异。

patterns.name: 嵌套代数式中的变量与指数
patterns.trigger: “m**”, “g**”, “Simplify”, “assuming … is positive”；大量括号、分数和负指数
patterns.context: 数学化简题中，变量字母反复出现并带有幂、分数指数或正值假设；也包括未显式出现 Simplify 的代数式片段。

patterns.name: enrolled in class 搭配
patterns.trigger: “You are enrolled in the following class”
patterns.context: 面向用户的课程报名或课程信息通知。

patterns.name: 视频扫描转换与采样率术语
patterns.context: 讨论视频信号转换及采样问题。

patterns.name: 法定调查义务及印第安儿童身份
patterns.trigger: “duty of inquiry”, “potential Indian child’s status”, “Iowa Code section 232B.15”
patterns.context: 说明特定情形如何触发法定调查义务，并引用爱荷华州法条。

patterns.name: 测试覆盖状态与关联
patterns.context: 描述软件组件之间的使用关系，以及测试覆盖报告显示的覆盖状态。

en.concept: Word-form triggers for presented and Cook
en.description: High activation most consistently falls on presented across paper, legal, patent, and news contexts; it also responds to Cook (including cooking and names) and a few line-break/paragraph markers, with one high activation on print.

patterns.name: presented
patterns.context: In passive constructions or other sentence forms, presented is followed by complements such as in terms of, with, or herein; sometimes a name or subject is adjacent to presented.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including papers, legal texts, patents, and news

patterns.name: Cook
patterns.context: Cook appears as a cooking verb/noun or as a name; activation falls on the Cook substring, including cases where the word form is split into Cook + ing.

patterns.name: Formatting and structural markers
patterns.context: Near line breaks, paragraph symbols, or numbering in documents; may relate to the structured formatting of legal texts.

patterns.name: Other sporadic triggers
patterns.context: Expressions such as print out instructions in operational guidance; this high activation does not clearly share terms with the others.

3_3047.concept: presented 与 Cook 的词形触发
3_3047.description: 高激活最稳定地落在 presented，跨论文、法律、专利、新闻语境；另对 Cook（含 cooking、人名）和少数换行/段落标记有反应，print 也有一次高激活。

patterns.name: presented
patterns.context: 在被动结构或句式中，presented 后接 in terms of、with、herein 等补语；有时是姓名或主语紧邻 presented。
patterns.domain: 论文、法律、专利及新闻等多种文体

patterns.name: Cook
patterns.context: Cook 作为烹饪动词/名词或人名出现；激活落在 Cook 子串，包含词形被分成 Cook + ing 的情形。
patterns.domain: 生活指南、哲学、科技新闻

patterns.name: 排版及结构标记
patterns.context: 文档中的换行、段落符号或编号附近；可能与法律文本的结构化排版有关。

patterns.name: 其他零散触发
patterns.context: 操作指引中，print out instructions 一类表达；该高激活不与其余明显共享词项。

en.description: Primarily responds to mathematical expressions with multiplication asterisks and exponentiation, commonly found in math problems; some problems also ask about common factors or multiples. There are also three code contexts: a macro identifier, a Finish-key comment, and Node/children interface documentation, with no unified surface trigger.

patterns.name: Asterisks, exponents, and algebraic operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Formulas or expressions contain multiplication asterisks, exponent symbols, variables, and numbers; no specific variable or operation order is required.

patterns.name: Common-factor/multiple phrasing in math problems
patterns.context: In questions asking for common multiples, common factors, greatest common factors, and so on, of numbers or expressions.

patterns.name: Underscore identifiers in C/C++-style macros
patterns.context: A macro definition uses an identifier with an uppercase prefix and underscore separators, combined with parentheses and comparison operators.

patterns.name: Finish key and naming in code comments
patterns.context: A documentation comment explains key functionality, followed by a string constant declaration or description of a UI display.

patterns.name: Node/children interface description in Java documentation comments
patterns.context: HTML-style documentation comments describe an interface method and note that certain nodes may not have children.

3_3047.description: 主要响应含星号乘法、幂运算的数学表达式，常见于数学题；部分数学题同时询问公因数或公倍数。另有三段代码语境：宏标识符、Finish 按键注释、Node/children 接口文档，未见统一的表面触发形式。

patterns.name: 数学式中的星号、幂与代数运算符
patterns.context: 公式或表达式中出现乘法星号、幂符号、变量及数字；不要求特定变量或运算顺序

patterns.name: 数学题里的公因数/倍数措辞
patterns.context: 在询问数或表达式的公倍数、公因数、最大公因数等问题时

patterns.name: C/C++ 风格宏中的下划线标识符
patterns.context: 宏定义里使用大写前缀、下划线分隔的标识符，并与括号、比较运算符组合

patterns.name: 代码注释中的 Finish key 与命名
patterns.context: 文档注释解释按键功能，并紧接着声明字符串常量或描述界面显示

patterns.name: Java 文档注释中的 Node/children 接口说明
patterns.context: HTML 风格文档注释说明接口方法及特定节点可能不具备 children

en.description: Activation is scattered across several text types: Op in legal citations, underscores in code identifiers and slashes in paths, source-code line breaks and comment boundaries, and a few natural-language word fragments. The shared trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: Op-initial words and case citations
patterns.context: Op appears in New York case citations such as “NY Slip Op 07792/00754”; it also appears in the ordinary word “Opens”, tokenized as Op and ens.

patterns.name: Underscore identifiers in code
patterns.context: In code or configuration, underscores separate parts of identifiers and are often adjacent to filenames, paths, or uppercase constants.

patterns.name: Path separators and directory paths
patterns.context: Slashes occur in source-file or include paths, serving as directory-level separators.

patterns.name: Code comments, line breaks, and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: At code documentation or source-formatting boundaries; activation is concentrated around line breaks and comment markers rather than a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Word fragments and punctuation in ordinary text
patterns.context: Word fragments occur in continuous natural-language prose or titles, without an obvious code-path or legal-citation context.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC natural language and webpage titles

patterns.name: Legal case citation format
patterns.context: In New York case-page headers, the case name, year, Slip Op number, and decision date appear together; strong activation falls mainly on Op and some citation tokens.

3_3047.description: 激活分散于多类文本：法律引注中的 Op、代码标识符下划线与路径斜杠、源码换行和注释边界，以及少数自然语言词片段。共同触发条件不明确。

patterns.name: Op 开头的词及判例引注
patterns.context: Op 出现在纽约州判例引注“NY Slip Op 07792/00754”中；也出现在普通词“Opens”里，词被切分为 Op 与 ens

patterns.name: 代码中的下划线标识符
patterns.trigger: «_»9、«_»7、«_»6，以及下划线分隔的标识符片段，如 PREFER_F、key_file、memory/ref_counted_memory
patterns.context: 代码或配置中，下划线作为标识符内部的分隔符，常邻接文件名、路径或大写常量

patterns.name: 路径分隔符与目录路径
patterns.context: 斜杠位于代码文件路径或 include 路径中，作为目录层级分隔符

patterns.name: 代码注释、换行与格式边界
patterns.context: 代码文档注释或源码排版边界处；激活集中在换行、注释标记附近，而非单一语义主题

patterns.name: 普通文本中的词语片段与标点
patterns.context: 连续自然语言叙述或标题中出现词语片段，周围没有明显代码路径或法律引注条件
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 自然语言及网页标题

patterns.name: 法律判例引注格式
patterns.context: 纽约州判例页眉中，案件名、年份、Slip Op 编号及裁决日期相邻；强激活主要落在 Op 与部分引注 token 上

en.description: The most consistent cue is “spouse” and its family-relationship context; there are also expressions related to residence and household size, as well as sporadic activation on code configuration identifiers. Other trigger words lack a consistent context.

patterns.name: Spouse (legal or family relationship)
patterns.context: A spouse appears as a person in relationships involving insurance, property, litigation, a teaching partner, or a caller; the word repeatedly triggers in different syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: Legal, insurance, family, and charitable education texts

patterns.name: Residence or cohabitation
patterns.context: Describes where a person lives, a move, household members living together, or household size.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, population statistics, narrative text

patterns.name: UI or configuration identifiers in code
patterns.context: Appears in XML project configuration or code comments, involving project keywords, help keys, and display functions.

patterns.name: Sporadic English function words and general narrative words
patterns.context: These words occur in varied contexts and show no stable, independent shared semantic condition; they may reflect local context or incidental co-activation.
patterns.domain: Legal discussion, telephone service descriptions, general narrative

3_3047.description: 最稳定的线索是“spouse”及其家庭关系语境；另有居住、家庭人数相关表达，以及代码配置标识处的零散激活。其余触发词缺少一致语境。

patterns.name: 配偶（法律或家庭关系）
patterns.context: 配偶作为保险、财产、诉讼、授课搭档或来电者等关系中的人物出现；该词在多个不同句法位置重复触发。
patterns.domain: 法律、保险、家庭与公益教育文本

patterns.name: 生活地点或共同居住
patterns.context: 描述人物居住地点、迁居、家庭成员同住，或统计家庭人数。
patterns.domain: 百科人物简介、人口统计、叙事文本

patterns.name: 代码中的界面或配置标识
patterns.context: 出现在 XML 项目配置或代码注释中，涉及项目关键字、帮助键及显示功能。

patterns.name: 零散的英语功能词和一般叙事词
patterns.context: 这些词所在语境各异，未呈现稳定、独立的共同语义条件；可能是局部上下文或偶然共激活。
patterns.domain: 法律论述、电话服务说明、一般叙事

en.description: Primarily responds to living alone in demographic contexts and household composition; it also appears in accounts of cohabitation, couples' residences, and family housing questions. The common thread is residence and family relationships.

patterns.name: People living alone in census household statistics
patterns.context: Household and residence statistics describing people living alone and their ages; often listed alongside nonfamily and one-person household percentages.

patterns.name: Residence/cohabitation relationships
patterns.context: Describes someone who once lived with another person and their family; the same passage also includes “at Young's house”.

patterns.name: Partners and shared residence
patterns.context: A biographical entry states a person's marital status and place of residence.

patterns.name: Family members asking about residential comfort
patterns.context: Asks whether a place would be suitable for a spouse and children to live in, considering commuting and housing costs.

3_3047.description: 主要响应人口统计中“独居”及住户构成语境里的 living alone；也出现在叙述同住、夫妻居住和家庭择居问题中。共同线索是居住与家庭关系。

patterns.name: 人口普查家庭统计中的独居者
patterns.trigger: “someone living alone who was 65 years of age or”
patterns.context: 家庭与住户统计段落中，描述独居者及其年龄；常与非家庭、个人住户比例并列。

patterns.name: 居住/共同生活关系
patterns.context: 叙述某人曾与他人及其家人同住；同段还出现“at Young's house”。

patterns.name: 人物伴侣与共同居住
patterns.trigger: “are married and live in Pacific Grove”
patterns.context: 人物简介中说明婚姻关系及居住地。

patterns.name: 家庭成员询问居住舒适度
patterns.trigger: “my wife and kids … feel comfortable living”
patterns.context: 询问某地是否适合配偶和孩子居住，且考虑通勤与房价。

en.description: Strong activation centers on three local forms: living in a population-statistics sentence (age description of people living alone), Op in case citations, and the beginning of Opens in a code comment. Their contexts differ; the main commonality is local string overlap.

patterns.name: living in residence statistics
patterns.context: In population or household statistics, describes the age of people living alone; a common structure is “had someone living alone who was 65 years of age or …”

patterns.name: Op in case names and legal citations
patterns.context: Standard case-name or citation formats in New York decisions, such as “NY Slip Op 089…”, often accompanied by line breaks and repeated headings.

patterns.name: Op in help-key descriptions
patterns.context: A code comment explains that the Help key opens or toggles a display; the trigger here is the beginning of an ordinary word, matching the spelling of Op in case citations.

3_3047.description: 强激活集中在三类局部形式：人口统计句中的 living（独居年龄描述）、判例引注中的 Op，以及代码注释单词 Opens 的开头。各自上下文不同，主要共同点是局部字符串重合。

patterns.name: 居住统计中的 living
patterns.context: 人口或家庭统计句中，描述独居者的年龄；常见结构为“had someone living alone who was 65 years of age or …”
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 英文人口普查／地方概况统计

patterns.name: 法律案名与判例引注中的 Op
patterns.trigger: « Op»10，出现在 «Slip» 后、年份及案号附近
patterns.context: 纽约州判例的标准案名或引注格式，如“NY Slip Op 089…”，常伴随换行和重复标题

patterns.name: 帮助键说明中的 Op
patterns.context: 代码注释说明 Help 键会打开或切换某种显示；这里触发的是普通单词开头，与判例引注中的 Op 拼写相同

en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of householders, household composition, and living alone in demographic statistics, especially living alone. It also appears in family-residence contexts, legal case formats, and remainder problems that do not fit one specific pattern.

patterns.name: Descriptions of living alone in demographic statistics
patterns.context: In a census or community statistics sentence, describes someone living alone; often followed by “who was 65 years of age or…”.

patterns.name: Householders and household composition in demographic statistics
patterns.context: Percentage statistics covering female or male householders, spouse absent, nonfamily households, and one-person households; often appears in the same paragraph as living-alone statistics.

patterns.name: Legal case citation format
patterns.context: Case titles and New York case citation format, accompanied by line breaks and decision dates.

patterns.name: Family suitability and individual residence
patterns.context: When asking about places to live in the Bay Area, states that a spouse and children want a comfortable life.

patterns.name: Remainder calculation problems
patterns.context: Consecutive division-with-remainder practice problems.

3_3047.description: 主要响应人口统计中关于户主、家庭构成及独居情况的表述，尤其是 living alone；另见家庭居住语境、法律判例格式和余数题，无法归入同一具体模式。

patterns.name: 人口统计中独居描述
patterns.context: 人口普查或社区统计句中，描述某人独自居住；常接“who was 65 years of age or…”。

patterns.name: 人口统计中户主与家庭构成
patterns.context: 百分比统计句，涉及女性或男性户主、配偶不在场、非家庭及由个人组成的家庭；与独居统计常在同一段落出现。

patterns.name: 法律判例引文格式
patterns.context: 判例标题与纽约州判例引用格式，伴随换行及裁决日期。

patterns.name: 家庭宜居性与个人居住
patterns.context: 询问湾区居住地点时，说明配偶和孩子希望舒适生活。

patterns.name: 余数计算题
patterns.context: 连续列出的除法余数练习题。

en.concept: word forms such as living / householder
en.description: Primarily responds to living (especially living alone) and householder in demographic text; also responds to household-composition statistical templates. Op appears in two case citations, showing a distinct legal-format pattern.

patterns.name: living in demographic sentences
patterns.context: When describing people living alone and their ages, “living” is the strongest activating token; nearby terms often include someone, alone, and age qualifiers for older adults.

patterns.name: householder in demographic sentences
patterns.context: Appears in household-composition statistics, often alongside female, no husband present, or male, no wife present.

patterns.name: Op in demographic sentences
patterns.context: In New York State court citations, a case number follows Op; this legal citation format differs from demographic sentences.

patterns.name: Template vocabulary in demographic paragraphs
patterns.context: Recurring in demographic descriptions of household composition; these words occur in the same paragraph as living and householder, but are not the highest-response tokens.

3_3047.description: 主要响应人口统计文本中的 living（尤指 living alone）和 householder；也响应家庭组成统计模板。另有两个判例引注中的 Op，呈现独立的法律格式模式。

patterns.name: 人口统计句中的 living
patterns.trigger: “living”及其后接“alone”“who was 65 years of age or”
patterns.context: 描述独居者及其年龄时，“living”是最强激活 token；周围常见 someone、alone 和老年年龄限定。

patterns.name: 人口统计句中的 householder
patterns.context: 出现在家庭构成统计中，常与 female、no husband present 或 male、no wife present 连用。

patterns.name: 人口统计句中的 Op
patterns.context: 纽约州法院判例引注里，Op 后接案号；该法律引注格式与人口统计句不同。

patterns.name: 人口统计段落的模板性词汇
patterns.trigger: “households”“non-families”“made up of individuals”及百分比数字
patterns.context: 反复出现于人口统计的家庭组成描述中；这些词与 living、householder 同处一段，但并非最高响应 token。

en.concept: ainer suffix and living-alone statistics context
en.description: The strongest shared signal is the suffix fragment “ainer”, which occurs in retainer. Another group consists of highly similar demographic sentences, especially those highlighting living alone and householders and household-percentage terms.

patterns.name: Census household statistics sentence structure
patterns.context: In population or community profiles, lists household types, householder gender, the percentage without a spouse present, and the percentage living alone; the numbers vary across segments, but the sentence structure is highly similar.

patterns.name: Retainer in dental restoration
patterns.context: In an account of dental restoration, retainer is tokenized as a marked fragment and refers to the retaining component of a fixed dental restoration.

patterns.name: Retainer in a device dock
patterns.context: Describes a dock securing a device with a retainer; again, the marked fragment is the ending of the English word retainer, but the context is not demographic statistics.

3_3047.description: 最强共同信号是词尾片段“ainer”，出现在 retainer 中；另有一组高度相似的人口统计句，尤其突出 living alone，并伴随户主及家庭比例词汇。

patterns.name: 人口普查家庭统计句式
patterns.trigger: «living»10 alone；同一统计句中还反复出现“householder”“non-families”“all households”“individuals”
patterns.context: 人口或社区概况中，列举家庭类型、户主性别、无配偶在场比例，以及独居者比例；不同段落数字变化，但句式高度相似。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人口普查/社区统计条目

patterns.name: 牙科修复中的 retainer
patterns.context: 在牙科修复叙述中，retainer 被拆分标记，指固定牙科修复体的固位部件。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景技术；牙科

patterns.name: 设备坞站中的 retainer
patterns.context: 描述坞站通过 retainer 固定其中设备；同样是英语单词 retainer 的词尾部分被标记，但不是人口统计语境。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景技术；设备/机械

en.concept: household composition and ages of people living alone in demographic statistics
en.description: Primarily responds to census household-composition statistics, especially people aged 65 and older living alone, and also to householder gender, spouse presence or absence, and nonfamily percentages; outlier patterns include legal conviction contexts and lists of game-character skins.

patterns.name: age groups living alone in demographic statements
patterns.context: At the end of statistical sentences describing household composition, reporting the number or percentage of people living alone who meet a specified age threshold; living in this phrase activates most strongly.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia city or regional census statistics

patterns.name: female householder with no husband present
patterns.context: A parallel clause listing household types in demographic statistics; the category of female householder with no husband present.

patterns.name: statistics on nonfamily households and individuals
patterns.context: Listed alongside householder categories, giving household-composition percentages for nonfamilies and one-person households.

patterns.name: male householder with no wife present
patterns.context: The male-householder category corresponding to the female-householder category in household-composition statistics.

patterns.name: conviction and applicability in legal rulings
patterns.context: Discusses whether an enhanced-penalty statute applies to a conviction and cites cases related to murder or shootings.

patterns.name: game characters and skin counts
patterns.context: Bullet lists of the number of skins owned by game characters and their names.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC game wiki or fan description

3_3047.concept: 人口统计中的家庭构成与独居年龄
3_3047.description: 主要响应人口普查家庭构成统计，尤其是独居者中65岁以上者，并兼及户主性别、配偶在场与否及非家庭比例；另有法律定罪语境和游戏角色皮肤列表两类离群模式。

patterns.name: 人口统计表述中的独居年龄组
patterns.trigger: «someone» living «alone» who was «65» years of age or
patterns.context: 位于描述家庭构成的统计句末，报告独居者中达到特定年龄的人数或比例；该短语中的 living 激活最强。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 城市或地区的人口普查统计

patterns.name: 女性户主且无丈夫在场
patterns.context: 人口统计中列举家庭类型的并列分句；女性户主与丈夫不在场这一类别。

patterns.name: 非家庭及个人组成的家庭统计
patterns.context: 与户主类别并列，给出非家庭、个人住户等家庭构成比例。

patterns.name: 男性户主且无妻子在场
patterns.context: 家庭构成统计中与女性户主类别相对应的男性户主类别。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的定罪与适用性
patterns.context: 讨论增强刑罚法规是否适用于某项定罪，并援引杀人或枪击相关判例。

patterns.name: 游戏角色与皮肤数量
patterns.context: 以项目符号列举游戏角色拥有的皮肤数量及角色名。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 游戏百科或粉丝说明

en.concept: Descriptions of household and personal living circumstances
en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of household composition, absence of a householder's spouse, and living alone in demographic statistics, especially living alone followed by an age threshold. There are also sporadic activations in a game character skin entry and the “make a living” sense in a novel.

patterns.name: Living-alone phrase in demographic sentence structures
patterns.context: Describes household composition and the ages of people living alone in demographic paragraphs; activation is concentrated on living, often near someone, alone, who was, and an age threshold.

patterns.name: Householder gender and spouse-absent phrasing
patterns.context: Demographic text describing female or male householders with no spouse present; householder and no husband/wife present recur.

patterns.name: Nonfamily and one-person household statistics
patterns.context: A household-composition statistics sentence lists nonfamily households and households made up of one person, often next to percentages.

patterns.name: Number and names of hero skins
patterns.context: A game entry lists the number and ranking of character skins; activation falls on fragments of champion, have, and the proper name Ryze.

patterns.name: Poverty and making a living by selling odds and ends
patterns.context: In narrative dialogue, a poor old man is described as making a meager living by selling things; living has a different usage from its use in demographic statistics.

3_3047.concept: 家庭与个人生活状况表述
3_3047.description: 主要响应人口统计中家庭构成、户主配偶缺席及“独自生活”的表述，尤其 living alone 后接年龄阈值；另有游戏角色皮肤条目和小说中“谋生”用法的零散激活。

patterns.name: 人口统计句式中的独居短语
patterns.trigger: «someone» living «alone» who «was» 65 years of age or
patterns.context: 人口统计段落中，描述家庭构成与独居者年龄；触发集中在 living，周围常有 someone、alone、who was 和年龄阈值。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人口普查、家庭统计

patterns.name: 户主性别及配偶缺席表述
patterns.context: 人口统计中说明无配偶在场的女性或男性户主；反复出现 householder、no husband/wife present。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人口普查、家庭统计

patterns.name: 非家庭与个人户统计
patterns.context: 家庭构成的统计句中，列出非家庭户及由个人组成的家庭户，常与百分比相邻。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人口普查、家庭统计

patterns.name: 英雄皮肤数量及名字
patterns.trigger: «champion» to «have» eight skins；second «champion» with nine skins；«Ry»«ze»
patterns.context: 游戏条目列举角色皮肤数量与排名；激活落在 champion、have 和专名 Ryze 的片段上。

patterns.name: 贫困与靠出售杂物谋生
patterns.trigger: a «poor» old fellow；scanty «living» selling just such 'trash'
patterns.context: 叙事对话中描述一个贫困老人靠卖东西维持微薄生计；living 与人口统计中的 living 用法不同。

en.description: Most passages come from math exercises, with activations broadly distributed across numbers, problem templates, answers, and line breaks; topics include radicals/powers, base conversion, and remainders. A passage about sexism and a legal citation may be triggered by numbers, punctuation, or formatting, and do not fit a unified mathematical pattern.

patterns.name: number sequences in math Q&A
patterns.context: DM Mathematics problems and short answers appear consecutively; activations occur on numbers, problem templates, and line breaks, often in radical, exponent, and rounding problems

patterns.name: base-conversion problems
patterns.context: A number is followed by its source base and a request to convert it to a target base; problem and answer are separated by a line break

patterns.name: remainder problems
patterns.context: Asks for the remainder when one integer is divided by another, usually followed by a short numeric answer

patterns.name: quoted offensive language and reaction
patterns.context: The narrator quotes a sexist stereotype about women drivers and describes an angry reaction

patterns.name: paragraph and citation formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: Case citations in legal argument, accompanied by line breaks, quotations, and footnote-style formatting

3_3047.concept: 数字与结构化文本特征
3_3047.description: 多数段落来自数学练习，激活广泛分布于数字、运算题模板、答案及换行；覆盖根式/幂、进制转换和求余数。另有一段性别歧视叙述及一段法律引文，可能是数字、标点或排版触发，无法与数学模式统一。

patterns.name: 数学问答中的数字序列
patterns.trigger: 数字与运算表达式，如“32”“1/2”“145”，以及答案后的“↵”
patterns.context: DM Mathematics题目与短答案连续排列；数字、问题模板和换行处均可见激活，常出现根式、幂和取整题

patterns.name: 进制转换题
patterns.trigger: “(base 13) to base 8”“(base 16) to base 4”“Convert 16 (base 7) to base”
patterns.context: 数字后标注源进制，并要求转换到目标进制；题目与答案以换行分隔

patterns.name: 求余数题
patterns.trigger: “Calculate the remainder when”“What is the remainder when”
patterns.context: 询问一个整数除以另一个整数后的余数，题目后通常跟短数字答案

patterns.name: 带引号的冒犯性措辞及其反应
patterns.context: 叙述者引用针对女性驾驶者的性别刻板印象，并描述愤怒反应

patterns.name: 法律文书中的段落与引文格式
patterns.context: 法律论述中引用判例，伴随换行、引文和脚注式排版

en.concept: Mixed local word-form and formatting cues
en.description: Activation is concentrated on Here as a transition to analysis in court rulings, with sporadic hits on POSIX, proper-name fragments, judicial narratives, math problems, and demographic terms. These secondary hits have no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Here in court citations
patterns.context: After a case citation or procedural facts, “Here” introduces the court's analysis of the facts or issues in the current case; it is often followed by a comma.

patterns.name: POSIX identifiers
patterns.context: The character sequence POSIX is tokenized as fragments in technical descriptions of system compatibility, file times, or APIs.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-internal fragments of names or other proper nouns in legal case names, attorney lists, or citations.

patterns.name: Quotation/speech after a sentence-initial period and line break
patterns.context: A legal narrative first describes an event ending abruptly, then shifts to a new paragraph recounting a party's protest and arguments in a brief. The trigger position is unstable and may be affected by formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Fractional-exponent math problems
patterns.context: Natural-language questions ask for a fractional power of a number and request rounding to the nearest integer; the problems repeat consecutively.

patterns.name: Demographic phrasing
patterns.context: Describes statistics on householder gender, household composition, and age distribution.

3_3047.concept: 混合的局部词形与排版线索
3_3047.description: 激活集中于判决书中的 Here 分析转折，也零散落在 POSIX、专名片段、判决叙事、数学题和人口统计词语上；这些次要命中缺乏统一的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 法庭引文中的 Here
patterns.context: 判例引文或程序事实之后，以“Here”引出法院对当前案件事实或争点的分析；常紧接逗号。

patterns.name: POSIX 标识符
patterns.context: 字符序列 POSIX 被拆分标记，出现在系统兼容性、文件时间或 API 的技术说明中。

patterns.name: 专名内部的切分片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名或普通专名的词内片段，出现在法律案件名称、律师名单或引文中。

patterns.name: 句首句点与换行后的引号/话语
patterns.context: 法律叙述中先描述事件突然结束，随后换段叙述当事人的抗议及其简报主张。触发位置并不稳定，可能受排版边界影响。

patterns.name: 分数指数数学题
patterns.context: 以自然语言询问数值的分数次幂并要求取最近整数，题目连续重复。

patterns.name: 人口统计表述
patterns.context: 描述家庭户主性别、家庭构成及年龄分布的统计比例。

en.description: Primarily responds to “Here” introducing case-specific analysis after a citation in a court opinion; also responds more weakly to rulings, code header files/Go dependency paths, and phrasing about segmented modeling.

patterns.name: Here introducing case-specific analysis in court opinions
patterns.context: Appears after a case citation, procedural background, or legal rule, introducing the court’s application to the facts or arguments of the current case; often followed by a comma and factual assessment.

patterns.name: ruling statements in court opinions
patterns.context: After citing legal authority, transitions to the court’s conclusion based on the case record.

patterns.name: C/C++ header-file include directives
patterns.context: A code line uses a preprocessor directive to include a project header file; activations are distributed across path fragments and filenames.

patterns.name: Go dependency paths and module names
patterns.context: Dependency labels in build configuration or vendored Go package paths, containing repository paths and library target names.

patterns.name: divide-and-conquer modeling and data segmentation
patterns.context: Discusses splitting data and developing models for each segment to address difficulties with overall modeling.

3_3047.description: 主要响应判决书引证后以“Here”引入本案分析；另对裁判结论语、代码头文件/Go 依赖路径及分段建模措辞有较弱响应。

patterns.name: 判决书中的 Here 转入具体分析
patterns.context: 出现在判例引文、程序背景或法律规则之后，引出法院对当前案件事实或主张的适用分析；常与逗号及后续事实判断相连。

patterns.name: 判决书中的裁判结论表述
patterns.context: 引证法律依据后，转入法院对案件记录作出的结论。

patterns.name: C/C++ 头文件包含指令
patterns.context: 代码行以预处理指令包含项目内头文件；触发分散在路径片段和文件名中。

patterns.name: Go 依赖路径与模块名
patterns.context: 构建配置中的依赖标签或 vendored Go 包路径，含仓库路径与库目标名。

patterns.name: 分治建模及数据分段
patterns.trigger: “divide and conquer strategy”“models on segments of the data”
patterns.context: 讨论将数据拆分并在各段上开发模型，以应对整体建模困难。

en.description: Activation spans two kinds of corpus: legal boilerplate in appellate rulings about reviewing the record, deciding cases, and agreement facts; and code involving package imports, protocol paths, indentation and line breaks, directory reading, or exception comments. Specific trigger points vary.

patterns.name: Formulaic sentences in appellate opinions
patterns.context: Procedural narrative in which a court reviews the record, briefs, and legal standards before deciding an appeal or affirming a judgment; trigger points often fall on legal terms, decision verbs, and adjacent formatting punctuation.

patterns.name: Generated protocols and directory reading in Go code
patterns.context: In Go source files, occurs in import declarations, package paths, indentation and line breaks, or function implementations and comments; it does not respond only to a single identifier.

patterns.name: Repeated use of “assumption agreement”
patterns.context: Legal fact narratives describe an agreement under which another party assumes the loan balance and its terms of liability; activation falls on this phrase and its surrounding context.

patterns.name: Test-file and package-import format
patterns.context: Package declarations and multiline import blocks at the start of source files, especially formatting structures in Go test code.

patterns.name: Repetition in exception handling and documentation comments
patterns.context: In C# code, exception-handling statements are followed by XML-style documentation comments; activation is distributed across code, punctuation, indentation, and comment terminology.

3_3047.concept: 结构化技术与法律文本
3_3047.description: 激活覆盖两类语料：上诉裁判中审阅案卷、裁定及协议事实的法律套语；代码中包导入、协议路径、缩进换行、目录读取或异常注释。各处具体触发点不一致。

patterns.name: 上诉裁判文书公式语句
patterns.trigger: « appeal»、« oral»« argument»、« standard» of « review»、« briefs»、the « record»、the « Court» « finds»；以及« judgment» is « affirmed»、« Anders» v California、« conclude» that
patterns.context: 法院在审阅案卷、简报及法律标准后决定上诉或确认判决的程序性叙述；触发点常在法律术语、裁判动词及其相邻格式标点上。

patterns.name: Go代码中的生成协议与目录读取
patterns.context: Go源文件的导入声明、包路径、缩进换行，或函数实现与注释中；不只对某个单独标识符起反应。

patterns.name: 重复使用“assumption agreement”
patterns.context: 法律事实叙述中说明借款余额由他方承担的协议及其责任条款；具体激活落在该短语及邻近语境。

patterns.name: 测试文件与包导入格式
patterns.context: 源文件开头的包声明和多行导入块，尤其是 Go 测试代码中的格式结构。

patterns.name: 异常处理与文档注释中的 repetition
patterns.trigger: «throw» new System«.»2Exception、« unexpected»« error»；以及«///»<summary>、« specific»« repetition»
patterns.context: C#代码中异常处理语句后接 XML 风格文档注释；激活分布在代码、标点、缩进和注释术语上。

en.description: Activations span common legal-opinion words and citations, fragments of names, and proper-name fragments such as code paths/selectors, signatures, and drug names; they are cross-domain and mostly local word fragments, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: language in legal opinions and case records
patterns.context: Appears in statements by courts about the record, pleadings, standards of review, or appellate outcomes, often with phrases such as “we conclude,” “the record,” and “the briefs.”

patterns.name: fragments in citations and legal names
patterns.context: Embedded in case citations and the names of parties or attorneys; activation falls on tokenized name fragments.

patterns.name: encoded fragments in Go import paths
patterns.context: Appears near the Go source import path `golang.org/x/text/encoding`, composed of slashes and segmented identifiers.

patterns.name: XPath selectors in code
patterns.context: Python/Selenium-style code calls an XPath-based element lookup and constructs a selector containing `select[@id=...]`.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A or code snippets

patterns.name: license comments and Java package paths
patterns.context: In a Java package declaration following a license notice, the activated fragment belongs to an Apache internal function’s package name.
patterns.domain: GitHub Java source code and license comments

patterns.name: word-ending fragments in medical author names
patterns.context: In author/location lists in medical papers, activation appears within proper names rather than obvious medical terminology.

patterns.name: fragments within drug names
patterns.context: In clinical descriptions of drug dosages and regimens, activation falls within drug names; other drugs and dosages are listed in the same passage.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central clinical cases or treatment records

3_3047.description: 激活分布在法律判决常用词与引证、人名片段，以及代码路径/选择器、署名和药名等专名片段；跨领域且多为局部词片段，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律意见与判决记录用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院对案卷、诉状、审查标准或上诉结果的表述中，常与“we conclude”“the record”“the briefs”等搭配。

patterns.name: 引证与法律人名中的片段
patterns.context: 嵌在案件引证、当事人或律师姓名中；激活具体落在被切分的人名片段上。

patterns.name: Go 导入路径中的编码片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Go 源码的 import 路径 `golang.org/x/text/encoding` 附近，路径由斜杠和分段标识符组成。

patterns.name: 代码中的 XPath 选择器
patterns.context: Python/Selenium 风格代码中调用按 XPath 查找元素，并构造包含 `select[@id=...]` 的选择器。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答或代码片段

patterns.name: 许可证注释与 Java 包路径
patterns.context: 许可证说明之后的 Java 包声明中，触发片段属于 Apache 内部函数的包名。
patterns.domain: GitHub Java 源码及许可证注释

patterns.name: 医学作者姓名中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 医学论文作者/地点列表中，激活出现在专名内部，而非明显的医学术语上。

patterns.name: 药物名称内部片段
patterns.context: 药物剂量和给药方案的临床叙述中，激活落在药名内部；同段还列有其他药物和剂量。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 临床病例或治疗记录

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal citations and judicial wording, subword fragments in proper names/model numbers, small words in forums, and code selectors; there is no stable, single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: avi in names
patterns.context: Within Iranian given names, activation falls on spelling fragments.

patterns.name: ht in names
patterns.context: Within Iranian surnames, activation falls on split letter fragments.

patterns.name: Numbers and letters in statutory citations
patterns.context: Legal case citations mark volumes, page numbers, years, and other elements; fragments in case names are also marked in the same passage, such as «CO», «Y», «v», «.», «T», «ANG», «IP».

patterns.name: Informal function words and measurement expressions
patterns.context: Several common small words are marked in informal forum text; strong activation occurs after “as” in an expression measuring lines of code.

patterns.name: Segmented spelling in aircraft names
patterns.context: Aircraft models and names are marked in segments, especially the letter fragment in the middle of the name Sk​​y​​train.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in sarcastic expressions
patterns.context: In hostile or mocking sentences, activation falls on subword fragments in compound insults; a phrase in the same passage is also weakly marked.

patterns.name: Skyt in names
patterns.context: Marked letter fragments appear within historical figures’ names.

patterns.name: Judgment conclusions and legal-document wording
patterns.context: In standard wording in appellate decisions, multiple legal nouns, verbs, and expressions of conclusion are marked.

patterns.name: Code selectors and path fragments
patterns.context: XPath selectors and nearby method names and identifiers are marked in web automation code.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in discussions of online etiquette
patterns.context: Ordinary words and truncated or segmented text both activate in forum discussions about etiquette for linking to blogs.

patterns.name: Case citations and wording of factual issues
patterns.context: Punctuation and volume/page numbers in legal citations, as well as fragments such as Here and triable in the body of a judgment, are marked.

3_3047.description: 激活分散在法律引文与判决措辞、专名/型号的词内片段、论坛小词及代码选择器中；没有稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 名字中的 avi
patterns.context: 在伊朗人名的内部，激活落在名字的拼写片段上。

patterns.name: 名字中的 ht
patterns.context: 在伊朗姓氏内部，激活落在被拆分的字母片段上。

patterns.name: 法条引文中的数字与字母
patterns.context: 法律判例引文中，卷册、页码和年份等被标记；同段还标记案件名称中的片段，如 «CO»、«Y»、«v»、«.»、«T»、«ANG»、«IP»。

patterns.name: 口语功能词及度量表达
patterns.context: 非正式论坛文字中，多个常见小词被标记；强激活出现在“as”之后、度量代码行数的表达中。

patterns.name: 飞机名称中的分段拼写
patterns.context: 航空器型号及名称被拆分标记，尤其是 Sk​​y​​train 名称中间的字母片段。

patterns.name: 讽刺表达中的词内片段
patterns.context: 攻击性或挖苦语气的句子中，激活落在复合辱称的词内片段；同段另有弱标记的短语。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的幽默/讽刺文本

patterns.name: 人名中的 Skyt
patterns.context: 历史人物姓名内部出现被标记的字母片段。

patterns.name: 判决结论与法律文书用语
patterns.trigger: « judgment»、« affirmed»、« brief»、« filed»、« record»、« conclude»
patterns.context: 上诉判决的固定措辞中，多个法律名词、动词及结论性表达被标记。

patterns.name: 代码选择器与路径片段
patterns.context: 网页自动化代码中，XPath 选择器及其周边方法名、标识符被标记。

patterns.name: 网络礼仪讨论中的词片段
patterns.context: 论坛讨论博客链接礼仪时，普通词语和被截断或分段的文本都出现激活。

patterns.name: 判例引文及事实争点措辞
patterns.context: 法律引文的标点、卷页数字，以及判决正文中的 Here 和 triable 等片段被标记。

en.concept: multiple local patterns in code and text
en.description: Responses are scattered: yt in proper names, keyboard API paths, GMP/C++ identifiers, options-writing terminology, the phrase “no such thing as,” and indentation/type words in type tables, with no unified trigger.

patterns.name: Skyttrain / Skytte proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the substring “yt” within proper names, appearing in an aircraft name and a personal name.

patterns.name: keyboard-event API paths
patterns.context: Path components and keyboard-event-related identifiers in MDN Web API documentation URLs.

patterns.name: GMP and related code identifiers
patterns.context: Near C/C++ preprocessor directives, header paths, library names, or type names; trigger locations vary.

patterns.name: trade writing and returns terminology
patterns.context: Explanations of options trading discuss selling, returns, and writing covered calls; “as” is also strongly marked.

patterns.name: fixed phrase “no such thing as”
patterns.context: In the phrase “There is no such thing as …,” followed by different nouns; not tied to a specific topic.

patterns.name: structured fields and type tables
patterns.context: In aligned columns of field names, indentation, and type declarations, activations occur near tabs and type words.

3_3047.concept: 多类代码与文本局部模式
3_3047.description: 响应分散：专名中的 yt、键盘 API 路径、GMP/C++ 标识符、期权写入术语、“no such thing as”句式及类型表的缩进/类型词，缺少统一触发条件。

patterns.name: Skyttrain / Skytte 专名片段
patterns.context: 在专名内部，激活落在子串“yt”上；分别位于飞机名称和人名中。

patterns.name: 键盘事件 API 路径
patterns.context: MDN Web API 文档 URL 中的路径组件及键盘事件相关标识符。

patterns.name: GMP 及相关代码标识符
patterns.context: C/C++ 预处理指令、头文件路径、库名或类型名附近；各处触发位置并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 交易写入与收益术语
patterns.context: 期权买卖解释中，讨论卖出、收益及写出买入合约；“as”也被强烈标记。

patterns.name: 固定短语“no such thing as”
patterns.context: 短语“There is no such thing as …”中，后接不同名词；不依赖特定话题。

patterns.name: 结构化字段与类型表
patterns.context: 按列排列的字段名、缩进和类型声明中，制表符及类型词附近激活。

en.concept: The “there is no such thing as” construction and formatting markers
en.description: Most passages show strong activation on “as” in fixed expressions such as “There is no such thing as”; other, unrelated formatting fragments include web/API paths, TCP source headers, legal citations, and reporting options.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “there is no such thing as”
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on “as” near the end of the phrase (intensity 10); sometimes the phrase is preceded by a negation or question structure and followed by something asserted not to exist
patterns.domain: Forum dialogue, Q&A, comments, and general prose

patterns.name: Web document and API path markers
patterns.context: URLs, slashes, and API name sequences in GitHub page addresses and MDN documentation paths
patterns.domain: Code hosting and web technical documentation

patterns.name: Keyboard event API names
patterns.context: Marks keyboard-related interfaces embedded in MDN Web API documentation URLs

patterns.name: TCP source files and version identifiers
patterns.context: File names, operating system names, directory paths, and version information in source-code comment headers

patterns.name: Numbers and case-name formatting in legal citations
patterns.context: Citation strings in court opinions composed of volume numbers, report abbreviations, page numbers, and case names

patterns.name: Moderation/reporting option lists
patterns.context: Reasons for reporting or flagging content are described in the first person, with multiple options listed consecutively

3_3047.concept: “there is no such thing as”句式及格式标记
3_3047.description: 多数段落在“There is no such thing as”一类固定表达的“as”处强激活；另有网页/API 路径、TCP 源码头、法律引证和举报选项等彼此不同的格式性片段。

patterns.name: 固定表达“there is no such thing as”
patterns.trigger: “There is no such thing as”及其变体“there is no such thing”“there such thing as”
patterns.context: 激活集中在短语后部的 “as”（强度10）；有时短语前带否定或疑问结构，后接被断言不存在的事物
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、问答、评论及一般论述

patterns.name: 网页文档与 API 路径标记
patterns.context: GitHub 页面地址与 MDN 文档路径中的 URL、斜杠和 API 名称序列
patterns.domain: 代码托管与网页技术文档

patterns.name: 键盘事件 API 名称
patterns.context: 嵌在 MDN Web API 文档 URL 中，标记键盘按键相关接口

patterns.name: TCP 源码文件及版本标识
patterns.context: 源码注释头部中的文件名、操作系统名、目录路径与版本信息

patterns.name: 法律引证中的数字与案名格式
patterns.context: 判决文本中以卷号、报告集缩写、页码和案名组成的引证串

patterns.name: 审核/举报选项列表
patterns.trigger: “This is NOT abusive”“It is spam / self promotion”“It is offensive or harmful”
patterns.context: 界面中以第一人称说明举报或标记内容的理由，多个选项连续排列

en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments within proper names (Pharoah/Pharo, Skytte, Tyner), code identifier fragments, all-caps organization names, sentence-final periods, and the mathematical term “denominator”; there is no unified semantics or clear stylistic condition across passages.

patterns.name: Pharoah string fragments
patterns.context: Letter fragments occur in a person’s name or software name; the most salient commonality is the tokenized Pharoah/Pharo substring

patterns.name: Skytte string fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within the proper name Skytte; “Sk«yt»rain” in [9] contains the same letter fragment, but its context is an aircraft model

patterns.name: Decimal points
patterns.context: Periods end complete statements; they occur mainly in the community moderation option list in [1]

patterns.name: Integer string fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in code identifiers or type names; positions and meanings vary, with no stable semantic condition observed

patterns.name: ner fragment within a name
patterns.context: Activation falls within the surname of jazz musician McCoy Tyner

patterns.name: All-caps name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within all-caps organization names in legal texts

patterns.name: Decimal denominator
patterns.context: A math problem asks for the common denominator of two fractions

patterns.name: sock fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Socket variable and struct field identifiers in C code

3_3047.description: 激活分散于专名内部片段（Pharoah/Pharo、Skytte、Tyner）、代码标识符片段、全大写机构名、句末句点及数学术语“denominator”；跨段没有统一语义或明显文体条件。

patterns.name: Pharoah 字符串片段
patterns.trigger: «Ph»...«aro»，尤其是 «aro»；在 [2]、[4]、[6] 中形成 “Pharoah” 或 “Pharo”
patterns.context: 字母片段处于人名或软件名称中；最显著的共同点是分词后的 Pharoah/Pharo 子串
patterns.domain: 爵士乐人物介绍、软件讨论

patterns.name: Skytte 字符串片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Skytte 内；[9] 的 “Sk«yt»rain” 也包含相同字母片段，但上下文是飞机型号
patterns.domain: 历史条目、军事航空列表

patterns.name: 十进制小数点
patterns.trigger: «.»5，位于 “NOT abusive.”、“by accident.” 等句末句点
patterns.context: 句号结束完整陈述；主要集中于 [1] 的社区审核选项列表

patterns.name: 整数字符串片段
patterns.context: 出现在代码标识符或类型名中；不同位置和含义，未见稳定语义条件

patterns.name: 名字内部的 ner 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在爵士音乐家 McCoy Tyner 的姓氏内部

patterns.name: 全大写姓名片段
