patterns.name: 小数分母
patterns.context: 数学题询问两个分数的共同分母

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 sock 片段
patterns.context: C 代码中的套接字变量与结构体字段标识符

en.description: Activation patterns are diverse: numbers, minus signs, bases, and multiplication stand out in math problems; other passages concern report labels, Web API links, Go imports, string examples, medical devices, and patent-law wording.

patterns.name: numeric and arithmetic expressions in math problems
patterns.context: In exercise or Q&A-style math text, asks for a product, multiplication, or conversion of a number from one base to another; a numeric answer often follows immediately

patterns.name: interface feedback labels and category options
patterns.context: In webpage or platform feedback forms, explains why an option was clicked by mistake or selects a content-report category; activation concentrates on label words and periods

patterns.name: keyboard-event APIs and key-value documentation paths
patterns.context: Repository text cites MDN documentation links whose paths contain pages about keyboard events or key values

patterns.name: testing and text-encoding imports in Go source
patterns.context: Go package declarations and import lists appear after a BSD-style license

patterns.name: strings and API documentation links in code examples
patterns.context: Q&A or examples concern the string type of an object property and include an MDN API documentation link

patterns.name: medical-device terminology
patterns.context: Describes a tension-free sling system and its placement, related complications, and device names

patterns.name: patent novelty and prior-art wording
patterns.context: In patent background or invention descriptions, fixed legal language states that a new device was not anticipated or suggested by prior art

3_3047.description: 激活模式多样：数学题中突出数字、负号、进制与乘法；其他段分别涉及举报标签、Web API 链接、Go 导入、字符串示例、医学器械及专利法律措辞。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数值与运算表达
patterns.trigger: 如 “0.60”“-4 times -0.021463”“the product of -0.406 and -0.05”“(base 6) in base 4”；强标记常落在数字片段、负号或运算词上
patterns.context: 练习题或问答式数学文本中，要求计算乘积、乘法，或将数从一种进制转换到另一种进制；题后常紧跟数值答案

patterns.name: 界面反馈标签与分类选项
patterns.trigger: “This is NOT abusive.”、“I pressed this button by accident.”、“It is spam / self promotion.”、“It is offensive or harmful.”
patterns.context: 网页或平台的反馈表单中，说明误点原因或选择内容举报类别；激活集中于标签词和句号

patterns.name: 键盘事件 API 与键值文档路径
patterns.context: 代码仓库文本引用 MDN 文档链接，路径包含键盘事件或按键值相关页面

patterns.name: Go 源码中的测试与文本编码导入
patterns.context: BSD 风格许可证之后出现 Go 包声明和导入列表

patterns.name: 代码示例中的字符串和 API 文档链接
patterns.context: 问答或示例围绕对象属性值的字符串类型，并附 MDN API 文档链接

patterns.name: 医学器械相关术语
patterns.context: 描述无张力吊带系统及其放置方式、相关并发症和器械名称

patterns.name: 专利新颖性与现有技术措辞
patterns.trigger: “not anticipated, rendered obvious, suggested, or even implied by any of the prior art”
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明描述中，以固定法律措辞说明新器械未被现有技术预见或暗示

en.concept: Gynecology character fragments and miscellaneous patterns
en.description: Activations concentrate on segmented fragments of obstetric and gynecological terms such as Gynecology/Gynecare; other examples include base conversion, decimal multiplication Q&A, reporting-interface text, and XPath locator code, with the latter patterns differing in topic.

patterns.name: Gynecology character segmentation
patterns.context: Strings such as Gynecology and Gynecare occur in medical terms or proper names, segmented into fragments such as Gy and ne.
patterns.domain: Medicine, obstetrics and gynecology, and related proper names

patterns.name: Number-base conversion
patterns.context: Math questions ask for a number to be converted from one base to another; the answer usually starts on a new line.

patterns.name: Multiplication and decimal arithmetic
patterns.context: Questions beginning with “What is …” ask for a decimal product or integer multiplication and provide the result.

patterns.name: Reporting options and interface text
patterns.context: Web or community reporting interfaces explain reporting categories and mention accidentally clicking a button.

patterns.name: XPath element locator code
patterns.context: URLs or code snippets contain Selenium-style element searches and XPath expressions.

3_3047.concept: Gynecology 字符片段及杂项模式
3_3047.description: 激活集中于 Gynecology/Gynecare 等妇产科术语的切分片段；另见进制转换、小数乘法问答、举报界面文本及 XPath 定位代码，后几类彼此主题不同。

patterns.name: Gynecology 字符切分
patterns.context: 医学术语或专名中出现 Gynecology、Gynecare 等以 Gy、ne 等片段切分的字符串。
patterns.domain: 医学、妇产科及相关专名

patterns.name: 数字进制转换
patterns.context: 数学问答中要求将数字从一种进制转换到另一种进制，答案通常另起一行。

patterns.name: 乘法与小数运算
patterns.context: 以“What is …”提问，计算小数乘积或整数乘法，并给出结果。

patterns.name: 举报选项及界面文本
patterns.context: 网页或社区举报界面中解释举报类别，并提及误按按钮。

patterns.name: XPath 元素定位代码
patterns.context: 网址或代码片段中出现 Selenium 风格的元素查找及 XPath 表达式。

en.concept: Mathematical arithmetic problem text and symbols
en.description: Primarily responds to arithmetic problems in math exercises: multiplication wording, numbers and operators, and the “base” expression in base-conversion problems; there is also an isolated feedback-form passage containing “Other” and moderation reasons.

patterns.name: “base” in base-conversion problems
patterns.context: Asks for a number’s representation in another base, often with parentheses, digit strings, or base arithmetic; activation concentrates on the problem text rather than the answer.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, base conversion and base arithmetic problems

patterns.name: Fixed wording in multiplication problems
patterns.context: Arithmetic Q&A or exercises alternating between problem and answer; values may be integers, decimals, positive or negative numbers, and the multiplication symbol may be written as “*”.

patterns.name: Scattered activation on numbers and operators
patterns.context: Occurs in arithmetic problems or their calculated results; activation falls at multiple positions on numbers and symbols, with no one numeric format dominating.

patterns.name: Feedback options and moderation reasons
patterns.context: Appears as options and explanations in feedback or content moderation forms; has no clear semantic connection to math problems.

3_3047.concept: 数学算术题文本与符号
3_3047.description: 主要响应数学练习中的算术题：乘法措辞、数字与运算符，以及进制转换题中的“base”表达；另有一段孤立的反馈表单文本，含“Other”和审核理由。

patterns.name: 基数转换题中的“base”
patterns.context: 询问数在另一进制中的表示，常带有括号、数字串或进制算术；触发集中在题目文本而非答案。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，进制转换与进制算术题

patterns.name: 乘法题的固定措辞
patterns.context: 算术问答或题目与答案交替的练习文本；数值可为整数、小数、正负数，乘法符号也可能写作“*”。

patterns.name: 数字与运算符的分散激活
patterns.context: 出现在算术问题或其计算结果中；激活落在数字和符号的多个位置，未见某一种数值格式独占。

patterns.name: 反馈选项与审核理由
patterns.trigger: “Other:” “This is NOT abusive.” “I pressed this button by accident.” “It is spam / self promotion.” “It is offensive or harmful.”
patterns.context: 作为反馈或内容审核表单中的选项及其解释出现；与数学题无明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 网页反馈／内容审核文本

en.description: Primarily activates on text related to arithmetic problems and base representations, conversions, and calculations in math Q&A; it also activates on a web interface passage containing answer feedback and content-reporting options.

patterns.name: Decimal multiplication Q&A
patterns.context: A natural-language question asks for the product of two numbers, followed by a newline and a numeric answer; decimals and negative numbers are common

patterns.name: Base-conversion problems
patterns.context: Given a number and source and target bases, the task is to convert it or provide the converted answer; numbers may contain letters or minus signs, and the bases vary

patterns.name: Base-arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Addition or subtraction is performed in a specified base, often with the result given in Q&A format

patterns.name: Moderation feedback and reporting options
patterns.context: A brief thank-you and evaluation of an answer are followed by content moderation/reporting reasons
patterns.domain: Pile-CC web or platform interface text

3_3047.concept: 数学问答与进制算术文本
3_3047.description: 主要对数学问答中运算题与进制表示、转换及计算相关文本激活；另对一段含答案评价和内容举报选项的网页界面文本激活。

patterns.name: 十进制乘法问答
patterns.trigger: “What is the product of”／“times”，以及带小数或负数的数值
patterns.context: 以自然语言提问两数乘积，后接换行和数值答案；常见小数、负数

patterns.name: 进制转换题
patterns.context: 给定数字和源、目标进制，要求转换或呈现转换答案；数字可含字母、负号，进制范围多样

patterns.name: 进制算术题
patterns.trigger: “In base”／“base”，以及“what is”；数值之间有“+”或“-”
patterns.context: 指定某进制后进行加减运算，常以问答格式给出结果

patterns.name: 审核反馈与举报选项
patterns.trigger: “Other:”“This is NOT abusive.”及“It is spam / self promotion.”等选项文字
patterns.context: 先有简短感谢和对答案的评价，随后列出内容审核/举报理由
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页或平台界面文本

en.concept: math problems and structured task prompts
en.description: Primarily responds to product/times wording in multiplication exercises and the base/in base/to base format in base-conversion problems; also responds to report options and form language in a webpage moderation passage.

patterns.name: connective wording in multiplication problems
patterns.context: Appears in math problems asking for the product of two numbers, usually followed immediately by an arithmetic answer; numbers may be positive, negative, decimal, or integer

patterns.name: base expressions in base-conversion problems
patterns.context: Requests conversion or representation of a number in different bases; nearby words often include numbers, base labels, and an answer on the following line

patterns.name: moderation/report options in feedback forms
patterns.context: Community moderation or report-form context; an evaluation of the answer comes first, followed by report options and a description of accidentally pressing a button
patterns.domain: Pile-CC webpage comments or form text

3_3047.concept: 数学题与结构化任务提示词
3_3047.description: 主要响应数学练习中乘法题的 product/times 等表述，以及进制转换题的 base/in base/to base 格式；另在一段网页审核文本中响应举报选项与表单用语。

patterns.name: 乘法题中的连接词
patterns.trigger: “What is the product of”“Product of”“times”“Calculate”；其中“product”标记较强，“times”较弱
patterns.context: 出现在询问两个数乘积、通常紧接着给出算式答案的数学题中；数字可为正负数、小数或整数

patterns.name: 进制转换题中的基数表述
patterns.context: 要求在不同进制之间转换或表示数；相关词周围常有数字、进制标号及换行后的答案
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 进制转换练习

patterns.name: 反馈表单中的审核/举报选项
patterns.trigger: “Other:”“NOT abusive”“spam / self promotion”“offensive or harmful”；另有“Thank you!”和“button”
patterns.context: 社区内容审核或举报表单语境；先有对答案的评价，随后列出举报选项，并描述误按按钮
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页评论或表单文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across Gromov geometry terminology, numbers and symbols in arithmetic multiplication problems, path/XPath fragments in code, and self in moderation categories; these patterns come from different contexts, with no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: Gromov terminology and name segmentation
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on segmented fragments of the spelling Gromov; H is sometimes also marked. Occurs in math abstracts, paper body text, or mathematical discussions.
patterns.domain: Geometry, math papers, and math Q&A

patterns.name: Numbers and minus signs in multiplication problems
patterns.context: In sequences of arithmetic Q&A, the prompt asks for the product or “times” of two numbers; numbers are often split into multiple tokens, and activation primarily falls on operator symbols and number fragments.

patterns.name: path and XPath in code identifiers
patterns.context: Java package paths or Selenium find_element_by_xpath calls appear in code or web automation examples; activation tends toward fragments within the path/XPath identifiers.
patterns.domain: Code, web automation, and software documentation

patterns.name: Comment moderation category terms
patterns.context: Lists reasons for whether a comment violates rules, including options for accidentally clicking a button or self-promotion; self shows the clearest activation in this passage.

3_3047.description: 激活分散于 Gromov 几何术语、算术乘法题的数字与符号、代码中的 path/XPath 片段，以及审核分类中的 self；这些模式来自不同语境，未见单一稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: Gromov 术语与姓名切分
patterns.trigger: «rom»、«ov»，以及相邻的未标记/标记字符串，如 “G«rom»3«ov»10”、“G«rom»2«ov»10-«H»2ausdorff”
patterns.context: 激活集中在被拆分标记的 Gromov 拼写片段；有时连带 H 被标记。出现在数学摘要、论文正文或数学讨论中。
patterns.domain: 几何、数学论文与数学问答

patterns.name: 乘法题中的数字与负号
patterns.trigger: “product”周围的数字、标点及负号，例如 «product»、“«-»10”、“«.»”、以及被分段标记的数字
patterns.context: 连续的算术问答中，题干询问两个数的乘积或“times”，数字常被切成多个 token；激活主要落在运算符号和数字片段。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 path 与 XPath
patterns.trigger: «path»，以及 XPath 代码中的 “«_»”“«by»”“«x»”“«path»”“«Opt»”“«contains»” 等片段
patterns.context: 代码或网页自动化示例中，出现 Java 包路径或 Selenium 的 find_element_by_xpath 调用；激活偏向 path/XPath 标识符内部片段。
patterns.domain: 代码、网页自动化与软件文档

patterns.name: 评论审核分类词
patterns.trigger: «self»，以及 “abusive”“spam”“offensive”“harmful”等审核选项附近的标记
patterns.context: 列举评论是否违规的分类理由，且包含用户误按按钮或自我推广等选项；此段最明显的激活是 self。
patterns.domain: 问答网站评论/审核界面文本

en.description: Activations occur on the Gromov word form, product calculation problems, and base-conversion problems in math text; there is also strong activation on self promotion in moderation options. The patterns belong to different contexts and are difficult to group under a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Gromov word form
patterns.context: Gromov is tokenized into rom, ov, and other tokens in math abstracts, research articles, or related discussions.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, especially geometry and mathematical physics

patterns.name: Product-problem prompt
patterns.context: Arithmetic exercises ask for the product of two numbers, usually followed by numbers, an answer, and a newline.

patterns.name: Base-conversion prompt
patterns.context: The problem asks for conversion between different bases, with base markers and digit strings nearby.

patterns.name: self promotion in moderation options
patterns.context: Listed alongside categories such as spam, offensive, and harmful in content moderation or reporting options.

3_3047.concept: 数学文本与固定提示语
3_3047.description: 激活见于数学文本中的 Gromov 词形、乘积计算题和进制转换题；另在审核选项短语 self promotion 上强烈激活。模式分属不同语境，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: Gromov 词形
patterns.context: Gromov 被切分为 rom、ov 等 token，出现在数学论文摘要、研究文章或相关讨论中。
patterns.domain: 数学，尤其几何与数学物理

patterns.name: 乘积题提示语
patterns.trigger: « the»…« product»…« of»；«What»…« is»…« the»…« product»；« times»
patterns.context: 算术练习中询问两个数的乘积，通常后接数字、答案及换行。

patterns.name: 进制转换提示语
patterns.context: 题目要求在不同进制之间转换，周围包含进制标记和数字串。

patterns.name: 审核选项中的 self promotion
patterns.context: 内容审核或举报选项列表中，和 spam、offensive、harmful 等类别并列。

en.concept: Local word fragments across multiple domains and multiplication-expression features
en.description: Activations span multiple domains: in math multiplication exercises they tend toward minus signs, product prompts, and expressions; they also occur in Gromov-like proper-name fragments, the moderation option “self promotion,” and license disclaimer wording.

patterns.name: Minus signs in math multiplication problems
patterns.context: Minus signs appear before negative numbers in multiplication expressions or “times” questions; also includes multiplication of a negative and positive number.

patterns.name: Product-problem wording
patterns.context: Prompts for multiplication problems and nearby numbers, multiplication signs, and answers; activation also occurs at some numeric values and result positions.

patterns.name: Fragments within Gromov proper names
patterns.context: In mathematical proper names such as Gromov or Gromov–Hausdorff, activation concentrates on the character fragments rom/ov, with hyphens or other proper-name components nearby.

patterns.name: Self-promotion moderation option
patterns.context: Listed alongside categories such as spam, abusive, and offensive among reporting or moderation options.

patterns.name: Legal wording in Java comments
patterns.context: Software license disclaimer wording followed by license, permission, and restriction terms.

3_3047.concept: 多领域局部词片段与乘法算式特征
3_3047.description: 激活跨多个领域：数学乘法练习中偏向负号、乘积题干及算式；另在 Gromov 类专名片段、审核选项“self promotion”和许可证免责声明措辞中出现。

patterns.name: 数学乘法题中的负号
patterns.context: 乘法算式或“times”题目中，负号出现在负数前；还包括负数与正数相乘。

patterns.name: 乘积题型措辞
patterns.context: 乘法问题的题干，以及相邻的数字、乘号和答案；激活也出现在部分数值与结果位置。

patterns.name: Gromov 专名内部片段
patterns.context: Gromov 或 Gromov–Hausdorff 等数学专名中，激活集中在 rom/ov 字符片段，周围出现连字符或其他专名成分。

patterns.name: 审核选项中的自我推广
patterns.context: 列举举报或审核选项时，与 spam、abusive、offensive 等分类并列。
patterns.domain: 用户界面／内容审核文本

patterns.name: Java 注释中的法律措辞
patterns.context: 软件许可证免责声明句式，后接许可证、权限与限制条款。

en.description: The strongest pattern is multiplication problems and product wording; weaker activations also occur in an internal fragment of the mathematical term Gromov, community report-option language, and financial trading vocabulary. Each has a clear local lexical trigger.

patterns.name: product wording in multiplication problems
patterns.context: Appears in problems asking for the product of two numbers; negative numbers and decimals are common, and passages mix questions with answers.

patterns.name: Gromov name fragment
patterns.context: The name or term appears in mathematical text concerning abstracts, distances, or invariants; activation falls on a fragment within the name.
patterns.domain: ArXiv math abstracts, StackExchange math Q&A

patterns.name: community report-option wording
patterns.context: Discusses answer quality or explains the options and meanings of a report button.

patterns.name: selling and cash in financial trading
patterns.context: Discusses options or trading contracts, premiums, and ways to profit.

3_3047.description: 最强模式是乘法题及乘积措辞；另对数学术语 Gromov 的内部片段、社区举报选项语言，以及金融交易词汇有较弱激活。各类均有明确的局部词汇触发。

patterns.name: 乘法题中的乘积措辞
patterns.trigger: “the product of”, “Product of”, “times”, “Multiply”及相邻的乘数
patterns.context: 出现在询问两个数乘积的题目中；常见负数、小数，且段内混有题目和答案。

patterns.name: Gromov 名称片段
patterns.context: 数学文本中该人名或术语出现于抽象、距离或不变量相关表述；激活落在名称内部片段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学摘要、StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: 社区举报选项措辞
patterns.context: 讨论回答质量或解释举报按钮的选项及其含义。

patterns.name: 金融交易中的卖出与现金
patterns.context: 讨论期权或买卖合约、溢价及获利方式。

en.description: Primarily responds to prompts in multiplication exercises, especially expressions asking for a product or multiple; weaker activation also occurs on Gromov terminology, technical documentation and link fragments, Go code paths, and base-conversion prompts.

patterns.name: Multiplication problem prompt
patterns.context: Math exercises ask for the product of two numbers, often with minus signs, decimals, and calculation results on a new line; number tokens themselves generally do not activate

patterns.name: Gromov lexical fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in terms such as Gromov–Hausdorff distance or Gromov non-hyperbolicity

patterns.name: Specific lead-in words and link fragments
patterns.context: Words or token fragments in installation instructions and URLs; activation is weak, with no context matching arithmetic problems

patterns.name: Go paths and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in vendor paths, Go client libraries, and identifiers

patterns.name: Base-representation prompt
patterns.context: Asks for a number’s representation in a specified base, including a base label in parentheses

3_3047.description: 主要响应乘法练习中的题目提示语，尤其是询问乘积或倍数的表达；另对 Gromov 术语、技术文档与链接片段、Go 代码路径及进制转换提示语有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 乘法题提示语
patterns.trigger: “What is the product of”“What is … times”“Product of”“Calculate”
patterns.context: 数学练习中询问两个数的乘积，常伴随负号、小数及换行后的计算结果；数字 token 本身多不激活

patterns.name: Gromov 词汇片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Gromov–Hausdorff distance 或 Gromov non-hyperbolicity 等术语中

patterns.name: 特定引导词与链接片段
patterns.context: 安装说明及 URL 中的词或分词片段；触发较弱，未见与算术题相同的上下文

patterns.name: Go 路径与标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 vendor 路径、Go 客户端库及标识符中

patterns.name: 进制表示提示语
patterns.context: 询问一个数在指定进制下的表示，包含括号中的 base 标注

en.description: Primarily responds to product, times, and adjacent numeric expressions in multiplication exercises (including negatives, decimals, and asterisks); also responds to base-conversion problems. Other triggers are scattered across Go configuration paths, moderation comments, format-string security discussions, and Java license source code.

patterns.name: product wording in multiplication problems
patterns.context: Asks for the product of two numbers in math exercises; operands are often positive or negative decimals, and an answer usually follows the problem.

patterns.name: operator notation in multiplication problems
patterns.context: Multiplication is written with an asterisk or in words, appearing in equations or “Calculate” problems; numbers are not limited to decimals.

patterns.name: base-conversion questions
patterns.context: Asks to convert a number from one base to another; the passage also contains subsequent problems or answers.

patterns.name: default library paths and configuration identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in Go dependency or configuration paths, containing directory names, package names, and underscore-separated identifiers.

patterns.name: positive answer feedback and report categories in comments
patterns.context: First evaluates an answer positively, then lists content moderation or report reasons and whether a button was pressed by mistake.

patterns.name: code-expression security discussions
patterns.context: Discusses automatic evaluation of expressions in format strings and requirements for variable lists.

patterns.name: license statements and Java package paths
patterns.context: Legal disclaimers occur directly next to Apache-style license comments and Java package declarations.

3_3047.description: 主要响应乘法练习中的 product、times 及相邻数值算式（含负数、小数和星号）；另响应进制转换题。其余触发分散于 Go 配置路径、审核评论、格式字符串安全讨论及 Java 许可证源码。

patterns.name: 乘法题中的乘积措辞
patterns.context: 在数学练习题中询问两个数的乘积；操作数常为带小数的正数或负数，题后通常接答案。

patterns.name: 乘法题中的运算符写法
patterns.context: 以星号或文字表示乘法，出现在算式或“Calculate”题目中；数值并不限于小数。

patterns.name: 进制转换提问
patterns.context: 询问一个数从一种进制转换到另一种进制，片段还包含后续题目或答案。

patterns.name: 默认库路径与配置标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 Go 依赖或配置路径中，包含目录名、包名及下划线连接的标识符。

patterns.name: 评论中的答案肯定与举报类别
patterns.trigger: “only real answer”“abusive”“spam / self promotion”“offensive or harmful”
patterns.context: 先评价回答有效，再列出内容审核或举报理由及是否误触按钮。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页评论/审核文本

patterns.name: 代码表达式安全讨论
patterns.trigger: “Security concerns”“automatic evaluation of expressions”“explicit list of variables”
patterns.context: 讨论格式字符串中的表达式自动求值及变量列表要求。

patterns.name: 许可证声明与 Java 包路径
patterns.trigger: “KIND, either express or implied”“See the License”“package com.sun.org.apache.xpath”
patterns.context: 法律免责声明紧邻 Apache 风格许可证注释和 Java 包声明。
